abstract.text: Importance: Monitoring emergency care quality requires understanding which conditions benefit most from timely, quality emergency care. Objectives: To identify a set of emergency care-sensitive conditions (ECSCs) that are treated in most emergency departments (EDs), are associated with a spectrum of adult age groups, and represent common reasons for seeking emergency care and to provide benchmark national estimates of ECSC acute care utilization. Design, Setting, and Participants: A modified Delphi method was used to identify ECSCs. In a cross-sectional analysis, ECSC-associated visits by adults (aged ≥18 years) were identified based on International Statistical Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision, Clinical Modification diagnosis codes and analyzed with nationally representative data from the 2016 US Nationwide Emergency Department Sample. Data analysis was conducted from January 2018 to December 2018. Main Outcomes and Measures: Identification of ECSCs and ECSC-associated ED utilization patterns, length of stay, and charges. Results: An expert panel rated 51 condition groups as emergency care sensitive. Emergency care-sensitive conditions represented 16 033 359 of 114 323 044 ED visits (14.0%) in 2016. On average, 8 535 261 of 17 886 220 ED admissions (47.7%) were attributed to ECSCs. The most common ECSC ED visits were for sepsis (1 716 004 [10.7%]), chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (1 273 319 [7.9%]), pneumonia (1 263 971 [7.9%]), asthma (970 829 [6.1%]), and heart failure (911 602 [5.7%]) but varied by age group. Median (interquartile range) length of stay for ECSC ED admissions was longer than non-ECSC ED admissions (3.2 [1.7-5.8] days vs 2.7 [1.4-4.9] days; P < .001). In 2016, median (interquartile range) ED charges per visit for ECSCs were $2736 ($1684-$4605) compared with $2179 ($1118-$4359) per visit for non-ECSC ED visits (P < .001). Conclusions and Relevance: This comprehensive list of ECSCs can be used to guide indicator development for pre-ED, intra-ED, and post-ED care and overall assessment of the adult, non-mental health, acute care system. Health care utilization and costs among patients with ECSCs are substantial and warrant future study of validation, variations in care, and outcomes associated with ECSCs.

10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2019.8642.abstractZh: 重要性：监测急诊护理质量需要了解哪些情况最能从及时、高质量的急诊护理中受益。目标：识别一组对急诊护理敏感的情况（ECSCs），这些情况在大多数急诊科中都有出现，涉及不同年龄段的成人，并且是寻求急诊护理的常见原因。同时提供全国范围内ECSCs急性护理利用情况的基准估计。设计、实施与参与者：采用改良的Delphi方法来确定ECSCs。通过国际疾病统计分类第十修订版临床修正诊断代码，识别出与ECSCs相关的成人就诊情况，并利用2016年美国全国急诊科样本数据进行分析。数据分析时间范围为2018年1月至12月。主要结果与测量指标：确定了ECSCs以及与之相关的急诊科利用模式、住院时间和费用。结果：专家小组将51种情况归类为急诊护理敏感情况。2016年，这些急诊护理敏感情况占114,323,044次急诊科就诊中的16,033,359次（14.0%）。平均而言，17,886,220次急诊科入院中有8,535,261次（47.7%）与ECSCs相关。最常见的急诊科就诊原因是败血症（1,716,004次，占10.7%）、慢性阻塞性肺病（1,273,319次，占7.9%）、肺炎（1,263,971次，占7.9%）、哮喘（970,829次，占6.1%）和心力衰竭（911,602次，占5.7%），但不同年龄段的就诊原因有所不同。ECSCs导致的急诊科入院患者的住院时间中位数（四分位距）比非ECSCs导致的急诊科入院患者更长（3.2[1.7-5.8]天 vs 2.7[1.4-4.9]天；P < .001）。在2016年，非ECSC急诊服务的每次就诊平均费用中位数为2736美元（范围从1684美元到4605美元），而非ECSC急诊服务的每次就诊平均费用为2179美元（范围从1118美元到4359美元）（P < .001）。结论与意义：这份全面的ECSC列表可用于指导急诊前、急诊期间和急诊后的护理指标制定，以及对整个成人非心理健康急性护理系统的整体评估。具有ECSC的患者在医疗利用和成本方面存在显著差异，值得进一步研究其验证、护理差异以及与ECSC相关的结果。

abstract.text: About 200 million children globally are not meeting their growth potential, and as a result will suffer the consequences in terms of future outcomes. I examine the effects of birth weight on child health and growth using information from 66 countries. I account for missing data and measurement error using instrumental variables and adopt an identification strategy based on siblings and twins. I find a consistent effect of birth weight on mortality risk, stunting, wasting, and coughing, with some evidence for fever, diarrhoea, and anaemia. Bounds analysis indicates that coefficients may be substantially underestimated due to mortality selection. Improving the pre-natal environment is likely to be important for helping children reach their full potential.

10.1002/hec.3823.abstractZh: 全球约有2亿儿童未能充分发挥其生长潜力，这将导致他们在未来发展中遭受相应后果。我利用66个国家的数据，研究了出生体重对儿童健康和生长的影响。我通过工具变量处理了缺失数据和测量误差，并采用了基于兄弟姐妹和双胞胎的识别策略。研究发现，出生体重对死亡风险、发育迟缓、消瘦以及咳嗽等健康指标有显著影响，同时也有证据表明出生体重与发热、腹泻和贫血有关。边界分析表明，由于死亡选择的影响，这些系数的估计值可能被严重低估。改善产前环境对于帮助儿童充分发挥其潜力至关重要。

abstract.text: We use novel longitudinal data from 19 monthly waves of the Singapore Life Panel to examine the short-term dynamics of the effects health shocks have on household health and nonhealth spending and income by the elderly. The health shocks we study are the occurrence of new major conditions such as cancer, heart problems, and minor conditions (e.g., diabetes and hypertension). Our empirical strategy is based on an event study approach that exploits unanticipated changes in health status through the diagnosis of new health conditions. We find that major shocks have large and persistent effects whereas minor shocks have small and mainly contemporaneous effects. We find that household income reduces following a major shock for males but not females. Major health shocks lead to a decrease in households' nonhealth expenditures that is particularly pronounced for cancer and stroke sufferers, driven largely by reductions in leisure spending. The financial impact of major shocks on medical saving account balances occurs to those without private health insurance, whereas the impact is on cash balances for privately insured individuals.

10.1002/hec.3824.abstractZh: 我们利用新加坡生活面板调查中的19个月份纵向数据，来研究健康冲击对老年人家庭健康支出和非健康支出及收入的短期影响。我们所研究的健康冲击包括癌症、心脏疾病等重大疾病的出现，以及糖尿病、高血压等轻微疾病。我们的实证研究方法基于事件研究法，通过诊断出新的健康状况来捕捉健康状况的意外变化。我们发现，重大健康冲击会产生较大且持久的影响，而轻微健康冲击则会产生较小且主要是同时发生的影响。研究发现，重大健康冲击后，男性家庭收入会下降，而女性家庭收入则不会下降。重大健康冲击会导致家庭非健康支出减少，尤其是在癌症和中风患者身上，这种减少主要源于休闲支出的减少。重大健康冲击对没有私人健康保险的人造成的财务影响体现在储蓄账户余额上，而对于有私人保险的人来说，这种影响则体现在现金余额上。

abstract.text: We provide evidence that average mental, physical, and general health worsens for employed workers in local U.S. labor markets exposed to greater import competition from China. The effects are greatest for mental health. Moving a region from the 25th to 75th percentiles of import exposure corresponds to a 7.8% increase in the morbidity of poor mental health, adding about 3 days of poor mental health per year for the average adult. Concurrently, the ability to afford health care decreases. Our results complement documented consequences of import competition on labor markets and temporary business cycle shocks on health outcomes.

10.1002/hec.3826.abstractZh: 我们的研究提供了证据，表明在美国本地劳动力市场中，受来自中国的更大进口竞争影响的就业工人，其心理、身体和整体健康状况均有所恶化。其中，心理健康方面的影响最为显著。当一个地区的进口竞争程度从第25百分位上升到第75百分位时，不良心理健康的发病率会增加7.8%，这意味着平均每个成年人每年会多经历大约3天的不良心理健康状况。与此同时，他们支付医疗保健费用的能力也会下降。我们的研究结果补充了关于进口竞争对劳动力市场以及临时经济周期冲击对健康结果影响的已有研究。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a new framework to discuss self-control problems in the context of life-cycle health and longevity. Individual decisions are conceptualized as the partial control of impulsive desires of a short-run self by a rationally forward-looking long-run self. The short-run self strives for immediate gratification through consumption of health-neutral and unhealthy goods. The long-run self reflects the long-term consequences of unhealthy behavior on health outcomes and longevity and invests time and money to improve current and future health. The model is calibrated with data from the United States and used to provide an assessment of the impact of imperfect self-control on unhealthy consumption, health investments, lifetime health, and the age at death.

10.1002/hec.3827.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个新框架，用于讨论生命周期健康与长寿背景下的自我控制问题。个体决策被概念化为短期自我对冲动欲望的部分控制，而长期自我则具有理性前瞻性。短期自我通过消费健康中性或不健康商品来追求即时满足。长期自我则考虑不健康行为对健康和寿命的长期影响，并投入时间和金钱以改善当前和未来的健康状况。该模型以美国的数据为基准进行校准，用于评估不完美自我控制对不健康消费、健康投资、终生健康以及死亡年龄的影响。

abstract.text: This paper contributes to the literature on the labor market consequences of obesity by using a novel instrument: genetic risk score, which reflects the predisposition to higher body mass index (BMI) across many genetic loci. We estimate instrumental variable models of the effect of BMI on labor market outcomes using Finnish data that have many strengths, for example, BMI that is measured rather than self-reported, and data on earnings and social income transfers that are from administrative tax records and are thus free of the problems associated with nonresponse, reporting error or top coding. The empirical results are sensitive to whether we use a narrower or broader genetic risk score, and to model specification. For example, models using the narrower genetic risk score as an instrument imply that a one-unit increase in BMI is associated with 6.9% lower wages, 1.8% fewer years employed, and a 3 percentage point higher probability of receiving any social income transfers. However, when we use a newer, broader genetic risk score, we cannot reject the null hypothesis of no effect. Future research using genetic risk scores should examine the sensitivity of their results to the risk score used.

10.1002/hec.3828.abstractZh: 本文通过引入一种新颖的工具变量——遗传风险评分，为关于肥胖对劳动力市场影响的文献做出了贡献。遗传风险评分能够反映多个遗传位点对较高体重指数（BMI）的倾向性。我们使用芬兰的数据来估计BMI对劳动力市场结果的影响，这些数据具有许多优势，例如BMI是通过测量而非自我报告获得的，以及关于收入和社会收入转移的数据来自行政税务记录，因此不存在无应答、报告错误或最高编码等问题。实证结果对我们使用的遗传风险评分的狭窄或宽泛程度，以及模型设定方式非常敏感。例如，使用较窄的遗传风险评分作为工具变量时，BMI每增加1单位，工资会降低6.9%，就业年限会减少1.8%，接受社会收入转移的概率则会增加3个百分点。然而，当我们使用较新的、更宽泛的遗传风险评分时，我们无法拒绝无效应的零假设。未来使用遗传风险评分的研究应考察结果对所使用的风险评分的敏感性。

abstract.text: Using a regression-discontinuity approach on a U.K. longitudinal dataset, this research analyses whether personalised weight feedback resulted in individuals losing weight over a period of between 2 and 7 years. The analysis presented here finds that being told one was "overweight" had, on average, no effect on subsequent weight loss; however, being told one was "very overweight" resulted in individuals losing, on average, approximately 1% of their bodyweight. The effect of feedback was found to be strongly moderated by household income, with those in higher income households accounting for seemingly all of the estimated effect due, in part, to increased physical activity. These findings suggest that the provision of weight feedback may be a cost-effective way to reduce obesity in adults. They do however also highlight that the differential response to the provision of health information may be a driver of health inequalities and that the provision of feedback may bias longitudinal health studies.

10.1002/hec.3829.abstractZh: 本研究采用回归不连续方法对英国纵向数据集进行分析，探讨个性化体重反馈是否能在2至7年的时间内促使个体减轻体重。研究发现，被告知“超重”这一信息对后续体重减轻的影响并不明显；而被告知“非常超重”的个体则平均减轻了约1%的体重。反馈效果受到家庭收入的强烈调节，高收入家庭中的个体因增加了体力活动而显著减轻了体重。这些发现表明，提供体重反馈可能是降低成人肥胖的有效方式。不过，研究也指出，对健康信息的不同反应可能是健康不平等的驱动因素，而反馈信息的提供可能会影响纵向健康研究的结果。

abstract.text: We provide the first evidence on the effects of state laws requiring students to receive education about alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs using data on over a million youths from the 1976-2010 Monitoring the Future study. In difference-in-differences and event-study models, we find robust evidence that these laws significantly reduced recent alcohol and marijuana use among high school seniors by 1.6-2.8 percentage points, or about 8-10% of the overall decline over this period. Our results suggest that information interventions can reduce youth substance use.

10.1002/hec.3830.abstractZh: 我们首次提供了关于州法律要求学生接受关于酒精、烟草和其他药物教育的效果的证据，这些证据基于1976年至2010年“监测未来”研究中的超过一百万名青少年的数据。通过差异-差异模型和事件-研究模型分析，我们发现这些法律显著减少了高中毕业生的近期酒精和大麻使用量，降幅为1.6%至2.8个百分点，约占同期整体下降幅度的8%至10%。我们的研究结果表明，信息干预措施能够降低青少年的物质使用行为。

abstract.text: Traditionally, threshold levels of cost-effectiveness have been derived from willingness-to-pay studies, indicating the consumption value of health (v-thresholds). However, it has been argued that v-thresholds need to be supplemented by so-called k-thresholds, which are based on the marginal returns to health care. The objective of this research is to estimate a k-threshold based on the marginal returns to cardiovascular disease (CVD) hospital care in the Netherlands. To estimate a k-threshold for hospital care on CVD, we proceed in two steps: First, we estimate the impact of hospital spending on mortality using a Bayesian regression modelling framework, using data on CVD mortality and CVD hospital spending by age and gender for the period 1994-2010. Second, we use life tables in combination with quality of life data to convert these estimates into a k-threshold expressed in euros per quality-adjusted life year gained. Our base case estimate resulted in an estimate of 41,000 per quality-adjusted life year gained. In our sensitivity analyses, we illustrated how the incorporation of prior evidence into the estimation pushes estimates downwards. We conclude that our base case estimate of the k-threshold may serve as a benchmark value for decision making in the Netherlands as well as for future research regarding k-thresholds.

10.1002/hec.3831.abstractZh: 传统上，成本效益的阈值水平是通过支付意愿研究得出的，这些研究指出了健康消费的价值（v-阈值）。然而，有观点认为，v-阈值需要辅以所谓的k-阈值，后者基于医疗保健的边际回报。本研究的目标是根据荷兰心血管疾病医院护理的边际回报来估算k-阈值。为了估算心血管疾病医院护理的k-阈值，我们分两步进行：首先，我们使用贝叶斯回归建模框架，利用1994-2010年间按年龄和性别划分的心血管疾病死亡率和医院护理支出的数据，来估算医院支出对死亡率的影响。其次，我们结合生命表与生活质量数据，将这些估算结果转换为以欧元计的每个质量调整生命年获得的k-阈值。我们的基准案例估算结果为每个质量调整生命年获得41,000欧元。在敏感性分析中，我们展示了将先前证据纳入估算过程如何使估算结果下降。我们得出结论，我们的k-阈值基准案例估算结果可以作为荷兰决策以及未来关于k-阈值研究的一个参考值。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the income elasticity of government pharmaceutical spending and assesses the simultaneous effect of such spending on gross domestic product (GDP). Using a panel dataset for 136 countries from 1995 to 2006, we employ a two-step instrumental variable procedure where we first estimate the effect of GDP on public pharmaceutical expenditure using tourist receipts as an instrument for GDP. In the second step, we construct an adjusted pharmaceutical expenditure series where the response of public pharmaceutical expenditure to GDP is partialled out and use this endogeneity adjusted series as an instrument for pharmaceutical expenditure. Our estimations show that GDP has a strong positive impact on pharmaceutical spending with elasticity in excess of unity in countries with low spending on pharmaceuticals and countries with large economic freedom. In the second step, we find that when the quantitatively large reverse effect of GDP is accounted for, public pharmaceutical spending has a negative effect on GDP per capita particularly in countries with limited economic freedom.

10.1002/hec.3832.abstractZh: 本文估计了政府药品支出的收入弹性，并评估了此类支出对国内生产总值（GDP）的同时影响。我们采用1995至2006年间136个国家的面板数据集，采用两步工具变量方法进行分析。首先，我们通过使用旅游收入作为GDP的工具变量，来估计GDP对公共药品支出的影响。第二步中，我们构建了一个调整后的药品支出序列，其中剔除了公共药品支出对GDP的响应因素，并使用这个经过内生性调整的序列作为药品支出的工具变量。我们的估计结果显示，在药品支出较少以及经济自由度较高的国家，GDP对药品支出的影响呈强烈的正向关系，其弹性超过1。在第二步中，我们发现，当考虑到GDP的显著负向影响时，公共药品支出对人均GDP有负面影响，尤其是在经济自由度有限的国家。

abstract.text: Although it is commonly argued that there is a mismatch between drug innovation and disease burden, there is little evidence on the magnitude and direction of such disparities. In this paper, we measure inequality in innovation, by comparing research and development activity with population health and gross domestic product data across 493 therapeutic indications to globally measure: (a) drug innovation, (b) disease burden, and (c) market size. We use concentration curves and indices to assess inequality at two levels: (a) broad disease groups and (b) disease subcategories for both 1990 and 2010. For some top burden disease subcategories (i.e., cardiovascular and circulatory diseases, neoplasms, and musculoskeletal disorders), innovation is disproportionately concentrated in diseases with high disease burden and large market size, whereas for others (i.e., mental and behavioral disorders, neonatal disorders, and neglected tropical diseases) innovation is disproportionately concentrated in low burden diseases. These inequalities persisted over time, suggesting inertia in pharmaceutical research and development in tackling the global health challenges. Our results confirm quantitatively assertions about the mismatch between disease burden and pharmaceutical innovation in both developed and developing countries and highlight the disease areas for which morbidity and mortality remain unaddressed.

10.1002/hec.3833.abstractZh: 尽管通常认为药物创新与疾病负担之间存在不匹配，但关于这种不匹配的规模和方向，现有的证据却很少。在本文中，我们通过比较493种治疗领域的研发活动与人口健康及国内生产总值数据，来衡量创新的不平等性，从而从全球层面评估：(a)药物创新、(b)疾病负担以及(c)市场规模。我们使用浓度曲线和指数来评估两个层面的不平等性：(a)广泛的疾病群体以及(b)疾病子类别，分别针对1990年和2010年的数据。对于一些疾病负担较高的子类别（如心血管和循环系统疾病、肿瘤以及肌肉骨骼疾病），创新主要集中在疾病负担高且市场规模大的疾病上；而对于另一些子类别（如精神行为障碍、新生儿疾病以及被忽视的热带疾病），创新则主要集中在疾病负担较低的疾病上。这些不平等现象随着时间的推移而持续存在，这表明在应对全球健康挑战方面，制药研究与开发的动力存在惰性。我们的研究结果在定量上证实了关于疾病负担与药物创新之间不匹配的论断，无论是在发达国家还是发展中国家，这些论断都是正确的。同时，研究结果也指出了那些发病率和死亡率仍然未被充分解决的疾病领域。

abstract.text: Influenza pandemics considerably burden affected health systems due to surges in inpatient admissions and associated costs. Previous studies underestimate or overestimate 2009/2010 influenza A/H1N1 pandemic hospital admissions and costs. We robustly estimate overall and age-specific weekly H1N1 admissions and costs between June 2009 and March 2011 across 170 English hospitals. We calculate H1N1 admissions and costs as the difference between our administrative data of all influenza-like-illness patients (seasonal and pandemic alike) and a counterfactual of expected weekly seasonal influenza admissions and costs established using time-series models on prepandemic (2004-2008) data. We find two waves of H1N1 admissions: one pandemic wave (June 2009-March 2010) with 10,348 admissions costing £20.5 million and one postpandemic wave (November 2010-March 2011) with 11,775 admissions costing £24.8 million. Patients aged 0-4 years old have the highest H1N1 admission rate, and 25- to 44- and 65+-year-olds have the highest costs. Our estimates are up to 4.3 times higher than previous reports, suggesting that the pandemic's burden on hospitals was formerly underassessed. Our findings can help hospitals manage unexpected surges in admissions and resource use due to pandemics.

10.1002/hec.3834.abstractZh: 流感大流行由于住院人数激增及相关成本的增加，给受影响的卫生系统带来了巨大负担。以往的研究对2009/2010年甲型H1N1流感大流行的住院人数和成本估计过高或过低。我们通过对170家英国医院在2009年6月至2011年3月期间的H1N1流感住院人数和成本进行稳健估计。我们将H1N1流感的住院人数和成本计算为所有类似流感疾病患者的行政数据（包括季节性流感和大流行期间）与基于大流行前数据（2004-2008年）的时间序列模型预测的季节性流感住院人数和成本之间的差值。我们发现H1N1流感有两次住院高峰：一次是大流行期间（2009年6月-2010年3月），共有10,348例住院，费用达2,050万英镑；另一次是大流行后期间（2010年11月-2011年3月），共有11,775例住院，费用达2,480万英镑。0-4岁年龄段的流感住院率最高，而25至44岁和65岁及以上年龄段的流感住院费用最高。我们的估计结果比以往报告高出4.3倍，这表明以前对流感大流行对医院影响的评估存在低估现象。我们的研究结果有助于医院应对大流行带来的住院人数和资源使用方面的意外激增。

abstract.text: Social desirability bias, which is the tendency to underreport socially undesirable health behaviours, significantly distorts information on sensitive behaviours gained from self-reports. We applied the list randomisation method to indirectly elicit condom use among female sex workers and tested it among 651 female sex workers in Senegal, a country where sex workers face high social stigma and where the AIDS epidemic is mainly concentrated among this population. On the basis of our list randomisation, we found that the condom use rate in the last sexual intercourse with a client was 78%, which is significantly lower than the 97% obtained when asked directly in the survey. When estimating condom use among the subgroups, we found that female sex workers who are at a higher risk of infection are less likely to use condoms.

10.1002/hec.3835.abstractZh: 社会期望偏差是指人们倾向于低估社会上不希望出现的健康行为，这严重扭曲了通过自我报告获得的关于敏感行为的信息。我们采用了列表随机化方法，间接调查了女性性工作者使用避孕套的情况，并在塞内加尔对651名女性性工作者进行了测试。塞内加尔是性工作者面临高社会耻辱感的国家，艾滋病疫情主要集中在这一人群中。根据我们的列表随机化结果，我们发现与客户进行最后一次性行为时使用避孕套的比例为78%，这一比例明显低于直接调查中获得的97%。在估计不同子群体中使用避孕套的情况时，我们发现感染风险较高的女性性工作者不太可能使用避孕套。

abstract.text: Disease management programs aim to reduce cost by improving the quality of care for chronic diseases. Evidence of their effectiveness is mixed. Reducing health care spending sufficiently to cover program costs has proved particularly challenging. This study uses a difference in differences design to examine the impact of a diabetes disease management program for high risk patients on preventive tests, health outcomes, and cost of care. Heterogeneity is examined along the dimensions of severity (measured using the proxy of poor glycemic control) and preventive testing received in the baseline year. Although disease management programs tend to focus on the sickest, the impact of this program concentrates in the group of people who had not received recommended tests in the preintervention period. If confirmed, such findings are practically important to improve cost-effectiveness in disease management programs by targeting relevant subgroups defined both based on severity and on (missing) test information.

10.1002/hec.3836.abstractZh: 疾病管理计划旨在通过提高慢性病的护理质量来降低成本。关于其有效性的证据并不一致。要足够减少医疗支出以覆盖项目成本，尤其具有挑战性。本研究采用差异分析设计，考察糖尿病疾病管理计划对高风险患者预防性检查、健康结果和护理成本的影响。研究考察了严重程度（以血糖控制不良作为衡量指标）以及基线年份接受的预防性检查等维度上的异质性。尽管疾病管理计划通常关注最严重的患者，但该计划的影响主要集中在那些在干预前未接受推荐检查的人群中。如果这一发现得到证实，那么通过针对基于严重程度和（缺失）检查信息确定的相关亚群体，这些发现对于提高疾病管理计划的成本效益具有实际意义。

abstract.text: This study examines whether labour outcomes of HIV-infected workers treated with antiretrovirals are associated with the stage of the disease when commencing therapy. We use data on employment separation and absenteeism from the workplace health programme of South Africa's largest coal mining company over the period of January 2009 to March 2017 in a Cox proportional hazards model. When treatment was initiated at a CD4 + T cell count above 350 cells/μl, the risk of separating from the company was 37% lower and the risk of absence was 20%t lower than initiating at a CD4 count below 200 cells/μl, and these differences persist over time. Also, we find that workers initiating antiretroviral therapy at CD4 ≥ 350 have an 8% lower risk of absence prior to treatment. Although many companies and the South African government have adopted universal test-and-treat policies aiming to initiate all HIV-infected people as early as possible, most HIV patients still start treatment late in the disease course when their CD4 counts have fallen to low levels. Our results indicate early HIV detection and treatment could have large productivity gains.

10.1002/hec.3837.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了接受抗逆转录病毒治疗的HIV感染员工的工作成果是否与开始治疗的疾病阶段有关。我们使用南非最大煤炭矿业公司工作场所健康计划中的离职和缺勤数据，在2009年1月至2017年3月期间，采用Cox比例风险模型进行分析。当治疗在CD4+ T细胞计数超过350细胞/μl时开始，员工离职的风险降低37%，缺勤风险降低20%；这些差异随时间持续存在。此外，我们发现，在CD4计数≥350时开始抗逆转录病毒治疗的员工，在治疗前的缺勤风险降低8%。尽管许多公司和南非政府采取了普遍检测和治疗政策，旨在尽早为所有HIV感染者开始治疗，但大多数HIV患者仍会在疾病进展到CD4计数下降的晚期才开始治疗。我们的研究结果表明，早期检测和治疗HIV能够带来巨大的生产力提升。

abstract.text: A motivation for increasing health insurance coverage is to improve health outcomes for impacted populations. However, health insurance coverage may alternatively increase risky health behaviors due to ex ante moral hazard, and past research on this issue has led to mixed conclusions. This paper uses a panel of household purchases to estimate the effects of the recent state-level Medicaid expansions resulting from the Affordable Care Act (ACA) on consumption goods that present adverse health risks. We utilize within-household variation to identify whether increases in Medicaid availability impacted household purchase patterns of alcohol, nicotine-related, snack food, and carbonated beverage products. Overall, we find little evidence that the ACA Medicaid expansion led to ex ante moral hazard across any of these products, but we find compelling evidence that the Medicaid expansions reduced cigarette consumption and increased smoking cessation product use among the Medicaid-eligible population.

10.1002/hec.3838.abstractZh: 增加健康保险覆盖率的动机是为了改善受影响人群的健康状况。然而，健康保险覆盖率的提高可能会因事前道德风险而增加危险的健康行为，关于这一问题的过往研究得出了不同的结论。本文利用家庭购买数据，估计了《平价医疗法案》推动的州级医疗补助扩展对具有不良健康风险消费品的效应。我们通过家庭内部差异来识别医疗补助的普及是否影响了家庭对酒精、与尼古丁相关的产品、零食以及碳酸饮料等产品的购买行为。总体而言，我们发现《平价医疗法案》推动的医疗补助扩展并未导致这些产品出现事前道德风险，但我们发现医疗补助扩展确实减少了香烟消费，并增加了符合医疗补助资格人群中的戒烟产品使用率。

abstract.text: Under the prospective payment system (PPS), hospitals receive a bundled payment for an entire episode of treatment based on diagnosis-related groups (DRG). Although there is ample evidence regarding the impact of the introduction of the PPS, there is little research on the effects of the ensuing changes in payment levels under the PPS. In 2005, the Medicare PPS changed its definition of payment areas from the Metropolitan Statistical Areas to the Core-Based Statistical Areas, generating substantial area-specific price shocks. Using these exogenous price variations, this study examines hospital responses to price changes under the PPS. The results demonstrate that, while the average payment amount significantly increases in the affected areas, no parallel trend is observed in admission volume, treatment intensity, and quality of services. Conversely, hospitals facing a price increase are more liable to the perverse incentives that the PPS is known to encourage, namely, selecting or shifting patients into higher-paying DRGs. These results suggest that paying a higher price for a given service may not induce hospitals to offer services of better quality, but can rather prompt even higher payments through other behavioral responses.

10.1002/hec.3839.abstractZh: 在预期支付系统（PPS）下，医院根据诊断相关分组（DRG）获得整个治疗过程的捆绑支付。尽管有大量关于引入PPS影响的证据，但关于PPS下支付水平变化所带来的影响的研究却很少。2005年，Medicare的PPS改变了支付区域的定义，从大都市统计区改为基于核心的统计区，这导致了地区特定的价格波动。本研究利用这些外部价格变化，考察了医院在PPS下的价格变化反应。研究结果表明，虽然受影响地区的平均支付金额显著增加，但在入院数量、治疗强度和服务质量方面并未出现相应的趋势。相反，面临价格上涨的医院更容易受到PPS所鼓励的逆向激励，即选择或将患者分配到支付更高的DRG中。这些结果表明，为某项服务支付更高的费用可能不会促使医院提供质量更好的服务，反而可能会通过其他行为反应引发更高的支付。

abstract.text: Workplace wellness programs have become increasingly common in the United States, although there is not yet consensus regarding the ability of such programs to improve employees' health and reduce health care costs. In this paper, we study a program offered by a large U.S. employer that provides substantial financial incentives directly tied to employees' health. The program has a high participation rate among eligible employees, around 80%, and we analyze the data on the first 4 years of the program, linked to health care claims. We document robust improvements in employee health and a correlation between certain health improvements and reductions in health care cost. Despite the latter association, we cannot find direct evidence causally linking program participation to reduced health care costs, although it seems plausible that such a relationship will arise over longer horizons.

10.1002/hec.3840.abstractZh: 在美国，工作场所的健康计划越来越普遍，不过目前还没有共识表明这些计划是否能够改善员工的健康状况并降低医疗成本。本文研究了一个由美国大型雇主提供且包含与员工健康直接相关的实质性经济激励措施的健康计划。该计划在符合条件的员工中参与度很高，约为80%。我们对该计划实施的前四年数据进行了分析，这些数据与医疗索赔记录相关联。我们发现员工健康状况有显著改善，某些健康指标的改善与医疗成本的降低之间存在相关性。尽管存在这种关联，但我们未能找到直接证明计划参与与医疗成本降低之间存在因果关系的证据，不过从长远来看，这种关系似乎是合理的。

abstract.text: The evaluation of policies that are not randomly assigned on outcomes generated by nonlinear data generating processes often requires modeling assumptions for which there is little theoretical guidance. This paper revisits previously published difference-in-differences results of an important example, the introduction of reference pricing to common outpatient procedures, to assess the robustness of the estimated impacts by using different matching, and reweighting techniques to preprocess the data. These techniques improve covariate balance and reduce model dependence. Specifically, we examine the robustness of the effect of reference pricing on patient site-of-care choice, total expenditures, and complication rates. We apply three preprocessing methods: propensity score reweighting, exact matching, and genetic matching. Propensity score reweighting is a technique for achieving covariate balance but does not balance higher-order moments and may lead to bias and inefficiency in estimating treatment effects in the context of nonlinear data generating processes. In contrast, exact matching and genetic matching are designed to balance higher-order moments. We find that although the use of the preprocessing techniques is a valuable robustness check showing that some results are sensitive to the method used, the three approaches generally yield results that do not statistically differ from the published results.

10.1002/hec.3841.abstractZh: 对于那些并非由非线性数据生成过程随机分配的政策效果评估，通常需要对建模假设进行建模，而关于这些假设的理论指导却很少。本文重新审视了一个重要案例的差异-差异分析结果，即引入参考价格政策对常见门诊手术的影响，通过采用不同的匹配和重新加权技术对数据进行预处理，以评估估计结果的稳健性。这些技术能够改善协变量的平衡性，并减少模型的依赖性。具体来说，我们考察了参考价格政策对患者就医选择、总支出和并发症率的影响的稳健性。我们采用了三种预处理方法：倾向得分重新加权、精确匹配和遗传匹配。倾向得分重新加权是一种实现协变量平衡的技术，但可能无法平衡高阶矩，并可能导致在非线性数据生成过程中的估计偏差和效率低下。相比之下，精确匹配和遗传匹配旨在平衡高阶矩。我们发现，尽管使用预处理技术是一种有价值的稳健性检验，表明某些结果对使用的方法敏感，但这三种方法通常得出的结果在统计上与已发表的结果没有显著差异。

abstract.text: Dishonest behavior significantly increases the cost of medical care provision. Upcoding of patients is a common form of fraud to attract higher reimbursements. Imposing audit mechanisms including fines to curtail upcoding is widely discussed among health care policy-makers. How audits and fines affect individual health care providers' behavior is empirically not well understood. To provide new evidence on fraudulent behavior in health care, we analyze the effect of a random audit including fines on individuals' honesty by means of a novel controlled behavioral experiment framed in a neonatal care context. Prevalent dishonest behavior declines significantly when audits and fines are introduced. The effect is driven by a reduction in upcoding when being detectable. Yet upcoding increases when not being detectable as fraudulent. We find evidence that individual characteristics (gender, medical background, and integrity) are related to dishonest behavior. Policy implications are discussed.

10.1002/hec.3842.abstractZh: 不诚实行为显著增加了医疗服务的成本。对病人进行过度编码是一种常见的欺诈手段，以吸引更高的报销金额。实施包括罚款在内的审计机制来遏制过度编码行为，是医疗政策制定者广泛讨论的话题。然而，审计和罚款对个体医疗服务提供者行为的实际影响尚未得到充分研究。为了提供关于医疗领域欺诈行为的新证据，我们通过一项新颖的对照行为实验，在新生儿护理背景下，分析了随机审计及罚款对个体诚实度的影响。当引入审计和罚款时，普遍的不诚实行为显著减少。这种效果主要源于在可检测的情况下减少了过度编码行为。然而，在不可检测的情况下，过度编码行为反而会增加。我们发现，个体特征（性别、医学背景和诚信度）与不诚实行为之间存在关联。最后讨论了政策启示。

abstract.text: Because health insurance is intended to protect patients in the event of a health shock, it is important to evaluate health insurance policy in the context of patients who experience health shocks. I measure the effect of cancer diagnosis on health insurance switching in order to compare cancer patient's preferences among private and publicly administered Medicare. I estimate that a cancer diagnosis increases the probability a patient will leave a private Medicare plan, for the public plan, by 0.8% points (41%). Similarly, a cancer diagnosis decreases the probability a patient will leave the public Medicare plan, for a private plan, by 0.5% points (16%). The implication is that private Medicare plans are relatively less attractive to cancer patients than they are to noncancer patients.

10.1002/hec.3843.abstractZh: 由于健康保险旨在在健康危机发生时保护患者，因此在经历健康危机的患者背景下评估健康保险政策非常重要。我研究了癌症诊断对健康保险转换的影响，以比较癌症患者对于私人管理和公共管理的医疗保险的偏好。我的估计表明，癌症诊断会使患者离开私人医疗保险计划而选择公共医疗保险计划的概率增加0.8个百分点（41%）。同样，癌症诊断也会使患者离开公共医疗保险计划而选择私人医疗保险计划的概率减少0.5个百分点（16%）。这意味着私人医疗保险计划对癌症患者的吸引力相对较低，而非癌症患者则不然。

abstract.text: Absenteeism of health workers in developing countries is common and can severely undermine the reliability of the health system. Therefore, it is important to understand where the prevalence of absenteeism is high. We develop a simple imputation method that combines a Service Delivery Indicators survey and a Service Provision Assessment survey to estimate the prevalence of absenteeism of health workers at the level of regions in Tanzania. The resulting estimates allow one to identify the regions in which the prevalence of absenteeism is significantly higher or lower than the national average and help policymakers determine priority areas for intervention.

10.1002/hec.3844.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，卫生工作者的缺勤现象很常见，这会严重削弱卫生系统的可靠性。因此，了解缺勤率较高的地区非常重要。我们开发了一种简单的估算方法，该方法结合了服务交付指标调查和服务提供评估调查，以估算坦桑尼亚各地区卫生工作者的缺勤率。通过这种估算方法，可以识别出缺勤率显著高于或低于全国平均水平的地区，从而帮助政策制定者确定需要优先干预的领域。

abstract.text: Economic theory predicts that vaccination policies at the local level can be negatively affected by the policies of neighboring regions because of free-riding motives, whereas positive dependency may exist due to policy diffusions among localities. By using the unique variations in the provision of vaccination subsidies in Japan, we assess how vaccination policies in a local government are affected by the decisions of neighboring governments. We find that the provision of vaccination subsidies is positively correlated with the decisions of neighboring localities. Moreover, a correlation is found with neighboring municipalities within the same prefecture but not with those in surrounding prefectures, indicating that the correlations are likely to arise because of mimicking behavior among localities within a prefecture. Our results show that vaccination policies tend to be formed following neighboring municipalities and do not necessarily aim to optimize community health, thus questioning the autonomy of local government authorities regarding vaccination policies.

10.1002/hec.3845.abstractZh: 经济理论预测，由于搭便车动机，地方层面的疫苗接种政策可能会受到邻近地区政策的负面影响，而由于政策在各地之间的传播，也可能存在正向的依赖性。通过研究日本疫苗接种补贴提供的独特差异，我们评估了地方政府疫苗接种政策如何受到邻近政府决策的影响。我们发现，疫苗接种补贴的提供与邻近地区的决策呈正相关。此外，这种相关性存在于同一 prefecture 内的邻近市镇之间，但与其他 prefecture 的邻近市镇之间则不存在这种相关性，这表明这种相关性可能是由于 prefecture 内各市镇之间的模仿行为所导致的。我们的研究结果表明，疫苗接种政策往往是根据邻近市镇的情况来制定的，并不一定旨在优化社区健康，因此这质疑了地方政府在疫苗接种政策方面的自主权。

abstract.text: A randomized controlled discrete choice experiment (DCE) with 3,320 participating respondents was used to investigate the individual and combined impact of level overlap and color coding on task complexity, choice consistency, survey satisfaction scores, and dropout rates. The systematic differences between the study arms allowed for a direct comparison of dropout rates and cognitive debriefing scores and accommodated the quantitative comparison of respondents' choice consistency using a heteroskedastic mixed logit model. Our results indicate that the introduction of level overlap made it significantly easier for respondents to identify the differences and choose between the choice options. As a stand-alone design strategy, attribute level overlap reduced the dropout rate by 30%, increased the level of choice consistency by 30%, and avoided learning effects in the initial choice tasks of the DCE. The combination of level overlap and color coding was even more effective: It reduced the dropout rate by 40% to 50% and increased the level of choice consistency by more than 60%. Hence, we can recommend attribute level overlap, with color coding to amplify its impact, as a standard design strategy in DCEs.

10.1002/hec.3846.abstractZh: 一项包含3,320名参与者的随机对照离散选择实验（DCE）被用来研究水平重叠和颜色编码对任务复杂性、选择一致性、调查满意度以及退出率的影响。研究各组的系统差异使得可以直接比较退出率和认知反馈得分，并能够使用异方差混合逻辑模型来定量比较受访者的选择一致性。我们的研究结果表明，引入水平重叠显著降低了受访者识别差异并选择选项的难度。作为一种独立的设计策略，属性水平重叠使退出率降低了30%，选择一致性的水平提高了30%，并避免了DCE初始选择任务中的学习效应。而水平重叠与颜色编码的结合则更为有效：它将退出率降低了40%至50%，并将选择一致性的水平提高了60%以上。因此，我们建议将属性水平重叠与颜色编码结合使用，以放大其效果，作为DCE中的标准设计策略。

abstract.text: Health-care systems around the world face limited financial resources, and England is no exception. The ability of the health-care system in England to operate within its financial resources depends in part on continually increasing its productivity. One means of achieving this is to identify and disseminate throughout the system the most efficient processes. We examine the annual productivity growth achieved by 151 hospitals over five financial years, using the same methods developed to measure productivity of the National Health Service as a whole. We consider whether there are hospitals that consistently achieve higher than average productivity growth. These could act as examples of good practice for others to follow and provide a means of increasing system performance. We find that the productivity growth of some hospitals over the whole period exhibits better than average performance, but there is little or no evidence of consistency in the performance of these hospitals over adjacent years. Even the best performers exhibit periods of very poor performance and vice versa. We therefore conclude that accepted methods of measuring productivity growth for the health system as a whole do not appear suitable for identifying good performance at the hospital level.

10.1002/hec.3847.abstractZh: 全球各地的医疗体系都面临着有限的财政资源，英格兰也不例外。英格兰医疗体系能否在其财政资源范围内正常运作，部分取决于其持续提高的生产力。实现这一目标的一种方法是识别并在整个体系中推广最高效的流程。我们研究了151家医院在五个财政年度内的年度生产力增长情况，使用了与衡量整个国家卫生服务系统生产力相同的方法。我们探讨了是否存在一些医院能够持续实现高于平均水平的生产力增长。这些医院可以作为良好实践的典范，供其他医院借鉴，从而提高整个系统的绩效。我们发现，一些医院在整个期间的生产力增长表现优于平均水平，但几乎没有证据表明这些医院在相邻年份中的表现具有一致性。即使是最表现良好的医院，也会出现表现不佳的时期，反之亦然。因此，我们认为，用于衡量整个医疗系统生产力增长的方法并不适合用于识别医院层面的良好表现。

abstract.text: This paper uses the American Time Use Survey from 2003 to 2015 to analyze the effect of economic conditions on sleep duration. Prior work has found that increases in the employment rate cause sleep duration of individuals to fall. No previous research considers that weekday sleep behavior and weekend sleep behavior may be differentially related to economic conditions. Estimates suggest that weekday sleep duration is indeed countercylical whereas weekend sleep duration is procyclical. Results are driven by individuals most susceptible to economic fluctuations: minorities, single adults, and individuals with less education. Differential results concerning economic conditions and sleep by day type may be one mechanism for which to expect economic conditions to impact other sleep-related outcomes diversely depending on day of the week.

10.1002/hec.3849.abstractZh: 本文利用2003至2015年的美国时间使用调查数据，分析经济状况对睡眠时长的影响。先前的研究发现，就业率的上升会导致个人睡眠时长的减少。但之前的研究并未考虑工作日和周末的睡眠行为可能与经济状况存在不同的关系。研究结果表明，工作日的睡眠时长呈现反周期趋势，而周末的睡眠时长则呈现顺周期趋势。这些结果主要受到那些最容易受到经济波动影响的群体的影响：少数族裔、单身成年人以及受教育程度较低的个体。关于经济状况和不同工作日类型对睡眠的影响存在差异，可能是经济状况会根据一周中的不同日子，以不同的方式影响其他与睡眠相关的结果的一种机制。

abstract.text: We utilize a large administrative dataset of sickness leave in Italy (a) to investigate whether private firms are more effective than the public insurer in choosing who to monitor and (b) to study the correlation between potentially opportunistic behavior and the observable characteristics of the employee. We find that private employers are more likely to select into monitoring employees who are fit for work despite being on sick leave, if the public insurer is not supported by any data-driven tool. However, the use of a scoring mechanism, based on past records, allows the public insurer to be as effective as the employer. This result suggests that the application of machine learning to appropriate databases may improve the targeting of public monitoring to detect opportunistic behavior. Concerning the association between observable characteristics and potentially opportunistic behavior, we find that males, employees younger than 50, those on short leaves, or without a history of illness are more likely to be found fit for work.

10.1002/hec.3850.abstractZh: 我们利用意大利大量的病假管理数据集，来研究私人企业是否比公共保险公司更擅长选择需要监控的员工，以及潜在的机会主义行为与员工可观测特征之间的关联。研究发现，如果公共保险公司缺乏数据支持，私人雇主更有可能选择那些即使处于病假状态也适合继续工作的员工纳入监控范围。然而，通过使用基于过往记录的评分机制，公共保险公司也能达到与雇主相同的监控效果。这一结果表明，将机器学习应用于合适的数据库，可能会提高公共监控对机会主义行为的识别能力。关于可观测特征与潜在机会主义行为之间的关联，我们发现男性、年龄小于50岁的员工、休假时间较短的员工，以及没有疾病史的员工，更有可能被认定为适合继续工作。

abstract.text: Reimbursement of English mental health hospitals is moving away from block contracts and towards activity and outcome-based payments. Under the new model, patients are categorised into 20 groups with similar levels of need, called clusters, to which prices may be assigned prospectively. Clinicians, who make clustering decisions, have substantial discretion and can, in principle, directly influence the level of reimbursement the hospital receives. This may create incentives for upcoding. Clinicians are supported in their allocation decision by a clinical clustering algorithm, the Mental Health Clustering Tool, which provides an external reference against which clustering behaviour can be benchmarked. The aims of this study are to investigate the degree of mismatch between predicted and actual clustering and to test whether there are systematic differences amongst providers in their clustering behaviour. We use administrative data for all mental health patients in England who were clustered for the first time during the financial year 2014/15 and estimate multinomial multilevel models of over, under, or matching clustering. Results suggest that hospitals vary systematically in their probability of mismatch but this variation is not consistently associated with observed hospital characteristics.

10.1002/hec.3851.abstractZh: 英格兰精神健康医院的报销方式正从固定合同转向基于活动和结果的支付模式。在新的模式下，患者被划分为20个具有相似需求的组别，这些组别被称为“集群”，并可以预先确定相应的价格。负责聚类决策的临床医生拥有较大的自主权，原则上可以直接影响医院获得的报销金额。这可能会促使医生进行过度编码行为。临床医生在分配决策过程中得到了“精神健康聚类工具”的支持，该工具提供了一个外部参考标准，以便对聚类行为进行基准测试。本研究旨在调查预测聚类与实际聚类之间的不匹配程度，并测试不同医疗服务提供者在聚类行为上存在系统性差异。我们使用了2014/15财年英格兰所有首次进行聚类的精神健康患者的行政数据，并建立了多项多项式多层模型，以分析聚类数量过多、不足或匹配的情况。研究结果表明，医院在聚类不匹配的概率上存在系统性差异，但这种差异并未与观察到的医院特征保持一致。

abstract.text: Obesity can spread more easily if it is not perceived negatively. This issue may be more pronounced among the poor, a conjecture that we test in this paper. We start with general evidence on the concave relationship between income and obesity, both across countries and within Mexico, a country characterized by very unequal development levels and the highest obesity rate in the world. We suggest a general model that explains this stylized fact from a simple necessary condition, namely, the complementarity between nonfood consumption and health concerns. Then, we test the direct effect of overweight on mental health among Mexican women. We find a positive effect of obesity in the low consumption group and a depressing effect among the rich. This result is robust to the inclusion of a range of confounders (childhood conditions, lifestyle variables, food expenditure, and household shocks) and after instrumenting individual fatness by the variation in genetic predisposition. The complementarity between living standards and weight concerns may reflect different norms, different labor market penalties, or simply different returns to healthy time across the social spectrum.

10.1002/hec.3852.abstractZh: 肥胖现象在未被负面看待的情况下可能会更容易传播。这一问题在贫困人群中可能更为明显，本文对此进行了验证。我们首先从一般性的证据出发，探讨收入与肥胖之间的负相关关系，这些证据涵盖了不同国家以及墨西哥国内的情况。墨西哥是一个发展水平极不平衡的国家，其肥胖率位居世界最高。我们提出了一个通用模型来解释这一现象，该模型基于一个简单的必要条件，即非食物消费与健康关注之间的互补性。随后，我们测试了超重对墨西哥女性心理健康的直接影响。研究发现，肥胖在低消费群体中具有正面影响，而在富裕人群中则具有负面影响。这一结果在纳入一系列混杂因素后依然成立，包括童年状况、生活方式变量、食物支出以及家庭冲击等。此外，通过将个体肥胖程度与遗传倾向相结合，这一结果依然成立。生活水平与体重关注之间的互补性可能反映了不同的规范、不同的劳动力市场惩罚，或者仅仅是不同社会群体对健康时间的不同回报。

abstract.text: This paper provides empirical evidence on the health behavior effect of prescription drug insurance. Using the difference in the regression discontinuity research design, I compare health behavior changes at age 65 before and after the introduction of Medicare Part D. I find that the implementation of Medicare Part D increased prescription drug insurance coverage and reduced out-of-pocket spending per prescription and the use of cardiovascular and metabolic therapeutic class drugs. I also find that Medicare Part D led to a 6.36 percentage point decrease in the probability of engaging in moderate physical exercise and a 27.4 percentage point decrease in the amount of time spent on moderate physical activity. It also increased the probability of being overweight by 5.75 percentage points. Its effects on vigorous and muscle-strengthening exercise both at the extensive and intensive margins, obesity, BMI, and cigarette consumption are not statistically significant.

10.1002/hec.3853.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于处方药保险对健康行为影响的实证证据。采用回归不连续设计，比较了在Medicare Part D实施前后65岁人群的健康行为变化。研究发现，Medicare Part D的实施增加了处方药保险覆盖范围，降低了每次处方的自付支出，并减少了心血管和代谢类治疗药物的使用。此外，Medicare Part D使进行中等强度体育锻炼的概率降低了6.36个百分点，中等强度体育锻炼的时间减少了27.4个百分点。同时，Medicare Part D使超重的概率增加了5.75个百分点。对于高强度及肌肉强化运动、肥胖、体质指数以及香烟消费方面，其影响并不具有统计学意义。

abstract.text: We use difference-in-differences models and individual-level data from the national and state Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System from 2005 to 2015 to examine the effects of e-cigarette minimum legal sale age (MLSA) laws on youth cigarette smoking, alcohol consumption, and marijuana use. Our results suggest that these laws increased youth smoking participation by about one percentage point and approximately half of the increased smoking participation could be attributed to smoking initiation. We find little evidence of higher cigarette smoking persisting beyond the point at which youth age out of the laws. Our results also show little effect of the laws on youth drinking, binge drinking, and marijuana use. Taking these together, our findings suggest a possible unintended effect of e-cigarette MLSA laws-rising cigarette use in the short term while youth are restricted from purchasing e-cigarettes.

10.1002/hec.3854.abstractZh: 我们采用差异-差异模型，并利用2005至2015年间全国及各州青少年风险行为监测系统的个体级数据，研究电子烟最低合法销售年龄法规对青少年吸烟、饮酒和大麻使用的影响。研究结果表明，这些法规使青少年吸烟参与率上升了约1个百分点，其中约一半的吸烟参与率上升可以归因于吸烟行为的开始。我们发现，在青少年因法规而离开该年龄段后，吸烟持续率几乎没有变化。此外，这些法规对青少年饮酒、酗酒和大麻使用的影响也较小。综合这些结果，我们认为电子烟最低合法销售年龄法规可能产生了一种意外效果——在青少年被限制购买电子烟的短期内，吸烟使用率有所上升。

abstract.text: The literature on health care utilisation has focussed on the interaction of supply and demand factors in determining utilisation. At the aggregate level, studies have modelled the simultaneity of demand and supply, and different methods have been used. This study proposes an alternative framework for modelling utilisation, which yet separates demand and supply factors, the disequilibrium theory of demand and supply. This theory is useful in modelling data that reflect that not all health care demand is met by health care providers and not all health care supply is taken by consumers. Such disequilibrium arises due to rigid prices and quantity rationing. We use the theory to model maternal health care utilisation and user fee exemption at mission health care facilities in Malawi. The study uses switching regression methods and data from the Malawi Health Management Information System. Results show that user fee exemption is associated with increased utilisation of maternal health care. Demand and supply regime classification shows that many of the health facilities met much of the demand, whereas the rest only provided as much maternal care as their maximum capacity. In the latter case, intended maternal health care utilisation targets may not have been met.

10.1002/hec.3856.abstractZh: 关于医疗保健利用的文献主要关注供需因素在决定利用程度中的相互作用。在总体层面上，研究对供需同时性进行了建模，并采用了不同的方法。本研究提出了一种替代的利用模型框架，该框架将供需因素分开，即供需失衡理论。这一理论有助于建模那些反映并非所有医疗保健需求都能得到满足以及并非所有医疗保健供应都被消费者接受的数据。这种失衡是由于价格僵化和数量配给造成的。我们利用这一理论来建模马拉维的 Mission 医疗保健设施中的孕产妇医疗保健利用情况以及用户费用豁免政策。研究采用了切换回归方法，并使用了马拉维健康管理系统中的数据。结果表明，用户费用豁免与孕产妇医疗保健利用的增加有关。供需制度分类显示，许多医疗机构满足了大部分需求，而其余医疗机构则只提供了与其最大容量相当的护理服务。在后一种情况下，预期的孕产妇医疗保健利用目标可能未能实现。

abstract.text: We use household survey data to estimate the price elasticity of quantity, and of quality, for tobacco products. In our data, commonly used estimation methods suggest an own-price elasticity of demand of about -1. These methods add together responses on the quantity margin and the quality margin. Just one third of the response to price is from quantity and two thirds is from quality. The simulated effect of higher excise taxes is to reduce overall quantity by just one third of what is predicted if the quality response is ignored. Higher taxes also shift demand to lower quality tobacco products.

10.1002/hec.3857.abstractZh: 我们使用家庭调查数据来估算烟草产品的数量弹性以及质量弹性。在我们的数据中，常用的估算方法表明，需求的自身价格弹性约为-1。这些方法将关于数量边际和质量边际的回答相加。对价格的回答中，只有三分之一来自数量方面，三分之二来自质量方面。模拟结果显示，更高的消费税会导致整体数量减少，但减少的幅度仅为忽略质量反应时所预测的三分之一。更高的税收还会将需求转向质量较低的烟草产品。

abstract.text: Government doctor absenteeism from their public posts is a sizable problem across developing economies. The consumer demand estimation for outpatient fever treatment presented in this paper investigates the interrelationship between government doctor absenteeism and the large informal healthcare sector. Using a counterfactual framework, this paper estimates treatment effect of eliminating government doctor absenteeism. The effects are measured by changes to the market share of government Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) providers and resulting own-price elasticities of demand for government MBBS providers and unqualified providers. Modelling incorporates patients expected health outcomes by provider via the use of a qualitative measure of word-of-mouth recommendations. Results indicate that eliminating government MBBS provider absenteeism in North India would increase utilisation of government outpatient fever treatments from 18% to 50%.

10.1002/hec.3858.abstractZh: 在发展中国家中，政府医生缺席公共职务是一个相当严重的问题。本文对门诊发热治疗的消费者需求进行了估算，探讨了政府医生缺席与庞大的非正式医疗部门之间的相互关系。采用反事实框架，本文估算了消除政府医生缺席所带来的治疗效果。这些效果通过政府医学学士和外科学士（MBBS）提供者的市场份额变化以及政府MBBS提供者与无证提供者的需求弹性变化来衡量。模型还考虑了患者通过口碑推荐对提供者的预期健康结果。研究结果表明，在印度北部消除政府MBBS提供者的缺席现象，将使政府门诊发热治疗的利用率从18%增加到50%。

abstract.text: Economic theory suggests that competition and information are complementary tools for promoting health care quality. The existing empirical literature has documented this effect only in the context of competition among existing firms. Extending this literature, we examine competition driven by the entry of new firms into the home health care industry. In particular, we use the certificate of need (CON) law as a proxy for the entry of firms to avoid potential endogeneity of entry. We find that home health agencies in non-CON states improved quality under public reporting significantly more than agencies in CON states. Because home health care is a labor-intensive and capital-light industry, the state CON law is a major barrier for new firms to enter. Our findings suggest that policymakers may jointly consider information disclosure and entry regulation to achieve better quality in home health care.

10.1002/hec.3859.abstractZh: 经济理论表明，竞争和信息是提升医疗保健质量的有效工具。现有的实证文献仅证明了这种效应存在于现有企业之间的竞争环境中。在此基础上，我们进一步研究了新企业进入家庭健康护理行业所带来的竞争效应。具体而言，我们采用需求认证法作为企业进入的代理指标，以避免进入行为的潜在内生性。研究发现，在非需求认证州，家庭健康服务机构在公开报告制度下提升质量的效果明显优于需求认证州的机构。由于家庭健康护理是一个劳动密集型且资本需求较低的行业，需求认证法成为新企业进入该行业的重大障碍。我们的研究建议，政策制定者可以考虑结合信息公开与进入监管措施，以进一步提高家庭健康护理服务的质量。

abstract.text: Hospital-physician integration has substantially grown in the United States for the past decade, particularly in certain medical specialties, such as oncology. Yet evidence is scarce on the relation between integration and outpatient specialty care use and spending. We analyzed the impact of oncologist integration on outpatient provider-administered chemotherapy use and spending in Medicare, where prices do not depend on providers' integration status or negotiating power. We addressed oncologists' selective integration and patients' nonrandom choice of oncologists using an instrumental variables method. We found that integrated oncologists reduced the quantity of outpatient chemotherapy drugs but used more expensive treatments. This led to an increase in chemotherapy-drug spending after integration. These findings suggest that changes in treatment patterns-treatment mix and quantity-may be an important mechanism by which integration increases spending. We also found that integration increased spending on chemotherapy administration (the act of injection). This is because integration shifted billing of chemotherapy to hospital outpatient departments, where Medicare payments for chemotherapy administration are higher than those in physician offices. As integration increases, efforts should continue to assess how integration influences patient care and explore policy options to ensure desirable outcomes from integration.

10.1002/hec.3860.abstractZh: 在过去十年中，美国的医院与医生之间的整合程度显著上升，尤其是在某些医学专业领域，如肿瘤学。然而，关于整合程度与门诊专科护理使用及支出之间的关系，相关的研究却很少。我们分析了肿瘤科医生整合对Medicare计划下门诊医生提供的化疗使用及支出的影响，其中化疗的价格并不取决于医生的整合状态或谈判能力。我们使用工具变量方法研究了肿瘤科医生的选择性整合以及患者对非随机选择的肿瘤医生的选择行为。研究发现，整合的肿瘤医生减少了门诊化疗药物的用量，但使用了更昂贵的治疗方法。这导致整合后化疗药物的支出增加。这些发现表明，治疗模式的变化——包括治疗方式和用药量的变化——可能是整合增加支出的重要机制之一。我们还发现，整合增加了化疗管理（即注射操作）的支出。这是因为整合将化疗的计费转移到了医院门诊部门，而Medicare对化疗管理的支付金额高于医生诊所。随着整合程度的提高，应继续评估整合如何影响患者护理，并探索政策选项以确保整合带来的积极效果。

abstract.text: The objective of this study is to examine the causal effect of health care utilization on unmet health care needs. An IV approach deals with the endogeneity between the use of health care services and unmet health care, using the presence of drug insurance and the number of physicians by health region as instruments. We employ three cycles of the Canadian Community Health Survey confidential master files (2003, 2005, and 2014). We find a robustly negative relationship between health care use and unmet health care needs. One more visit to a medical doctor on average decreases the probability of reporting unmet health care needs by 0.014 points. The effect is negative for the women-only group whereas it is statistically insignificant for men; similarly, the effect is negative for urban dwellers but insignificant for rural ones. Health care use reduces the likelihood of reporting unmet health care. Policies that encourage the use of health care services, like increasing the coverage of public drug insurance and increasing after hours accessibility of physicians, can help reduce the likelihood of unmet health care.

10.1002/hec.3862.abstractZh: 本研究旨在探讨医疗服务的利用对未满足医疗需求的影响。采用工具变量方法，通过医疗服务的使用与未满足医疗需求之间的内生关系进行分析，以药物保险的存在和医生数量作为地区指标。我们使用了加拿大社区健康调查的三轮机密数据（2003年、2005年和2014年）。研究发现，医疗服务的利用与未满足医疗需求之间存在显著的负相关关系。平均而言，每增加一次就医，报告未满足医疗需求的概率会降低0.014个百分点。这一效应在女性群体中较为显著，而在男性群体中则没有统计学意义；同样，这一效应在城市居民中为负，但在农村居民中则不明显。医疗服务的利用可以降低报告未满足医疗需求的可能性。鼓励医疗服务使用的政策，如扩大公共药物保险覆盖范围以及提高医生在业余时间的可及性，有助于减少未满足医疗需求的情况。

abstract.text: Demographic change has increased the need for elderly care. Training unemployed workers might be one way to increase the supply of elderly care nurses. This study analyzes the effectiveness of subsidized training for unemployed individuals in the elderly care professions in Germany over 11.5 years. We find that short further training and long retraining courses significantly increase workers' long-term employment. As approximately 25% to 50% of trained nurses have permanent jobs in the care sector, we estimate that approximately 5% of all employed nurses are formerly trained unemployed workers.

10.1002/hec.3863.abstractZh: 人口结构的变化增加了对老年护理的需求。培训失业工人可能是增加老年护理护士供应的一种方式。本研究分析了在德国对从事老年护理职业的失业人员进行补贴培训的有效性，研究时间长达11.5年。我们发现，短期的进修课程和长期再培训课程显著提高了工人的长期就业率。由于大约25%到50%的受训护士在护理行业拥有稳定的工作，我们估计，所有就业中的护士中约有5%曾经是接受过培训的失业工人。

abstract.text: In utero shocks have been shown to have long-lasting consequences. However, we hardly know whether these effects tend to fade out over time and whether they can be compensated by post-natal investments. This paper examines the effect of birth endowment over time by employing a long panel of individuals born in 1983 in Cebu (Philippines) that includes relevant information on the pregnancy. We build a refined health endowment measure netted out from prenatal investments. We find that initial endowments affect trajectories both through the human capital production function and subsequent parental investment. The effect of birth endowment remains until adulthood and the fading out is very limited for health outcomes but more pronounced for educational outcomes. We also find that parents tend to reinforce initial health endowments, but the effect of this behaviour has almost no effect on final outcomes.

10.1002/hec.3864.abstractZh: 研究表明，子宫内的冲击会产生长期影响。然而，我们几乎不清楚这些影响是否会随着时间的推移逐渐消失，以及是否可以通过产后投资来弥补。本文通过采用1983年出生于菲律宾宿务的一个长期个体面板数据，来研究出生时的健康状况随时间的变化情况，该数据包含了关于妊娠的相关信息。我们构建了一个经过精细调整的卫生状况指标，该指标剔除了产前投资的影响。研究发现，初始的卫生状况通过人力资本生产函数和随后的父母投资对个体轨迹产生影响。出生时的卫生状况影响持续至成年期，而健康结果的变化非常有限，但教育结果的变化则更为明显。我们还发现，父母倾向于强化初始的卫生状况，但这种行为对最终结果的影响几乎为零。

abstract.text: Over 95% of post-mortem samples from the 1918 pandemic, which caused 50 to 100 million deaths, showed bacterial infection complications. The introduction of antibiotics in the 1940s has since reduced the risk of bacterial infections, but growing resistance to antibiotics could increase the toll from future influenza pandemics if secondary bacterial infections are as serious as in 1918, or even if they are less severe. We develop a valuation model of the option to withhold wide use of an antibiotic until significant outbreaks such as pandemic influenza or foodborne diseases are identified. Using real options theory, we derive conditions under which withholding wide use is beneficial, and calculate the option value for influenza pandemic scenarios that lead to secondary infections with a resistant Staphylococcus aureus strain. We find that the value of withholding an effective novel oral antibiotic can be positive and significant unless the pandemic is mild and causes few secondary infections with the resistant strain or if most patients can be treated intravenously. Although the option value is sensitive to parameter uncertainty, our results suggest that further analysis on a case-by-case basis could guide investment in novel agents as well as strategies on how to use them.

10.1002/hec.3867.abstractZh: 在1918年那场导致5000万至1亿人死亡的疫情中，超过95%的尸检样本显示存在细菌感染并发症。20世纪40年代抗生素的引入降低了细菌感染的风险，但抗生素耐药性的增加可能会在未来流感大流行中增加死亡人数，如果二次细菌感染与1918年一样严重，或者即使严重程度较低。我们开发了一个估值模型，用于评估在出现重大疫情或食源性疾病之前暂缓广泛使用某种抗生素的选择。利用实物期权理论，我们推导出暂缓使用抗生素的有利条件，并计算了导致耐药金黄色葡萄球菌二次感染的流感大流行情景下的期权价值。我们发现，除非流感大流行较为温和，导致较少的耐药菌株二次感染，或者大多数患者可以通过静脉注射进行治疗，否则暂缓使用一种有效的新型口服抗生素的期权价值可能是正值且显著的。尽管期权价值对参数不确定性敏感，但我们的研究结果表明，基于具体情况进行进一步分析，可以指导对新型药物的投资以及如何使用这些药物的策略。

abstract.text: We use the 2006 relaxation of constraints on patient choice of hospital in the English NHS to investigate the effect of hospital competition on dimensions of efficiency including indicators of resource management (admissions per bed, bed occupancy rate, proportion of day cases, and cancelled elective operations) and costs (reference cost index for overall and elective activity, cleaning services costs, laundry and linen costs). We employ a quasi differences-in-differences approach and estimate seemingly unrelated regressions and unconditional quantile regressions with data on hospital trusts from 2002/2003 to 2010/2011. Our findings suggest that increased competition had mixed effects on efficiency. An additional equivalent rival increased admissions per bed by 1.1%, admissions per doctor by 0.9% and the proportion of day cases by 0.38 percentage points, but it also increased the number of cancelled elective operations by 2.5%.

10.1002/hec.3868.abstractZh: 我们利用2006年英国国家医疗服务体系对医院患者选择限制的松绑政策，来研究医院竞争对效率各维度的影响，这些效率维度包括资源管理指标（每床位的入院人数、床位占用率、日间手术比例以及取消的择期手术）和成本（整体及择期活动的参考成本指数、清洁服务成本、洗衣和床品成本）。我们采用准差异-差异方法，并利用2002/2003年至2010/2011年间医院信托机构的数据，进行看似不相关的回归和无条件分位数回归分析。研究发现，竞争加剧对效率的影响具有双重性：额外的竞争使每床位的入院人数增加了1.1%，每位医生的入院人数增加了0.9%，日间手术比例增加了0.38个百分点，但同时也使取消的择期手术数量增加了2.5%。

abstract.text: Discrete choice experiments (DCEs) are frequently used in health economics to measure preferences for nonmarket goods. Best-worst discrete choice experiment (BWDCE) has been proposed as a variant of the traditional "pick the best" approach. BWDCE, where participants choose the best and worst options, is argued to generate more precise preference estimates because of the additional information collected. However, the validity of the approach relies on two necessary conditions: (a) best and worst decisions provide similar information about preferences and (b) asking individuals to answer more than one choice question per task does not reduce data quality. Whether these conditions hold in empirical applications remains under researched. This is the first study to compare participants' choices across three experimental conditions: (a) BEST choices only, (b) WORST choices only, and (c) BEST and WORST choices (BWDCE). We find responses to worst choices are noisier. Implied preferences from the best only and worst only choices are qualitatively different, leading to different WTP values. Responses to BWDCE tasks have lower consistency, and respondents are more likely to use simplifying decision heuristics. We urge caution in using BWDCE as an alternative to the traditional "pick the best" DCE.

10.1002/hec.3869.abstractZh: 离散选择实验（DCEs）在健康经济学中常被用来衡量对非市场商品的偏好。最佳-最差离散选择实验（BWDCE）被提出作为传统“选择最佳”方法的变体。BWDCE中，参与者选择最佳和最差选项，因为收集了额外的信息，因此能够得出更精确的偏好估计。然而，这种方法的有效性依赖于两个必要条件：(a) 最佳和最差决策提供了相似的偏好信息；(b) 要求个体在每项任务中回答多个选择问题并不会降低数据质量。这些条件在实证应用中的适用性仍有待研究。这是第一项比较参与者在三种实验条件下的选择的研究：(a) 仅选择最佳选项；(b) 仅选择最差选项；以及(c) 同时选择最佳和最差选项（BWDCE）。我们发现，对最差选项的回应更加不稳定。仅选择最佳和最差选项所反映的偏好在质量上有所不同，从而导致不同的支付意愿值。BWDCE任务的回应一致性较低，受访者更可能使用简化的决策启发式方法。我们建议在使用BWDCE作为传统“选择最佳”DCE的替代方案时需谨慎。

abstract.text: Despite its importance in health care, empirical evidence on patient trust is limited. This is likely because, as with many complex concepts, trust is difficult to measure. This study measured patient trust in health care providers in a sample of 667 patients in Senegal. Two instruments were used to measure patient trust in providers: a survey questionnaire and an incentivised behavioural economic experiment-a "trust game." The results show that the two measures are significantly, but weakly, associated. Using information from patients and providers, we find that continuity of care, provider communication ability, and clinical competence were positively associated with patient trust. Based on the results obtained from both methods, the trust game seems to have higher construct validity than the survey instrument in this context. This paper contributes to the methodological literature on patient trust and the evidence on the determinants of patient trust. It suggests that researchers interested in studying patient trust in providers should rely more on economic experiments and explore their validity in different contexts.

10.1002/hec.3870.abstractZh: 尽管信任在医疗保健中具有重要意义，但关于患者信任的实证研究却十分有限。这可能是因为，与许多复杂概念一样，信任难以测量。本研究在塞内加尔的667名患者样本中，使用两种工具来衡量患者对医疗保健提供者的信任：一种是调查问卷，另一种是激励性的行为经济实验——即“信任游戏”。研究结果表明，这两种测量方法之间存在显著但较弱的关联。根据患者和提供者的反馈，我们发现，持续性的护理服务、提供者的沟通能力和临床能力都与患者的信任呈正相关。基于这两种方法得出的结果，信任游戏在这一点上似乎比调查问卷具有更高的结构效度。本文为关于患者信任的方法论研究提供了贡献，并提供了有关患者信任决定因素的实证证据。研究建议，对研究患者与提供者之间信任感兴趣的研究人员应更多地依赖经济实验，并探索这些实验在不同情境下的有效性。

abstract.text: This analysis presents the results of a systematic review for health state utilities in multiple myeloma, as well as analysis of over 9,000 observations taken from registry and trial data. The 27 values identified from 13 papers are then synthesised in a frequentist nonparametric bootstrap model and a Bayesian meta-regression. Results were similar between the frequentist and Bayesian models with low utility on disease diagnosis (approximately 0.55), raising to approximately 0.65 on first line treatment and declining slightly with each subsequent line. Stem cell transplant was also found to be a significant predictor of health-related quality of life in both individual patient data and meta-regression, with an increased utility of approximately 0.06 across different models. The work presented demonstrates the feasibility of Bayesian methods for utility meta-regression, whilst also presenting an internally consistent set of data from the analysis of registry data. To facilitate easy updating of the data and model, data extraction tables and model code are provided as Data S1. The main limitations of the model relate to the low number of studies available, particularly in highly pretreated patients.

10.1002/hec.3871.abstractZh: 该分析呈现了针对多发性骨髓瘤健康状态效用的系统综述结果，同时分析了来自登记数据和试验数据的9,000多项观察结果。从13篇论文中确定的27个效用值通过频率主义非参数自助法模型和贝叶斯元回归进行了综合分析。频率主义和贝叶斯模型的结果相似，疾病诊断的效用值较低（约为0.55），一线治疗的效用值上升至约0.65，而后续每一线的效用值略有下降。干细胞移植也被发现是个体患者数据和元回归分析中健康相关生活质量的重要预测因素，不同模型下的效用值增加了约0.06。该研究展示了贝叶斯方法在效用元回归中的可行性，同时提供了来自登记数据分析的内部一致的数据集。为了便于数据更新和模型维护，提供了数据提取表和模型代码作为数据S1。模型的主要限制在于可用研究数量较少，尤其是在高度预处理的患者中。

abstract.text: The concurrence of health insurance expansion under the Affordable Care Act (ACA) and increasing opioid-related mortality has led to debate whether insurance increases or decreases opioid deaths. I use the introduction of the ACA young adult (YA) provision as a quasi-experiment and utilize the resulting policy-induced variation across states over time in YA access to insurance to study the effect of coverage on opioid-related mortality. I rely on the share of state populations which stood to gain insurance before the ACA to perform a dose-response analysis, and find that the YA provision reduced opioid-related mortality. The analysis suggests that 1 percentage point more coverage reduced opioid mortality among YA by 2.5/100,000 or 19.8%.

10.1002/hec.3872.abstractZh: 根据《平价医疗法案》推动医疗保险扩展与阿片类药物相关死亡率上升的情况，引发了关于保险政策是否会增加还是减少阿片类药物相关死亡人数的讨论。我以《平价医疗法案》中的青年成人条款为实验对象，利用各州在青年成人获得保险方面的政策差异来研究保险覆盖对阿片类药物相关死亡率的影响。我依据《平价医疗法案》实施前各州因保险覆盖而受益的人口比例进行了剂量反应分析，发现青年成人条款确实降低了阿片类药物相关死亡率。分析结果表明，每增加1个百分点的保险覆盖，青年成人的阿片类药物相关死亡率可降低2.5/100,000或19.8%。

abstract.text: Research on home-based long-term care has centered almost solely on the costs; there has been very little, if any, attention paid to the relative benefits. This study exploits the randomization built into the Cash and Counseling Demonstration and Evaluation program that directly impacted the likelihood of having family involved in home care delivery. Randomization in the trial is used as an instrumental variable for family involvement in care, resulting in a causal estimate of the effect of changing the combination of home health-care providers on health-care utilization and health outcomes of the beneficiary. We find that some family involvement in home-based care significantly decreases health-care utilization: lower likelihood of emergency room use, Medicaid-financed inpatient days, any Medicaid hospital expenditures, and fewer months with Medicaid-paid inpatient use. We find that individuals who have some family involved in home-based care are less likely to have several adverse health outcomes within the first 9 months of the trial, including lower prevalence of infections, bedsores, or shortness of breath, suggesting that the lower utilization may be due to better health outcomes.

10.1002/hec.3873.abstractZh: 关于家庭长期护理的研究几乎完全集中在成本方面；对于相对收益的关注则非常少，甚至几乎没有。本研究利用了“现金与咨询示范与评估计划”中内置的随机化机制，该机制直接影响了家庭参与家庭护理的可能性。试验中的随机化被用作家庭参与护理的工具变量，从而能够推断出改变家庭护理提供者组合对护理利用和受益人健康结果的影响。我们发现，家庭参与家庭护理显著降低了护理利用：急诊室使用的可能性降低，接受医疗补助资助的住院天数减少，医疗补助医院支出减少，使用医疗补助支付的住院时间也减少。我们还发现，在试验的前9个月内，有家庭参与的家庭成员出现不良健康结果的可能性较低，包括感染、褥疮或呼吸急促的发生率较低，这表明较低的利用可能源于更好的健康结果。

abstract.text: This article identifies information asymmetries and the corresponding problem of overtreatment as a possible source of prevention and health disparities when patients differ with respect to their health risk. It analyzes preventive health behavior (primary prevention) and preventive health-care utilization (secondary prevention) in markets in which patients cannot determine whether they receive excessive secondary preventive treatment-that is, where health services are credence goods. The problem of overtreatment in such markets is considered as a possible pathway through which differences in health risk lead to disparities in primary and secondary prevention as well as the corresponding health outcomes. Patients with high health risks do not invest in primary prevention, because they anticipate to be provided with unnecessary secondary prevention. Patients with lower risks invest in primary but not in secondary prevention, resulting in health losses. Furthermore, when societal groups differ with respect to their exposure to overtreatment, and we consider socioeconomic status as a possible reason, we observe disparities in primary and secondary prevention as well as the resulting health outcomes, including the "social gradient." Several implications for empirical research are discussed.

10.1002/hec.3874.abstractZh: 本文指出，信息不对称性以及过度治疗可能是预防和健康差异的潜在来源，尤其是在患者健康风险存在差异的情况下。文章分析了在患者无法判断自己是否接受了过度二级预防治疗的市场中的预防健康行为（一级预防）和预防性医疗服务利用（二级预防）——即，在医疗服务被视为可信赖商品的市场中。这类市场中过度治疗的问题被视为导致健康风险差异引发一级预防和二级预防差异以及相应健康结果差异的潜在途径。健康风险较高的患者不会投资于一级预防，因为他们预期会接受不必要的二级预防。而风险较低的患者则只投资于一级预防，而不投资于二级预防，从而导致健康损失。此外，当不同社会群体在过度治疗的暴露程度上存在差异时，如果我们将社会经济地位视为可能的原因，我们会观察到一级预防和二级预防的差异以及相应的健康结果差异，包括所谓的“社会梯度”。文章还讨论了若干对实证研究的启示。

abstract.text: Utilization-based approaches have predominated the measurement of socioeconomic-related inequity in health care. This approach, however, can be misleading when preferences over health and health care are correlated with socioeconomic status, especially when the underlying focus is on equity of access. We examine the potential usefulness of an alternative approach to assessing inequity of access using a direct measure of possible barriers to access-self-reported unmet need (SUN)-which is documented to vary with socioeconomic status and is commonly asked in health surveys. Specifically, as part of an assessment of its external validity, we use Canadian longitudinal health data to test whether self-reported unmet need in one period is associated with a subsequent deterioration in health status in a future period, and find that it is. This suggests that SUN does reflect in part reduced access to needed health care, and therefore may have a role in assessing health system equity as a complement to utilization-based approaches.

10.1002/hec.3877.abstractZh: 基于利用度的研究方法在衡量与经济社会地位相关的医疗不平等方面占据主导地位。然而，当对健康和医疗的偏好与经济社会地位相关联时，这种方法可能会产生误导，尤其是在关注公平获取机会的情况下。我们探讨了另一种评估获取机会不平等的方法的潜在实用性，该方法采用直接衡量可能的获取障碍——自我报告的无满足需求——这一指标被证明会随经济社会地位变化，并且在健康调查中经常被询问。具体来说，作为对其外部有效性的评估的一部分，我们使用加拿大纵向健康数据来测试某一时期的自我报告无满足需求是否与随后某一时期的健康状况恶化有关，结果发现确实如此。这表明自我报告的无满足需求在一定程度上反映了对所需医疗服务的获取减少，因此可能作为补充手段，在评估医疗系统公平性方面发挥作用，与基于利用度的方法相辅相成。

abstract.text: Individuals often have biased perceptions about their peers' behavior. We use an economic equilibrium analysis to study the role social norms play in substance use decisions. Using a nationally representative dataset, we estimate the effect of misperception about friends' alcohol, smoking, and marijuana use on consumption of these substances by youths in grades 7-12. Overestimation of friend's substance use significantly increases adolescent's own use approximately 1 year later, and the estimated effect is robust across specifications including individual-level fixed effects regression. The effect size is bigger for boys than for girls. The estimates for those who initially underestimated the norm suggest the possibility of a rebound/boomerang effect.

10.1002/hec.3878.abstractZh: 人们往往对同龄人的行为持有偏见。我们采用经济均衡分析方法来研究社会规范在物质使用决策中的作用。利用一个具有全国代表性的数据集，我们估计了人们对朋友酒精、吸烟和大麻使用情况的误解对7至12年级青少年这些物质使用行为的影响。对朋友物质使用情况的过高估计会在大约一年后显著增加青少年自身的物质使用量，且这一效应在包括个体水平固定效应回归在内的多种模型中均具有稳定性。对于男孩而言，这种效应的大小比女孩更大。对于那些最初低估社会规范的人，我们的估计结果表明可能存在一种反弹/回弹效应。

abstract.text: This study proposes a new empirical strategy for assessing how "efficient" different individuals and groups are in converting their available resources into achievements. Following the capabilities approach, pioneered by Amartya Sen, we employ the concept of "conversion rates" to capture the efficiency of the link from resources to achievements. The methodology is both simpler and more conceptually precise than previous options, this offering the potential to support significant expanded work in this area. The proposed methodology is then tested in relation to health care in Italy. The findings suggest that investments in education may carry particular health benefits for women, which public resources are particularly important for the elderly, and that single individuals pose special challenges because they benefit less from all types of resources than married couples. The results thus highlight significant heterogeneities in the abilities of different groups to convert public, private, and nonfinancial resources into health, and we conclude by noting the possible consequences for health care and public policies.

10.1002/hec.3879.abstractZh: 本研究提出了一种新的实证策略，用于评估不同个体和群体将可用资源转化为成就的“效率”。遵循阿马蒂亚·森开创的能力主义方法，我们采用“转化率”这一概念来衡量资源转化为成就的效率。该方法比以往的选择更为简单且概念上更为精确，为这一领域的研究提供了进一步扩展的潜力。随后，我们针对意大利的医疗保健领域对所提出的方法进行了测试。研究发现，对教育的投资可能对女性带来特定的健康益处，而公共资源对老年人尤为重要。此外，单身个体面临特殊挑战，因为他们从各种资源中获得的收益比已婚夫妇要少。这些结果凸显了不同群体将公共资源、私人资源和非财务资源转化为健康成果的能力存在显著差异，最后我们指出了这些发现对医疗保健和公共政策可能产生的影响。

abstract.text: In the "basic" approach, medical expenses are catastrophic if they exceed a prespecified percentage of consumption or income; the approach tells us if expenses cause a large percentage reduction in living standards. The ability-to-pay (ATP) approach defines expenses as catastrophic if they exceed a prespecified percentage of consumption less expenses on nonmedical necessities or an allowance for them. The paper argues that the ATP approach does not tell us whether expenses are large enough to undermine a household's ability to purchase nonmedical necessities. The paper compares the income-based and consumption-based variants of the basic approach, and shows that if the individual is a borrower after a health shock, the income-based ratio will exceed the consumption-based ratio, and both will exceed the more theoretically correct Flores et al. ratio; whereas if the individual continues to be a saver after a health shock, the ordering is reversed and the income-based ratio may not overestimate Flores et al.'s ratio. Last, the paper proposes a lifetime money metric utility (LMMU) approach defining medical expenses as catastrophic in terms of their lifetime consequences. Under certain assumptions, the LMMU and Flores et al. approaches are identical, and neither requires data on how households finance their medical expenses.

10.1002/hec.3881.abstractZh: 在“基础”方法中，如果医疗费用超过消费或收入的特定百分比，则被视为灾难性支出；该方法会告诉我们这些支出是否会导致生活水平大幅下降。支付能力方法将医疗费用定义为灾难性支出，前提是它们超过消费减去非医疗必需品支出或相关补贴后的比例。本文认为，支付能力方法无法判断这些支出是否足以削弱家庭购买非医疗必需品的能力。文章比较了基于收入和基于消费的基础方法，并表明：如果个体在健康危机后成为借款人，基于收入的比例会超过基于消费的比例，而两者都会超过理论上更为准确的Flores等人的比例；而如果个体在健康危机后继续作为储蓄者，则顺序会相反，基于收入的比例可能不会高估Flores等人的比例。最后，文章提出了一种终身货币效用指标方法，将医疗费用定义为在其终身后果方面具有灾难性影响的支出。在某些假设条件下，终身货币效用指标方法和Flores等人的方法是一致的，且两者都不需要关于家庭如何融资医疗费用的数据。

abstract.text: Household scanner data are increasingly used to inform health policy such as sugar-sweetened beverage taxes. This article examines whether differences in the level of reported expenditures between IRI Consumer Network scanner panel and the Consumer Expenditure Survey (CES) lead to important differences in demand elasticities and policy simulation outcomes. Using each dataset, we estimated a structural consumer demand system with seven food groups and a numéraire good. To compare the two datasets on a level playing field, we went to great lengths to ensure that the explanatory variables in the two demand models were comparably constructed. Results indicate that scanner data households are not consistently more price responsive than the general population and underreported Consumer Network expenditures do not seem to result in systematic differences in price elasticities. The income elasticities are uniformly lower in Consumer Network than in CES for higher income households because of the positive association between income and the degree of underreporting. This, however, has limited effects on uncompensated price elasticities and policy simulations because food budget shares are small for higher income households. Overall, these findings support continued use of household scanner data in health policy research related to effects of price (dis)incentives.

10.1002/hec.3883.abstractZh: 家庭扫描数据越来越多地被用于制定健康政策，例如对含糖饮料征税。本文探讨了IRI消费者网络扫描小组与消费者支出调查之间报告支出水平的差异是否会导致需求弹性和政策模拟结果的重要差异。利用这两个数据集，我们建立了一个包含七种食品类别和一个基准商品的消费者需求结构模型。为了在两个数据集之间进行比较，我们尽力确保两个需求模型中的解释变量具有可比性。结果表明，使用扫描数据的家庭并不比普通人群更敏感于价格变化，且未报告的消费者网络支出似乎并不会导致价格弹性的系统性差异。对于高收入家庭而言，消费者网络调查中的收入弹性普遍低于CES调查，这是因为收入与报告不足程度之间存在正相关关系。然而，这一因素对未补偿价格弹性和政策模拟的影响有限，因为高收入家庭的食品预算份额较小。总体而言，这些发现支持在涉及价格激励/抑制效应的健康政策研究中继续使用家庭扫描数据。

abstract.text: The cost-effectiveness acceptability curve (CEAC) shows the probability that an option ranks first for net benefit. Where more than two options are under consideration, the CEAC offers only a partial picture of the decision uncertainty. This paper discusses the appropriateness of showing the full set of rank probabilities for reporting the results of economic evaluation in multiple technology appraisal (MTA). A case study is used to illustrate the calculation of rank probabilities and associated metrics, based on Monte Carlo simulations from a decision model. Rank probabilities are often used to show uncertainty in the results of network meta-analysis, but until now have not been used for economic evaluation. They may be useful decision-making tools to complement the CEAC in specific MTA contexts.

10.1002/hec.3884.abstractZh: 成本效益可接受性曲线（CEAC）展示了某个选项在净收益方面排名第一的概率。当考虑超过两个选项时，CEAC只能提供决策不确定性的部分信息。本文讨论了在多项技术评估中展示完整的排名概率集以报告经济评估结果的合理性。通过案例研究，基于决策模型的蒙特卡洛模拟，说明了排名概率及相关指标的计算方法。排名概率通常用于展示网络元分析结果的不确定性，但迄今为止尚未用于经济评估。在特定多项技术评估场景中，它们可以作为补充CEAC的决策工具。

abstract.text: Research linking economic conditions and health often does not consider children's mental health problems, which are the most common and consequential health issues for children and adolescents. We examine the effects of unemployment rates and housing prices on well-validated child and adolescent mental health outcomes and use of special education services for emotional problems in the 2001-2013 National Health Interview Survey. We find that the effects of economic conditions on children's mental health are clinically and economically meaningful; children's mental health outcomes worsen as the economy weakens. The effects of economic conditions on child and adolescent mental health are pervasive, found in almost every subgroup that we examine. The use of special education services for emotional problems also rises when economic conditions worsen. Our analyses of possible mechanisms that link economic conditions to child mental health suggest that parental unemployment cannot fully explain the relationship between economic conditions and child mental health.

10.1002/hec.3885.abstractZh: 关于经济状况与健康关系的研究往往忽视了儿童心理健康问题，而这些问题是儿童和青少年中最常见且后果严重的健康问题。本研究通过2001-2013年国民健康访谈调查，考察了失业率与房价对儿童及青少年心理健康结果以及情绪问题特殊教育服务使用的影响。研究发现，经济状况对儿童心理健康的影响具有临床和经济上的意义；随着经济衰退，儿童心理健康状况恶化。经济状况对儿童和青少年心理健康的影响具有普遍性，在我们调查的几乎所有子群体中均有所体现。当经济状况恶化时，用于解决情绪问题的特殊教育服务使用率也会上升。我们对经济状况与儿童心理健康之间可能联系机制的分析表明，父母失业并不能完全解释经济状况与儿童心理健康之间的关系。

abstract.text: The impact of the financial crisis has been uneven-with differences across industries and occupations. Jobs linked to health care appear better insulated, with nurses specifically showing labor force gains during the recent recession. What is not known is how important public sector employment opportunities are for these national nursing trends. Observing the universe of nurses working for one of the largest (and publicly operated) health care employers, we show that worsening economic conditions lead to stronger job attachment. Relatedly, older nurses also seem more willing to delay retirement and instead transition to part-time positions during a downturn.

10.1002/hec.3886.abstractZh: 金融危机的影响在不同行业和职业中并不均衡。与医疗保健相关的职业似乎相对较为稳定，尤其是护士在最近的经济衰退期间就业情况有所改善。然而，目前尚不清楚公共部门的工作机会对这些国家护理行业的趋势有多重要。通过对一家大型（且由公共机构运营）医疗保健雇主中的护士群体进行观察，我们发现经济状况恶化反而增强了他们对工作的忠诚度。此外，年长的护士似乎更愿意在经济低迷时期推迟退休，转而从事兼职工作。

abstract.text: There is limited evidence on the relationship between formal and informal care using panel data in a U.K. setting and focused specifically on people living together (co-residents). Using all 18 waves of the British Household Panel Survey (1991-2009), we analyse the effect of informal care given by co-residents on the use of formal home care and health care services more generally. To account for endogeneity, we estimate models using random effects instrumental variable regression using the number of daughters as a source of exogenous variation. We find that a 10% increase in the monthly provision of informal care hours decreases the probability of using home help (formal home care) by 1.02 percentage points (p < .05), equivalent to a 15.62% relative reduction. This effect was larger for home help provided by the state (β = -.117) compared with non-state home help (β = -.044). These results provide evidence that significant increases in the supply of informal care would reduce the demand for home-help provision.
