10.1002/hec.3887.abstractZh: 关于正式与非正式照顾之间的关系，使用英国面板数据的研究较为有限，且主要集中在共同居住的人群上。我们利用了英国家庭面板调查的全部18个调查周期（1991-2009年），分析了共同居住者提供的非正式照顾对正式家庭照顾及一般医疗服务使用的影响。为了考虑内生性问题，我们采用了随机效应工具变量回归模型，以女儿数量作为外生变量的来源。研究发现，非正式照顾时间每月增加10%，会使使用家庭帮助（正式家庭照顾）的概率降低1.02个百分点（p < .05），相当于相对减少了15.62%。对于由国家提供的家庭帮助，这一效应更为显著（β = -.117），而非国家提供的家庭帮助则表现为较小的效应（β = -.044）。这些结果表明，大幅增加非正式照顾的供给会减少对家庭帮助的需求。

abstract.text: Ambulances are a vital part of emergency medical services. However, they come in single, high intervention form, which is at times unnecessary, resulting in excessive costs for patients and insurers. In this paper, we ask whether UberX's entry into a city caused substitution away from traditional ambulances for low-risk patients, reducing overall volume. Using a city-panel over-time and leverage that UberX enter markets sporadically over multiple years, we find that UberX entry reduced the per capita ambulance volume by at least 6.7%. Our result is robust to numerous specifications.

10.1002/hec.3888.abstractZh: 救护车是紧急医疗服务中不可或缺的一部分。然而，救护车通常采取单一的高强度干预形式，这有时是不必要的，会导致患者和保险公司的过度成本。在本文中，我们探讨了UberX进入某城市是否导致低风险患者从传统救护车转向UberX，从而减少了整体救护车的使用量。通过长期的城市面板数据分析，并结合UberX在多个年份中分散进入市场的特点，我们发现UberX的进入使人均救护车使用量减少了至少6.7%。我们的研究结果在多种假设条件下依然成立。

abstract.text: A large literature has documented strong positive correlations among siblings in health, including body mass index (BMI) and obesity. This paper tests whether that is explained by a specific type of peer effect in obesity: genetic nurture. Specifically, we test whether an individual's weight is affected by the genes of their sibling, controlling for the individual's own genes. Using genetic data in Add Health, we find no credible evidence that an individual's BMI is affected by the polygenic risk score for BMI of their full sibling when controlling for the individual's own polygenic risk score for BMI. Thus, we find no evidence that the positive correlations in BMI between siblings are attributable to genetic nurture within families.

10.1002/hec.3889.abstractZh: 大量文献记录了兄弟姐妹在健康方面的强烈正相关性，包括体重指数（BMI）和肥胖问题。本文旨在探讨这种正相关性是否可以通过一种特定的同伴效应来解释：即遗传影响。具体来说，我们检验了一个人的体重是否受到其兄弟姐妹基因的影響，同时控制了个体自身的基因因素。利用Add Health研究所的遗传数据，我们发现，在控制个体自身BMI的多基因风险评分后，无法找到任何可信的证据表明个体的BMI会受到其全兄弟姐妹的多基因风险评分的影响。因此，我们没有发现证据表明兄弟姐妹之间的BMI正相关性可以归因于家庭内部的遗传影响。

abstract.text: Little is known about how prospective provider payment affects the provision of services led by unpredictable demand. We investigate hospital responses to a 32% increase in price for two treatments in emergency departments in England in April 2011 using data on 11,532,304 attendances (79 hospitals) between 2009/2010 and 2013/2014. We compare changes in the volumes of these two treatments to a treatment not attracting additional reimbursement using a difference-in-differences framework. Additional reimbursement led to 76% and 152% increases in the volumes of the two incentivised treatments. Hospitals received an additional £64.4 M between April 2011 and March 2014 for providing these treatments, of which 40% (£25.9 M) was attributable to the unanticipated hospital response to the price increase. We use time in treatment to distinguish real increases in treatment from reductions in undercoding or increases in upcoding. The association between the recorded receipt of these treatments and time spent in treatment was the same before and after the price increase, and there was no association between hospital-specific increases in recorded treatment volumes and changes in treatment times. The persistence of the treatment time increment suggests the increase in recorded treatment was a real increase in provision of treatments.

10.1002/hec.3890.abstractZh: 关于预期医疗服务提供方式如何影响服务供给，目前了解甚少。本研究利用2009/2010年至2013/2014年间11,532,304次就诊数据（涉及79家医院），调查了2011年4月英格兰急诊部门两项治疗费用增加32%时医院的应对情况。通过差异-差异框架，我们将这两项治疗费用增加后的就诊量变化与未获得额外补偿的治疗的就诊量变化进行了比较。额外补偿导致这两项激励性治疗的就诊量分别增加了76%和152%。在2011年4月至2014年3月期间，医院因提供这些治疗而额外获得了64.4百万英镑的收入，其中40%（25.9百万英镑）归因于医院对价格上涨的意外反应。我们通过治疗时间来区分实际的治疗量增加与编码错误导致的减少或编码过度导致的增加。记录到的这些治疗的接受时间与治疗时间之间的关联在价格上涨前后保持不变，且医院特定治疗量的增加与治疗时间的变化之间没有关联。治疗时间增加的持续性表明，记录到的治疗量增加是真实的治疗供给增加。

abstract.text: This paper presents a new regression-based decomposition of socioeconomic inequality of health that is more direct than other approaches. The method can be applied to both rank-dependent and level-dependent indicators of inequality. The response variable of our regression model is a simple reformulation of the measure of overall performance of an individual in the health and socioeconomic domains. Regression results are described in terms of marginal effects of the explanatory variables, but also in terms of their logworths or importance values. We illustrate our method, and compare it with alternatives, using Australian health and income data.

10.1002/hec.3891.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的基于回归的方法，用于分解健康领域的社会经济不平等现象，该方法比其他方法更为直接。该方法可以应用于依赖于排名和依赖于水平的各种不平等指标。我们的回归模型的响应变量是对个体在健康和社会经济领域整体表现的一种简单重新表述。回归结果不仅以解释变量的边际效应来描述，还以它们的对数价值或重要性值来描述。我们通过使用澳大利亚的健康和收入数据来演示我们的方法，并将其与其他方法进行比较。

abstract.text: The 2008 reform of the Spanish disability system reduced the benefits for individuals who have a short contributory history relative to their age. It also unintentionally introduced an incentive for individuals to apply for disability in the present. We use a lifecycle model and an empirical analysis to understand the overall impact of the reform. Our baseline estimates suggest that men and women who were affected by the reform were 46% and 22% more likely to be on permanent partial disability following the reform, respectively, and 55% and 46% more likely to be on total disability, respectively.

10.1002/hec.3892.abstractZh: 2008年西班牙残疾制度改革使得那些在年龄相对较短的情况下有短暂缴费历史的个人获得的福利减少。该改革还无意中为个人在当前申请残疾福利提供了激励。我们通过生命周期模型和实证分析来了解该改革的总体影响。我们的基线估计表明，受该改革影响的男性与女性分别有46%和22%的可能性在改革后处于永久部分残疾状态，分别有55%和46%的可能性处于完全残疾状态。

abstract.text: In many health care markets, physicians can respond to changes in reimbursement schemes by changing the volume (volume response) and the composition of services provided (substitution response). We examine the relative importance of these two behavioral responses in the context of physician drug dispensing in Switzerland. We find that dispensing increases drug costs by 52% for general practitioners and 56% for specialists. This increase is mainly due to a volume increase. The substitution response is negative on average, but not significantly different from zero for large parts of the distribution. In addition, our results reveal substantial effect heterogeneity.

10.1002/hec.3893.abstractZh: 在许多医疗保健市场中，医生可以通过改变服务的数量和服务内容的构成来应对报销方案的变化。我们研究了在瑞士医生配药过程中，这两种行为反应的相对重要性。研究发现，普通医生的配药行为使药物成本增加了52%，而专科医生的配药行为则使药物成本增加了56%。这种增加主要源于服务数量的增加。替代反应的平均值为负，但在大部分情况下与零没有显著差异。此外，我们的研究结果还揭示了效应存在显著的异质性。

abstract.text: This note studies the empirical link between public health expenditures and growth using a dynamic panel data model and U.S. state-level data over the period 1963-2015. We find a positive relationship between public health expenditures and growth, even after controlling for the offsetting impacts of the requisite taxation and the government budget constraint.

10.1002/hec.3894.abstractZh: 本论文利用动态面板数据模型，以1963年至2015年美国各州的数据为基础，研究公共卫生支出与经济增长之间的实证关系。研究发现，即使在控制了必要的税收和政府预算限制所带来的负面影响后，公共卫生支出与经济增长之间仍存在正相关关系。

abstract.text: Common health state valuation methodologies, such as standard gamble (SG) and time trade-off (TTO), typically produce different weights for identical health states. We attempt to alleviate these differences by correcting the confounding influences modeled in prospect theory: loss aversion and probability weighting. Furthermore, we correct for nonlinear utility of life duration. In contrast to earlier attempts at correcting TTO and SG weights, we measure and correct all these tenets simultaneously, using newly developed nonparametric methodology. These corrections were applied to three less-than-perfect health states, measured with TTO and SG. We found considerable loss aversion and probability weighting for both gains and losses in life years, and we observe concave utility for gains and convex utility for losses in life years. After correction, the initially significant differences in weights between TTO and SG disappeared for all health states. Our findings suggest new opportunities to account for bias in health state valuations but also the need for further validation of resulting weights.

10.1002/hec.3895.abstractZh: 常见的健康状态估值方法，如标准赌博法和时间权衡法，通常会在相同健康状态下产生不同的权重。我们试图通过修正前景理论中存在的混淆因素来减轻这些差异：损失厌恶和概率加权。此外，我们还修正了生命持续时间的非线性效用函数。与之前修正时间权衡法和标准赌博法权重的尝试不同，我们采用新开发的非参数方法同时测量和修正所有这些因素。这些修正被应用于三种不太理想的健康状态，这些状态通过时间权衡法和标准赌博法进行衡量。我们发现，无论是收益还是损失，都存在显著的损失厌恶和概率加权现象，并且观察到生命年数的收益具有凹效用，而损失则具有凸效用。经过修正后，时间权衡法和标准赌博法之间最初显著的权重差异在所有健康状态下都消失了。我们的研究结果提示了处理健康状态估值偏差的新机会，同时也需要进一步验证所得权重的准确性。

abstract.text: In light of population aging, it is important to understand whether limiting public in-kind transfers to the elderly affects elderly mortality. I focus on home health care-a popular in-kind transfer-and I exploit variation in the Medicare home health care reimbursement that arose in 1997 in the United States to study whether cuts to government coverage of home health care affected elderly mortality. Under the identifying assumptions of the DID model, I find that the cuts affected total mortality for some men but not women, suggesting that changes in home health care can affect elderly mortality and differences in mortality between men and women. For men aged between 65 and 74, the Interim Payment System was associated with an increase in mortality equal to 0.6%, an effect in absolute value comparable to the mortality response to a one percentage point change in unemployment rates and within the range of other estimates of the impact of health insurance on elderly mortality.

10.1002/hec.3896.abstractZh: 鉴于人口老龄化的趋势，了解限制向老年人提供的实物转移是否会影响老年人死亡率至关重要。我重点关注家庭护理这一受欢迎的实物转移方式，并利用1997年美国Medicare家庭护理报销政策的变化来研究政府家庭护理覆盖范围的削减是否影响了老年人死亡率。根据DID模型的假设，我发现削减政策对某些男性群体的总死亡率产生了影响，但对女性群体则没有，这表明家庭护理的变化能够影响老年人死亡率，以及男女之间的死亡率差异。对于年龄在65至74岁之间的男性，中期支付系统与死亡率增加了0.6%，这一效应在绝对值上可与失业率增加一个百分点所带来的死亡率变化相媲美，且与其他关于健康保险对老年人死亡率影响的估计结果一致。

abstract.text: A change in the expectations about future treatments may change the option value of a current treatment, thereby affecting its utilization. We conducted an interrupted time series analysis using a large administrative claims database to test whether the utilization of existing cancer treatments changed after the disclosures of the then-investigational drug ipilimumab's Phase II and Phase III results among metastatic melanoma patients from 2008 to 2011. We used a multinomial logistic regression to analyze the temporal probability of receiving antineoplastic systemic therapy, surgical resection of metastasis, or both, relative to no treatment, in the first 3 months following the first metastasis diagnosis. One thousand eight hundred forty-six metastatic melanoma patients were included. After adjusting for clinical and sociodemographic variables and the underlying time trend, the disclosure of ipilimumab's Phase II result was associated with a nearly twofold immediate increase in the probability of receiving surgical resection of metastasis relative to no treatment, which was significant at 5% level. No significant effect was observed for the time trend. No significant effects were found for the announcement of the Phase III result. Our findings in metastatic melanoma provide the first empirical evidence of the impact of option value in cancer treatment decision making.

10.1002/hec.3899.abstractZh: 对未来治疗方法的预期变化可能会改变当前治疗的选项价值，从而影响其使用率。我们使用大型行政索赔数据库进行了中断时间序列分析，以测试在2008年至2011年间，随着当时正在研究的药物伊匹木单抗在转移性黑色素瘤患者中的II期和III期研究结果公布后，现有癌症治疗的利用是否发生了变化。我们采用多项逻辑回归分析，研究在首次转移诊断后的前3个月内，接受抗肿瘤全身治疗、转移灶手术切除或两者兼有的时间概率，与不接受治疗的情况进行比较。共有1806名转移性黑色素瘤患者被纳入研究。在调整了临床和社会人口学变量以及基础时间趋势后，伊匹木单抗的II期研究结果公布后，接受转移灶手术切除的概率立即增加了近两倍，这一差异在5%的水平上具有显著性。对于时间趋势没有观察到显著效应。对于III期研究结果的通知也没有发现显著效应。我们在转移性黑色素瘤中的研究结果首次提供了关于选项价值在癌症治疗决策中影响的实证证据。

abstract.text: How does the presentation of multidimensional quality information in public reporting affect consumer responsiveness? This paper addresses this question exploiting an exogenous change of reporting format in the Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) reports by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Compared with the first version of the ART report, the second version highlights the "singleton-birth rate" measure, which is complementary to the "multiple-birth rate" measure reported in the first version. We find that consumers are more likely to choose clinics with a lower multiple-birth rate after the format change, indicating more sensitivity to the highlighted measure. This finding implies that information presentation plays an important role in affecting the effectiveness of public reporting.

10.1002/hec.3900.abstractZh: 在公共报告中呈现多维质量信息如何影响消费者的反应？本文通过探讨美国疾病控制与预防中心在辅助生殖技术报告中格式的变化来解答这个问题。与报告的第一版本相比，第二版本增加了“单胎出生率”这一指标，该指标是对第一版本中报告的“多胎出生率”的补充。我们发现，在格式变更后，消费者更倾向于选择多胎出生率较低的诊所，这表明他们对被强调的指标更为敏感。这一发现意味着信息呈现在影响公共报告的有效性方面起着重要作用。

abstract.text: We use randomized roommate assignment in dormitories in a college in Kolkata in India to examine peer effects in weight gains among roommates. We use administrative data on weight, height, and test scores of students at the time of college admission and then survey these students at the end of their first and second years in college. We do not find any significant roommate specific peer effect in weight gain. Our results rather suggest that an obese roommate reduces the probability that the other roommates become obese in subsequent years. We examine potential mechanism using survey data on students' eating habits, smoking, exercise, and sleeping patterns. We find that obese roommates sleep longer, which in turn improves the sleep pattern of others, which might explain the weak negative effect of obese roommates on the weight of others in the same room.

10.1002/hec.3901.abstractZh: 我们在印度加尔各答的一所大学宿舍中采用随机分配室友的方式，来研究室友之间对体重增长的相互影响。我们利用了学生入学时记录的体重、身高和考试成绩的行政数据，并在学生大学第一年和第二年末对这些学生进行了调查。我们发现，室友之间并没有显著的体重增长影响。相反，我们的结果表明，肥胖的室友会降低其他室友在后续年份变得肥胖的概率。为了进一步探究可能的机制，我们还使用了关于学生饮食习惯、吸烟、锻炼和睡眠模式的调查数据。研究发现，肥胖的室友睡眠时间更长，这反过来又改善了其他室友的睡眠模式，这可能解释了为什么肥胖室友对同室其他人的体重产生较弱的负面影响。

abstract.text: The objective of the study was to develop the clinical value unit method of allocating indirect costs to patient costs using clinical factors. The method was tested to determine whether it is a more reliable alternative to using the length of stay and marginal mark-up allocation method. The method developed used data from a Polish specialist hospital. The study involved 4,026 patients grouped into nine diagnosis-related groups (DRG). The study methodology involved a three stage approach: (a) identification of correlates of patient costs, (b) a comparison of the costs calculated using the clinical value unit method with the alternative methods: length of stay and marginal mark-up methods, and (c) an estimation of the cost homogeneity of the DRGs. The study showed that length of stay cost allocation method may underestimate the proportion of indirect costs in patient costs for a short in-patient stay and overestimate the cost for the patients with a long stay. The total costs estimated using the marginal mark-up method were higher than those estimated with length of stay method. For most surgical procedures, the mean indirect costs are higher using clinical value unit method than when using length of stay or marginal mark-up method. In all medical procedure cases, the mean indirect costs calculated using the clinical value unit method are in the range between marginal mark-up and length of stay method. We also show that in all DRGs except one, that the coefficient of homogeneity for clinical value unit is higher than for length of stay or marginal mark-up method. We conclude that the clinical value unit method of cost allocation is a more precise and reliable alternative than the other methods.

10.1002/hec.3902.abstractZh: 本研究的目的在于开发一种基于临床因素的间接成本向患者成本分配的临床价值单位方法。该方法经过测试，以确定其是否是一种比使用住院时间和边际加成分配方法更可靠的替代方案。所开发的方法采用了波兰一家专科医院的数据。研究涉及4,026名患者，这些患者被分为九个诊断相关组（DRG）。研究方法包括三个阶段：(a) 识别患者成本的相关因素；(b) 使用临床价值单位方法计算的成本与住院时间和边际加成方法的成本进行比较；(c) 估算各诊断相关组的成本同质性。研究表明，住院时间成本分配方法可能会低估短期住院患者的间接成本比例，并高估长期住院患者的成本。使用边际加成方法估算的总成本高于使用住院时间方法估算的成本。对于大多数外科手术，使用临床价值单位方法计算的平均间接成本高于使用住院时间或边际加成方法时计算的成本。在所有医疗手术案例中，使用临床价值单位方法计算的平均间接成本介于边际加成方法和住院时间方法之间。我们还发现，除了一个例外，所有诊断相关组的临床价值单位方法的同质性系数都高于住院时间或边际加成方法。因此，我们认为临床价值单位方法在成本分配方面是一种更精确和可靠的替代方案。

abstract.text: Pharmaceutical spending in the United States, Canada, and the EU is growing. Public payers cover a large portion of these costs and have responded by instituting various pricing and access policies to limit their expenditure. One challenge that public payers face is additional demand induced by a manufacturer's marketing effort. We use a game theoretic approach to study the impact of pharmaceutical marketing on six practical pricing and access policies: negotiated pricing, open pricing, controlled pricing, a listing process, a risk-sharing arrangement, and a value-based pricing with risk-sharing arrangement. We find that all non-value-based policies result in either restricted access or suboptimal treatment coverage. We find that marketing is the highest in the first-best setting where all decisions are made by a social planner. We also find that the value-based pricing with risk-sharing arrangement is preferred by the manufacturer and from a societal perspective whereas no policy is universally preferred by a health care payer. A value-based pricing with risk-sharing arrangement always results in zero net monetary benefit for a health care payer. Therefore, considering non-value-based arrangements, we find that a negotiated pricing policy, a controlled pricing policy, or a risk-sharing arrangement may be socially preferred.

10.1002/hec.3903.abstractZh: 美国、加拿大和欧盟的药品支出正在增长。公共支付方承担了大部分费用，并采取了各种定价和获取政策来限制其支出。公共支付方面临的一个挑战是由制造商的营销活动引发的额外需求。我们采用博弈论方法研究药品营销对六种实际定价和获取政策的影响：协商定价、公开定价、控制定价、上市流程、风险共享安排以及带有风险共享的基于价值的定价。我们发现，所有非基于价值的政策都会导致限制获取或治疗覆盖不足的情况。在最优情况下，营销活动的影响最大，此时所有决策都由社会规划者做出。我们还发现，从社会角度来看，制造商更倾向于采用带有风险共享的基于价值的定价方式，而没有任何一种政策被医疗支付方普遍偏好。带有风险共享的基于价值的定价方式总是对医疗支付方产生零净货币收益。因此，考虑到非基于价值的安排，我们发现协商定价政策、控制定价政策或风险共享安排可能是社会所偏好的选择。

abstract.text: Standard reference case methods recommended for health technology appraisals do not translate well to a public health setting. This paper reports on a Delphi survey designed to elicit views of public health decision makers in England and Wales, about different methodological elements of economic evaluation. This is important as methods should align with the objective function of decision makers. The Delphi survey comprised two rounds, with round 1 allowing open-ended recommendations in addition to 5-point Likert scale responses. The final survey comprised 36 questions, and levels and strength of agreement were assessed using median values and mean absolute deviation of the median. The Delphi panel (n = 66) achieved high levels of agreement for costs, health, well-being, and productivity impact to be important elements within an economic evaluation. The panel agreed that evaluations should be relevant to the local context and include costs and consequences over a lifetime horizon. There was a call for the transparent reporting of costs and effects for different population subgroups, and for different sectors. Overall, the panel revealed a preference for a flexible approach, understanding that economic evidence fits within a dynamic process of decision making. These results provide empirical evidence to inform guidelines for public health economic evaluation.

10.1002/hec.3916.abstractZh: 在健康技术评估中推荐的标准参考案例方法并不适用于公共卫生领域。本文报告了一项德尔菲调查，旨在收集英格兰和威尔士的公共卫生决策者对于经济评估不同方法学要素的看法。这一点非常重要，因为评估方法应与决策者的目标函数保持一致。德尔菲调查分为两轮，第一轮允许开放式建议，同时采用5点Likert量表进行回答。最终调查包含36个问题，通过中位数和 Median的均值绝对偏差来评估同意程度。德尔菲小组（n=66）在成本、健康、福祉和生产力影响方面达成了高度一致，认为这些是经济评估中的重要要素。小组一致认为，评估应结合当地实际情况，并涵盖终身范围内的成本和后果。此外，还呼吁对不同人群亚群和不同行业进行透明化的成本和效果报告。总体而言，小组倾向于采用灵活的方法，认为经济证据应适应动态的决策过程。这些结果为公共卫生经济评估的指南提供了实证依据。

abstract.text: We assess the relative importance of demand and supply factors as determinants of regional variation in healthcare expenditures in the Netherlands. Our empirical approach follows individuals who migrate between regions. We use individual data on annual healthcare expenditures for the entire Dutch population between the years 2006 and 2013. Regional variation in healthcare expenditures is mostly driven by demand factors, with an estimated share of around 70%. The relative importance of different causes varies with the groups of regions being compared.

10.1002/hec.3917.abstractZh: 我们评估了需求和供应因素在荷兰地区间医疗支出差异中的相对重要性。我们的实证研究方法以在各地区之间迁移的个人为研究对象。我们使用了2006年至2013年间整个荷兰人口的年度医疗支出数据。地区间医疗支出的差异主要由需求因素驱动，其占比约为70%。不同因素的相对重要性会随着所比较的地区群体而有所不同。

abstract.text: Many health economic studies assume expected utility maximisation, with typically a concave utility function to capture risk aversion. Given these assumptions, Rabin's paradox (RP) involves preferences over mixed gambles yielding moderate outcomes, where turning down such gambles imply absurd levels of risk aversion. Although RP is considered a classic critique of expected utility, no paper has as of yet fully tested its preferences within individuals. In an experiment we report a direct test of RP in the health domain, which was previously only considered in the economic literature, showing it may have pervasive implications here too. Our paper supports the shift towards alternative, empirically valid models, such as prospect theory, also in the health domain. These alternative models are able to accommodate Rabin's paradox by allowing reference-dependence and loss aversion.

10.1002/hec.3918.abstractZh: 许多健康经济研究都假设期望效用最大化，通常采用凹形效用函数来反映风险厌恶。基于这些假设，拉宾悖论涉及对混合赌注的偏好选择，这些赌注往往会导致中等的结果，而拒绝这些赌注则意味着极端的风险厌恶。尽管拉宾悖论被视为对期望效用的经典批判，但至今还没有论文完全测试了个体内部的偏好情况。在一项实验中，我们直接测试了拉宾悖论在健康领域的应用，而这一理论此前仅在经济文献中被考虑过，结果表明它在这里也可能具有广泛的影响。我们的论文支持向其他经验上有效的模型转变，例如前景理论，这些模型也能通过允许参考依赖和损失厌恶来解释拉宾悖论。

abstract.text: We use a difference-in-differences strategy to estimate the effects of JUNTOS, a conditional cash transfer program targeted to poor rural households in Peru, on use of prenatal care. Using data from the Peruvian Demographic and Health Surveys over the period 2000-2011, we find that JUNTOS increased prenatal care utilization among program-eligible women. Even more, we find positive effects of JUNTOS on the probability of receiving prenatal care delivered by a skilled professional, including specific medical checkups during the prenatal visits, and a negative effect on the probability of experiencing obstetric emergencies during labor and childbirth.

10.1002/hec.3919.abstractZh: 我们采用差异-差异策略来估计JUNTOS项目对秘鲁贫困农村家庭使用产前护理的影响。通过利用2000-2011年秘鲁人口与健康调查的数据，我们发现JUNTOS项目增加了符合条件的女性使用产前护理的比例。此外，我们还发现JUNTOS项目对获得由专业医生提供的产前护理的概率有积极影响，包括产前检查等具体医疗服务，同时对该项目对分娩过程中遇到产科紧急情况的概率有负面影响。

abstract.text: In most studies on hospital merger effects, the unit of observation is the merged hospital, whereas the observed price is the weighted average across hospital products and across payers. However, little is known about whether price effects vary between hospital locations, products, and payers. We expand existing bargaining models to allow for heterogeneous price effects and use a difference-in-differences model in which price changes at the merging hospitals are compared with price changes at comparison hospitals. We find evidence of heterogeneous price effects across health insurers, hospital products and hospital locations. These findings have implications for ex ante merger scrutiny.

10.1002/hec.3920.abstractZh: 在大多数学院合并效应的研究中，观察单位是合并后的医院，而观测到的价格是医院产品和服务以及支付方之间的加权平均值。然而，关于价格效应在不同医院位置、产品和服务以及支付方之间是否存在差异，目前知之甚少。我们扩展了现有的谈判模型，以允许价格效应的异质性，并使用差异-差异模型来比较合并医院的价格变化与对比医院的价格变化。我们发现，不同健康保险公司、医院产品和服务以及医院位置之间存在价格效应的异质性。这些发现对合并前的审查具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Many older Americans have poor access to dental care, resulting in a high prevalence of oral health problems. Because traditional Medicare does not include dental care benefits, only older Americans who are employed, have post-retirement dental benefits or spousal coverage, or enroll in certain Medicare Advantage plans are able to obtain dental care coverage. We seek to determine the extent to which poor access to dental insurance and high out-of-pocket costs affect dental service use by the elderly. Using the 2007-2015 Medical Expenditure Panel Survey and supplemental data on dental care prices, we estimate a demand system for preventive dental services and basic and major restorative services. Selection into dental and medical insurance is addressed using a correlated random effects panel data specification. Consistent with prior studies of the nonelderly population, dental service use was not sensitive to out-of-pocket prices. However, private dental insurance increased preventive service use by 25%, and dental coverage through Medicaid increased basic and major service use by 23% and 36%, respectively. The use of services was more responsive to dental insurance for women than men. These estimates suggest that a Medicare dental benefit could significantly increase dental service use by older Americans.

10.1002/hec.3921.abstractZh: 许多美国老年人难以获得优质的口腔护理服务，导致口腔健康问题的发生率很高。由于传统的医疗保险并不包含口腔护理福利，因此只有那些有工作、拥有退休后口腔护理福利或配偶保险覆盖的老年人，或者参加某些医疗保险附加计划的老年人，才能获得口腔护理服务。我们旨在研究口腔保险获取困难和高额自付费用对老年人口腔服务使用的影响。通过2007-2015年的医疗支出调查数据以及有关口腔护理价格的补充数据，我们估算了预防性口腔服务以及基础性和主要修复性服务的需求。使用相关随机效应面板数据模型来研究进入口腔和医疗保险的情况。与之前对非老年人群体的研究一致，口腔服务的使用并不受自付费用的影响。然而，私人口腔保险使预防性服务的使用增加了25%，而通过医疗补助获得的口腔护理服务则分别使基础性和主要服务的使用增加了23%和36%。女性对口腔保险服务的使用反应比男性更为敏感。这些估计表明，医疗保险中的口腔护理福利可以显著增加美国老年人的口腔服务使用。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of legislative changes allowing nurse practitioners to prescribe schedule II controlled substances independently. We find that this legal environment is associated with an increase in treatment admissions for opioid misuse and a decrease in opioid related mortality only when Mandatory Prescription Drugs Monitoring Programs are in place.

10.1002/hec.3922.abstractZh: 本文研究了允许护士执业者独立开具II类管制药物的法律变更所带来的影响。研究发现，只有在实施强制性处方药物监测计划的情况下，这种法律环境才会导致阿片类药物滥用治疗人次增加，以及阿片类药物相关死亡率下降。

abstract.text: California implemented hospital-unit level licensed nurse minimum staffing regulations in 2004, with more stringent regulations applying for certain units in 2005 and 2008. All analyses agree that there were significant increases in Registered Nurse (RN) staffing levels, especially in hospitals with lower preregulation staffing. Analyses of the labor market effects of the regulations, however, come to mixed conclusions. I revisit the labor market effects of the regulations using different data and a different analytical model for RN wages. For the analysis of growth of RN employment, I use information from the National Sample Survey of Registered Nurses, the largest and most complete source of information on nurse employment, and find that RN employment grew significantly faster in California than in other states after the regulations were implemented. For the analysis of changes in RN wages, I apply a panel difference-in-difference-in-difference model to wage averages in Metropolitan Statistical Areas, controlling for MSA-, occupation-, and time-fixed effects, and all their two-way interactions. Analysis of changes in the differential between RN wages and wages in four other selected occupations indicates significant growth in RN wages after the regulations were implemented.

10.1002/hec.3924.abstractZh: 加利福尼亚州于2004年实施了医院单位级别的持证护士最低人员配置规定，2005年和2008年对某些单位实施了更严格的规定。所有分析均表明，持证护士的人员配置水平显著增加，尤其是在配置水平较低的医院中。然而，关于这些规定对劳动力市场影响的分析结果不一。我使用不同的数据和不同的分析模型来重新评估这些规定对劳动力市场的影响，特别是护士工资方面。在分析持证护士就业增长情况时，我参考了《全国注册护士抽样调查》的数据，这是关于护士就业情况的最大且最完整的信息来源。结果发现，在加利福尼亚州，持证护士的就业增长速度明显快于其他州。在分析持证护士工资变化方面，我应用了面板差异模型，对都市统计区内的平均工资进行了分析，同时控制了都市统计区、职业和时间固定效应以及它们之间的双向交互作用。分析结果显示，在持证护士工资与其他四个选定职业的工资相比时，持证护士的工资也显著增长。

abstract.text: Seasonal variation exists in disease incidence. The variation could occur across the different regions in a country. This paper argues that using national household data that are not adjusted for seasonal and regional variations in disease incidence may not be directly suitable for assessing socio-economic inequality in annual outpatient service utilisation, including for cross-country comparison. In fact, annual health service utilisation may be understated or overstated depending on the period of data collection. This may lead to miss-estimation of socio-economic inequality in health service utilisation depending, among other things, on how health service utilisation, across geographical areas, varies by socio-economic status. Using a nationally representative dataset from South Africa, the paper applies a seasonality index that is constructed from the District Health Information System, an administrative dataset, to annualise public outpatient health service visits. Using the concentration index, socio-economic inequality in health service visits, after accounting for seasonal variations, was compared with that when seasonal variations are ignored. It was found that, in some cases, socio-economic inequality in outpatient health service visits depends on the socio-economic distribution of the seasonality index. This may justify the need to account for seasonal and geographical variations.

10.1002/hec.3925.abstractZh: 疾病发病率存在季节性变化，这种变化可能在不同地区出现。本文认为，使用未调整季节性及地区性差异的全国家庭数据来评估年度门诊服务利用情况的社会经济不平等程度，可能并不适合，尤其是在跨国比较中。实际上，年度医疗服务利用情况可能会因数据收集的时间段而有所不同，从而导致社会经济不平等程度的误估。这主要取决于医疗服务利用情况在不同地理区域及社会经济地位上的差异。本文以南非具有全国代表性的数据集为案例，利用来自地区健康信息系统的行政数据集构建季节性指数，以年度化公共门诊医疗服务访问量。通过浓度指数，在考虑季节性变化后，社会经济不平等程度与忽略季节性变化时的不平等程度进行了比较。研究发现，在某些情况下，门诊医疗服务访问的社会经济不平等程度取决于季节性指数的社会经济分布。这说明了考虑季节性和地理差异的必要性。

abstract.text: Physician payment models' incentives regarding many aspects of primary health care are not well understood. We focus on the case of medical laboratory utilization and examine how physicians' laboratory test ordering patterns change following a switch to a blended capitation payment model from one with fee for service enhanced with pay for performance. Also, within blended capitation, we examine differences between traditional staffing and interdisciplinary teams. Using a propensity score weighted fixed-effects specification to address selection, it is estimated that the switch to capitation leads to a short-run average of 3% fewer laboratory requisitions per patient. Patients' laboratory utilization also becomes more concentrated with the rostering physician. More importantly, using diabetes-related laboratory tests as a case study, after joining the blended model, physicians order 3% fewer inappropriate/redundant tests, and the addition of an interdisciplinary care team makes the reduction about 9%. Advances in both continuity and quality seem to be associated with blended capitation.

10.1002/hec.3927.abstractZh: 关于医生支付模式对初级医疗保健诸多方面的激励作用，目前尚未有充分的研究。本文重点关注医学实验室服务的利用情况，探讨在从基于服务收费的模式转向基于混合制酬付酬模式后，医生对实验室检测的订购模式发生了哪些变化。此外，在混合制酬付酬模式下，我们还研究了传统团队与跨学科团队之间的差异。通过采用倾向得分加权固定效应模型来消除选择偏差，研究发现转向混合制酬付酬模式后，短期内每患者的实验室检测请求平均减少了3%。患者的实验室服务也变得更加集中，由指定医生负责。更重要的是，以糖尿病相关实验室检测为例，在采用混合制酬付酬模式后，医生订购的不适当/冗余检测数量减少了3%，而加入跨学科护理团队后，这一减少幅度约为9%。无论是连续性还是质量方面，混合制酬付酬模式似乎都带来了提升。

abstract.text: We present the first study that empirically examines the effects of neighbourhood ethnic diversity on mental health. Using 16 waves of longitudinal data from the Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia survey, we find that ethnic diversity is negatively associated with mental health. Our preferred estimates, using lagged ethnic diversity at the state level to instrument for neighbourhood ethnic diversity, suggest that a standard deviation increase in ethnic diversity is associated with a decline of 0.092-0.129 standard deviations in mental health. This result is robust to alternative estimation approaches to addressing endogeneity of ethnic diversity and alternative ways of measuring ethnic diversity and irrespective of whether mental health is measured with the Mental Health Inventory scale or the Kessler Psychological Distress Scale (K10). We further find that ethnic diversity influences mental health through the level of neighbourhood trust. Our findings point to the need to develop policies that promote social inclusion in multicultural societies and build trust between heterogeneous ethnic groups as a vehicle to improve mental health.

10.1002/hec.3928.abstractZh: 我们首次开展研究，实证考察了社区种族多样性对心理健康的影响。通过澳大利亚家庭、收入和劳动动态调查中的16个纵向数据波，我们发现种族多样性与心理健康呈负相关。我们采用滞后状态下的州级种族多样性作为社区种族多样性的工具变量，发现种族多样性的标准差每增加一个标准差，心理健康的标准差就会下降0.092至0.129个标准差。这一结果在采用不同估计方法处理种族多样性的内生性问题以及采用不同测量方法的情况下仍然成立，且无论心理健康是通过心理健康量表还是Kessler心理困扰量表来测量。我们还发现，种族多样性通过社区信任水平影响心理健康。我们的研究结果表明，需要制定政策来促进多元文化社会中的社会包容，并加强不同种族群体之间的信任，以此作为改善心理健康的途径。

abstract.text: Efficient health-care provision for nursing home residents is a concern in many OECD (Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development) countries. This paper analyzes whether nursing homes respond to financial incentives when deciding whether to hospitalize their residents. In Germany, reimbursements for nursing homes are reduced after a defined number of days when a resident stays in a hospital instead of a nursing home. As a result of a federal law introduced in 2008, some German states had to change the point at which reimbursements to nursing homes are reduced so that reductions are made from Day 4 instead of Day 1 of a resident's absence. This exogenously raised an incentive for the nursing homes affected to hospitalize residents especially for an expected short-term stay. This analysis exploits the introduction of the law in a difference-in-difference approach, using market-wide German-DRG files covering all hospital patients discharged from hospitals to nursing homes from 2007 to 2011. The results suggest an increase of approximately 11% in short-term hospital stays as a consequence of the longer reimbursement period introduced by the law.

10.1002/hec.3930.abstractZh: 为养老院居民提供高效的医疗保健服务是许多经合组织国家关注的问题。本文分析了养老院在决定是否将居民转入医院时是否会对经济激励作出反应。在德国，当居民在养老院停留一定天数后转入医院，养老院获得的报销金额会有所减少。由于2008年颁布的一项联邦法律，一些德国州不得不调整报销比例的计算方式，使得报销金额从居民缺勤的第一天开始减少，而不是从第四天开始。这一外部因素促使养老院更倾向于为预期短期的住院需求提供医疗服务。本研究采用差异分解法对法律实施后的影响进行了分析，使用了涵盖2007年至2011年间所有从医院出院并转至养老院的患者的德国DRG文件。研究结果表明，由于法律引入了更长的报销期限，短期住院时间增加了约11%。

abstract.text: This paper examines how hospital adoption of electronic medical records (EMRs) impacts medical procedure choice in the context of cesarean section deliveries. It provides a unique contribution by tying the literature on EMR diffusion to the literature on the utilization of expensive medical technology and provider practice style. Exploiting within-hospital variation in three types of EMR adoption, we find that computerized physician order entry, an advanced EMR system that typically incorporates decision support, reduces C-section rates for low-risk mothers by 2.5%. Obstetric-specific EMR systems and physician documentation have no statistically significant effect on C-section rates. In addition, we find that the computerized practitioner order entry effect occurs predominantly in hospitals that were already performing fewer C-sections and does not change the behavior of already high-intensity providers.

10.1002/hec.3932.abstractZh: 本文探讨了医院采用电子病历（EMR）对剖宫产分娩中医疗程序选择的影响。通过将关于电子病历普及的文献与关于昂贵医疗技术使用及医疗服务提供者实践模式的文献相结合，本文做出了独特的贡献。通过对医院内三种电子病历采用情况的差异分析，我们发现，先进的电子病历系统通常包含决策支持功能，能够降低低风险母亲的分娩次数2.5%。而针对产科的特定电子病历系统和医生文档记录对剖宫产率没有统计学上的显著影响。此外，我们还发现，计算机化的医师订单录入系统对剖宫产率的降低效果主要出现在那些已经减少剖宫产手术的医院中，并且不会改变那些 already 高强度的医疗服务提供者的行为。

abstract.text: The depleting effect of repeated decision making is often referred to as decision fatigue. Understanding how decision fatigue affects medical decision making is important for achieving both efficiency and fairness in health care. In this study, we investigate the potential role of decision fatigue in orthopedic surgeons' decisions to operate, exploiting a natural experiment whereby patient allocation to time slots is plausibly randomized at the level of the patient. Our results show that patients who met a surgeon toward the end of his or her work shift were 33 percentage points less likely to be scheduled for an operation compared with those who were seen first. In a logistic regression with doctor‐fixed effects and standard errors clustered at the level of the doctor, the odds of operation were estimated to decrease by 10.5% (odds ratio = 0.895, p < .001; 95% CI [0.842, 0.951]) for each additional patient appointment in the doctors' work shift. This pattern in surgeons' decision making is consistent with decision fatigue. Because long shifts are common in medicine, the effect of decision fatigue could be substantial and may have important implications for patient outcomes.

10.1002/hec.3933.abstractZh: 反复决策所带来的疲劳效应通常被称为决策疲劳。了解决策疲劳如何影响医疗决策对于实现医疗服务的效率和公平性至关重要。本研究探讨了决策疲劳在骨科医生手术决策中的潜在作用，通过一项自然实验，以患者为单位对患者的手术时间进行随机分配。研究结果显示，那些在医生工作班次末期才被安排手术的患者，与那些优先被安排手术的患者相比，接受手术的可能性降低了33个百分点。在采用医生固定效应和医生级别的标准误差进行逻辑回归分析后，发现医生工作班次中每增加一名患者的手术预约，接受手术的概率就会下降10.5%（比值比=0.895，p<0.001；95%置信区间[0.842, 0.951]）。这种外科医生决策模式与决策疲劳的现象一致。由于长时间的工作班次在医学领域很常见，决策疲劳的影响可能相当显著，并对患者的治疗效果产生重要影响。

abstract.text: In 2008, the Rural Health Project (Health XI) was initiated in 40 Chinese counties to pilot interventions aimed at improving local health systems. Performance targets were pre-specified (results-based), and project counties were allowed to tailor their interventions (bottom-up) in recognition of the substantial regional variations. Using household data from the China National Health Services Survey in a difference-in-differences strategy combined with matching, we find that project counties have improved outcomes (both incentivized and not-directly-incentivized) in all three domains examined-medical care, public health services, and self-rated health-by 2013. In particular, the decrease in outpatient intravenous drip use and financial strain and the increase in all four components of public health services provision are robust to a variety of tests and alternative matching strategies. Results for not-directly-incentivized indicators suggest that results-based payment did not lead to multitasking problems but rather to positive spillovers. On the other hand, little improvement in inpatient-related indicators suggests that the Health XI interventions did not successfully redress the perverse incentives driving the bulk of providers' income. In general, however, our results indicate that interventions adopted in the results-based bottom-up approach generated substantial benefits given the investment.

10.1002/hec.3935.abstractZh: 2008年，中国40个县级地区启动了“农村健康项目”（Health XI），旨在试点改善当地卫生系统的措施。项目设定了明确的绩效目标，并允许各县级地区根据地区差异灵活调整措施。通过中国国家卫生服务调查中的家庭数据，采用差异-差异策略结合匹配方法的研究发现，到2013年，所有三个领域——医疗服务、公共卫生服务以及自我健康评估——的项目县都取得了改善。特别是，门诊静脉输液使用的减少、经济压力的降低，以及公共卫生服务提供的四个方面的提升，这些结果在多种测试和替代匹配策略下依然显著。对于没有直接激励措施的指标而言，基于绩效的支付方式并未导致多任务处理问题，反而带来了积极的溢出效应。然而，与住院相关的指标改善幅度较小，这表明“农村健康项目”的措施未能有效纠正导致医疗服务提供者收入偏斜的激励机制。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，采用基于绩效的自下而上的方法所实施的干预措施，在投入的情况下确实带来了显著的好处。

abstract.text: This study explores the forces that drive the formation of physician patient sharing networks. In particular, I examine the degree to which hospital affiliation drives physicians' sharing of Medicare patients. Using a revealed preference framework where observed network links are taken to be pairwise stable, I estimate the physicians' pair-specific values using a tetrad maximum score estimator that is robust to the presence of unobserved physician specific characteristics. I also control for a number of potentially confounding patient sharing channels, such as (a) common physician group or hospital system affiliation, (b) physician homophily, (c) knowledge complementarity, (d) patient side considerations related to both geographic proximity and insurance network participation, and (e) spillover from other collaborations. Focusing on the Chicago hospital referral region, I find that shared hospital affiliation accounts for 36.5% of the average pair-specific utility from a link. Implications for reducing care fragmentation are discussed.

10.1002/hec.3936.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了推动医生与患者共享网络形成的因素。具体而言，我考察了医院隶属关系在何种程度上驱动医生共享Medicare患者。采用显示偏好框架，将观察到的网络链接视为成对稳定的，我使用一种对未观察到的医生特定特征具有鲁棒性的四元组最大得分估计方法，来估算医生对特定链接的偏好值。我还控制了多种可能干扰共享行为的因素，例如：(a) 共同的医生团体或医院系统隶属关系；(b) 医生的同质性；(c) 知识互补性；(d) 与患者相关的地理接近性和保险网络参与因素；(e) 其他合作关系的溢出效应。以芝加哥医院转诊区域为例，我发现共享医院隶属关系占链接中平均特定链接效用的36.5%。文中还讨论了减少医疗碎片化的意义。

abstract.text: The spread of fake news and misinformation on social media is blamed as a primary cause of vaccine hesitancy, which is one of the major threats to global health, according to the World Health Organization. This paper studies the effect of the diffusion of misinformation on immunization rates in Italy by exploiting a quasi-experiment that occurred in 2012, when the Court of Rimini officially recognized a causal link between the measles-mumps-rubella vaccine and autism and awarded injury compensation. To this end, we exploit the virality of misinformation following the 2012 Italian court's ruling, along with the intensity of exposure to nontraditional media driven by regional infrastructural differences in Internet broadband coverage. Using a Difference-in-Differences regression on regional panel data, we show that the spread of this news resulted in a decrease in child immunization rates for all types of vaccines.

10.1002/hec.3937.abstractZh: 根据世界卫生组织的说法，社交媒体上虚假新闻和错误信息的传播被认为是导致疫苗犹豫的主要原因之一，而疫苗犹豫是全球健康面临的主要威胁之一。本文通过利用2012年发生的准实验数据来研究错误信息传播对意大利免疫率的影响。当时里米尼法院正式认定麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹疫苗与自闭症之间存在因果关系，并因此判决进行损害赔偿。为此，我们分析了2012年意大利法院裁决后错误信息传播的情况，以及由于地区互联网宽带覆盖差异导致的非传统媒体信息的传播强度。通过采用差异回归分析方法对地区面板数据进行分析，我们发现这些错误信息传播导致所有类型疫苗的儿童免疫率下降。

abstract.text: Although the economic consequences of epidemic outbreaks to affected areas are often well documented, little is known about how these might carry over into the economies of unaffected regions. In the absence of direct pathogen transmission, global trade is one mechanism through which geographically distant epidemics could reverberate to unaffected countries. This study explores the link between global public health events and U.S. economic outcomes by evaluating the role of the 2014 West Africa Ebola outbreak in U.S. exports and exports-supported U.S. jobs, 2005-2016. Estimates were obtained using difference-in-differences models where sub-Saharan Africa countries were assigned to treatment and comparison groups based on their Ebola transmission status, with controls for observed and unobserved time-variant factors that may independently influence trends in trade. Multiple model specification checks were performed to ensure analytic robustness. The year of peak transmission, 2014, was estimated to result in $1.08 billion relative reduction in U.S. merchandise exports to Ebola-affected countries, whereas estimated losses in exports-supported U.S. jobs exceeded 1,200 in 2014 and 11,000 in 2015. These findings suggest that remote disruptions in health security might play a role in U.S. economic indicators, demonstrating the interconnectedness between global health and aspects of the global economy and informing the relevance of health security efforts.

10.1002/hec.3938.abstractZh: 尽管疫情对受影响地区的经济影响通常已有充分记录，但关于这些影响如何波及到未受影响地区的经济情况，目前了解甚少。在没有直接病原体传播的情况下，全球贸易是地理上相距甚远但疫情可能波及到未受影响国家的机制之一。本研究通过评估2014年西非埃博拉疫情对美国出口及受出口带动的美国就业的影响，探讨了全球公共卫生事件与美国经济结果之间的联系。研究采用差异-差异模型进行估计，根据撒哈拉以南非洲国家的埃博拉传播状况将其分为治疗组和对照组，并控制了可能影响贸易趋势的随时间变化的因素。为确保分析结果的稳健性，进行了多项模型检验。研究估计，2014年埃博拉疫情高峰期间，美国对受疫情影响国家的商品出口减少了10.8亿美元；而受疫情影响的美国就业岗位在2014年减少了1200个，在2015年则减少了11000个。这些发现表明，远程发生的健康安全问题可能对美国经济指标产生影响，从而揭示了全球健康与全球经济之间的相互关联性，并为健康安全工作的有效性提供了依据。

abstract.text: Although uncontrolled diabetes (UD) or poor glycaemic control is a widespread condition with potentially life-threatening consequences, there is sparse evidence of its effects on health care utilisation. We jointly model the propensities to consume health care and UD by employing an innovative bivariate latent Markov model that allows for dynamic unobserved heterogeneity, movements between latent states and the endogeneity of UD. We estimate the effects of UD on primary and secondary health care consumption using a panel dataset of rich administrative records from Spain and measure UD using a biomarker. We find that, conditional on time-varying unobservables, UD does not have a statistically significant direct effect on health care use. Furthermore, individuals appear to move across latent classes and increase their propensities to poor glycaemic control and health care use over time. Our results suggest that by ignoring time-varying unobserved heterogeneity and the endogeneity of UD, the effects of UD on health care utilisation might be overestimated and this could lead to biased findings. Our approach reveals heterogeneity in behaviour beyond standard groupings of frequent versus infrequent users of health care services. We argue that this dynamic latent Markov approach could be used more widely to model the determinants of health care use.

10.1002/hec.3939.abstractZh: 尽管未控制的糖尿病或不良的血糖控制是一种普遍存在的状况，且可能带来致命后果，但关于其对医疗保健利用影响的证据却非常有限。我们采用一种创新的双变量潜在马尔可夫模型来模拟消费医疗保健的倾向以及糖尿病的影响，该模型能够考虑动态的非观测异质性、潜在状态之间的转换以及糖尿病的内生性。我们利用西班牙丰富的行政记录数据，估计糖尿病对初级和次级医疗保健消费的影响，并通过生物标志物来测量糖尿病的存在。研究发现，在考虑时间变化的非观测变量的情况下，糖尿病对医疗保健使用的直接影响并不显著。此外，个体似乎会在潜在类别之间移动，并随着时间的推移增加不良血糖控制及医疗保健使用的倾向。我们的结果表明，如果忽略时间变化的非观测异质性和糖尿病的内生性，那么对糖尿病对医疗保健利用影响的评估可能会过高，从而导致研究结果出现偏差。我们的方法揭示了与标准划分的频繁使用与不频繁使用医疗保健服务的人群相比，行为上的异质性。我们认为，这种动态潜在马尔可夫方法可以更广泛地用于模拟医疗保健使用的决定因素。

abstract.text: Practice variation in publicly financed long-term care (LTC) may be inefficient and inequitable, similarly to practice variation in the health care sector. Although most OECD countries spend an increasing share of their gross domestic product on LTC, it has received comparatively little attention to date compared with the health care sector. This paper contributes to the literature by assessing and comparing regional practice variation in both access to and use of institutional LTC and investigating its relation with income and out-of-pocket payment. For this, we have access to unique individual-level data covering the entire Dutch population. Even though we found practice variation in the use of LTC once access was granted, the variation between regions was still relatively small compared with international standards. In addition, we showed how a co-payment measure could be used to reduce practice variation across care office regions and income classes making the LTC system not only more efficient but also more equitable.

10.1002/hec.3940.abstractZh: 公共资助的长期护理服务中的实践差异可能效率低下且不公平，这与医疗保健领域的实践差异类似。尽管大多数经合组织国家将越来越多的国内生产总值用于长期护理服务，但与医疗保健领域相比，这一领域至今受到的关注相对较少。本文通过评估并比较不同地区在获得和使用机构长期护理服务方面的实践差异，以及其与收入和自付费用之间的关系，为相关文献做出了贡献。为此，我们获得了涵盖整个荷兰人口的独特个体级数据。尽管在获得长期护理服务后，我们发现使用服务的实践存在差异，但各地区的差异仍相对较小，符合国际标准。此外，我们还展示了如何通过共同支付措施来减少不同护理机构区域和收入阶层之间的实践差异，从而使长期护理系统不仅更加高效，而且更加公平。

abstract.text: Surgical measures to combat obesity are very effective in terms of weight loss, recovery from diabetes, and improvement in cardiovascular risk factors. However, previous studies found both positive and negative results regarding the effect of bariatric surgery on health care utilization. Using claims data from the largest health insurance provider in Germany, we estimated the causal effect of bariatric surgery on health care costs in a time period ranging from 2 years before to 3 years after bariatric intervention. Owing to the absence of a control group, we employed a Bayesian structural forecasting model to construct a synthetic control. We observed a decrease in medication and physician expenditures after bariatric surgery, whereas hospital expenditures increased in the post-intervention period. Overall, we found a slight increase in total costs after bariatric surgery, but our estimates include a high degree of uncertainty.

10.1002/hec.3941.abstractZh: 针对肥胖的手术治疗在减轻体重、改善糖尿病状况以及降低心血管风险因素方面非常有效。然而，先前的研究发现，减肥手术对医疗服务的利用既有积极的影响，也有消极的影响。我们利用德国最大健康保险公司的索赔数据，估算了减肥手术在手术前后2年至3年时间内对医疗成本的影响。由于缺乏对照组，我们采用了贝叶斯结构预测模型来构建综合控制组。我们发现，减肥手术后药物和医生费用有所下降，而医院费用在手术后有所增加。总体而言，我们发现减肥手术后的总成本略有上升，但我们的估计结果存在较高的不确定性。

abstract.text: Choice-based stated preference methods, such as time trade-offs (TTOs), are used to establish health state utilities informing healthcare allocation. However, little is known about the presence of (position-dependent and precedent-dependent) sequence effects in the valuation of health states, despite techniques requiring respondents to evaluate several health states in a sequence. This paper is the first to explicitly test for the presence of sequence effects in the health domain using a new explanation based on contrast effects and preference imprecision; the implication being that randomisation cannot avoid sequence effects. Six TTO questions were designed using the EQ-5D-3L descriptive system. These were grouped into two blocks of three and within each block four sequences were used. In an online survey, 1,197 Spanish respondents answered one grouping of three TTO questions. Results indicate that sequence effects can affect preferences as utilities of health states are biased downwards if preceded by a better health state and biased upwards if preceded by a worse health state. This study informs our understanding of how context effects interact with preference elicitation methods, which is essential for interpreting survey results used to inform policy.

10.1002/hec.3942.abstractZh: 基于选择的陈述偏好方法，如时间权衡法，被用于确定健康状态的效用值，从而指导医疗资源的分配。然而，尽管有技术要求受访者依次评估多个健康状态，但关于健康状态评估中是否存在（与位置相关和先例相关的）序列效应，目前知之甚少。本文首次使用基于对比效应和偏好不精确性的新解释，明确测试了健康领域序列效应的存在；这意味着随机化无法避免序列效应。通过EQ-5D-3L描述系统设计了六个时间权衡问题。这些问题被分为两组，每组三个问题，每组中使用四个序列。在一项在线调查中，1,197名西班牙受访者回答了一个包含三个时间权衡问题的分组。结果表明，序列效应会影响偏好，如果前一个健康状态较好，健康状态的效用值会向下偏置；如果前一个健康状态较差，效用值则会向上偏置。这项研究有助于我们理解上下文效应如何与偏好引导方法相互作用，这对于解释用于政策制定的调查结果至关重要。

abstract.text: Since 2013, The Order of St John Award for Organ Donation has been offered to the families of deceased solid organ donors in the United Kingdom to honor the donors and inspire others to donate. We evaluate the effects of this award using a difference-in-differences approach that builds on the fact that solid organ donors are eligible for the award, whereas cornea-only donors are not. We find that the introduction of the award led to an increase in the number of deceased solid organ donors.

10.1002/hec.3943.abstractZh: 自2013年以来，圣约翰骑士团器官捐赠奖一直颁发给英国已故实体器官捐赠者的家属，以表彰这些捐赠者并激励其他人进行器官捐赠。我们采用差异-差异方法评估该奖项的效果，该方法基于实体器官捐赠者有资格获得该奖项，而仅角膜捐赠者则没有这一资格的事实。研究发现，该奖项的设立导致已故实体器官捐赠者的数量有所增加。

abstract.text: The United States is currently in the midst of the worst drug epidemic in its history, with nearly 64,000 overdose deaths in 2016. In response, pharmaceutical companies have begun introducing abuse-deterrent painkillers, pills with properties that make the drug more difficult to misuse. The first such painkiller, a reformulated version of OxyContin, was released in 2010. Previous research has found no net effect on opioid mortality, with users substituting from OxyContin toward heroin. This paper explores health effects of the reformulation beyond mortality. In particular, I show that heroin is substantially more likely to be injected than OxyContin, increasing exposure to blood-borne diseases. Exploiting variation across states in OxyContin misuse prior to the reformulation, I find relative increases in the spread of hepatitis B and C in states most likely to be affected by the reformulation. In aggregate, the estimates suggest that absent the reformulation, we would have observed approximately 76% fewer cases of hepatitis C and 53% fewer cases of hepatitis B from 2011 to 2015. I find some suggestive evidence that the reformulation also lead to increases in HIV and hepatitis A, although these findings are less robust. These findings have important implications for future policies addressing the opioid crisis.

10.1002/hec.3944.abstractZh: 美国目前正面临历史上最严重的药物流行病，2016年有近64,000人因药物过量死亡。为应对这一危机，制药公司开始推出具有抑制滥用作用的止痛药，这些药物的特性使得药物更难被滥用。第一种此类止痛药是OxyContin的改良版本，于2010年上市。先前的研究发现，这种改良药对阿片类药物相关死亡率没有显著影响，使用者通常会从OxyContin转向海洛因。本文探讨了这种改良药在健康方面的影响，而不仅仅是死亡率。我指出，与OxyContin相比，海洛因更可能被注射使用，从而增加了感染血液传播疾病的风险。通过分析改良药推出前各州OxyContin滥用的差异，我发现，在最有可能受到改良药影响的州，乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎的患病率相对增加。总体而言，这些估计表明，如果没有这种改良药，2011年至2015年间，丙型肝炎的病例数将减少约76%，乙型肝炎的病例数将减少约53%。我还发现了一些提示性的证据，表明改良药也可能导致HIV和甲型肝炎的病例增加，不过这些发现并不十分可靠。这些发现对未来应对阿片类药物危机的政策具有重要意义。

abstract.text: The United States is in the midst of an opioid epidemic, and drug overdose deaths are becoming a leading cause of death. Meanwhile, in 2010, the United States passed comprehensive health care reform providing access to care for millions of individuals who previously lacked care. Part of the new access came from expanding Medicaid, the insurance program for low-income individuals. Expanding Medicaid was optional for states. Those individuals living in expansion states gained prescription drug coverage and hence more access to opioid pain-relievers that are known to be addictive. However, they also gained access to medication-assisted treatment for addiction. This paper uses a difference-in-differences approach and state-level data from 2010 to 2017 to compare opioid death rates in expansion and non-expansion states to determine if Medicaid expansion was a potential cause of rising opioid deaths. We find no evidence that Medicaid expansion is related to opioid deaths.

10.1002/hec.3945.abstractZh: 美国正面临阿片类药物泛滥的危机，药物过量死亡已成为主要的死亡原因之一。与此同时，在2010年，美国通过了全面的医疗保健改革，为数百万此前缺乏医疗服务的民众提供了医疗服务。新政策的一部分是通过扩大医疗补助计划来为低收入人群提供保险服务。虽然扩大医疗补助计划是各州可选的，但生活在扩大计划实施地区的民众获得了处方药覆盖，从而能够更容易获得已知具有成瘾性的阿片类止痛药。此外，他们还能获得药物辅助治疗，以帮助戒除成瘾。本文采用差异-差异方法，并利用2010至2017年的州级数据，比较了实施扩大计划与未实施扩大计划的州的阿片类药物死亡率，以探讨医疗补助计划的扩大是否可能是阿片类药物死亡率上升的原因。研究发现，医疗补助计划的扩大与阿片类药物死亡率之间没有关联。

abstract.text: New technologies may displace existing, higher-value care under a fixed budget. Countries aim to curtail adoption of low-value technologies, for example, by installing cost-effectiveness thresholds. Our objective is to estimate the opportunity cost of hospital care to identify a threshold value for the Netherlands. To this aim, we combine claims data, mortality data and quality of life questionnaires from 2012 to 2014 for 11,000 patient groups to obtain quality-adjusted life-year (QALY) outcomes and spending. Using a fixed effects translog model, we estimate that a 1% increase in hospital spending on average increases QALY outcomes by 0.2%. This implies a threshold of €73,600 per QALY, with 95% confidence intervals ranging from €53,000 to €94,000 per QALY. The results stipulate that new technologies with incremental cost effectiveness ratios exceeding the Dutch upper reference value of €80,000 may indeed displace more valuable care.

10.1002/hec.3946.abstractZh: 新技术可能会在固定预算下取代现有的、价值更高的护理服务。各国试图通过设定成本效益阈值来限制低价值技术的采用。我们的目标是估算医院护理的机会成本，以确定荷兰的阈值。为此，我们结合了2012至2014年的索赔数据、死亡数据以及生活质量问卷，针对11,000个患者群体，以获取质量调整生命年（QALY）结果和支出信息。利用固定效应跨对数模型，我们估计医院支出每增加1%，QALY结果将增加0.2%。这意味着每QALY的阈值为73,600欧元，95%置信区间在53,000至94,000欧元之间。研究结果表明，那些成本效益比率超过荷兰80,000欧元的新型技术确实可能取代更有价值的护理服务。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effect of the Affordable Care Act preexisting conditions provision on marriage. The policy was implemented to prevent insurers from denying insurance coverage to individuals with preexisting health conditions. We test whether the implementation of the provision led to decreases in marriage among affected adults. We add to earlier work on how marital behavior is influenced by spousal health insurance and examine for the presence of "marriage lock," a situation in which individuals remain married primarily for insurance. Using longitudinal data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics from 2009 to 2017 and estimating difference-in-differences models, we find that male household heads with preexisting conditions are 7.12 percentage points (8.9 percent) less likely to be married after the policy. Using information on insurance status prior to the policy change, we find significant reductions in marriage among individuals with preexisting conditions who were previously insured by spousal health insurance plans. The findings suggest that the inability to attain individual coverage and reliance on spousal insurance provided incentives to remain married before 2014.

10.1002/hec.3947.abstractZh: 本文研究了《平价医疗法案》中关于既往健康状况条款对婚姻的影响。该政策的实施旨在防止保险公司拒绝为有既往健康状况的个体提供保险。我们测试了该条款的实施是否导致受影响的成年人中结婚率下降。我们进一步研究了配偶健康保险如何影响婚姻行为，并探讨了“婚姻锁”现象的存在，即个体主要为了保险而维持婚姻关系。通过2009至2017年的收入动态面板数据以及差异差异模型估计，我们发现有既往健康状况的男性户主在政策实施后结婚的可能性降低了7.12个百分点（即8.9%）。利用政策变更前的信息，我们发现之前由配偶健康保险计划提供保险的有既往健康状况的个体中，结婚率显著下降。研究结果表明，无法获得个人保险以及依赖配偶保险，在2014年之前为个体维持婚姻关系提供了激励。

abstract.text: This study examines the relationship between state-level earned income tax credit (EITC) laws in the United States on suicides. Following findings in previous work showing that the EITC is associated with lower depression rates and reduced number of risky biomarkers, I estimated the effects of state EITC generosity on suicide rates. Using data for the years 1996 to 2016, a period with 74 state-level EITC policy changes, I find that introducing a high state EITC rate reduces suicide rates for adults aged 25 or above by 3.91%. The results are consistent across four different measures of EITC generosity.

10.1002/hec.3948.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了美国各州所得税抵免政策与自杀率之间的关系。先前的研究表明，所得税抵免与较低的抑郁率和较少的风险生物标志物相关。因此，我估算了各州所得税抵免政策宽松程度对自杀率的影响。利用1996年至2016年的数据，这一期间共有74个州级所得税抵免政策发生变化，我发现，提高各州的所得税抵免率可使25岁及以上成年人的自杀率降低3.91%。这一结果在四种不同的所得税抵免政策宽松程度衡量方式下都是一致的。

abstract.text: The U.S. Veterans Administration (VA) is a large publicly financed health system that has long struggled with provider shortages. Shortages may arise at the VA because it offers different compensation than private sector employment options or because of differences in the way that labor is supplied to public versus private employers. In the mid-2000s, the VA adopted a more generous and flexible pay schedule for its dentists. We exploit this salary schedule change to study the impact of a positive wage shock on dental labor supplied to the VA, within a difference-in-differences framework. We find limited effects on VA separation and new hire rates overall-though early career dentists appear more sensitive to the wage change. More generous pay has its clearest effects on employment type for VA dentists, reducing the likelihood of being part-time by roughly 10%.

10.1002/hec.3949.abstractZh: 美国退伍军人管理局（VA）是一个由公共资金资助的大型医疗系统，长期以来一直面临医生短缺的问题。VA出现短缺的原因可能是其薪酬待遇与私营部门相比有所不同，也可能是因为公共与私营雇主在劳动力供应方式上的差异。在2000年代中期，VA为牙医制定了更为慷慨且灵活的薪酬制度。我们利用这一薪酬制度的变化，通过差异-差异框架来研究工资上涨对VA牙医供应情况的影响。研究发现，这一变化对VA的离职率和新招聘率的影响有限，不过早期职业的牙医似乎对工资变化更为敏感。更为慷慨的薪酬对VA牙医的就业类型产生了最明显的影响，使牙医成为兼职员工的可能性降低了约10%。

abstract.text: The EORTC QLU-C10D is a new multi-attribute utility instrument derived from the widely used cancer-specific quality of life questionnaire, EORTC QLQ-C30. It contains 10 dimensions (physical functioning, role functioning, social functioning, emotional functioning, pain, fatigue, sleep, appetite, nausea, bowel problems), each with four levels. The aim of this study was to provide U.K. general population utility weights for the QLU-C10D. A U.K. online panel was quota-sampled to align the sample to the general population proportions of sex and age (≥18 years). The online valuation survey included a discrete choice experiment (DCE). Each participant was asked to complete 16 choice-pairs, each comprising two QLU-C10D health states plus duration. DCE data were analysed using conditional logistic regression to generate utility weights. Data from 2,187 respondents who completed at least one choice set were included in the DCE analysis. The final U.K. QLU-C10D utility weights comprised decrements for each level of each health dimension. For nine of the 10 dimensions (all except appetite), the expected monotonic pattern was observed across levels: Utility decreased as severity increased. For the final model, consistent monotonicity was achieved by merging inconsistent adjacent levels for appetite. The largest utility decrements were associated with physical functioning and pain. The worst possible health state (the worst level of each dimension) is -0.083, which is considered slightly worse than being dead. The U.K.-specific utility weights will enable cost-utility analysis (CUA) for the economic evaluation of new oncology therapies and technologies in the United Kingdom, where CUA is commonly used to inform resource allocation.

10.1002/hec.3950.abstractZh: EORTC QLU-C10D是一种新的多属性效用工具，源自广泛使用的癌症特异性生活质量问卷EORTC QLQ-C30。该问卷包含10个维度（身体功能、角色功能、社会功能、情绪功能、疼痛、疲劳、睡眠、食欲、恶心、肠道问题），每个维度都有四个等级。本研究的目的是为英国普通人群提供QLU-C10D的效用权重。英国在线样本采用配额抽样方法，以确保样本与普通人群的性别和年龄比例相匹配（≥18岁）。在线评估调查包括离散选择实验（DCE）。每位参与者需要完成16对选择项，每对选择项包括两个QLU-C10D健康状态及持续时间。DCE数据通过条件逻辑回归进行分析，以生成效用权重。在DCE分析中，包含了2,187名至少完成了一个选择集的受访者的数据。最终的英国QLU-C10D效用权重包括每个健康维度每个等级对应的减分。在10个维度中，有9个维度（除食欲外）都表现出随等级上升而效用下降的单调趋势：效用随着严重程度的增加而减少。对于食欲这一维度，通过合并相邻但不一致的等级，最终模型实现了一致的单调性。最大的效用减分与身体功能和疼痛相关。最糟糕的健康状态（每个维度的最低等级）为-0.083，这被认为略低于死亡状态。英国特定的效用权重将使得在英国对新肿瘤疗法和技术进行成本效用分析（CUA）成为可能，而CUA通常用于指导资源分配。

abstract.text: We examine family physicians' responses to financial incentives for medical services in Ontario, Canada. We use administrative data covering 2003-2008, a period during which family physicians could choose between the traditional fee for service (FFS) and blended FFS known as the Family Health Group (FHG) model. Under FHG, FFS physicians are incentivized to provide comprehensive care and after-hours services. A two-stage estimation strategy teases out the impact of switching from FFS to FHG on service production. We account for the selection into FHG using a propensity score matching model, and then we use panel-data regression models to account for observed and unobserved heterogeneity. Our results reveal that switching from FFS to FHG increases comprehensive care, after-hours, and nonincentivized services by 3%, 15%, and 4% per annum. We also find that blended FFS physicians provide more services by working additional total days as well as the number of days during holidays and weekends. Our results are robust to a variety of specifications and alternative matching methods. We conclude that switching from FFS to blended FFS improves patients' access to after-hours care, but the incentive to nudge service production at the intensive margin is somewhat limited.

10.1002/hec.3951.abstractZh: 我们研究了加拿大安大略省的家庭医生对医疗服务财务激励的反应。我们使用2003-2008年的行政数据，在这段时间里，家庭医生可以在传统按服务收费模式与被称为家庭健康小组的混合按服务收费模式之间选择。在混合按服务收费模式下，医生被激励提供全面的护理和夜间服务。我们采用两阶段估计策略，以分析从按服务收费模式转向混合按服务收费模式对服务生产的影响。我们通过倾向得分匹配模型来考虑选择加入混合按服务收费模式的因素，然后使用面板数据回归模型来考虑观察到的和未观察到的异质性。我们的结果显示，从按服务收费模式转向混合按服务收费模式，每年分别增加了3%、15%和4%的全面护理、夜间服务以及非激励性服务。我们还发现，混合按服务收费模式的医生通过增加总工作天数以及在节假日和周末工作的天数来提供更多服务。我们的结果在多种参数设定和不同的匹配方法下仍然保持稳定。我们得出结论，从按服务收费模式转向混合按服务收费模式确实改善了患者获得夜间护理的机会，但在强化服务生产方面的激励作用相对有限。

abstract.text: Chronic diseases strongly affect individuals' health status. In aggregate terms, this impact is reflected by the stock of health, which measures the amount of health of a population in a given period of time. The objectives of this study were to measure the relative burden of chronic illnesses by assessing health-related quality of life using the EQ-5D-5L instrument, to rank diseases according to their associations with the stock of health, and to calculate the stock of health of the Spanish population and the amount of health loss attributable to each chronic disease from a social perspective. Data were gathered from the Spanish Health Survey (ENSE 2011-2012, N = 20,587). A population weighted least squares model was used. Chronic diseases represent 19.19% of the stock of health losses in Spain compared with a country free from those diseases. In Spain, the stock of health in 2011 was 31.86 million units on the visual analog scale. The diseases with the strongest impact in terms of loss of stock of health at the individual level were mental illness and embolism, stroke, or cerebral hemorrhage. Collectively, the diseases with the largest impact included osteoarthritis, arthritis, or rheumatism; chronic back pain; and high blood pressure.

10.1002/hec.3952.abstractZh: 慢性疾病对个人的健康状况有显著影响。从总体上看，这种影响体现在健康存量上，健康存量衡量的是某一时期内人群的健康状况。本研究的目标是通过使用EQ-5D-5L工具评估健康相关生活质量，来衡量慢性疾病的相对负担；根据疾病与健康存量的关联程度对疾病进行排名；并从社会角度计算西班牙人口的健康存量以及每种慢性疾病导致的健康损失。数据来源于西班牙健康调查（ENSE 2011-2012，样本量20,587人）。研究采用了加权最小二乘法模型。与没有这些疾病的国家相比，西班牙的慢性疾病占健康损失存量的19.19%。2011年，西班牙的健康存量为31.86百万视觉模拟单位。在个体层面，对健康存量损失影响最大的疾病包括精神疾病以及栓塞、中风或脑出血。总体而言，影响最大的疾病包括骨关节炎、关节炎或风湿病；慢性背痛；以及高血压。

abstract.text: In year 1991, regional governments in Spain started a period of implementation of a law that rose the minimum legal drinking age from 16 to 18 years old. To evaluate the effects of this change on the consumption of legal drugs and its related morbidity outcomes, we construct a regional panel dataset on alcohol consumption and hospital entry registers and compare variation in several measures of prevalence between the treatment group (16-18 years old) and the control group (20-22 years old). Our findings show important differences by gender. Our main result regarding overall drinking prevalence shows a reduction of -21.37% for the subsample that includes males and females altogether. This effect on drinking is mainly driven by a reduction of -44.43% in mixed drinks and/or liquors drinking prevalence corresponding to the subsample of males. No causal effects regarding overall smoking prevalence and hospitalizations due to alcohol overdose or motor vehicle traffic accidents were found. To our knowledge, this is the first paper providing evidence on gender-based differences to policies aimed at reducing alcohol consumption. Our results have important policy implications for countries currently considering changes in the minimum legal drinking age.

10.1002/hec.3955.abstractZh: 在1991年，西班牙的地方政府开始实施一项法律，将法定饮酒年龄从16岁提高到18岁。为了评估这一变化对合法药物消费及其相关发病率的影响，我们构建了一个关于酒精消费和住院登记数据的区域面板数据集，并比较了治疗组（16-18岁）和对照组（20-22岁）在多个流行率指标上的差异。我们的研究发现，性别因素对结果产生了重要影响。总体而言，包括男性和女性在内的样本组中，饮酒率下降了21.37%。这一影响主要源于男性样本中混合饮料和/或烈酒饮用率的下降，幅度达到了44.43%。然而，关于整体吸烟率以及因酒精过量或机动车交通事故导致的住院情况，并未发现明显的因果效应。据我们所知，这是第一篇提供基于性别差异的关于减少酒精消费政策的证据的研究。我们的研究结果对于目前考虑调整法定饮酒年龄的国家具有重要的政策意义。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) has provided millions of Americans with medical insurance but may have led to an increase in retirement among older individuals who are utilizing the newly available coverage options as a substitute for employer-provided insurance. Using data from the American Community Survey from 2009-2016, this hypothesis is tested by estimating the effect of the premium subsidies and Medicaid expansions of the ACA on retirement transitions for the non-Medicare eligible cohort of older Americans aged 55-64. Research results indicate a 2% and 8% decrease in labor force participation resulting from the premium subsidies and Medicaid expansions, respectively. Slightly larger estimates are found among a subgroup of adult couples. The study also finds suggestive evidence of crowd-out of employer-sponsored insurance by subsidized marketplace plans but finds no such effects from the Medicaid expansions.

10.1002/hec.3959.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》为数百万美国人提供了医疗保险，但可能导致那些利用新获得的保险选项作为雇主提供保险替代品的老年人群的退休年龄有所推迟。本研究使用2009-2016年的美国社区调查数据，通过估算《平价医疗法案》中的保费补贴和医疗补助扩展对55-64岁非Medicare资格老年人群的退休转变的影响来验证这一假设。研究结果表明，保费补贴和医疗补助扩展分别导致劳动力参与率下降2%和8%。在成年夫妇这一子群体中，估计的下降幅度略大。研究还发现了一些迹象表明，补贴市场计划可能挤占了雇主提供的保险，但医疗补助扩展并未产生此类影响。

abstract.text: Many markets maintain a nontrivial mix of both nonprofit and for-profit firms, particularly in health care industries such as hospice, nursing homes, and home health. What are the effects of coexistence vs. dominance of one ownership type? We show how the presence of both ownership types can lead to greater diversity in consumer types served, even if both firms merely profit-maximize. This is the case where firms serve consumers for multiple consumption durations, but where donations are part of a nonprofit firm objective function and happen after services have been provided. This finding is strengthened if the good or service has value beyond immediate consumption or the direct consumer. We show these predictions empirically in the hospice industry, using data containing over 90 percent of freestanding U.S. hospices, 2000-2008. Nonprofit and for-profit providers split the patient market according to length of stay, leading to a wider range of patients being served than in the absence of this coexistence.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.10.001.abstractZh: 许多市场同时存在非营利性和营利性企业，尤其是在临终关怀、养老院和家庭健康护理等医疗保健行业。这两种所有权类型的共存与主导分别会产生什么影响？我们发现，即使两家企业都仅仅追求利润最大化，它们的存在也能使所提供的消费者类型更加多样化。这种情况发生在企业为消费者提供多种消费期限的服务时，但捐赠行为属于非营利性企业的目标函数，并且发生在服务提供之后。如果商品或服务具有超出即时消费或直接消费的价值，这一发现将更加明显。我们在临终关怀行业通过包含2000-2008年超过90%的美国独立临终关怀机构的数据，实证验证了这些预测。非营利性和营利性提供者根据住院时间划分患者市场，这使得所提供的患者种类比没有这种共存的情况更为广泛。

abstract.text: This article examines the long term physical and mental health effects of internal migration focusing on a relatively unique migration experience concentrated over a short period between 1950 and 1970 from the South to the North of Italy. We find a positive and statistically significant association between migration, its timing and physical health for migrant females, which we show are likely to represent rural females in both the early and the late cohort. We find less defined evidence of migration-health association for mental health. We link our findings to the economic transition and labor market transformation that Italy witnessed in that era. Male migrants were likely to be positively selected to migration, but harsh working conditions were likely to downplay this differential. On the contrary, women migrants, by and large, would not engage in the formal labor market avoiding the ill effects of working environments, at the same time benefiting from better living conditions and health care in the destination regions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.10.002.abstractZh: 本文探讨了内部迁移对长期身心健康的影响，重点关注1950至1970年间意大利南部向北部迁移这一相对独特的迁移经历。我们发现，对于迁移女性而言，迁移及其时间选择与身体健康之间存在积极且统计学上显著的关联，这些女性很可能属于早期和晚期迁移群体中的农村女性。关于迁移与心理健康之间的关联，我们发现的证据较为模糊。我们将这些发现与意大利在那个时代所经历的经济转型和劳动力市场变化联系起来。男性移民可能更倾向于选择迁移，但恶劣的工作条件可能会削弱这种差异。相反，女性移民通常不会进入正式劳动力市场，以避免恶劣的工作环境，同时还能在目的地地区享受更好的生活条件和医疗保健。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect of Medicaid prescription drug spending on mortality. I use the group- and state-specific roll out of Medicaid drug coverage to isolate plausibly exogenous variation in drug expenditures. I find that a $1 increase in Medicaid drug expenditures per resident reduces mortality from internal causes by 2.0 deaths per hundred thousand, a decline of 0.23%. I find relatively large effects for: (1) medically-treated diseases which pose an immediate risk of death, (2) impoverished areas which received a disproportionate share of state Medicaid dollars, and (3) areas with a high ratio of medical to surgical physicians.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.10.003.abstractZh: 本文估计了医疗补助处方药物支出对死亡率的影响。我利用群体和州级医疗补助药物覆盖范围的差异，来分离出可能由外部因素引起的药物支出变化。研究发现，每名居民医疗补助药物支出增加1美元，内部原因导致的死亡率将减少2.0例/十万人，即下降0.23%。研究发现，以下情况的影响较为显著：(1) 需要医疗治疗的疾病，这些疾病直接威胁生命；(2) 贫困地区，这些地区获得的州级医疗补助资金比例较高；(3) 医疗医师与外科医师比例较高的地区。

abstract.text: We provide evidence for the causal relationship between unemployment insurance (UI) and individuals' smoking behavior using the 1995-2011 Current Population Survey-Tobacco Use Supplement data. Our identification relies on the exploitation of the exogenous variations of the maximum UI weekly benefits across states and over years. Instead of focusing on all unemployed people, we concentrate on those who are eligible for UI benefits. We find that when the maximum UI weekly benefit level increases by $100, smoking cessation increases by approximately 2.9 percentage points among the UI-eligible unemployed. The results are robust to various model specifications. We also explore the mechanism and find suggestive evidence that the increase in the maximum UI weekly benefit leads to a decrease in the probability of over-work of the respective spouse. Moreover, the unemployed who are less educated are more responsive to the increasing UI benefits.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.10.004.abstractZh: 我们利用1995-2011年当前人口调查-烟草使用补充数据，为失业保险与个人吸烟行为之间的因果关系提供了证据。我们的研究基于利用各州及年份间失业保险最高周津贴的外生变化来进行分析。我们关注的并非所有失业者，而是有资格领取失业保险福利的失业人群。研究发现，当失业保险最高周津贴增加100美元时，有资格领取失业保险的失业人群中的戒烟率大约会增加2.9个百分点。这些结果在不同模型设定下依然保持稳定。我们还探讨了相关机制，并发现最高周津贴的增加会导致配偶过度工作的概率下降。此外，受教育程度较低的失业者对增加的失业保险福利反应更为敏感。

abstract.text: High-volume hospitals typically perform better than low-volume hospitals. In this paper, we study whether such patterns reflect a causal effect of case volume on patient outcomes. To this end, we exploit closures and openings of entire cancer clinics in Swedish hospitals which provides sharp and arguably exogenous variation in case volumes. Using detailed register data on more than 100,000 treatment episodes of advanced cancer surgery, our results suggest substantial positive effects of operation volume on survival. Complementary analyses point to learning-by-doing as an important explanation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.10.005.abstractZh: 高手术量的医院通常比低手术量的医院表现更好。在本文中，我们研究了这种模式是否反映了手术量对病人结果的因果效应。为此，我们利用了瑞典医院中整个癌症诊所的关闭和开设情况，这提供了手术量的急剧且可视为外生性的变化。通过利用超过10万例晚期癌症手术的治疗记录数据，我们的研究结果表明手术量对生存有显著的积极影响。补充分析指出，通过实践学习是这一现象的重要解释因素。

abstract.text: In 2008, Brazil's conditional cash transfer program expanded to cover a wider range of ages. Poor families are now given stipends for their children's school attendance up to age seventeen, whereas prior the maximum age was fifteen. Using a nationally representative household survey, we estimate the impact of this policy on teen fertility with a triple difference analysis on the fertility outcomes of treated cohorts vs. non-treated cohorts based on income eligibility, age eligibility, and timing of program implementation. We find a three percentage point drop in fertility among eligible teens within five years of program implementation. This offsets the difference in fertility between poor and non-poor teens. The impact is concentrated in urban areas, with no program effects found in rural areas. We are able to replicate these findings using National Birth Registry Data.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.10.006.abstractZh: 2008年，巴西的条件性现金转移计划扩展到了更广泛的年龄范围。现在，贫困家庭可以为子女接受教育提供津贴，直至17岁，而此前的最大年龄限制为15岁。通过一项具有全国代表性的家庭调查，我们基于收入资格、年龄资格以及计划实施的时间点，利用三重差异分析来估算这一政策对青少年生育率的影响。研究发现，在计划实施后的五年内，符合条件的青少年生育率下降了三个百分点。这一下降抵消了贫困与非贫困青少年之间的生育率差异。这一影响主要集中在城市地区，而在农村地区并未发现计划带来的效果。我们还能利用全国出生登记数据来验证这些发现。

abstract.text: I study the causal impact of neighborhoods on body mass index (BMI). Through exploiting variation in the number of years individuals have lived in their neighborhood, using a data set from California, I examine if there exist causal effects of exposure to neighborhoods with high potential effects on one's BMI. The identifying assumption is that there are no unobserved individual level characteristics correlated with both BMI and moving, after controlling for observables. I find evidence that suggests that neighborhoods do not have a causal impact on BMI.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.10.007.abstractZh: 我研究了社区对体重指数（BMI）的因果影响。通过利用加州的数据集，我考察了个体在其社区居住的年数变化是否会对BMI产生因果影响。我的假设是，在控制了可观测变量后，不存在与BMI和居住地点相关的未观测到的个体特征。我的研究发现表明，社区对BMI并没有因果影响。

abstract.text: We exploit lottery-determined admission to dental school to estimate the payoffs to the study of dentistry in the Netherlands. Using data from up to 22 years after the lottery, we find that in most years after graduation dentists earn around 50,000 Euros more than they would earn in their next-best profession. The payoff is larger for men than for women but does not vary with high school GPA. The large payoffs cannot be attributed to longer working hours, larger investments while studying (opportunity costs and direct costs), or unpleasant aspects of working as a dentist. A plausible explanation is that dentists earn a monopoly rent. Results from regressions of dentists' earnings on dentists density are consistent with this, as are the facts that the supply of dentists in the Netherlands is low and that the payoff does not vary with high school GPA.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.11.001.abstractZh: 我们利用彩票决定的牙科学校入学机会来估算牙科研究在荷兰的收益。通过收集截至彩票发放后22年的数据，我们发现大多数情况下，牙医毕业后的收入比选择次优职业时高出约5万欧元。男性获得的收益高于女性，但这一收益并不随高中成绩的变化而变化。如此高的收益并非由于工作时间更长、学习期间的投入更大（机会成本与直接成本），或是从事牙医职业的负面因素所致。一个合理的解释是，牙医享有垄断租金。将牙医收入与牙医密度进行回归分析的结果支持这一解释，同时荷兰牙医供应不足的事实以及收益与高中成绩无关的事实也进一步证实了这一点。

abstract.text: This study examines how subsidized coverage affects prescription drug utilization among low-income non-elderly adults. Using the Affordable Care Act's Medicaid expansions as a source of variation and a national, all-payer pharmacy transactions database, we find that within the first 15 months of new health insurance availability, aggregate Medicaid-paid prescriptions increased 19 percent, amounting to nearly 9 new prescriptions a year, per new enrollee. We find no evidence of reductions in uninsured or privately-insured prescriptions, suggesting that new coverage did not simply substitute for other payment sources. The largest increases occurred for medications treating conditions such as diabetes and heart disease, suggesting greater price elasticity for chronic medications. Generics increased more than brand-name drugs; and utilization increased less in expansion states with higher Medicaid drug copayments. Overall, these findings suggest that prescription drug demand among low-income populations exhibits substantial price sensitivity, and insurance expansion can increase medication treatment for chronic conditions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.11.002.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了补贴覆盖政策对低收入非老年成年人处方药使用的影响。以《平价医疗法案》的医疗补助扩展政策作为变量来源，并利用全国性的全支付药店交易数据库，我们发现，在新医疗保险生效后的前15个月内，通过医疗补助支付的处方药总量增加了19%，相当于每位新参保者每年新增近9种处方药。我们没有发现无保险或私人保险处方数量的减少，这表明新推出的保险政策并未简单地替代其他支付方式。增幅最大的药物是治疗糖尿病和心脏病等疾病的药品，这表明慢性病药物的价格弹性更大。仿制药的使用量比品牌药更多；而在医疗补助药物自付费用较高的扩展州，处方药的使用量增长幅度较小。总体而言，这些发现表明，低收入人群对处方药的需求表现出显著的价格敏感性，而保险政策的扩展能够增加慢性病患者的药物治疗。

abstract.text: This paper presents the results of a randomized study of a home visiting program implemented in Germany for low-income, first-time mothers. Besides improving child health and development, a major goal of the program is to improve the participants' economic self-sufficiency and family planning. I use administrative data from the German social security system and detailed telephone surveys to examine the effects of the intervention on maternal employment, welfare benefits, household composition, well-being, and fertility behavior. The study reveals that the intervention decreased maternal employment by 9.3 percentage points and increased subsequent births by 6.4 percentage points, in part through a reduction in abortions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.11.003.abstractZh: 本文介绍了在德国实施的针对低收入初产妇的家庭访视项目的随机研究结果。该项目的目标除了改善儿童的健康和发展外，还包括提高参与者的经济自给能力和家庭规划能力。本研究利用德国社会保障系统的行政数据以及详细的电话调查，来考察该干预措施对母亲就业、福利福利、家庭结构、幸福感以及生育行为的影响。研究结果表明，该干预措施使母亲的就业率下降了9.3个百分点，同时使后续生育率上升了6.4个百分点，部分原因是由于减少了堕胎行为。

abstract.text: I estimate demand for health insurance using consumer-level data from the California and Washington ACA exchanges. I use the demand estimates to simulate the impact of policies targeting adverse selection, including subsidies and the individual mandate. I find (1) own-premium elasticities of -7.2 to -10.6 and insurance coverage elasticities of -1.1 to -1.2; (2) limited response to the mandate penalty amount, but significant response to the penalty's existence, suggesting consumers have a "taste for compliance"; (3) mandate repeal slightly increases consumer surplus because the ACA's price-linked subsidies shield most consumers from premium increases resulting from repeal and some consumers are not compelled to purchase insurance against their will; and (4) mandate repeal decreases consumer surplus if ACA subsidies are replaced with vouchers that expose consumers to premium increases. The economic rationale for the mandate depends on the extent of adverse selection and the presence of other policies targeting selection.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.11.004.abstractZh: 我利用加利福尼亚州和华盛顿州《平价医疗法案》交易所提供的消费者级数据来估算健康保险的需求。利用这些需求估算结果，我模拟了针对逆向选择问题的政策的影响，包括补贴和个人强制保险措施。研究发现：(1)个人保费弹性为-7.2至-10.6，保险覆盖弹性为-1.1至-1.2；(2)消费者对强制保险罚款金额的反应有限，但对罚款的存在有显著反应，这表明消费者有“遵守规定”的倾向；(3)废除强制保险政策会略微增加消费者剩余，因为《平价医疗法案》中的价格补贴可以保护大多数消费者免受因政策废除而导致的保费上涨，同时一些消费者也不会被迫购买保险；(4)如果《平价医疗法案》的补贴被 vouchers 替代，导致消费者面临保费上涨，那么废除强制保险政策反而会减少消费者剩余。强制保险政策的经济合理性取决于逆向选择的程度以及是否存在其他针对逆向选择的政策。
