abstract.text: Whether place-based welfare programs affect fertility and health outcomes is an understudied question. I estimate the health impacts of the Empowerment Zone (EZ) program-a federal program that gave sizeable grants and tax breaks to certain high-poverty census tracts in selected cities. Using difference-in-differences methods, I find that the EZ program decreased fertility rates by 11 percent and improved birth outcomes. Compositional changes in fertility likely cannot explain changes in infant health. Recent research on the later-life impacts of low birth weight suggest that the health impacts of this program may have substantial long-term benefits.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.11.005.abstractZh: 关于以地点为基础的福利计划是否会影响生育率和健康结果，这一问题尚未得到充分研究。我通过差异-差异方法估算了“赋能区”计划对健康的影响——该计划是联邦政府为某些高贫困普查区域提供的巨额拨款和税收优惠。研究发现，“赋能区”计划使生育率降低了11%，并改善了出生结果。生育率的复合变化可能无法解释婴儿健康的改变。最近关于低出生体重对后期生活影响的研究表明，该计划可能对健康产生长期的积极影响。

abstract.text: The dramatic increase in the utilization of caesarean section has raised concerns on its impact on public expenditure and health. While the financial costs associated with this surgical procedure are well recognized, less is known on the intangible health costs borne by mothers and their families. We contribute to the debate by investigating the effect of unplanned caesarean deliveries on mothers' mental health in the first nine months after the delivery. Differently from previous studies, we account for the unobserved heterogeneity due to the fact that mothers who give birth through an unplanned caesarean delivery may be different than mothers who give birth with a natural delivery. Identification is achieved exploiting exogenous variation in the position of the baby in the womb at the time of delivery while controlling for hospital unobserved factors. We find that mothers having an unplanned caesarean section are at higher risk of developing postnatal depression and this result is robust to alternative specifications.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.11.006.abstractZh: 剖宫产手术使用率的急剧增加引发了人们对其对公共支出和健康影响的担忧。虽然这种手术过程的财务成本已经得到了广泛认可，但关于母亲及其家庭所承受的无形健康成本，目前了解甚少。我们通过研究非计划性剖宫产对母亲在分娩后九个月内心理健康的影响，为这一讨论做出了贡献。与以往的研究不同，我们考虑了由于非计划性剖宫产而分娩的母亲与自然分娩的母亲可能存在差异这一未观察到的异质性因素。我们通过利用分娩时胎儿在子宫内的位置这一外生变量，并在控制医院未观察到的因素后，实现了识别。我们发现，经历过非计划性剖宫产的母亲更容易患上产后抑郁症，这一结果在采用不同模型参数时依然成立。

abstract.text: We conducted a randomized controlled experiment to test whether vouchers, cash transfers, and SMS messages were effective in boosting facility delivery rates among poor, pregnant women in rural Kenya. We find a strong effect of the full vouchers and the conditional cash transfers: 48% of women with access to both interventions delivered in a health facility, while only 36% of those with neither did. Amongst women who did not receive a cash transfer, we find that a small copayment dramatically reduced voucher effectiveness, suggesting a discontinuous impact of cost-sharing on the demand for health services. Both the unconditional cash transfer and the text messages had limited effect on the use of health services. Finally, we also find no evidence that a government policy to eliminate user fees increased demand for maternal health services.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.12.001.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项随机对照实验，旨在测试代金券、现金转移和短信通知在提高肯尼亚农村贫困孕妇就医率方面的效果。研究发现，全额代金券和条件性现金转移具有显著效果：有这两种干预措施的女性中，有48%能够前往医疗机构就诊，而没有这两种干预措施的女性中，只有36%能够就诊。对于未收到现金转移的女性来说，小额自付费用显著降低了代金券的效果，这表明费用分担对医疗服务需求的影响是不连续的。无条件现金转移和短信通知对医疗服务使用的影响有限。最后，我们也没有发现政府取消用户费用政策能够增加孕产妇健康服务的需求。

abstract.text: We provide a model where hospitals compete on quality under fixed prices to investigate how hospital competition affects (i) quality differences between hospitals, and as a result, (ii) health inequalities across hospitals and patient severities. The answer to the first question is ambiguous and depends on factors related to both demand and supply of health care. Whether competition increases or reduces health inequalities depends on the type and measure of inequality. Health inequalities due to the postcode lottery are more likely to decrease if the marginal health gains from quality decrease at a higher rate, whereas health inequalities between high- and low-severity patients decrease if patient composition effects are sufficiently small. We also investigate the effect of competition on health inequalities as measured by the Gini and the Generalised Gini coefficients, and highlight differences compared to the simpler dispersion measures.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.12.002.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，其中医院在固定价格下通过质量竞争来争夺市场，以研究医院竞争如何影响（i）医院之间的质量差异，以及由此导致的（ii）医院间和患者病情严重程度上的健康不平等。对于第一个问题的答案并不明确，它取决于与医疗服务供需相关的因素。竞争是否会增加或减少健康不平等，取决于不平等的类型和衡量方式。如果质量提升带来的边际健康收益下降的速度更快，那么由邮政编码导致的健康不平等更有可能减少；而如果患者构成的影响足够小，那么高病情和低病情患者之间的健康不平等就会减少。我们还研究了竞争对健康不平等的影响，通过基尼系数和广义基尼系数来衡量，并指出了与简单的离散度衡量方式相比的差异。

abstract.text: Health Insurance Marketplaces have received considerable attention for their narrow network health plans. Yet, little is known about consumer tastes for network breadth and how they affect plan selection. I estimate demand for health plans in California's Marketplace, Covered California. Using 2017 individual enrollment data and provider network directories, I develop a geospatial measure of network breadth that reflects the physical locations of households and network providers. I find that households are sensitive to network breath in their plan choices. Mean willingness to pay for a broad network plan relative to a narrow network plan, defined as a two standard deviation, 17.44 percentage point increase in network breadth, is $45.83 in post-subsidy monthly premiums. Variation in WTP indicates a selection mechanism exists whereby older households sort into broader network plans. I also find that households are highly premium sensitive, which may be a result of plan standardization in Covered California.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.12.003.abstractZh: 健康保险市场因其网络式健康计划而受到广泛关注。然而，关于消费者对网络广度需求的了解以及这些因素如何影响计划选择，目前仍知之甚少。我针对加州的健康保险市场——Covered California，对健康保险的需求进行了估算。利用2017年的个人参保数据以及医疗服务提供者网络目录，我开发了一种地理空间指标来衡量网络广度，该指标反映了家庭与网络医疗服务提供者的物理位置。我发现，家庭在选择计划时非常关注网络广度。对于较广的网络计划，家庭愿意支付的费用比较窄的网络计划高出17.44个百分点，这一差额相当于每月保费增加45.83美元。支付意愿的变化表明，老年家庭更倾向于选择网络更广的计划。我还发现，家庭对保费的变化非常敏感，这可能是由于Covered California中的计划标准化所致。

abstract.text: We investigate univariate and multivariate risk preferences for health (longevity) and wealth. We measure attitudes toward correlation and attitudes toward higher order dependence structures such as cross-prudence and cross-temperance, making use of the risk apportionment technique proposed by Eeckhoudt et al. (2007). For multivariate gains, we find correlation aversion and cross-prudence in longevity and wealth. For losses, we observe correlation seeking and cross-imprudence. We do not find clear evidence for cross-temperance. Our results indicate that longevity and wealth are considered to be substitutes for gains, but not for losses. Second, univariate (higher order) risk preferences are comparable for longevity and wealth, although somewhat closer to linearity for wealth. Third, we find evidence that attitudes toward dependence structures in the health domain are sign-dependent.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.12.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了健康（寿命）和财富的单变量及多变量风险偏好。我们通过Eeckhoudt等人（2007年）提出的风险分配技术，来衡量对相关性的态度以及对更高阶依赖结构的态度，例如交叉谨慎和交叉节制。对于多变量收益，我们发现寿命和财富存在相关性厌恶和交叉谨慎现象。对于损失，我们观察到相关性寻求和交叉不谨慎现象。我们没有发现明确的交叉节制证据。我们的结果表明，寿命和财富被视为收益的替代品，但不是损失的替代品。其次，单变量（更高阶）风险偏好在寿命和财富方面是可比的，尽管财富的风险偏好更接近线性。第三，我们发现对健康领域依赖结构的态度是依赖于符号的。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of introducing external medical review for disability insurance (DI) in a system relying on treating physician testimony for eligibility determination. Using a unique policy change and administrative data from Switzerland, I show that medical review reduces DI incidence by 23%. Incidence reductions are closely tied to difficult-to-diagnose conditions, suggesting inaccurate assessments by treating physicians. Due to a partial benefit system, reductions in full benefit awards are partly offset by increases in partial benefits. More intense screening also increases labor market participation. Existing benefit recipients are downgraded and lose part of their benefit income when scheduled medical reviews occur. Back-of-the-envelope calculations indicate that external medical review is highly cost-effective. Under additional assumptions, the results provide a lower bound of the effect on the false positive award error rate.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.12.005.abstractZh: 本文研究了在依赖治疗医生证词来确定资格资格的残疾保险体系中引入外部医学审查的影响。通过瑞士的独特政策变更和行政数据，我们发现医学审查使残疾保险的发生率降低了23%。这一下降与难以诊断的病症密切相关，这表明治疗医生的评估可能存在不准确之处。由于部分福利制度的特点，全额福利的减少部分被部分福利的增加所抵消。更严格的筛查也增加了劳动力市场的参与度。当进行预定的医学审查时，现有的福利领取者会被降级，并失去部分福利收入。初步计算表明，外部医学审查具有很高的成本效益。在额外的假设条件下，这些结果提供了对错误阳性奖励错误率影响的下限估计。

abstract.text: This study examines the contributions of the medium-run evolution of local economies and of changes in the "drug environment' in explaining county-level changes in drug and related mortality rates from 1999 to 2015. A primary finding is that drug mortality rates did increase more in counties experiencing relative economic decline than in those with more robust growth, but that the relationship is weak and mostly accounted for by confounding factors. In the preferred estimates, less than one-tenth of the rise in drug and opioid-involved fatality rates is explained and the contribution is even smaller, quite possibly zero, when allowing for plausible selection on unobservables. Conversely, the risk of drug deaths varies systematically over time across population subgroups in ways that are consistent with an important role for the public health environment related to the availability and cost of drugs. In particular, the relative risk and share of drug mortality increased rapidly for males and younger adults, compared to their counterparts, when the primary driver of the fatal drug epidemic transitioned from prescription to illicit opioids. These results suggest that efforts to improve local economies, while desirable for other reasons, are not likely to yield significant reductions in overdose mortality, but with greater potential for interventions directly addressing the drug environment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.01.001.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了地方经济的中期演变以及“药物环境”的变化在解释1999年至2015年间县级药物及相关死亡率变化中的作用。主要发现是，在相对经济衰退的县中，药物死亡率的上升幅度比经济增长较为强劲的县更大，但这种关系较弱，且主要由混杂因素解释。在最优估计中，药物及阿片类药物相关死亡率的上升幅度不到十分之一，而当考虑到不可观测变量的合理选择时，这一贡献甚至更小，可能接近于零。相反，药物死亡风险在不同人口亚群中随时间系统性地变化，这与与药物可获得性和成本相关的公共卫生环境的重要作用相一致。特别是，当致命药物流行的主要驱动因素从处方阿片类药物转变为非法阿片类药物时，男性及年轻成年人的药物死亡率的相对风险和占比迅速增加。这些结果表明，尽管改善地方经济的努力出于其他原因具有积极意义，但不太可能显著减少药物过量死亡，而直接针对药物环境的干预则具有更大的潜力。

abstract.text: We draw from documented characteristics of the biopharmaceutical industry to construct a model where two firms can choose to outsource R&D to an external unit, and/or engage in internal R&D, before competing in a final market. We investigate the distribution of profits among market participants, and the incentives to coordinate outsourcing activities or to integrate R&D and production. Consistent with the empirical evidence, we find that the sign and magnitude of an aggregate measure of direct (inter-firm) and indirect (through the external unit) technological externalities drives the distribution of industry profits, with higher returns to the external unit when involved in development (clinical trials) than in early-stage research (drug discovery). In the latter case, the delinkage of investment incentives from industry value, together with the ability of firms to transfer risks to the external unit, imply a vulnerability of early-stage investors' returns to negative shocks, and the likely abandonment of projects with economic and medical value. We also find that competition in the equity market makes a buyout by one of the two firms more profitable to a research biotech than to a clinical services unit, and can stimulate early-stage investments. However, this long-term incentive can be minimal, notably if the superior efficiency of outsourced operations originates from economies of scope that can hardly be exploited when a firm takes control of the external unit exclusively for itself. R&D outsourcing thus does not always qualify as a relevant pathway to address the declining productivity in innovation that has characterized the industry over several decades.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.01.002.abstractZh: 我们基于生物制药行业的 documented 特征构建了一个模型，该模型描述了两家公司在最终市场竞争中可以选择将研发工作外包给外部单位，或自行进行内部研发。我们研究了市场参与者之间的利润分配情况，以及协调外包活动或整合研发与生产的激励因素。与实证证据一致，我们发现直接（企业间）和间接（通过外部单位）技术外部性的综合衡量指标，决定了行业利润的分布。当外部单位参与开发阶段（临床试验）时，其收益高于早期研究阶段（药物发现）。在后一种情况下，投资激励与行业价值的脱钩，以及企业能够将风险转移给外部单位的能力，意味着早期投资者的收益对负面冲击非常敏感，可能会放弃具有经济和医学价值的项目。我们还发现，在股权市场的竞争中，对一家研究型生物技术公司的收购比对临床服务单位更有利，并且可以刺激早期投资。然而，这种长期激励可能非常有限，尤其是当外包操作的效率优势源于范围经济时，这种优势在企業完全控制外部单位时几乎无法利用。因此，研发外包并不总是解决该行业几十年来创新生产力下降问题的有效途径。

abstract.text: Health screening provides information on disease risk and diagnosis, but whether this promotes health is unclear. We estimate the impacts of information provided by Korea's National Health Screening Program by applying a regression discontinuity design around different biomarker thresholds of diabetes, obesity, and hyperlipidemia risk using administrative data that includes medical claims, biomarkers, and behavioral surveys over four years after screening. Generally, we find limited responses to disease risk information alone. However, we find evidence for weight loss around the high risk threshold for diabetes, where information is combined with active prompting for a secondary examination for diagnosis and treatment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.01.003.abstractZh: 健康筛查可以提供疾病风险和诊断信息，但这是否有助于促进健康尚不清楚。我们采用回归不连续设计，利用包括医疗索赔、生物标志物和行为调查在内的行政数据，在糖尿病、肥胖症和高脂血症风险的不同生物标志物阈值附近，评估韩国国家健康筛查计划提供的信息所带来的影响。总体而言，我们发现仅依赖疾病风险信息时，响应有限。然而，我们发现，在糖尿病高风险阈值附近，当信息与主动提示结合使用时，人们会采取减重措施，以便进行二次检查以确诊和治疗疾病。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of New York City's universal pre-kindergarten program (UPK) on the health and utilization of children enrolled in Medicaid using a difference-in-regression-discontinuities design. We find that UPK increases the probability that a child is diagnosed with asthma or with vision problems, receives treatment for hearing or vision problems, or receives an immunization or screening during the pre-kindergarten year. These effects are not offset by lower rates in the kindergarten year, suggesting that UPK accelerates the rate at which children are identified with and treated for conditions that could potentially delay learning and cause behavioral problems.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.01.004.abstractZh: 我们采用差异回归不连续设计，研究了纽约市普及学前班计划对参加医疗补助计划的儿童健康状况和利用率的影响。研究发现，普及学前班计划增加了儿童在学前班期间被诊断出哮喘或视力问题、接受听力或视力问题治疗，以及接受免疫接种或筛查的概率。这些影响并未因幼儿园阶段的较低发病率而抵消，这表明普及学前班计划加快了儿童被识别并接受治疗的情况，从而可能延缓学习进程并导致行为问题。

abstract.text: People deny health risks, invest too little in disease prevention, and are highly sensitive to the price of preventative health care, especially in developing countries. Moreover, private sector R&D spending on developing-country diseases is almost non-existent. To explain these empirical observations, I propose a model of motivated belief formation, in which an agent's decision to engage in health risk denial balances the psychological benefits of reduced anxiety with the physical cost of underprevention. I use the model to study firms' price-setting behavior and incentive to innovate. I also show that tax-funded prevention subsidies are welfare enhancing.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.01.005.abstractZh: 人们否认健康风险，对疾病预防的投资不足，并且对预防性医疗保健的价格非常敏感，尤其是在发展中国家。此外，私营部门在发展中国家疾病防治方面的研发支出几乎为零。为了解释这些实证现象，我提出了一个动机性信念形成模型，该模型认为，个体是否选择否认健康风险取决于减少焦虑带来的心理收益与未采取预防措施所付出的身体代价之间的权衡。我利用该模型研究企业的定价行为及创新动机。我还表明，由税收资助的预防补贴能够提升福利水平。

abstract.text: We investigate the effects of perinatal medical treatments on low-income newborns who are classified as low-risk. A policy rule in The Netherlands states that low-risk deliveries before week 37 should be supervised by physicians and later deliveries only by midwives with no physician present. This creates large discontinuities in the probability of receiving medical interventions only physicians are allowed to perform. Using a regression discontinuity design, we find that babies born slightly before the week-37 cutoff are significantly less likely to die than babies born slightly later. Our data suggest that physician supervision of birth reduces the likelihood of adverse events such as fetal distress or emergency C-section. Our results indicate that low-income women benefit from receiving a higher level of medical care even if no explicit risk factors have been recognized, pointing to challenges in identifying all high-risk pregnancies. "Back-of-the-envelope" calculations suggest this additional care is highly cost-effective.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.01.006.abstractZh: 我们研究了围产期医疗治疗对被归类为低风险的低收入新生儿的影响。荷兰的一项政策规定，在37周之前的低风险分娩应由医生监督，之后的分娩则仅由助产士操作，且不得有医生在场。这导致只有医生才能执行的医疗干预措施的概率出现了巨大差异。通过回归 discontinuity 设计的研究发现，在37周截止日期之前出生的婴儿，其死亡风险明显低于在该日期之后出生的婴儿。我们的数据表明，医生的监督可以减少胎儿窘迫或紧急剖宫产等不良事件的发生。研究结果表明，即使没有识别出明确的高风险因素，低收入女性也能从更高水平的医疗护理中受益，这提示在识别所有高风险妊娠方面存在挑战。“粗略计算”表明，这种额外的护理具有很高的成本效益。

abstract.text: A longstanding literature explores how altruism affects the way physicians respond to incentives and provide care. We analyze how patient socioeconomic status mediates these responses. We show theoretically that patient socioeconomic status systematically influences the way physicians respond to reimbursement changes, and we identify the channels through which these effects operate. We use two Medicare reimbursement changes to investigate these insights empirically. We confirm that a given physician facing an increase in reimbursement boosts utilization by more when treating richer patients. We show that average supply price elasticities vary from 0.02 to 0.18 for a given physician, depending on the patient's socioeconomic status. Finally, we show that the Medicare reforms we study led to overall reimbursement increases that raised healthcare utilization by 10% more for high-income patients compared to their low-income peers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.02.001.abstractZh: 已有大量文献探讨了利他主义如何影响医生对激励措施的响应以及提供医疗服务的方式。我们分析了患者社会经济地位如何中介这些响应。从理论上讲，患者社会经济地位系统性地影响着医生对报销政策变化的反应，并且我们确定了这些效应作用的渠道。我们通过两个医疗保险报销政策的变动来实证研究这些发现。我们确认，面对报销增加，某位医生在治疗富裕患者时的服务利用率会提高更多。我们还发现，对于同一位医生来说，平均供应价格弹性从0.02到0.18不等，这取决于患者所处的社会经济地位。最后，我们表明，我们所研究的医疗保险改革导致整体报销增加，使得高收入患者比低收入患者多获得10%的医疗服务利用机会。

abstract.text: This paper studies a commercial insurer-driven intervention to improve resource allocation. The insurer developed a claims-based algorithm to derive a member-level healthcare utilization risk score. Members with the highest scores were contacted by a care management team tasked with closing gaps in care. The number of members outreached was dictated by resource availability and not by severity, creating a set of arbitrary cutoff points, separating treated and untreated members with very similar predicted risk scores. Using a regression discontinuity approach, we find evidence that predictive analytics-driven interventions directed at high-risk individuals reduced emergency room and specialist visits, yet not hospitalizations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.02.002.abstractZh: 本文研究了一家商业保险公司为推动资源优化分配所采取的干预措施。该保险公司开发了一种基于索赔的算法，用于计算会员的医疗保健利用风险评分。风险评分最高的会员会收到护理管理团队的联系，其任务就是填补护理服务中的空白。被联系会员的数量取决于资源可用性，而非风险的严重程度，这就产生了一组任意的临界值，将风险评分非常相似的会员分为接受治疗和未接受治疗的两类。通过回归不连续方法分析发现，针对高风险个体的预测性分析驱动的干预措施确实减少了急诊室和专科门诊的就诊次数，但并未减少住院次数。

abstract.text: This study explores the interplay between two important public programs for vulnerable children: Medicaid and the Supplemental Security Income (SSI) program. Children's public health insurance eligibility increased dramatically during the late 1990s with the launch of the Children's Health Insurance Program along with concurrent Medicaid expansions. We use a measure of simulated eligibility as an exogenous source of variation in Medicaid generosity to identify the effects of the eligibility expansions on SSI outcomes. Though increases in eligibility for public health insurance did not affect contemporaneous youth SSI applications or awards on average, expansions in coverage significantly decreased both applications and awards in states where SSI recipients did not automatically receive Medicaid. We attribute the difference in findings to the higher transactions costs associated with entering Medicaid via SSI in such states. In the long-term, increased public insurance eligibility during childhood reduces young adult SSI applications to some extent, consistent with recent findings that Medicaid coverage in youth improves adult health and economic outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.02.003.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了两项针对弱势儿童的重大公共计划——医疗补助和补充安全收入计划之间的相互作用。在1990年代末，随着儿童健康保险计划的启动以及医疗补助的扩展，儿童公共健康保险资格资格显著上升。我们通过模拟资格资格作为医疗补助慷慨度变化的外生变量，来识别资格资格扩展对补充安全收入计划结果的影响。尽管公共健康保险资格资格的增加并未显著影响当时青少年的补充安全收入计划申请或补助金额，但在那些补充安全收入计划受助者不自动获得医疗补助的州，保险覆盖范围的扩大显著减少了申请和补助金额。我们将这一差异归因于这些州通过补充安全收入计划进入医疗补助计划所伴随的更高交易成本。从长期来看，儿童时期公共保险资格资格的提升在一定程度上减少了年轻成年人的补充安全收入计划申请，这与最近的研究结果一致，即青少年时期的医疗补助覆盖能够改善成年后的健康和经济状况。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the relationship between self-reported health and material hardship among older Americans. Differently from income-based measures, material hardship provides a more specific description of the concrete adversities faced by the elderly. We have used the last six waves of the Health and Retirement Study to explore the relative contributions of state dependence, unobserved heterogeneity and time-specific shocks on reporting poor health, experiencing food insecurity and medication cutbacks. We have used a Latent Markov model to estimate a multivariate non-linear system of equations for panel data allowing time-varying unobserved heterogeneity. Our results reveal a high state dependence of both health and material hardship conditions. Estimated trajectories reveal that pathways of material hardship are associated differently with health. Material hardship is also spread across its dimensions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.02.004.abstractZh: 本文研究了美国老年人自我报告的健康状况与物质困境之间的关系。与基于收入的衡量标准不同，物质困境能够更具体地描述老年人所面临的现实困境。我们利用了“健康与退休研究”的过去六次调查数据，探讨了状态依赖性、未观测的异质性以及时间特定的冲击对报告健康状况不佳、遭遇食物不安全以及药物供应减少的影响。我们采用潜马尔可夫模型来估计一个多变量非线性方程组，该模型适用于包含时间变化未观测异质性的面板数据。研究结果表明，健康状况和物质困境都表现出高度的状态依赖性。估计的轨迹显示，物质困境的路径与健康状况的关联方式有所不同。此外，物质困境在不同维度上也存在差异。

abstract.text: Mergers that affiliate a hospital with a Catholic owner, network, or system reduce the set of possible reproductive medical procedures since Catholic hospitals have strict prohibitions on contraception. Using changes in ownership of hospitals, we find that Catholic hospitals reduce the per bed rates of tubal ligations by 31%, whereas there is no significant change in related permitted procedures such as Caesarian sections. However, across a variety of measures, we find minimal overall welfare reductions. Still, fewer tubal ligations increase the risk of unintended pregnancies across the United States, imposing a potentially substantial cost for less reliable contraception on women and their partners.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.02.005.abstractZh: 将医院与天主教所有者、网络或系统合并后，由于天主教医院对避孕有严格限制，可进行的生殖医疗程序数量会减少。通过研究医院所有权的变化，我们发现天主教医院使每床位的输卵管结扎手术费用减少了31%，而诸如剖腹产等相关手术则没有显著变化。不过，从各种指标来看，整体福利的减少幅度很小。尽管如此，较少的输卵管结扎手术会增加美国范围内意外怀孕的风险，从而给女性及其伴侣带来潜在的高昂代价，因为他们需要依赖不太可靠的避孕措施。

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of access to convenience stores and competition between convenience store chains on the use of medical care in Taiwan. Using insurance claims from 0.85 million individuals and administrative data on store sales, we find that greater store density and more inter-brand competition reduced expenditures on outpatient medical services and prescription drugs. In support of these findings, we demonstrate that convenience store competition was associated with greater consumption of healthy foods and lower obesity rates. Our estimates suggest that the rise in convenience store competition from 2002 to 2012 reduced outpatient expenditures in Taiwan by 0.44 percent and prescription drug expenditures by 0.85 percent.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.03.001.abstractZh: 我们研究了便利店的普及程度以及不同便利店连锁企业之间的竞争对台湾医疗使用情况的影响。通过0.85百万人的保险理赔数据以及商店销售的相关行政数据，我们发现店铺密度增加以及不同品牌之间的竞争减少了门诊医疗服务和处方药的开支。进一步分析发现，便利店之间的竞争与对健康食品的消费增加以及肥胖率的降低有关。我们的估计表明，从2002年到2012年，便利店竞争的增加使台湾的门诊支出减少了0.44%，处方药支出减少了0.85%。

abstract.text: We study the introduction of reference pricing to the California Public Employees' Retirement System. Reference pricing changes the relative price of using a hospital versus an ambulatory surgery center (ASC) for patients receiving a colonoscopy, leading to as good as random variation in patients' use of ASCs. We find a 10 percentage point increase in the share of patients using an ASC, leading to a $2300 to $1700 reduction in prices paid for patients who switch to ASCs. Our results suggest that the use of ASCs has a causal effect on prices paid and has no negative effect on patient health outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.03.002.abstractZh: 我们研究了在加利福尼亚州公共雇员退休体系中引入参考定价的情况。参考定价改变了使用医院与门诊手术中心进行结肠镜检查的相对价格，导致患者使用门诊手术中心的情况出现随机变化。我们发现，使用门诊手术中心的患者比例增加了10个百分点，这使得转向门诊手术中心的患者支付的费用减少了2300美元至1700美元。我们的研究结果表明，使用门诊手术中心对支付费用有因果影响，并且不会对患者的健康结果产生负面影响。

abstract.text: We investigate whether the development of eating disorders, in the form of purging, is influenced by peers' body size through interpersonal comparisons. Using detailed information on recent cohorts of U.S. teenagers, we document a sizeable and significant negative effect of high school peers' body mass index (BMI) on purging behavior during the adolescence for females, but not for males. Interpersonal comparisons operate through the formation of a distorted self-perception: teenage girls with relatively thin female peers perceive themselves as heavier than they actually are. The girls who are more susceptible to peer influences are those having peers who are thinner, more popular, more (verbally) able, and with more educated parents.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.03.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了以清除行为为代表的饮食障碍的发展是否受到同龄人通过人际比较所表现出的体型影响。利用美国青少年群体的详细数据，我们发现高中同龄人的体重指数对女性青少年的清除行为有显著的负面影响，但对男性青少年则没有这种影响。人际比较通过形成扭曲的自我认知来发挥作用：与体型较瘦的同龄人相比，青少年女孩会认为自己比实际更重。那些更容易受到同龄人影响的女孩，往往拥有体型更瘦、更受欢迎、在言语上更有能力，且父母受教育程度更高的同龄人。

abstract.text: One concern with employer-based health insurance is job lock or the inability for employees to leave their current employment for better opportunities for fear of losing benefits. We use the implementation of the Affordable Care Act's dependency mandate as a natural experiment. Data from the United States Army overcome some limitations in previous studies including the ability to examine workers with fixed contract expiration dates, uniform pay, and health coverage. We find that the ACA decreased reenlistment rates by 3.13 percent for enlisted soldiers aged 23-25. We also find that younger veterans who leave the Army are more likely to attend college. These findings show that the ACA reduced job lock and increased college-going.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.03.005.abstractZh: 雇主提供的健康保险存在一个问题，即员工可能会因担心失去福利而无法离开当前的工作岗位。我们利用《平价医疗法案》中的依赖强制条款实施作为自然实验。来自美国陆军的数据克服了以往研究中的一些限制，包括能够考察合同期限固定的工人、固定薪酬的工人以及有健康保险覆盖的工人。我们发现，《平价医疗法案》使23-25岁的士兵的重新入伍率降低了3.13%。此外，离开陆军的年轻退伍军人更有可能上大学。这些发现表明，《平价医疗法案》减少了工作锁定现象，并增加了年轻人上大学的机会。

abstract.text: We test the physicians' altruism and moral hazard hypotheses using a national panel register containing all 2003-2010 statins prescriptions in Finland. We estimate the likelihood that physicians prescribe generic versus branded versions of statins as a function of the shares of the difference between what patients have to pay out of their pocket and what is covered by the insurance, controlling for patient, physician, and drug characteristics. We find that the estimated coefficients and the average marginal effects associated with moral hazard and altruism are nearly zero, and are orders of magnitude smaller than the ones associated with other explanatory factors such as the prescriptions' year and the physician specialization. When the analysis distinctly accounts for both the patient and the insurer shares of expenditure, the estimated coefficients directly reject the altruism and moral hazard hypotheses. Instead, we find strong and robust evidence of habits persistence in prescribing branded drugs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.03.006.abstractZh: 我们使用一个包含2003年至2010年芬兰所有他汀类药物处方的全国面板数据库，来检验医生们的利他主义与道德风险假设。我们估计了医生选择使用仿制药还是品牌药的可能性，这一可能性取决于患者需自付费用与保险覆盖费用之间的差额比例，同时控制了患者、医生和药物的特性。研究发现，与道德风险和利他主义相关的估计系数几乎为零，其数值远小于其他解释因素（如处方年份和医生专业领域）的影响。当分析同时考虑了患者和保险公司的支出分担比例时，估计的系数直接否定了利他主义和道德风险假设。相反，我们发现品牌药物处方习惯具有较强且稳定的持续性。

abstract.text: The rapid evolution into a 24 h society challenges individuals' ability to conciliate work schedules and biological needs. Epidemiological research suggests that social and biological time are increasingly drifting apart ("social jetlag"). This study uses a spatial regression discontinuity design to estimate the economic cost of the misalignment between social and biological rhythms arising at the border of a time-zone in the presence of relatively rigid social schedules (e.g., work and school schedules). Exploiting the discontinuity in the timing of natural light at a time-zone boundary, we find that an extra hour of natural light in the evening reduces sleep duration by an average of 19 minutes and increases the likelihood of reporting insufficient sleep. Using data drawn from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and the US Census, we find that the discontinuity in the timing of natural light has significant effects on health outcomes typically associated with circadian rhythms disruptions (e.g., obesity, diabetes, cardiovascular diseases, and breast cancer) and economic performance (per capita income). We provide a lower bound estimate of the health care costs and productivity losses associated with these effects.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.03.007.abstractZh: 快速向24小时社会转型的挑战，使得个人难以协调工作时间和生物需求。流行病学研究表明，社会和生物时间之间的差距正在日益扩大（“社会时差”）。本研究采用空间回归不连续设计，估算了在相对固定的社会时间表（如工作和学校时间表）背景下，社会和生物节律不一致所带来的经济成本。通过利用时间区边界处自然光时间的不连续性，我们发现，晚上多一小时的自然光会使睡眠时长平均减少19分钟，并增加睡眠不足的报告频率。利用美国疾病控制与预防中心和美国人口普查局提供的数据，我们发现自然光时间的不连续性对与昼夜节律紊乱相关的健康结果（如肥胖、糖尿病、心血管疾病和乳腺癌）以及经济表现（人均收入）有显著影响。我们提供了与这些影响相关的医疗保健成本和生产率损失的下限估计值。

abstract.text: This paper examines the causal effect of retirement on health and healthcare utilization using two identification strategies on Danish full population data. First, I use a reform of the statutory retirement age in an IV design. Second, I use a large discontinuity in retirement take-up at the earliest age of retirement (60) in a regression discontinuity design. The results show that early retirement leads to decreases in GP visits and hospitalizations of 8-10% in the short run. The reduction in GP visits is driven by a drop in female GP utilization, while both genders contribute equally to the decline in hospitalizations. Early retirement has no effect on health measured by comorbidities or mortality. Statutory retirement has no effect on health or healthcare utilization. The results suggest that gender, age at retirement and complier composition are important sources of heterogeneity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.03.008.abstractZh: 本文通过采用两种识别策略，基于丹麦全人群数据，探讨了退休对健康和医疗利用的因果效应。首先，我采用IV设计对法定退休年龄进行了改革。其次，我利用回归不连续设计，在最早的退休年龄（60岁）处引入了一个较大的退休接受度不连续性。研究结果表明，短期内提前退休会导致全科医生就诊次数和住院次数的减少，幅度为8-10%。全科医生就诊次数的减少主要源于女性全科医生的利用减少，而住院次数的减少则涉及男女双方的贡献。提前退休对以合并症或死亡率衡量的健康状况没有影响。法定退休年龄对健康和医疗利用也没有影响。研究结果表明，性别、退休年龄以及遵守规定的人群构成是造成异质性的重要因素。

abstract.text: While there is increasing evidence that graded return-to-work is an effective tool for the rehabilitation of sick-listed workers, little is known on the optimal timing and level of grading in return-to-work trajectories. We use administrative data from a Dutch private workplace reintegration provider to fill this gap. In order to correct for the selection bias inherent to the evaluation of activation strategies, we exploit the discretionary room of the case managers in setting up treatment plans. We find that graded return-to-work has the potential to speed up the recovery process, but does not necessarily help rehabilitate workers who would otherwise have not rehabilitated. Work resumption can be achieved faster when graded return-to-work is started earlier and may permanently increase when started at a higher rate of work resumption. These findings however do not hold for individuals who have problems related to mental health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.03.009.abstractZh: 尽管越来越多的证据表明，分阶段恢复工作是一种有效的康复工具，但对于恢复工作的最佳时机和分阶段程度仍知之甚少。我们利用一家荷兰私人工作场所康复机构的行政数据来填补这一空白。为了纠正评估激活策略时固有的选择偏差，我们利用了案例管理者在制定治疗计划时的自由裁量权。我们发现，分阶段恢复工作有潜力加快康复过程，但并不一定能帮助那些原本无法康复的工人。如果分阶段恢复工作开始得越早，恢复工作的速度可能会更快；而如果以更高的恢复速度开始，则可能会带来更持久的康复效果。然而，这些发现并不适用于那些存在心理健康问题的个体。

abstract.text: This paper examines the long-term effects of childhood disability on individuals' educational and occupational choices, late-career labor market participation, and mortality. We merge medical records on children hospitalized with poliomyelitis during the 1952 Danish epidemic to census and administrative data, and exploit quasi-random variation in paralysis incidence in this population. While childhood disability increases the likelihood of early retirement and disability pension receipt at age 50, paralytic polio survivors are more likely to obtain a university degree and to go on to work in white-collar and computer-demanding jobs than their non-paralytic counterparts. Our results are consistent with individuals making educational and occupational choices that reflect a shift in the comparative advantage of cognitive versus physical skills. We also find that paralytic polio patients from low socioeconomic status backgrounds are more likely to die prematurely than their non-paralytic counterparts, whereas there is no effect on mortality among polio survivors from more advantaged backgrounds.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.03.010.abstractZh: 本文探讨了儿童期残疾对个体教育和职业选择、晚年劳动力市场参与以及死亡率的长期影响。我们通过合并1952年丹麦脊髓灰质炎疫情期间因脊髓灰质炎住院的儿童的医疗记录与人口普查及行政数据，并利用该人群中麻痹症发病率的准随机变化，来研究这一问题。研究发现，儿童期残疾会增加50岁时提前退休和领取残疾养老金的可能性，但脊髓灰质炎幸存者更有可能获得大学学位，并从事白领工作或需要计算机技能的工作。我们的研究结果表明，个体在教育和职业选择上的差异反映了认知技能与身体技能相对优势的变化。此外，我们还发现，来自低社会经济背景的脊髓灰质炎患者比非麻痹症患者更容易过早死亡，而来自更有优势背景的脊髓灰质炎幸存者则没有这种死亡风险。

abstract.text: In health, stated preference data from discrete choice experiments (DCEs) are commonly used to estimate discrete choice models that are then used for forecasting behavioral change, often with the goal of informing policy decisions. Data from DCEs are potentially subject to hypothetical bias. In turn, forecasts may be biased, yielding substandard evidence for policymakers. Bias can enter both through the elasticities as well as through the model constants. Simple correction approaches exist (using revealed preference data) but are seemingly not widely used in health economics. We use DCE data from an experiment on smokers in the US. Real-world data are used to calibrate the scale of utility (in two ways) and the alternative-specific constants (ASCs); several innovations for calibration are proposed. We find that embedding revealed preference data in the model makes a substantial difference to the forecasts; and that how models are calibrated also makes a substantial difference.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.03.011.abstractZh: 在健康领域，离散选择实验（DCEs）中的偏好数据常被用来估计离散选择模型，这些模型随后被用于预测行为变化，其目的通常是为政策决策提供信息。然而，DCEs的数据可能存在假设性偏差。由此产生的预测也可能存在偏差，从而为政策制定者提供不准确的证据。这种偏差可能通过弹性参数以及模型常数来产生。虽然存在简单的校正方法（使用揭示性偏好数据），但在健康经济学中似乎并未被广泛采用。我们使用了美国一项关于吸烟者的实验数据。实际数据被用来校准效用尺度（以两种方式）以及替代特定常数（ASCs）；我们提出了几种新的校准方法。我们发现，在模型中嵌入揭示性偏好数据对预测结果有显著影响；而模型校准的方式同样会产生重要影响。

abstract.text: Taiwanese Labor, Government Employee, and Farmer Insurance programs provide 5 to 6 months of salary to enrollees who undergo hysterectomies or oophorectomies before their 45th birthday. These programs create incentives for more and earlier treatments, referred to as inducement and timing effects. Using National Health Insurance data between 1997 and 2011, we estimate these effects on surgery hazards by difference-in-difference and bunching-smoothing polynomial methods. For Government Employee and Labor Insurance, inducement is 11-12% of all hysterectomies, and timing 20% of inducement. For oophorectomies, both effects are insignificant. Enrollees' behaviors are consistent with rational choices. Each surgery qualifies an enrollee for the same benefit, but oophorectomy has more adverse health consequences than hysterectomy. Induced hysterectomies increase benefit payments and surgical costs, at about the cost of a mammogram and 5 pap smears per enrollee.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.04.001.abstractZh: 台湾的劳工保险、政府雇员保险和农民保险计划为在45岁之前接受子宫切除术或卵巢切除术的参保人提供5到6个月的工资保障。这些保险计划通过激励措施促使人们更早进行手术，这种现象被称为“激励效应”和“时机效应”。利用1997年至2011年的国民健康保险数据，我们通过差异分解和多项式平滑方法估计了这些效应对手术风险的影响。对于政府雇员保险和劳工保险，激励效应占所有子宫切除术的11-12%，而时机效应则占激励效应的20%。对于卵巢切除术，这两种效应均不显著。参保人的行为符合理性选择。每种手术都能为参保人提供相同的保险福利，但卵巢切除术比子宫切除术对健康的负面影响更大。激励性子宫切除术会增加保险支付和手术成本，大约相当于每位参保人进行一次乳腺X光检查和5次宫颈涂片检查的费用。

abstract.text: Accumulated medical information is necessary to determine comorbidity risk between a primary disease and secondary diseases. However, medical decisions often must be made without conclusive evidence because individuals do not have sufficient information. By introducing ambiguity regarding comorbidities, we describe situations in which individuals face a set of plausible comorbidity risks that determines the correlations between primary and secondary diseases. This study examines the conditions under which the willingness to pay for health improvement is larger with comorbidity ambiguity than without it. This study also examines the effect of changes in ambiguity and ambiguity aversion on the willingness to pay.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.04.002.abstractZh: 积累的医疗信息对于确定主要疾病与次要疾病之间的共病风险是必要的。然而，由于个人缺乏足够的信息，医疗决策往往必须在没有确凿证据的情况下做出。通过引入共病的模糊性，我们描述了个体面临一系列可能的共病风险的情况，这些风险决定了主要疾病与次要疾病之间的相关性。本研究探讨了在共病模糊性存在的情况下，人们愿意为改善健康支付更多费用的条件。此外，本研究还探讨了模糊性变化以及模糊性厌恶对支付意愿的影响。

abstract.text: Between 1996 and 2015, vehicular fatalities per capita involving 16- to 17-year-old drivers declined by 68.7%. During this same period, states enacted teen driver licensure provisions in an á la carte fashion, now collectively referred to as graduated driver licensing (GDL) programs, that restricted teen driving. While the literature demonstrates that 'good' GDL programs reduce vehicular fatalities, how these reductions occur remains open. In this study, separate GDL provisions and no pass, no drive laws are studied to understand reduction mechanisms. The evaluation is based on a state-by-year panel and uses difference-in-difference and triple-difference specifications to identify causal impacts on rates of licensing, vehicular fatalities, and fatalities per licensee. The empirical results find that the minimum intermediate licensing age of 16.5 or older provision reduces licensing of 16- to 17-year-old teens by 20.1%, and no other licensure provision consistently impacts licensing. In addition, vehicular fatalities decrease from the minimum intermediate licensing age of 16.5 or older provision by 22.7%, the driver's education reduces supervised hours provision by 5.9%, and no pass, no drive laws by 7.3%, while vehicular fatalities increase from the supervised driving hours required provision by 6.3%. Furthermore, only teen driver cellphone or texting bans have impacts on vehicular fatalities per 16- to 17-year-old licensed female and few long-term impacts are identified on those ages 18-20 who 'graduated' from licensing programs. This research suggests that GDL programs affect vehicular fatalities mostly through incapacitation, rather than programmatically.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.04.003.abstractZh: 在1996年至2015年间，涉及16至17岁驾驶员的车辆死亡人数减少了68.7%。在同一时期，各州以各自的方式实施了青少年驾驶执照制度，这些制度现在被称为渐进式驾驶执照制度（GDL计划），旨在限制青少年的驾驶行为。尽管文献表明“良好的”GDL计划能够减少车辆死亡事故，但这些减少是如何实现的仍不清楚。本研究分别考察了GDL计划的不同条款以及不通过驾驶考试就不允许驾驶的规定，以了解其减少死亡事故的机制。研究基于逐年状态面板数据，并使用差异分解和三重差异模型来识别对执照颁发率、车辆死亡事故数量以及每执照持有者死亡事故数量的因果影响。实证结果发现，将最低中间执照年龄设定为16.5岁或更高，可使16至17岁青少年的执照颁发率降低20.1%；其他任何执照规定对执照颁发率的影响并不明显。此外，从16.5岁或更高的最低中间执照年龄规定来看，车辆死亡事故减少了22.7%；驾驶教育中的监督时间减少5.9%；不通过驾驶考试就不允许驾驶的规定减少了7.3%，而监督驾驶时间的规定则使车辆死亡事故增加了6.3%。此外，只有青少年驾驶手机或短信禁令对16至17岁持证女性的车辆死亡事故有显著影响，而对18至20岁已通过执照颁发计划的青少年则几乎没有长期影响。研究表明，GDL计划主要通过限制驾驶能力来影响车辆死亡事故，而非通过制度本身来实现。

abstract.text: We examine whether relaxing occupational licensing to allow nurse practitioners (NPs)-registered nurses with advanced degrees-to prescribe medication without physician oversight improves population mental health. Exploiting time-series variation in independent prescriptive authority for NPs from 1990 to 2014, we find that broadening prescriptive authority leads to improvements in self-reported mental health and decreases in mental health-related mortality. These improvements are concentrated in areas that are underserved by physicians and among populations that have difficulty accessing physician-provided care. Our results demonstrate that extending independent prescriptive authority to NPs can help mitigate physician shortages and extend care to disadvantaged populations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.04.004.abstractZh: 我们研究的是，放宽职业许可规定，允许拥有高级学位的执业护士在没有医生监督的情况下开药，是否有助于改善人群心理健康。通过对比1990年至2014年间执业护士独立处方权的变化，我们发现扩大其处方权能够提升自我报告的心理健康状况，并降低与心理健康相关的死亡率。这些改善主要体现在那些医生服务不足的地区以及难以获得医生提供的医疗服务的人群中。我们的研究结果表明，扩大执业护士的独立处方权有助于缓解医生短缺问题，并能够为弱势人群提供更全面的医疗服务。

abstract.text: Based on a dynamic life cycle model, this study analyzes health-related risks of consumption and old-age poverty. The model allows for health effects on employment risks, on productivity, on longevity, the correlation between health risks, productivity and preferences, and the financial incentives of the German public insurance schemes. The estimation uses data on male employees and an extended expectation-maximization algorithm. Simulations suggest that health shocks induce average losses in annual consumption of about 10% and account for more than two-thirds of the cases of old-age poverty. Annuity markets that account for differences in the longevity risk by health status can effectively reduce the consumption risks, but only slightly decrease old-age poverty. A policy analysis of minimum pension benefits indicates that a means test mitigates the associated moral hazard problem substantially.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.04.005.abstractZh: 本研究基于动态生命周期模型，分析了消费与健康相关的风险以及老年贫困问题。该模型考虑了健康对就业风险、生产力、寿命的影响，以及健康风险、生产力与偏好之间的关联，还包括德国公共保险计划的财政激励措施。研究采用男性员工的数据，并运用扩展的期望最大化算法进行估计。模拟结果显示，健康冲击会导致年均消费损失约10%，并且这一因素在老年贫困案例中占比超过三分之二。能够根据健康状况差异调整寿命风险的年金市场可以有效降低消费风险，但仅能略微减少老年贫困现象。对最低养老金福利的政策分析表明，通过收入核查可以显著减轻相关的道德风险问题。

abstract.text: Cognitive functioning exhibits a clear lifecycle pattern with a general deterioration over older ages. This article estimates the short-term effect of retirement on cognitive performance of elderly Australians by exploiting the exogenous variation in retirement decisions induced by changes in social security eligibility rules. The empirical results show that on average retirement has a negative but modest effect on cognition, and the rate of cognitive decline with age is greater for men than women. The results for women display no significant effects on working memory and speed of information processing. The article further adds to the literature by providing evidence on the possible mechanisms through which retirement could affect individual's cognitive performance. We find that moving into retirement leads women to increase the time spent in mental and household activities, which may in part explain the modest effect we observe for women.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.04.006.abstractZh: 认知功能呈现出明显的生命周期模式，随着年龄的增长，认知能力会普遍下降。本文通过利用社会保障资格规则变化所导致的退休决策外生变异，估算了退休对澳大利亚老年人认知表现的短期影响。实证结果显示，平均而言，退休对认知能力的负面影响较为温和，且随着年龄增长，男性的认知衰退速度比女性更快。对于女性而言，退休并未对其工作记忆和信息处理速度产生显著影响。本文还进一步为相关文献提供了证据，揭示了退休可能影响个体认知表现的可能机制。我们发现，进入退休阶段后，女性会增加用于心理和家务活动的时间，这可能部分解释了我们观察到的女性认知能力的温和下降现象。

abstract.text: Minimum unit prices (MUPs) have been proposed on the grounds that they can reduce alcohol consumption of the heaviest drinkers, without significantly burdening moderate drinkers. This paper examines the case for MUPs in an optimal tax framework. Such a policy can improve welfare when two conditions are both satisfied. First, beverage quality and quantity should be substitutes. Second, there should be more distortion to consumption of cheaper alcohol than to more expensive varieties. The consequences of a MUP for the optimal corrective tax are explored with a calibrated numerical example. This example illustrates how the optimal tax rate might be higher when used in isolation, than when a MUP is also being used.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.04.007.abstractZh: 最低单位价格这一概念被提出，其理由是它可以减少重度饮酒者的饮酒量，而不会给适度饮酒者带来过大的负担。本文在最优税收框架下探讨了最低单位价格的可行性。当满足以下两个条件时，这样的政策可以提高福利水平：首先，饮料的质量和数量应该是可替代的；其次，较便宜的酒精饮料对消费的影响应该大于较昂贵的酒精饮料。通过一个经过校准的数值例子，本文探讨了最低单位价格对最优矫正税的影响。该例子表明，当单独使用最低单位价格时，最优税率可能会高于同时采用最低单位价格和其他税收措施的情况。

abstract.text: This paper shows that early-life health is an important determinant of labor market vulnerability during macroeconomic downturns. Using data on twins during Sweden's crisis of the early 1990s, we show that individuals with higher birth weight are differentially less likely to receive unemployment insurance benefits after the crisis as compared to before it, and that this effect is concentrated among workers in the private sector. While differences in early-life health thus lead to increased inequality in employment outcomes, we also find that there is no differential effect of birth weight on total income after the crisis. This suggests that in the context of Sweden, the social safety net is able to mitigate the effects of early-life health on labor market outcomes during economic downturns.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.05.001.abstractZh: 本文指出，早年健康状况是宏观经济衰退期间劳动力市场脆弱性的重要决定因素。通过研究20世纪90年代初瑞典危机期间双胞胎的数据，我们发现，与危机前相比，出生体重较高的个体在危机后获得失业保险福利的可能性显著降低，且这种效应主要集中在私营部门的劳动者中。虽然早年健康状况的差异导致了就业结果的不平等加剧，但我们还发现，危机过后，出生体重对总收入的影响并没有出现差异。这表明，在瑞典的情境下，社会保障体系能够缓解早年健康状况对经济衰退期间劳动力市场结果的影响。

abstract.text: The impact of parallel trade on innovation in R&D-intensive industries, such as pharmaceuticals, is a hotly debated question in antitrust and IP policy. The well-known argument that parallel trade dampens innovation by undermining firms' ability to price discriminate has been challenged by recent literature. The argument is that with endogenous price controls, parallel trade increases innovation by reducing governments' incentives to set particularly low price caps. In this paper, we show that this result crucially depends on the degree of homogeneity of the trading countries. The result only holds if consumers in poorer countries have a relatively similar demand for medication as consumers in richer countries. Instead, when countries are relatively heterogeneous, parallel trade dampens innovation and lowers welfare by exporting price cap regulation from poorer to richer countries. These findings are in line with recent case evidence. We also show that when patent length is endogenous, richer countries will tend to choose longer patent protection with parallel trade, whereas equilibrium price caps tend to be tighter in that case.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.05.002.abstractZh: 平行贸易对研发密集型行业（如制药业）创新的影响，是反垄断和知识产权政策中一个备受争议的问题。一种常见的观点认为，平行贸易通过削弱企业定价歧视的能力来抑制创新，但最近的文献对这一观点提出了质疑。新的研究表明，在价格控制机制内在化的情况下，平行贸易实际上会促进创新，因为政府设定较低价格上限的动机会减弱。本文指出，这一结果在很大程度上取决于贸易国家之间的同质化程度。只有当较贫穷国家的消费者对药品的需求与富裕国家的消费者需求相对相似时，这一结论才成立。相反，当各国之间存在较大差异时，平行贸易会抑制创新并降低福利，因为价格上限的管制会从较贫穷国家转移到富裕国家。这些发现与最近的案例研究一致。我们还发现，当专利期限具有内生性时，富裕国家倾向于选择更长的专利保护期限，而均衡价格上限在这种情况下通常会更加严格。

abstract.text: Teenagers under 18 could legally purchase e-cigarettes until states passed minimum legal sale age laws. These laws may have curtailed teenagers' use of e-cigarettes for smoking cessation. We investigate the effect of e-cigarette minimum legal sale age laws on prenatal cigarette smoking and birth outcomes for underage rural teenagers using data on all births from 2010 to 2016 from 32 states. We find that the laws increased prenatal smoking by 0.6 percentage points (pp) overall. These effects were concentrated in prepregnancy smokers, with no effect on prepregnancy non-smokers. These results suggest that the laws reduced cigarette smoking cessation during pregnancy rather than causing new cigarette smoking initiation. Our results may indicate an unmet need for assistance with smoking cessation among pregnant teenagers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.05.003.abstractZh: 在18岁以下青少年可以合法购买电子香烟，直到各州通过最低合法销售年龄法律。这些法律可能限制了青少年为了戒烟而使用电子香烟的行为。我们利用2010年至2016年间32个州的所有出生数据，研究了电子香烟最低合法销售年龄法律对农村未成年青少年孕期吸烟和出生结果的影响。研究发现，这些法律总体上使孕期吸烟率增加了0.6个百分点。这些影响主要集中在孕期前的吸烟者身上，而对孕期前的非吸烟者没有影响。这些结果表明，这些法律减少了青少年在孕期戒烟的行为，而不是导致新的吸烟行为出现。我们的研究结果可能表明，孕妇青少年在戒烟方面存在未被满足的需求。

abstract.text: Insurance companies can respond to increases in expected per-capita healthcare expenditures by adjusting premiums, cost-sharing requirements, and/or plan generosity. We use a Difference-in-Difference model with Plan-level Fixed Effects to estimate the impacts of increases in expected expenditures generated by closure of state-operated High Risk Pools (HRPs). For Silver plans, we find that issuers responded to HRP closures by increasing both premiums and deductibles, and by increasing the ratios of premiums to deductibles. This adjustment to the structure of plan prices is consistent with the hypothesis that issuers will be reluctant to adjust deductibles, because consumers tend to overweight changes in deductibles over changes in premiums. The increase in the ratio of premiums to deductibles indicates that the increase in expected expenditures triggered an increase in the share of total risk-pool healthcare expenditures paid by low healthcare utilizers, and a decrease in the share paid by high utilizers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.05.004.abstractZh: 保险公司可以通过调整保费、费用分担要求以及保险计划的福利水平来应对预期人均医疗支出的增加。我们使用带有计划层面固定效应的差异分解模型，来估算由于关闭州运营的高风险保险池而导致的预期支出增加所带来的影响。对于银牌计划，我们发现保险公司通过提高保费和免赔额，以及提高保费与免赔额的比例来应对高风险保险池的关闭。这种对计划价格结构的调整与假设一致，即保险公司不愿调整免赔额，因为消费者往往更关注免赔额的变化而非保费的变化。保费与免赔额比例的增加表明，预期支出的增加导致低风险用户支付的整体风险池医疗支出比例上升，而高使用率用户支付的份额则下降。

abstract.text: The conventional method for developing health care plan payment systems uses observed data to study alternative algorithms and set incentives for the health care system. In this paper, we take a different approach and transform the input data rather than the algorithm, so that the data used reflect the desired spending levels rather than the observed spending levels. We present a general economic model that incorporates the previously overlooked two-way relationship between health plan payment and insurer actions. We then demonstrate our systematic approach for data transformations in two Medicare applications: underprovision of care for individuals with chronic illnesses and health care disparities by geographic income levels. Empirically comparing our method to two other common approaches shows that the "side effects" of these approaches vary by context, and that data transformation is an effective tool for addressing misallocations in individual health insurance markets.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.05.005.abstractZh: 传统的医疗保健计划支付系统开发方法是通过观察数据来研究不同的算法，并为医疗保健系统设定激励措施。在本文中，我们采取了不同的方法，对输入数据进行转换，而不是对算法进行转换，这样使用的数据能够反映期望的支出水平，而不是实际观察到的支出水平。我们提出了一个通用的经济模型，该模型包含了之前被忽视的医疗保健计划支付与保险公司行为之间的双向关系。随后，我们展示了在两种Medicare应用中，我们的数据转换方法的有效性：针对慢性病患者护理不足的问题，以及因地理收入水平导致的医疗保健差异问题。通过实证比较我们的方法与另外两种常见方法，我们发现这些方法的“副作用”因情境而异，而数据转换是一种有效的工具，可用于解决个人健康保险市场中的资源配置问题。

abstract.text: California's paid family leave (PFL) policy improved mothers' labor market outcomes, however, the health impacts of this program are less studied. I compare child and parental health of likely eligible households to a series of control groups before and after California's PFL program was implemented. I find improvements in parent-reported overall child health and suggestive improvements in maternal mental health status. Findings also suggest a reduction in asthma and a greater likelihood that parents feel they are coping well with the day-to-day demands of parenting. There are no significant effects on respiratory or food allergies, or father's mental health status. The results are robust to multiple control groups and placebo tests.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.05.006.abstractZh: 加利福尼亚州的带薪家庭休假政策改善了母亲在劳动力市场中的表现，然而，该计划对健康的影響研究较少。我將可能符合條件的家庭在加利福尼亚州实施带薪家庭休假政策前后的儿童和父母健康状况与一系列对照组进行了比较。我发现父母报告的儿童整体健康状况有所改善，母亲的心理健康状况也有改善的迹象。研究还表明，哮喘的发病率有所下降，父母感觉自己能够很好地应对育儿的日常需求的可能性也增加了。然而，该政策对呼吸道或食物过敏问题，以及父亲的健康状况没有显著影响。这些结果在多个对照组和安慰剂测试中都是稳健的。

abstract.text: Competition among physicians is widespread, but compelling empirical evidence on its impact on service provision is limited, mainly due to endogeneity issues. In this paper we exploit that many GPs, in addition to own practice, work in local emergency centres, where the matching of patients to GPs is random. The same GP is observed both with competition (own practice) and without (emergency centre). Using high-dimensional fixed-effect models, we find that GPs with a fee-for-service (fixed-salary) contract are 12 (8) percentage points more likely to certify sick leave at own practice than at the emergency centre. Thus, competition has a positive impact on GPs' sicklisting that is strongly reinforced by financial incentives.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.05.007.abstractZh: 医生之间的竞争普遍存在，但关于其对医疗服务提供影响的实证证据却十分有限，主要由于内生性问题。在本文中，我们利用了这样一个事实：许多全科医生除了自己的诊所外，还在当地的急诊中心工作，因此患者与全科医生的匹配是随机的。同一位全科医生在存在竞争的情况下（自己的诊所）和没有竞争的情况下（急诊中心）的表现被观察到。通过高维固定效应模型分析，我们发现采用按服务收费（固定工资）合同的全科医生，在自己诊所申请病假的可能性比在急诊中心高12%（8%）。因此，竞争对全科医生的病假申请有积极影响，而这种影响又因财务激励而得到加强。

abstract.text: Report cards on provider performance are intended to improve consumer decision-making and address information gaps in the market for quality. However, inadequate risk adjustment of report-card measures often biases comparisons across providers. We test whether going to a skilled nursing facility (SNF) with a higher star rating leads to better quality outcomes for a patient. We exploit variation over time in the distance from a patient's residential ZIP code to SNFs with different ratings to estimate the causal effect of admission to a higher-rated SNF on health care outcomes, including mortality. We found that patients who go to higher-rated SNFs achieved better outcomes, supporting the validity of the SNF report card ratings.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.05.008.abstractZh: 提供商的绩效评估报告旨在帮助消费者做出更明智的决策，并填补市场上关于质量信息的空白。然而，报告指标的风险调整不足常常会导致不同提供商之间的比较出现偏差。我们研究了选择星级较高的护理机构是否能为患者带来更好的医疗效果。我们通过分析患者居住地邮政编码与不同星级护理机构之间的距离随时间的变化，来估算进入星级较高的护理机构对医疗效果的影响，包括死亡率。研究发现，选择星级较高的护理机构的患者获得了更好的医疗效果，这支持了护理机构评级的有效性。

abstract.text: This paper examines the determinants of parental decisions about infant immunization. Using the exact timing of vaccination relative to birth, we estimate the effects of local pertussis outbreaks occurring in utero and during the first two months of life on the likelihood of on-time initial immunization for pertussis and other diseases. We find that parents respond to changes in perceived disease risk: pertussis outbreaks within a state increase the rate of on-time receipt of the pertussis vaccine at two months of age, particularly among low-socioeconomic status (SES) subgroups. In addition, we find that pertussis outbreaks increase the likelihood of immunization against other vaccine-preventable diseases. Spillover effects in low-SES subgroups are as large as direct effects and are present only for vaccines given during the same visit as the pertussis vaccine, which suggests that provider contact may be a key factor in infant vaccination decisions in poor families.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.05.009.abstractZh: 本文探讨了父母在婴儿免疫接种方面的决策因素。通过研究疫苗接种时间与出生时间的相对关系，我们估算了子宫内及婴儿出生后的前两个月内 pertussis疫情对婴儿及时接种pertussis疫苗及其他疾病疫苗的影响。研究发现，父母会对感知到的疾病风险作出反应：一个州内的pertussis疫情会提高两个月大婴儿及时接种pertussis疫苗的比例，尤其是在低社会经济地位（SES）的群体中。此外，我们还发现，pertussis疫情会增加婴儿接种其他可预防疾病疫苗的可能性。在低社会经济地位群体中，这种溢出效应与直接效应相当，且仅发生在与pertussis疫苗在同一次接种过程中接种的其他疫苗，这表明医疗服务提供者与婴儿的接触可能是贫困家庭婴儿疫苗接种决策的关键因素。

abstract.text: This study contributes to the literature on the capacity challenges faced by health care providers after insurance expansions by examining the Affordable Care Act (ACA) and ambulance response times. Exploiting temporal and geographic variation in the implementation of the ACA as well as pre-treatment differences in uninsured rates, we estimate that the expansions of private and Medicaid coverage under the ACA combined to slow ambulance response times by an average of 24%. We conclude that, through extending coverage to individuals who, in its absence, would not have availed themselves of emergency medical services, the ACA added strain to emergency response systems.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.05.010.abstractZh: 本研究通过考察《平价医疗法案》和救护车响应时间，为关于保险扩展后医疗保健提供者所面临的能力挑战的文献做出了贡献。利用《平价医疗法案》实施过程中的时间和地理差异，以及治疗前无保险人群的比例差异，我们估计，在《平价医疗法案》下，私人和医疗补助覆盖范围的扩大使救护车响应时间平均减缓了24%。我们得出结论，通过为那些在没有《平价医疗法案》的情况下不会寻求紧急医疗服务的个体提供覆盖，该法案给紧急响应系统带来了额外的负担。

abstract.text: Price transparency initiatives have recently emerged as a solution to the lack of health care price information available to consumers. This paper uses the staggered and nationwide diffusion of a leading internet-based price transparency platform to estimate the effects of price transparency on provider prices. I find a 1-4% reduction in provider prices for homogenous services, laboratory tests, but find no price response for differentiated services, office visits. Price responses are driven by active consumer use of price information. This paper demonstrates how reducing consumer search costs can spur limited firm price competition in health care markets.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.06.001.abstractZh: 近期，价格透明度倡议被视作解决消费者无法获取医疗价格信息这一问题的方案。本文通过分析一家领先的互联网价格透明度平台的分阶段全国推广情况，来评估价格透明度对医疗服务价格的影响。研究发现，对于同类服务、如实验室检测，价格透明度可使医疗服务价格降低1-4%；而对于差异化的服务，如门诊就诊，则未发现价格变化。价格反应受到消费者主动使用价格信息的影响。本文表明，降低消费者的搜索成本能够促进医疗市场中有限的企业价格竞争。

abstract.text: Studies examining the introduction of pictorial warnings on cigarette packages provide inconclusive evidence due to small samples and methodological issues. We use individual-level panel data from Australia to examine the association between pictorial warnings and smoking behaviour - prevalence, quitting, initiating and relapsing. The pictorial warnings were accompanied by a reference to a smoking cessation helpline and supportive television commercials. Applying an event study framework, we show that the reform reduced smoking rates by around 4% within the first year of the policy. The effect decreases with age, is similar for men and women, and is slightly larger for low-educated compared to high-educated individuals. The reform permanently lowered smoking rates primarily due to increased quitting in the year of the reform. Thus, pictorial warnings combined with a reference to a smoking cessation helpline and supportive media campaigns are an important tobacco control measure to reduce the social costs of smoking.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.06.002.abstractZh: 关于在香烟包装上引入图片警告的研究因样本量小和方法论问题而未能得出明确结论。我们利用澳大利亚的个体级面板数据来研究图片警告与吸烟行为之间的关联——包括吸烟率、戒烟行为、开始吸烟以及复吸情况。图片警告还附带了关于戒烟热线的信息以及支持性的电视广告。通过事件研究框架分析，我们发现该改革在政策实施的第一年内使吸烟率降低了约4%。这一效果随年龄增长而减弱，男女之间的差异不大，且受教育程度较低的人群比受教育程度较高的人群吸烟率下降幅度略大。该改革之所以能永久降低吸烟率，主要是因为改革当年戒烟的人数有所增加。因此，结合图片警告、戒烟热线信息以及支持性媒体宣传，是减少吸烟社会成本的重要烟草控制措施。

abstract.text: A fundamental question in health insurance markets is how do health care consumers dynamically optimize their medical utilization under non-linear insurance contracts? Our paper tests the neoclassical prediction that a fully forward-looking agent only responds to their expected end-of-year price. Our unique identification strategy studies families during the year of childbirth who will likely satisfy their annual deductible, thereby knowing their expected end-of-year price. We find that during the year of a childbirth, fathers increase medical spending by 11% per month after their deductible is satisfied, rejecting the null of fully forward-looking consumers. This behavior cannot be explained by fathers increasing utilization in response to the childbirth itself. Furthermore, this myopia translates to a 21-24% decrease in total annual medical spending, relative to the counterfactual of fully forward-looking behavior, and is concentrated in elective procedures; we find no response in low value or urgent care. Our findings suggest the need for modeling non-linear incentives while accounting for myopic behavior when studying the medical utilization responses to health insurance.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.06.003.abstractZh: 在健康保险市场中，一个基本问题是：在非线性保险合同下，医疗消费者如何动态优化其医疗支出？我们的论文检验了新古典主义预测，即完全具有前瞻性意识的消费者只会根据他们预期的年末价格做出反应。我们独特的识别策略研究了在分娩当年需要支付年度免赔金的家庭，这些家庭因此能够知道他们预期的年末价格。我们发现，在分娩当年，父亲在满足免赔金要求后，每月的医疗支出增加了11%，这反驳了完全具有前瞻性意识的消费者的假设。这种行为不能解释为父亲因分娩本身而增加医疗支出。此外，这种短视行为导致年度总医疗支出比完全具有前瞻性意识的消费者减少了21-24%，且这种减少主要集中在选择性手术上；而在低价值或紧急护理方面则没有类似变化。我们的研究结果表明，在研究医疗支出对健康保险的反应时，需要建模非线性激励因素，并考虑短视行为的影响。

abstract.text: Intergenerational transmission of human capital from parents to offspring is widely documented. However, whether there are upward spillovers from children to parents remains understudied. This paper uses data from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study to estimate the causal impact of educational attainment of children on various health and cognition outcomes of older parents. Identification is achieved by using the exposure of children to the compulsory education law in China and its interaction with local schooling level before law enforcement as instruments for children's years of schooling. IV estimation results demonstrate that increasing years of education of children lead to better cognitive functions, higher survival expectations and improved lung function of Chinese older parents. Further evidence suggests that children's education might shape health of older parents by providing financial support, affecting the access to resources and influencing the labor supply and psychological well-being of parents.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.06.004.abstractZh: 关于人力资本从父母传递给后代的现象已有大量研究。然而，子女对父母是否存在向上溢出效应仍未被充分研究。本文利用中国健康与退休纵向研究的数据，估算了子女教育水平对年长父母各项健康与认知结果的影响。通过利用子女是否受到中国义务教育法的约束以及该法律实施前当地教育水平的交互作用作为子女受教育年限的衡量指标，实现了研究变量的识别。实证结果表明，子女受教育年限的增加有助于提升年长父母的认知功能、提高生存预期并改善肺功能。进一步的证据表明，子女的教育可能通过提供经济支持、影响资源获取、以及影响父母的劳动力供给和心理健康来塑造年长父母的健康状况。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic model of hospital competition where (i) waiting times increase if demand exceeds supply; (ii) patients choose a hospital based in part on waiting times; and (iii) hospitals incur waiting time penalties. We show that, whereas policies based on penalties will lead to lower waiting times, policies that promote patient choice will instead lead to higher waiting times. These results are robust to different game-theoretic solution concepts, designs of the hospital penalty structure, and patient utility specifications. Furthermore, waiting time penalties are likely to be more effective in reducing waiting times if they are designed with a linear penalty structure, but the counterproductive effect of patient choice policies is smaller when penalties are convex. These conclusions are partly derived by calibration of our model based on waiting times and elasticities observed in the English NHS for a common treatment (cataract surgery).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.06.005.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个医院竞争的动态模型，其中：(i) 如果需求超过供应，等待时间会增加；(ii) 患者选择医院时部分依据等待时间；(iii) 医院会面临等待时间惩罚。我们表明，基于惩罚的政策虽然能降低等待时间，但促进患者选择的政策反而会导致更长的等待时间。这些结果在不同博弈论解决方案、医院惩罚结构设计以及患者效用规范下仍然成立。此外，如果惩罚结构采用线性形式，等待时间惩罚在减少等待时间方面可能更为有效；而当惩罚呈凸形时，患者选择政策的反效果则会减小。这些结论部分是通过基于等待时间和英国国民医疗服务体系常见治疗（白内障手术）的弹性数据对模型进行校准得出的。

abstract.text: Transactional sex is an important risk-coping mechanism and a leading contributor to the HIV/AIDS epidemic in sub-Saharan Africa. We use data from a conditional cash transfer (CCT) experiment in rural Tanzania designed to incentivize safer sexual behavior by conditioning transfers on testing negative for sexually transmitted infections (STIs). For women, we find that negative shocks measured by food insecurity lead to a 36% increase in STIs and increases in self-reported risky sexual behavior. We find no significant effects of negative shocks on either STIs or self-reported sexual behavior for men. This CCT design did not appear to mitigate the behavioral response to shocks that we document in women. We propose that this finding can be explained by binding credit constraints and the relatively infrequent timing of the CCTs. When women experience a negative shock, cash needs are immediate, while transfers linked to a CCT are paid out in a specific point in time. If women are unable to access credit during a shock, they may resort to transactional sex even if they face monetary incentives to do otherwise.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.06.006.abstractZh: 交易性性行为是撒哈拉以南非洲地区HIV/AIDS疫情的重要风险应对机制之一。我们利用了坦桑尼亚农村一项条件性现金转移实验的数据，该实验旨在通过以性传播感染检测结果为条件来激励更安全的性行为。研究发现，对于女性而言，因食物不安全导致的负面冲击会导致性传播感染率增加36%，以及自我报告的冒险性行为增加。而对于男性来说，负面冲击对性传播感染率或自我报告的性行为则没有显著影响。这项现金转移实验的设计似乎未能缓解我们在女性身上观察到的行为反应。我们认为，这一发现可以归因于信用约束的约束效应，以及现金转移相对不频繁的时间安排。当女性面临负面冲击时，现金需求是即时的，而与现金转移相关的资金则是在特定时间点支付的。如果女性在冲击期间无法获得信用支持，她们可能会选择交易性性行为，即使这样做会面临金钱上的激励。

abstract.text: Reform of the Chinese State-Owned Enterprise (SOE) sector in the late 1990s triggered massive layoffs (34 million employees) and marked the end of the "Iron Rice Bowl" guarantee of employment security for the remaining 67 million workers. An expanding international literature has documented the adverse health impacts of economic insecurity on adults, but has typically neglected children. This paper uses the natural experiment of SOE reform to explore the causal relationship between increased parental economic insecurity and children's BMI Z-score. Using province-year-level layoff rates and income loss from the layoffs, we estimate a generalised difference-in-differences model with child fixed effects and year fixed effects. For a medium-build 10-year-old boy, a median treatment effect implies a gain of 1.8 kg and a 2.2-percentage-point increase in the overweight rate due to the reform. Anxiety about potential losses causes weight gain for boys whose SOE parents kept their jobs. Unconditional quantile regressions suggest that boys who are heavier are more likely to gain weight. Girls are not significantly affected. Intergenerational effects therefore increase the estimated public health costs of greater economic insecurity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.06.007.abstractZh: 1990年代末对中国国有企业部门的改革引发了大规模裁员（3400万员工），这标志着为剩余的6700万工人提供的“铁饭碗”就业保障的终结。越来越多的国际文献记录了经济不稳定性对成年人健康的负面影响，但通常忽视了儿童的影响。本文利用国有企业改革这一自然实验，探讨父母经济不稳定性增加与儿童体质指数得分之间的因果关系。通过以省份和年份为单位的裁员率和因裁员导致的收入损失数据，我们建立了一个包含儿童固定效应和年份固定效应的广义差异模型。对于中等体型、10岁左右的男孩来说，中位处理效应意味着体重增加了1.8公斤，超重率上升了2.2个百分点。对于那些国有企业员工继续工作的男孩来说，对潜在损失的担忧导致了体重的增加。无条件分位数回归表明，体重较重的男孩更有可能继续增重。女孩则没有受到显著影响。因此，代际效应增加了经济不稳定性加剧所带来的公共健康成本。

abstract.text: This paper builds and estimates a dynamic choice model to examine the impact on health insurance selection of Chile's GES health care reform. This program provides guarantees in coverage and benefits to several health conditions in the context of a market where public and private health insurers co-exist. Structural differences in premiums, benefits and out-of-pocket medical costs across systems may have caused adverse selection problems. Restrictions on pre-existing conditions in the private system mean that insurance selection could be a dynamic process in which current choices can affect future health insurance selection. In fact, estimation results suggest there is willingness to pay to have access to private insurance to those affected by pre-existing conditions. The GES reform may have also altered health insurance choices, as it seems to have significantly reduced out-of-pocket medical costs to people affected by the covered illnesses. Simulations show an increase in participation in the public system of about 3.8 percentage points due to the reform, which is stronger for younger, healthier and more educated individuals. Therefore, the reform may have eased adverse selection problems in Chile's health care system by drawing low-risk individuals towards the public system.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.07.001.abstractZh: 本文构建并估计了一个动态选择模型，以研究智利GES医疗改革对健康保险选择的影响。该计划为多种健康状况提供覆盖和福利保障，而市场中存在公共和私人健康保险公司的竞争。不同体系在保费、福利和自付医疗费用方面的结构性差异可能导致了逆向选择问题。私人体系对既往病史的限制意味着保险选择可能是一个动态过程，当前的选择会影响未来的健康保险选择。事实上，估计结果显示，那些受既往病史影响的人愿意支付费用以获得私人保险。GES改革还可能改变了健康保险的选择，因为它似乎显著降低了受覆盖疾病影响者的自付医疗费用。模拟结果显示，由于改革，公共体系的参与率增加了约3.8个百分点，这一影响在年轻、健康且受教育程度较高的群体中更为明显。因此，改革可能通过吸引低风险个体进入公共体系，缓解了智利医疗系统中的逆向选择问题。

abstract.text: Contracts between health insurers and providers are private. By modelling this explicitly, we find the following. Insurers with bigger provider networks, pay providers higher fee-for-service rates. This makes it more likely that a patient is treated and hence health care costs and utilization increase with provider network size. Although providers are homogeneous, the welfare maximizing provider network can consist of two or more providers. Provider profits are positive whereas they would be zero with public contracts. Increasing transparency of provider prices increases welfare only if consumers can "mentally process" the prices of all treatments involved in an insurance contract. If not, it tends to reduce welfare.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102222.abstractZh: 健康保险公司与医疗服务提供者之间的合同属于私人性质。通过明确建模，我们发现以下现象：拥有更大医疗服务网络的公司会向提供者支付更高的按服务收费率。这使得患者接受治疗的几率增加，从而导致医疗成本和利用率上升。尽管医疗服务提供者具有同质性，但能够最大化福利的医疗服务网络可以由两个或更多的提供者组成。提供者的利润是正值，而在公共合同中则为零。只有当消费者能够“心理处理”保险合同中涉及的所有治疗的价格时，提高提供者价格的透明度才能提升福利。否则，这种做法往往会降低福利。

abstract.text: We develop a theoretical analysis of two widely used regulations of genetic tests, Disclosure Duty and Consent Law, and we run an experiment in order to shed light on both the take-up rate of genetic testing and on the comparison of policyholders' welfare under the two regulations. Disclosure duty forces individuals to reveal their test results to insurers, exposing them to a discrimination risk. Consent Law allows them to hide any detrimental information, resulting in adverse selection. The experiment results in much lower genetic tests take-up rates with Disclosure Duty than with Consent Law, showing that subjects are very sensitive to the discrimination risk. Under Consent Law, take-up rates increase with the adverse selection intensity. A decrease in the test cost, and in adverse selection intensity, both make it more likely that Consent Law is preferred to Disclosure Duty.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102223.abstractZh: 我们对两种广泛使用的基因检测监管制度进行了理论分析，分别是披露义务和同意法。为了探究这两种监管制度下基因检测的接受率以及政策受惠者的福利差异，我们开展了一项实验。披露义务要求个人向保险公司透露检测结果，这使他们面临歧视风险。而同意法则允许个人隐藏任何不利信息，从而导致逆向选择现象。实验结果显示，采用披露义务时，基因检测的接受率远低于采用同意法时，这表明人们非常敏感于歧视风险。在同意法下，随着逆向选择程度的增加，基因检测的接受率也会上升。同时，如果降低检测成本并减少逆向选择程度，则更有可能选择同意法而非披露义务。

abstract.text: Females live a lot longer than males in most parts of the world today. But that was not always the case. We ask when and why the female advantage emerged. We show that reductions in maternal mortality and fertility are only partial reasons. Rather, the sharp reduction in infectious disease in the early twentieth century played a role. Those who survive most infectious diseases carry a health burden that affects organs and impacts general well-being. We use newly collected data from Massachusetts containing information on cause of death since 1887 to show that females between the ages of 5 and 25 were disproportionately affected by infectious diseases. Both males and females lived longer as the burden of infectious disease fell, but women were more greatly impacted. Our explanation does not tell us precisely why women live longer than men, but it does help understand the timing of their relative increase.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102224.abstractZh: 在当今世界的许多地区，女性的寿命普遍比男性长。但这种情况并非一直如此。我们探讨了女性寿命优势出现的时间和原因。我们发现，降低孕产妇死亡率和生育率只是部分原因。实际上，20世纪初传染病的大幅减少起到了重要作用。那些在传染病中存活下来的人，会承受着影响器官健康并损害整体健康的健康负担。我们利用自1887年以来马萨诸塞州死亡原因数据的新收集资料，发现5至25岁的女性受到传染病的严重影响。随着传染病负担的减轻，男女的寿命都有所延长，但女性的影响更为显著。我们的解释并不能确切说明为什么女性的寿命比男性长，但它有助于理解女性寿命相对增加的时机。

abstract.text: Numerous U.S. cities have recently enacted taxes on sweetened beverages. To examine the effects of the beverage tax of 1.5 cents per ounce in Philadelphia, we surveyed adults and children in Philadelphia and nearby comparison communities both before the tax and nearly one year after implementation. We find that the tax reduced purchases in Philadelphia stores and that Philadelphia residents increased purchases of taxed beverages outside of the city. The tax reduced the frequency of adults' soda consumption by 31 percent, but had no detectable impacts on adults' consumption of other beverages. The tax had no detectable impact on children's consumption of soda or all taxed beverages, although children who were frequent consumers prior to the tax reduced their consumption after the tax.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102225.abstractZh: 许多美国城市最近实施了甜饮料税。为了研究费城每盎司1.5美分的饮料税的影响，我们对费城及附近地区的成人和儿童进行了调查，时间跨度从税实施前到实施近一年后。研究发现，该税减少了费城商店中甜饮料的购买量，而费城居民在城外购买了更多受税影响的饮料。该税使成人饮用苏打水的频率减少了31%，但对成人其他饮料的消费没有显著影响。该税对儿童饮用苏打水或所有受税影响的饮料都没有显著影响，不过在税实施前经常饮用饮料的儿童在税实施后减少了消费。

abstract.text: We study a pay-for-efficiency scheme that encourages hospitals to admit and discharge patients on the same calendar day when clinically appropriate. Since 2010, hospitals in the English NHS are incentivised by a higher price for patients treated as same-day discharge than for overnight stays, despite the former being less costly. We analyse administrative data for patients treated during 2006-2014 for 191 conditions for which same-day discharge is clinically appropriate - of which 32 are incentivised. Using difference-in-difference and synthetic control methods, we find that the policy had generally a positive impact with a statistically significant effect in 14 out of the 32 conditions. The median elasticity is 0.24 for planned and 0.01 for emergency conditions. Condition-specific design features explain some, but not all, of the differential responses.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102226.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种以效率为奖励的支付方案，该方案鼓励医院在临床条件允许的情况下，在同一日历日进行患者的入院和出院操作。自2010年以来，英国国家医疗服务体系中的医院通过提高当日出院患者的收费来激励医院进行此类操作，尽管当日出院的成本更低。我们分析了2006至2014年间，针对191种临床条件允许当日出院的病症患者的行政数据，其中32种病症受到该政策的激励。通过差异分解法和合成控制法分析发现，该政策总体上产生了积极的影响，在32种病症中，有14种病症的效应具有统计学意义。对于计划性出院和紧急出院这两种情况，中位弹性分别为0.24和0.01。特定病症的设计特点解释了部分差异，但并非全部差异的原因。

abstract.text: We provide the first causal evidence on whether e-cigarette advertising on television and in magazines encourages adult smokers to quit. We find the answer to be yes for TV advertising but no for magazine advertising. Our results indicate that a policy banning TV advertising of e-cigs would have reduced the number of smokers who quit in the recent past by approximately 3%. If the FDA were not considering regulations and mandates, e-cig ads might have reached the number of nicotine replacement therapy TV ads during that period. That would have increased the number of smokers who quit by around 10%.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102227.abstractZh: 我们首次提供了关于电子香烟广告在电视和杂志上的传播是否有助于促使成年吸烟者戒烟的因果证据。研究发现，电视广告确实有助于戒烟，而杂志广告则没有这种效果。我们的结果显示，如果禁止电视上播放电子香烟广告，近期戒烟的吸烟者数量可能会减少约3%。如果美国食品药品监督管理局不出台相关法规，电子香烟广告的数量可能会与尼古丁替代疗法的广告相当，这样戒烟的吸烟者数量可能会增加约10%。

abstract.text: Innovations in cancer treatment have lowered mortality, but little is known about their economic benefits. We assess the effect of two decades of improvement in cancer treatment options on the labor market outcomes of breast and prostate cancer patients. In addition, we compare this effect across cancer patients with different levels of educational attainment. We estimate the effect of medical innovation on cancer patients' labor market outcomes employing tax return and cancer registry data from Canada and measuring medical innovation by using the number of approved drugs and a quality-adjusted patent index. We find that innovations in cancer treatment during the 1990s and 2000s reduced the negative employment effects of cancer by 63% to 70%, corresponding to a reduction in the economic costs of prostate and breast cancer diagnoses by 13,500 and 5800 dollars per year, respectively. The benefits of medical innovation are limited to cancer patients with postsecondary education.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102228.abstractZh: 癌症治疗领域的创新降低了死亡率，但对其经济效益的了解却相对较少。我们评估了二十年来癌症治疗方法的改进对乳腺癌和前列腺癌患者劳动力市场结果的影响。此外，我们还比较了不同教育水平的患者所受的影响。我们通过使用加拿大的纳税申报表和癌症登记数据，并利用批准药物的数量和质量调整专利指数来衡量医疗创新的影响，从而估算医疗创新对癌症患者劳动力市场结果的影响。研究发现，20世纪90年代和21世纪初癌症治疗领域的创新将癌症带来的负面就业影响减少了63%至70%，这意味着前列腺癌和乳腺癌诊断的经济成本分别每年减少了13,500美元和5800美元。医疗创新的好处仅限于接受过高等教育的癌症患者。

abstract.text: We study patient choice of healthcare provider based on both objective and subjective quality measures in the context of maternal care hospital services in Germany. Objective measures are obtained from publicly reported clinical indicators, while subjective measures are based on satisfaction scores from a large and nationwide patient survey. We merge both quality metrics to detailed hospital discharge records and quantify the additional distance expectant mothers are willing to travel to give birth in maternity clinics with higher reported quality. Our results reveal that patients are on average willing to travel 0.1-2.7 additional kilometers for a one standard deviation increase in quality. Patients respond to both objective and subjective quality measures, suggesting that patient satisfaction scores may constitute important complements to clinical indicators when choosing provider.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102229.abstractZh: 我们研究了德国孕产妇护理医院服务背景下，患者基于客观和主观质量指标对医疗服务提供者的选择行为。客观指标来源于公开报道的临床指标，而主观指标则基于大规模全国性患者调查中的满意度评分。我们将这两种质量指标与详细的医院出院记录相结合，量化了孕妇为获得更高质量的服务而愿意额外行走的距离。研究结果表明，患者平均愿意为质量提升一个标准差而额外行走0.1至2.7公里。患者对客观和主观质量指标都有积极反应，这表明在选择医疗服务提供者时，患者满意度评分可能是临床指标的重要补充。

abstract.text: A large literature points out that exposure to criminal victimization has far-reaching effects on public health. What remains surprisingly unexplored is that role that health shocks play in explaining aggregate fluctuations in offending. This research finds novel evidence that crime is sensitive to health shocks. We consider the responsiveness of crime to a pervasive and common health shock which we argue shifts costs and benefits for offenders and victims: seasonal allergies. Leveraging daily variation in city-specific pollen counts, we present evidence that violent crime declines in U.S. cities on days in which the local pollen count is unusually high and that these effects are driven by residential violence. While past literature suggests that property crimes have more instrumental motives, require planning, and hence are particularly sensitive to permanent changes in the cost and benefits of crime, we find that violence may be especially sensitive to health shocks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102230.abstractZh: 大量文献指出，遭受犯罪侵害对公共健康有着深远的影响。然而，鲜有研究探讨健康冲击在解释犯罪总量波动中的作用。本研究发现了新的证据，表明犯罪对健康冲击非常敏感。我们研究了一种普遍存在的健康冲击对犯罪行为的影響，我们认为这种冲击会改变犯罪者和受害者的成本和收益：季节性过敏。通过利用城市特定花粉浓度的日变化数据，我们发现美国城市中的暴力犯罪在花粉浓度异常高的日子里会下降，而这些影响主要由家庭暴力所驱动。虽然以往的研究表明财产犯罪具有更明确的动机，需要更多的计划，因此对犯罪成本和收益的永久性变化更为敏感，但我们发现暴力行为可能对健康冲击更为敏感。

abstract.text: The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP, formerly food stamps) is one of the most important elements of the social safety net. Unlike most other safety net programs, SNAP varies little across states and over time, which creates challenges for quasi-experimental evaluation. Notably, SNAP benefits are fixed across 48 states; but local food prices vary, leading to geographic variation in the real value - or purchasing power - of SNAP benefits. In this study, we provide the first estimates that leverage variation in SNAP purchasing power across markets to examine effects of SNAP on child health. We link panel data on regional food prices to National Health Interview Survey data and use a fixed effects framework to estimate the relationship between local purchasing power of SNAP and children's health and health care utilization. We find that lower SNAP purchasing power leads to lower utilization of preventive health care and more days of school missed due to illness. We estimate no effect on parent-reported health status.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102231.abstractZh: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP，以前称为食品券）是社会安全网中最重要的组成部分之一。与大多数其他安全网计划不同，SNAP在各州以及时间上的变化幅度很小，这给准实验评估带来了挑战。值得注意的是，SNAP福利在48个州都是固定的；但当地食品价格会有所不同，导致SNAP福利的实际价值或购买力存在地域差异。在这项研究中，我们首次利用SNAP购买力在不同市场中的差异来研究SNAP对儿童健康的影响。我们将区域食品价格的数据与国家健康访谈调查数据联系起来，并使用固定效应框架来估计SNAP的当地购买力与儿童健康和医疗利用之间的关系。我们发现，较低的SNAP购买力会导致预防性医疗保健的利用减少，以及因疾病而缺课的天数增加。我们并未发现SNAP对父母报告的健康状况有影响。
