abstract.text: This paper characterizes the link between ambient temperatures and a broad set of mental health outcomes. We find that higher temperatures increase emergency department visits for mental illness, suicides, and self-reported days of poor mental health. Specifically, cold temperatures reduce negative mental health outcomes while hot temperatures increase them. Our estimates reveal no evidence of adaptation, instead the temperature relationship is stable across time, baseline climate, air conditioning penetration rates, accessibility of mental health services, and other factors. The character of the results suggests that temperature affects mental health very differently than physical health, and more similarly to other psychological and behavioral outcomes. We provide suggestive evidence for sleep disruption as an active mechanism behind our results and discuss the implications of our findings for the allocation of mental health services and in light of climate change.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102240.abstractZh: 本文探讨了环境温度与一系列心理健康结果之间的关联。研究发现，较高的环境温度会增加因精神疾病、自杀以及自我报告的心理健康状况不佳而前往急诊室的次数。具体而言，寒冷的温度会减轻负面的心理健康影响，而高温则会增加这些影响。我们的估计结果显示，这种温度与心理健康状况之间的关系并未表现出适应性变化，而是随时间、基线气候条件、空调普及率、心理健康服务的可及性等因素保持稳定。研究结果表明，温度对心理健康的影响与对身体健康的影响不同，与其他心理和行为结果的关系更为密切。我们还提出了睡眠中断可能是导致这些结果的一个活跃机制的观点，并讨论了我们的发现对心理健康服务分配以及应对气候变化的影响。

abstract.text: Participation and utilisation decisions lie at the heart of many public policy questions. I contribute new evidence by using hospital records to examine how access to primary care services affects utilisation of hospital Emergency Departments in England. Using a natural experiment in the roll out of services, I first show that access to primary care reduces Emergency Department visits. Additional strategies then allow me to separate descriptively four aspects of primary care access: proximity, opening hours, need to make an appointment, and eligibility. Convenience-oriented services divert three times as many patients from emergency visits, largely because patients can attend without appointments.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102242.abstractZh: 参与和利用决策是许多公共政策问题的核心。我通过利用医院记录来研究初级医疗服务获取情况如何影响英格兰医院急诊科的利用情况，从而提供了新的证据。通过一项服务推广中的自然实验，我首先证明了初级医疗服务的获取可以减少急诊科的就诊次数。随后，通过其他策略，我能够区分初级医疗服务获取的四个方面：距离、开放时间、是否需要预约以及资格要求。以便利性为导向的服务可以将三倍多的患者从急诊就诊中转移出来，主要是因为患者无需预约即可就诊。

abstract.text: Generic drugs are sold at a fraction of the original brand price. Yet, generic entry typically produces a drop in the quantity market share of the molecule losing exclusivity. This effect is economically and statistically significant for a large dataset covering hundreds of prescription drugs sold in the US during the period 1994Q1-2003Q4. This paper proposes the first systematic analysis of what appears to be a market anomaly. We propose a model to characterize the market equilibrium before and after generic entry. We identify precise conditions under which entry reduces the quantity market share of the molecule. Intriguingly, this is more likely to occur when the remaining patent-protected molecules feature low horizontal differentiation. We test this and other theoretical predictions of the model and find they are validated empirically.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102243.abstractZh: 仿制药的售价仅为原品牌价格的一小部分。然而，仿制药的进入通常会导致相关药物的市场份额下降，从而失去独家性。这一效应在涵盖1994年第一季度至2003年第四季度的数百种在美国销售的处方药的大规模数据集中具有经济和统计上的显著性。本文首次系统地分析了这一市场异常现象。我们提出了一个模型来描述仿制药进入市场前后市场的均衡状况。我们确定了仿制药进入市场导致相关药物市场份额下降的具体条件。有趣的是，这种情况更可能发生在那些剩余受专利保护的药物具有较低水平差异化的情况下。我们对该模型的其他理论预测进行了测试，并发现这些预测得到了实证支持。

abstract.text: We examine whether family doctor firms in England respond to local competition by increasing their quality. We measure quality in terms of clinical performance and patient-reported satisfaction to capture its multi-dimensional nature. We use a panel covering 8 years for over 8000 English general practices. We measure competition as the number of rival doctors within a small distance and control for a large number of potential confounders. We find that increases in local competition are associated with increases in patient satisfaction and to a lesser extent in clinical quality. However, the magnitude of the effect is small.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102249.abstractZh: 我们研究英格兰的家庭医生诊所是否通过提高服务质量来应对当地竞争。我们以临床表现和患者满意度来衡量服务质量，以反映其多维性。我们使用了涵盖8年、涉及8000多家英国普通诊所的面板数据。我们将竞争定义为在较小范围内存在竞争对手的医生数量，并控制了大量潜在的混杂因素。研究发现，当地竞争的增加与患者满意度的提高相关，临床质量的影响则较小。不过，这种影响的幅度并不大。

abstract.text: In 1988, the Brazilian Constitution defined health as a universal right and a state responsibility. Progress towards universal health coverage in Brazil has been achieved through a unified health system (Sistema Único de Saúde [SUS]), created in 1990. With successes and setbacks in the implementation of health programmes and the organisation of its health system, Brazil has achieved nearly universal access to health-care services for the population. The trajectory of the development and expansion of the SUS offers valuable lessons on how to scale universal health coverage in a highly unequal country with relatively low resources allocated to health-care services by the government compared with that in middle-income and high-income countries. Analysis of the past 30 years since the inception of the SUS shows that innovations extend beyond the development of new models of care and highlights the importance of establishing political, legal, organisational, and management-related structures, with clearly defined roles for both the federal and local governments in the governance, planning, financing, and provision of health-care services. The expansion of the SUS has allowed Brazil to rapidly address the changing health needs of the population, with dramatic upscaling of health service coverage in just three decades. However, despite its successes, analysis of future scenarios suggests the urgent need to address lingering geographical inequalities, insufficient funding, and suboptimal private sector-public sector collaboration. Fiscal policies implemented in 2016 ushered in austerity measures that, alongside the new environmental, educational, and health policies of the Brazilian government, could reverse the hard-earned achievements of the SUS and threaten its sustainability and ability to fulfil its constitutional mandate of providing health care for all.

10.1016/s0140-6736(19)31243-7.abstractZh: 1988年，巴西宪法将健康定义为一项普遍权利和国家责任。通过1990年建立的统一卫生系统（Sistema Único de Saúde [SUS]），巴西在全民健康覆盖方面取得了进展。尽管在卫生项目的实施和卫生系统组织方面存在成功与挫折，巴西已使大部分人口几乎能够享受到医疗保健服务。SUS的发展和扩展历程为如何在资源匮乏、政府对医疗保健服务的投入相对较低的国家实现全民健康覆盖提供了宝贵经验。对SUS成立以来的30年进行分析后发现，创新不仅体现在新的护理模式上，还强调了建立政治、法律、组织和管理相关结构的重要性，明确界定联邦政府和地方政府在治理、规划、融资和提供医疗服务方面的职责。SUS的扩展使巴西能够在短短三十年内迅速满足民众不断变化的健康需求，大幅提升了医疗服务覆盖水平。然而，尽管取得了这些成就，对未来情景的分析表明，仍需紧迫解决地理不平等、资金不足以及私营部门与公共部门合作不足等问题。2016年实施的财政政策带来了紧缩措施，加上巴西政府新的环境、教育和健康政策，可能会破坏SUS所取得的来之不易的成就，并威胁到其可持续性和履行宪法赋予为所有人提供医疗保健的职责的能力。

abstract.text: A "Nash equilibrium in Nash bargains" has become a workhorse bargaining model in applied analyses of bilateral oligopoly. This paper proposes a noncooperative foundation for "Nash-in-Nash" bargaining that extends Rubinstein's alternating offers model to multiple upstream and downstream firms. We provide conditions on firms' marginal contributions under which there exists, for sufficiently short time between offers, an equilibrium with agreement among all firms at prices arbitrarily close to Nash-in-Nash prices, that is, each pair's Nash bargaining solution given agreement by all other pairs. Conditioning on equilibria without delayed agreement, limiting prices are unique. Unconditionally, they are unique under stronger assumptions.

10.1086/700729.abstractZh: “纳什均衡在纳什讨价还价中”已成为双边寡头垄断应用分析中的核心讨价还价模型。本文提出了一种非合作基础的“纳什-纳什”讨价还价模型，将鲁宾斯坦的交替报价模型扩展到多个上下游企业。我们提出了企业边际贡献的条件，在这些条件下，如果报价间隔足够短，则所有企业都能达成一致的均衡，且价格接近纳什-纳什价格。也就是说，每对企业在其他企业达成一致的情况下，都能得到纳什讨价还价解决方案。如果仅考虑无延迟一致的均衡，则价格具有唯一性。在更强的假设条件下，这些价格也是唯一的。

abstract.text: We incorporate a search-theoretic model of imperfect competition into a standard model of asymmetric information with unrestricted contracts. We characterize the unique equilibrium and use our characterization to explore the interaction between adverse selection, screening, and imperfect competition. We show that the relationship between an agent’s type, the quantity he trades, and the price he pays is jointly determined by the severity of adverse selection and the concentration of market power. Therefore, quantifying the effects of adverse selection requires controlling for market structure. We also show that increasing competition and reducing informational asymmetries can decrease welfare.

10.1086/700730.abstractZh: 我们将不完全竞争的理论模型纳入了具有无限制合同的不对称信息标准模型中。我们描述了独特的均衡状态，并利用这一描述来探讨逆向选择、筛选机制与不完全竞争之间的相互作用。我们发现，代理人的类型、其交易数量以及支付价格之间的关系，共同受到逆向选择严重程度和市场力量集中程度的制约。因此，量化逆向选择的影响需要控制市场结构因素。此外，我们还指出，增加竞争和减少信息不对称性能够提升福利水平。

abstract.text: This paper considers equilibrium two-sided search with ex ante heterogeneous agents, vectors of attributes, and idiosyncratic match draws. The analysis applies to a large class of models, from the nontransferable utility case to the collective household model with bargaining, for which transferable utility is a special case. The approach is powerful for it identifies a simple algorithm that, in our numerical application, is found to rapidly converge to equilibrium. Our application explores the impact of equal opportunities for women in the labor market on female match incentives and the timing of marriage.

10.1086/700731.abstractZh: 本文探讨了具有事前异质代理人、属性向量以及独特匹配抽样的双边搜索均衡问题。分析适用于大量模型，从不可转让效用案例到包含讨价还价行为的集体家庭模型，其中可转让效用是特殊情况。该方法非常有效，因为它提出了一个简单的算法，在我们的数值应用中，该算法能够迅速收敛到均衡状态。我们的应用研究探讨了女性在劳动力市场中获得平等机会对女性匹配激励以及婚姻时机的影响。

abstract.text: Empirical work has drawn attention to the high degree of productivity differences within industries and their role in resource allocation. This paper examines the allocational efficiency of such markets. Productivity differences introduce two new margins of potential inefficiency: selection of the right distribution of firms and allocation of the right quantities across firms. We show that these considerations affect welfare and policy analysis, and market power across firms leads to distortions in resource allocation. Demand-side elasticities determine how resources are misallocated and when increased competition from market expansion provides welfare gains.

10.1086/700732.abstractZh: 实证研究已经注意到行业内生产力差异的显著程度，以及这些差异在资源配置中的作用。本文探讨了此类市场的资源配置效率。生产力差异引入了两种新的潜在低效率因素：选择正确的企业分布以及在不同企业之间分配正确的资源数量。我们指出，这些因素会影响福利和政策分析，而企业间的市场力量会导致资源配置的扭曲。需求方的弹性决定了资源如何被错误分配，以及市场扩张带来的竞争何时能够带来福利收益。

abstract.text: We explore the impact of allowing for outsourcing service delivery to the private sector within Indonesia's largest targeted transfer program. In a field experiment across 572 municipalities, we find that allowing for outsourcing the last mile of food delivery reduced operating costs without sacrificing quality. However, the prices citizens paid were lower only where we modified the bidding rules to encourage more bidders. Higher rents are associated with greater entry despite elites' efforts to block reform. In this context, the option to outsource and sufficient competition generated significant benefits relative to public distribution.

10.1086/700734.abstractZh: 我们探讨了在印度尼西亚规模最大的目标转移计划中，允许将服务交付外包给私营部门的影响。在涵盖572个市镇的实地实验中，我们发现，允许将食品配送的最后环节外包可以降低运营成本，同时不牺牲服务质量。然而，只有当我们修改了竞标规则以鼓励更多参与者时，市民支付的价格才会降低。尽管精英阶层试图阻止改革，但较高的租金与更多的进入机会相关。在这种情况下，外包的选择以及充分的竞争为公共分配带来了显著的好处。

abstract.text: We document the economywide extent of misconduct among financial advisers and the associated labor market consequences. Seven percent of advisers have misconduct records, and this share reaches more than 15 percent at some of the largest firms. Roughly one-third of advisers with misconduct are repeat offenders. Approximately half of advisers lose their jobs after misconduct. The labor market partially undoes firm-level discipline by rehiring such advisers. Firms that persistently engage in misconduct coexist with firms that have clean records. We show that this phenomenon may be explained by some firms “specializing” in misconduct and catering to unsophisticated consumers.

10.1086/700735.abstractZh: 我们记录了金融顾问中普遍存在的不当行为及其对劳动力市场的影響。有7%的顾问存在不当行为记录，而在一些大型企业中，这一比例甚至超过15%。大约三分之一的不当行为顾问是惯犯。大约一半的顾问在行为不当后失去工作。劳动力市场对这类顾问的重新聘用部分抵消了企业层面的纪律措施。那些持续出现不当行为的企业与那些行为记录清洁的企业并存。我们发现，这种现象可能是由于某些企业专门从事不当行为，并迎合不成熟的消费者。

abstract.text: We propose a difference-in-differences strategy to identify the existence of interjurisdictional tax competition. Our strategy rests on differences between desired tax levels determined by culture-specific preferences and equilibrium tax levels determined by fiscal externalities and by preferences. While preferences differ systematically between French-speaking and German-speaking Swiss municipalities, local income tax burdens exhibit smooth spatial gradients. To qualify the empirical evidence, we develop a theoretical model of strategic tax setting by local governments that anticipate the effects of taxes on the per capita income and the median “hedonic” income, two inextricable consequences of the sorting of heterogeneous individuals.

10.1086/700760.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种差异-差异策略，用于识别跨司法管辖区的税收竞争的存在。该策略基于由文化特定偏好决定的期望税收水平与由财政外部性和偏好决定的均衡税收水平之间的差异。尽管法语区和德语区瑞士各市镇的偏好存在系统性差异，但当地所得税负担却呈现出平滑的空间梯度。为了验证这些实证证据，我们开发了一个理论模型，用于描述地方政府在税收对人均收入和中位数“享乐”收入影响方面的战略性税收设定，这两者都是异质个体排序的不可分割的后果。

abstract.text: Engagement in a destructive war can be understood as the “punishment” for entering into a dispute. Institutions that reduce the chance that disputes lead to war make this punishment less severe. This may incentivize hawkish policies like militarization and potentially offset the benefits of peace brokering. We study a model in which unmediated peace talks are effective at improving the peace chance for given militarization but lead to more militarization and ultimately to a higher incidence of war. Instead, a form of third-party mediation inspired by work of Myerson effectively brokers peace in emerged disputes and also minimizes equilibrium militarization.

10.1086/700761.abstractZh: 参与破坏性战争可以被视为对卷入争端的一种“惩罚”。那些能够降低争端引发战争几率的机构，会使这种惩罚变得不那么严厉。这可能会激励采取鹰派政策，如军事化，并可能抵消促成和平所带来的好处。我们研究了一个模型，在该模型中，未经调解的和平谈判在一定的军事化水平下能够有效提高和平的可能性，但会导致更多的军事化，最终增加战争的发生率。相反，一种受迈尔森理论启发的第三方调解方式，能够有效促成出现争端的地区的和平，同时还能最小化均衡军事化水平。

abstract.text: Context-dependent individual choice challenges the principle of utility maximization. I explain context dependence as the optimal response of an imperfectly informed agent to the ease of comparison of the options. I introduce a discrete choice model, the Bayesian probit, which allows the analyst to identify stable preferences from context-dependent choice data. My model accommodates observed behavioral phenomena--including the attraction and compromise effects--that lie beyond the scope of any random utility model. I use data from frog mating choices to illustrate how the model can outperform the random utility framework in goodness of fit and out-of-sample prediction.

10.1086/700762.abstractZh: 情境依赖的个体选择挑战了效用最大化原则。我将情境依赖性解释为信息不完全的代理人对选项比较便利性的最优反应。我引入了一个离散选择模型——贝叶斯Probit模型，该模型使分析师能够从情境依赖的选择数据中识别出稳定的偏好。我的模型能够解释一些观察到的行为现象，包括吸引效应和妥协效应，这些现象超出了任何随机效用模型所能涵盖的范围。我以青蛙交配选择的数据为例，说明该模型在拟合优度和样本外预测方面如何优于随机效用框架。

abstract.text: When people can self-insure via migration, they may have less need for informal risk sharing. At the same time, informal insurance may reduce the need to migrate. To understand the joint determination of migration and risk sharing, I study a dynamic model of risk sharing with limited commitment frictions and endogenous temporary migration. First, I characterize the model. Second, I structurally estimate the model using the new ICRISAT panel from rural India. Third, I introduce a rural employment scheme. The policy reduces migration and decreases risk sharing, lowering the welfare gain of the policy.

10.1086/700763.abstractZh: 当人们能够通过迁移进行自我保险时，他们对非正式风险共享的需求可能会减少。同时，非正式保险也可能降低迁移的需求。为了理解迁移与风险共享的联合决定因素，我研究了一个具有有限承诺摩擦和内生性临时迁移的动态风险共享模型。首先，我对模型进行了描述性分析。其次，我利用印度农村的新ICRISAT面板数据对模型进行了结构估计。第三，我引入了一个农村就业计划。该政策减少了迁移需求，并降低了风险共享，从而降低了政策的福利收益。

abstract.text: This paper examines the importance of buyer-supplier relationships for firm performance. We develop a model in which firms outsource tasks and search for suppliers. Lower search and outsourcing costs lead firms to search more and find better suppliers, which in turn drives down marginal costs. We test the theory by exploiting the opening of a high-speed train line in Japan, which lowered the cost of passenger travel but left shipping costs unchanged. Using an exhaustive data set on firms’ buyer-seller linkages, we find significant improvements in firm performance as well as creation of buyer-seller links, consistent with the model.

10.1086/700764.abstractZh: 本文探讨了买方-供应商关系对企业绩效的重要性。我们建立了一个模型，其中企业将任务外包给供应商。较低的搜索成本和外包成本促使企业更频繁地寻找供应商，从而找到更优质的供应商，进而降低边际成本。我们通过日本一条高速铁路线的开通来检验这一理论，该线路降低了乘客的出行成本，但运输成本保持不变。利用关于企业买方-供应商关系的大量数据，我们发现企业绩效的显著提升以及买方-供应商关系的建立，与模型预测的结果一致。

abstract.text: We present a model in which human capital investments occur over the life cycle and across generations, à la Becker and Tomes. The human capital technology features multiple stages of childhood investments, college, and life cycle accumulation. The model can explain a wide range of intergenerational relationships while remaining empirically consistent with cross-sectional inequality. Much of the latter is determined by early investments in children, so that borrowing constraints faced by young parents are important for understanding the persistence of economic status across generations. Education subsidies, especially early on, can significantly reduce the intergenerational persistence of economic status.

10.1086/700765.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，其中人力资本投资贯穿生命周期并跨越世代，类似于贝克尔和托姆斯的模型。该人力资本技术模型包含多个阶段的儿童投资、大学教育以及生命周期内的积累。该模型能够解释广泛的代际关系，同时与横截面上的不平等现象保持实证一致性。后者很大程度上取决于对儿童的早期投资，因此年轻父母面临的借贷限制对于理解经济地位在代际间的持续性具有重要意义。教育补贴，尤其是在早期阶段，可以显著减少经济地位在代际间的持续性。

abstract.text: We explore the first period of sustained decline in child mortality in the U.S. and provide estimates of the independent and combined effects of clean water and effective sewerage systems on under-five mortality. Our case is Massachusetts, 1880 to 1920, when authorities developed a sewerage and water district in the Boston area. We find the two interventions were complementary and together account for approximately one-third of the decline in log child mortality during the 41 years. Our findings are relevant to the developing world and suggest that a piecemeal approach to infrastructure investments is unlikely to significantly improve child health.

10.1086/700766.abstractZh: 我们探讨了美国儿童死亡率持续下降的第一个时期，并估算了清洁水源和有效的污水系统对五岁以下儿童死亡率的独立影响及联合影响。我们的研究案例是马萨诸塞州，时间跨度从1880年到1920年，当时当局在波士顿地区建立了污水和供水系统。我们发现这两种措施是互补的，共同导致了41年间儿童死亡率下降的约三分之一。我们的研究结果对发展中国家具有参考价值，表明逐步进行基础设施投资不太可能显著改善儿童健康。

abstract.text: A key decision facing firms is the extent of control to exert over the different stages in their production processes. We develop and test a property rights model of firm boundary choices along the value chain. We construct firm-level measures of the upstreamness of integrated and nonintegrated inputs by combining information on firms’ production activities in more than 100 countries with input-output tables. Whether a firm integrates upstream or downstream suppliers depends crucially on the elasticity of demand it faces. Moreover, integration is shaped by the relative contractibility of stages along the value chain, as well as by the firm’s productivity.

10.1086/700935.abstractZh: 企业面临的一个关键决策是对其生产过程的不同阶段施加何种程度的控制。我们开发并测试了一个关于企业边界选择的产权模型，该模型涉及价值链的各个阶段。我们通过结合100多个国家企业的生产活动信息以及投入产出表，构建了企业层面关于整合型与非整合型投入的上游程度指标。企业是整合上游还是下游供应商，在很大程度上取决于其所面临的需求弹性。此外，整合程度还受到价值链各阶段相对可合约性的影响，以及企业的生产效率的制约。

abstract.text: We provide evidence that democracy has a positive effect on GDP per capita. Our dynamic panel strategy controls for country fixed effects and the rich dynamics of GDP, which otherwise confound the effect of democracy. To reduce measurement error, we introduce a new indicator of democracy that consolidates previous measures. Our baseline results show that democratizations increase GDP per capita by about 20 percent in the long run. We find similar effects using a propensity score reweighting strategy as well as an instrumental-variables strategy using regional waves of democratization. The effects are similar across different levels of development and appear to be driven by greater investments in capital, schooling, and health.

10.1086/700936.abstractZh: 我们提供了证据，表明民主对人均GDP有积极影响。我们的动态面板策略控制了国家固定效应和GDP的动态变化，这些因素可能会混淆民主的影响。为了减少测量误差，我们引入了一个新的民主指标，该指标整合了之前的测量方法。我们的基线结果显示，从长期来看，民主化进程可使人均GDP增加约20%。使用倾向得分重新加权策略以及利用区域民主化进程的工具变量策略，我们也发现了类似的效果。这些效果在不同发展水平的国家中表现相似，并且似乎是由对资本、教育和健康的更大投资所驱动的。

abstract.text: We design and implement a large-scale resume correspondence study to address limitations of existing field experiments testing for age discrimination that may bias their results. One limitation that may bias results is giving older and younger applicants similar experience to make them “otherwise comparable.” A second limitation is that greater unobserved differences in human capital investment of older applicants may bias the results against finding age discrimination. On the basis of over 40,000 job applications, we find robust evidence of age discrimination in hiring against older women, especially those near retirement age, but considerably less evidence of age discrimination against men.

10.1086/701029.abstractZh: 我们设计并实施了一项大规模简历对照研究，旨在解决现有实地实验在测试年龄歧视时可能导致的局限性，这些实验可能会使结果产生偏差。其中一个可能导致结果偏差的局限性是，让年长申请者和年轻申请者拥有相似的经历，以使他们“在其他方面具有可比性”。另一个局限性是，年长申请者在人力资本投资方面的差异可能较大，这可能会使得研究结果不利于发现年龄歧视现象。基于超过40,000份求职申请的数据，我们发现存在针对年长女性的招聘年龄歧视现象，尤其是那些接近退休年龄的女性，但针对男性的年龄歧视现象则相对较少。

abstract.text: China’s land reform in 1978–84 unleashed rapid growth in farm output and household income. In new data on reform timing in 914 counties, we find an immediate trend break in the fraction of male children following the reform. Among second births that followed a firstborn girl, sex ratios increased from 1.1 to 1.3 boys per girl in the 4 years following reform. Larger increases are found among families with more education. The land reform estimate is robust to controlling for the county-level rollout of the One Child Policy. Overall, we estimate land reform accounted for about 1 million missing girls.

10.1086/701030.abstractZh: 1978年至1984年中国进行的土地改革使农业产量和家庭收入迅速增长。通过对914个县的改革时间的新数据分析，我们发现改革后男性儿童的比例立即出现下降。在改革后四年中，如果第二个孩子是一个女孩，那么男孩与女孩的比例从1.1上升到1.3。受教育程度较高的家庭中，这种比例变化更为明显。即使控制了“独生子女政策”在县级层面的实施情况，土地改革对性别比例变化的解释仍然较为稳健。总体而言，我们估计土地改革使大约100万女孩得以存活。

abstract.text: The “friendship paradox” (first noted by Feld in 1991) refers to the fact that, on average, people have strictly fewer friends than their friends have. I show that this oversampling of more popular people can lead people to perceive more engagement than exists in the overall population. This feeds back to amplify engagement in behaviors that involve complementarities. Also, people with the greatest proclivity for a behavior choose to interact the most, leading to further feedback and amplification. These results are consistent with studies finding overestimation of peer consumption of alcohol, cigarettes, and drugs and with resulting high levels of drug and alcohol consumption.

10.1086/701031.abstractZh: “友谊悖论”最初由Feld在1991年提出，指的是平均而言，一个人的朋友数量严格少于其朋友的数量。我发现，这种对更受欢迎的人进行过度采样的行为会导致人们认为整体人群中的互动程度高于实际水平。这种反馈效应会进一步放大那些涉及互补性的行为的互动。此外，那些更倾向于某种行为的人会选择更多的互动，从而进一步产生反馈效应。这些结果与一些研究发现的类似现象一致，即人们高估了同龄人在酒精、香烟和药物消费方面的水平，从而导致药物和酒精消费水平过高。

abstract.text: Suppose that agents can exert costly effort that creates nonrival, heterogeneous benefits for each other. At each possible outcome, a weighted, directed network describing marginal externalities is defined. We show that Pareto efficient outcomes are those at which the largest eigenvalue of the network is 1. An important set of efficient solutions--Lindahl outcomes--are characterized by contributions being proportional to agents' eigenvector centralities in the network. The outcomes we focus on are motivated by negotiations. We apply the results to identify who is essential for Pareto improvements, how to efficiently subdivide negotiations, and whom to optimally add to a team.

10.1086/701032.abstractZh: 假设代理人能够付出昂贵的努力，从而为彼此创造非竞争性的、异质性的收益。在每一种可能的结果下，都会定义一个带有权重的、有向的网络，用以描述边际外部性。我们证明，帕累托有效的结果是指该网络的最大特征值等于1的情况。一组重要的有效解决方案——林德哈尔结果——其特点是各代理人的贡献与他们在网络中的特征向量中心性成正比。我们关注的结果是由谈判所驱动的。我们将这些结果应用于识别哪些因素对实现帕累托改进至关重要，如何有效地将谈判进行细分，以及应该将哪些人最优地纳入团队中。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of the establishment of the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) clearinghouse in 1892 on counterparty risk using a novel historical experiment. During this period, the NYSE stocks were dual-listed on the Consolidated Stock Exchange (CSE), which already had a clearinghouse. Using identical securities on the CSE as a control, we find that the introduction of multilateral net settlement through a clearinghouse substantially reduced volatility of NYSE returns caused by settlement risk and increased asset values. Our results indicate that a clearinghouse can improve market stability and value through a reduction in network contagion and counterparty risk.

10.1086/701033.abstractZh: 我们通过一项新颖的历史实验，研究了1892年纽约证券交易所（NYSE）清算所的建立对交易对手风险的影响。在这一时期，NYSE的股票同时在已经拥有清算所的合并证券交易所（CSE）上市。我们以CSE上的相同证券作为对照组，发现通过清算所引入多边净额结算机制，显著降低了由结算风险引起的NYSE股票回报的波动性，并提升了资产价值。我们的研究结果表明，清算所可以通过减少网络传染和交易对手风险，从而提高市场稳定性和资产价值。

abstract.text: Interbank networks amplified the contraction in lending during the Great Depression. Panics induced banks in the hinterland to withdraw interbank deposits from Federal Reserve member banks located in reserve and central reserve cities. These correspondent banks responded by curtailing lending to businesses. Between the peak in the summer of 1929 and the banking holiday in the winter of 1933, interbank amplification reduced aggregate commercial bank lending by an estimated 15 percent.

10.1086/701034.abstractZh: 在大萧条期间，银行间网络加剧了借贷的收缩。恐慌导致内陆地区的银行从位于储备城市和中央储备城市的联邦储备银行成员银行中提取了银行间存款。这些代理银行因此缩减了对企业的贷款。从1929年夏季的峰值到1933年冬季的银行假期期间，银行间网络的放大效应使商业银行的总贷款减少了约15%。

abstract.text: We use the late nineteenth-century establishment of agricultural experiment stations at preexisting land-grant colleges across the United States to estimate the importance of proximity to research for productivity growth. Our analysis reveals that proximity to newly opened permanent stations affected land productivity for about 20 years and then subsequently declined until becoming largely absent today. We conclude that spatial frictions substantially reduced the rate of return to public research spending in the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, but such frictions significantly diminished as extension programs, automobiles, and telephones made it easier for discoveries to reach farther farms.

10.1086/701035.abstractZh: 我们利用19世纪末在美国各地现有的赠地大学中建立的农业实验站，来估算与研究地点距离对生产力增长的重要性。我们的分析显示，新建立的永久性实验站附近的土地生产力在大约20年内有所提升，之后则逐渐下降，直至如今几乎完全消失。我们得出结论，空间障碍在19世纪末至20世纪初显著降低了公共研究支出的回报率，但随着推广计划、汽车和电话的普及，这些障碍逐渐减弱，使得研究成果能够更轻松地传播到更远的农场。

abstract.text: We nonparametrically estimate spillovers of properties financed by the Low Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) onto neighborhood residents by developing a new difference-in-differences style estimator. LIHTC development revitalizes low-income neighborhoods, increasing house prices 6.5 percent, lowering crime rates, and attracting racially and income diverse populations. LIHTC development in higher-income areas causes house price declines of 2.5 percent and attracts lower-income households. Linking these price effects to a hedonic model of preferences, LIHTC developments in low-income areas cause aggregate welfare benefits of $116 million. Affordable housing development acts like a place-based policy and can revitalize low-income communities.

10.1086/701354.abstractZh: 我们通过开发一种新的差异估计方法，非参数地估算了由低收入住房税收抵免政策资助的房产对周边居民的影响。低收入住房税收抵免政策的实施能够振兴低收入社区，使房价上涨6.5%，降低犯罪率，并吸引不同种族和收入背景的人群。而在高收入地区实施该政策则会导致房价下降2.5%，并吸引低收入家庭入住。将这些价格变化与偏好享乐模型相结合，结果显示，在低收入地区实施该政策可带来总计1.16亿美元的福利收益。经济适用房的开发就像一项基于地点的政策，能够振兴低收入社区。

abstract.text: We study how intelligence and personality affect the outcomes of groups, focusing on repeated interactions that provide the opportunity for profitable cooperation. Our experimental method creates two groups of subjects who have different levels of certain traits, such as higher or lower levels of Intelligence, Conscientiousness, and Agreeableness, but who are very similar otherwise. Intelligence has a large and positive long-run effect on cooperative behavior. The effect is strong when at the equilibrium of the repeated game there is a trade-off between short-run gains and long-run losses. Conscientiousness and Agreeableness have a natural, significant but transitory effect on cooperation rates.

10.1086/701355.abstractZh: 我们研究了智力和人格如何影响群体的结果，重点关注那些能够促成有利合作的重复互动。我们的实验方法将受试者分为两组，这两组在某些特质上存在差异，例如智力、尽责性和宜人性水平的高低，但在其他方面则非常相似。智力对合作行为有显著且积极的长期影响。当重复博弈的均衡状态下存在短期收益与长期损失之间的权衡时，这种影响尤为明显。尽责性和宜人性对合作率有显著但短暂的影响。

abstract.text: We propose a new theory of systemic risk based on Knightian uncertainty (“ambiguity”). Because of uncertainty aversion, bad news on one asset class worsens investors’ expectations on other asset classes, so that idiosyncratic risk creates contagion, snowballing into systemic risk. In a Diamond and Dybvig setting, uncertainty-averse investors are less prone to run individual banks, but runs can be systemic and are associated with stock market crashes and flight to quality. Finally, increasing uncertainty makes the financial system more fragile and more prone to crises. Implications for the current public policy debate on management of financial crisis are derived.

10.1086/701356.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于奈特不确定性（“模糊性”）的系统风险新理论。由于不确定性厌恶，某一资产类别的负面消息会加剧投资者对其他资产类别的预期，从而导致特异性风险引发连锁反应，最终形成系统风险。在戴蒙德和戴布维格的模型中，厌恶不确定性的投资者不太可能进行个别银行挤兑，但挤兑仍可能具有系统性影响，并引发股市崩盘和优质资产追捧现象。此外，不确定性的增加会使金融系统更加脆弱，更容易发生危机。本文还探讨了这些结论对当前关于金融危机管理公共政策讨论的意义。

abstract.text: Using census microdata on multistate firms and their organizational forms, we estimate the impact of state taxes on business activity. For C corporations, employment and the number of establishments have short-run corporate tax elasticities of −0.4 to −0.5 and do not vary with changes in personal tax rates. Pass-through entity activities show tax elasticities of −0.2 to −0.4 with respect to personal tax rates and are invariant with respect to corporate tax rates. Capital shows similar patterns. Reallocation of productive resources to other states drives around half the effect. The responses are strongest for firms in tradable and footloose industries.

10.1086/701357.abstractZh: 通过利用多州企业的普查微观数据及其组织形式，我们估算了州税对商业活动的影响。对于C类公司而言，就业数量和企业数量在短期内的企业税弹性为-0.4至-0.5，并且不会因个人税率的变化而发生变化。转嫁实体活动的税收弹性为-0.2至-0.4，且不受企业税率的影响。资本也表现出类似的模式。将生产资源重新分配到其他州的行为驱动了大约一半的影响。这种效应在从事可交易行业和自由流动行业的企业中最为明显。

abstract.text: We introduce a new matching model to mimic two-sided exchange programs such as tuition and worker exchanges, in which export-import balances are required for longevity of programs. These exchanges use decentralized markets, making it difficult to achieve this goal. We introduce the two-sided top trading cycles, the unique mechanism that is balanced-efficient, worker-strategy-proof, acceptable, individually rational, and respecting priority bylaws regarding worker eligibility. Moreover, it encourages exchange, because full participation induces a dominant-strategy equilibrium for firms. We extend it to dynamic settings permitting tolerable yearly imbalances and demonstrate that its regular and tolerable versions perform considerably better than models of current practice.

10.1086/701358.abstractZh: 我们引入了一种新的匹配模型，用于模拟诸如学费和劳动力交换这样的双边交换项目。这些项目需要进出口平衡以确保其长期运行。这些交换采用分散市场模式，因此难以实现这一目标。我们提出了双边顶级交易周期机制，这是一种独特的机制，既具有均衡效率，又保证了劳动力策略的不可伪造性、可接受性、个体理性，并且尊重关于劳动力资格优先法则的规定。此外，该机制还鼓励交换，因为完全参与会促使企业形成占优策略均衡。我们将这一模型扩展到动态环境中，允许可容忍的年度不平衡，并证明其常规且可容忍的版本比当前实践中的模型表现要好得多。

abstract.text: The standard new Keynesian model predicts that economies behave differently at the zero lower bound: completely wasteful government spending or forward guidance is very stimulative, and capital destruction or oil supply shocks are expansionary. I provide empirical evidence on this prediction and find it wanting: The Great East Japan Earthquake and oil supply shocks are contractionary at the zero lower bound. Modifications of the model that are consistent with this evidence also overturn other unusual policy predictions, such as large fiscal multipliers. My results suggest that many of the usual rules of economics continue to hold at zero nominal interest rates.

10.1086/701421.abstractZh: 标准的新凯恩斯主义模型预测，在零下限条件下，经济体的行为会有所不同：完全浪费性的政府支出或前瞻性指导会起到极大的刺激作用，而资本破坏或石油供应冲击则会导致经济扩张。我提供了关于这一预测的经验证据，并发现该预测并不准确：东日本大震灾和石油供应冲击在零下限条件下会导致经济收缩。对这一模型进行修正后，与这些证据一致的模型结果也推翻了其他不寻常的政策预测，例如大规模财政乘数效应。我的研究结果表明，许多常见的经济学规律在零名义利率条件下仍然成立。

abstract.text: We document a causal response of local retail prices to changes in local house prices, with elasticities of 15–20 percent across housing cycles. These price responses are largest in zip codes with many homeowners and are driven by changes in markups rather than local costs. We argue that markups rise with house prices because greater housing wealth reduces homeowners’ demand elasticity, and firms raise markups in response. Shopping data confirm that house price changes affect the price sensitivity of homeowners, but not that of renters. Our evidence suggests a new source of business cycle markup variation.

10.1086/701422.abstractZh: 我们记录了当地零售价格对当地房价变化的因果响应，在不同的房地产周期中，价格弹性为15-20%。这种价格响应在拥有较多房主的邮政编码区域最为明显，其变化是由加价而非当地成本所驱动的。我们认为，房价上升会导致加价增加，因为更高的房地产财富会降低房主的需求弹性，而企业也会因此提高加价。购物数据证实，房价变化会影响房主的价格敏感度，但不会影响租户的价格敏感度。我们的证据表明，存在一种新的商业周期加价变化来源。

abstract.text: This paper explores racial differences in police use of force. On nonlethal uses of force, blacks and Hispanics are more than 50 percent more likely to experience some form of force in interactions with police. Adding controls that account for important context and civilian behavior reduces, but cannot fully explain, these disparities. On the most extreme use of force—officer-involved shootings—we find no racial differences either in the raw data or when contextual factors are taken into account. We argue that the patterns in the data are consistent with a model in which police officers are utility maximizers, a fraction of whom have a preference for discrimination, who incur relatively high expected costs of officer-involved shootings.

10.1086/701423.abstractZh: 本文探讨了警察使用武力的种族差异。在非致命武力使用方面，黑人和西班牙裔在与警察互动时遭遇某种形式武力的可能性比其他人高出50%以上。然而，纳入了考虑重要背景和平民行为的控制因素后，这些差异虽然有所减少，但并不能完全解释这些差异。在最极端的武力使用情况——涉及警员参与的枪击事件——中，无论是原始数据还是考虑背景因素后，我们都未发现种族差异。我们认为，数据中的模式与一种模型相符，即警察是效用最大化者，其中一部分警察存在歧视倾向，并且他们因涉及警员参与的枪击事件而承担相对较高的预期成本。

abstract.text: This paper investigates how tax changes for different income groups affect aggregate economic activity. I construct a measure of who received (or paid for) tax changes in the postwar period using tax return data from NBER’s TAXSIM. Variation in the income distribution across US states and federal tax changes generate variation in regional tax shocks that I exploit to test for heterogeneous effects. I find that the positive relationship between tax cuts and employment growth is largely driven by tax cuts for lower-income groups and that the effect of tax cuts for the top 10 percent on employment growth is small.

10.1086/701424.abstractZh: 本文研究了不同收入群体的税收变化如何影响整体经济活动。我利用美国国家经济研究局TAXSIM的纳税申报数据，构建了一个衡量战后时期哪些人实际获得了（或支付了）税收变化的指标。美国各州之间以及联邦税收变化导致的收入分布差异，会引发地区性的税收冲击，我利用这些冲击来检验不同群体的异质效应。研究发现，减税与就业增长之间的正相关关系主要源于对低收入群体的减税，而对收入最高的10%人群减税对就业增长的影响则较小。

abstract.text: Depression is the leading cause of illness and disability in adolescence. Many studies show a correlation between religiosity and mental health, yet the question remains whether the relationship is causal. We exploit within-school variation in adolescents' peers to deal with selection into religiosity. We find robust effects of religiosity on depression that are stronger for the most depressed. These effects are not driven by the school social context; depression spreads among close friends rather than through broader peer groups that affect religiosity. Exploration of mechanisms suggests that religiosity buffers against stressors in ways that school activities and friendships do not.

10.1086/701425.abstractZh: 抑郁是青少年时期导致疾病和残疾的主要原因。许多研究表明宗教性对心理健康存在关联，但这一关系是否具有因果关系仍存疑问。我们利用青少年同伴在学校的差异来消除宗教性选择的影响。研究发现，宗教性对抑郁有显著影响，且这种影响在抑郁程度较高的人群中更为明显。这些影响并非由学校社交环境所驱动；抑郁在亲密朋友之间传播，而非通过影响宗教性的更广泛的同伴群体。机制层面的分析表明，宗教性以学校活动和友谊无法实现的方式，对压力源起到了缓冲作用。

abstract.text: An increase in credit supply driven by looser lending constraints in the mortgage market is the key force behind four empirical features of the housing boom before the Great Recession: the unprecedented rise in home prices, the surge in household debt, the stability of debt relative to house values, and the fall in mortgage rates. These facts are more difficult to reconcile with the popular view that attributes the housing boom only to looser borrowing constraints associated with lower collateral requirements, because they shift the demand for credit.

10.1086/701440.abstractZh: 在抵押贷款市场中，由于贷款限制放宽，信贷供应增加是大衰退前房地产繁荣的四个实证特征背后的关键驱动力：房价前所未有的上涨、家庭债务的激增、债务相对于房屋价值的稳定，以及抵押贷款利率的下降。这些事实与普遍观点难以调和，后者认为房地产繁荣仅归因于借贷限制的放宽，即抵押品要求的降低，因为这些因素实际上改变了信贷需求。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether propaganda broadcast over radio helped to change interethnic attitudes in postgenocide Rwanda. We exploit variation in exposure to the government’s radio propaganda due to the mountainous topography of Rwanda. Results of lab-in-the-field experiments show that individuals exposed to government propaganda have lower salience of ethnicity, have increased interethnic trust, and show more willingness to interact face-to-face with members of another ethnic group. Our results suggest that the observed improvement in interethnic behavior is not cosmetic and reflects a deeper change in interethnic attitudes. The findings provide some of the first quantitative evidence that the salience of ethnic identity can be manipulated by governments.

10.1086/701441.abstractZh: 本文探讨了通过广播传播的宣传是否有助于改变卢旺达种族灭绝后不同族群之间的态度。我们利用了卢旺达山区地形导致的政府广播宣传接触程度差异来进行分析。实验室与实地实验的结果表明，接触政府宣传的人群对种族身份的显著性感知较低，族际信任度较高，并且更愿意与不同种族的成员进行面对面交流。我们的研究结果表明，这种族际行为的改善并非表面现象，而是反映了族群态度的深层次变化。这些发现提供了首批定量证据，证明政府可以操控种族身份的显著性。

abstract.text: We study a model of signaling in which agents are heterogeneous on two dimensions. An agent's natural action is the action taken in the absence of signaling concerns. Her gaming ability parameterizes the cost of increasing the action. Equilibrium behavior muddles information across dimensions. As incentives to take higher actions increase--due to higher stakes or more manipulable signaling technology--more information is revealed about gaming ability, and less about natural actions. We explore a new externality: showing agents' actions to additional observers can worsen information for existing observers. Applications to credit scoring, school testing, and web searching are discussed.

10.1086/701604.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个信号传递模型，其中代理人在两个维度上是异质的。代理人的自然行为是在没有信号传递影响的情况下所采取的行动。其博弈能力参数化了增加该行为所需的成本。均衡行为会使得信息在不同维度之间产生混乱。随着采取更高行为的激励增加——由于风险更高或信号传递技术更加可操控——关于博弈能力的信息会更多地被揭示出来，而关于自然行为的信息则会减少。我们探讨了一个新的外部性：向额外的观察者展示代理人的行为可能会恶化现有观察者的信息。文章还讨论了这一模型在信用评分、学校测试和网络搜索等领域的应用。

abstract.text: We study the role of morality in debt repayment, using an experiment with the credit card customers of a large Islamic bank in Indonesia. In our main treatment, clients receive a text message stating that “non-repayment of debts by someone who is able to repay is an injustice.” This moral appeal decreases delinquency by 4.4 percentage points from a baseline of 66 percent and reduces default among customers with the highest ex ante credit risk. Additional treatments help benchmark the effects against direct financial incentives and rule out competing explanations, such as reminder effects, priming religion, and provision of new information.

10.1086/701605.abstractZh: 我们研究了道德在债务偿还中的作用，通过一项针对印度尼西亚一家大型伊斯兰银行信用卡客户的实验来进行研究。在我们的主要实验中，客户会收到一条短信，内容为“有能力偿还债务的人不偿还债务是一种不公正的行为”。这种道德呼吁使违约率从66%的基线水平降低了4.4个百分点，并减少了那些事前信用风险最高的客户的违约行为。其他实验措施有助于将效果与直接财务激励措施进行比较，并排除其他可能的解释因素，如提醒效应、对宗教的预设效应以及提供新信息的影响。

abstract.text: We show that psychological well-being in adulthood varies with circumstance in early life. Combining a time series of real producer prices of cocoa with a nationally representative household survey in Ghana, we find that a one standard deviation rise in the cocoa price in early life decreases the likelihood of severe mental distress in adulthood by 3 percentage points (half the mean prevalence) for cohorts born in cocoa-producing regions relative to those born in other regions. Impacts on related personality traits are consistent with this result. Maternal nutrition, reinforcing childhood investments, and adult circumstance are likely operative channels of impact.

10.1086/701606.abstractZh: 我们表明，成年期的心理幸福感会受到早年生活环境的影響。通过结合加纳一项具有全国代表性的家庭调查数据以及可可产品的实际价格时间序列数据，我们发现，早年可可价格每上升一个标准差，成年期出现严重精神困扰的可能性就会降低3个百分点（即平均患病率的半数）。这一结果与其他相关人格特质的影响一致。母亲的营养状况、童年时期的投资以及成年后的生活环境，可能是影响心理幸福感的重要因素。

abstract.text: While there is strong evidence that more productive plants select into exporting, the literature has struggled to identify export-related efficiency gains within plants. We show that this is due to the common use of revenue-based productivity measures (TFPR): more efficient producers tend to charge lower prices, leading to a downward bias in TFPR. Using census panels of Chilean, Colombian, and Mexican manufacturing plants, we find sizable efficiency gains after export entry based on efficiency measures that are not affected by output prices. Evidence suggests that a complementarity between exporting and investment in technology is an important driver of these gains.

10.1086/701607.abstractZh: 虽然有大量证据表明，更具生产力的企业更倾向于出口，但相关文献在识别企业出口相关的效率提升方面存在困难。我们发现，这一现象是由于普遍使用基于收入的生产率指标所致：效率更高的生产者往往能够收取更低的价格，从而导致基于收入的生产率指标出现向下偏差。通过对智利、哥伦比亚和墨西哥的制造企业的普查数据进行分析，我们发现，在出口后，企业的效率确实有所提升，而这种效率提升是基于那些不受产出价格影响的指标。证据表明，出口与技术投资之间的互补性是推动这些效率提升的重要因素。

abstract.text: During the Great Recession, US regions that experienced large declines in household debt also experienced large drops in consumption, employment, and wages. We develop a search and matching model in which tighter debt constraints raise the cost of investing in new job vacancies and so reduce job-finding rates and employment. On-the-job human capital accumulation is critical to generating sizable drops in employment: it increases the duration of the benefit flows from posting vacancies, thereby amplifying the employment drop from a credit tightening 10-fold relative to the standard model. Our model reproduces the salient cross-regional features of the US Great Recession.

10.1086/701608.abstractZh: 在大衰退期间，美国那些家庭债务大幅下降的地区，消费、就业和工资也出现了大幅下降。我们建立了一个搜索与匹配模型，该模型表明，债务约束的加剧会增加对新职位空缺进行投资的成本，从而降低求职率和就业率。在职人力资本积累对于实现显著的就业下降至关重要：它延长了因发布职位空缺而获得的福利持续时间，从而使就业下降幅度比标准模型中的情况高出10倍。我们的模型再现了美国大衰退期间显著的跨地区特征。

abstract.text: Happiness is reported in ordered intervals (e.g., very, pretty, not too happy). We review and apply standard statistical results to determine when such data permit identification of two groups’ relative average happiness. The necessary conditions for nonparametric identification are strong and unlikely to ever be satisfied. Standard parametric approaches cannot identify this ranking unless the variances are exactly equal. If not, ordered probit findings can be reversed by lognormal transformations. For nine prominent happiness research areas, conditions for nonparametric identification are rejected and standard parametric results are reversed using plausible transformations. Tests for a common reporting function consistently reject.

10.1086/701679.abstractZh: 幸福被描述为有序的区间（例如，非常、相当、不太幸福）。我们回顾并应用标准统计结果，以确定何时这些数据能够识别出两组相对平均幸福度的差异。非参数识别的必要条件非常严格，且不太可能同时满足。除非方差完全相等，否则标准参数方法无法识别这种排序。如果不满足这一条件，可以通过对数正态变换来反转有序概率模型的结果。对于九个重要的幸福研究领域，非参数识别的条件被拒绝，而标准参数结果则可以通过合理的变换来反转。对于共同报告函数的检验，结果一致地拒绝了这一假设。

abstract.text: We provide measures of ethnic and racial segregation in urban consumption. Using Yelp reviews, we estimate how spatial and social frictions influence restaurant visits within New York City. Transit time plays a first-order role in consumption choices, so consumption segregation partly reflects residential segregation. Social frictions also affect restaurant choices: individuals are less likely to visit venues in neighborhoods demographically different from their own. While spatial and social frictions jointly produce significant levels of consumption segregation, we find that restaurant consumption is only about half as segregated as residences. Consumption segregation owes more to social than spatial frictions.

10.1086/701680.abstractZh: 我们提供了城市消费中种族和族裔隔离的衡量指标。通过Yelp评论，我们估计了空间和社会因素对纽约市餐厅消费的影响。通勤时间对消费选择起着首要作用，因此消费隔离在一定程度上反映了居住隔离。社会因素也会影响餐厅选择：个体不太可能去那些在人口构成上与自己不同的社区中的餐厅。虽然空间和社会因素共同导致了显著的消费隔离现象，但我们发现餐厅消费中的隔离程度仅约为住宅消费的一半。消费隔离更多地归因于社会因素而非空间因素。

abstract.text: Measurement error is ubiquitous in experimental work. It leads to imperfect statistical controls, attenuated estimated effects of elicited behaviors, and biased correlations between characteristics. We develop statistical techniques for handling experimental measurement error. These techniques are applied to data from the Caltech Cohort Study, which conducts repeated incentivized surveys of the Caltech student body. We replicate three classic experiments, demonstrating that results change substantially when measurement error is accounted for. Collectively, these results show that failing to properly account for measurement error may cause a field-wide bias leading scholars to identify "new" phenomena.

10.1086/701681.abstractZh: 测量误差在实验工作中普遍存在。它会导致统计控制不精确、引发行为的估计效果减弱，以及特征之间的相关性出现偏差。我们开发了处理实验测量误差的统计技术。这些技术被应用于加州理工学院学生群体进行的重复激励调查数据。我们复现了三个经典实验，结果表明在考虑测量误差后，实验结果发生了显著变化。总体而言，这些结果表明，未能正确处理测量误差可能会导致整个领域出现偏差，使学者们能够识别出“新”现象。

abstract.text: We study the political effects of mass emigration to the United States in the nineteenth century using data from Sweden. To instrument for total emigration over several decades, we exploit severe local frost shocks that sparked an initial wave of emigration, interacted with within-country travel costs. Our estimates show that emigration substantially increased the local demand for political change, as measured by labor movement membership, strike participation, and voting. Emigration also led to de facto political change, increasing welfare expenditures as well as the likelihood of adopting more inclusive political institutions.

10.1086/701682.abstractZh: 我们利用瑞典的数据，研究了19世纪大规模移民到美国的政治影响。为了量化数十年的整体移民情况，我们利用了当地严重的霜冻灾害作为触发初始移民潮的诱因，并将其与国内旅行成本相结合进行分析。我们的估计结果显示，移民显著增加了当地对政治变革的需求，这一需求通过劳工运动成员数量、罢工参与率和投票率等指标得以体现。移民还导致了事实上的政治变革，增加了福利支出，并提高了采用更具包容性的政治体制的可能性。

abstract.text: We develop an asset pricing model with flexible heterogeneity in asset demand across investors, designed to match institutional and household holdings. A portfolio choice model implies characteristics-based demand when returns have a factor structure and expected returns and factor loadings depend on the assets’ own characteristics. We propose an instrumental variables estimator for the characteristics-based demand system to address the endogeneity of demand and asset prices. Using US stock market data, we illustrate how the model could be used to understand the role of institutions in asset market movements, volatility, and predictability.

10.1086/701683.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个资产定价模型，该模型考虑了投资者之间资产需求的灵活异质性，旨在与机构和家庭持有的资产相匹配。投资组合选择模型意味着，当回报具有因子结构且预期回报和因子载荷取决于资产自身特征时，需求是基于特征的。我们提出了一种工具变量估计方法，用于解决需求和资产价格的内生性问题。通过美国股市数据，我们展示了该模型如何用于理解机构在资产市场波动、波动性和可预测性中的作用。

abstract.text: We provide a framework for empirical analysis of negotiated-price markets. Using mortgage market data and a search and negotiation model, we characterize the welfare impact of search frictions and quantify the role of search costs and brand loyalty for market power. Search frictions reduce consumer surplus by $12/month/consumer, 28 percent of which can be associated with discrimination, 22 percent with inefficient matching, and 50 percent with search costs. Banks with large consumer bases have margins 70 percent higher than those with small consumer bases. The main source of this incumbency advantage is brand loyalty; however, price discrimination based on search frictions accounts for almost a third.

10.1086/701684.abstractZh: 我们提供了一个用于实证分析议价市场的框架。利用抵押贷款市场数据以及搜索与谈判模型，我们描述了搜索摩擦对福利的影响，并量化了搜索成本和品牌忠诚度对市场力量的作用。搜索摩擦使每个消费者的消费者剩余每月减少12美元，其中28%的原因与歧视有关，22%的原因与匹配效率低下有关，50%的原因与搜索成本有关。拥有大量消费者的银行的利润率比拥有少量消费者的银行高出70%。这种占据市场优势的主要来源是品牌忠诚度；然而，基于搜索摩擦的价格歧视也占据了近三分之一的原因。

abstract.text: We outline a framework for the empirical analysis of signaling games based on three features: sorting, incentive compatibility, and beliefs. We apply it to document cheap-talk signaling in the use of round-number offers during negotiations. Using millions of online bargaining interactions, we show that items listed at multiples of $100 receive offers that are 8–12 percent lower but are 15–25 percent more likely to sell, demonstrating the trade-off requisite for incentive compatibility. Those same sellers are more likely to accept a similar offer, and buyers are more likely to investigate their listings, consistent with seller sorting and buyer belief updating.

10.1086/701699.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个基于三个特征的信号博弈实证分析框架：排序、激励相容性和信念。我们将这一框架应用于分析谈判过程中使用整数报价的行为。通过数百万次在线讨价还价互动数据，我们发现以100美元整数倍列出的商品，其报价会低8%至12%，但销售的可能性则会提高15%至25%，这证明了激励相容性所需的权衡。同样的卖家更有可能接受类似的报价，而买家则更有可能调查他们的商品信息，这与卖家排序和买家信念更新的行为一致。

abstract.text: We advocate a different approach to measure the gender gap, summarizing each distribution by suitable evaluative functions and computing the difference between the evaluations. Unlike the conventional approach, ours does not assume rank invariance. We discuss the decision-theoretic framework behind different functions and introduce measures based on entropy functions. We further adopt quantile-copula approaches to account for selection into full-time employment and discuss how to take into account nonmarket values in measuring the gap. The evolution of the gender gap depends on the measure of it and whether nonmarket values are incorporated. We further assess and challenge a variety of assumptions, hypotheses, and findings in the literature.

10.1086/701788.abstractZh: 我们提倡一种不同的方法来衡量性别差距，通过合适的评估函数对每种分布进行总结，并计算这些评估值之间的差异。与传统方法不同，我们的方法不假设排名的不变性。我们讨论了不同函数背后的决策理论框架，并引入了基于熵函数的衡量方法。此外，我们采用分位数- Copula 方法来考虑全职就业的选择问题，并探讨了如何在衡量性别差距时考虑非市场价值。性别差距的演变取决于其衡量方式以及是否纳入了非市场价值。我们还评估并质疑了文献中各种假设、假说和发现的有效性。

abstract.text: Familiar explanations of why hunter-gatherers first took up farming—superior labor productivity, population pressure, or adverse climate—receive little support from recent evidence. Farming would be an unlikely choice without possession-based private property, which appears to have existed among rare groups of sedentary hunter-gatherers who became the first farmers. Our model shows that among them, farming could have benefited first adopters because private possession was more readily established and defended for cultivated crops and domesticated animals than for the diffuse wild resources on which hunter-gatherers relied, thus explaining how farming could have been introduced even without a productivity advantage.

10.1086/701789.abstractZh: 关于狩猎采集者为何首先采用农业生产的解释——比如更高的劳动生产率、人口压力或恶劣的气候——最近的证据并不支持这些观点。如果没有基于占有权的私有财产，农业可能并非一个合理的选择。而私有财产似乎只存在于少数定居的狩猎采集者群体中，他们后来成为了最早的农民。我们的模型表明，在这些群体中，农业可能使最初采用农业的人受益，因为对于栽培作物和驯养动物来说，私有权的确立和捍卫相对容易，而对于狩猎采集者所依赖的分散的野生资源来说则较为困难。因此，即使没有生产力的优势，农业也有可能被引入。

abstract.text: The dispersion of many economic variables is countercyclical. What drives this fact? Greater dispersion could arise from greater volatility of shocks or from agents responding more to shocks of constant size. Without data separately measuring exogenous shocks and endogenous responses, a theoretical debate between these explanations has emerged. In this paper, we provide novel identification using price data in the open-economy environment: using confidential BLS microdata, we document a robust positive relationship between exchange rate pass-through and the dispersion of item-level price changes. We then show that this relationship supports models with time-varying responsiveness.

10.1086/701790.abstractZh: 许多经济变量的分散程度具有反周期性。这一现象背后的驱动因素是什么？更大的分散程度可能是由于冲击的波动性增加，或者是因为经济主体对相同大小的冲击反应更为敏感。由于缺乏分别衡量外部冲击和内生反应的数据，关于这两种解释的理论争论一直存在。在本文中，我们利用开放经济环境下的价格数据提出了新的识别方法：通过 confidential BLS 微观数据，我们发现了汇率传递与项目级价格变化分散程度之间存在稳健的正相关关系。随后，我们表明这种关系支持了具有时变反应性的模型。

abstract.text: We study efficient and stable mechanisms in matching markets when the number of agents is large and individuals’ preferences and priorities are drawn randomly. When agents’ preferences are uncorrelated, then both efficiency and stability can be achieved in an asymptotic sense via standard mechanisms such as deferred acceptance and top trading cycles. When agents’ preferences are correlated over objects, however, these mechanisms are either inefficient or unstable, even in an asymptotic sense. We propose a variant of deferred acceptance that is asymptotically efficient, asymptotically stable, and asymptotically incentive compatible. This new mechanism performs well in a counterfactual calibration based on New York City school choice data.

10.1086/701791.abstractZh: 我们研究了在代理人数量众多且个体偏好和优先级随机分布的情况下，匹配市场中的高效且稳定的机制。当代理人的偏好不相关时，通过延迟接受和顶级交易周期等标准机制，可以在渐近意义上实现效率和稳定性。然而，当代理人的偏好在对象上相关时，这些机制即使在渐近意义上也往往效率低下或不稳定。我们提出了一种改进的延迟接受机制，该机制在渐近意义上既高效又稳定，并且具有渐近激励兼容性。基于纽约市学校选择数据进行的反事实校准表明，这种新机制表现良好。

abstract.text: The US Great Recession featured a large decline in output and labor, tighter financial conditions, and a large increase in firm growth dispersion. We build a model in which increased volatility at the firm level generates a downturn and worsened credit conditions. The key idea is that hiring inputs is risky because financial frictions limit firms’ ability to insure against shocks. An increase in volatility induces firms to reduce their inputs to reduce such risk. Our model can generate most of the decline in output and labor in the Great Recession and the observed increase in firms’ interest rate spreads.

10.1086/701792.abstractZh: 美国大衰退期间，产出和劳动力大幅减少，金融状况趋紧，企业增长的不确定性显著增加。我们构建了一个模型，该模型表明企业层面的波动性增加会导致经济衰退和信贷状况恶化。其核心思想是，雇佣生产要素存在风险，因为金融摩擦限制了企业应对冲击的能力。波动性增加促使企业减少生产要素投入，以降低这种风险。我们的模型能够解释大衰退期间产出和劳动力减少的大部分原因，以及企业利率差扩大的现象。

abstract.text: Earnings nonresponse in household surveys is widespread, yet there is limited knowledge of how nonresponse biases earnings measures. We examine the consequences of nonresponse on earnings gaps and inequality using Current Population Survey individual records linked to administrative earnings data. The common assumption that earnings are missing at random is rejected. Nonresponse across the earnings distribution is U-shaped, highest in the left and right tails. Inequality measures differ between household and administrative data due in part to nonresponse. Nonresponse biases earnings differentials by race, gender, and education, particularly in the tails. Flexible copula-based models can account for nonrandom nonresponse.

10.1086/701807.abstractZh: 家庭调查中收入数据的缺失现象十分普遍，但关于这种缺失如何对收入测量产生偏差的认识却十分有限。我们利用与行政收入数据相关联的当前人口调查个体记录，研究了数据缺失对收入差距和不平等的影响。人们通常认为收入数据的缺失是随机的，但我们的研究结果表明这一假设并不成立。收入分布的缺失情况呈现U形分布，在分布的两端最为严重。由于数据缺失的影响，家庭数据与行政数据之间的不平等指标存在差异。数据缺失还会导致不同种族、性别和教育水平的人群之间的收入差异出现偏差，尤其是在分布的两端。基于灵活copula模型的分析能够解释这种非随机的数据缺失现象。

abstract.text: We investigate the determinants of students’ university choice in Pakistan, with a focus on monetary returns, nonpecuniary factors enjoyed at school, and financial constraints. To mitigate the identification problem concerning the separation of preferences, expectations, and market constraints, we use rich data on subjective expectations, with direct measures of financial constraints, to estimate a life-cycle model of school choice jointly with school-specific expectations of dropping out. We find that labor market prospects play a small role. Instead, nonpecuniary outcomes, such as the school’s ideology, are the major determinants. Policy simulations suggest that relaxing financial constraints would have large welfare gains.

10.1086/701808.abstractZh: 我们研究了巴基斯坦学生选择大学的决定因素，重点关注货币回报、学校提供的非金钱性因素以及经济约束。为了缓解偏好、预期和市场约束分离所带来的识别问题，我们利用关于主观预期的大量数据，以及直接测量的经济约束数据，来估计一个包含学校辍学预期的学校选择生命周期模型。研究发现，劳动力市场前景的作用较小，而非金钱性因素，如学校的意识形态，才是主要决定因素。政策模拟表明，放宽经济约束将带来巨大的福利收益。

abstract.text: This paper uses US local areas as a laboratory to test for long-term impacts of the Great Recession. In administrative longitudinal data, I estimate that exposure to a 1 percentage point larger 2007–9 local unemployment shock reduced 2015 working-age employment rates by over 0.3 percentage points. Rescaled, this long-term recession impact accounts for over half of the 2007–15 US age-adjusted employment decline. Impacts were larger among older and lower-earning individuals and typically involved a layoff but are present even in a mass-layoffs sample. Disability insurance and out-migration yielded little income replacement. These findings reveal that the Great Recession imposed employment and income losses even after unemployment rates signaled recovery.

10.1086/701809.abstractZh: 本文以美国各地区为实验场，研究大衰退的长期影响。通过行政纵向数据分析，我们发现2007-2009年间当地失业率每上升1个百分点，2015年工作年龄人口的就业率就会下降0.3个百分点以上。经过重新调整，这种长期衰退的影响占2007-2015年间美国年龄调整后的就业下降幅度的一半以上。对年龄较大和收入较低的人群而言，这种影响更为显著，通常涉及裁员，但在大规模裁员样本中同样存在这种现象。残疾保险和外出移民对收入替代作用甚微。这些发现表明，即使失业率显示出复苏迹象，大衰退仍导致了就业和收入的损失。

abstract.text: We estimate the aggregate productivity gains from reducing barriers to internal labor migration in Indonesia, accounting for worker selection and spatial differences in human capital. We distinguish between movement costs, which mean workers will move only if they expect higher wages, and amenity differences, which mean some locations must pay more to attract workers. We find modest but important aggregate impacts. We estimate a 22 percent increase in labor productivity from removing all barriers. Reducing migration costs to the US level, a high-mobility benchmark, leads to a 7.1 percent productivity boost. These figures hide substantial heterogeneity. The origin population that benefits most sees a 104 percent increase in average earnings from a complete barrier removal, or a 25 percent gain from moving to the US benchmark.

10.1086/701810.abstractZh: 我们估算了减少印尼内部劳动力迁移障碍所带来的总体生产率提升效果，同时考虑了工人选择因素以及人力资本的空间差异。我们将迁移成本与便利条件差异区分开来：迁移成本意味着只有在预期工资更高的情况下，工人才会迁移；而便利条件差异则意味着某些地区必须支付更高的报酬来吸引工人。我们发现，这些影响虽然较为温和，但具有重要意义。我们估算出，消除所有迁移障碍后，劳动生产率将提升22%。如果将迁移成本降低到与高流动性地区相当的水平，劳动生产率将提升7.1%。这些数字掩盖了显著的异质性现象。受益最大的原籍人口，在完全消除迁移障碍的情况下，平均收入将增加104%；而迁移到高流动性地区后，收入则增加25%。

abstract.text: This paper considers cost-reducing R&D investment with spillovers in a Cournot oligopoly with overlapping ownership. We show that overlapping ownership leads to internalization of rivals’ profits by firms and find that, for demand not too convex, increases in overlapping ownership increase (decrease) R&D and output for high (low) enough spillovers while they increase R&D but decrease output for intermediate levels of spillovers. There is scope for overlapping ownership to improve welfare and consumer surplus, provided that spillovers are sufficiently large. The results obtained are robust when R&D has commitment value and in a Bertrand oligopoly model with product differentiation.

10.1086/701811.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在具有重叠所有权的Cournot寡头垄断市场中，降低研发成本并带来溢出效应的研究。我们指出，重叠所有权会导致企业内化竞争对手的利润，并且发现，对于需求不是过于凸的情况，当重叠所有权程度足够高时，会增加研发投入和产出；而对于中等程度的溢出效应，则会增加研发投入但减少产出。只要溢出效应足够大，重叠所有权确实可以提高福利和消费者剩余。这些结果在研发具有承诺价值的情况下仍然成立，并且在具有产品差异性的Bertrand寡头垄断模型中同样适用。

abstract.text: We study the mechanics of cartel enforcement and its interaction with bidding constraints in the context of repeated procurement auctions. Under collusion, bidding constraints weaken cartels by limiting the scope of punishment. This yields a test of collusive behavior exploiting the counterintuitive prediction that introducing minimum prices can lower the winning-bid distribution. The model’s predictions are borne out in Japanese procurement data, where we find evidence that minimum prices weakened collusion. A robust design insight is that setting a minimum price at the bottom of the observed winning-bid distribution necessarily improves over a minimum price of zero.

10.1086/701812.abstractZh: 我们研究了卡特尔执行机制及其在重复采购拍卖中与投标约束相互作用的情况。在勾结行为下，投标约束通过限制惩罚范围来削弱卡特尔的力量。这一发现验证了那种反直觉的预测，即引入最低价格可以降低中标分布。模型的预测在日本采购数据中得到验证，我们发现最低价格确实削弱了勾结行为。一个重要的设计原则是，在观察到的中标分布底部设定最低价格，必然比设定零价格更为有效。

abstract.text: We propose a price-theoretic approach to Bayesian persuasion by establishing an analogy between the sender’s problem and finding Walrasian equilibria of a persuasion economy. The sender, who acts as a consumer, purchases posterior beliefs at their prices using the prior distribution as her endowment. A single firm has the technology to garble the state. Welfare theorems provide a verification tool for optimality of a persuasion scheme and characterize the structure of prices that support the optimal solution. This approach yields a tractable solution method for persuasion problems in which the sender’s utility depends only on the expected state.

10.1086/701813.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于价格理论的方法来处理贝叶斯说服问题，通过将发送者的问题与寻找一个说服经济中的瓦尔拉斯均衡进行类比。发送者作为消费者，以预先给定的价格购买后验信念，其初始状态为预先给定的分布。单个企业拥有操纵状态的技术。福利定理为说服方案的最优性提供了验证工具，并描述了支持最优解的价格结构。这种方法为那些发送者的效用仅依赖于预期状态的说服问题提供了一种可行的解决方案。

abstract.text: We examine the quantitative impact of policy-induced changes in firms’ innovative investment on growth in aggregate productivity and output in a model that nests several of the canonical models. We isolate two statistics, the impact elasticity of aggregate productivity growth with respect to aggregate innovative investment and the degree of intertemporal knowledge spillovers in research, that shape the model’s predicted dynamic response to a change in the innovation intensity of the economy. Given measures of these statistics, there is only modest scope for increasing aggregate productivity and output over a 20-year horizon with uniform innovation subsidies to firms’ investments in innovation of a reasonable magnitude, but the welfare gains may be substantial.

10.1086/701823.abstractZh: 我们在一个融合了多个经典模型的模型中，研究了政策引起的企业创新投资变化对总体生产力和产出增长的定量影响。我们确定了两个关键指标：总体生产力增长对创新投资的影响弹性，以及研究过程中知识跨期溢出效应的程度。这些指标决定了模型对经济创新强度变化的动态响应。根据这些指标，我们发现在20年的时间内，通过给予企业合理的创新投资补贴，总体生产力和产出有适度的增长空间，但福利收益可能是相当可观的。

abstract.text: Uncertainty about future economic and climate conditions substantially affects the choice of policies for managing interactions between the climate and the economy. We develop a framework of dynamic stochastic integration of climate and economy, and show that the social cost of carbon is substantially affected by both economic and climate risks and is a stochastic process with significant variation. We examine a wide but plausible range of values for critical parameters with robust results and show that large-scale computing makes it possible to analyze policies in models substantially more complex and realistic than usually used in the literature.

10.1086/701890.abstractZh: 对未来经济和气候状况的不确定性，对管理气候与经济相互作用的政策选择有着重大影响。我们开发了一个动态随机积分的气候与经济框架，并表明碳社会成本受到经济与气候风险的双重影响，是一个具有显著变化的随机过程。我们考察了广泛但合理的临界参数取值范围，并得到了稳健的结果。同时，我们表明大规模计算使得能够分析比文献中通常使用的更为复杂和现实的模型中的政策。

abstract.text: This paper presents a model of a monetary economy where there are differences in liquidity across assets. Money circulates because it is more liquid than other assets, not because it has any special function. The model is used to investigate how aggregate activity and asset prices fluctuate with shocks to productivity and liquidity and to examine what role government policy might have through open-market operations that change the mix of assets held by the private sector.

10.1086/701891.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个货币经济模型，其中不同资产之间的流动性存在差异。货币之所以流通，是因为它比其他资产更具流动性，而非因为它具有任何特殊功能。该模型用于研究在生产力与流动性受到冲击时，整体经济活动及资产价格如何波动，并探讨政府政策通过公开市场操作改变私营部门持有的资产组合，可能发挥的作用。

abstract.text: The paper analyzes the impact of price caps agreed upon by industry participants. Price caps, like mergers, allow firms to solve Cournot’s multiple-marginalization problem, but unlike mergers, they do not stifle price competition in case of substitutes or facilitate foreclosure in case of complements. The paper first demonstrates this for nonrepeated interaction and general demand and cost functions. It then shows that allowing price caps has no impact on investment and entry in case of substitutes. Under more restrictive assumptions, the paper finally generalizes the insights to repeated price interaction, analyzing coordinated effects when goods are not necessarily substitutes.

10.1086/702014.abstractZh: 本文分析了行业参与者共同约定的价格上限的影响。与合并类似，价格上限允许企业解决库尔诺的多边际化问题，但与合并不同的是，价格上限不会抑制替代品之间的价格竞争，也不会导致互补品之间的市场垄断。文章首先针对非重复互动和一般需求与成本函数进行了验证。随后指出，在替代品的情况下，允许价格上限对投资和进入市场没有影响。在更严格的假设下，文章最终将这一结论推广到重复价格互动的情况，分析了非替代品情况下协调效应的影响。

abstract.text: We use data from Denmark, Germany, Norway, the United Kingdom, and the United States to document the degree of educational assortative mating, how it evolves over time, and the extent to which it differs between countries. This descriptive analysis motivates and guides a decomposition analysis in which we quantify the contribution of various factors to the distribution of household income. We find that assortative mating accounts for a nonnegligible part of the cross-sectional inequality in household income in each country. However, changes in assortative mating over time barely move the time trends in household income inequality.

10.1086/702018.abstractZh: 我们利用了丹麦、德国、挪威、英国和美国的データ，来研究教育上的选择性交配程度、其随时间的变化情况，以及不同国家之间这种现象的差异。这项描述性分析为分解分析提供了依据，我们在分解分析中量化了各种因素对家庭收入分布的影响。我们发现，选择性交配在每个国家中都是家庭收入不平等的一个不可忽视的因素。然而，选择性交配随时间的变化对家庭收入不平等的时间趋势几乎没有影响。

abstract.text: We introduce an empirical framework for models of matching with imperfectly transferable utility and unobserved heterogeneity in tastes. Our framework allows us to characterize matching equilibrium in a flexible way that includes as special cases fully and nontransferable utility models, collective models, and settings with taxes on transfers. We allow for the introduction of a general class of additive unobserved heterogeneity on agents' preferences. We show existence and uniqueness of an equilibrium under minimal assumptions. We provide two algorithms to compute the equilibrium in our model. We then show that the associated log likelihood has a simple expression and compute its derivatives. An empirical illustration is provided in the appendix.

10.1086/702020.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个用于描述具有不完全可转移效用以及偏好存在未观测异质性情况下的匹配模型的实证框架。该框架能够以灵活的方式刻画匹配均衡，并将完全不可转移效用模型、集体模型以及存在转移税的情况作为特殊情况纳入其中。我们允许引入一类关于代理人偏好未观测异质性的加性模型。在最小假设条件下，我们证明了均衡的存在性和唯一性。我们还提供了两种算法来计算模型中均衡的状态。接着，我们证明了相关的对数似然函数具有简单的表达式，并计算了其导数。附录中提供了实证示例。

abstract.text: Technology has facilitated new, nontraditional work arrangements, including the ride-sharing company Uber. Uber drivers provide rides anytime they choose. Using data on hourly earnings and driving, we document driver utilization of this real-time flexibility. We propose that the value of flexibility can be measured as deriving from time variation in the drivers' reservation wage. Measuring time variation in drivers' reservation wages allows us to estimate the surplus and labor supply implications of Uber relative to alternative, less-flexible work arrangements. Despite other drawbacks to the Uber arrangement, we estimate that Uber drivers earn more than twice the surplus they would in less-flexible arrangements.

10.1086/702171.abstractZh: 技术促进了新的、非传统的工作安排，其中包括拼车公司Uber。Uber司机可以在他们选择的任何时间提供乘车服务。通过收集关于每小时收入以及驾驶时间的数据，我们记录了司机对这种实时灵活性的利用情况。我们认为，灵活性的价值可以通过司机预订工资的时变来衡量。通过测量司机预订工资的时变，我们可以估算出Uber相对于其他不太灵活的工作安排所带来的收益和劳动力供应方面的优势。尽管Uber存在其他缺点，但我们估计，Uber司机获得的收益是其他不太灵活安排的两倍以上。

abstract.text: We offer a propensity score perspective to interpret and analyze the marginal treatment effect (MTE). Specifically, we redefine MTE as the expected treatment effect conditional on the propensity score and a latent variable representing unobserved resistance to treatment. As with the original MTE, the redefined MTE can be used as a building block for constructing standard causal estimands. The weights associated with the new MTE, however, are simpler, more intuitive, and easier to compute. Moreover, the redefined MTE immediately reveals treatment effect heterogeneity among individuals at the margin of treatment, enabling us to evaluate a wide range of policy effects.

10.1086/702172.abstractZh: 我们采用倾向得分视角来解释和分析边际处理效应（MTE）。具体来说，我们将MTE定义为在倾向得分和代表未观察到的治疗抵抗的潜在变量条件下的预期处理效应。与原始的MTE一样，重新定义的MTE可以作为构建标准因果估计量的基础。然而，与新的MTE相关的权重更为简单、直观且易于计算。此外，重新定义的MTE能够立即揭示个体在边际处理状态下的处理效应异质性，使我们能够评估各种政策效应。

abstract.text: We analyze the competitive effects of mergers in markets with buyer power. Using mechanism design arguments, we show that without cost synergies, mergers harm buyers, regardless of buyer power. However, buyer power mitigates the harm to a buyer from a merger of symmetric suppliers. With buyer power, a merger increases incentives for entry, increases investment incentives for rivals, and can increase investment incentives for merging parties. Because buyer power reduces the profitability of a merger, it increases the profitability of perfect collusion relative to a merger. Cost synergies can eliminate merger harm but also render otherwise profitable mergers unprofitable.

10.1086/702173.abstractZh: 我们分析了在买方力量存在的市场中，合并对竞争的影响。通过机制设计理论的分析，我们发现，如果没有成本协同效应，合并会对买方造成伤害，无论买方力量如何。然而，买方力量可以缓解对称供应商合并对买方造成的损害。在买方力量存在的情况下，合并会增加进入市场的激励，提高竞争对手的投资激励，并可能增加合并双方的投资激励。由于买方力量降低了合并的盈利能力，因此相对于完全勾结而言，合并的盈利能力会有所提高。成本协同效应可以消除合并带来的损害，但也可能使原本具有盈利性的合并变得无利可图。

abstract.text: We develop a set of frameworks for welfare analysis of Medicaid and apply them to the Oregon Health Insurance Experiment, a Medicaid expansion for low-income, uninsured adults that occurred via random assignment. Across different approaches, we estimate recipient willingness to pay for Medicaid between $0.5 and $1.2 per dollar of the resource cost of providing Medicaid; estimates of the expected transfer Medicaid provides to recipients are relatively stable across approaches, but estimates of its additional value from risk protection are more variable. We also estimate that the resource cost of providing Medicaid to an additional recipient is only 40% of Medicaid's total cost; 60% of Medicaid spending is a transfer to providers of uncompensated care for the low-income uninsured.

10.1086/702238.abstractZh: 我们开发了一套用于福利分析的框架，并将其应用于俄勒冈健康保险实验。该实验是对低收入、无保险成年人进行的医疗补助扩展计划，通过随机分配方式实施。通过不同的方法，我们估计了接受医疗补助的民众愿意支付的费用，大约在每美元医疗补助资源成本0.5到1.2美元之间；医疗补助对接受者的预期转移效果在不同方法下相对稳定，但其在风险保护方面的额外价值则更为多变。我们还估计，为额外一名接受者提供医疗补助的资源成本仅占总成本的40%；医疗补助支出的60%是向低收入无保险人群提供的无补偿护理服务。

abstract.text: We examine the equilibrium effects of college financial aid policies building an overlapping-generations life cycle model with education, labor supply, and saving decisions. Cognitive and noncognitive skills of children depend on parental education and skills and affect education and labor market outcomes. Education is funded by parental transfers that supplement grants, loans, and student labor supply. Crowding out of parental transfers by government programs is sizable and cannot be ignored. The current system of federal aid improves long-run welfare by 6 percent. More generous ability-tested grants would increase welfare and dominate both an expansion of student loans and a labor tax cut.

10.1086/702241.abstractZh: 我们研究了大学经济援助政策的均衡效应，构建了一个包含教育、劳动力供给和储蓄决策的跨代生命周期模型。儿童的认知和非认知技能取决于父母的受教育程度和技能，这些因素会影响其教育和劳动力市场的结果。教育资金来源于父母的转移支付，这些转移支付补充了助学金、贷款以及学生劳动力供给。政府项目对父母转移支付的影响相当大，不容忽视。当前的联邦经济援助体系通过提高6%的长期福利来改善社会状况。更慷慨的能力评估型助学金将提升福利水平，并且能够超越学生贷款的增加以及劳动力税收减免的影响。

abstract.text: By how much does an extension of unemployment benefits affect macroeconomic outcomes such as unemployment? Answering this question is challenging because U.S. law extends benefits for states experiencing high unemployment. We use data revisions to decompose the variation in the duration of benefits into the part coming from actual differences in economic conditions and the part coming from measurement error in the real-time data used to determine benefit extensions. Using only the variation coming from measurement error, we find that benefit extensions have a limited influence on state-level macroeconomic outcomes. We apply our estimates to the increase in the duration of benefits during the Great Recession and find that they increased the unemployment rate by at most 0.3 percentage point.

10.1093/qje/qjy018.abstractZh: 失业救济金的延长会对宏观经济结果，如失业率产生多大的影响？回答这个问题颇具挑战性，因为美国法律允许为失业率较高的州延长救济金期限。我们通过数据修订将救济金持续时间的差异分解为两部分：一部分是由于实际的经济条件差异导致的，另一部分则是用于确定救济金延长的实时数据测量误差所致。仅考虑测量误差导致的差异，我们发现救济金延长的宏观经济影响有限。我们将这些估计结果应用于大衰退期间救济金持续时间的延长情况，发现它们使失业率增加了最多0.3个百分点。

abstract.text: Since the 1972 U.S. Clean Water Act, government and industry have invested over |${\$}$|1 trillion to abate water pollution, or |${\$}$|100 per person-year. Over half of U.S. stream and river miles, however, still violate pollution standards. We use the most comprehensive set of files ever compiled on water pollution and its determinants, including 50 million pollution readings from 240,000 monitoring sites and a network model of all U.S. rivers, to study water pollution’s trends, causes, and welfare consequences. We have three main findings. First, water pollution concentrations have fallen substantially. Between 1972 and 2001, for example, the share of waters safe for fishing grew by 12 percentage points. Second, the Clean Water Act’s grants to municipal wastewater treatment plants, which account for |${\$}$|650 billion in expenditure, caused some of these declines. Through these grants, it cost around |${\$}$|1.5 million (2014 dollars) to make one river-mile fishable for a year. We find little displacement of municipal expenditure due to a federal grant. Third, the grants’ estimated effects on housing values are smaller than the grants’ costs; we carefully discuss welfare implications.

10.1093/qje/qjy019.abstractZh: 自1972年《美国清洁水法》实施以来，政府和工业界已投入超过1万亿美元用于减少水污染，相当于每人每年100美元。然而，美国仍有超过一半的溪流和河流不符合污染标准。我们利用迄今为止最全面的关于水污染及其影响因素的数据集，包括来自24万个监测点的5000万条污染数据，以及所有美国河流的网络模型，来研究水污染的趋势、原因以及其对福利的影响。我们的主要发现有以下三点：首先，水污染浓度显著下降。例如，在1972年至2001年间，适合钓鱼的水域比例增加了12个百分点。其次，《清洁水法》对市政污水处理厂的拨款，占到了65亿美元的支出，这些拨款在一定程度上导致了水污染浓度的下降。通过这些拨款，每年使一条河流可供一年使用所需的费用约为150万美元（按2014年美元计算）。我们发现，由于联邦拨款，市政支出几乎没有被转移。第三，拨款对房价的影响小于拨款的成本；我们仔细讨论了这些影响的福利含义。

abstract.text: We use insurance claims data covering 28% of individuals with employer-sponsored health insurance in the United States to study the variation in health spending on the privately insured, examine the structure of insurer-hospital contracts, and analyze the variation in hospital prices across the nation. Health spending per privately insured beneficiary differs by a factor of three across geographic areas and has a very low correlation with Medicare spending. For the privately insured, half of the spending variation is driven by price variation across regions, and half is driven by quantity variation. Prices vary substantially across regions, across hospitals within regions, and even within hospitals. For example, even for a nearly homogeneous service such as lower-limb magnetic resonance imaging, about a fifth of the total case-level price variation occurs within a hospital in the cross section. Hospital market structure is strongly associated with price levels and contract structure. Prices at monopoly hospitals are 12% higher than those in markets with four or more rivals. Monopoly hospitals also have contracts that load more risk on insurers (e.g., they have more cases with prices set as a share of their charges). In concentrated insurer markets the opposite occurs-hospitals have lower prices and bear more financial risk. Examining the 366 mergers and acquisitions that occurred between 2007 and 2011, we find that prices increased by over 6% when the merging hospitals were geographically close (e.g., 5 miles or less apart), but not when the hospitals were geographically distant (e.g., over 25 miles apart).

10.1093/qje/qjy020.abstractZh: 我们利用涵盖美国28%拥有雇主赞助健康保险个体的保险索赔数据，研究私人保险客户的医疗支出差异，分析保险公司与医院之间的合同结构，并分析全国范围内医院价格的差异。私人保险客户的医疗支出在不同地区之间存在三倍的差异，且与医疗保险支出的相关性非常低。对于私人保险客户而言，支出差异的一半是由地区间的价格差异引起的，另一半则是由数量差异引起的。不同地区的价格差异很大，同一地区内的医院之间也存在价格差异，甚至同一医院内部也存在价格差异。例如，即使是像下肢磁共振成像这样的几乎同质服务，总价格差异的约五分之一也发生在同一医院内部。医院的市场结构与价格水平和合同结构密切相关。垄断医院的定价比拥有四个或更多竞争对手的市场高出12%。垄断医院还签订了将更多风险转嫁给保险公司的合同（例如，这些医院的某些病例的价格是其收费的一部分）。在保险公司集中的市场中，情况则相反——医院的价格较低，但承担更多的财务风险。通过对2007年至2011年间发生的366起并购案例进行分析，我们发现，当合并的医院地理位置相近（例如，相距5英里或更少）时，价格上升了6%以上，而当医院地理位置相距较远（例如，超过25英里）时，价格则没有变化。

abstract.text: We argue that the time-varying regional distribution of housing equity influences the aggregate consequences of monetary policy through its effects on mortgage refinancing. Using detailed loan-level data, we show that regional differences in housing equity affect refinancing and spending responses to interest rate cuts, but these effects vary over time with changes in the regional distribution of house price growth. We build a heterogeneous household model of refinancing with mortgage borrowers and lenders and use it to explore the monetary policy implications arising from our regional evidence. We find that the 2008 equity distribution made spending in depressed regions less responsive to interest rate cuts, thus dampening aggregate stimulus and increasing regional consumption inequality, whereas the opposite occurred in some earlier recessions. Taken together, our results strongly suggest that monetary policy makers should track the regional distribution of equity over time.

10.1093/qje/qjy021.abstractZh: 我们认为，住房权益的区域性分布随时间变化，会通过其对抵押贷款再融资的影响来影响货币政策的总体效果。利用详细的贷款数据，我们发现住房权益的区域差异会影响再融资行为以及对利率下调的响应，但这些影响随时间变化而变化，这与房价增长区域分布的变化有关。我们建立了一个包含抵押贷款借款人和贷款人的异质家庭再融资模型，并利用该模型来探讨我们的区域证据所揭示的货币政策含义。我们发现，2008年的权益分布使得经济萧条地区的消费对利率下调的响应减弱，从而削弱了整体刺激效果，并加剧了地区间的消费不平等；而在一些早期的经济衰退中则出现了相反的情况。综合来看，我们的研究结果强烈表明，货币政策制定者应该关注权益的区域性分布随时间的变化。

abstract.text: In this article, we analyze how inflation affects firms’ price-setting behavior. For a class of menu cost models, we derive several predictions about how price-setting changes with inflation at very high and at near-zero inflation rates. Then, we present evidence supporting these predictions using product-level data underlying Argentina’s consumer price index from 1988 to 1997—a unique experience where monthly inflation ranged from almost 200% to less than zero. For low inflation rates, we find that (i) the frequency and absolute size of price changes as well as the dispersion of relative prices do not change with inflation, (ii) the frequency and size of price increases and decreases are symmetric around zero inflation, and (iii) aggregate inflation changes are mostly driven by changes in the frequency of price increases and decreases, as opposed to the size of price changes. For high inflation rates, we find that (iv) the elasticity of the frequency of price changes with respect to inflation is close to two-thirds, (v) the frequency of price changes across different products becomes similar, and (vi) the elasticity of the dispersion of relative prices with respect to inflation is one-third. Our findings confirm and extend available evidence for countries that experienced either very high or near-zero inflation. We conclude by showing that a hyperinflation of 500% a year is associated with a cost of approximately 8.5% of aggregate output a year as a result of inefficient price dispersion alone.

10.1093/qje/qjy022.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们分析了通货膨胀如何影响企业的定价行为。针对一类菜单成本模型，我们得出了关于价格设定如何随通货膨胀率的变化而变化的几个预测。然后，我们使用1988年至1997年间阿根廷消费者价格指数背后的产品级数据来支持这些预测——这一独特时期内的月通货膨胀率从接近200%到低于零不等。对于低通货膨胀率，我们发现：(i) 价格变化的频率和绝对幅度以及相对价格的分散度并不随通货膨胀而变化；(ii) 价格上涨和下降的频率和幅度在零通货膨胀率附近是对称的；(iii) 总体通货膨胀的变化主要由价格上涨和下降的频率变化所驱动，而非价格变化的幅度。对于高通货膨胀率，我们发现：(iv) 价格变化频率对通货膨胀的弹性接近三分之二；(v) 不同产品的价格变化频率变得相似；(vi) 相对价格分散度对通货膨胀的弹性为三分之一。我们的发现证实并扩展了有关经历过高或接近零通货膨胀率的国家的现有证据。最后，我们指出，每年500%的恶性通货膨胀会导致总产出损失约8.5%，这主要是由于价格分散度的低效造成的。

abstract.text: Agricultural productivity is particularly low in developing countries.
