Output-sharing rules that make farmers less-than-full residual claimants are seen as a potentially important driver of low agricultural productivity. We report results from a field experiment designed to estimate and understand the effects of sharecropping contracts on agricultural input choices, risk-taking, and output. The experiment induced variation in the terms of sharecropping contracts. After agreeing to pay 50% of their output to the landlord, tenants were randomized into three groups: (i) some kept 50% of their output; (ii) others kept 75%; (iii) others kept 50% of output and received a lump-sum payment at the end of their contract, either fixed or stochastic. We find that tenants with higher output shares used more inputs, cultivated riskier crops, and produced 60% more output relative to control. Income or risk exposure have at most a small effect on farm output; the increase in output should be interpreted as an incentive effect of the output-sharing rule.

10.1093/qje/qjy023.abstractZh: 发展中国家的农业生产力尤其低下。将农民视为不完全享有剩余收益的产出分配规则，被认为是导致农业生产力低下的一个重要因素。我们报告了一项田间实验的结果，该实验旨在评估分享契约对农业投入选择、风险承担和产出的影响。实验中改变了分享契约的条款。在同意向地主支付50%的产出后，租户被随机分为三组：(i) 部分租户保留50%的产出；(ii) 其他租户保留75%的产出；(iii) 另一些租户保留50%的产出，并在合同结束时获得固定或随机的一次性付款。我们发现，拥有更高产出份额的租户使用了更多的投入，种植了风险更高的作物，并且相对于对照组，他们的产出增加了60%。收入或风险暴露对农场产出的影响很小；产出的增加应被解释为产出分配规则的激励效应。

abstract.text: This article examines the long-term consequences of a historical human capital intervention. The Jesuit order founded religious missions in 1609 among the Guaraní, in modern-day Argentina, Brazil, and Paraguay. Before their expulsion in 1767, missionaries instructed indigenous inhabitants in reading, writing, and various crafts. Using archival records, as well as data at the individual and municipal level, I show that in areas of former Jesuit presence—within the Guaraní area—educational attainment was higher and remains so (by 10%–15%) 250 years later. These educational differences have also translated into incomes that are 10% higher today. The identification of the positive effect of the Guaraní Jesuit missions emerges after comparing them with abandoned Jesuit missions and neighboring Franciscan Guaraní missions. The enduring effects observed are consistent with transmission mechanisms of structural transformation, occupational specialization, and technology adoption in agriculture.

10.1093/qje/qjy024.abstractZh: 本文探讨了历史上人类资本干预的长期影响。耶稣会于1609年在阿根廷、巴西和巴拉圭的瓜拉尼地区建立了宗教传教站。在1767年被驱逐之前，传教士向当地居民传授读写技能以及各种手工艺。通过档案记录以及个人和市级层面的数据，我发现，在耶稣会传教站曾经存在的地区，教育水平更高，并且在250年后仍然保持这种水平（高出10%至15%）。这些教育上的差异也导致了如今收入高出10%。通过与废弃的耶稣会传教站以及邻近的方济各会瓜拉尼传教站进行比较，我们发现了瓜拉尼耶稣会传教站的积极效应。所观察到的持久影响与结构转型、职业专业化以及农业技术采纳的传递机制相一致。

abstract.text: We use a massive, matched employer-employee database for the United States to analyze the contribution of firms to the rise in earnings inequality from 1978 to 2013. We find that one-third of the rise in the variance of (log) earnings occurred within firms, whereas two-thirds of the rise occurred due to a rise in the dispersion of average earnings between firms. However, this rising between-firm variance is not accounted for by the firms themselves but by a widening gap between firms in the composition of their workers. This compositional change can be split into two roughly equal parts: high-wage workers became increasingly likely to work in high-wage firms (i.e., sorting increased), and high-wage workers became increasingly likely to work with each other (i.e., segregation rose). In contrast, we do not find a rise in the variance of firm-specific pay once we control for the worker composition in firms. Finally, we find that two-thirds of the rise in the within-firm variance of earnings occurred within mega (10,000+ employee) firms, which saw a particularly large increase in the variance of earnings compared with smaller firms.

10.1093/qje/qjy025.abstractZh: 我们利用美国庞大的雇主-雇员数据库，分析1978年至2013年间企业对于收入不平等加剧的贡献。研究发现，收入（对数）方差增加的三分之一源于企业内部的变化，而三分之二的增加则由于企业间平均收入分布的分散性加剧所致。然而，这种企业间收入方差的增加并非由企业自身造成，而是由企业员工构成中的差距扩大所导致。这种构成变化可以大致分为两部分：高薪工人越来越倾向于在高薪企业工作（即排序加剧），同时高薪工人之间也越来越多地相互合作（即隔离加剧）。相比之下，当我们控制了企业员工的构成后，并未发现企业特定薪酬的方差有所上升。最后，我们发现，企业内部收入方差增加的三分之二发生在员工数量超过10,000人的大型企业，这些企业的收入方差相比小型企业有显著的增加。

abstract.text: We decompose violations of uncovered interest parity into a cross-currency, a betweentime-and-currency, and a cross-time component. We show that most of the systematic violations are in the cross-currency dimension. By contrast, we find no statistically reliable evidence that currency risk premia respond to deviations of forward premia from their time- and currency-specific mean. These results imply that the forward premium puzzle (FPP) and the carry-trade anomaly are separate phenomena that may require separate explanations. The carry trade is driven by static differences in interest rates across currencies, whereas the FPP appears to be driven primarily by cross-time variation in all currency risk premia against the US dollar. Models that feature two symmetric countries thus cannot explain either of the two phenomena. Once we make the appropriate econometric adjustments we also cannot reject the hypothesis that the elasticity of risk premia with respect to forward premia in all three dimensions is smaller than one. As a result, currency risk premia need not be correlated with expected changes in exchange rates.

10.1093/qje/qjy026.abstractZh: 我们将未揭示的利率平价违反行为分解为跨货币、时间-货币以及时间维度上的违反。我们发现，大多数系统性违反行为都发生在跨货币维度上。相比之下，我们没有发现任何统计上可靠的证据表明货币风险溢价会响应远期溢价与其时间和货币特定均值之间的偏差。这些结果意味着，远期溢价之谜和套利交易异常现象是两种不同的现象，可能需要不同的解释。套利交易是由不同货币之间的利率静态差异驱动的，而远期溢价则主要受到所有货币风险溢价相对于美元的时间变化的影响。因此，包含两个对称国家的模型无法解释这两种现象中的任何一种。一旦我们进行了适当的计量经济学调整，我们也不能拒绝这样一个假设：风险溢价相对于远期溢价的弹性在三个维度上都小于1。因此，货币风险溢价不必与汇率的预期变化相关。

abstract.text: Using data on over a million land transactions during 2004–2016 where local governments are the sole seller, we find that firms linked to members of China's supreme political elites—the Politburo—obtained a price discount ranging from 55.4% to 59.9% compared with those without the same connections. These firms also purchased slightly more land. In return, the provincial party secretaries who provided the discount to these “princeling” firms are 23.4% more likely to be promoted to positions of national leadership. To curb corruption, President Xi Jinping stepped up investigations and strengthened personnel control at the province level. Using a spatially matched sample (e.g., within a 500-meter radius), we find a reduction in corruption of between 42.6% and 31.5% in the provinces either targeted by the central inspection teams or whose party secretary was replaced by one appointed by Xi. Accordingly, this crackdown on corruption has also significantly reduced the promotional prospects of those local officials who rely on supplying a discount to get ahead.

10.1093/qje/qjy027.abstractZh: 通过对2004年至2016年间超过一百万笔地方政府独家出售的土地交易数据进行分析，我们发现与中国的政治精英——政治局成员有联系的企业，相比没有这些联系的企业，能够以55.4%到59.9%的价格优势获得土地。这些企业购买的土地数量也略多一些。作为回报，为这些“精英企业”提供价格优惠的省级党委书记，其被提拔到国家领导职位的几率高出23.4%。为了遏制腐败，习近平主席加强了调查力度，并加强了省级层面的人员管控。通过空间匹配样本（例如，在500米半径范围内），我们发现，那些受到中央检查组检查或党委书记被习近平任命的人，其腐败程度降低了42.6%到31.5%。因此，这种反腐败措施也显著降低了那些通过提供优惠来谋取晋升机会的地方官员的晋升前景。

abstract.text: We characterize the factors that determine who becomes an inventor in the United States, focusing on the role of inventive ability (“nature”) versus environment (“nurture”). Using deidentified data on 1.2 million inventors from patent records linked to tax records, we first show that children’s chances of becoming inventors vary sharply with characteristics at birth, such as their race, gender, and parents’ socioeconomic class. For example, children from high-income (top 1%) families are 10 times as likely to become inventors as those from below-median income families. These gaps persist even among children with similar math test scores in early childhood—which are highly predictive of innovation rates—suggesting that the gaps may be driven by differences in environment rather than abilities to innovate. We directly establish the importance of environment by showing that exposure to innovation during childhood has significant causal effects on children’s propensities to invent. Children whose families move to a high-innovation area when they are young are more likely to become inventors. These exposure effects are technology class and gender specific. Children who grow up in a neighborhood or family with a high innovation rate in a specific technology class are more likely to patent in exactly the same class. Girls are more likely to invent in a particular class if they grow up in an area with more women (but not men) who invent in that class. These gender- and technology class–specific exposure effects are more likely to be driven by narrow mechanisms, such as role-model or network effects, than factors that only affect general human capital accumulation, such as the quality of schools. Consistent with the importance of exposure effects in career selection, women and disadvantaged youth are as underrepresented among high-impact inventors as they are among inventors as a whole. These findings suggest that there are many “lost Einsteins”—individuals who would have had highly impactful inventions had they been exposed to innovation in childhood—especially among women, minorities, and children from low-income families.

10.1093/qje/qjy028.abstractZh: 我们分析了决定谁会成为美国发明家的因素，重点关注了创新能力（“天性”）与环境（“后天因素”）的作用。利用与税务记录相关的120万发明家的匿名数据，我们首先发现，儿童成为发明家的可能性与其出生时的特征密切相关，例如种族、性别以及父母的社会经济阶层。例如，来自高收入家庭（前1%）的儿童成为发明家的可能性是来自低收入家庭儿童的10倍。即使是在早期数学测试成绩相似的情况下，这些差异仍然存在——而数学测试成绩通常能很好地预测创新率——这表明这些差异可能主要由环境因素而非创新能力所驱动。我们通过实证分析直接证明了环境的重要性，发现童年时期接触创新对儿童的发明倾向有显著的因果效应。那些在幼年时期搬到了高创新地区的家庭的孩子更有可能成为发明家。这些接触效应与技术类别和性别有关。在特定技术类别中，成长于高创新率社区或家庭的儿童更有可能在同一类别中申请专利。如果女孩成长于有更多女性（而非男性）在该类别中从事发明工作的地区，她们更有可能在该类别中发明。这些与性别和技术类别相关的接触效应更可能由特定机制所驱动，如榜样效应或网络效应，而非仅影响一般人力资本积累的因素，如学校质量。与职业选择中曝光效应的重要性相一致，女性和弱势青年在具有重大影响力的发明者中所占比例同样偏低。这些发现表明，有许多“失落的爱因斯坦”——即那些如果在童年时期能够接触到创新的话，本可以做出具有重大影响力的发明的个体，尤其是在女性、少数族裔以及来自低收入家庭的儿童中。

abstract.text: I follow R. A. Fisher's,The Design of Experiments (1935), using randomization statistical inference to test the null hypothesis of no treatment effects in a comprehensive sample of 53 experimental papers drawn from the journals of the American Economic Association. In the average paper, randomization tests of the significance of individual treatment effects find 13% to 22% fewer significant results than are found using authors’ methods. In joint tests of multiple treatment effects appearing together in tables, randomization tests yield 33% to 49% fewer statistically significant results than conventional tests. Bootstrap and jackknife methods support and confirm the randomization results.

10.1093/qje/qjy029.abstractZh: 我遵循R. A. Fisher在《实验设计》（1935年）中的方法，使用随机化统计推断来检验53篇来自美国经济学会期刊的实验论文中不存在处理效应的零假设。在平均情况下，使用随机化检验对单个处理效应的显著性进行统计分析时，显著结果的数量比使用作者自身的方法少13%到22%。在表格中同时出现的多个处理效应的联合检验中，随机化检验得出的统计显著结果比传统方法少33%到49%。自助法和小刀法也支持并证实了随机化检验的结果。

abstract.text: This article examines how product innovations led to inflation inequality in the United States from 2004 to 2015. Using scanner data from the retail sector, I find that annual inflation for retail products was 0.661 (std. err. 0.0535) percentage points higher for the bottom income quintile relative to the top income quintile. When including changes in product variety over time, this difference increases to 0.8846 (std. err. 0.0739) percentage points a year. In CEX-CPI data covering the full consumption basket, the annual inflation difference is 0.368 (std. err. 0.0502) percentage points. I investigate the following hypothesis: (i) the relative demand for products consumed by high-income households increased because of growth and rising inequality; (ii) in response, firms introduced more new products catering to such households; (iii) as a result, the prices of continuing products in these market segments fell due to increased competitive pressure. Using a shift-share research design, I find causal evidence that increasing relative demand leads to increasing product variety and lower inflation for continuing products. A calibration indicates that the hypothesized channel accounts for a large fraction (over 50%) of observed inflation inequality. JEL Codes: E31, I31, I32, O30, O31, O33.

10.1093/qje/qjy031.abstractZh: 本文探讨了从2004年到2015年间，产品创新如何导致美国通货膨胀的不平等现象。通过零售行业的扫描数据，我发现零售产品的年度通货膨胀率，对于收入最低的五分位数家庭而言，比收入最高的五分位数家庭高出0.661个百分点（标准差为0.0535）。当考虑到产品种类随时间的变化时，这一差异增加到每年0.8846个百分点（标准差为0.0739）。在涵盖全部消费篮子的CEX-CPI数据中，年度通货膨胀差异为0.368个百分点（标准差为0.0502）。我研究了以下假设：(i) 由于经济增长和不平等加剧，高收入家庭对产品的相对需求增加；(ii) 作为回应，企业推出了更多针对这类家庭的新产品；(iii) 因此，这些市场细分领域的持续产品价格因竞争压力增加而下降。通过采用移位分享研究设计，我发现因果证据表明，相对需求的增加会导致产品种类的增加以及持续产品的通货膨胀率降低。校准结果显示，假设中的渠道解释了观测到的通货膨胀不平等的很大一部分（超过50%）。JEL代码：E31, I31, I32, O30, O31, O33。

abstract.text: Using the Consumption Activities Mail Survey (CAMS) module in the HRS, we document how individual time allocations change when one or more household members transitions from full-time work to not working. We find that the ratio of home production to leisure time is approximately constant for both family members. Using a model of household labor supply to understand the implications of this finding, we conclude that the elasticity of substitution between the leisure of the two members is quite large. This elasticity plays a key role in models of household labor supply and is important for understanding how changes in relative wages and taxes affect household labor supply.

10.1093/qje/qjy032.abstractZh: 我们利用HRS中的消费活动邮件调查模块，记录了当一名或多名家庭成员从全职工作转为不工作时，个人时间分配的变化情况。我们发现，对于两名家庭成员而言，家庭生产时间与休闲时间的比例大致保持不变。通过构建家庭劳动力供给模型来理解这一发现的影响，我们得出结论：两名家庭成员之间的休闲时间替代弹性相当大。这一弹性在家庭劳动力供给模型中起着关键作用，对于理解相对工资和税收的变化如何影响家庭劳动力供给具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This article provides a comprehensive history of anchor or reference currencies, exchange rate arrangements, and a new measure of foreign exchange restrictions for 194 countries and territories over 1946–2016. We find that the often cited post–Bretton Woods transition from fixed to flexible arrangements is overstated; regimes with limited flexibility remain in the majority. Even if central bankers’ communications jargon has evolved considerably in recent decades, it is apparent that many still place a large implicit weight on the exchange rate. The U.S. dollar scores as the world's dominant anchor currency by a very large margin. By some metrics, its use is far wider today than 70 years ago. In contrast, the global role of the euro appears to have stalled. We argue that in addition to the usual safe assets story, the record accumulation of reserves since 2002 may also have to do with many countries’ desire to stabilize exchange rates in an environment of markedly reduced exchange rate restrictions or, more broadly, capital controls: an important amendment to the conventional portrayal of the macroeconomic trilemma.

10.1093/qje/qjy033.abstractZh: 本文全面回顾了1946年至2016年间194个国家和地区锚定货币或参考货币、汇率安排以及外汇限制的新衡量标准的历史。我们发现，关于布雷顿森林体系之后从固定汇率制度向浮动汇率制度过渡的论述被夸大了；大多数国家仍然采用具有有限灵活性的汇率制度。尽管中央银行官员的沟通用语在最近几十年发生了显著变化，但显然许多人仍然非常重视汇率因素。美元作为全球主导锚定货币的地位依然非常稳固。根据某些指标，如今美元的使用范围比70年前要广泛得多。相比之下，欧元的全球角色似乎有所停滞。我们认为，除了通常提到的避险资产因素外，自2002年以来储备金的累积也可能与许多国家希望在汇率限制大幅减少或更广泛意义上的资本管制环境下稳定汇率的愿望有关。这或许是对传统宏观经济三难困境描述的重要修正。

abstract.text: Large and regular seasonal price fluctuations in local grain markets appear to offer African farmers substantial intertemporal arbitrage opportunities, but these opportunities remain largely unexploited. Small-scale farmers are commonly observed to “sell low and buy high,” rather than the reverse. In a field experiment in Kenya, we show that credit market imperfections limit farmers’ abilities to move grain intertemporally. Providing timely access to credit allows farmers to buy at lower prices and sell at higher prices, increasing farm revenues and generating a return on investment of 29%. To understand general equilibrium (GE) effects of these changes in behavior, we vary the density of loan offers across locations. We document significant effects of the credit intervention on seasonal price fluctuations in local grain markets, and show that these GE effects shape individual-level profitability estimates. In contrast to existing experimental work, the results indicate a setting in which microcredit can improve firm profitability, and suggest that GE effects can substantially shape microcredit’s effectiveness. In particular, failure to consider these GE effects could lead to underestimates of the social welfare benefits of microcredit interventions.

10.1093/qje/qjy034.abstractZh: 当地粮食市场中存在较大且规律的季节性价格波动，这为非洲农民提供了丰富的跨时滞套利机会，但这些机会大多未被充分利用。通常观察到小规模农民的做法是“低价出售、高价购买”，而非相反。在肯尼亚的一项实地实验中，我们发现信贷市场的缺陷限制了农民跨时滞进行粮食交易的能力。及时获得信贷使农民能够以较低的价格购买粮食，并以较高的价格出售，从而增加了农场收入，并实现了29%的投资回报。为了了解这些行为变化对一般均衡的影响，我们改变了不同地区的贷款提供密度。我们发现信贷干预对当地粮食市场的季节性价格波动有显著影响，并且这些一般均衡效应会影响个体层面的盈利能力估计。与现有的实验研究不同，这些结果表明小额信贷可以提高企业的盈利能力，并表明一般均衡效应可以显著影响小额信贷的有效性。特别是，如果不考虑这些一般均衡效应，可能会导致对小额信贷干预带来的社会福利效益的低估。

abstract.text: Across the social sciences, a key question is how societies manage to enforce cooperative behavior in social dilemmas such as public goods provision or bilateral trade. According to an influential body of theories in psychology, anthropology, and evolutionary biology, the answer is that humans have evolved moral systems: packages of functional psychological and biological mechanisms that regulate economic behavior, including a belief in moralizing gods; moral values; negative reciprocity; and emotions of shame, guilt, and disgust. Based on a stylized model, this article empirically studies the structure and evolution of these moral traits as a function of historical heterogeneity in extended kinship relationships. The evidence shows that societies with a historically tightly knit kinship structure regulate behavior through communal moral values, revenge taking, emotions of external shame, and notions of purity and disgust. In loose kinship societies, on the other hand, cooperation appears to be enforced through universal moral values, internalized guilt, altruistic punishment, and an apparent rise and fall of moralizing religions. These patterns point to the presence of internally consistent but culturally variable functional moral systems. Consistent with the model, the relationship between kinship ties, economic development, and the structure of the mediating moral systems amplified over time.

10.1093/qje/qjz001.abstractZh: 在众多社会科学领域，一个关键问题是：社会如何能够在诸如公共物品提供或双边贸易等社会困境中强制实施合作行为。根据心理学、人类学和进化生物学领域的一些有影响力的理论，答案是人类进化出了道德体系：一套功能性的心理和生物学机制，用于调节经济行为，包括对道德化神的信仰、道德价值观、负向互惠以及羞耻、内疚和厌恶等情绪。基于一个简化的模型，本文通过实证研究探讨了这些道德特征的结构与演变，以及它们如何受到历史上有差异的亲属关系结构的影响。研究表明，具有紧密亲属关系结构的社会通过共同的道德价值观、报复行为、外部羞耻感以及纯洁与厌恶的概念来规范行为。而在亲属关系较为松散的社会中，合作则似乎是通过普遍的道德价值观、内化的内疚感、利他性惩罚以及道德化宗教的兴衰来强制实施的。这些模式表明，存在内在一致但文化上有所差异的功能性道德体系。与模型一致的是，亲属关系、经济发展以及中介道德体系的结构之间的关系随着时间的推移而得到加强。

abstract.text: Social scientists have long viewed the decision to protest as strategic, with an individual's participation a function of their beliefs about others’ turnout. We conduct a framed field experiment that recalibrates individuals’ beliefs about others’ protest participation, in the context of Hong Kong's ongoing antiauthoritarian movement. We elicit subjects’ planned participation in an upcoming protest and their prior beliefs about others’ participation, in an incentivized manner. One day before the protest, we randomly provide a subset of subjects with truthful information about others’ protest plans and elicit posterior beliefs about protest turnout, again in an incentivized manner. After the protest, we elicit subjects’ actual participation. This allows us to identify the causal effects of positively and negatively updated beliefs about others’ protest participation on subjects’ own turnout. In contrast with the assumptions of many recent models of protest participation, we consistently find evidence of strategic substitutability. We provide guidance regarding plausible sources of strategic substitutability that can be incorporated into theoretical models of protests.

10.1093/qje/qjz002.abstractZh: 社会科学家长期以来将抗议行为的决定视为一种策略性行为，个体的参与程度取决于他们对他人参与情况的看法。我们开展了一项实地实验，重新调整了个体对他人参与抗议行为的看法，实验背景是香港当前持续的反权威运动。我们通过激励方式，收集了受试者在即将举行的抗议活动中的参与计划以及他们之前对他人参与情况的看法。在抗议活动前一天，我们随机向部分受试者提供了关于他人抗议计划真实的信息，并再次通过激励方式收集了他们之后的看法。抗议活动结束后，我们收集了受试者的实际参与情况。这使我们能够确定，对他人参与抗议行为的积极或消极看法，对个体自身的参与行为产生了何种因果效应。与许多关于抗议参与行为的模型假设不同，我们始终发现了策略性替代性的证据。我们提出了一些合理的策略性替代性来源，这些来源可以纳入关于抗议行为的理论模型中。

abstract.text: The home-market effect, first hypothesized by Linder (1961) and later formalized by Krugman (1980), is the idea that countries with larger demand for some products at home tend to have larger sales of the same products abroad. In this article, we develop a simple test of the home-market effect using detailed drug sales data from the global pharmaceutical industry. The core of our empirical strategy is the observation that a country's exogenous demographic composition can be used as a predictor of the diseases that its inhabitants are most likely to die from and, in turn, the drugs they are most likely to demand. We find that the correlation between predicted home demand and sales abroad is positive and greater than the correlation between predicted home demand and purchases from abroad. In short, countries tend to be net sellers of the drugs they demand the most, as predicted by Linder (1961) and Krugman (1980).

10.1093/qje/qjz003.abstractZh: “本土市场效应”这一概念最初由Linder在1961年提出，后来由Krugman在1980年进一步理论化。其核心观点是：那些在国内对某些产品需求较大的国家，其在国外的同类产品销售也往往较为旺盛。在本文中，我们基于全球制药行业的详细药品销售数据，对“本土市场效应”进行了简单的实证检验。我们的实证策略的核心在于：一个国家的外部人口构成可以作为预测其居民最可能患病的疾病以及他们最可能需求的药品的依据。研究发现，预测出的国内需求与国外销售之间的相关性是正向的，并且这一相关性大于预测出的国内需求与国外购买之间的相关性。简而言之，正如Linder（1961）和Krugman（1980）所预测的那样，这些国家往往成为其最需要的药品的净出口国。

abstract.text: This article studies strategic default on forward sale contracts in the international coffee market. To test for strategic default, we construct contract-specific measures of unanticipated changes in market conditions by comparing spot prices at maturity with the relevant futures prices at the contracting date. Unanticipated rises in market prices increase defaults on fixed-price contracts but not on price-indexed ones. We isolate strategic default by focusing on unanticipated rises at the time of delivery after production decisions are sunk and suppliers have been paid. Estimates suggest that roughly half of the observed defaults are strategic. We model how strategic default introduces a trade-off between insurance and counterparty risk: relative to indexed contracts, fixed-price contracts insure against price swings but create incentives to default when market conditions change. A model calibration suggests that the possibility of strategic default causes 15.8% average losses in output, significant dispersion in the marginal product of capital, and sizable negative externalities on supplying farmers.

10.1093/qje/qjz004.abstractZh: 本文研究了国际咖啡市场上远期销售合同中的战略违约行为。为了检验战略违约现象，我们通过比较到期时的现货价格与签订合同时的相关期货价格，构建了针对特定合同的市场条件变化指标。市场价格的意外上涨会增加固定价格合同的违约率，而价格指数合同则不会受到影响。我们专注于在生产决策已确定且供应商已获得付款之后的交货时发生的意外价格上涨情况，以区分战略违约与非战略违约。估计结果显示，大约一半的违约行为属于战略违约。我们模型化战略违约如何导致保险风险与交易对手风险之间的权衡：与价格指数合同相比，固定价格合同能够防范价格波动，但在市场条件发生变化时却会引发违约动机。模型校准表明，战略违约可能导致平均15.8%的产量损失、资本边际产量的显著分散，并对供应农民产生显著的负面影响。

abstract.text: In setting prices for physician services, Medicare solicits input from a committee that evaluates proposals from industry. The committee itself comprises members from industry; we investigate whether this arrangement leads to regulatory capture with prices biased toward industry interests. We find that increasing a measure of affiliation between the committee and proposers by one standard deviation increases prices by 10%. We then evaluate whether employing a biased committee as an intermediary may nonetheless be desirable, if greater affiliation allows the committee to extract information needed for regulation. We find industry proposers more affiliated with the committee produce less hard evidence in their proposals. However, on soft information, we find evidence of a trade-off: private insurers set prices that more closely track Medicare prices generated under higher affiliation.

10.1093/qje/qjz005.abstractZh: 在为医生服务定价时，医疗保险机构会邀请一个委员会来评估来自行业的提案。该委员会由来自行业的成员组成；我们研究了这种安排是否会导致监管被行业势力所控制，从而使价格偏向行业利益。我们发现，如果委员会与提案者之间的关联程度增加一个标准差，价格就会上涨10%。然后，我们评估了使用这种带有偏见的委员会作为中介是否仍然具有吸引力，因为更高的关联程度可能使委员会能够获取所需的监管信息。我们发现，与委员会关联程度较高的行业提案者在提案中提供的硬性证据较少。然而，在软性信息方面，我们发现存在一种权衡：私人保险公司设定的价格更接近于在更高关联程度下由医疗保险机构产生的价格。

abstract.text: We show that grit, a skill that has been shown to be highly predictive of achievement, is malleable in childhood and can be fostered in the classroom environment. We evaluate a randomized educational intervention implemented in two independent elementary school samples. Outcomes are measured via a novel incentivized real-effort task and performance in standardized tests. We find that treated students are more likely to exert effort to accumulate task-specific ability and hence more likely to succeed. In a follow up 2.5 years after the intervention, we estimate an effect of about 0.2 standard deviations on a standardized math test.

10.1093/qje/qjz006.abstractZh: 我们表明，毅力这一被证明与成就高度相关的技能，在儿童时期具有可塑性，并且可以在课堂环境中得到培养。我们评估了一项在两家独立的小学样本中实施的随机教育干预措施的效果。通过一项新颖的激励性实际任务以及标准化测试的成绩来衡量干预效果。我们发现，接受干预的学生更有可能付出努力来积累特定任务所需的能力，因此更有可能取得成功。在干预后2.5年的随访中，我们估计该干预措施对标准化数学测试的影响约为0.2个标准差。

abstract.text: I study whether exposure to teacher stereotypes, as measured by the Gender-Science Implicit Association Test, affects student achievement. I provide evidence that the gender gap in math performance, defined as the score of boys minus the score of girls in standardized tests, substantially increases when students are assigned to math teachers with stronger gender stereotypes. Teacher stereotypes induce girls to underperform in math and self-select into less demanding high schools, following the track recommendation of their teachers. These effects are at least partially driven by lower self-confidence on math ability of girls exposed to gender-biased teachers. Stereotypes impair the test performance of girls, who end up failing to achieve their full potential. I do not detect statistically significant effects on student outcomes of literature teacher stereotypes.

10.1093/qje/qjz008.abstractZh: 我研究的是，通过性别科学隐性关联测试来测量的教师刻板印象对学生学业成绩的影响。我的研究结果表明，当学生被分配到具有更强性别刻板印象的数学教师任教时，数学成绩上的性别差距——即男孩的成绩减去女孩的成绩——会显著增大。教师刻板印象导致女孩在数学方面的表现不佳，并促使她们选择要求较低的高中，从而遵循教师的推荐。这些效应至少部分是由于接触性别偏见教师后的女孩在数学能力上的自信心降低所导致的。刻板印象损害了女孩的测试表现，使她们无法充分发挥自己的潜力。然而，我没有发现文献中提到的教师刻板印象对学生学业成绩有统计学上的显著影响。

abstract.text: We analyze a large data set of commercial records produced by Assyrian merchants in the nineteenth century BCE. Using the information from these records, we estimate a structural gravity model of long-distance trade in the Bronze Age. We use our structural gravity model to locate lost ancient cities. In many cases, our estimates confirm the conjectures of historians who follow different methodologies. In some instances, our estimates confirm one conjecture against others. We also structurally estimate ancient city sizes and offer evidence in support of the hypothesis that large cities tend to emerge at the intersections of natural transport routes, as dictated by topography. Finally, we document persistent patterns in the distribution of city sizes across four millennia, find a distance elasticity of trade in the Bronze Age close to modern estimates, and show suggestive evidence that the distribution of ancient city sizes, inferred from trade data, is well approximated by Zipf’s law.

10.1093/qje/qjz009.abstractZh: 我们分析了一组由公元前19世纪亚述商人产生的商业记录数据。利用这些记录中的信息，我们建立了一个结构引力模型来模拟青铜时代的远程贸易。我们使用这个结构引力模型来定位那些已经失落的古代城市。在许多情况下，我们的估计结果证实了历史学家通过不同方法得出的推测。在某些情况下，我们的估计结果支持了一个推测而否定了另一个推测。我们还对古代城市规模进行了结构性估计，并提供了证据支持这样的假设：大型城市往往出现在自然交通路线的交汇处，这与地形特征相符。最后，我们记录了四个千年间城市规模分布的持续模式，发现青铜时代贸易的距离弹性接近现代估计值，并提供了一些线索表明，从贸易数据推断出的古代城市规模分布可以很好地用齐普夫定律来近似描述。

abstract.text: We present results from a large-scale randomized experiment across 350 schools in Tanzania that studied the impact of providing schools with (i) unconditional grants, (ii) teacher incentives based on student performance, and (iii) both of the above. After two years, we find (i) no impact on student test scores from providing school grants, (ii) some evidence of positive effects from teacher incentives, and (iii) significant positive effects from providing both programs. Most important, we find strong evidence of complementarities between the programs, with the effect of joint provision being significantly greater than the sum of the individual effects. Our results suggest that combining spending on school inputs (the default policy) with improved teacher incentives could substantially increase the cost-effectiveness of public spending on education.

10.1093/qje/qjz010.abstractZh: 我们展示了在坦桑尼亚350所学校进行的大规模随机实验的结果，该实验研究了向学校提供以下措施的影响：(i)无条件拨款；(ii)基于学生表现的教师激励措施；以及(iii)上述两种措施的联合实施。经过两年的研究，我们发现：(i)提供学校拨款对学生考试成绩没有显著影响；(ii)教师激励措施有一些积极效果；(iii)同时实施这两种措施具有显著的正面效果。最重要的是，我们发现这些措施之间存在互补性，联合实施的效果明显大于单独实施的效果之和。我们的研究结果表明，将学校投入的支出与改进的教师激励措施相结合，可以显著提高公共教育支出的成本效益。

abstract.text: This article analyzes how patent-induced shocks to labor productivity propagate into worker compensation using a new linkage of U.S. patent applications to U.S. business and worker tax records. We infer the causal effects of patent allowances by comparing firms whose patent applications were initially allowed to those whose patent applications were initially rejected. To identify patents that are ex ante valuable, we extrapolate the excess stock return estimates of Kogan et al. (2017) to the full set of accepted and rejected patent applications based on predetermined firm and patent application characteristics. An initial allowance of an ex ante valuable patent generates substantial increases in firm productivity and worker compensation. By contrast, initial allowances of lower ex ante value patents yield no detectable effects on firm outcomes. Patent allowances lead firms to increase employment, but entry wages and workforce composition are insensitive to patent decisions. On average, workers capture roughly 30 cents of every dollar of patent-induced surplus in higher earnings. This share is roughly twice as high among workers present since the year of application. These earnings effects are concentrated among men and workers in the top half of the earnings distribution and are paired with corresponding improvements in worker retention among these groups. We interpret these earnings responses as reflecting the capture of economic rents by senior workers, who are most costly for innovative firms to replace.

10.1093/qje/qjz011.abstractZh: 本文通过分析美国专利申请与企业和工人税务记录之间的关联，探讨专利对劳动生产率的影响如何传导至工人薪酬。我们通过比较那些专利申请最初被允许的公司和那些专利申请最初被拒绝的公司，来推断专利许可的因果效应。为了识别那些在事前具有价值的专利，我们基于预定的企业和专利申请特征，将Kogan等人（2017年）对超额股票回报的估计外推到所有被接受和被拒绝的专利申请。对于事前具有价值的专利进行初始许可，会显著提升企业的生产效率和工人的薪酬。相反，对于事前价值较低的专利进行初始许可，则不会对企业结果产生可检测的影响。专利许可促使企业增加就业，但进入工资和劳动力构成对专利决策并不敏感。平均而言，工人从专利带来的每1美元剩余收益中获得了大约30美分的收益。这一比例在自申请年份以来一直存在的工人中更高，约为其他工人的两倍。这些收益效应主要集中在男性以及收入分布中处于较高位置的工人身上，并且伴随着这些群体在员工保留方面的相应改善。我们将这些收益反应解释为高级工人对经济租金的占有，这些工人对于创新企业来说是最难以替代的。

abstract.text: What is the aggregate real rate of return in the economy? Is it higher than the growth rate of the economy and, if so, by how much? Is there a tendency for returns to fall in the long run? Which particular assets have the highest long-run returns? We answer these questions on the basis of a new and comprehensive data set for all major asset classes, including housing. The annual data on total returns for equity, housing, bonds, and bills cover 16 advanced economies from 1870 to 2015, and our new evidence reveals many new findings and puzzles.

10.1093/qje/qjz012.abstractZh: 经济中的总体实际回报率是多少？它是否高于经济增长率，如果是，高出多少？从长期来看，回报率是否有下降的趋势？哪些特定资产在长期内具有最高的回报率？我们基于一个涵盖所有主要资产类别（包括房地产）的新且全面的数据集来回答这些问题。关于股票、房地产、债券和票据的总回报率的年度数据涵盖了1870年至2015年间的16个发达国家，我们的新证据揭示了许多新的发现和谜题。

abstract.text: We develop a framework for welfare analysis of interventions designed to increase take-up of social safety net programs in the presence of potential behavioral biases. We calibrate the key parameters using a randomized field experiment in which 30,000 elderly individuals not enrolled in—but likely eligible for—the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) are either provided with information that they are likely eligible, provided with this information and offered assistance in applying, or are in a “status quo” control group. Only 6% of the control group enrolls in SNAP over the next nine months, compared to 11% of the Information Only group and 18% of the Information Plus Assistance group. The individuals who apply or enroll in response to either intervention have higher net income and are less sick than the average enrollee in the control group. We present evidence consistent with the existence of optimization frictions that are greater for needier individuals, which suggests that the poor targeting properties of the interventions reduce their welfare benefits.

10.1093/qje/qjz013.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个框架，用于分析旨在增加社会安全网项目参与度的干预措施对福利的影响，同时考虑可能存在的行为偏差。我们通过一项随机实地实验来校准关键参数。实验中，30,000名未参加但可能符合补充营养援助计划（SNAP）资格的老年人被分为三组：一组获得信息得知自己符合资格，另一组在获得信息后还获得了援助申请服务，第三组则处于“现状”对照组。结果显示，在接下来的九个月内，对照组中只有6%的人参加了SNAP计划，而仅提供信息的组为11%，提供信息并额外提供援助的组为18%。接受干预措施的人比对照组的平均参与者拥有更高的净收入，并且健康状况也更好。我们的研究结果表明，存在优化摩擦效应，这种效应在更需要帮助的人群中更为显著，这说明这些干预措施的目标定位特性降低了它们的福利效益。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of minimum wages on low-wage jobs using 138 prominent state-level minimum wage changes between 1979 and 2016 in the United States using a difference-in-differences approach. We first estimate the effect of the minimum wage increase on employment changes by wage bins throughout the hourly wage distribution. We then focus on the bottom part of the wage distribution and compare the number of excess jobs paying at or slightly above the new minimum wage to the missing jobs paying below it to infer the employment effect. We find that the overall number of low-wage jobs remained essentially unchanged over the five years following the increase. At the same time, the direct effect of the minimum wage on average earnings was amplified by modest wage spillovers at the bottom of the wage distribution. Our estimates by detailed demographic groups show that the lack of job loss is not explained by labor-labor substitution at the bottom of the wage distribution. We also find no evidence of disemployment when we consider higher levels of minimum wages. However, we do find some evidence of reduced employment in tradeable sectors. We also show how decomposing the overall employment effect by wage bins allows a transparent way of assessing the plausibility of estimates.

10.1093/qje/qjz014.abstractZh: 我们使用差异-差异方法，基于1979年至2016年间美国138个州级最低工资变化的资料，来估计最低工资对低薪工作的影响。我们首先通过按时薪分布的不同区间来估计最低工资提高对就业变化的影响。随后，我们重点关注工资分布的最低部分，比较那些支付等于或略高于新最低工资的工作岗位数量与那些支付低于新最低工资的空缺岗位数量，以推断最低工资对就业的影响。研究发现，在最低工资提高后的五年时间里，低薪工作的总体数量基本保持不变。同时，最低工资对平均收入的直接影响因工资分布最低层存在适度的工资溢出效应而得到放大。根据详细的人口统计分组进行的估计显示，工资分布最低层的工作岗位空缺并非由劳动力替代所解释。此外，当我们考虑更高水平的最低工资时，也没有发现失业增加的证据。不过，我们确实发现了一些证据表明可交易行业的就业有所减少。我们还展示了如何通过按工资区间分解总体就业效应，从而以透明的方式评估估计结果的合理性。

abstract.text: We study the causes of “nutritional inequality”: why the wealthy eat more healthfully than the poor in the United States. Exploiting supermarket entry and household moves to healthier neighborhoods, we reject that neighborhood environments contribute meaningfully to nutritional inequality. We then estimate a structural model of grocery demand, using a new instrument exploiting the combination of grocery retail chains’ differing presence across geographic markets with their differing comparative advantages across product groups. Counterfactual simulations show that exposing low-income households to the same products and prices available to high-income households reduces nutritional inequality by only about 10%, while the remaining 90% is driven by differences in demand. These findings counter the argument that policies to increase the supply of healthy groceries could play an important role in reducing nutritional inequality.

10.1093/qje/qjz015.abstractZh: 我们研究了“营养不平等”的原因：为什么在美国，富人比穷人更注重健康饮食。通过研究超市的进入情况以及家庭迁移到更健康的社区，我们发现社区环境对营养不平等的影响并不显著。随后，我们建立了一个食品需求的结构模型，利用一种新的工具变量来进行分析，该工具变量结合了食品零售连锁企业在不同地理市场中的存在差异以及它们在不同产品类别上的比较优势。反事实模拟结果显示，让低收入家庭获得与高收入家庭相同的产品和价格，只能减少约10%的营养不平等，而剩余的90%的不平等是由需求差异造成的。这些发现反驳了那种认为增加健康食品供应可以在减少营养不平等方面发挥重要作用的观点。

abstract.text: A common objection to “sin taxes”—corrective taxes on goods that are thought to be overconsumed, such as cigarettes, alcohol, and sugary drinks—is that they often fall disproportionately on low-income consumers. This paper studies the interaction between corrective and redistributive motives in a general optimal taxation framework and delivers empirically implementable formulas for sufficient statistics for the optimal commodity tax. The optimal sin tax is increasing in the price elasticity of demand, increasing in the degree to which lower-income consumers are more biased or more elastic to the tax, decreasing in the extent to which consumption is concentrated among the poor, and decreasing in income effects, because income effects imply that commodity taxes create labor supply distortions. Contrary to common intuitions, stronger preferences for redistribution can increase the optimal sin tax, if lower-income consumers are more responsive to taxes or are more biased. As an application, we estimate the optimal nationwide tax on sugar-sweetened beverages, using Nielsen Homescan data and a specially designed survey measuring nutrition knowledge and self-control. Holding federal income tax rates constant, our estimates imply an optimal federal sugar-sweetened beverage tax of 1 to 2.1 cents per ounce, although optimal city-level taxes could be as much as 60% lower due to cross-border shopping.

10.1093/qje/qjz017.abstractZh: 对“罪恶税”的常见反对意见是，这类针对被认为过度消费的商品（如香烟、酒精和含糖饮料）的税收往往不成比例地落在低收入消费者身上。本文在一般最优税收框架内研究了纠正性税收与再分配动机之间的相互作用，并提出了可用于实际操作的商品最优税收统计公式。最优罪恶税与需求的价格弹性成正比，与低收入消费者对税收的敏感度成正比，与贫困人群的消费集中度成反比，同时与收入效应成反比，因为收入效应意味着商品税收会导致劳动力供给的扭曲。与普遍直觉相反，如果低收入消费者对税收更为敏感或存在更大的消费偏差，那么再分配偏好较强的状况反而会增加最优罪恶税。作为应用案例，我们利用Nielsen Homescan数据以及专门设计的调查来估算全国范围内含糖饮料的最优税收。在联邦所得税税率保持不变的情况下，我们的估算结果显示，最优联邦含糖饮料税收为每盎司1至2.1美分，而由于跨境购物的影响，城市层面的最优税收可能低达60%。

abstract.text: Can access to a few hundred dollars of liquidity affect the career choice of a recent college graduate? In a three-year field experiment with Teach For America (TFA), a prestigious teacher placement program, we randomly increase the financial packages offered to nearly 7,300 potential teachers who requested support for the transition into teaching. The first two years of the experiment reveal that although most applicants do not respond to a marginal $600 of grants or loans, those in the worst financial position respond by joining TFA at higher rates. We continue the experiment into the third year and self-replicate our results. For the highest-need applicants, an extra $600 in loans, $600 in grants, and $1,200 in grants increase the likelihood of joining TFA by 12.2, 11.4, and 17.1 percentage points (or 20.0%, 18.7%, and 28.1%), respectively. Additional grant and loan dollars are equally effective, suggesting a liquidity mechanism. A follow-up survey bolsters the liquidity story and also shows that those drawn into teaching would have otherwise worked in private-sector firms.

10.1093/qje/qjz018.abstractZh: 能否获得几百美元的流动性资金会影响刚毕业的大学生职业选择？我们在为期三年的实验中，选取了著名的教师安置项目“ Teach For America (TFA)”，随机为近7,300名申请教师提供了额外的经济支持，帮助他们顺利过渡到教师职业。实验的前两年显示，虽然大多数申请者对仅600美元的补助金或贷款反应不大，但经济状况较差的申请人则更倾向于加入TFA。我们将实验延续到第三年，并重复了研究结果。对于需求最高的申请人来说，额外的600美元贷款、600美元的补助金以及1,200美元的补助金分别使他们加入TFA的可能性增加了12.2%、11.4%和17.1个百分点（即20.0%、18.7%和28.1%）。额外的补助金和贷款同样有效，这表明流动性因素在职业选择中起到了重要作用。后续的调查进一步证实了这一结论，同时发现那些被吸引从事教师职业的人，原本可能会选择在私营部门工作。

abstract.text: We show that most U.S. food, drugstore, and mass-merchandise chains charge nearly uniform prices across stores, despite wide variation in consumer demographics and competition. Demand estimates reveal substantial within-chain variation in price elasticities and suggest that the median chain sacrifices ${\$}$16 million of annual profit relative to a benchmark of optimal prices. In contrast, differences in average prices between chains are broadly consistent with the optimal benchmark. We discuss a range of explanations for nearly uniform pricing, highlighting managerial inertia and brand image concerns as mechanisms frequently mentioned by industry participants. Relative to our optimal benchmark, uniform pricing may significantly increase the prices paid by poorer households relative to the rich, dampen the response of prices to local economic shocks, alter the analysis of mergers in antitrust, and shift the incidence of intranational trade costs.

10.1093/qje/qjz019.abstractZh: 我们指出，尽管美国大多数食品、药店和大众消费品连锁店的定价存在巨大差异，但由于消费者人口统计特征的广泛差异以及市场竞争的存在，这些连锁店的价格却几乎保持一致。需求估计数据显示，各连锁店之间的价格弹性存在显著差异，并且中位数连锁店每年因此损失1600万美元的利润，相对于最优价格基准而言。相比之下，不同连锁店之间的平均价格差异与最优价格基准大致一致。我们探讨了多种导致价格一致性的原因，其中管理层惯性以及品牌形象问题被行业参与者频繁提及。相对于我们的最优价格基准，统一定价可能会显著增加贫困家庭相对于富裕家庭支付的价格，减弱价格对当地经济冲击的响应，改变反垄断中对合并的分析，并改变国内贸易成本的分布。

abstract.text: How important is human capital at the top of the U.S. income distribution? A primary source of top income is private “pass-through” business profit, which can include entrepreneurial labor income for tax reasons. This article asks whether top pass-through profit mostly reflects human capital, defined as all inalienable factors embodied in business owners, rather than financial capital. Tax data linking 11 million firms to their owners show that top pass-through profit accrues to working-age owners of closely held mid-market firms in skill-intensive industries. Pass-through profit falls by three-quarters after owner retirement or premature death. Classifying three-quarters of pass-through profit as human capital income, we find that the typical top earner derives most of her income from human capital, not financial capital. Growth in pass-through profit is explained by both rising productivity and a rising share of value added accruing to owners.

10.1093/qje/qjz020.abstractZh: 美国收入分配顶端的人力资本有多重要？顶端收入的主要来源是私企的“传递性”商业利润，其中可能包括出于税务原因而获得的创业劳动收入。本文探讨的是，顶端传递性利润是否主要反映了人力资本，即所有不可剥夺的因素，这些因素体现在企业主身上，而非金融资本。将1100万家企业与其所有者联系起来的税务数据显示，顶端传递性利润主要归属于从事技能密集型行业的中小型企业的在职所有者。当所有者退休或过早去世后，传递性利润会减少四分之三。如果将传递性利润的四分之三归类为人力资本收入，我们发现典型的顶端收入者大部分收入来自人力资本，而非金融资本。传递性利润的增长可以由生产率的提升以及所有者所获得附加值份额的增加来解释。

abstract.text: We adapt simple tools from computational linguistics to construct a new measure of political risk faced by individual U.S. firms: the share of their quarterly earnings conference calls that they devote to political risks. We validate our measure by showing that it correctly identifies calls containing extensive conversations on risks that are political in nature, that it varies intuitively over time and across sectors, and that it correlates with the firm’s actions and stock market volatility in a manner that is highly indicative of political risk. Firms exposed to political risk retrench hiring and investment and actively lobby and donate to politicians. These results continue to hold after controlling for news about the mean (as opposed to the variance) of political shocks. Interestingly, the vast majority of the variation in our measure is at the firm level rather than at the aggregate or sector level, in the sense that it is captured neither by the interaction of sector and time fixed effects nor by heterogeneous exposure of individual firms to aggregate political risk. The dispersion of this firm-level political risk increases significantly at times with high aggregate political risk. Decomposing our measure of political risk by topic, we find that firms that devote more time to discussing risks associated with a given political topic tend to increase lobbying on that topic, but not on other topics, in the following quarter.

10.1093/qje/qjz021.abstractZh: 我们采用计算语言学的简单工具，构建了一个衡量美国个体企业面临政治风险的新指标：即企业每季度财报会议中用于讨论政治风险的时长比例。我们通过以下方式验证了这一指标的有效性：它能够准确识别出涉及政治风险的详细讨论内容；该指标随时间以及不同行业呈现出直观的变化趋势；并且它与企业的行为以及股市波动之间存在高度相关性，这充分表明了政治风险的存在。面临政治风险的企業会缩减招聘和投资，并积极游说或向政客捐款。即使在控制了政治冲击的均值（而非方差）因素后，这些结果依然成立。有趣的是，我们测量指标中的大部分变异都发生在企业层面，而非整体或行业层面，也就是说，这种变异既无法通过行业和时间的固定效应交互作用来解释，也无法通过个别企业对不同政治议题的异质性暴露来解释。在整体政治风险较高的时期，企业层面政治风险的分散程度会显著增加。通过对政治风险指标按主题进行分解，我们发现，那些在某一特定政治议题上投入更多时间讨论的企业，往往会在接下来的季度中增加对该议题的游说活动，但在其他议题上则不会如此。

abstract.text: The best worker is not always the best candidate for manager. In these cases, do firms promote the best potential manager or the best worker in their current job? Using microdata on the performance of sales workers at 131 firms, we find evidence consistent with the Peter Principle, which proposes that firms prioritize current job performance in promotion decisions at the expense of other observable characteristics that better predict managerial performance. We estimate that the costs of promoting workers with lower managerial potential are high, suggesting either that firms are making inefficient promotion decisions or that the benefits of promotion-based incentives are great enough to justify the costs of managerial mismatch. We find that firms manage the costs of the Peter Principle by placing less weight on sales performance in promotion decisions when managerial roles entail greater responsibility and when frontline workers are incentivized by strong pay for performance.

10.1093/qje/qjz022.abstractZh: 最优秀的员工并不总是最适合担任管理职务的人。在这种情况下，企业是应该提拔最优秀的潜在管理者，还是提拔当前职位上表现最出色的员工呢？通过对131家公司的销售员工绩效的微数据进行分析，我们发现这一结论与彼得原理相符。彼得原理认为，企业在提拔决策时应该优先考虑当前的工作表现，而忽视那些更能预测管理绩效的其他可观察特征。我们的估计表明，提拔那些管理能力较低的员工所带来的成本很高，这要么表明企业做出了低效的提拔决策，要么表明基于晋升的激励措施所带来的收益足以弥补管理不匹配所带来的成本。我们发现，当管理职位需要承担更大的责任，或者一线员工因绩效奖励而受到激励时，企业会在提拔决策中减少销售表现的权重，从而有效管理彼得原理带来的成本。

abstract.text: Workplace wellness programs cover over 50 million U.S. workers and are intended to reduce medical spending, increase productivity, and improve well-being. Yet limited evidence exists to support these claims. We designed and implemented a comprehensive workplace wellness program for a large employer and randomly assigned program eligibility and financial incentives at the individual level for nearly 5,000 employees. We find strong patterns of selection: during the year prior to the intervention, program participants had lower medical expenditures and healthier behaviors than nonparticipants. The program persistently increased health screening rates, but we do not find significant causal effects of treatment on total medical expenditures, other health behaviors, employee productivity, or self-reported health status after more than two years. Our 95% confidence intervals rule out 84% of previous estimates on medical spending and absenteeism.

10.1093/qje/qjz023.abstractZh: 工作场所的健康计划覆盖了超过5000万美国员工，旨在减少医疗支出、提高生产力并改善员工福祉。然而，目前缺乏足够的证据来支持这些主张。我们为一家大型雇主设计并实施了一项全面的工作场所健康计划，并在近5000名员工中随机分配了参与计划的条件和财务激励措施。我们发现，在干预措施实施前的那一年里，参与计划的员工医疗支出较低，且行为更健康。该计划持续提高了健康筛查率，但超过两年后，我们并未发现该计划对总医疗支出、其他健康行为、员工生产力或自我报告的健康状况有显著的因果效应。我们的95%置信区间排除了84%之前关于医疗支出和缺勤率的估计结果。

abstract.text: Many developing economies adopt industrial policies favoring selected sectors. Is there an economic logic to this type of intervention? I analyze industrial policy when economic sectors form a production network via input-output linkages. Market imperfections generate distortionary effects that compound through backward demand linkages, causing upstream sectors to become the sink for imperfections and have the greatest size distortions. My key finding is that the distortion in sectoral size is a sufficient statistic for the social value of promoting that sector; thus, there is an incentive for a well-meaning government to subsidize upstream sectors. Furthermore, sectoral interventions’ aggregate effects can be simply summarized, to first order, by the cross-sector covariance between my sufficient statistic and subsidy spending. My sufficient statistic predicts sectoral policies in South Korea in the 1970s and modern-day China, suggesting that sectoral interventions might have generated positive aggregate effects in these economies.

10.1093/qje/qjz024.abstractZh: 许多发展中国家采取工业政策，以扶持特定行业。这种干预措施是否存在经济逻辑？我分析了当经济部门通过投入产出联系形成生产网络时的工业政策。市场缺陷会产生扭曲效应，这些效应通过下游需求联系进一步加剧，导致上游行业成为这些缺陷的承受者，并遭受最大的规模扭曲。我的主要发现是，行业规模的扭曲是衡量促进该行业社会价值的充分统计量；因此，善意的政府有动机对上游行业进行补贴。此外，行业干预的总体效应可以简单地用我的充分统计量与补贴支出之间的跨部门协方差来概括。我的充分统计量预测了20世纪70年代韩国和现代中国的行业政策，表明行业干预可能在这些经济体中产生了积极的总体效应。

abstract.text: We study inference in shift-share regression designs, such as when a regional outcome is regressed on a weighted average of sectoral shocks, using regional sector shares as weights. We conduct a placebo exercise in which we estimate the effect of a shift-share regressor constructed with randomly generated sectoral shocks on actual labor market outcomes across U.S. commuting zones. Tests based on commonly used standard errors with 5% nominal significance level reject the null of no effect in up to 55% of the placebo samples. We use a stylized economic model to show that this overrejection problem arises because regression residuals are correlated across regions with similar sectoral shares, independent of their geographic location. We derive novel inference methods that are valid under arbitrary cross-regional correlation in the regression residuals. We show using popular applications of shift-share designs that our methods may lead to substantially wider confidence intervals in practice.

10.1093/qje/qjz025.abstractZh: 我们研究了在混合回归设计中的推断问题，例如当一个地区性结果被回归到部门冲击的加权平均值上时，使用地区部门份额作为权重。我们进行了一个安慰剂实验，通过随机生成的部门冲击来估计混合回归量对实际劳动力市场结果的影响，这些结果来自美国的各个通勤区域。基于常用的标准误差，当名义显著性水平为5%时，高达55%的安慰剂样本拒绝了无效应的原假设。我们使用一个简化的经济模型来说明，这种过度拒绝现象的出现是因为回归残差在不同地区之间存在相关性，而这种相关性与地理位置无关。我们提出了新的推断方法，这些方法在回归残差存在任意跨地区相关性的情况下仍然有效。通过实际应用混合回归设计的方法，我们发现我们的方法可能会导致实际置信区间显著扩大。

abstract.text: We examine the within- and across-firm shipment decisions of tens of thousands of goods-producing and goods-distributing establishments. This allows us to quantify the normally unobservable forces that determine firm boundaries, that is, which transactions are mediated by ownership control, as opposed to contracts or markets. We find firm boundaries to be an economically significant barrier to trade: having an additional vertically integrated establishment in a given destination ZIP code has the same effect on shipment volumes as a 40% reduction in distance. These effects are larger for high value-to-weight products, faraway destinations, differentiated products, and IT-intensive industries.

10.1093/qje/qjz026.abstractZh: 我们研究了数万家生产商品和分销商品的企业的内部及跨企业运输决策。这使我们能够量化那些通常难以观察到的因素，这些因素决定了企业的边界，即哪些交易是由所有权控制来决定的，而不是由合同或市场来决定的。我们发现，企业边界是贸易的一个重要的障碍：在特定的目的地邮政编码区拥有另一个垂直整合的企业，其运输量减少的效果与距离缩短40%的效果相同。对于高价值与重量比的产品、偏远的目的地、差异化产品以及技术密集型行业来说，这种效应更为显著。

abstract.text: We study the gains from trade liberalization in models with monopolistic competition, firm-level heterogeneity, and variable markups. For a large class of demand functions used in the international macro and trade literature, we derive a parsimonious generalization of the welfare formula in Arkolakis et al. (2012). We then use both estimates from micro-level trade data and evidence regarding firm-level pass-through to quantify the implications of this new formula. Within the class of models that we consider, our main finding is that gains from trade liberalization predicted by models with variable markups are equal to, at best, and slightly lower than, at worst, those predicted by models with constant markups. In this sense, pro-competitive effects of trade are elusive.

10.1093/restud/rdx075.abstractZh: 我们研究了在垄断竞争、企业层面异质性和可变加价率的模型中，贸易自由化的收益。针对国际宏观和贸易文献中使用的绝大多数需求函数，我们推导出了Arkolakis等人（2012年）提出的福利公式的一个简洁概括。然后，我们利用微观层面的贸易数据估计结果以及关于企业层面传递效应的证据，来量化这一新公式的含义。在我们所考虑的模型类别中，我们的主要发现是：由可变加价率模型预测的贸易自由化收益，在最好的情况下等于，在最坏的情况下则略低于由恒定加价率模型预测的收益。从这个意义上说，贸易对竞争有利的影响并不明显。

abstract.text: I present a theory of harmful addiction in which “giving in” to an unwanted urge (⁠|$i.e.$| consumption) delays the recurrence of urges in the short-run, but increases their long-run frequency. The theory offers new predictions as to how the frequency, levels, cue-dependence, and temporal consistency of consumption evolve during habituation, while uniquely capturing near-term substitution in demand across time. New welfare implications for restrictions on consumption and on marketing are also addressed.

10.1093/restud/rdx079.abstractZh: 我提出了一个关于有害成瘾的理论，该理论认为，在短期内，屈服于不想要的冲动（即消费行为）可以延缓这些冲动的再次出现，但会增加其长期出现的频率。该理论对消费频率、水平、线索依赖性以及时间一致性在习惯形成过程中的演变提供了新的预测，同时能够独特地捕捉到需求在一段时间内的替代情况。此外，该理论还探讨了针对消费和营销限制的新福利影响。

abstract.text: Many information structures generate correlated rather than mutually independent signals, the news media being a prime example. This paper shows experimentally that in such contexts many people neglect these correlations in the updating process and treat correlated information as independent. In consequence, people's beliefs are excessively sensitive to well-connected information sources, implying a pattern of "overshooting" beliefs. Additionally, in an experimental asset market, correlation neglect not only drives overoptimism and overpessimism at the individual level, but also affects aggregate outcomes in a systematic manner. In particular, the excessive confidence swings caused by correlated signals give rise to predictable price bubbles and crashes. These findings are reminiscent of popular narratives according to which aggregate booms and busts might be driven by the spread of "stories". Our results also lend direct support to recent models of boundedly rational social learning.

10.1093/restud/rdx081.abstractZh: 许多信息结构产生的信号是相关的，而非相互独立的，新闻媒体就是典型的例子。实验表明，在这种情况下，许多人会在更新信息时忽略这些相关性，将相关信息视为独立的。结果，人们的信念对信息来源的高度关联性过于敏感，导致信念出现“过度反应”的现象。此外，在实验性的资产市场中，这种相关性忽略不仅会在个体层面引发过度乐观或过度悲观，还会以系统性的方式影响整体市场表现。特别是，由相关信号引起的过度信心波动会导致可预测的价格泡沫和崩盘。这些发现与一些流行的观点相呼应，即整体市场的繁荣与萧条可能由“故事”的传播所驱动。我们的研究结果也直接支持了最近关于有限理性社会学习模型的理论。

abstract.text: We measure the impact of direct-to-consumer television advertising (DTCA) by drug manufacturers. Our identification strategy exploits shocks to local advertising markets generated by the political advertising cycle and a regulatory intervention affecting a single product. We find evidence of significant business stealing effects among branded, advertised drugs. In addition, we show positive spillovers from drug advertisements to non-advertised competitors in the same class. We decompose the effect and show it is primarily due to new customers. Finally, we provide evidence that DTCA is cost-effective from a societal standpoint in our setting.

10.1093/restud/rdy001.abstractZh: 我们通过药物制造商直接面向消费者的电视广告来衡量其影响。我们的识别策略利用了政治广告周期以及针对单一产品的监管干预对本地广告市场产生的冲击。我们发现，品牌化、有广告宣传的药物在商业方面存在显著的“盗用效应”。此外，我们还发现药物广告对同类非广告宣传的竞争对手产生了积极的溢出效应。我们进一步分解了这一效应，发现其主要源于新客户的获取。最后，我们提供了证据，证明在我们的研究环境中，直接面向消费者的电视广告具有社会成本效益。

abstract.text: We provide a general theoretical characterization of how firms’ technology choice on a technology frontier determines the long-run elasticity of substitution between capital and labour. We show that the shape of the frontier determines factor shares and the elasticity of substitution between capital and labour. If there are adjustment costs to technology choice, the short- and long-run elasticities differ, with the long-run always higher. If the technology frontier is log-linear, the production function becomes Cobb–Douglas in the long run but, consistent with empirical evidence, short-run dynamics are characterized by gross complementarity. The approach is easily implementable and yields a powerful way to introduce CES-type production functions in macroeconomic models. We provide an illustration within an estimated dynamic general equilibrium model and show that the use of our production technology provides a good match for the short- and medium-run behaviour of the U.S. labour share.

10.1093/restud/rdy002.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于企业技术选择在技术前沿上的选择如何决定资本与劳动之间长期替代弹性的总体理论描述。我们指出，技术前沿的形状决定了各要素的比例以及资本与劳动之间的替代弹性。如果技术选择存在调整成本，那么短期与长期的替代弹性会有所不同，长期弹性通常更高。如果技术前沿是对数线性的，那么生产函数在长期表现为Cobb–Douglas型，但与实证证据一致的是，短期动态特征表现为总互补性。这种方法易于实施，并为在宏观经济模型中引入CES型生产函数提供了一种强有力的方式。我们通过一个估计的动态一般均衡模型进行了说明，并表明我们的生产技术能够很好地解释美国劳动份额在短期和中期的行为。

abstract.text: To what extent does crime follow the pattern of potential gains to illegal activity? This article presents evidence on how criminals respond to this key incentive by reporting crime–price elasticities estimated from a comprehensive crime dataset containing detailed information on stolen items for London between 2002 and 2012. Evidence of significant positive crime–price elasticities are shown, for a panel of 44 consumer goods and for commodity related goods (jewellery, fuel, and metal crimes). The reported evidence indicates that potential gains are a major empirical driver of criminal activity and a crucial part of the economic model of crime. The changing structure of goods prices helps to explain over 10–15% of the observed fall in property crime across all goods categories, and the majority of the sharp increases in the commodity related goods observed between 2002 and 2012.

10.1093/restud/rdy004.abstractZh: 犯罪在多大程度上遵循非法活动的潜在收益模式？本文通过一项包含2002年至2012年伦敦被盗物品详细信息的综合犯罪数据集，展示了犯罪者对这一关键激励的反应——即犯罪与价格之间的弹性关系。研究结果显示，对于44种消费品以及与商品相关的物品（如珠宝、燃料和金属犯罪），犯罪与价格之间存在显著的正弹性关系。这些证据表明，潜在收益是犯罪活动的主要实证驱动因素，也是犯罪经济模型的重要组成部分。商品价格结构的变化有助于解释所有商品类别中观察到的财产犯罪下降幅度超过10-15%，以及2002年至2012年间与商品相关的物品价格出现的大幅上涨。

abstract.text: Large multi-product firms dominate international trade flows. Using novel linked production and export data at the firm-product level, we find that the overwhelming majority of manufacturing firms export products that they do not produce. Three quarters of the exported products and 30% of export value from Belgian manufacturers are in goods that are not produced by the firm, so-called Carry-Along Trade (CAT). The number of CAT products is strongly increasing in firm productivity while the number of produced products that are exported is weakly increasing in firm productivity. We propose a general model of production and sourcing at multi-product firms and explore new demand- and supply-side modelling features capable of generating predictions consistent with the empirical findings. Export price data and company interviews offer suggestive evidence for the presence of demand-scope complementarities.

10.1093/restud/rdy006.abstractZh: 大型多产品企业主导着国际贸易流动。通过采用新的企业-产品层面的生产和出口数据，我们发现绝大多数制造企业的出口产品并非本企业生产的。比利时制造商所出口的产品中，有四分之三属于企业未生产的商品，这种贸易被称为“ Carry-Along Trade”（CAT）。CAT产品的数量与企业生产率呈正相关，而实际出口的产品数量则与企业生产率的关系较弱。我们提出了一个关于多产品企业生产和采购的一般模型，并探索了新的需求和供应侧建模方法，这些方法能够生成与实证研究结果一致的预测。出口价格数据以及企业访谈提供了关于需求-供给互补性的有力证据。

abstract.text: Many decisions are made in environments where outcomes are determined by the realization of multiple random events. A decision maker may be uncertain how these events are related. We identify and experimentally substantiate behaviour that intuitively reflects a lack of confidence in their joint distribution. Our findings suggest a dimension of ambiguity which is different from that in the classical distinction between risk and “Knightian uncertainty”.

10.1093/restud/rdy008.abstractZh: 许多决策是在结果由多个随机事件的组合决定的情况下做出的。决策者可能对这些事件之间的关联缺乏信心。我们识别并通过实验验证了那些直观上反映出对联合分布缺乏信心的行为。我们的研究结果表明，这种模糊性与经典意义上的风险与“奈特不确定性”之间的区别不同。

abstract.text: Why do office-motivated politicians sometimes espouse views that are non-congruent with their electorate’s? Can non-congruent statements convey any information about what a politician will do if elected, and if so, why would voters elect a politician who makes such statements? Furthermore, can electoral campaigns also directly affect an elected official’s behaviour? We develop a model of credible “cheap talk”—costless and non-binding communication—in elections. The foundation is an endogenous voter preference for a politician who is known to be non-congruent over one whose congruence is sufficiently uncertain. This preference arises because uncertainty about an elected official’s policy preferences generates policymaking distortions due to reputation/career concerns. We show that cheap talk can alter the electorate’s beliefs about a politician’s policy preferences and thereby affect the elected official’s behaviour. Informative cheap talk can increase or decrease voter welfare, with a greater scope for welfare benefits when reputation concerns are more important.

10.1093/restud/rdy009.abstractZh: 为什么一些以办公室工作为动机的政治家有时会提出与其选民观点不一致的观点？这些不一致的陈述能否传达出政治家当选后会采取何种行动的信息？如果可以，为什么选民会选择这样的政治家？此外，选举活动是否也能直接影响当选官员的行为？我们建立了一个关于可信“廉价言论”的模型——这种沟通方式无需成本且不具有约束力。该模型的基础是选民对政治家不一致行为的偏好，而非一致行为的政治家则因其一致性存在不确定性而受到更多关注。这种偏好源于对当选官员政策偏好不确定性的担忧，这种不确定性会导致政策制定的偏差，因为人们会担心声誉或职业生涯受到影响。我们表明，廉价言论可以改变选民对政治家政策偏好的看法，从而影响当选官员的行为。具有信息性的廉价言论可以提高或降低选民的福利，当声誉问题更为重要时，对选民福利的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: This article analyses the effectiveness of hiring credits. Using comprehensive administrative data, we show that the French hiring credit, implemented during the Great Recession, had significant positive employment effects and no effects on wages. Relying on the quasi-experimental variation in labour cost triggered by the hiring credit, we estimate a structural search and matching model. Simulations of counterfactual policies show that the effectiveness of the hiring credit relied to a large extent on three features: it was non-anticipated, temporary and targeted at jobs with rigid wages. We estimate that the cost per job created by permanent hiring credits, either countercyclical or time-invariant, in an environment with flexible wages would have been much higher.

10.1093/restud/rdy011.abstractZh: 本文分析了招聘信贷的有效性。通过综合行政数据，我们发现法国在大衰退期间实施的招聘信贷对就业产生了显著的积极影响，但对工资没有影响。基于招聘信贷引发的劳动力成本变化，我们建立了一个结构性搜索与匹配模型。对反事实政策的模拟表明，招聘信贷的有效性在很大程度上取决于三个特征：它是非预期的、临时性的，并且针对工资固定的岗位。我们估计，在工资具有灵活性的环境下，无论是逆周期性的还是时间不变的永久性招聘信贷，每创造一个岗位的成本将会更高。

abstract.text: In this article, I show that the key aspects of sovereign debt crises can be rationalized as part of the efficient risk-sharing arrangement between a sovereign borrower and foreign lenders in a production economy with informational and commitment frictions. The constrained efficient allocation involves ex post inefficient outcomes that resemble sovereign default episodes in the data and can be implemented with non-contingent defaultable bonds and active maturity management. Defaults and periods of temporary exclusion from international credit markets happen along the equilibrium path and are essential to supporting the efficient allocation. Furthermore, during debt crises, the maturity composition of debt shifts towards short-term debt and the term premium inverts as in the data.

10.1093/restud/rdy012.abstractZh: 在本文中，我展示了主权债务危机的关键方面可以被合理化为生产经济中主权借款国与外国贷款者之间有效风险分担安排的一部分，其中存在信息和承诺的摩擦。这种受限的有效分配会导致事后效率较低的结果，这些结果与数据中的主权违约事件相似，并且可以通过非偶然性的可违约债券和积极的到期管理来实现。违约以及暂时被排除在国际信贷市场之外的情况会沿着均衡路径发生，并且对于支持有效分配至关重要。此外，在债务危机期间，债务的期限结构会转向短期债务，期限溢价也会像数据中所显示的那样发生逆转。

abstract.text: The rules and procedures of legislatures often provide legislators with information bearing on the identities of upcoming proposers. For a broad class of legislative bargaining games, we establish that Markovian equilibria necessarily deliver all economic surplus to the first proposer whenever the information structure permits the legislators to rule out some minimum number of proposers one round in advance. This result holds regardless of the recognition process and even if players vary in patience and risk aversion. It raises the possibility that procedures adopted in the interest of transparency may contribute to the imbalance of political power.

10.1093/restud/rdy013.abstractZh: 立法机构的规则和程序通常会向立法者提供有关即将提出的提案者身份的信息。对于一类广泛的立法协商游戏，我们证明了只要信息结构允许立法者在一轮之前排除一定数量以上的提案者，马尔可夫均衡必然会将所有经济剩余分配给第一个提案者。这一结果不受识别过程的影响，即使参与者的耐心和风险厌恶程度不同，这一结论依然成立。这表明，为了透明性而采用的程序可能会加剧政治权力的不平衡。

abstract.text: We study two wage bargaining games between a firm and multiple workers. We revisit the bargaining game proposed by Stole and Zwiebel. We show that, in the unique Subgame Perfect Equilibrium, the gains from trade captured by workers who bargain earlier with the firm are larger than those captured by workers who bargain later, as well as larger than those captured by the firm. The resulting equilibrium payoffs are different from those reported in Stole and Zwiebel as they are not the Shapley values. We propose a novel bargaining game, the Rolodex game, which follows a simple and realistic protocol. In the unique no-delay Subgame Perfect Equilibrium of this game, the payoffs to the firm and to the workers are their Shapley values.

10.1093/restud/rdy015.abstractZh: 我们研究了企业与多名工人之间的两种工资谈判博弈。我们重新审视了Stole和Zwiebel提出的谈判博弈模型。我们发现，在唯一的子博弈完美均衡中，较早与企业进行谈判的工人所获得的收益，不仅大于较晚进行谈判的工人，也大于企业所获得的收益。这种均衡结果与Stole和Zwiebel所报告的结果不同，因为它们并非Shapley值。我们提出了一种新颖的谈判博弈模型——Rolodex博弈，该模型遵循一种简单而现实的协议。在该博弈的唯一无延迟子博弈完美均衡中，企业及工人的收益即为他们的Shapley值。

abstract.text: This article quantitatively evaluates the trade-off between the provision of health-related social insurance and the incentives to maintain good health through costly investments. To do so, we construct and estimate a dynamic model of health investments and health insurance in which the cross-sectional health distribution evolves endogenously and is shaped by labour market and health insurance policies. A no wage discrimination law in the labour market limits the extent to which wages can depend on the health status of a worker, and a no prior conditions law outlaws higher insurance premia for individuals with worse health status. In the model, the static gains from better insurance against poor health induced by these policies are traded off against their adverse dynamic incentive effects on household efforts to lead a healthy life. In our quantitative analysis, we find that it is optimal to insure 80% of labour market-related income risk (70% if a no prior conditions law is also present). Providing full insurance is strongly suboptimal, however, since at high levels of consumption insurance, the negative dynamic incentive effects on health effort and thus the population health distribution in the long run start to dominate the short-run consumption insurance gains.

10.1093/restud/rdy017.abstractZh: 本文定量评估了提供与健康相关的社会保险与通过昂贵投资维持良好健康状况之间的权衡。为此，我们构建并估计了一个关于健康投资与社会保险的动态模型，其中健康状况的横向分布由劳动力市场和社会保障政策内生地决定。劳动力市场中的无工资歧视法则限制了工资对劳动者健康状况的依赖性，而无先决条件法则则禁止为健康状况较差的个体支付更高的保险费用。在模型中，这些政策带来的更好保险对不良健康的静态收益与它们对家庭健康生活努力的负面动态激励效应之间发生了权衡。我们的定量分析发现，为80%的劳动力市场相关收入风险提供保险是最优的（如果存在无先决条件法则，则为70%）。然而，提供全额保险则明显次优，因为在高消费水平下，对健康努力的负面动态激励效应在长期内开始占据主导地位，从而超过了短期保险带来的收益。

abstract.text: This article examines the effect of cash versus in-kind transfers on local prices. Both types of transfers increase the demand for normal goods; in-kind transfers also increase supply in recipient communities, which could lead to lower prices than under cash transfers. We test and confirm this prediction using a programme in Mexico that randomly assigned villages to receive boxes of food (trucked into the village), equivalently-valued cash transfers, or no transfers. We find that prices are significantly lower under in-kind transfers compared to cash transfers; relative to the control group, in-kind transfers cause a 4% fall in prices while cash transfers cause a positive but negligible increase in prices. In the more economically developed villages in the sample, households’ purchasing power is only modestly affected by these price effects. In the less developed villages, the price effects are much larger in magnitude, which we show is due to these villages being less tied to the outside economy and having less competition among local suppliers.

10.1093/restud/rdy018.abstractZh: 本文探讨了现金转移与实物转移对当地价格的影响。这两种转移方式都会增加正常商品的需求；实物转移还会增加接收社区的供应，这可能导致价格低于现金转移的情况。我们通过墨西哥的一个项目来验证这一预测，该项目将村庄随机分配为接受食品箱（通过卡车运送到村庄）、等值现金转移或不接受任何转移。研究发现，与现金转移相比，实物转移导致的价格显著下降；相对于对照组，实物转移使价格下降了4%，而现金转移则导致价格略有上升，但幅度很小。在样本中的经济较发达村庄，家庭购买力仅受到这些价格效应的轻微影响。而在经济欠发达的村庄，价格效应的幅度要大得多，我们认为这是由于这些村庄与外部经济的联系较少，且当地供应商之间的竞争也较少。

abstract.text: We experimentally investigate the time-inconsistent taste for immediate gratification and future-preference misprediction. Across 7 weeks, 100 participants choose the number of unpleasant transcription tasks given various wages to complete immediately and at different future dates. Participants preferred 10–12% fewer tasks in the present compared to any future date, leading to an estimated |$\beta $| of |$0.83$|⁠. Comparing predictions with actual immediate-work choices provides evidence against substantial sophistication, with estimates implying that participants understand no more than 24% of their present bias. Finally, we find evidence of “projection bias”: participants wished to complete 4–12% fewer tasks when decisions were elicited right after completing tasks rather than before.

10.1093/restud/rdy019.abstractZh: 我们通过实验研究了即时满足的时间不一致性偏好以及未来偏好误判现象。在7周的时间里，100名参与者需要选择不同报酬的转录任务，并决定是立即完成还是在未来某个时间完成。与任何未来日期相比，参与者更倾向于在现在完成任务，数量减少了10-12%，估计的β值为0.83。通过比较预测结果与实际即时选择，我们发现参与者的认知水平并不复杂，他们理解的当前偏见不超过24%。最后，我们发现了一个“投射偏差”现象：当决策在任务完成后立即提出时，参与者希望完成的任务数量比在任务完成前减少了4-12%。

abstract.text: We propose a dynamic theory of financial intermediaries that are better able to collateralize claims than households, that is, have a collateralization advantage. Intermediaries require capital as they have to finance the additional amount that they can lend out of their own net worth. The net worth of financial intermediaries and the corporate sector are both state variables affecting the spread between intermediated and direct finance and the dynamics of real economic activity, such as investment, and financing. The accumulation of net worth of intermediaries is slow relative to that of the corporate sector. The model is consistent with key stylized facts about macroeconomic downturns associated with a credit crunch, namely, their severity, their protractedness, and the fact that the severity of the credit crunch itself affects the severity and persistence of downturns. The model captures the tentative and halting nature of recoveries from crises.

10.1093/restud/rdy020.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个动态金融中介理论，这些中介能够比家庭更好地为债权提供抵押品，即具有抵押优势。中介机构需要资本，因为它们必须为其可贷出的额外金额提供资金，而这些资金来自它们的净资产。金融中介机构和企业部门的净资产都是影响中介融资与直接融资之间差距以及实际经济活动（如投资和融资）动态性的状态变量。与企业部门相比，中介机构的净资产积累速度较慢。该模型与关于宏观经济衰退的关键典型事实一致，这些衰退与信贷紧缩有关，即其严重程度、持续时间，以及信贷紧缩本身的严重程度会影响衰退的严重程度和持续时间。该模型还揭示了从危机中恢复时的试探性和停滞性特征。

abstract.text: Historically, European Jews have specialized in financial services while being the victims of antisemitism. We find that the present-day demand for finance is lower in German counties where historical antisemitism was higher, compared to otherwise similar counties. Households in counties with high historical antisemitism have similar saving rates but invest less in stocks, hold lower saving deposits, and are less likely to get a mortgage to finance homeownership after controlling for wealth and a rich set of current and historical covariates. Present-day antisemitism and supply-side forces do not fully explain the results. Households in counties where historical antisemitism was higher distrust the financial sector more—a potential cultural externality of historical antisemitism that reduces wealth accumulation in the long run.

10.1093/restud/rdy021.abstractZh: 从历史上看，欧洲犹太人一直专注于金融服务行业，却成为反犹太主义的受害者。我们发现，在历史上反犹太主义较为严重的德国地区，如今对金融服务的需求较低，与其他类似地区相比存在明显差异。在历史上反犹太主义严重的地区，家庭储蓄率相似，但投资股票的比例较低，储蓄存款也较少，并且在控制财富及一系列当前和历史变量后，他们获得抵押贷款以购买住房的可能性也较低。当前的反犹太主义以及供给方面的因素并不能完全解释这些结果。在历史上反犹太主义严重的地区，家庭对金融部门的信任度较低——这可能是反犹太主义的历史性外部性，从长远来看会抑制财富积累。

abstract.text: This paper studies wage dispersion in an equilibrium on-the-job-search model with endogenous search intensity.Workers differ in their permanent skill level and firms differ with respect to productivity.Positive (negative) sorting results if the match production function is supermodular (submodular).The model is estimated on Danish matched employer-employee data.We find evidence of positive assortative matching.In the estimated equilibrium match distribution, the correlation between worker skill and firm productivity is 0.12.The assortative matching has a substantial impact on wage dispersion.We decompose wage variation into four sources: Worker heterogeneity, firm heterogeneity, frictions, and sorting.Worker heterogeneity contributes 51% of the variation, firm heterogeneity contributes 11%, frictions 23%, and finally sorting contributes 15%.We measure the output loss due to mismatch by asking how much greater output would be if the estimated population of matches were perfectly positively assorted.In this case, output would increase by 7.7%.

10.1093/restud/rdy022.abstractZh: 本文研究了在具有内生搜索强度的均衡在职搜索模型中的工资差异问题。劳动者在永久技能水平上存在差异，而企业则因生产率的不同而有所差异。如果匹配生产函数是超模块性的（次模块性的），则会出现正向（或负向）的排序效应。该模型基于丹麦的雇主-雇员匹配数据进行了估计。我们发现存在正向的同配匹配现象。在估计的均衡匹配分布中，劳动者技能与企业生产率之间的相关性为0.12。同配匹配对工资差异有显著影响。我们将工资变化分解为四个来源：劳动者异质性、企业异质性、摩擦因素以及排序效应。其中，劳动者异质性贡献了51%的变化幅度，企业异质性贡献了11%，摩擦因素贡献了23%，而排序效应则贡献了15%。我们通过询问如果估计的匹配人群完全呈正向同配，产出会增加多少来衡量由于不匹配导致的产出损失。在这种情况下，产出将增加7.7%。

abstract.text: We conduct an empirical analysis of consumer preferences and search costs on an Internet platform. Using data from a major French platform (PriceMinister), we show descriptive evidence of substantial price dispersion among adverts for the same product, of consumers often not choosing the cheapest advert and sometimes choosing an advert dominated in price and non-price characteristics by another available advert. We consider a sequential search model where consumers sample adverts in an endogenous order based on their preferences and search costs. We show that the optimal search-and-purchase strategy can be characterized by a set of inequalities which can feasibly be tested on transaction and advert data. This allows us to estimate, for each transaction, a set of preference and search cost parameter values, thus allowing for flexible consumer heterogeneity in preferences and search costs. The estimated model can then describe a wide range of consumer search and purchase behaviours. We find that the model can explain almost all transactions in the data and requires non-zero preferences and search costs for at least 50% and 22% (respectively) of observations. We also find evidence of heterogeneous and sometimes substantial search costs.

10.1093/restud/rdy023.abstractZh: 我们对互联网平台上的消费者偏好和搜索成本进行了实证分析。利用法国一家主要平台（PriceMinister）的数据，我们发现了一些有趣的发现：同一产品的广告之间价格存在较大差异；消费者通常不会选择最便宜的广告，有时会选择那些在价格和非价格特征上优于其他可用广告的广告。我们考虑了一个序贯搜索模型，其中消费者根据他们的偏好和搜索成本以内生顺序选择广告。我们证明，最优的搜索与购买策略可以通过一组不等式来描述，这些不等式可以通过交易和广告数据来实际验证。这使我们能够为每个交易估计出一组偏好和搜索成本参数值，从而允许在偏好和搜索成本方面存在灵活的消费者异质性。估计出的模型可以描述广泛的消费者搜索与购买行为。我们发现，该模型几乎可以解释数据中的所有交易，并且至少50%和22%的观测数据中，消费者的偏好和搜索成本均不为零。我们还发现了消费者搜索成本存在异质性的证据，有时甚至存在相当大的搜索成本。

abstract.text: This article develops a method to estimate and simulate the adoption of a network good. I estimate demand for mobile phones as a function of individuals’ social networks, coverage, and prices, using transaction data from nearly the entire network of Rwandan mobile phone subscribers at the time, over 4.5 years. I estimate the utility of adopting a phone based on its eventual usage: subscribers pay on the margin, so calls reveal the value of communicating with each contact. I use this structural model to simulate the effects of two policies. A requirement to serve rural areas lowered operator profits but increased net social welfare. Developing countries heavily tax mobile phones, but standard metrics that neglect network effects grossly understate the true welfare cost in a growing network, which is up to 3.12 times the revenue raised. Shifting from handset to usage taxes would have increased the surplus of poorer users by at least 26%.

10.1093/restud/rdy024.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种估算和模拟网络商品采纳率的方法。我利用4.5年间来自卢旺达几乎所有移动电话用户网络的交易数据，将移动电话的需求作为个人社交网络、网络覆盖范围和价格的函数进行估算。我根据手机的最终使用效果来估算采纳手机的效用：用户通过通话成本来支付，这表明与每个联系人沟通的价值。我利用这一结构模型来模拟两种政策的效果。要求运营商服务农村地区虽然降低了运营商的利润，但提高了社会的整体福利。发展中国家对移动电话征收高额税，但忽略网络效应的标准指标严重低估了在不断发展的网络中的实际福利成本，这一成本可能是所收取收入的3.12倍。从对手机征收税改为对使用行为征税，至少能使较贫困用户的福利增加26%。

abstract.text: We model and test two school-based peer cultures: one that stigmatizes effort and one that rewards ability. The model shows that either may reduce participation in educational activities when peers can observe participation and performance. We design a field experiment that allows us to test for, and differentiate between, these two concerns. We find that peer pressure reduces takeup of an SAT prep package virtually identically across two very different high school settings. However, the effects arise from very distinct mechanisms: a desire to hide effort in one setting and a desire to hide low ability in the other.

10.1093/restud/rdy026.abstractZh: 我们模拟并测试了两种基于学校的同伴文化：一种强调努力，另一种则奖励能力。模型显示，当同伴能够观察到参与情况和表现时，这两种文化都可能降低参与教育活动的意愿。我们设计了一项实地实验，以测试并区分这两种影响。研究发现，在两种截然不同的高中环境中，同伴压力对SAT备考包的使用意愿的影响几乎相同。然而，这些影响源自不同的机制：一种环境是出于隐藏努力的动机，另一种环境则是出于隐藏低能力的动机。

abstract.text: In this article, we use cross-state panel and cross-U.S. commuting-zone data to look at the relationship between innovation, top income inequality and social mobility. We find positive correlations between measures of innovation and top income inequality. We also show that the correlations between innovation and broad measures of inequality are not significant. Next, using instrumental variable analysis, we argue that these correlations at least partly reflect a causality from innovation to top income shares. Finally, we show that innovation, particularly by new entrants, is positively associated with social mobility, but less so in local areas with more intense lobbying activities.

10.1093/restud/rdy027.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们采用跨州面板数据和美国各通勤区的数据，来研究创新、顶层收入不平等与社会流动性之间的关系。我们发现，创新指标与顶层收入不平等之间存在正相关关系。同时，我们指出，创新与广泛的不平等指标之间的相关性并不显著。接下来，通过工具变量分析，我们认为这些相关性至少部分反映了从创新到顶层收入份额的因果关系。最后，我们发现，尤其是新进入者所创造的创新，与社会流动性呈正相关，但在 lobbying 活动较为激烈的地区，这种关联程度较低。

abstract.text: We empirically study the effects of broadband internet diffusion on local election outcomes and on local government policies using rich data from the U.K. Our analysis shows that the internet has displaced other media with greater news content (i.e. radio and newspapers), thereby decreasing voter turnout, most notably among less-educated and younger individuals. In turn, we find suggestive evidence that local government expenditures and taxes are lower in areas with greater broadband diffusion, particularly expenditures targeted at less-educated voters. Our findings are consistent with the idea that voters’ information plays a key role in determining electoral participation, government policies, and government size.

10.1093/restud/rdy028.abstractZh: 我们通过使用英国丰富的数据，实证研究了宽带互联网普及对地方选举结果及地方政府政策的影响。分析结果显示，互联网已经取代了其他新闻内容更丰富的媒体（如广播和报纸），从而降低了选民的投票率，尤其是在受教育程度较低和年龄较小的群体中。此外，我们发现，宽带普及程度较高的地区，地方政府在支出和税收方面的水平较低，尤其是针对受教育程度较低的选民的支出。我们的研究结果与“选民的信息获取在决定选举参与、政府政策以及政府规模方面起着关键作用”这一观点一致。

abstract.text: This article provides a model of social learning where the order in which actions are taken is determined by an |$m$|-dimensional integer lattice rather than along a line as in the herding model. The observation structure is determined by a random network. Every agent links to each of his preceding lattice neighbours independently with probability |$p$|⁠, and observes the actions of all agents that are reachable via a directed path in the realized social network. For |$m\geq 2$|⁠, we show that as |$p<1$| goes to one, (1) so does the asymptotic proportion of agents who take the optimal action, (2) this holds for any informative signal distribution, and (3) bounded signal distributions might achieve higher expected welfare than unbounded signal distributions. In contrast, if signals are bounded and |$p=1$|⁠, all agents select the suboptimal action with positive probability.

10.1093/restud/rdy029.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个社会学习模型，其中行动的顺序由|$m$|-维整数格子决定，而非像群聚模型那样沿直线进行。观察结构由随机网络决定。每个代理以概率|$p$|独立地与其前一个格子邻居建立联系，并观察通过实现的社会网络中的有向路径可以到达的所有代理的行为。对于|$m\geq 2$|，我们证明了当|$p<1$|趋近于1时，(1)采取最优行动的代理的渐近比例也会增加，(2)这一结论适用于任何信息信号分布，并且(3)有界信号分布可能比无界信号分布带来更高的预期福利。相反，如果信号是有界的且|$p=1$|，则所有代理都有正概率选择次优行动。

abstract.text: This article proposes a theory of optimal public expenditure when unemployment is inefficient. The theory is based on a matching model. Optimal public expenditure deviates from the Samuelson rule to reduce the unemployment gap (the difference between current and efficient unemployment rates).
