Such optimal “stimulus spending” is described by a formula expressed with three sufficient statistics: the unemployment gap, the unemployment multiplier (the decrease in unemployment achieved by increasing public expenditure), and the elasticity of substitution between public and private consumption. When unemployment is inefficiently high and the multiplier is positive, the formula yields the following results. (1) Optimal stimulus spending is positive and increasing in the unemployment gap. (2) Optimal stimulus spending is zero for a zero multiplier, increasing in the multiplier for small multipliers, largest for a moderate multiplier, and decreasing in the multiplier beyond that. (3) Optimal stimulus spending is zero if extra public goods have no value, it becomes larger as the elasticity of substitution increases, and it completely fills the unemployment gap if extra public goods are as valuable as extra private goods.

10.1093/restud/rdy030.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种在失业效率低下时的最优公共支出理论。该理论基于一个匹配模型。最优公共支出偏离萨缪尔森规则，以缩小失业差距（当前失业率与有效失业率之间的差异）。这种最优“刺激性支出”可以用一个公式来描述，该公式包含三个必要的统计量：失业差距、失业乘数（增加公共支出所减少的失业量）以及公共消费与私人消费之间的替代弹性。当失业率过高且失业乘数为正时，该公式得出以下结果：(1) 最优刺激性支出为正，并且随着失业差距的增加而增加；(2) 当失业乘数为零时，最优刺激性支出为零；对于较小的失业乘数，最优刺激性支出增加；对于中等大小的失业乘数，最优刺激性支出最大；超过该数值时，最优刺激性支出减少；(3) 如果额外公共产品的价值为零，则最优刺激性支出为零；随着替代弹性的增加，最优刺激性支出变大；如果额外公共产品的价值与额外私人产品的价值相当，则最优刺激性支出完全弥补了失业差距。

abstract.text: Non-equilibrium models of choice (e.g. level-|$k$| reasoning) have significantly different, sometimes more accurate, predictions in games than does Nash equilibrium. When it comes to the maximal set of functions that are implementable in mechanism design, however, they turn out to have similar implications. Focusing on single-valued rules, we discuss the role and implications of different behavioural anchors (arbitrary level-0 play), and prove a level-|$k$| revelation principle. If a function is level-|$k$| implementable given any level-0 play, it must obey a slight weakening of standard strict incentive constraints. Further, the same condition is also sufficient for level-|$k$| implementability, although the role of specific level-0 anchors is more controversial for the sufficiency argument. Nonetheless, our results provide tight characterizations of level-|$k$| implementable functions under a variety of level-0 play, including truthful, uniform, and atomless anchors.

10.1093/restud/rdy031.abstractZh: 非均衡选择模型（例如，水平-$k$|推理）在博弈中的预测与纳什均衡相比，有着显著的不同，有时甚至更为准确。然而，在机制设计中可实施的最大函数集合方面，这些模型却有着相似的含义。我们重点关注单值规则，探讨不同行为锚点（任意水平-0玩法）的作用和含义，并证明了水平-$k$|启示原则。如果一个函数在任何水平-0玩法下都能实现水平-$k$|，那么它必须遵循对标准严格激励约束的轻微放宽。此外，同样的条件也足以保证函数的水平-$k$|实现，尽管特定水平-0锚点的作用在充分性论证中更具争议性。尽管如此，我们的研究结果提供了在各种水平-0玩法下，能够实现水平-$k$|的函数的严格特征描述，包括真实、统一且无原子锚点的情况。

abstract.text: In late 2003, Norway passed a law mandating 40% representation of each gender on the board of public limited liability companies. The primary objective of this reform was to increase the representation of women in top positions in the corporate sector and decrease the gender disparity in earnings within that sector. We document that the women appointed to these boards post-reform were observably more qualified than their female predecessors along many dimensions, and that the gender gap in earnings within boards fell substantially. However, we see no robust evidence that the reform benefited the larger set of women employed in the companies subject to the quota. Moreover, the reform had no clear impact on highly qualified women whose qualifications mirror those of board members but who were not appointed to boards. Finally, we find mixed support for the view that the reform affected the decisions of young women. While the reform was not accompanied by any change in female enrollment in business education programmes, we do see some improvements in labour market outcomes for young women with graduate business degrees in their early career stages; however, we observe similar improvements for young women with graduate science degrees, suggesting this may not be due to the reform. Overall, seven years after the board quota policy fully came into effect, we conclude that it had very little discernible impact on women in business beyond its direct effect on the women who made it into boardrooms.

10.1093/restud/rdy032.abstractZh: 在2003年末，挪威通过了一项法律，要求上市公司董事会中必须至少有40%的成员为不同性别。这项改革的主要目标是提高女性在企业高层职位中的比例，并减少该行业内的性别收入差异。我们发现，改革后进入董事会的女性在多个方面的资质都明显优于之前的女性，而且董事会内部的性别收入差距也显著缩小。然而，我们没有发现任何有力的证据表明这项改革对受配额制度约束的公司中的其他女性产生了积极影响。此外，这项改革对那些具备与董事会成员相当资质但未被任命到董事会的女性也没有明显的影响。最后，我们发现对于这项改革是否影响了年轻女性的决策，支持意见并不一致。虽然这项改革并没有导致女性进入商业教育项目的比例发生变化，但我们确实观察到，拥有商业学位的年轻女性在职业生涯初期的劳动力市场表现有所改善；不过，拥有科学学位的年轻女性的表现也有类似的改善，这表明这种改善可能并非由于这项改革所致。总体而言，在董事会配额政策完全实施七年后，我们得出结论：除了对进入董事会的女性产生直接影响外，这项政策对女性在整个商业领域的影响微乎其微。

abstract.text: This article illustrates and characterizes how adaptive learning can lead to recurrent large fluctuations. Learning models have typically focused on the convergence of beliefs towards an equilibrium. However in stochastic environments, there may be rare but recurrent episodes where shocks cause beliefs to escape from the equilibrium, generating large movements in observed outcomes. I characterize the escape dynamics by drawing on the theory of large deviations, developing new results which make this theory directly applicable in a class of learning models. The likelihood, frequency, and most likely direction of escapes are all characterized by a deterministic control problem. I illustrate my results with two simple examples.

10.1093/restud/rdy033.abstractZh: 本文阐述了适应性学习如何导致反复出现的大幅波动。学习模型通常关注信念向均衡的收敛过程。然而在随机环境中，可能会出现一些罕见但反复出现的事件，这些事件中的冲击会导致信念偏离均衡，从而在观测结果中产生大幅波动。我利用大偏差理论来描述这种偏离动态，并提出了新的结果，使得这一理论可以直接应用于一类学习模型。偏离的可能性、频率以及最可能方向都由确定性控制问题来刻画。我通过两个简单的例子来说明我的研究结果。

abstract.text: We quantify the impact of scientific grant funding at the National Institutes of Health (NIH) on patenting by pharmaceutical and biotechnology firms. Our paper makes two contributions. First, we use newly constructed bibliometric data to develop a method for flexibly linking specific grant expenditures to private-sector innovations. Second, we take advantage of idiosyncratic rigidities in the rules governing NIH peer review to generate exogenous variation in funding across research areas. Our results show that NIH funding spurs the development of private-sector patents: a $10 million boost in NIH funding leads to a net increase of 2.3 patents. Though valuing patents is difficult, we report a range of estimates for the private value of these patents using different approaches.

10.1093/restud/rdy034.abstractZh: 我们量化了美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）的科研资助对制药和生物技术公司专利申请的影响。我们的论文有两个贡献点。首先，我们利用新构建的文献计量数据，开发了一种灵活的方法，将具体的科研资助支出与私营部门的创新活动联系起来。其次，我们利用NIH同行评审规则中的特殊性刚性，产生了不同研究领域的资金差异。我们的结果显示，NIH的资助促进了私营部门专利的发展：每增加1000万美元的NIH资金，专利数量就会增加2.3项。尽管评估专利价值很困难，但我们使用不同的方法报告了这些专利的私人价值范围。

abstract.text: We implement a dynamic asset pricing experiment in the spirit of Lucas (1978) with storable assets and non-storable cash. In the first treatment, we impose diminishing marginal returns to cash to incentivize consumption smoothing across periods. We find that subjects use the asset to smooth consumption, although the asset trades at a discount relative to the risk-neutral fundamental price. This under-pricing is a departure from the asset price “bubbles” observed in the large experimental asset pricing literature originating with Smith et al. (1988) and can be rationalized by considering subjects’ risk aversion with respect to uncertain money earnings. In a second treatment, with no induced motivation for trade à la the Smith et al. design, we find that the asset trades at a premium relative to its expected value and that shareholdings are highly concentrated. Elimination of asset price uncertainty in additional experimental treatments serves to reinforce the same observations, and suggests that speculative behaviour explains the departure of prices from fundamental value in the absence of a consumption-smoothing motive for asset trades.

10.1093/restud/rdy035.abstractZh: 我们实施了一种动态资产定价实验，其理念源自Lucas（1978）的研究，实验中涉及可存储资产与不可存储现金。在第一个实验设计中，我们设定了现金的边际回报递减机制，以激励参与者在不同时期进行消费平滑。研究发现，参与者确实使用该资产来平滑消费，尽管该资产相对于风险中性基本价格而言处于折价状态。这种低估现象与Smith等人（1988）开创的大规模实验资产定价文献中观察到的资产价格“泡沫”现象不同，可以通过考虑参与者对不确定货币收益的风险厌恶来加以解释。在第二个实验设计中，由于缺乏Smith等人设计中的交易动机，我们发现该资产相对于其预期价值而言处于溢价状态，且持股情况高度集中。在额外的实验设计中，通过消除资产价格的不确定性，我们再次观察到相同的现象，这表明在没有消费平滑动机的情况下，投机行为解释了资产价格与基本价值之间的偏差。

abstract.text: We develop a model explaining how criminal organizations strategically use pre-electoral violence as a way of influencing electoral results and politicians’ behaviour. We then characterize the incentives to use such violence under different levels of electoral competition and different electoral rules. Our theory is consistent with the empirical evidence within Sicily and across Italian regions. Specifically, the presence of organized crime is associated with abnormal spikes in violence against politicians before elections—particularly when the electoral outcome is more uncertain—which in turn reduces voting for parties opposed by criminal organizations. Using a very large data set of parliamentary debates, we also show that violence by the Sicilian Mafia reduces anti-Mafia efforts by members of parliament appointed in Sicily, particularly from the parties that traditionally oppose the Mafia.

10.1093/restud/rdy036.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个模型，用以解释犯罪组织如何战略性地利用选举前的暴力行为来影响选举结果和政客的行为。随后，我们分析了在不同选举竞争程度和不同选举规则下，使用此类暴力的动机。我们的理论与西西里岛以及整个意大利地区的实证证据是一致的。具体来说，有组织犯罪的存在与选举前针对政客的暴力行为异常增加有关——尤其是在选举结果更加不确定的情况下——这反过来又减少了支持犯罪组织反对的政党的投票率。通过大量议会辩论数据的分析，我们还发现西西里黑手党实施的暴力行为会削弱被任命到西西里岛的议员的反黑手党努力，尤其是那些传统上反对黑手党的政党。

abstract.text: We unite two basic approaches to modelling limited attention in choice by showing that the rational inattention model implies the formation of consideration sets—only a subset of the available alternatives will be considered for choice. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for rationally inattentive behaviour which allow the identification of consideration sets. In simple settings, chosen options are those that are best on a stand-alone basis. In richer settings, the consideration set can only be identified holistically. In addition to payoffs, prior beliefs impact consideration sets. Linear inequalities identify all priors consistent with each possible consideration set.

10.1093/restud/rdy037.abstractZh: 我们结合两种基本方法来建模有限注意力在选择中的表现，表明理性忽视模型意味着考虑集的形成——只有部分可用选项才会被考虑用于选择。我们提供了理性忽视行为的必要充分条件，从而能够识别考虑集。在简单的设定中，被选中的选项是在单独基础上最优的选项。在更复杂的设定中，考虑集只能整体地被识别。除了收益之外，先前的信念也会影响考虑集。线性不等式可以识别出与每个可能的考虑集一致的先验信息。

abstract.text: Home price expectations are believed to play an important role in housing dynamics, yet we have limited understanding of how they are formed and how they affect behaviour. Using a unique “information experiment” embedded in an online survey, this article investigates how consumers’ home price expectations respond to past home price growth, and how they impact investment decisions. After eliciting respondents’ priors about past and future local home price changes, we present a random subset of them with factual information about past (one- or five-year) changes, and then re-elicit expectations. This unique “panel” data allows us to identify causal effects of the information, and provides insights on the expectation formation process. We find that, on average, year-ahead home price expectations are revised in a way consistent with short-term momentum in home price growth, though respondents tend to underpredict the strength of momentum. Revisions of longer-term expectations show that respondents do not expect the empirically-occurring mean reversion in home price growth. These patterns are in line with recent behavioural models of housing cycles. Finally, we show that home price expectations causally affect investment decisions in a portfolio choice experiment embedded in the survey.

10.1093/restud/rdy038.abstractZh: 人们认为房价预期在住房动态中起着重要作用，然而我们对房价预期是如何形成以及它们如何影响行为了解有限。本文通过一项独特的“信息实验”，结合在线调查，研究了消费者房价预期如何响应过去的房价增长，以及这些预期如何影响投资决策。在收集受访者对过去和未来当地房价变化的先验认知后，我们向其中随机选取的一部分受访者提供有关过去（一年或五年）房价变化的实际信息，然后再次收集他们的预期。这种独特的“面板”数据使我们能够识别信息的因果效应，并揭示预期形成过程的机制。研究发现，平均而言，未来一期的房价预期会按照房价增长的短期趋势进行修正，尽管受访者往往低估了这种趋势的强度。对长期预期的修正表明，受访者并不预期房价增长会出现典型的均值回归现象。这些发现与最近关于住房周期的行为模型相符。最后，我们在调查中嵌入了一项投资组合选择实验，结果显示房价预期确实会因果性地影响投资决策。

abstract.text: Low adoption of agricultural technologies holds large productivity consequences for developing countries. Many countries hire agricultural extension agents to communicate with farmers about new technologies, even though a large academic literature has established that information from social networks is a key determinant of product adoption. We incorporate social learning in extension policy using a large-scale field experiment in which we communicate to farmers using different members of social networks. We show that communicator own adoption and effort are susceptible to small performance incentives, and the social identity of the communicator influences others’ learning and adoption. Farmers appear most convinced by communicators who share a group identity with them, or who face comparable agricultural conditions. Exploring the incentives for injection points in social networks to experiment with and communicate about new technologies can take the influential social learning literature in a more policy-relevant direction.

10.1093/restud/rdy039.abstractZh: 农业技术的采用率低会对发展中国家的生产力产生重大影响。许多国家雇用农业推广人员与农民沟通新技术，尽管大量学术研究表明，来自社交网络的信息是产品采用的关键决定因素。我们通过一项大规模实地实验将社会学习纳入推广政策中，实验中我们使用不同的社交网络成员向农民传递信息。我们发现，传播者自身的采用意愿和努力容易受到微小的绩效激励的影响，而且传播者的社会身份也会影响他人的学习和采用行为。农民似乎更相信那些与他们拥有相同群体身份或面临相似农业条件的传播者所传递的信息。探索在社交网络中设置注入点以试验和传播新技术的方法，可以将有影响力的社会学习文献转化为更具政策相关性的成果。

abstract.text: We study platform markets in which the information about users’ preferences is dispersed. First, we show how the dispersion of information introduces idiosyncratic uncertainty about participation decisions and how the latter shapes the elasticity of the demands and the equilibrium prices. We then study the effects on profits, consumer surplus, and welfare of platform design, blogs, forums, conferences, advertising campaigns, post-launch disclosures, and other information management policies affecting the agents’ ability to predict participation decisions on the other side of the market.

10.1093/restud/rdy040.abstractZh: 我们研究的是信息分散的平台市场。首先，我们探讨了信息的分散如何引入参与决策的特异性不确定性，以及这种不确定性如何影响需求弹性和均衡价格。接着，我们研究了平台设计、博客、论坛、会议、广告活动、上市后的信息披露以及其他影响参与者预测市场另一侧参与决策能力的信息管理政策对利润、消费者剩余和福利的影响。

abstract.text: The standard revenue-maximizing auction discriminates against a priori stronger bidders so as to reduce their information rents. We show that such discrimination is no longer optimal when the auction’s winner may resell to another bidder, and the auctioneer has non-Bayesian uncertainty about such resale opportunities. We identify a “worst-case” resale scenario, in which bidders’ values become publicly known after the auction and losing bidders compete Bertrand-style to buy the object from the winner. With this form of resale, misallocation no longer reduces the information rents of the high-value bidder, as he could still secure the same rents by buying the object in resale. Under regularity assumptions, we show that revenue is maximized by a version of the Vickrey auction with bidder-specific reserve prices, first proposed by Ausubel and Cramton (2004). The proof of optimality involves constructing Lagrange multipliers on a double continuum of binding non-local incentive constraints.

10.1093/restud/rdy041.abstractZh: 标准的收益最大化拍卖会对事先较强的竞买者进行歧视，以减少他们的信息租金。我们指出，当拍卖的获胜者可以将物品转售给其他竞买者，而拍卖师对这种转售机会存在非贝叶斯不确定性时，这种歧视就不再是最优的。我们定义了一个“最坏情况”的转售场景，在这种情况下，竞买者的价值在拍卖后变得公开，失败的竞买者会以伯特兰式的方式竞争，试图从获胜者手中购买物品。在这种转售形式下，错配行为不再降低高价值竞买者的信息租金，因为他仍然可以通过转售获得相同的租金。在常规假设下，我们证明，通过一种带有竞买者特定保留价格的维克里拍卖版本，收益可以被最大化，这一版本最初由Ausubel和Cramton在2004年提出。证明最优性涉及在双重连续体上构建拉格朗日乘数，以应对具有约束性的非局部激励条件。

abstract.text: We propose a criterion of approximate incentive compatibility, strategy-proofness in the large (SP-L), and argue that it is a useful second-best to exact strategy-proofness (SP) for market design. Conceptually, SP-L requires that an agent who regards a mechanism’s “prices” as exogenous to her report—be they traditional prices as in an auction mechanism, or price-like statistics in an assignment or matching mechanism—has a dominant strategy to report truthfully. Mathematically, SP-L weakens SP in two ways: (1) truth-telling is required to be approximately optimal (within epsilon in a large enough market) rather than exactly optimal, and (2) incentive compatibility is evaluated ex interim, with respect to all full-support i.i.d. probability distributions of play, rather than ex post with respect to all possible realizations of play. This places SP-L in between the traditional notion of approximate SP, which evaluates incentives to manipulate ex post and as a result is too strong to obtain our main results in support of SP-L, and the traditional notion of approximate Bayes-Nash incentive compatibility, which, like SP-L, evaluates incentives to manipulate ex interim, but which imposes common knowledge and strategic sophistication assumptions that are often viewed as unrealistic.

10.1093/restud/rdy042.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种近似激励兼容性的标准，以及在大市场中策略不可伪造的标准（SP-L），并认为这对于市场设计来说是一种有用的次优方案。从概念上讲，SP-L要求一个将机制的“价格”视为外生因素的代理人——无论是拍卖机制中的传统价格，还是分配或匹配机制中的类似价格的统计数据——都有一种最优策略是如实报告。从数学上讲，SP-L在两个方面削弱了SP：（1）如实报告在足够大的市场中近似最优（在epsilon范围内），而不是完全最优；（2）激励兼容性是在事后针对所有完全支持的独立同分布概率分布进行评估的，而不是事后针对所有可能的游戏实现情况进行评估。这使得SP-L介于传统的近似SP概念与近似贝叶斯-纳什激励兼容性概念之间。传统的近似SP概念是在事后评估激励以操纵游戏，因此过于严格，无法支持SP-L的主要结论；而近似贝叶斯-纳什激励兼容性概念则像SP-L一样在事后评估激励以操纵游戏，但其中包含了通常被认为不现实的常识和策略复杂性假设。

abstract.text: I study optimal design of a dynamic capital allocation process in an organization in which the division manager with empire-building preferences privately observes the arrival and properties of investment projects, and headquarters can audit projects at a cost. Under certain conditions, a budgeting mechanism with threshold separation of financing is optimal. Headquarters: (1) allocate a spending account to the manager and replenish it over time; (2) set a threshold, such that projects below it are financed from the account, while projects above are financed fully by headquarters upon an audit. Further analysis studies when co-financing of projects is optimal and how the size of the account depends on past performance of projects.

10.1093/restud/rdy043.abstractZh: 我研究的是组织中动态资本分配过程的最优设计问题。在这种组织中，具有扩张型偏好的部门经理会私下观察投资项目的到来和特性，而总部可以以一定的成本对项目进行审计。在某些条件下，具有阈值分离机制的预算机制是最优的。总部应：(1) 向经理分配一个支出账户，并随时间对其进行补充；(2) 设定一个阈值，低于该阈值的项目由该账户提供资金，而高于该阈值的项目则由总部在审计后全额资助。进一步的分析研究了项目共同融资的情况，以及账户规模如何取决于项目的过往表现。

abstract.text: We use 130 years of data on historical migrations to the U.S. to show a causal effect of the ancestry composition of U.S. counties on foreign direct investment (FDI) sent and received by local firms. To isolate the causal effect of ancestry on FDI, we build a simple reduced-form model of migrations: Migrations from a foreign country to a U.S. county at a given time depend on (1) a push factor, causing emigration from that foreign country to the entire U.S., and (2) a pull factor, causing immigration from all origins into that U.S. county. The interaction between time-series variation in origin-specific push factors and destination-specific pull factors generates quasi-random variation in the allocation of migrants across U.S. counties. We find that doubling the number of residents with ancestry from a given foreign country relative to the mean increases the probability that at least one local firm engages in FDI with that country by 4 percentage points. We present evidence that this effect is primarily driven by a reduction in information frictions, and not by better contract enforcement, taste similarities, or a convergence in factor endowments.

10.1093/restud/rdy044.abstractZh: 我们利用130年的美国历史移民数据，来研究美国各县的种族构成对当地企业对外直接投资的影响。为了分离出种族构成对对外直接投资的影响，我们构建了一个简单的迁移模型：在某个时间点，从一个外国国家到美国某个县的迁移取决于两个因素：（1）推动因素，导致该外国国家的居民向整个美国移民；（2）吸引因素，促使来自所有来源地的居民迁入该美国县。起源地特定的推动因素与目的地特定的吸引因素之间的相互作用，产生了美国各县之间移民分配的准随机变化。我们发现，如果某个外国国家拥有移民的居民数量相对于平均水平翻倍，那么至少有一家当地企业与该国家进行对外直接投资的概率将增加4个百分点。我们的证据表明，这种效应主要源于信息摩擦的减少，而非合同执行力的提升、口味相似性或要素禀赋的趋同。

abstract.text: Panel and experimental data are used to analyse the economic outcomes in the extended warranty market. We establish that the strong demand and high profits in this market are driven by consumers distorting the failure probability of the insured product, rather than standard risk aversion or sellers’ market power. Providing information to consumers about failure probabilities significantly reduces their willingness to pay for warranties, indicating the important role of information, or lack of, in driving consumers’ purchase behaviour. Such information provision is shown to be more effective in enhancing consumer welfare than additional market competition.

10.1093/restud/rdy045.abstractZh: 通过面板数据和实验数据来分析延长保修市场的经济成果。我们发现，该市场的高需求和高利润是由消费者扭曲了被保险产品的故障概率所驱动的，而非标准的风险厌恶或卖方的市场力量。向消费者提供故障概率信息会显著降低他们购买保修服务的意愿，这表明信息的提供或缺乏在驱动消费者购买行为中起着重要作用。这种信息提供在提升消费者福利方面比额外的市场竞争更为有效。

abstract.text: We use randomized interest rates, offered across eighty geographically distinct regions for twenty-nine months by Mexico’s largest microlender, to sketch the adjustment from a price change to a new equilibrium. Demand is elastic, and more so over the longer run; e.g. the dollars-borrowed elasticity increases from $-$1.1 in Year one to $-$2.9 in Year three. Credit bureau data do not show evidence of crowd-out, although this and other null results are imprecisely estimated. The lender’s profits increase, albeit noisily, starting in Year two. But competitors do not respond by reducing rates. These findings, together with other results, suggest that informational frictions are important, and that cutting rates furthered Compartamos Banco’s “double bottom line” of improving social welfare subject to a profitability constraint.

10.1093/restud/rdy046.abstractZh: 我们采用了墨西哥最大的微型贷款机构在八十个地理上不同的地区提供的随机利率，持续了二十九年，以此来描绘从价格变动到新均衡状态的调整过程。需求具有弹性，且在较长时间内更为明显；例如，以美元借款的弹性从第一年的$-1.1增加到第三年的$-2.9。信用局的数据并未显示出挤出现象，尽管这一结果以及其他无效结果估计并不精确。从第二年开始，贷款机构的利润有所增加，尽管增长幅度较大。但竞争对手并未通过降低利率来应对。这些发现以及其他结果表明，信息摩擦非常重要，而降低利率进一步促进了Compartamos Banco的“双重目标”——在盈利性的约束下改善社会福利。

abstract.text: To estimate the causal effect of refugee migration on voting outcomes in parliamentary and municipal elections in Denmark, our study is the first that addresses the key problem of immigrant sorting by exploiting a policy that assigned refugee immigrants to municipalities on a quasi-random basis. We find that in all but the most urban municipalities, allocation of larger refugee shares between electoral cycles leads to an increase in the vote share for right-leaning parties with an anti-immigration agenda, and we show large differences in voters’ responses to refugee allocation according to pre-policy municipal characteristics. However, in the largest and urban municipalities, refugee allocation has—if anything—the opposite effect on vote shares for anti-immigration parties. This coincides with a sharp divide in attitudes to refugees between urban and rural populations, which may be partly explained by distinctive interactions between natives and those with different background in cities and rural areas. Refugee allocation also has a large impact on the anti-immigration parties’ choice of where to stand for municipal election, and we provide some evidence that it influences voter turnout.

10.1093/restud/rdy047.abstractZh: 为了估计难民迁移对丹麦议会和市政选举投票结果的影响，我们的研究是首个通过利用一种将难民分配到市政区的准随机政策来解决移民分类这一关键问题的研究。我们发现，除了最城市化的市政区外，每轮选举中难民比例的增加会导致支持反移民政党的政党获得更高的投票份额。同时，我们发现选民对难民分配的反应因市政区的政策前特征而存在显著差异。然而，在最大规模和城市化程度最高的市政区，难民分配反而对反移民政党的投票份额产生了相反的影响。这与城市和农村人口在对待难民态度上的明显分歧相吻合，这部分可以归因于城市和农村地区本地人与不同背景人群之间的独特互动。难民分配还显著影响了反移民政党在市政选举中的竞选策略选择，我们有一些证据表明它会影响选民的投票率。

abstract.text: We examine how trust is sustained in large societies with random matching, when records of past transgressions are retained for a finite length of time. To incentivize trustworthiness, defaulters should be punished by temporary exclusion. However, it is profitable to trust defaulters who are on the verge of rehabilitation. With perfect bounded information, defaulter exclusion unravels and trust cannot be sustained, in any purifiable equilibrium. A coarse information structure, that pools recent defaulters with those nearing rehabilitation, endogenously generates adverse selection, sustaining punishments. Equilibria where defaulters are trusted with positive probability improve efficiency, by raising the proportion of likely re-offenders in the pool of defaulters.

10.1093/restud/rdy048.abstractZh: 我们研究了在随机匹配的大规模社会中，如何维持信任，同时记录过去的不当行为并保留一定的时间。为了激励诚信行为，应通过对违约者进行临时排除来惩罚他们。然而，对于那些即将改过自新的违约者，信任他们是具有盈利性的。在完美的有界信息条件下，违约者的排除会导致信任无法维持，在任何可消除的均衡中都是如此。一种粗糙的信息结构，将最近的违约者与即将改过自新的人聚集在一起，会内生性地产生逆向选择，从而维持惩罚措施。在违约者被以较高概率信任的均衡中，效率得到提升，因为违约者群体中可能再次违约的比例增加了。

abstract.text: This article studies an asymptotic framework for conducting inference on parameters of the form |$\phi(\theta_0)$|⁠, where |$\phi$| is a known directionally differentiable function and |$\theta_0$| is estimated by |$\hat \theta_n$|⁠. In these settings, the asymptotic distribution of the plug-in estimator |$\phi(\hat \theta_n)$| can be derived employing existing extensions to the Delta method. We show, however, that (full) differentiability of |$\phi$| is a necessary and sufficient condition for bootstrap consistency whenever the limiting distribution of |$\hat \theta_n$| is Gaussian. An alternative resampling scheme is proposed that remains consistent when the bootstrap fails, and is shown to provide local size control under restrictions on the directional derivative of |$\phi$|⁠. These results enable us to reduce potentially challenging statistical problems to simple analytical calculations—a feature we illustrate by developing a test of whether an identified parameter belongs to a convex set. We highlight the empirical relevance of our results by conducting inference on the qualitative features of trends in (residual) wage inequality in the U.S.

10.1093/restud/rdy049.abstractZh: 本文研究了一种用于推断形如|$\phi(\theta_0)$|参数的渐近框架，其中|$\phi$|是一个已知的方向可微函数，而|$\theta_0$|则通过|$\hat \theta_n$|进行估计。在这些情况下，可以利用对Delta方法的现有扩展来推导插人估计量|$\phi(\hat \theta_n)$|的渐近分布。然而，我们指出，只要|$\hat \theta_n$|的极限分布是高斯分布，|$\phi$|的完全可微性就是自举法一致性的必要充分条件。我们提出了一种替代的重采样方案，该方案在自举法失效时仍然保持一致性，并且被证明在限制|$\phi$|的方向导数的情况下能够提供局部规模控制。这些结果使我们能够将潜在的统计问题简化为简单的分析计算——我们通过开发一个测试来检验一个已识别的参数是否属于凸集，以此来说明这一点。我们通过对美国（剩余）工资不平等趋势的定性特征进行推断，强调了我们结果的实证相关性。

abstract.text: We study state taxes as a potential source of spatial misallocation in the U.S.. We build a spatial general equilibrium framework that incorporates salient features of the U.S. state tax system, and use changes in state tax rates between 1980 and 2010 to estimate the model parameters that determine how worker and firm location respond to changes in state taxes. We find that heterogeneity in state tax rates leads to aggregate welfare losses. In terms of consumption equivalent units, harmonizing state taxes increases worker welfare by 0.6% if government spending is held constant, and by 1.2% if government spending responds endogenously. Harmonization of state taxes within Census regions achieves most of these gains. We also use our model to study the general equilibrium effects of recently implemented and proposed tax reforms.

10.1093/restud/rdy050.abstractZh: 我们研究了州税作为美国空间资源配置失衡的潜在来源。我们构建了一个空间一般均衡框架，该框架包含了美国州税制度的显著特征，并利用1980年至2010年间州税率的变化来估计决定工人和企业的位置如何响应州税变化的模型参数。我们发现，州税率的异质性会导致总体福利损失。就消费等价单位而言，如果政府支出保持不变，州税的统一将使工人福利增加0.6%；如果政府支出是内生性的，则增加1.2%。在人口普查区域内部统一州税可以实现大部分这些收益。我们还利用我们的模型研究了最近实施和提出的税收改革的一般均衡效应。

abstract.text: We study the impact of the integration of women in U.S. policing between the late 1970s and early 1990s on violent crime reporting and domestic violence (DV). Along these two key dimensions, we find that female officers improved police quality. Crime victimization data reveal that as female representation increases among officers in an area, violent crimes against women in that area, and especially DV, are reported to the police at significantly higher rates. There are no such effects for violent crimes against men or from increases in the female share of civilian police employees. Furthermore, increases in female officer shares are followed by significant declines in rates of intimate partner homicide and non-fatal domestic abuse. These effects are all consistent between fixed effects models with controls for economic and policy variables and models that focus exclusively on increases in female police employment driven by externally imposed affirmative action plans following litigation for employment discrimination.

10.1093/restud/rdy051.abstractZh: 我们研究了20世纪70年代末至90年代初美国警察队伍中女性比例增加对暴力犯罪报告和家庭暴力报告的影响。从这两个关键维度来看，我们发现女性警员的加入提升了警察队伍的整体素质。犯罪受害数据表明，当一个地区女性警员比例增加时，该地区针对女性的暴力犯罪，尤其是家庭暴力，被报告给警察的比例显著上升。然而，针对男性的暴力犯罪或女性警察在文职人员中比例的增加并未产生类似效果。此外，女性警员比例的增加伴随着亲密伴侣凶杀和非致命性家庭暴力的发生率显著下降。这些效应在考虑了经济和政策变量的固定效应模型中与那些仅关注因就业歧视诉讼而实施的积极行动计划导致的女性警察就业增加的模型中都是一致的。

abstract.text: This article proposes a strategic framework to account for fertility choices in polygamous households. It uses unique data on fertility histories of a representative sample of co-wives in Senegal to estimate a duration model of birth intervals with individual baseline hazards. Exploiting entries and exits of co-wives as well as gender of births, empirical tests show that children are strategic complements. One wife raises her fertility in response to an increase by the other wife, because children are the best claim to resources controlled by the husband. This result is the first quantitative evidence that the competition between co-wives drives fertility upwards. It suggests that polygamy undermines the fertility transition in Sub-Saharan Africa by incentivizing women to want many children. This article is also one of the few attempts to open the black box of non-nuclear families, placing strategic interactions at the heart of household decision-making.

10.1093/restud/rdy052.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个战略框架，用于解释多配偶家庭中的生育选择。文章利用塞内加尔代表性样本中的寡妇生育历史数据，建立了一个包含个体基线风险的出生间隔模型。通过分析寡妇的进出情况以及出生的性别，实证研究表明，子女是战略上的互补资源。一位妻子会提高自己的生育率以回应另一位妻子的生育意愿，因为子女是丈夫控制资源的最佳依据。这一结果是首个定量证据，表明寡妇之间的竞争会推动生育率上升。文章还指出，多配偶制通过激励女性生育多个子女，从而破坏了撒哈拉以南非洲地区的生育转型。本文也是少数试图揭示非核心家庭内部战略互动的尝试之一，将战略互动置于家庭决策的核心位置。

abstract.text: We study the implications of including many covariates in a first-step estimate entering a two-step estimation procedure. We find that a first-order bias emerges when the number of included covariates is “large” relative to the square-root of sample size, rendering standard inference procedures invalid. We show that the jackknife is able to estimate this “many covariates” bias consistently, thereby delivering a new automatic bias-corrected two-step point estimator. The jackknife also consistently estimates the standard error of the original two-step point estimator. For inference, we develop a valid post-bias-correction bootstrap approximation that accounts for the additional variability introduced by the jackknife bias-correction. We find that the jackknife bias-corrected point estimator and the bootstrap post-bias-correction inference perform excellent in simulations, offering important improvements over conventional two-step point estimators and inference procedures, which are not robust to including many covariates. We apply our results to an array of distinct treatment effect, policy evaluation, and other applied microeconomics settings. In particular, we discuss production function and marginal treatment effect estimation in detail.

10.1093/restud/rdy053.abstractZh: 我们研究了在第一步估计中引入多个协变量对第二步估计程序的影响。我们发现，当所包含的协变量数量相对于样本量的平方根“过大”时，会出现一阶偏差，使得标准推断方法变得无效。我们证明，杰克刀法能够一致地估计这种“多协变量”偏差，从而提供了一种新的自动偏差校正两步点估计量。杰克刀法还能一致地估计原始两步点估计量的标准误差。在推断方面，我们开发了一种有效的偏差校正后自助法近似方法，该方法能够考虑到杰克刀法偏差校正引入的额外变异性。我们发现，杰克刀法偏差校正后的点估计量和自助法偏差校正后的推断在模拟实验中表现优异，相较于传统的两步点估计量和推断方法，具有显著改进，后者在面对多协变量时并不稳健。我们将研究结果应用于一系列不同的处理效应、政策评估以及其他应用微观经济学场景。特别是，我们详细讨论了生产函数和边际处理效应估计的问题。

abstract.text: When judging the value of a good, people may be overly influenced by the state in which they previously consumed it. For example, someone who tries out a new restaurant while very hungry may subsequently rate it as high quality, even if the food is mediocre. We produce a simple framework for this form of attribution bias that embeds a standard model of decision making as a special case. We test for attribution bias across two consumer decisions. First, we conduct an experiment in which we randomly manipulate the thirst of participants prior to consuming a new drink. Second, using data from thousands of amusement park visitors, we explore how pleasant weather during their most recent trip affects their stated and actual likelihood of returning. In both of these domains, we find evidence that people misattribute the influence of a temporary state to a stable quality of the consumption good. We provide evidence against several alternative accounts for our findings and discuss the broader implications of attribution bias in economic decision making.

10.1093/restud/rdy054.abstractZh: 在评估商品的价值时，人们可能会受到他们之前消费该商品的情境的过度影响。例如，一个在非常饥饿的情况下尝试一家新餐厅的人，可能会认为这家餐厅的食物质量很高，即使实际上食物只是中等水平。我们提出了一个简单的框架来解释这种归因偏差，该框架将标准决策模型作为特例纳入其中。我们对两种消费决策进行了归因偏差的测试。首先，我们进行了一项实验，在参与者饮用新饮料之前随机操控他们的口渴程度。其次，利用数千名游乐园游客的数据，我们探讨了他们最近一次旅行中的天气状况如何影响他们返回的可能性。在这两个领域，我们发现人们将临时情境的影响错误地归因于商品的稳定质量。我们提供了一些证据来反驳其他可能的解释，并讨论了归因偏差在经济决策中的更广泛影响。

abstract.text: This article models a frictional labour market where employers endogenously discriminate against the long-term unemployed. The estimated model replicates recent experimental evidence which documents that interview invitations for observationally equivalent workers fall sharply as unemployment duration progresses. We use the model to quantitatively assess the consequences of such employer behaviour for job finding rates and long-term unemployment and find only modest effects given the large decline in callbacks. Interviews lost to duration impact individual job finding rates solely if they would have led to jobs. We show that such instances are rare when firms discriminate in anticipation of an ultimately unsuccessful application. Discrimination in callbacks is thus largely a response to dynamic selection, with limited consequences for structural duration dependence and long-term unemployment.

10.1093/restud/rdy055.abstractZh: 本文对一个摩擦性劳动力市场进行了建模，其中雇主会内生性地歧视长期失业者。所建立的模型能够复制最近的实验证据，这些证据显示，对于在观察上等效的工人，随着失业时间的延长，获得面试邀请的机会会显著减少。我们利用该模型定量评估了这种雇主行为对求职率和长期失业的影响，发现其影响较为有限，因为获得面试邀请的机会大幅减少。只有当面试机会会导致实际就业时，失业时间才会对个人的求职率产生显著影响。我们指出，当企业出于对最终申请失败的预期而实施歧视时，这种情况较为罕见。因此，在面试机会方面的歧视主要是对动态选择的响应，其对结构性失业时间依赖性和长期失业的影响有限。

abstract.text: We build a dynamic model of migration where, in addition to standard relocation costs, workers face spatial frictions that decrease their ability to compete for distant job opportunities. We estimate the model on a matched employer–employee panel dataset describing labour market transitions within and between the 100 largest French cities. Our identification strategy is based on the premise that frictions affect the frequency of job transitions, while mobility costs impact the distribution of accepted wages. We find that: (1) controlling for spatial frictions reduces mobility cost estimates by one order of magnitude; (2) the urban wage premium is driven by better opportunities for local job-to-job transitions in larger cities; (3) migration reduces lifetime inequalities by providing insurance against unsatisfactory initial location draws; (4) labour mobility policies based on relocation subsidies are inefficient, unlike switching from nationwide to local minimum wages.

10.1093/restud/rdy056.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个动态迁移模型，在该模型中，除了标准的迁移成本外，劳动者还面临空间摩擦，这些摩擦会降低他们竞争远距离工作机会的能力。我们在一个匹配的雇主-雇员面板数据集上对该模型进行了估计，该数据集描述了法国100个最大城市内部及之间的劳动力市场转换情况。我们的识别策略基于这样一个前提：摩擦会影响工作转换的频率，而迁移成本则会影响接受工资的分配。我们发现：(1)控制空间摩擦可以将迁移成本的估计值降低一个数量级；(2)城市工资溢价是由大城市中更好的工作转换机会所驱动的；(3)迁移通过提供对初始位置选择不理想的保险，减少了终身不平等；(4)基于迁移补贴的劳动力流动政策是低效的，与从全国范围转向当地最低工资的做法相比。

abstract.text: We introduce a dynamic noisy rational expectations model in which information diffuses through a general network of agents. In equilibrium, agents who are more closely connected have more similar period-by-period trades, and an agent’s profitability is determined by a centrality measure that is related to Katz centrality. Volatility after an information shock is more persistent in less central networks, and volatility and trading volume are also influenced by the network’s asymmetry and irregularity. Using account-level data of all portfolio holdings and trades on the Helsinki Stock Exchange between 1997 and 2003, we find support for the aggregate predictions, altogether suggesting that the market’s network structure is important for these dynamics.

10.1093/restud/rdy058.abstractZh: 我们引入了一个动态噪声理性预期模型，其中信息通过一般的代理人网络进行传播。在均衡状态下，联系更紧密的代理人之间的交易模式更为相似，代理人的盈利能力由与Katz中心性相关的中心性指标决定。在信息冲击之后，波动在中心性较低的网络中更为持久，波动性和交易量也受到网络不对称性和不规则性的影响。利用1997年至2003年间赫尔辛基证券交易所所有投资组合持有量和交易的数据，我们发现这些总体预测得到了支持，进一步表明市场的网络结构对这些动态过程至关重要。

abstract.text: We develop and evaluate experimentally a novel tool that redesigns the job search process by providing tailored advice at low cost. We invited jobseekers to our computer facilities for twelve consecutive weekly sessions to search for real jobs on our web interface. For one-half, instead of relying on their own search criteria, we use readily available labour market data to display relevant alternative occupations and associated jobs. The data indicate that this broadens the set of jobs they consider and increases their job interviews especially for participants who otherwise search narrowly and have been unemployed for a few months.

10.1093/restud/rdy059.abstractZh: 我们开发并实验性地评估了一种新型工具，该工具通过提供低成本、个性化的建议来重新设计求职过程。我们邀请求职者每周两次使用我们的计算机设施，在我们的网络界面上搜索真实的工作机会。在其中的一半时间里，我们不再依赖求职者自身的搜索标准，而是使用现成的劳动力市场数据来展示相关的职业选择及相应的工作机会。数据显示，这种方法能够扩大求职者考虑的工作范围，并增加他们的求职机会，尤其是对于那些原本搜索范围较窄且已经失业了几个月的求职者来说。

abstract.text: Standard optimal Debt Management (DM) models prescribe a dominant role for long bonds and advocate against issuing short bonds. They require very large positions in order to complete markets and assume each period that governments repurchase all outstanding bonds and reissue (r/r) new ones. These features of DM are inconsistent with U.S. data. We introduce incomplete markets via small transaction costs which serves to make optimal DM more closely resemble the data : r/r are negligible, short bond issuance substantial and persistent and short and long bonds positively co-vary. Intuitively, long bonds help smooth taxes over states and short bonds over time. Solving incomplete market models with multiple assets is challenging so a further contribution of this article is introducing a novel computational method to find global solutions.

10.1093/restud/rdy061.abstractZh: 标准最优债务管理模型强调长期债券的主导地位，并反对发行短期债券。这些模型要求政府持有大量债券以完成市场运作，并假设每个周期政府都会回购所有未偿还债券并重新发行新的债券。这些特点与美国的数据不符。我们通过引入小额交易成本来模拟不完美市场，从而使最优债务管理模型更接近实际数据：重新发行的新债券数量可以忽略不计，短期债券发行频繁且持续存在，短期和长期债券之间存在正相关关系。直观上，长期债券有助于平滑各州的税收负担，而短期债券则有助于时间上的税收平滑。解决具有多种资产的不完美市场模型是一项挑战，本文进一步提出了一种新颖的计算方法，以寻找全局解决方案。

abstract.text: The majority of innovations are developed by multi-sector firms. The knowledge needed to invent new products is more easily adapted from some sectors than from others. We study this network of knowledge linkages between sectors and its impact on firm innovation and aggregate growth. We first document a set of sectoral-level and firm-level observations on knowledge applicability and firms’ multi-sector patenting behaviour. We then develop a general equilibrium model of firm innovation in which inter-sectoral knowledge linkages determine the set of sectors a firm chooses to innovate in and how much R&D to invest in each sector. It captures how firms evolve in the technology space, accounts for cross-sector differences in R&D intensity, and describes an aggregate model of technological change. The model matches new observations as demonstrated by simulation. It also yields new insights regarding the mechanism through which sectoral fixed costs of R&D affect growth.

10.1093/restud/rdy062.abstractZh: 大多数创新是由多部门企业开发的。发明新产品所需的知识，从某些部门获取比从其他部门获取更为容易。我们研究了这些部门之间的知识联系网络及其对企业创新和整体增长的影响。首先，我们记录了一组关于知识适用性以及企业多部门专利行为的部门级和企业级观察结果。随后，我们建立了一个企业创新的一般均衡模型，该模型认为部门间的知识联系决定了企业选择进行创新的部门，以及每个部门需要投入多少研发资源。该模型能够描述企业在技术领域的演变过程，解释不同部门在研发强度上的差异，并描述技术变革的整体模型。通过模拟实验，我们发现该模型与新的观察结果相符。此外，该模型还提供了关于部门固定研发成本如何影响增长的机制的新见解。

abstract.text: We develop a new methodology to estimate the elasticity of urban costs with respect to city population using French house and land price data. After handling a number of estimation concerns, we find that the elasticity of urban costs increases with city population with an estimate of about 0.03 for an urban area with 100,000 inhabitants to 0.08 for an urban area of the size of Paris. Our approach also yields a number of intermediate outputs of independent interest such as the share of housing in expenditure, the elasticity of unit house and land prices with respect to city population, and within-city distance gradients for house and land prices.

10.1093/restud/rdy063.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种新的方法，利用法国房屋和土地价格数据来估算城市成本对城市人口变化的弹性。在处理了一系列估算问题后，我们发现城市成本对城市人口的弹性随着人口的增加而增加，对于拥有10万居民的城区，该弹性约为0.03；而对于像巴黎这样的大都市，该弹性则上升至0.08。我们的方法还产生了一些具有独立价值的中间结果，例如住房在总支出中的占比、单位房屋和土地价格对城市人口的弹性，以及城市内部房屋和土地价格的距离梯度。

abstract.text: In markets where sellers are able to price discriminate, individuals pay different prices that may be unobserved by the econometrician. This article considers the structural estimation of a demand and supply model of differentiated products with such price discrimination and limited information on prices taking the form of, e.g., observing list prices from catalogues or average prices. Within this framework, identification is achieved not only with usual moment conditions on the demand side, but also through supply-side restrictions. The model can be estimated by GMM using a nested fixed point algorithm that extends the usual contraction mapping algorithm to our setting. We apply our methodology to estimate the demand and supply in the French new automobile market. Our results suggest that discounting arising from price discrimination is important. The average discount is estimated to be 9.6%, with large variation depending on buyers’ characteristics and cars’ specifications. Our results are consistent with other evidence on transaction prices in France.

10.1093/restud/rdy064.abstractZh: 在卖方能够进行价格歧视的市场中，消费者会支付不同的价格，而这些价格可能不会被计量经济学家观察到。本文考虑了在有限价格信息的情况下，对具有价格歧视的差异化产品需求和供应模型进行结构估计的方法。例如，可以通过观察目录中的标价或平均价格来获取这些价格信息。在这个框架下，识别不仅可以通过需求方面的常规矩条件来实现，还可以通过供应方面的限制来实现。该模型可以使用嵌套固定点算法进行广义矩估计，该算法将常规的收缩映射算法扩展到我们的情境下。我们将该方法应用于估计法国新汽车市场的需求和供应情况。我们的结果表明，由于价格歧视而产生的折扣效应非常重要。平均折扣率估计为9.6%，且这一数值会因购买者的特征和汽车的规格而有所不同。我们的结果与法国其他关于交易价格的研究结果一致。

abstract.text: This article considers the problem of testing many moment inequalities where the number of moment inequalities, denoted by $p$, is possibly much larger than the sample size $n$. There is a variety of economic applications where solving this problem allows to carry out inference on causal and structural parameters; a notable example is the market structure model of Ciliberto and Tamer (2009) where $p=2^{m+1}$ with $m$ being the number of firms that could possibly enter the market. We consider the test statistic given by the maximum of $p$ Studentized (or $t$-type) inequality-specific statistics, and analyse various ways to compute critical values for the test statistic. Specifically, we consider critical values based upon (1) the union bound combined with a moderate deviation inequality for self-normalized sums, (2) the multiplier and empirical bootstraps, and (3) two-step and three-step variants of (1) and (2) by incorporating the selection of uninformative inequalities that are far from being binding and a novel selection of weakly informative inequalities that are potentially binding but do not provide first-order information. We prove validity of these methods, showing that under mild conditions, they lead to tests with the error in size decreasing polynomially in $n$ while allowing for $p$ being much larger than $n$; indeed $p$ can be of order $\exp (n^{c})$ for some $c > 0$. Importantly, all these results hold without any restriction on the correlation structure between $p$ Studentized statistics, and also hold uniformly with respect to suitably large classes of underlying distributions. Moreover, in the online supplement, we show validity of a test based on the block multiplier bootstrap in the case of dependent data under some general mixing conditions.

10.1093/restud/rdy065.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在矩不等式数量可能远大于样本量$n$的情况下，如何检验这些不等式的问题。在多种经济应用中，解决这一问题有助于对因果效应和结构参数进行推断；一个典型的例子是Ciliberto和Tamer在2009年提出的市场结构模型，其中$p=2^{m+1}$，$m$表示可能进入市场的企业数量。我们考虑了由$p$个学生化（或$t$型）不等式统计量的最大值构成的检验统计量，并分析了计算检验统计量临界值的不同方法。具体来说，我们考虑了基于以下三种方法的临界值：(1)结合适度偏差不等式的自归一化和的联合界限；(2)乘数效应和实证自举法；(3)通过选择远离约束性的无信息不等式和选择可能具有约束性但不提供一阶信息的弱信息不等式，对(1)和(2)进行两步和三步变体处理。我们证明了这些方法的有效性，表明在温和条件下，这些方法能够使得检验的误差大小随$n$呈多项式下降，同时允许$p$远大于$n$；实际上，$p$可以呈$\exp (n^{c})$的顺序增长，其中$c > 0$。重要的是，所有这些结果都不依赖于$p$个学生化统计量之间的相关结构，并且对于适当大的基础分布类具有一致性。此外，在在线补充材料中，我们展示了在一般混合条件下，基于块乘数自举法的检验在依赖数据情况下的有效性。

abstract.text: In this article, we analyse the dynamics of intra-household allocations using unique panel data on individual-specific consumption expenditures and time used for leisure, market production, and home production. Cross-sectional differences at the time of marriage in expected wage profiles between a husband and wife strongly affect the allocation of private consumption expenditures and time use by households in the cross section. There are substantial gender asymmetries in these allocations. Even for households where the husband and wife have identical wages, the private consumption expenditures for the wife are about half those for the husband. Within a given household over time, shocks to wages lead households to shift the relative weights in favour of the spouse receiving the favourable shock. Additionally, we find that households adjust the weights in response to large but not to small shocks; the adjustment to the weights is twice as large in the year leading up to a divorce; and adjustments are more frequent in dual- than in single-earner households. We interpret the data using a dynamic collective model of the household with potentially limited commitment.

10.1093/restud/rdy066.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们分析了家庭内部分配的动态变化，使用了关于个人消费支出以及用于休闲、市场生产和家庭生产的时间的独特面板数据。在婚姻时的预期工资状况方面，夫妻之间的差异对家庭在横截面上的私人消费支出和时间使用有着显著的影响。在这些分配中存在着显著的性别不对称现象。即使对于夫妻工资相同的家庭来说，妻子的私人消费支出大约只有丈夫的一半。在给定家庭中，工资的变化会导致家庭调整其相对权重，以有利于接受有利冲击的一方。此外，我们发现家庭在面临较大冲击时会调整权重，而在离婚前的年份，这种调整幅度是离婚前两年的两倍；而且，这种调整在双收入家庭中的频率高于单收入家庭。我们使用动态集体模型来解释这些数据，该模型考虑了家庭可能有限的承诺因素。

abstract.text: We study the relationship between homebuyers’ beliefs about future house price changes and their mortgage leverage choices. Whether more pessimistic homebuyers choose higher or lower leverage depends on their willingness and ability to reduce the size of their housing market investments. When households primarily maximize the levered return of their property investments, more pessimistic homebuyers reduce their leverage to purchase smaller houses. On the other hand, when considerations such as family size pin down the desired property size, pessimistic homebuyers reduce their financial exposure to the housing market by making smaller downpayments to buy similarly-sized homes. To determine which scenario better describes the data, we investigate the cross-sectional relationship between house price beliefs and mortgage leverage choices in the U.S. housing market. We use plausibly exogenous variation in house price beliefs to show that more pessimistic homebuyers make smaller downpayments and choose higher leverage, in particular in states where default costs are relatively low, as well as during periods when house prices are expected to fall on average. Our results highlight the important role of heterogeneous beliefs in explaining households’ financial decisions.

10.1093/restud/rdy068.abstractZh: 我们研究了购房者对未来房价变化的看法与其抵押贷款杠杆选择之间的关系。更悲观的购房者是否选择更高的或更低的杠杆，取决于他们减少住房市场投资规模的意愿和能力。当家庭主要追求其房产投资的杠杆回报时，更悲观的购房者会减少杠杆以购买较小的房屋。另一方面，当家庭规模等因素决定了所需的房产规模时，悲观的购房者会通过减少首付来降低对住房市场的财务风险。为了确定哪种情景更能描述数据，我们调查了美国住房市场中房价看法与抵押贷款杠杆选择之间的横截面关系。我们利用看似外生的房价看法变化来证明，更悲观的购房者会减少首付并选择更高的杠杆，尤其是在违约成本相对较低的州，以及房价预计平均下跌的时期。我们的研究结果强调了异质性信念在解释家庭财务决策中的重要作用。

abstract.text: A series of discontinuities in the allocation mechanism of federal transfers to municipal governments in Brazil allow us to identify the causal effect of public spending on local labour markets, using a “fuzzy” Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD). Our estimates imply a cost per job of about 8,000 US dollars per year and a local income multiplier around two. The effect comes mostly from employment in services and is more pronounced among less financially developed municipalities.

10.1093/restud/rdy069.abstractZh: 通过对巴西联邦政府对市政政府的转移支付分配机制中一系列不连续性的分析，我们能够利用“模糊回归不连续设计”方法，识别出公共支出对当地劳动力市场的影响。我们的估计结果显示，每个就业岗位每年的成本约为8,000美元，当地收入乘数约为2。这种影响主要来自于服务业的就业，并且在经济欠发达的市政当局中更为明显。

abstract.text: Deforestation is a matter of pressing global concern, yet surprisingly little is known about the relative efficacy of various policies designed to combat it. This article sets out a framework for measuring the cost effectiveness of alternative policies—both command-and-control and incentive-based—in the Brazilian Amazon. First, I estimate the demand for deforestation on private properties, exploiting regional variation in transportation costs as a means to recover farmers’ responses to permanent policies. Here, rescaling transportation costs using local yields allows me to express changes in farmers’ valuations in dollars per hectare. I then use the estimated demand to infer farmers’ willingness to deforest under different counterfactual policies, such as payments to avoid deforestation and taxes on land use, along with the corresponding potential farmers’ lost surpluses. The results indicate that payment programmes and land use taxes on agricultural land can be highly effective in preserving the rainforest and also be substantially less expensive than command-and-control policies (approximately 8 times less costly). A carbon tax equal to the social cost of carbon could virtually eliminate all agricultural land in the Amazon, given the low agricultural returns there.

10.1093/restud/rdy070.abstractZh: 森林砍伐是一个全球性的紧迫问题，然而，关于各种旨在应对这一问题的政策的相对有效性，我们知之甚少。本文提出了一个框架，用于衡量巴西亚马逊地区不同政策——包括命令控制型政策和激励型政策——的成本效益。首先，我估算了私人土地上的森林砍伐需求，通过利用区域间运输成本差异来反映农民对永久性政策的反应。通过使用当地产量重新调整运输成本，我可以将农民对每公顷土地价值的变动以美元表示。然后，我利用估算出的需求来推断农民在不同假设政策下的砍伐意愿，例如支付费用以避免森林砍伐和对土地使用征税，以及相应的农民潜在收益损失。结果表明，支付计划和对农业用地的土地使用税在保护雨林方面非常有效，并且其成本远低于命令控制型政策（大约低8倍）。考虑到亚马逊地区的农业回报较低，相当于碳社会成本的碳税几乎可以消除所有农业用地。

abstract.text: Dynastic models common in macroeconomics use a single parameter to control the willingness of individuals to substitute consumption both intertemporally, or across periods, and intergenerationally, or across parents and their children. This article defines the concept of elasticity of intergenerational substitution (EGS), and extends a standard dynastic model in order to disentangle the EGS from the EIS, or elasticity of intertemporal substitution. A calibrated version of the model lends strong support to the notion that the EGS is significantly larger than one. In contrast, estimates of the EIS suggests that it is at most one. What disciplines the identification is the need to match empirically plausible fertility rates for the U.S. We illustrate the potential role of the EGS in macroeconomics.

10.1093/restud/rdy071.abstractZh: 在宏观经济学中常见的王朝模型使用单一参数来控制个体在跨时间或跨时期，以及跨代际或父母与子女之间替代消费的意愿。本文定义了代际替代弹性（EGS）的概念，并扩展了一个标准王朝模型，以将EGS与跨时间替代弹性（EIS）区分开来。经过校准的模型版本强烈支持EGS远大于1的观点。相比之下，EIS的估计表明其最大值为一。限制这种识别的因素是需要匹配美国实际可行的生育率数据。本文阐述了EGS在宏观经济学中的潜在作用。

abstract.text: We study the interplay between informational frictions and second-degree price discrimination. Our theory recognizes that consumers differ in their tastes for quality as well as in the information they possess about available offers, which leads to dispersion over price–quality menus in equilibrium. While firms are ex ante identical, we show that their menus are ordered so that more generous menus leave more surplus to consumers of all valuations. We explore the cross-section of equilibrium menus and variations in market conditions to generate empirical predictions on prices, qualities, and markups across firms, and within a firm’s product line. For instance, more competition may raise prices for low-quality goods; yet, consumers are better off, as the qualities they receive also increase. The predictions of our model illuminate empirical findings in many markets, such as those for cell phone plans, yellow-pages advertising, cable TV, and air travel.

10.1093/restud/rdy072.abstractZh: 我们研究了信息摩擦与二级价格歧视之间的相互作用。我们的理论认识到，消费者对质量的需求以及他们所掌握的相关信息存在差异，这导致在均衡状态下价格与质量的组合出现多样性。虽然企业在事前是相同的，但我们发现它们的产品组合是有序的，这样更优的产品组合能够为各种需求的消费者带来更多的剩余收益。我们探讨了均衡产品组合的市场条件变化，并提出了关于企业间以及企业内部产品线中价格、质量及加价率的实证预测。例如，更多的竞争可能会提高低质量商品的价格；然而，消费者实际上会受益更多，因为他们获得的质量也提高了。我们模型的预测与许多市场的实证研究结果相符，比如手机套餐、黄页广告、有线电视和航空旅行等领域的情况。

abstract.text: A seller has a fixed number of goods to sell by a deadline. At each time, he posts a regular price and decides whether to hold a flash sale. Over time, buyers privately enter the market and strategically time their purchases. If a buyer does not purchase when she arrives, she can pay an attention cost to recheck the regular price afterwards, or she can wait for future flash sales where she may obtain a good at a discounted price. In the unique Markov perfect equilibrium, the seller sporadically holds flash sales to lower the stock of goods. A flash sale increases the willingness to pay of future buyers, but decreases the willingness to pay of buyers who arrive early in the game. When it is very likely that a buyer will obtain a good in a flash sale, the seller holds a “big” initial flash sale for all but one unit of the good.

10.1093/restud/rdy073.abstractZh: 卖家在截止日期前需要售出固定数量的商品。每次销售时，他都会公布固定价格，并决定是否进行限时抢购。随着时间的推移，买家会私下进入市场，并策略性地安排购买时间。如果买家在到达时没有购买，她可以支付一定的成本来重新查看价格，或者等待未来的限时抢购，这样她可能会以折扣价购买商品。在独特的马尔可夫完美均衡状态下，卖家会不定期地举行限时抢购，以降低商品库存。限时抢购能够提升未来买家的支付意愿，但会降低早期到达的买家的支付意愿。当买家很有可能在限时抢购中购买到商品时，卖家会为除一个单位外的所有商品举行一次“大型”的初期限时抢购。

abstract.text: We consider a game between a principal, an agent, and a monitor in which the principal would like to rely on messages by the monitor (the potential whistleblower) to target intervention against a misbehaving agent. The difficulty is that the agent can credibly threaten to retaliate against the monitor in the event of an intervention. In this setting, intervention policies that are responsive to the monitor’s message provide informative signals to the agent, which can be used to target threats efficiently. Principals that are too responsive to information shut down communication channels. Successful intervention policies must therefore garble the information provided by monitors and cannot be fully responsive. We show that policy evaluation on the basis of non-verifiable whistleblower messages is feasible under arbitrary incomplete information provided policy design takes into account that messages are endogenous.

10.1093/restud/rdy075.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一个由委托人、代理人以及监督者组成的博弈。委托人希望依靠监督者（潜在的举报人）传递的信息来针对行为不端的代理人进行干预。然而，代理人的行为可能会可信地威胁到对监督者的报复行为。在这种情况下，对监督者传递的信息做出反应的干预政策能够为代理人提供有用的信息，从而有效应对威胁。但过于依赖这些信息会导致沟通渠道的关闭。因此，成功的干预政策必须同时模糊监督者提供的信息，不能完全依赖这些信息。我们证明，在任意不完备信息条件下，基于不可验证的举报人信息来评估政策是可行的，前提是政策设计考虑到信息具有内生性。

abstract.text: We propose non-parametric definitions of absolute and comparative naivete. These definitions leverage ex ante choice of menu to identify predictions of future behaviour and ex post (random) choices from menus to identify actual behaviour. The main advantage of our definitions is their independence from any assumed functional form for the utility function representing behaviour. An individual is sophisticated if she is indifferent ex ante between retaining the option to choose from a menu ex post or committing to her actual distribution of choices from that menu. She is naive if she prefers the flexibility in the menu, reflecting a mistaken belief that she will act more virtuously than she actually will. We propose two definitions of comparative naivete and explore the restrictions implied by our definitions for several prominent models of time inconsistency.

10.1093/restud/rdy076.abstractZh: 我们提出了绝对天真和比较天真的非参数定义。这些定义利用事前选择菜单的方式来识别未来行为的预测，并通过事后（随机）选择菜单的方式来识别实际行为。我们的定义的主要优势在于，它们独立于任何假定的效用函数功能形式，该效用函数代表行为。如果一个个体在事前对是否事后选择菜单中的选项或坚持其实际选择分布持中立态度，那么她就是复杂的。如果她更倾向于菜单中的灵活性，反映出一种错误的信念，即她会表现得比实际更道德，那么她就是天真的。我们提出了两种比较天真的定义，并探讨了这些定义对几种典型的时间不一致性模型的限制。

abstract.text: How strong are strategic complementarities in price setting across firms? In this article, we provide a direct empirical estimate of firms’ price responses to changes in competitor prices. We develop a general theoretical framework and an empirical identification strategy, taking advantage of a new micro-level dataset for the Belgian manufacturing sector. We find strong evidence of strategic complementarities, with a typical firm adjusting its price with an elasticity of 0.4 in response to its competitors’ price changes and with an elasticity of 0.6 in response to its own cost shocks. Furthermore, we find evidence of substantial heterogeneity in these elasticities across firms. Small firms exhibit no strategic complementarities in price setting and complete cost pass-through. In contrast, large firms exhibit strong strategic complementarities, responding to both competitor price changes and their own cost shocks with roughly equal elasticities of around 0.5. We show that this pattern of heterogeneity in markup variability across firms is important for explaining the aggregate markup response to international shocks and the observed low exchange rate pass-through into domestic prices.

10.1093/restud/rdz005.abstractZh: 企业之间在定价策略上的互补性有多强？在本文中，我们直接通过实证方法估计了企业对竞争对手价格变动的响应。我们建立了一个通用的理论框架和实证识别策略，并利用比利时制造业领域的新微观数据进行了研究。我们发现企业之间存在强烈的互补性：典型企业的价格调整弹性为0.4，以应对竞争对手的价格变动，而自身成本冲击的响应弹性为0.6。此外，我们还发现这些弹性在不同企业之间存在显著的异质性。小型企业在定价和成本传递方面缺乏互补性，而大型企业在应对竞争对手价格变动和自身成本冲击时，其弹性大致为0.5。我们指出，这种企业间定价弹性的异质性对于解释整体价格对国际冲击的响应以及汇率对国内价格的影响较小具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Unemployed households’ access to unsecured revolving credit more than tripled over the last three decades. This article analyses how both cyclical fluctuations and trend increases in credit access impact the business cycle. The main quantitative result is that credit expansions and contractions have contributed to moderately deeper and more protracted recessions over the last 40 years. As more individuals obtained credit from 1977 to 2010, cyclical credit fluctuations affected a larger share of the population and became more important determinants of employment dynamics. Even though business cycles are more volatile, newborns strictly prefer to live in the economy with growing, but fluctuating, access to credit markets.

10.1093/restud/rdz006.abstractZh: 在过去三十年中，失业家庭获得无担保循环信贷的机会增加了两倍多。本文分析了周期性波动和信贷获取量的趋势性增长如何影响商业周期。主要的定量结果表明，在过去40年中，信贷的扩张和收缩导致了更为严重且持续时间更长的经济衰退。从1977年到2010年，随着越来越多的人获得信贷，周期性信贷波动对更大比例的人口产生了影响，并成为就业动态的重要决定因素。尽管商业周期更加不稳定，但新生个体仍然更倾向于生活在信贷市场获取能力虽有波动但仍在增长的经济环境中。

abstract.text: Exporting firms often enter foreign markets that are similar to their previous export destinations. We develop a dynamic model in which a firm’s exports in a market may depend on how similar the market is to the firm’s home country (gravity) and to its previous export destinations (extended gravity). Given the large number of export paths from which forward-looking firms may choose, we use a moment inequality approach to estimate our model. Our estimates indicate that sharing similarities with a prior export destination in terms of geographic location, language, and income per capita jointly reduces the cost of foreign market entry by 69–90%. Reductions due to geographic location (25–38%) and language (29–36%) have the largest effect. Extended gravity thus has a large impact on export entry costs.

10.1093/restud/rdz007.abstractZh: 出口企业通常会进入与其以往出口目的地相似的外国市场。我们建立了一个动态模型，该模型表明，企业在某个市场的出口情况可能取决于该市场与本国以及以往出口目的地的相似程度（分别称为“引力效应”和“扩展引力效应”）。鉴于有大量的出口路径可供有前瞻性的企业选择，我们采用矩不等式方法对模型进行估计。我们的估计结果显示，在地理位置、语言和人均收入方面与以往出口目的地具有相似性，可以共同降低进入外国市场的成本，降低幅度为69%至90%。其中，地理位置的降低效果最为显著，为25%至38%，语言因素的降低效果为29%至36%。因此，扩展引力效应对出口进入成本有着较大的影响。

abstract.text: Can we identify highly central individuals in a network without collecting network data, simply by asking community members? Can seeding information via such nominated individuals lead to significantly wider diffusion than via randomly chosen people, or even respected ones? In two separate large field experiments in India, we answer both questions in the affirmative. In particular, in 521 villages in Haryana, we provided information on monthly immunization camps to either randomly selected individuals (in some villages) or to individuals nominated by villagers as people who would be good at transmitting information (in other villages). We find that the number of children vaccinated every month is 22% higher in villages in which nominees received the information. We show that people’s knowledge of who are highly central individuals and good seeds can be explained by a model in which community members simply track how often they hear gossip about others. Indeed, we find in a third data set that nominated seeds are central in a network sense, and are not just those with many friends or in powerful positions.

10.1093/restud/rdz008.abstractZh: 我们能否在不收集网络数据的情况下，仅通过询问社区成员来识别网络中的核心人物？通过这样被提名的人来传递信息，是否比通过随机选择的人，甚至是受人尊敬的人来传递信息，能带来更广泛的传播效果？在印度进行的两项大型实地实验中，我们得出了肯定的答案。特别是在哈里亚纳邦的521个村庄中，我们向随机选择的个体，以及由村民提名认为能够擅长传递信息的个体，提供了关于每月免疫活动的信息。我们发现，在那些被提名者收到信息的村庄，每月接种疫苗的儿童数量高出22%。我们还发现，人们对谁是核心人物以及谁是优秀的传播者，可以通过一个模型来解释，即社区成员只需记录他们听到关于他人的闲言碎语的频率。事实上，在第三个数据集中，我们发现被提名的人在网络中确实处于核心地位，而不仅仅是那些拥有许多朋友或处于强势地位的人。

abstract.text: Individuals are constantly processing external information and translating it into actions. This draws on limited resources of attention and requires economizing on attention devoted to signals related to economic behaviour. A natural measure of such costs is based on Shannon’s “channel capacity”. Modelling economic agents as constrained by Shannon capacity as they process freely available information turns out to imply that discretely distributed actions, and thus actions that persist across repetitions of the same decision problem, are very likely to emerge in settings that without information costs would imply continuously distributed behaviour. We show how these results apply to the behaviour of an investor choosing portfolio allocations, as well as to some mathematically simpler “tracking” problems that illustrate the mechanism. Trying to use costs of adjustment to explain “stickiness” of actions when interpreting the behaviour in our economic examples would lead to mistaken conclusions.

10.1093/restud/rdz011.abstractZh: 个体不断处理外部信息并将其转化为行动。这一过程需要有限的注意力资源，因此必须节省用于与经济行为相关的信号上的注意力。衡量这种成本的一个自然方法是基于香农的“信道容量”理论。将经济主体建模为在自由获取信息的条件下受到香农容量限制，意味着离散分布的行动，即在重复相同的决策过程中持续出现的行动，很可能在没有信息成本的情况下会导致连续分布的行为。我们展示了这些结果如何适用于投资者选择投资组合分配的行为，以及一些数学上更简单的“跟踪”问题，这些问题可以说明这一机制。试图用调整成本来解释行动在解释经济实例中的“粘性”时，会导致错误的结论。

abstract.text: The world’s poor are seeing a rapid expansion in access to formal savings accounts. What is the source of savings when households are connected to a formal account? We combine a high-frequency panel survey spanning two and a half years with an experiment in which a Sri Lankan bank used mobile Point-of-Service (POS) terminals to collect deposits directly from households each week. We find that the headwaters of formal savings lie in sacrificed leisure time: households work more, and improved savings options generate an increase in labour effort in both self-employment and in the wage market. The results suggest that the labour allocation channel is an important mechanism linking savings opportunities to income.

10.1093/restud/rdz020.abstractZh: 全球贫困人口在获得正式储蓄账户服务方面取得了快速进展。当家庭能够使用正式账户时，储蓄的来源究竟是什么？我们结合了一项为期两年半的高频面板调查，以及一项实验——斯里兰卡的一家银行使用移动服务终端每周直接从家庭收集存款。研究发现，正式储蓄的源头在于家庭牺牲了休闲时间：家庭工作的时间增加了，而改进的储蓄选择使得家庭在自雇和工资市场中的劳动投入也增加了。这些结果表明，劳动分配机制是连接储蓄机会与收入的重要机制。

abstract.text: We investigate the link between hospital performance and managerial education by collecting a large database of management practices and skills in hospitals across nine countries. We find that hospitals closer to universities offering both medical education and business education have lower mortality rates from acute myocardial infarction (heart attacks), better management practices, and more MBA-trained managers. This is true compared to the distance to universities that offer only business or medical education (or neither). We argue that supplying bundled medical and business education may be a channel through which universities improve management practices in hospitals and raise clinical performance.

10.1162/rest_a_00847.abstractZh: 我们通过收集九个国家医院管理实践和技能的大量数据库，研究了医院绩效与管理教育之间的联系。研究发现，那些靠近同时提供医学教育和商业教育大学的医院，其急性心肌梗死（心脏病发作）的死亡率较低，管理实践也更为完善，且拥有更多接受过工商管理硕士培训的管理人员。相比之下，那些仅提供商业教育或医学教育（或两者都不提供）的大学所在医院则存在这些问题。我们认为，提供整合的医学与商业教育可能是大学改善医院管理实践并提高临床绩效的一种途径。

abstract.text: This lecture focuses on the costs of public debt when safe interest rates are low. I develop four main arguments. First, I show that the current US situation, in which safe interest rates are expected to remain below growth rates for a long time, is more the historical norm than the exception. If the future is like the past, this implies that debt rollovers, that is the issuance of debt without a later increase in taxes, may well be feasible. Put bluntly, public debt may have no fiscal cost. Second, even in the absence of fiscal costs, public debt reduces capital accumulation, and may therefore have welfare costs. I show that welfare costs may be smaller than typically assumed. The reason is that the safe rate is the risk-adjusted rate of return to capital. If it is lower than the growth rate, it indicates that the risk-adjusted rate of return to capital is in fact low. The average risky rate however also plays a role. I show how both the average risky rate and the average safe rate determine welfare outcomes. Third, I look at the evidence on the average risky rate, i.e., the average marginal product of capital. While the measured rate of earnings has been and is still quite high, the evidence from asset markets suggests that the marginal product of capital may be lower, with the difference reflecting either mismeasurement of capital or rents. This matters for debt: the lower the marginal product, the lower the welfare cost of debt. Fourth, I discuss a number of arguments against high public debt, and in particular the existence of multiple equilibria where investors believe debt to be risky and, by requiring a risk premium, increase the fiscal burden and make debt effectively more risky. This is a very relevant argument, but it does not have straightforward implications for the appropriate level of debt. My purpose in the lecture is not to argue for more public debt, especially in the current political environment. It is to have a richer discussion of the costs of debt and of fiscal policy than is currently the case. (JEL E22, E23, E43, E62, H63)

10.1257/aer.109.4.1197.abstractZh: 本次讲座聚焦于在安全利率较低时公共债务的代价。我提出了四个主要论点。首先，我指出当前美国的状况——安全利率预计将在很长一段时间内低于经济增长率——更属于历史常态而非例外。如果未来与过去相同，那么债务重划，即在不增加税收的情况下发行债务，可能是可行的。坦率地说，公共债务可能不会产生财政成本。其次，即使没有财政成本，公共债务也会降低资本积累，因此可能会带来福利成本。我表明，这些福利成本可能比通常认为的要小。原因是安全利率是风险调整后的资本回报率。如果它低于经济增长率，则表明风险调整后的资本回报率实际上很低。然而，平均风险利率也起着作用。我展示了平均风险利率和平均安全利率如何共同决定福利结果。第三，我研究了关于平均风险利率的证据，即资本的平均边际产品。虽然实际收益率一直很高，但资产市场的证据表明，资本的边际产品可能较低，这种差异反映了资本测量错误或租金问题。这对债务来说很重要：边际产品越低，债务的福利成本就越低。第四，我讨论了一些反对高公共债务的论点，特别是存在多个均衡的情况，投资者认为债务具有风险，并通过要求风险溢价来增加财政负担，从而使债务实际上变得更加风险高。这是一个非常相关的论点，但它并没有直接说明适当的债务水平。我在讲座中的目的不是主张增加公共债务，尤其是在当前的政治环境下。而是希望就债务成本和财政政策展开更深入的讨论。（JEL E22, E23, E43, E62, H63）

abstract.text: William D. Nordhaus delivered his Prize Lecture on 8 December 2018 at the Aula Magna, Stockholm University.

10.1257/aer.109.6.1991.abstractZh: 威廉·D·诺德豪斯于2018年12月8日在斯德哥尔摩大学的大礼堂发表了他的获奖演讲。

abstract.text: In recent years, the concern about the tradeoffs between economic growth and environmental quality have been paramount. To a large extent, the energy sector has been the locus of the major battles. For the most part, the concerns have been with local environmental problems such as disputes over air and water quality, nuclear accidents, and radioactive wastes. Although these problems have not been solved, it appears that as a result of considerable technical work that techniques exist (even if political will does not) to reduce most local environmental problems to a tolerable level. There remain on the agenda, however, a number of global environmental problems, and again these relate mainly to the energy sector. In particular, it appears that emissions of carbon dioxide particulate matter, and waste heat may, at some time in the future, lead to significant climatic modifications. Of these, it appears that carbon dioxide will probably be the first man-made emission to affect climate on a global scale, with a significant temperature increase by the end of the century.

10.1257/aer.109.6.2015.abstractZh: 近年来，关于经济增长与环境质量之间的权衡问题备受关注。在很大程度上，能源领域一直是这些争论的焦点。这些担忧主要涉及到当地的环境问题，如空气和水质问题、核事故以及放射性废物等。尽管这些问题尚未得到完全解决，但鉴于大量的技术努力，已经存在一些方法（即使缺乏政治意愿）可以将大多数当地环境问题降低到可容忍的水平。然而，仍有一些全球性的环境问题需要解决，而这些问题同样主要与能源领域相关。特别是，二氧化碳、颗粒物以及废热排放在未来某个时候可能会导致显著的气候变化。其中，二氧化碳排放很可能是第一个影响全球气候的人为因素，预计到本世纪末，全球气温将出现显著上升。

abstract.text: Leading empiricists and theorists of cities have recently argued that the generation and exchange of ideas must play a more central role in the analysis of cities. This paper develops the first system of cities model with costly idea exchange as the agglomeration force. The model replicates a broad set of established facts about the cross section of cities. It provides the first spatial equilibrium theory of why skill premia are higher in larger cities and how variation in these premia emerges from symmetric fundamentals. (JEL J24, J31, O31, R12, R23)

10.1257/aer.20130249.abstractZh: 一些著名的城市经济学理论家与实证研究者最近提出，在分析城市问题时，思想的产生与交流必须扮演更为核心的角色。本文提出了首个以 costly idea exchange 作为集聚力的城市模型，该模型能够再现关于城市横截面的一系列既定事实。该模型首次提出了空间均衡理论，解释了为何在较大城市中技能溢价较高，以及这些溢价如何因对称的基本面而发生变化。（JEL J24, J31, O31, R12, R23）

abstract.text: This paper shows that a macro model with segmented financial markets can generate sizable movements in housing prices in response to changes in credit conditions. We establish theoretically that reductions in mortgage rates always have a positive effect on prices, whereas the relaxation of loan-to-value constraints has ambiguous effects. A quantitative version of the model under perfect foresight accounts for about one-half of the observed price increase in the United States in the 2000s. When we include shocks to expectations about housing finance conditions, the model’s ability to match house values improves significantly. The framework reconciles the observed disconnect between house prices and rents since, in general equilibrium, financial shocks can decrease rents and increase prices. (JEL E44, G21, R31)

10.1257/aer.20140193.abstractZh: 本文表明，一个具有分割金融市场的宏观模型能够因信贷条件的变化而产生显著的房价波动。我们从理论上证明，抵押贷款利率的降低总是会对房价产生积极影响，而贷款与房产价值的限制放宽则会产生不确定的效果。在完全预见性的情况下，该模型的定量版本可以解释20世纪00年代美国房价上涨约一半的原因。当我们考虑对住房融资条件的预期冲击时，模型对房价与租金之间关系的匹配能力显著提高。该框架解释了房价与租金之间观察到的不一致现象，因为在一般均衡条件下，金融冲击可以降低租金并提高房价。（JEL E44, G21, R31）

abstract.text: We study the market for ratings agencies in the commercial mortgage backed securities sector leading up to and including the financial crisis of 2007–2008. Using a structural model adapted from the auctions literature, we characterize the incentives of ratings agencies to distort ratings in favor of issuers. We find an important equilibrium distortion, which decreased after the crisis. We study several counterfactual experiments motivated by recent policymaking in this industry. (JEL D44, G01, G24)

10.1257/aer.20140773.abstractZh: 我们研究了2007-2008年金融危机期间及之前，商业抵押贷款支持证券领域评级机构的市场状况。采用从拍卖文献中借鉴的结构模型，我们分析了评级机构为了偏袒发行人而扭曲评级的动机。我们发现了一个重要的均衡扭曲现象，该扭曲现象在危机后有所减轻。我们还研究了基于该行业近期政策制定的几种反事实实验。（JEL D44, G01, G24）

abstract.text: This paper develops a new approach to test for downward wage rigidity by examining transitory shocks to labor demand (i.e., rainfall) across 600 Indian districts. Nominal wages rise during positive shocks but do not fall during droughts. In addition, transitory positive shocks generate ratcheting: after they have dissipated, wages do not adjust back down. Ratcheting reduces employment by 9 percent, indicating that rigidities distort employment levels. Inflation, which is unaffected by local rainfall, enables downward real wage adjustments—offering causal evidence for its labor market effects. Surveys suggest that individuals believe nominal wage cuts are unfair and lead to effort reductions. (JEL E24, E31, J23, J31, O15, O18, R23)

10.1257/aer.20141625.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的方法来检验工资刚性问题，通过研究印度600个地区的劳动力需求的暂时性冲击（如降雨）。在积极的冲击下，名义工资会上升，而在干旱期间则不会下降。此外，暂时的积极冲击还会产生“棘轮效应”：这些冲击消失后，工资并不会再次下降。这种棘轮效应会导致就业减少9%，表明刚性现象会扭曲就业水平。不受当地降雨影响的通货膨胀则能够实现名义工资的下降——这为通货膨胀在劳动力市场中的影响提供了因果证据。调查表明，人们认为名义工资的削减是不公平的，并且会导致工作努力度的降低。（JEL E24, E31, J23, J31, O15, O18, R23）

abstract.text: We study slow moving debt crises: self-fulfilling equilibria in which high interest rates, due to the fear of a future default, lead to a gradual but faster accumulation of debt, ultimately validating investors’ fear. We show that slow moving crises arise in a variety of settings, both when fiscal policy follows a given rule and when it is chosen by an optimizing government. A key assumption, in all these settings, is that the borrowing government cannot commit to issue a fixed amount of bonds in a given period. We discuss how multiplicity is avoided for low debt levels, for sufficiently responsive fiscal policy rules, and for long enough debt maturities. When the equilibrium is unique, debt dynamics are characterized by a tipping point, below which debt falls and stabilizes and above which debt and default rates grow. (JEL E43, E62, H50, H63)

10.1257/aer.20141766.abstractZh: 我们研究了缓慢发展的债务危机：这种危机中，由于对未来违约的恐惧，高利率导致债务逐渐但加速地累积，最终验证了投资者的担忧。我们发现，这种缓慢发展的危机出现在多种情况下，无论是当财政政策遵循某种规则时，还是当政府出于优化目的选择政策时。所有这些情况下，一个关键假设是，借款政府无法承诺在给定时间内发行固定数量的债券。我们探讨了如何避免低债务水平、足够敏感的财政政策规则以及足够长的债务到期时间时出现多重均衡问题。当均衡是唯一的时，债务动态会有一个转折点，低于这个转折点，债务会下降并稳定下来；高于这个转折点，债务和违约率会上升。（JEL E43, E62, H50, H63）

abstract.text: We study how goods- and labor-market frictions affect aggregate labor productivity in China. Combining unique data with a general equilibrium model of internal and international trade, and migration across regions and sectors, we quantify the magnitude and consequences of trade and migration costs. The costs were high in 2000, but declined afterward. The decline accounts for 36 percent of the aggregate labor productivity growth between 2000 and 2005. Reductions in internal trade and migration costs are more important than reductions in external trade costs. Despite the decline, migration costs are still high and potential gains from further reform are large. (JEL E24, F16, J24, P23, P25, R12, R23)

10.1257/aer.20150811.abstractZh: 我们研究商品市场和劳动力市场中的摩擦如何影响中国的总体劳动生产率。通过结合独特的数据与内部贸易、国际贸易以及跨地区、跨部门的迁移的一般均衡模型，我们量化了贸易和迁移成本的大小及其影响。2000年时这些成本很高，但之后有所下降。在2000年至2005年间，成本的下降贡献了总体劳动生产率增长的36%。减少内部贸易和迁移成本比减少外部贸易成本更为重要。尽管成本有所下降，但迁移成本仍然很高，进一步改革的潜在收益仍然很大。（JEL E24, F16, J24, P23, P25, R12, R23）

abstract.text: We study the political impact of commercial television in Italy exploiting the staggered introduction of Berlusconi’s private TV network, Mediaset, in the early 1980s. We find that individuals with early access to Mediaset all-entertainment content were more likely to vote for Berlusconi’s party in 1994, when he first ran for office. The effect persists for five elections and is driven by heavy TV viewers, namely the very young and the elderly. Regarding possible mechanisms, we find that individuals exposed to entertainment TV as children were less cognitively sophisticated and civic-minded as adults, and ultimately more vulnerable to Berlusconi’s populist rhetoric. (JEL D72, L82, M31, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20150958.abstractZh: 我们研究了商业电视在意大利的政治影响，重点关注贝卢斯科尼在1980年代初推出私人电视网络Mediaset时的分阶段推广过程。研究发现，那些最早接触Mediaset全娱乐内容的人群，在1994年贝卢斯科尼首次竞选公职时，更有可能投票给他的政党。这种影响持续了五次选举，并且主要受到高电视观众群体的影响，即非常年轻和年老的人群。关于可能的机制，我们发现，那些在童年时期接触娱乐电视的人，成年后认知能力较低，公民意识较弱，因此更容易被贝卢斯科尼的民粹主义言论所影响。（JEL D72, L82, M31, Z13）

abstract.text: This paper develops a model of the nursing home industry to investigate the quality effects of policies that either raise regulated reimbursement rates or increase local competition. Using data from Pennsylvania, I estimate the parameters of the model. The findings indicate that nursing homes increase the quality of care, measured by the number of skilled nurses per resident, by 8.7% following a universal 10% increase in Medicaid reimbursement rates. In contrast, I find that pro-competitive policies lead to only small increases in skilled nurse staffing ratios, suggesting that Medicaid increases are more cost effective in raising the quality of care.

10.1257/aer.20151057.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个养老院行业的模型，以研究提高监管报销率或增加本地竞争的政策对服务质量的影响。通过宾夕法尼亚州的数据，我估算了该模型的参数。研究结果表明，在医疗补助报销率普遍提高10%之后，养老院通过增加每名居民配备的熟练护士数量，使服务质量提高了8.7%。相反，我发现支持竞争的政策仅能小幅提高熟练护士的配备比例，这表明提高医疗补助费用在提升服务质量方面更为经济有效。

abstract.text: We measure the welfare distortions from endogenous quality choice in imperfectly competitive markets. For US cable television markets between 1997–2006, prices are 33 percent to 74 percent higher and qualities 23 percent to 55 percent higher than socially optimal. Such quality overprovision contradicts classic results in the literature and our analysis shows that it results from the presence of competition from high-end satellite TV providers: without the competitive pressure from satellite companies, cable TV monopolists would instead engage in quality degradation. For welfare, quality overprovision implies cable customers would prefer smaller, lower-quality cable bundles at a lower price, amounting to a twofold increase in consumer surplus for the average consumer. (JEL L13, L15, L82)

10.1257/aer.20151182.abstractZh: 我们研究了在不完全竞争市场中，由于内生性质量选择导致的福利扭曲。以1997年至2006年的美国有线电视市场为例，价格比社会最优水平高出33%至74%，服务质量则高出23%至55%。这种过度提供服务的现象与文献中的经典研究结果相矛盾，我们的分析表明，这一现象是由于高端卫星电视供应商的竞争造成的：如果没有卫星公司的竞争压力，有线电视垄断者会选择降低服务质量。从福利的角度来看，过度提供服务的现象意味着有线电视用户会更愿意选择更小、质量较低的服务包，同时价格更低，这相当于平均消费者的消费剩余增加了两倍。（JEL L13, L15, L82）

abstract.text: There is no evaluation of the consequences of Disability Insurance (DI) receipt that captures the effects on households’ net income and consumption expenditure, family labor supply, or benefits from other programs. Combining detailed register data from Norway with an instrumental variables approach based on random assignment to appellant judges, we comprehensively assess how DI receipt affects these understudied outcomes. To consider the welfare implications of the findings from this instrumental variables approach, we estimate a dynamic model of household behavior that translates employment, reapplication, and savings decisions into revealed preferences for leisure and consumption. The model-based results suggest that on average, the willingness to pay for DI receipt is positive and sizable. Because spousal labor supply strongly buffers the household income and consumption effects of DI allowances, the estimated willingness to pay for DI receipt is smaller for married than single applicants. (JEL D12, D14, H55, I38, J14, J22)

10.1257/aer.20151231.abstractZh: 目前尚无关于残疾保险领取对家庭净收入和消费支出、家庭劳动力供应以及其他项目福利影响的评估。我们结合挪威的详细登记数据，并采用基于随机分配到申请法官的工具变量方法，全面分析了残疾保险领取对这些未被充分研究的变量的影响。为了考虑这种工具变量方法得出的研究结果对福利的影响，我们建立了一个家庭行为动态模型，将就业、重新申请和储蓄决策转化为对休闲和消费的偏好。模型分析结果表明，平均而言，人们愿意为残疾保险领取支付一定的费用。由于配偶劳动力供应对家庭收入和消费的影响具有显著的缓冲作用，因此已婚申请者相比单身申请者，愿意为残疾保险领取支付的费用较低。（JEL D12, D14, H55, I38, J14, J22）

abstract.text: We study the effect of financial market frictions on managerial compensation.
