We embed a market microstructure model into an otherwise standard contracting framework, and analyze optimal pay-for-performance when managers use information they learn from the market in their investment decisions. In a less frictional market, the improved information content of stock prices helps guide managerial decisions and thereby necessitates lower-powered compensation. Exploiting a randomized experiment, we document evidence that pay-for-performance is lowered in response to reduced market frictions. Firm investment also becomes more sensitive to stock prices during the experiment, consistent with increased managerial learning from the market. (JEL D83, G12, G14, G32, G34, M12, M52)

10.1257/aer.20151310.abstractZh: 我们研究了金融市场摩擦对管理层薪酬的影响。我们将市场微观结构模型嵌入到标准的契约框架中，并分析了当管理者在投资决策中利用从市场获得的信息时，基于绩效的薪酬分配情况。在摩擦较小的市场中，股票价格所具有的改进信息内容有助于指导管理层的决策，因此管理层所需的薪酬水平会更低。通过一项随机实验，我们发现随着市场摩擦的减少，基于绩效的薪酬分配会相应降低。实验期间，企业的投资也变得更加敏感于股票价格，这与管理层从市场中获得更多学习成果是一致的。（JEL D83, G12, G14, G32, G34, M12, M52）

abstract.text: Do large firm dynamics drive the business cycle? We answer this question by developing a quantitative theory of aggregate fluctuations caused by firm-level disturbances alone. We show that a standard heterogeneous firm dynamics setup already contains in it a theory of the business cycle, without appealing to aggregate shocks. We offer an analytical characterization of the law of motion of the aggregate state in this class of models, the firm size distribution, and show that aggregate output and productivity dynamics display: (i ) persistence, (ii ) volatility, and (iii ) time-varying second moments. We explore the key role of moments of the firm size distribution, and, in particular, the role of large firm dynamics, in shaping aggregate fluctuations, theoretically, quantitatively, and in the data. (JEL D21, D22, D24, E32, L11)

10.1257/aer.20151317.abstractZh: 大型企业的动态是否驱动商业周期？我们通过发展一种仅由企业层面扰动引起的总体波动的定量理论来回答这个问题。我们表明，一个标准的异质企业动态模型本身就包含了商业周期的理论，而无需依赖总体冲击。我们对这类模型中总体状态的运动规律进行了分析性描述，包括企业规模分布，并发现总体产出和生产力动态表现出：(i) 持续性，(ii) 波动性，以及(iii) 时间变化的二阶矩。我们探讨了企业规模分布矩的关键作用，特别是大型企业动态在塑造总体波动中的作用，无论是在理论上、定量上，还是在数据中。(JEL D21, D22, D24, E32, L11)

abstract.text: We investigate whether patents on human genes have affected follow-on scientific research and product development. Using administrative data on successful and unsuccessful patent applications submitted to the US Patent and Trademark Office, we link the exact gene sequences claimed in each application with data measuring follow-on scientific research and commercial investments. Using this data, we document novel evidence of selection into patenting: patented genes appear more valuable-prior to being patented-than non-patented genes. This evidence of selection motivates two quasi-experimental approaches, both of which suggest that on average gene patents have had no quantitatively important effect on follow-on innovation.

10.1257/aer.20151398.abstractZh: 我们研究了人类基因专利是否影响了后续科学研究和产品开发。通过美国专利商标局提供的成功与失败的专利申请数据，我们将每份申请中声称的精确基因序列与衡量后续科学研究和商业投资的数据进行了关联。利用这些数据，我们发现了一个新的选择机制：在获得专利之前，被专利化的基因比未被专利化的基因更具价值。这一选择机制促使我们采用了两种准实验方法，这两种方法均表明，总体而言，基因专利对后续创新并没有产生显著的定量影响。

abstract.text: We propose novel approaches to estimating student preferences with data from matching mechanisms, especially the Gale-Shapley deferred acceptance. Even if the mechanism is strategy-proof, assuming that students truthfully rank schools in applications may be restrictive. We show that when students are ranked strictly by some ex ante known priority index (e.g., test scores), stability is a plausible and weaker assumption, implying that every student is matched with her favorite school/college among those she qualifies for ex post. The methods are illustrated in simulations and applied to school choice in Paris. We discuss when each approach is more appropriate in real-life settings. (JEL D11, D12, D82, I23)

10.1257/aer.20151422.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种利用匹配机制数据来估计学生偏好的新方法，特别是Gale-Shapley延迟接受机制。即使该机制是策略免疫的，假设学生如实对申请学校进行排名也可能过于严格。我们证明，当学生严格按照某个预先已知的优先级指数（例如，考试成绩）进行排序时，稳定性是一个合理且较为宽松的假设，这意味着每个学生都能与她最心仪的学校/大学进行匹配。这些方法通过模拟进行了验证，并应用于巴黎的学校选择案例。我们还讨论了在实际场景中哪种方法更为适用。（JEL D11, D12, D82, I23）

abstract.text: Traditional approaches to structural vector autoregressions (VARs) can be viewed as special cases of Bayesian inference arising from very strong prior beliefs. These methods can be generalized with a less restrictive formulation that incorporates uncertainty about the identifying assumptions themselves. We use this approach to revisit the importance of shocks to oil supply and demand. Supply disruptions turn out to be a bigger factor in historical oil price movements and inventory accumulation a smaller factor than implied by earlier estimates. Supply shocks lead to a reduction in global economic activity after a significant lag, whereas shocks to oil demand do not. (JEL C32, L71, Q35, Q43)

10.1257/aer.20151569.abstractZh: 传统的结构向量自回归模型方法可以被视为基于非常强先验假设的贝叶斯推断的特殊情况。这些方法可以通过一种更为宽松的框架进行推广，该框架能够考虑到对识别假设本身的不确定性。我们采用这种方法重新审视了石油供应和需求冲击的重要性。与先前估计所暗示的相反，供应中断在历史上的石油价格变动和库存积累中起着更为重要的作用，而石油需求冲击则没有这种作用。（JEL C32, L71, Q35, Q43）

abstract.text: We quantitatively identify the factors that drive wealth dynamics in the United States and are consistent with its skewed cross-sectional distribution and with social mobility. We concentrate on three critical factors: (i) skewed earnings, (ii) differential saving rates across wealth levels, and (iii) stochastic idiosyncratic returns to wealth. All of these are fundamental for matching both distribution and mobility. The stochastic process for returns which best fits the cross-sectional distribution of wealth and social mobility in the United States shares several statistical properties with those of the returns to wealth uncovered by Fagereng et al. (2017) from tax records in Norway. (JEL D31, E13, E21, E25)

10.1257/aer.20151684.abstractZh: 我们定量分析了推动美国财富动态变化的因素，这些因素与该国偏斜的横截面分布和社会流动性是一致的。我们重点关注三个关键因素：(i) 收入分布的不均衡；(ii) 不同财富水平之间的储蓄率差异；(iii) 财富产生的随机特异性回报。所有这些因素对于匹配财富分布和社会流动性都至关重要。这些回报的随机过程能够最好地拟合美国财富的横截面分布和社会流动性，其统计特性与Fagereng等人（2017年）通过挪威税务记录发现的财富回报具有相似性。(JEL D31, E13, E21, E25)

abstract.text: We exploit changes in the area-specific eligibility criteria for a program to support jobs through investment subsidies. European rules determine whether an area is eligible for subsidies, and we construct instrumental variables for area eligibility based on parameters of these rule changes. Areas eligible for higher subsidies significantly increased jobs and reduced unemployment. A 10-percentage point increase in the maximum investment subsidy stimulates a 10 percent increase in manufacturing employment. This effect exists solely for small firms: large companies accept subsidies without increasing activity. There are positive effects on investment and employment for incumbent firms but not Total Factor Productivity. (JEL E24, G31, H25, L25, L52, R23)

10.1257/aer.20160034.abstractZh: 我们研究了通过投资补贴来支持就业的计划中，特定地区资格标准的变化。欧洲的相关规定决定了某个地区是否有资格获得补贴，我们基于这些规则变化的参数构建了地区资格的工具变量。有资格获得更高补贴的地区，就业人数显著增加，失业率也有所下降。最大投资补贴增加10个百分点，制造业就业人数将增加10%。这种效应仅适用于小型企业：大型企业接受补贴后，活动量并不会增加。对于现有企业而言，投资与就业方面存在积极影响，但全要素生产率则没有变化。（JEL E24, G31, H25, L25, L52, R23）

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the role of redistribution in the transmission mechanism of monetary policy to consumption. Three channels affect aggregate spending when winners and losers have different marginal propensities to consume: an earnings heterogeneity channel from unequal income gains, a Fisher channel from unexpected inflation, and an interest rate exposure channel from real interest rate changes. Sufficient statistics from Italian and US data suggest that all three channels are likely to amplify the effects of monetary policy. (JEL E21, E31, E43, E52)

10.1257/aer.20160137.abstractZh: 本文评估了再分配在货币政策向消费传导机制中的作用。当受益者和受损者的消费边际倾向不同的情况下，有三种渠道会影响总支出：一种是由不平等收入带来的收益差异渠道，一种是由意外通胀引起的费雪渠道，还有一种是由实际利率变化引起的利率暴露渠道。来自意大利和美国的数据表明，这三种渠道都可能放大货币政策的效果。（JEL E21, E31, E43, E52）

abstract.text: What makes an asset a “safe” asset? We study a model where two countries each issue sovereign bonds to satisfy investors’ safe asset demands. The countries differ in the float of their bonds and the fundamental resources available to rollover debts. A sovereign’s debt is safer if its fundamentals are strong relative to other possible safe assets, not merely strong on an absolute basis. If demand for safe assets is high, a large float enhances safety through a market depth benefit. If demand for safe assets is low, then large debt size is a negative as rollover risk looms large. (JEL F34, H63)

10.1257/aer.20160216.abstractZh: 什么使得一种资产成为“安全”资产？我们研究了一个模型，其中两个国家各自发行主权债券以满足投资者对安全资产的需求。这两个国家在债券流通量和可用于债务再融资的基本资源方面存在差异。如果一个主权国家的经济基本面相对于其他可能的安全资产更为强劲，那么其债务就更为安全，而不仅仅是绝对意义上的强劲。如果对安全资产的需求较高，那么较大的债券流通量可以通过市场深度效应增强安全性。如果对安全资产的需求较低，那么较大的债务规模则是一个负面因素，因为债务再融资的风险很大。（JEL F34, H63）

abstract.text: We analyze how separations responded to arbitrary differences in own and peer wages at a large US retailer. Regression-discontinuity estimates imply large causal effects of own-wages on separations, and on quits in particular. However, this own-wage response could reflect comparisons either to market wages or to peer wages. Estimates using peer-wage discontinuities show large peer-wage effects and imply the own-wage separation response mostly reflects peer comparisons. The peer effect is driven by comparisons with higher-paid peers—suggesting concerns about fairness. Separations appear fairly insensitive when raises are similar across peers—suggesting search frictions and monopsony are relevant in this low-wage sector. (JEL D63, J31, J42, J62, L81)

10.1257/aer.20160232.abstractZh: 我们分析了在美国一家大型零售商中，员工因自身工资与同事工资的任意差异而选择离职的情况。回归不连续模型估计表明，自身工资对离职行为有显著的因果影响，尤其是对离职决策的影响。然而，这种自身工资的响应可能反映了与市场价格或同事工资的比较。使用同事工资不连续性的模型估计显示，同事工资的影响同样显著，这表明员工离职的响应主要反映了与同事的比较。这种同事效应是由与高薪同事的比较所驱动的，这暗示了人们对公平性的担忧。当不同同事之间的加薪幅度相近时，员工离职的行为似乎并不敏感，这表明在该低工资行业中，搜寻成本和垄断行为起着重要作用。（JEL D63, J31, J42, J62, L81）

abstract.text: It takes a woman and a man to make a baby. This fact suggests that for a birth to take place, the parents should first agree on wanting a child. Using newly available data on fertility preferences and outcomes, we show that indeed, babies are likely to arrive only if both parents desire one. In addition, there are many couples who disagree on having babies, and in low-fertility countries women are much more likely than men to be opposed to having another child. We account for this evidence with a quantitative model of household bargaining in which the distribution of the burden of child care between mothers and fathers is a key determinant of fertility. The model implies that fertility is highly responsive to targeted policies that lower the child care burden specifically for mothers. (JEL C78, D13, J13, J16)

10.1257/aer.20160328.abstractZh: 生育一个婴儿需要一位女性和一个男性。这一事实表明，为了能够生育，父母双方首先必须一致同意想要孩子。利用最新的生育偏好和结果数据，我们发现，只有当父母双方都希望有孩子时，孩子才有可能出生。此外，许多夫妻在是否要孩子的问题上存在分歧，在低生育率国家，女性比男性更有可能反对再要一个孩子。我们通过一个定量模型来解释这一现象，该模型描述了家庭之间的协商过程，其中父母之间在育儿责任分配上的分歧是决定生育率的关键因素。该模型表明，针对降低母亲育儿负担的政策，生育率会有显著的反应。（JEL C78, D13, J13, J16）

abstract.text: This paper measures the effects of bankruptcy protection on industry structure and environmental outcomes in oil and gas extraction. Using administrative data from Texas, I exploit variation in an insurance requirement that reduced firms’ ability to avoid liability through bankruptcy. Among small firms, the policy substantially improved environmental outcomes and reduced production. Most production was reallocated to larger firms with better environmental records, but high-cost production where social cost may have exceeded social benefit decreased. These results suggest that incomplete internalization of environmental costs due to bankruptcy is an important determinant of industry structure and safety effort in hazardous industries. (JEL G22, G33, L25, L71, Q35, Q52)

10.1257/aer.20160346.abstractZh: 本文研究了破产保护对石油和天然气开采行业结构及环境成果的影响。通过利用德克萨斯州的行政数据，本文分析了保险要求的变化对 firms 避免破产责任的影响。在小型企业中，该政策显著改善了环境成果并减少了生产活动。大部分生产被重新分配给那些环境记录更好的大型企业，但高成本生产活动——其中社会成本可能超过社会收益——有所减少。这些结果表明，由于破产导致的环境成本内部化不完全，是危险行业中行业结构和安全努力的重要因素。（JEL G22, G33, L25, L71, Q35, Q52）

abstract.text: The paper analyzes a durable goods monopoly problem in which multiple varieties can be sold. A robust Coase conjecture establishes that the market eventually clears, with profits exceeding static optimal market-clearing profits and converging to this lower bound in all stationary equilibria with instantaneous price revisions. Pricing need not be efficient, nor is it minimal (equal to the maximum of marginal cost and minimal value), and can lead to cross-subsidization. Conclusions nest both classical Coasian insights and modern Coasian failures. The option to scrap products does not affect results qualitatively, but delivers a novel motive for selling high cost products. (JEL C78, D42, L12)

10.1257/aer.20160404.abstractZh: 本文分析了一个可销售多种品种的耐用商品垄断问题。Coase猜想指出，市场最终会实现清算，利润会超过静态最优市场清算利润，并在所有具有瞬时价格调整的静态均衡中收敛于这一下限。定价不一定需要高效，也不一定是最优的（即等于边际成本与最小值的乘积），并且可能导致交叉补贴。结论既包含了经典的Coase观点，也包含了现代Coase理论中的缺陷。选择报废产品并不会定性地影响结果，但为销售高成本产品提供了一个新的动机。（JEL C78, D42, L12）

abstract.text: We assume that domestic (foreign) agents, when investing abroad, can only trade in the foreign (domestic) risk-free rates. In a preference-free environment, we derive the exchange rate volatility and risk premia in any such incomplete spanning model, as well as a measure of exchange rate cyclicality. We find that incomplete spanning lowers the volatility of exchange rate, increases the risk premia but only by creating exchange rate predictability, and does not affect the exchange rate cyclicality. (JEL E32, F31, F44, G15)

10.1257/aer.20160409.abstractZh: 我们假设国内（国外）的代理人在进行海外投资时，只能以外国（国内）的无风险利率进行交易。在一个无偏好环境下，我们推导出了这种不完全扩展模型中汇率的波动性和风险溢价，以及汇率周期性的衡量指标。我们发现，不完全扩展降低了汇率的波动性，增加了风险溢价，但这一增加是通过提高汇率的可预测性来实现的，并且不影响汇率的周期性。（JEL E32, F31, F44, G15）

abstract.text: We propose a generalization of the rational expectations framework to allow for temporarily unstable paths. Our approach introduces multiplicative sunspot shocks and it yields drifting parameters and stochastic volatility. Then, we provide an econometric strategy to estimate this generalized model on the data. The methodology allows the data to choose between different possible alternatives: determinacy, indeterminacy, and temporary instability. We apply our methodology to US inflation dynamics in the 1970s through the lens of a simple New Keynesian model. When temporarily unstable paths are allowed, the data unambiguously select them to explain the stagflation period in the 1970s. (JEL D84, E12, E31, E32, E52)

10.1257/aer.20160576.abstractZh: 我们提出了对理性预期框架的推广，以允许暂时不稳定的路径。我们的方法引入了乘法型太阳黑子冲击，从而产生了漂移参数和随机波动性。随后，我们提供了一种计量经济策略，用于根据数据估计这一广义模型。该方法允许数据在确定性、不确定性和暂时不稳定性之间做出选择。我们将该方法应用于1970年代美国的通货膨胀动态，通过一个简单的新凯恩斯模型进行分析。当允许暂时不稳定的路径时，数据明确选择了这些路径来解释1970年代的滞胀时期。（JEL D84, E12, E31, E32, E52）

abstract.text: This paper examines the effects of globalization on the distribution of worker-specific labor taxes using a unique set of tax calculators. We find a differential effect of higher trade and factor mobility on relative tax burdens in 1980–1993 versus 1994–2007 in the OECD. Prior to 1994, greater openness meant that higher income earners were taxed progressively more. However, after 1994, we document a globalization-induced rise in the labor income tax burden of the middle class, while the top 1 percent of workers and employees faced a reduction in their tax burden of 0.59–1.45 percentage points. (JEL D31, F16, F61, H22, H24)

10.1257/aer.20160600.abstractZh: 本文通过一套独特的税收计算器，研究了全球化对工人特定劳动税收分配的影响。我们发现，在1980至1993年期间，贸易的扩大和要素流动对税收负担的相对影响与1994至2007年期间有所不同。在1994年之前，更大的开放程度意味着高收入者需要缴纳更高的税收。然而，在1994年之后，我们发现全球化导致中产阶级的劳动所得税负担增加，而最富有的1%的工人和雇员则面临0.59%至1.45%的税收负担减少。（JEL D31, F16, F61, H22, H24）

abstract.text: To investigate the enforcement value of third-party information on potentially collusive taxpayers, I study an anti-tax evasion program that rewards consumers for ensuring that firms report sales and establishes a verification system to aid whistle-blowing consumers in São Paulo, Brazil (Nota Fiscal Paulista). Firms reported sales increased by at least 21 percent over 4 years. The results are consistent with fixed costs of concealing collusion, increased detection probability from whistle-blower threats, and with behavioral biases associated with lotteries amplifying the enforcement value of the program. Although firms increased reported expenses, tax revenue net of rewards increased by 9.3 percent. (JEL D22, H25, H26, L25, O14, O17)

10.1257/aer.20160658.abstractZh: 为了研究第三方信息在打击潜在勾结纳税人方面的执行价值，我研究了一个反逃税计划。该计划通过奖励消费者来确保企业准确报告销售额，并建立了验证系统，以协助举报者在巴西圣保罗的Nota Fiscal Paulista系统中进行举报。在4年的时间里，企业报告的销售额增加了至少21%。这些结果与隐藏勾结的固定成本、举报者威胁带来的检测概率增加，以及与抽奖相关的行为偏差共同提升了该计划的执行价值。尽管企业报告的支出有所增加，但扣除奖励后的税收收入却增加了9.3%。（JEL D22, H25, H26, L25, O14, O17）

abstract.text: Households with familiarity biases tilt their portfolios toward a few risky assets. The resulting mean-variance loss from portfolio underdiversification is equivalent to only a modest reduction of about 1 percent per year in a household’s portfolio return. However, once we consider also the effect of familiarity biases on the asset- allocation and intertemporal consumption-savings decisions, the welfare loss is multiplied by a factor of four. In general equilibrium, the suboptimal decisions of households distort also aggregate growth, amplifying further the overall social welfare loss. Our findings demonstrate that financial markets are not a mere sideshow to the real economy and that improving the financial decisions of households can lead to large benefits, not just for individual households, but also for society. (JEL D14, D91, E21, E44, G11, G41)

10.1257/aer.20161076.abstractZh: 具有熟悉偏见的家庭会将投资组合倾向于少数风险资产。由此导致的平均-方差损失相当于家庭投资组合回报每年仅减少约1%。然而，一旦我们考虑到熟悉偏见对资产配置和跨期消费-储蓄决策的影响，福利损失就会增加四倍。在一般均衡中，家庭的次优决策还会扭曲整体增长，进一步加剧整体社会福利损失。我们的研究表明，金融市场并非实体经济中的附属现象，改善家庭的金融决策不仅能够为单个家庭带来巨大收益，也能为社会带来积极影响。（JEL D14, D91, E21, E44, G11, G41）

abstract.text: A decision maker needs to reach a decision and relies on an expert to acquire information. Ideal actions of expert and decision maker are partially aligned and the expert chooses what to learn about each. The decision maker can either get advice from the expert or delegate decision making to him. Under delegation, the expert learns his privately optimal action and chooses it. Under communication, advice based on such information is discounted, resulting in losses from strategic communication. We characterize the communication problems that make the expert acquire information of equal use to expert and decision maker. In these problems, communication outperforms delegation. (JEL D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20161109.abstractZh: 决策者需要做出决策，并依赖专家来获取信息。专家和决策者的理想行为在某种程度上是一致的，专家会选择要学习的内容。决策者可以选择向专家寻求建议，或者将决策权委托给专家。在委托的情况下，专家会学习到其私人最优行动并选择该行动。而在沟通的情况下，基于此类信息的建议会被忽略，从而导致战略沟通上的损失。我们描述了那些使得专家获取的信息对专家和决策者来说都同样有用的沟通问题。在这些问题中，沟通的效果优于委托。（JEL D82, D83）

abstract.text: We study potential equilibria in California’s cap-and-trade market for greenhouse gases (GHGs) based on information available before the market started. We find large ex ante uncertainty in business-as-usual emissions and in the abatement that might result from non-market policies, much larger than the reduction that could plausibly occur in response to an allowance price within a politically acceptable range. This implies that the market price is very likely to be determined by an administrative price floor or ceiling. Similar factors seem likely to be present in other cap-and-trade markets for GHGs. (JEL D47, D81, Q54, Q58, R11)

10.1257/aer.20161218.abstractZh: 我们研究了基于市场启动前信息的加利福尼亚温室气体总量控制市场中的潜在均衡。我们发现，常规排放以及非市场政策可能带来的减排措施存在较大的事前不确定性，这种不确定性远大于在政治上可接受的配额价格范围内可能实现的减排量。这意味着市场价格很可能会由行政性的价格上限或下限来决定。类似的因素似乎也存在于其他温室气体总量控制市场中。（JEL D47, D81, Q54, Q58, R11）

abstract.text: Does the impact of teachers extend beyond the students in their classroom? Using the natural transitions of students from multiple elementary schools into a single middle school, this paper provides a new method for isolating and quantifying peer spillover effects of teaching and shows that ignoring these spillovers underestimates a teacher’s value by at least 30 percent. Because the spillovers also affect teacher value-added estimates, I develop a method of moments estimator of teacher value-added and show that accounting for the spillovers does not have a large impact on the ranking of teachers in New York City. I conclude by showing that the spillovers occur within groups of students who share the same race and gender, which suggests that social networks play a critical role in disseminating the effect. (JEL H75, I21, J15, J16, J45, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20161226.abstractZh: 教师的影响是否也延伸到他们课堂之外的学生？本文通过多个小学的学生合并到一所中学的过程中，提供了一种新的方法来分离和量化教学的同伴溢出效应，并表明忽略这些溢出效应会使教师的价值低估至少30%。由于这些溢出效应也会影响教师增值估计，我开发了一种教师增值的矩估计方法，并表明考虑这些溢出效应对纽约市教师的排名并没有太大影响。最后，我指出这些溢出效应主要发生在具有相同种族和性别的学生群体中，这表明社交网络在传播这种效应中起着关键作用。（JEL H75, I21, J15, J16, J45, Z13）

abstract.text: We study a generous program to promote the adoption of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems through subsidies on future electricity production, rather than through upfront investment subsidies. We develop a tractable dynamic model of new technology adoption, also accounting for local market heterogeneity. We identify the discount factor from demand responses to variation that shifts expected future but not current utilities. Despite the massive adoption, we find that households significantly discounted the future benefits from the new technology. This implies that an upfront investment subsidy program would have promoted the technology at a much lower budgetary cost. (JEL C51, D15, Q48, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20161343.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个通过补贴未来电力生产来促进太阳能光伏系统采用的慷慨计划，而不是通过前期投资补贴。我们开发了一个可行的动态模型，用于研究新技术的采用情况，同时考虑了当地市场的异质性。我们发现，由于需求对变化的反应，未来预期的效用被显著折扣，而当前效用则没有受到影响。尽管采用了大量新技术，我们发现家庭对新技术未来收益的折扣程度相当高。这意味着，采用前期投资补贴计划可以在更低的预算成本下促进技术的采用。（JEL C51, D15, Q48, Q58）

abstract.text: Following the 2016 Leave vote in the referendum on UK membership in the EU and the election of Donald Trump, trade agreements have entered a period of great instability. To predict the impact of possible disruptions to existing arrangements requires counterfactual analysis that takes into account the complex set of factors influencing the production and marketing strategies of multinational corporations. We estimate a model of multinational decision-making in the car industry. This model predicts the production reallocation and consumer surplus consequences of changes in tariffs and non-tariff barriers induced by US-led protectionism, Brexit, transpacific, and transatlantic integration agreements. (JEL F13, F23, L21, L62, M31)

10.1257/aer.20161345.abstractZh: 在2016年英国是否脱离欧盟的公投中，以及唐纳德·特朗普当选总统之后，贸易协议进入了非常不稳定的时期。要预测现有安排可能受到的影响，需要进行反事实分析，同时考虑到影响跨国企业生产和营销策略的复杂因素。我们建立了一个关于汽车行业的跨国决策模型。该模型预测了由于美国主导的保护主义、英国脱欧、跨太平洋和跨大西洋一体化协议导致的关税和非关税壁垒变化所带来的生产重新分配和消费者剩余的变化。（JEL F13, F23, L21, L62, M31）

abstract.text: To show how fast Internet affects employment in Africa, we exploit the gradual arrival of submarine Internet cables on the coast and maps of the terrestrial cable network. Robust difference-in-differences estimates from 3 datasets, covering 12 countries, show large positive effects on employment rates—also for less educated worker groups—with little or no job displacement across space. The sample-wide impact is driven by increased employment in higher-skill occupations, but less-educated workers’ employment gain less so. Firm-level data available for some countries indicate that increased firm entry, productivity, and exporting contribute to higher net job creation. Average incomes rise. (JEL F14, J23, J24, J63, L86, O15, O33)

10.1257/aer.20161385.abstractZh: 为了展示互联网对非洲就业的影响，我们利用了海底互联网电缆逐渐在沿海地区铺设的情况，以及陆地电缆网络的地图数据。来自3个数据集的稳健差异估计结果显示，在12个国家中，互联网对就业率产生了显著的正面影响，尤其是针对受教育程度较低的劳动者群体。这种影响在地域上几乎没有或完全没有导致就业流失的情况。整体样本范围内的影响主要体现在高技能职业的就业增加上，而受教育程度较低的劳动者则获益较少。对于某些国家而言，企业层面的数据表明，企业数量的增加、生产率的提升以及出口活动的增加都促进了更多的净就业创造。平均收入也有所上升。（JEL F14, J23, J24, J63, L86, O15, O33）

abstract.text: Tourism is a fast-growing services sector in developing countries. This paper combines a rich collection of Mexican microdata with a quantitative spatial equilibrium model and a new empirical strategy to study the long-term economic consequences of tourism both locally and in the aggregate. We find that tourism causes large and significant local economic gains relative to less touristic regions that are in part driven by significant positive spillovers on manufacturing. In the aggregate, however, these local spillovers are largely offset by reductions in agglomeration economies among less touristic regions, so that the national gains from trade in tourism are mainly driven by a classical market integration effect. (JEL L60, L83, O14, O18, R11, Z31, Z32)

10.1257/aer.20161434.abstractZh: 旅游业是发展中国家增长迅速的服务行业之一。本文结合墨西哥丰富的微观数据、定量空间均衡模型以及新的实证策略，研究旅游业在本地及整体层面的长期经济影响。研究发现，与旅游较少的地区相比，旅游业能够带来显著且巨大的本地经济收益，这部分收益部分源于对制造业的积极溢出效应。然而，从整体来看，这些本地溢出效应在很大程度上被旅游较少地区的集聚经济减少所抵消，因此，旅游业带来的国家收益主要源于传统的市场整合效应。（JEL L60, L83, O14, O18, R11, Z31, Z32）

abstract.text: Persuaders often face the task of changing their listeners’ world-view, which may involve conveying evidence that disconfirms that view. It has been shown, however, that people are often reluctant to change their worldviews. These aspects of persuasion cannot be captured in the standard Bayesian framework. The paper identifies the constraints, opportunities, and trade-offs of persuading people to change worldview. It finds necessary and sufficient conditions under which it is optimal for persuaders to do so. It also shows when and how they conceal disconfirming evidence and take advantage of their listener’s existing worldview. (JEL D82, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20161441.abstractZh: 说服者常常面临改变听众世界观的任务，这可能涉及提供与现有观点相悖的证据。然而，人们往往不愿意改变自己的世界观。这些说服的方面无法用标准的贝叶斯框架来捕捉。本文指出了说服人们改变世界观所面临的约束、机会和权衡。文章还探讨了说服者采取这种行动的最佳条件，以及他们何时以及如何隐藏反驳性证据，并利用听众现有的世界观。（JEL D82, D83, D91）

abstract.text: We construct a dynamic theory of sovereign debt and structural reforms with limited enforcement and moral hazard. A sovereign country in recession wishes to smooth consumption. It can also undertake costly reforms to speed up recovery. The sovereign can renege on contracts by suffering a stochastic cost. The constrained optimal allocation (COA) prescribes imperfect insurance with non-monotonic dynamics for consumption and effort. The COA is decentralized by a competitive equilibrium with markets for renegotiable GDP-linked one-period debt. The equilibrium features debt overhang: reform effort decreases in a high debt range. We also consider environments with less complete markets. (JEL D82, E21, E23, E32, F34, H63)

10.1257/aer.20161457.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个关于主权债务和结构性改革的动态理论，该理论考虑了有限执行和道德风险的情况。处于衰退状态的主权国家希望平滑消费。它也可以进行昂贵的改革以加速经济复苏。主权国家可能会因随机成本而违约。受限最优分配方案规定了对消费和努力的不完美保险，且保险机制具有非单调动态。该方案通过竞争性均衡实现去中心化，市场负责重新谈判与GDP挂钩的短期债务。均衡特征表现为债务负担：在债务较高的情况下，改革努力会下降。我们还考虑了市场不完全的环境。（JEL D82, E21, E23, E32, F34, H63）

abstract.text: This paper investigates the role of self-fulfilling expectations in sovereign bond markets. We consider a model of sovereign borrowing featuring endogenous debt maturity, risk-averse lenders, and self-fulfilling crises à la Cole and Kehoe (2000). In this environment, interest rate spreads are driven by both fundamental and nonfundamental risk. These two sources of risk have contrasting implications for the maturity structure of debt chosen by the government. Therefore, they can be indirectly inferred by tracking the evolution of debt maturity. We fit the model to Italian data and find that nonfundamental risk played a limited role during the 2008–2012 crisis. (JEL E43, E44, F34, G01, G15, H63)

10.1257/aer.20161471.abstractZh: 本文探讨了自我实现预期在主权债券市场中的作用。我们研究了一个具有内生债务到期日、风险厌恶的出借者以及类似Cole和Kehoe（2000年）提出的自我实现危机特征的主权借贷模型。在这种环境下，利率差由基本风险和非基本风险共同驱动。这两种风险来源对政府选择的债务到期结构有着不同的影响。因此，可以通过追踪债务到期日的演变来间接推断这两种风险的影响。我们将该模型应用于意大利数据，发现非基本风险在2008-2012年的危机期间作用有限。（JEL E43, E44, F34, G01, G15, H63）

abstract.text: I characterize the optimal financial regulation policy in an economy where financial intermediaries trade capital assets on behalf of households, but must retain an equity stake to align incentives. Financial regulation is necessary because intermediaries cannot be excluded from privately trading in capital markets. They don’t internalize that high asset prices force everyone to bear more risk. The socially optimal allocation can be implemented with a tax on asset holdings. I derive a sufficient statistic for the externality and use market data on leverage and volatility of intermediaries’ equity to measure it. (JEL D82, G01, G12, G20, G31, H25)

10.1257/aer.20161488.abstractZh: 我描述了在一种经济体系中最优的金融监管政策。在这种经济体系中，金融中介代表家庭进行资本资产交易，但必须保留一定的股权份额以调整激励机制。金融监管是必要的，因为金融中介不能被排除在资本市场私人交易之外。它们没有意识到高资产价格迫使每个人承担更多的风险。通过征收资产持有税，可以实现社会最优的资产配置。我推导出了这一外部性的充分条件，并利用关于金融中介股权杠杆和波动性的市场数据来衡量这一外部性。（JEL D82, G01, G12, G20, G31, H25）

abstract.text: We examine how the premature death of eminent life scientists alters the vitality of their fields. While the flow of articles by collaborators into affected fields decreases after the death of a star scientist, the flow of articles by non-collaborators increases markedly. This surge in contributions from outsiders draws upon a different scientific corpus and is disproportionately likely to be highly cited. While outsiders appear reluctant to challenge leadership within a field when the star is alive, the loss of a luminary provides an opportunity for fields to evolve in new directions that advance the frontier of knowledge within them.

10.1257/aer.20161574.abstractZh: 我们研究了著名生命科学家过早的去世如何改变其所在领域的活力。虽然随着这位杰出科学家的去世，合作者向受影响领域的文章投稿数量减少，但非合作者的投稿数量却显著增加。这种来自外部的贡献激增，往往基于不同的科学领域，并且更有可能被大量引用。当这位杰出人物还活着时，外部人士似乎不愿挑战该领域的领导地位，但一位杰出人物的离世为领域提供了向新方向发展的机会，从而推动知识前沿的进展。

abstract.text: The National Banking Acts (NBAs) of 1863–1864 established rules governing the amounts and locations of interbank deposits, thereby reshaping the bank networks. Using unique data on bank balance sheets and detailed interbank deposits in 1862 and 1867 in Pennsylvania, we study how the NBAs changed the network structure and quantify the effect on financial stability in an interbank network model. We find that the NBAs induced a concentration of interbank deposits at both the city and bank levels, creating systemically important banks. Although the concentration facilitated diversification, contagion would have become more likely when financial center banks faced large shocks. (JEL E44, G01, G21, G28, L14, N21)

10.1257/aer.20161661.abstractZh: 1863年至1864年的《国家银行法》制定了关于银行间存款金额和存放地点的规定，从而重塑了银行网络结构。我们利用宾夕法尼亚州1862年和1867年的银行资产负债表以及详细的银行间存款数据，研究这些法律如何改变了网络结构，并量化其对银行间网络金融稳定性的影响。研究发现，这些法律导致银行间存款在城市和银行层面都出现了集中现象，从而形成了具有系统重要性的银行。尽管这种集中现象有助于分散风险，但当金融中心银行面临重大冲击时，风险传染的可能性会增大。（JEL E44, G01, G21, G28, L14, N21）

abstract.text: This paper presents a dynamic equilibrium model of a taxi market. The model is estimated using data from New York City yellow cabs. Two salient features by which most taxi markets deviate from the efficient market ideal are, first, matching frictions created by the need for both market sides to physically search for trading partners, and second, regulatory limitations to entry. To assess the importance of these features, we use the model to simulate the effect of changes in entry, alternative matching technologies, and different market density. We use the geographical features of the matching process to back out unobserved demand through a matching simulation. The matching function exhibits increasing returns to scale, which is important to understand the impact of changes in this market and has welfare implications. For instance, although alternative dispatch platforms can be more efficient than street-hailing, platform competition is harmful because it reduces effective density. (JEL C78, L51, L84, L92, L98, R48)

10.1257/aer.20161720.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个出租车市场的动态均衡模型。该模型基于纽约市黄色出租车的数据进行估算。大多数出租车市场偏离有效市场理想的两个主要因素分别是：首先，由于市场双方需要亲自寻找交易伙伴，这种匹配摩擦的存在；其次，进入市场的监管限制。为了评估这些因素的重要性，我们使用该模型模拟了进入门槛变化、不同的匹配技术以及不同市场密度对市场的影响。我们通过匹配过程的地理特征来推断未观察到的需求，并通过匹配模拟来验证匹配函数的规模报酬递增特性，这对于理解市场变化的影响以及其福利效应至关重要。例如，虽然替代的派车平台可能比街头叫车更高效，但平台竞争是有害的，因为它会降低市场的有效密度。（JEL C78, L51, L84, L92, L98, R48）

abstract.text: We study the conditional distribution of GDP growth as a function of economic and financial conditions. Deteriorating financial conditions are associated with an increase in the conditional volatility and a decline in the conditional mean of GDP growth, leading the lower quantiles of GDP growth to vary with financial conditions and the upper quantiles to be stable over time. Upside risks to GDP growth are low in most periods while downside risks increase as financial conditions become tighter. We argue that amplification mechanisms in the financial sector generate the observed growth vulnerability dynamics. (JEL C53, E23, E27, E32, E44)

10.1257/aer.20161923.abstractZh: 我们研究了GDP增长的条件分布，作为经济与金融状况的函数。金融状况的恶化与GDP增长的条件波动性的增加以及条件均值的下降相关，导致GDP增长的较低分位数随金融状况的变化而变化，而较高分位数则随时间保持稳定。在大多数时期，GDP增长的上升风险较低，而随着金融状况的收紧，下降风险会增加。我们认为，金融部门的放大机制导致了所观察到的增长脆弱性动态。（JEL C53, E23, E27, E32, E44）

abstract.text: I argue that the winners and losers from trade are decided primarily by occupation. In addition to fixed adjustment costs, workers build up specific human capital over time that is destroyed when they must change occupations. I show that ignoring human capital biases estimates of adjustment costs upward by a factor of 3. Estimating an occupational choice model of the Danish labor market, I show that 57 percent of the dispersion in worker outcomes is accounted for by occupations, and only 16 percent by sectors. Finally, the model suggests that rising import competition from 1995–2005 reduced lifetime earnings for 5 percent of workers. (JEL F14, F16, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.20161925.abstractZh: 我认为，贸易的赢家和输家主要由职业决定。除了固定的调整成本外，劳动者随着时间积累特定的人力资本，而当他们必须改变职业时，这些人力资本就会丧失。我的研究表明，忽略人力资本会使得调整成本的估算高出3倍。通过构建丹麦劳动力市场的职业选择模型，我发现工人结果的差异中有57%是由职业决定的，而只有16%是由行业决定的。最后，该模型表明，1995年至2005年间，进口竞争的加剧导致5%的工人的终身收入下降。（JEL F14, F16, J24, J31）

abstract.text: We conduct laboratory experiments that explore how gender stereotypes shape beliefs about ability of oneself and others in different categories of knowledge. The data reveal two patterns. First, men’s and women’s beliefs about both oneself and others exceed observed ability on average, particularly in difficult tasks. Second, overestimation of ability by both men and women varies across categories. To understand these patterns, we develop a model that separates gender stereotypes from misestimation of ability related to the difficulty of the task. We find that stereotypes contribute to gender gaps in self-confidence, assessments of others, and behavior in a cooperative game. (JEL C92, D83, D91, J16)

10.1257/aer.20170007.abstractZh: 我们进行了实验室实验，探讨性别刻板印象如何影响人们对自身和他人在不同知识领域能力的认知。数据揭示了两种现象：首先，男性和女性对自己和他人的能力认知普遍高于实际能力，尤其是在难度较高的任务中。其次，男性和女性对能力的高估在不同领域存在差异。为了理解这些现象，我们开发了一个模型，将性别刻板印象与因任务难度导致的能力误估区分开来。研究发现，性别刻板印象导致了在自信心、对他人的评估以及合作游戏中的行为方面存在的性别差异。（JEL C92, D83, D91, J16）

abstract.text: We argue that an influential neo-Fisherian analysis of the effects of low interest rates depends on using perfect-foresight equilibrium analysis under circumstances where it is not plausible for people to hold expectations of that kind. We propose an explicit cognitive process by which agents may form their expectations of future endogenous variables. Perfect foresight is justified by our analysis as a reasonable approximation in some cases, but in the case of a commitment to maintain a low nominal interest rate for a long time, our reflective equilibrium implies neither neo-Fisherian conclusions nor implausibly strong predicted effects of forward guidance. (JEL D84, E12, E31, E43, E52)

10.1257/aer.20170110.abstractZh: 我们认为，一种具有影响力的新菲歇尔主义分析，关于低利率效应的研究，依赖于在人们不可能持有此类预期的情况下使用完美预见均衡分析。我们提出了一种明确的认知过程，通过这一过程，代理人可以形成对未来内生变量的预期。我们的分析认为，完美预见在某些情况下是一种合理的近似，但在长期维持低名义利率的承诺情况下，我们的反思均衡既无法得出新菲歇尔主义的结论，也无法产生不切实际的强烈预测效果。（JEL D84, E12, E31, E43, E52）

abstract.text: This paper studies equilibrium selection in the retail gasoline industry. We exploit a unique dataset that contains the universe of station-level prices for an urban market for 15 years, and that encompasses a coordinated equilibrium transition mid-sample. We uncover a gradual, three-year equilibrium transition, whereby dominant firms use price leadership and price experiments to create focal points that coordinate market prices, soften price competition, and enhance retail margins. Our results inform the theory of collusion, with particular relevance to the initiation of collusion and equilibrium selection. We also highlight new insights into merger policy and collusion detection strategies. (JEL G34, L12, L13, L71, L81, Q35)

10.1257/aer.20170116.abstractZh: 本文研究了零售汽油行业的均衡选择问题。我们利用了一个独特的数据集，该数据集包含了15年间一个城市市场中加油站价格的全貌，并且涵盖了样本中期内的均衡转变过程。我们发现，主导企业通过价格领导以及价格实验来创造市场焦点，从而协调市场价格、缓和价格竞争并提升零售利润。我们的研究结果对共谋理论具有启示意义，尤其对于共谋的发起和均衡选择机制的研究具有重要意义。此外，本文还提出了关于合并政策和共谋检测策略的新见解。（JEL G34, L12, L13, L71, L81, Q35）

abstract.text: We study the informational events that trigger equilibrium shifts in coordination games with incomplete information. Assuming that the distribution of the changes in fundamentals has fat tails, we show that majority play shifts either if fundamentals reach a critical threshold or if there are large common shocks, even before the threshold is reached. The fat-tail assumption matters because it implies that large shocks make players more unsure about whether their payoffs are higher than others. This feature is crucial for large shocks to matter. (JEL C72, C73, D83)

10.1257/aer.20170159.abstractZh: 我们研究了在信息不完全的协调博弈中触发均衡变化的资讯事件。假设基本面的变化分布具有厚尾特性，我们表明，只要基本面达到一个临界阈值，或者存在大规模的共同冲击，即使尚未达到该阈值，多数玩家也会发生转变。厚尾假设的重要性在于，它意味着大规模冲击会让玩家更加不确定自己的收益是否高于他人。这一特性对于大规模冲击的效应至关重要。（JEL C72, C73, D83）

abstract.text: From March to July 1933, US industrial production rose 57 percent. We show that an important source of recovery was the effect of dollar devaluation on farm prices, incomes, and consumption. Devaluation immediately raised traded crop prices, and auto sales grew more rapidly in states and counties most exposed to these price increases. The response was amplified in counties with more severe farm debt burdens. For plausible assumptions about farmers’ relative MPC, the incidence of higher farm prices, and the aggregate multiplier, this redistribution to farmers accounted for a substantial portion of spring 1933 growth. This farm channel thus provides an example of how the distributional consequences of macroeconomic policies can have large aggregate effects. That recovery in 1933 benefited from redistribution to farmers suggests an important limitation to the use of 1933 as a guide to the effects of monetary regime changes in other circumstances. (JEL E32, E65, N12, N52, Q11, Q12)

10.1257/aer.20170237.abstractZh: 从1933年3月到7月，美国工业生产增长了57%。我们发现，经济复苏的一个重要因素是美国美元贬值对农产品价格、农民收入以及消费的影响。美元贬值立即提升了农产品价格，而在那些受价格上涨影响最严重的州和县，汽车销售增长更为迅速。在农业债务负担较重的县，这种影响更为显著。基于关于农民相对边际消费倾向的合理假设，较高的农产品价格以及总乘数效应，这种对农民的经济再分配在1933年春季的经济增长中占据了重要比例。因此，这一农业渠道表明，宏观经济政策的分配后果能够产生巨大的整体效应。1933年的经济复苏得益于对农民的经济再分配，这提示我们，将1933年作为其他情况下货币政策变化影响的参考标准可能存在重要局限性。（JEL E32, E65, N12, N52, Q11, Q12）

abstract.text: We study empirically how past exposure to conflict in origin countries makes migrants more violence-prone in their host country, focusing on asylum seekers in Switzerland. We exploit a novel and unique dataset on all crimes reported in Switzerland by the nationalities of perpetrators and of victims over 2009–2016. Our baseline result is that cohorts exposed to civil conflict/mass killing during childhood are 35 percent more prone to violent crime than the average cohort. This effect is particularly strong for early childhood exposure and is mostly confined to co-nationals, consistent with inter-group hostility persisting over time. We exploit cross-region heterogeneity in public policies within Switzerland to document which integration policies are best able to mitigate the detrimental effect of past conflict exposure on violent criminality. We find that offering labor market access to asylum seekers eliminates two-thirds of the effect. (JEL D74, F22, K42, Z18)

10.1257/aer.20170263.abstractZh: 我们通过实证研究探讨了原籍国过去经历的冲突如何使移民在所在国家更容易发生暴力行为，重点关注瑞士的寻求庇护者。我们利用了瑞士2009至2016年间所有犯罪案件的独特数据集，这些案件涉及犯罪者的国籍和受害者的国籍。我们的基本结论是，在童年时期经历过内战或大规模杀戮的群体，其暴力犯罪倾向比普通群体高出35%。这种效应在童年时期尤为明显，并且主要局限于同国居民，这与群体间敌意长期存在的情况一致。我们利用瑞士不同地区的公共政策差异，研究哪些融合政策最能减轻过去冲突经历对暴力犯罪的影响。我们发现，为寻求庇护者提供劳动力市场机会可以消除这一效应的三分之二。（JEL D74, F22, K42, Z18）

abstract.text: We study the role of economic incentives in shaping the coexistence of Jews, Catholics, and Protestants, using novel data from Germany for 1,000+ cities. The Catholic usury ban and higher literacy rates gave Jews a specific advantage in the moneylending sector. Following the Protestant Reformation (1517), the Jews lost these advantages in regions that became Protestant. We show (i) a change in the geography of anti-Semitism with persecutions of Jews and anti-Jewish publications becoming more common in Protestant areas relative to Catholic areas; (ii) a more pronounced change in cities where Jews had already established themselves as moneylenders. These findings are consistent with the interpretation that, following the Protestant Reformation, Jews living in Protestant regions were exposed to competition with the Christian majority, especially in moneylending, leading to an increase in anti-Semitism. (JEL D74, J15, N33, N43, N93)

10.1257/aer.20170279.abstractZh: 我们研究了经济激励在塑造犹太人、天主教徒和新教徒共存关系中的作用，使用了来自德国1000多个城市的新数据。天主教会的高利贷禁令和较高的识字率使犹太人在放贷领域具有特定优势。在宗教改革之后（1517年），犹太人在成为新教地区的优势逐渐丧失。我们发现：(i) 反犹太主义的地理分布发生了变化，在新教地区，针对犹太人的迫害和反犹太出版物更为常见；(ii) 在那些犹太人已经确立自己作为放贷者的城市，反犹太主义的变化更为明显。这些发现与以下解释一致：在宗教改革之后，生活在新教地区的犹太人面临着与基督教多数群体的竞争，尤其是在放贷领域，这导致了反犹太主义的增加。(JEL D74, J15, N33, N43, N93)

abstract.text: In many cases, buyers are not informed about their valuations and rely on experts, who are informed but biased for overbidding. We study auction design when selling to such “advised buyers.” We show that a canonical dynamic auction, the English auction, has a natural equilibrium that outperforms standard static auctions in expected revenues and allocative efficiency. The ability to communicate as the auction proceeds allows for more informative communication and gives advisors the ability to persuade buyers into overbidding. The same outcome is the unique equilibrium of the English auction when bidders can commit to contracts with their advisors. (JEL D44, D82, D83, D86)

10.1257/aer.20170334.abstractZh: 在许多情况下，买家并不了解自己的估值情况，只能依赖那些知情但存在偏见的专家来进行交易。我们研究了向这类“受顾问指导的买家”出售时的拍卖设计。研究表明，典型的动态拍卖——即英国式拍卖——存在一个自然均衡状态，其预期收益和分配效率均优于标准静态拍卖。在拍卖过程中，通过沟通可以获取更多信息，从而使顾问能够说服买家进行高估。当竞拍者能够与顾问签订合同时，英国式拍卖也呈现出同样的均衡状态。（JEL D44, D82, D83, D86）

abstract.text: Using confidential establishment-level data from the US Census Bureau’s Longitudinal Business Database, this paper documents how local shocks propagate across US regions through firms’ internal networks of establishments. Consistent with a model of optimal within-firm resource allocation, we find that establishment-level employment is sensitive to shocks in distant regions in which the establishment’s parent firm is operating, and that the elasticity with respect to such shocks increases with the firm’s financial constraint. At the aggregate regional level, we find that aggregate county-level employment is sensitive to shocks in distant counties linked through firms’ internal networks. (JEL D22, G32, L14, L22, R23, R32)

10.1257/aer.20170346.abstractZh: 本文利用美国人口普查局纵向商业数据库中的机密企业级数据，记录了地方冲击如何通过企业的内部网络在美国各区域传播。与最优企业内部资源分配模型一致，我们发现企业级就业对母公司所在遥远地区的冲击非常敏感，且这种敏感性随着企业的财务约束程度的增加而增强。在区域整体层面，我们发现全县级就业对通过企业内部网络相连的遥远县的冲击也非常敏感。（JEL D22, G32, L14, L22, R23, R32）

abstract.text: This paper studies alcohol consumption among low-income workers in India. In a 3-week field experiment, the majority of 229 cycle-rickshaw drivers were willing to forgo substantial monetary payments in order to set incentives for themselves to remain sober, thus exhibiting demand for commitment to sobriety. Randomly receiving sobriety incentives significantly reduced daytime drinking while leaving overall drinking unchanged. I find no evidence of higher daytime sobriety significantly changing labor supply, productivity, or earnings. In contrast, increasing sobriety raised savings by 50 percent, an effect that does not appear to be solely explained by changes in income net of alcohol expenditures.

10.1257/aer.20170458.abstractZh: 本文研究了印度低收入工人中的酒精消费情况。在为期3周的实地实验中，229名脚踏车出租车司机中，大多数愿意放弃可观的金钱报酬，以激励自己保持清醒，这表明人们有保持清醒的意愿。随机给予清醒激励显著减少了白天的饮酒行为，但整体饮酒量并未发生变化。我没有发现白天保持清醒会显著改变劳动力供给、生产力或收入的情况。相反，提高清醒度使储蓄增加了50%，这一效果似乎不仅仅是由扣除酒精支出后的收入变化所解释的。

abstract.text: Partnering with the US Census Bureau, we implement a new survey of “structured” management practices in two waves of 35,000 manufacturing plants in 2010 and 2015. We find an enormous dispersion of management practices across plants, with 40 percent of this variation across plants within the same firm. Management practices account for more than 20 percent of the variation in productivity, a similar, or greater, percentage as that accounted for by R&D, ICT, or human capital. We find evidence of two key drivers to improve management. The business environment, as measured by right-to-work laws, boosts incentive management practices. Learning spillovers, as measured by the arrival of large “Million Dollar Plants” in the county, increases the management scores of incumbents. (JEL D22, D24, L25, L60, M11, M50)

10.1257/aer.20170491.abstractZh: 我们与美国人口普查局合作，对2010年和2015年分别针对2.5万家制造工厂进行了两次关于“结构化”管理实践的调查。研究发现，不同工厂之间的管理实践存在巨大差异，其中40%的差异发生在同一企业内部。管理实践对生产力差异的贡献超过20%，这一比例与研发、信息通信技术或人力资本所占比重相当或更高。我们发现两个关键因素有助于改善管理实践：商业环境，如劳动权利法的实施，能够提升管理实践的积极性；学习溢出效应，如大型“百万美元工厂”的引入，能够提升现有企业的管理水平。（JEL D22, D24, L25, L60, M11, M50）

abstract.text: Using de-identified bank account data, we show that spending drops sharply at the large and predictable decrease in income arising from the exhaustion of unemployment insurance (UI) benefits. We use the high-frequency response to a predictable income decline as a new test to distinguish between alternative consumption models. The sensitivity of spending to income we document is inconsistent with rational models of liquidity-constrained households, but is consistent with behavioral models with present-biased or myopic households. Depressed spending after exhaustion also implies that the consumption-smoothing gains from extending UI benefits are four times larger than from raising UI benefit levels. (JEL D14, D91, E21, E24, E70, J65)

10.1257/aer.20170537.abstractZh: 利用去标识化的银行账户数据，我们发现，在失业保险福利耗尽导致收入大幅减少时，消费会急剧下降。我们通过高频反应对可预测的收入下降进行新的测试，以区分不同的消费模型。我们记录的消费对收入的敏感性与理性模型中对流动性受限家庭的假设不符，但与行为模型中对当前偏好或短视家庭的假设一致。在福利耗尽后消费下降的情况表明，延长失业保险福利所带来的消费平滑效应是提升福利水平所带来的效应的四倍。（JEL D14, D91, E21, E24, E70, J65）

abstract.text: This paper examines the long-run causal effects of management on firm performance. Under the United States Technical Assistance and Productivity Program (1952–1958), the United States organized management training trips for Italian managers to US firms and granted technologically advanced machines to Italian companies. I exploit an unexpected budget cut that reduced the number of participating firms and find that, compared to businesses excluded by the budget cut: performance of Italian firms that sent their managers to the United States increased for at least fifteen years after the program; performance of companies that received new machines increased, but flattened out over time; management and new machines were complementary. (JEL F23, L25, M16, M54, N34, N64, O33)

10.1257/aer.20170619.abstractZh: 本文探讨了管理对企业绩效的长期因果效应。在美国技术援助与生产力计划（1952–1958年）期间，美国为意大利经理人员组织了赴美国企业的管理培训，并向意大利公司提供了技术先进的机器。本文利用一次意外的预算削减导致参与企业数量减少的情况进行分析，发现与因预算削减而被排除在外的企业相比，派出经理前往美国的意大利企业在项目结束后至少十五年内绩效有所提升；而获得新机器的公司的绩效也有所提升，但随着时间的推移逐渐趋于平稳。管理能力和新机器是互补的。（JEL F23, L25, M16, M54, N34, N64, O33）

abstract.text: Statistical agencies face a dual mandate to publish accurate statistics while protecting respondent privacy. Increasing privacy protection requires decreased accuracy. Recognizing this as a resource allocation problem, we propose an economic solution: operate where the marginal cost of increasing privacy equals the marginal benefit. Our model of production, from computer science, assumes data are published using an efficient differentially private algorithm. Optimal choice weighs the demand for accurate statistics against the demand for privacy. Examples from US statistical programs show how our framework can guide decision-making. Further progress requires a better understanding of willingness-to-pay for privacy and statistical accuracy. (JEL C38, C81, D83)

10.1257/aer.20170627.abstractZh: 统计机构面临着双重任务：既要发布准确的统计数据，又要保护受访者的隐私。然而，随着隐私保护要求的提高，准确性要求不得不降低。我们将这一问题视为一个资源配置问题，并提出了一种经济解决方案：在增加隐私保护的边际成本等于边际收益的地点进行操作。我们的生产模型基于计算机科学，假设数据发布使用的是一种高效的差分隐私算法。最优选择是在对准确统计数据的需求与对隐私保护的需求之间进行权衡。美国统计机构的实际案例表明，我们的框架能够指导决策过程。要取得进一步进展，就需要更好地理解人们对隐私保护和统计准确性的支付意愿。（JEL C38, C81, D83）

abstract.text: We study the information sensitivity of government debt denominated in domestic versus foreign currency: the former is subject to inflation risk and the latter to default. Default only affects sophisticated bond traders, whereas inflation concerns a larger and less informed group. Within a two-period Bayesian trading game, differential information manifests itself in the secondary market, and we display conditions under which debt prices are more resilient to bad news even in the primary market, where only sophisticated players operate. Our results can explain debt prices across countries following the 2008 financial crisis, and also provide a theory of “original sin.” (JEL D84, F34, H63)

10.1257/aer.20170721.abstractZh: 我们研究了以本国货币或外币计价的政府债务的信息敏感性：前者面临通胀风险，后者则面临违约风险。违约仅影响经验丰富的债券交易员，而通胀则影响规模更大且信息较少的群体。在双期贝叶斯交易游戏中，差异信息在二级市场上显现出来，我们展示了在一级市场（仅由经验丰富的参与者操作）中，债务价格对负面消息的抵抗力更强的条件。我们的研究结果可以解释2008年金融危机后各国债务价格的变化，并提供了一种关于“原罪”的理论解释。（JEL D84, F34, H63）

abstract.text: We study the role of limited commitment in a standard auction environment. In each period, the seller can commit to an auction with a reserve price but not to future reserve prices. We characterize the set of equilibrium profits attainable for the seller as the period length vanishes. An immediate sale by efficient auction is optimal when there are at least three buyers. For many natural distributions two buyers is enough. Otherwise, we give conditions under which the maximal profit is attained through continuously declining reserve prices. (JEL D44, D82)

10.1257/aer.20170882.abstractZh: 我们研究了在标准拍卖环境中有限承诺的作用。在每个时期，卖方可以承诺一个保留价格，但不能承诺未来的保留价格。我们描述了随着时期长度的缩短，卖方能够获得的均衡利润集合。当至少有三个买家时，通过高效拍卖立即出售是最优选择。对于许多自然分布情况，两个买家就足够了。否则，我们给出了通过持续降低保留价格来实现最大利润的条件。（JEL D44, D82）

abstract.text: We combine national accounts, surveys, and new tax data to study the accumulation and distribution of income and wealth in China from 1978 to 2015. The national wealth-income ratio increased from 350 percent in 1978 to 700 percent in 2015, while the share of public property in national wealth declined from 70 percent to 30 percent. We provide sharp upward revision of official inequality estimates. The top 10 percent income share rose from 27 percent to 41 percent between 1978 and 2015; the bottom 50 percent share dropped from 27 percent to 15 percent. China’s inequality levels used to be close to Nordic countries and are now approaching US levels. (JEL D31, E01, E23, O11, P24, P26, P36)

10.1257/aer.20170973.abstractZh: 我们结合国民账户、调查数据以及新的税收数据，研究1978年至2015年间中国收入和财富的积累与分配情况。国民财富与收入比率从1978年的350%上升到2015年的700%，而公共财产在国民财富中的占比则从70%下降到30%。我们的研究显著提高了官方不平等程度的估计值。1978年至2015年间，收入最高的10%人群所占的比例从27%上升到41%；而收入最低的50%人群所占的比例则从27%下降到15%。中国的不平等程度曾经接近北欧国家，现在则接近美国的水平。（JEL D31, E01, E23, O11, P24, P26, P36）

abstract.text: This paper studies how the durability of assets affects financing. We show that more durable assets require larger down payments making them harder to finance, because durability affects the price of assets and hence the overall financing need more than their collateral value. Durability affects technology adoption, the choice between new and used capital, and the rent versus buy decision. Constrained firms invest in less durable assets and buy used assets. More durable assets are more likely to be rented. Economies with weak legal enforcement invest more in less durable, otherwise dominated assets and are net importers of used assets. (JEL D25, G31, G32, O31)

10.1257/aer.20170995.abstractZh: 本文研究了资产耐久性对融资的影响。我们发现，更耐用的资产需要更高的首付金额，这使得融资变得更加困难，因为耐久性会影响资产的价格，从而增加了整体融资需求，而不仅仅是抵押物的价值。耐久性还影响技术采用、新旧资本的选择以及租赁与购买之间的决策。受限制的企业更倾向于投资较不耐用的资产，并购买二手资产。更耐用的资产更有可能被租赁。法律执行力度较弱的经济体会更多地投资于那些较不耐用但占据主导地位的资产，并成为二手资产的净进口国。（JEL D25, G31, G32, O31）

abstract.text: We consider a decision maker (DM) who, before taking an action, seeks information by allocating her limited attention dynamically over different news sources that are biased toward alternative actions. Endogenous choice of information generates rich dynamics: the chosen news source either reinforces or weakens the prior, shaping subsequent attention choices, belief updating, and the final action. The DM adopts a learning strategy biased toward the current belief when the belief is extreme and against that belief when it is moderate. Applied to consumption of news media, observed behavior exhibits an “ echo-chamber” effect for partisan voters and a novel “ anti-echo-chamber” effect for moderates. (JEL D72, D83, D91, L82)

10.1257/aer.20171000.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个决策者，在采取行动之前，会通过动态分配有限的注意力来搜索不同新闻来源的信息，这些新闻来源往往倾向于不同的行动方案。信息选择的内生性产生了丰富的动态效应：所选的新闻来源要么强化或削弱先前的信念，从而影响后续的注意力选择、信念更新以及最终的行动。当信念极端时，决策者会采取偏向当前信念的学习策略；而当信念较为温和时，则会采取与当前信念相悖的策略。在新闻媒体消费方面，观察到的行为表现为党派选民存在“回音室”效应，而温和派则表现出一种新颖的“反回音室”效应。（JEL D72, D83, D91, L82）

abstract.text: This paper asks whether elite colleges help students outside of historically advantaged groups reach top positions in the economy. I combine administrative data on income and leadership teams at publicly traded firms with a regression discontinuity design based on admissions rules at elite business-focused degree programs in Chile. The 1.8 percent of college students admitted to these programs account for 41 percent of leadership positions and 39 percent of top 0.1 percent incomes. Admission raises the number of leadership positions students hold by 44 percent and their probability of attaining a top 0.1 percent income by 51 percent. However, these gains are driven by male applicants from high-tuition private high schools, with zero effects for female students or students from other school types with similar admissions test scores. Admissions effects are equal to 38 percent of the gap in rates of top attainment by gender and 54 percent of the gap by high school background for male students. A difference-in-differences analysis of the rates at which pairs of students lead the same firms suggests that peer ties formed between college classmates from similar backgrounds may play an important role in driving the observed effects. (JEL I23, I26, J16, O15)

10.1257/aer.20171019.abstractZh: 本文探讨精英大学是否有助于历史上处于不利地位的学生在经济领域取得顶尖职位。本研究结合了智利以商业为导向的精英大学录取数据的行政数据，以及公开上市公司的收入与领导团队的相关信息，并采用了基于录取规则的回归不连续设计方法。在这些大学中录取的学生占全体大学生的1.8%，他们占据了41%的领导职位和39%的顶尖收入群体。录取率使学生在领导职位上的占比增加了44%，获得顶尖收入的概率则提高了51%。然而，这些收益主要来自于来自高学费私立高中的男性申请者，而对女性学生或其他具有类似录取成绩的学校类型的学生则没有显著影响。录取对男女学生顶尖成就率的差距贡献了38%，对男性学生高中背景差异的差距贡献了54%。通过对同一公司中不同学生之间的领导情况进行的差异分析，发现来自相似背景的大学同学之间的同伴关系可能在推动这些效应方面发挥了重要作用。（JEL I23, I26, J16, O15）

abstract.text: Sticky price models featuring heterogeneous firms and systematic firm-level productivity trends deliver radically different predictions for the optimal inflation rate than their popular homogenous-firm counterparts: (i) the optimal steady-state inflation rate generically differs from zero and (ii) inflation optimally responds to productivity disturbances. We show this by aggregating a heterogeneous-firm model with sticky prices in closed form. Using firm-level data from the US Census Bureau, we estimate the historically optimal inflation path for the US economy: the optimal inflation rate ranges between 1 percent and 3 percent per year and displays a downward trend over the period 1977–2015. (JEL C51, D24, D25, E31, E52)

10.1257/aer.20171066.abstractZh: 具有异质性企业和系统性企业生产率趋势的粘性价格模型，对于最优通胀率的预测与常见的同质性企业模型截然不同：(i) 最优稳态通胀率通常不为零；(ii) 通胀会针对生产率波动做出相应调整。我们通过将异质性企业模型与粘性价格相结合，以封闭形式进行整合，从而证明了这一点。利用美国人口普查局提供的企业级数据，我们估算了美国经济历史上最优的通胀路径：最优通胀率每年在1%至3%之间，并在1977年至2015年期间呈现下降趋势。(JEL C51, D24, D25, E31, E52)

abstract.text: We study the impact of a personalized technology-aided after-school instruction program in middle-school grades in urban India using a lottery that provided winners with free access to the program. Lottery winners scored 0.37 σ higher in math and 0.23 σ higher in Hindi over just a 4.5-month period. IV estimates suggest that attending the program for 90 days would increase math and Hindi test scores by 0.6 σ and 0.39 σ respectively. We find similar absolute test score gains for all students, but much greater relative gains for academically-weaker students. Our results suggest that well-designed, technology-aided instruction programs can sharply improve productivity in delivering education. (JEL I21, I26, I28, J24, O15)

10.1257/aer.20171112.abstractZh: 我们研究了在印度城市的中学阶段，一项个性化技术辅助的课后辅导项目的影响。该项目通过抽奖方式向参与者提供免费参与的机会。结果显示，在仅4.5个月的时间里，抽奖获胜者在数学和印地语方面的成绩分别提高了0.37σ和0.23σ。模型估计表明，连续90天参加该项目能使学生的数学和印地语测试成绩分别提高0.6σ和0.39σ。我们发现所有学生的绝对测试成绩都有所提高，但学业较弱的学生相对收益更大。我们的研究结果表明，设计良好的技术辅助教学项目能够显著提高教育的效率。（JEL I21, I26, I28, J24, O15）

abstract.text: Schools worldwide distribute information to parents about their children’s academic performance. Do frictions prevent parents, particularly low-income parents, from accessing this information to make decisions? A field experiment in Malawi shows that, at baseline, parents’ beliefs about their children’s academic performance are often inaccurate. Providing parents with clear, digestible performance information causes them to update their beliefs and adjust their investments: they increase the school enrollment of their higher-performing children, decrease the enrollment of lower-performing children, and choose educational inputs that are more closely matched to their children’s academic level. Heterogeneity analysis suggests information frictions are worse among the poor. (JEL C93, D83, I21, I24, J13, O15)

10.1257/aer.20171172.abstractZh: 全球各地的学校向家长提供关于孩子学业表现的信息。是否存在一些障碍阻碍家长，尤其是低收入家长，获取这些信息以做出决策？在马拉维进行的一项实地实验表明，在初始阶段，家长对孩子学业表现的认知往往是不准确的。向家长提供清晰、易于理解的成绩信息能够促使他们更新认知并调整投资：他们会增加成绩较好的孩子的入学率，减少成绩较差的孩子的入学率，并选择更符合孩子学业水平的教育投入。异质性分析表明，信息障碍在贫困人群中更为严重。（JEL C93, D83, I21, I24, J13, O15）

abstract.text: We evaluate the consequences of narrow hospital networks in commercial health care markets. We develop a bargaining solution, "Nash- in-Nash with Threat of Replacement," that captures insurers' incentives to exclude, and combine it with California data and estimates from Ho and Lee (2017) to simulate equilibrium outcomes under social, consumer, and insurer- optimal networks. Private incentives to exclude generally exceed social incentives, as the insurer benefits from substantially lower negotiated hospital rates. Regulation prohibiting exclusion increases prices and premiums and lowers consumer welfare without significantly affecting social surplus. However, regulation may prevent harm to consumers living close to excluded hospitals.

10.1257/aer.20171288.abstractZh: 我们评估了医院网络狭窄在商业医疗保健市场中的后果。我们提出了一种“纳什-纳什与替代威胁”的谈判解决方案，该方案能够捕捉保险公司排除其他医院的动机，并结合加利福尼亚州的数据以及Ho和Lee（2017年）的估计结果，来模拟在社会、消费者和保险公司最优网络下的均衡结果。私人排除其他医院的动机通常超过社会动机，因为保险公司可以从谈判达成更低的医院费用中获益。禁止排除行为的法规会提高价格和保费，降低消费者福利，但并不会显著影响社会剩余。不过，此类法规或许能够防止居住在被排除医院附近的消费者受到损害。

abstract.text: This paper extends the benchmark New-Keynesian model by introducing two frictions: (i) agent heterogeneity with incomplete markets, uninsurable idiosyncratic risk, and occasionally-binding borrowing constraints; and (ii) bounded rationality in the form of level-k thinking. Compared to the benchmark model, we show that the interaction of these two frictions leads to a powerful mitigation of the effects of monetary policy, which is more pronounced at long horizons, and offers a potential rationalization of the “forward guidance puzzle.” Each of these frictions, in isolation, would lead to no or much smaller departures from the benchmark model. (JEL D52, D81, E12, E52)

10.1257/aer.20171400.abstractZh: 本文通过引入两种摩擦来扩展基准的新凯恩斯模型：(i) 代理人异质性，包括不完全市场、无法保险的特殊风险以及偶尔生效的借贷限制；(ii) 以水平思维形式出现的有界理性。与基准模型相比，我们表明这两种摩擦的相互作用显著减轻了货币政策的影响，这种效果在长期范围内更为明显，并为“前瞻性指导之谜”提供了可能的解释。单独来看，这些摩擦不会导致与基准模型相比的显著偏差或较小的偏差。(JEL D52, D81, E12, E52)

abstract.text: We propose an approach to measuring the misallocation of production in a market that compares actual industry cost curves to undistorted (counterfactual ) supply curves. As compared to traditional, TFPR-based, misallocation measures, this approach leverages cost data, such that results are readily mapped to welfare metrics. As an application, we analyze global crude oil extraction and quantify the extent of misallocation therein, together with the proportion attributable to market power. From 1970 to 2014, we find substantial misallocation, in the order of US$744 billion, 14.1 percent to 21.9 percent of which is attributable to market power. (JEL D24, F23, L13, L71, Q35)

10.1257/aer.20171438.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种衡量市场生产资源错配的方法，该方法将实际的行业成本曲线与未受扭曲的供给曲线进行比较。与传统的基于TFPR的错配度量方法相比，这种方法利用了成本数据，使得结果能够直接转化为福利指标。作为应用案例，我们分析了全球原油开采情况，并量化了其中的错配程度，以及其中由市场力量导致的部分。从1970年到2014年，我们发现存在相当大的生产资源错配，金额约为7440亿美元，其中14.1%到21.9%的错配是由市场力量造成的。（JEL D24, F23, L13, L71, Q35）

abstract.text: This paper provides a comprehensive assessment of the margins along which firms responded to a large and persistent minimum wage increase in Hungary. We show that employment elasticities are negative but small even four years after the reform; that around 75 percent of the minimum wage increase was paid by consumers and 25 percent by firm owners; that firms responded to the minimum wage by substituting labor with capital; and that disemployment effects were greater in industries where passing the wage costs to consumers is more difficult. We estimate a model with monopolistic competition to explain these findings. (JEL J23, J24, J31, J38, L13)

10.1257/aer.20171445.abstractZh: 本文对企业在匈牙利大规模且持续的最低工资上涨情况下的反应进行了全面评估。我们发现，即使改革四年后，就业弹性仍为负值且较小；大约75%的最低工资上涨费用由消费者承担，25%由企业主承担；企业通过用资本替代劳动力来应对最低工资的变化；而在将工资成本转嫁给消费者的行业，失业效应更为显著。我们采用垄断竞争模型来解释这些发现。（JEL J23, J24, J31, J38, L13）

abstract.text: How much are low- income individuals willing to pay for health insurance, and what are the implications for insurance markets? Using administrative data from Massachusetts’ subsidized insurance exchange, we exploit discontinuities in the subsidy schedule to estimate willingness to pay and costs of insurance among low- income adults. As subsidies decline, insurance take- up falls rapidly, dropping about 25 percent for each $40 increase in monthly enrollee premiums. Marginal enrollees tend to be lower- cost, indicating adverse selection into insurance. But across the entire distribution we can observe (approximately the bottom 70 percent of the willingness to pay distribution) enrollees’ willingness to pay is always less than half of their own expected costs that they impose on the insurer. As a result, we estimate that take- up will be highly incomplete even with generous subsidies. If enrollee premiums were 25 percent of insurers’ average costs, at most half of potential enrollees would buy insurance; even premiums subsidized to 10 percent of average costs would still leave at least 20 percent uninsured. We briefly consider potential explanations for these findings and their normative implications.

10.1257/aer.20171455.abstractZh: 低收入人群愿意为健康保险支付多少费用，这对保险市场有何影响？我们利用马萨诸塞州补贴保险交易所的行政数据，通过补贴计划中的不连续性来估算低收入成年人的支付意愿和保险成本。随着补贴的减少，保险投保率迅速下降，每月参保人保费每增加40美元，投保率就会下降约25%。边际参保人往往属于成本较低的群体，这表明保险市场存在逆向选择的问题。但在整个参保人群中，大约70%的参保人的支付意愿始终低于他们向保险公司支付的预期成本的一半。因此，我们估计即使有慷慨的补贴，保险投保率也会非常低。如果参保人保费仅为保险公司平均成本的一半，那么最多只有一半的潜在参保人会购买保险；即使保费补贴到平均成本的一半，仍有至少20%的人无法获得保险。我们简要探讨了这些发现的可能解释及其规范意义。

abstract.text: Charter school funding is typically set by formulas that provide the same amount for students regardless of advantage or need. I present evidence that this policy skews the distribution of students served by charters toward low-cost populations by influencing where charter schools open and whether they survive. To do this, I develop and estimate an equilibrium model of charter school supply and competition to evaluate the effects of funding policies that aim to correct these incentives. The results indicate that a cost-adjusted funding formula would increase the share of disadvantaged students in charter schools with little reduction in aggregate effectiveness. (JEL H75, I21, I22, I28)

10.1257/aer.20171484.abstractZh: 特许学校的资金通常通过公式确定，无论学生的优势或需求如何，都会提供相同的资金额度。我提供了证据，表明这一政策通过影响特许学校的开设地点以及其能否持续运营，使得特许学校服务的学生分布偏向低成本群体。为此，我开发并估算了一个关于特许学校供给与竞争的均衡模型，以评估旨在纠正这些激励机制的资助政策的效果。研究结果表明，采用成本调整后的资金分配公式，可以在不大幅降低整体效果的情况下，增加特许学校中弱势学生的比例。（JEL H75, I21, I22, I28）

abstract.text: We provide a revealed preference methodology for identifying beliefs and utilities that can vary across states. A notion of comparative informativeness is introduced that is weaker than the standard Blackwell ranking. We show that beliefs and state-dependent utilities can be identified using stochastic choice from two informational treatments, where one is strictly more informative than another. Moreover, if the signal structure is known, then stochastic choice from a single treatment is enough for identification. These results illustrate novel identification methodologies unique to stochastic choice. Applications include identifying biases in job hiring, loan approvals, and medical advice. (JEL D11, D82, D83, J23, M51)

10.1257/aer.20171534.abstractZh: 我们提供了一种揭示偏好方法，用于识别在不同状态下可能变化的信念和效用。我们引入了比较信息性的概念，这一概念比标准的Blackwell排名更为宽松。我们展示了，通过两种信息处理方式下的随机选择，可以识别出信念和状态依赖的效用，其中一种处理方式比另一种更为信息丰富。此外，如果信号结构已知，那么仅使用单一处理方式下的随机选择就足以进行识别。这些结果展示了随机选择特有的新颖识别方法。应用范围包括识别招聘、贷款审批和医疗建议中的偏见。（JEL D11, D82, D83, J23, M51）

abstract.text: We analyze test design and certification standards when an uninformed seller has the option to generate and disclose costly information regarding asset quality. We characterize equilibria by a minimum principle: the test and disclosure policy are chosen to minimize the asset’s value conditional on nondisclosure. Thus, when sellers choose the information provided, simple pass/fail certification tests are likely to dominate the market. A social planner could raise informational and allocative efficiency, and lower deadweight testing costs, by raising the certification standard. Monopolist certifiers also satisfy the minimum principle but set a higher standard and reduce testing rates to maximize revenue. (JEL D42, D83, L12, L15)

10.1257/aer.20171722.abstractZh: 我们分析了在不知情卖方有选择生成和披露与资产质量相关的昂贵信息的情境下的测试设计和认证标准。我们通过最小原则来描述均衡状态：测试和披露政策的选择旨在在非披露条件下最小化资产的价值。因此，当卖方选择提供信息时，简单的通过/失败认证测试很可能会主导市场。社会规划者可以通过提高认证标准来提高信息和分配效率，并降低无效的测试成本。垄断性认证者同样满足最小原则，但他们设定更高的标准，并降低测试率以最大化收入。（JEL D42, D83, L12, L15）

abstract.text: I study expertise acquisition in a model of trading under asymmetric information. I propose and implement a method to measure r, the ratio of the marginal social value to the marginal private value of expertise. This can be decomposed into three sufficient statistics: traders’ average profits, the fraction of bad assets among traded assets, and the elasticity of good assets traded with respect to capital inflows. I measure r = 0.16 for the junk bond underwriting market. Since this is less than 1, it implies that marginal investments in expertise destroy surplus. (JEL D82, G11, G14, G21, L84)

10.1257/aer.20171735.abstractZh: 我研究在信息不对称条件下交易模型中的专业知识获取问题。我提出了一种方法来衡量r值，即专业知识边际社会价值与边际私人价值的比率。这一数值可以分解为三个充分统计量：交易者的平均利润、交易资产中不良资产的比例，以及与资本流入相关的优质资产交易弹性。我得出的结果表明，垃圾债券承销市场的r值为0.16。由于这一数值小于1，这意味着对专业知识的边际投资会破坏剩余收益。（JEL D82, G11, G14, G21, L84）

abstract.text: For exiting products, statistical agencies often impute inflation from surviving products. This understates growth if creatively-destroyed products improve more than surviving ones. If so, then the market share of surviving products should systematically shrink. Using entering and exiting establishments to proxy for creative destruction, we estimate missing growth in US Census data on non-farm businesses from 1983 to 2013. We find missing growth (i) equaled about one-half a percentage point per year; (ii) arose mostly from hotels and restaurants rather than manufacturing; and (iii) did not accelerate much after 2005, and therefore does not explain the sharp slowdown in growth since then. (JEL E23, E31, L14, L15, O30, O41)

10.1257/aer.20171745.abstractZh: 对于退出市场的产品，统计机构通常会从存活下来的产品中估算通货膨胀。如果被创造性破坏的产品改进程度超过存活下来的产品，那么这种估算就会低估了增长情况。如果真是如此，那么存活下来的产品的市场份额应该会系统性地下降。我们利用新进入和退出市场的企业作为创造性破坏的代理变量，估算了1983年至2013年间美国非农业企业 Census 数据中缺失的增长数据。我们发现，缺失的增长量每年约为0.5个百分点；这些增长主要来自酒店和餐馆，而非制造业；并且在2005年之后增长速度并没有明显加快，因此无法解释此后增长速度的急剧放缓。（JEL E23, E31, L14, L15, O30, O41）

abstract.text: We propose a new channel to account for the difficulties of individuals with contingent reasoning: the presence of uncertainty. When moving from an environment with one state of known value to one with multiple possible values, two changes occur. First, the number of values to consider increases. Second, the value of the state is uncertain. We show in an experiment that this lack of certainty, or the loss of the Power of Certainty, impedes payoff maximization and that it accounts for a substantial portion of the difficulties with contingent reasoning. (JEL D12, D81, D91)

10.1257/aer.20171764.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的渠道，以解释具有条件性推理的个体所面临的困难：不确定性的存在。当从一个具有单一已知价值的情境转移到具有多个可能价值的情境时，会发生两个变化。首先，需要考虑的价值数量增加。其次，状态的价值变得不确定。我们通过实验表明，这种不确定性的缺失，或者说确定性力量的丧失，会阻碍收益的最大化，并且这解释了条件性推理中存在的许多困难。（JEL D12, D81, D91）

abstract.text: Media censorship is a hallmark of authoritarian regimes. We conduct a field experiment in China to measure the effects of providing citizens with access to an uncensored internet. We track subjects’ media consumption, beliefs regarding the media, economic beliefs, political attitudes, and behaviors over 18 months. We find four main results: (i) free access alone does not induce subjects to acquire politically sensitive information; (ii) temporary encouragement leads to a persistent increase in acquisition, indicating that demand is not permanently low; (iii) acquisition brings broad, substantial, and persistent changes to knowledge, beliefs, attitudes, and intended behaviors; and (iv) social transmission of information is statistically significant but small in magnitude. We calibrate a simple model to show that the combination of low demand for uncensored information and the moderate social transmission means China’s censorship apparatus may remain robust to a large number of citizens receiving access to an uncensored internet. (JEL C93, D72, D83, L82, L86, L88, P36)

10.1257/aer.20171765.abstractZh: 媒体审查是专制政权的特征之一。我们在中国进行了一项实地实验，以评估为公民提供无审查互联网的影响。我们跟踪了受试者在18个月内的媒体消费、对媒体的看法、经济观念、政治态度和行为。我们发现四个主要结果：(i) 仅提供免费访问并不促使受试者获取政治敏感信息；(ii) 临时鼓励会导致获取信息的持续增加，表明需求并非长期低迷；(iii) 获取信息会带来知识、观念、态度及预期行为的广泛、显著且持久的变化；(iv) 信息的社会传播在统计上显著，但幅度较小。我们通过一个简单的模型进行校准，表明对无审查信息的低需求以及适度的社会传播意味着，即使大量公民能够访问无审查互联网，中国的审查机制仍可能保持有效。(JEL C93, D72, D83, L82, L86, L88, P36)

abstract.text: We model the dynamics of discrimination and show how its evolution can identify the underlying source. We test these theoretical predictions in a field experiment on a large online platform where users post content that is evaluated by other users on the platform. We assign posts to accounts that exogenously vary by gender and evaluation histories. With no prior evaluations, women face significant discrimination. However, following a sequence of positive evaluations, the direction of discrimination reverses: women’s posts are favored over men’s. Interpreting these results through the lens of our model, this dynamic reversal implies discrimination driven by biased beliefs. (JEL C93, D83, J16, J71)

10.1257/aer.20171829.abstractZh: 我们模拟了歧视的动态过程，并展示了其演变如何揭示潜在的来源。我们在一个大型在线平台上进行了实地实验，以验证这些理论预测。在该平台上，用户发布的内容由其他用户进行评估。我们将帖子分配给按性别和评估历史外生划分的账户。在没有先前评估的情况下，女性面临显著的歧视。然而，在经历一系列积极的评估后，歧视的方向发生了逆转：女性的帖子比男性的帖子更受青睐。通过我们的模型来解释这些结果，这种动态逆转意味着歧视是由偏见信念驱动的。（JEL C93, D83, J16, J71）

abstract.text: Subsidy programs have two countervailing effects on firms: direct gains for eligible firms and indirect losses for those whose competitors are eligible. In 2006, India changed the eligibility criteria for small-firm subsidies, and the sales of newly eligible firms grew by roughly 35 percent. Competitors of the newly eligible firms were affected, with almost complete crowd-out within products that were less internationally traded, but little crowd-out for more-traded products. The newly eligible firms had relatively high marginal products, so relaxing the eligibility criteria for subsidies increased aggregate productivity by around 1−2 percent. Targeting different firms could have led to similar gains. (JEL D22, D24, H25, L25, L52, L60, O14)

10.1257/aer.20171840.abstractZh: 补贴计划对企业有两方面的影响：对符合条件的企业有直接的好处，而对那些竞争对手也有条件的企业则会产生间接的损失。2006年，印度修改了小型企业补贴的资格标准，新符合资格标准的企业的销售额增长了大约35%。新符合条件的企业的竞争对手也受到了影响，在那些国际贸易较少的产品上，几乎完全被淘汰，但在贸易较多的产品上，淘汰效应较小。新符合条件的企业具有相对较高的边际产品，因此放宽补贴资格标准使总体生产率提高了大约1-2%。针对不同的企业实施补贴也可能带来类似的收益。（JEL D22, D24, H25, L25, L52, L60, O14）

abstract.text: An informer sequentially collects and disseminates information through costly research to persuade an evaluator to approve an activity. Payoffs and control rights are split between informer and evaluator depending on the organizational rules governing the approval process. The welfare benchmark corresponds to Wald’s classic solution for a statistician with payoff equal to the sum of informer and evaluator. Organizations with different commitment power of informer and evaluator are compared from a positive and normative perspective. Granting authority to the informer is socially optimal when information acquisition is sufficiently costly. The analysis is applied to the regulatory process for drug approval. (JEL D82, D83, I18, L51, L65, O31)

10.1257/aer.20171919.abstractZh: 一名告密者通过成本高昂的研究来收集和传播信息，以说服评估者批准某项活动。根据管理批准流程的组织规则，收益和控制权在告密者和评估者之间分配。福利基准对应于Wald的经典解决方案，即收益等于告密者和评估者收益之和。从积极和规范的角度，比较了告密者和评估者在不同承诺能力下的组织情况。当信息获取成本足够高时，将授权给予告密者是社会最优的。该分析适用于药品审批的监管流程。（JEL D82, D83, I18, L51, L65, O31）

abstract.text: This paper uses administrative data to analyze a large employer-borne payroll tax rate cut for young workers in Sweden. We find no effect on net-of-tax wages of young treated workers relative to slightly older untreated workers, and a 2–3 percentage point increase in youth employment. Firms employing many young workers receive a larger tax windfall and expand right after the reform: employment, capital, sales, and profits increase. These effects appear stronger in credit-constrained firms. Youth-intensive firms also increase the wages of all their workers collectively, young as well as old, consistent with rent sharing of the tax windfall. (JEL H25, H32, J13, J23, J31, M51)

10.1257/aer.20171937.abstractZh: 本文利用行政数据分析了瑞典一项针对年轻工人的大规模雇主带来的工资税税率下调政策。研究发现，与年龄稍大但未受政策影响的工人相比，这项政策对年轻工人的税后工资没有影响，同时还使青年就业率提高了2-3个百分点。雇佣大量年轻工人的企业获得了更大的税收收益，并在改革后迅速扩大规模：就业、资本、销售额和利润均有所增长。在信贷受限的企业中，这些效应更为明显。同时，以青年劳动力为主的企业也提高了所有工人的工资，无论是年轻工人还是老年工人，这与税收收益的共享效应一致。（JEL H25, H32, J13, J23, J31, M51）

abstract.text: A principal specifies time paths of effort provision, task allocation, and knowledge transfer for a cash-constrained apprentice, who is free to walk away at any time. In the optimal contract the apprentice pays for training by working for low or no wages and by working inefficiently hard. The apprentice can work on both knowledge-complementary and knowledge-independent tasks. We study the optimal time path of effort distortions and their impact on the knowledge transfer, and analyze the effect of regulatory limits on the length of apprenticeships and on how much effort apprentices are allowed to provide. (JEL D82, D86, J24, J41, M53)

10.1257/aer.20171939.abstractZh: 一位负责人为一名资金有限的学徒指定了努力投入、任务分配和知识传递的时间路径，该学徒可以在任何时间自由离开。在最优契约中，学徒通过低工资或无工资的工作以及低效的努力来支付培训费用。学徒可以从事既需要知识支持又不需要知识支持的任务。我们研究了努力投入的最优时间路径及其对知识传递的影响，并分析了监管限制对学徒期限以及学徒允许投入的努力程度的影响。（JEL D82, D86, J24, J41, M53）

abstract.text: We study how health behaviors are shaped through family spillovers. We leverage administrative data to identify the effects of health shocks on family members’ consumption of preventive care and health-related behaviors, constructing counterfactuals for affected households using households that experience the same shock but a few years in the future. Spouses and adult children immediately improve their health behaviors and their responses are both significant and persistent. These spillovers are far-reaching as they cascade even to coworkers. While some responses are consistent with learning information about one’s own health, the evidence points to salience as a major operative explanation. (JEL D15, D83, I12, J12)

10.1257/aer.20171993.abstractZh: 我们研究了健康行为是如何通过家庭溢出效应而受到影响的。我们利用行政数据来识别健康冲击对家庭成员预防性护理和健康相关行为的消费影响，通过未来几年内经历相同冲击但情况稍好的家庭来构建反事实情景。配偶和成年子女的健康行为立即得到改善，且这种改善是显著且持久的。这些溢出效应具有广泛的影响，甚至波及到同事。虽然一些反应与了解自身健康状况的信息有关，但证据表明，显著性是一个重要的解释因素。（JEL D15, D83, I12, J12）

abstract.text: Oligopoly models of price competition predict that strategic firms exercise market power and generate inefficiencies. However, heterogeneity in firms’ strategic ability also generates inefficiencies. We study the Texas electricity market where firms exhibit significant heterogeneity in how they deviate from Nash equilibrium bidding. These deviations, in turn, increase the cost of production. To explain this heterogeneity, we embed a cognitive hierarchy model into a structural model of bidding and estimate firms’ strategic sophistication. We find that firm size and manager education affect sophistication. Using the model, we show that mergers which increase sophistication can increase efficiency despite increasing market concentration. (JEL D24, D43, G34, L13, L25, L94)

10.1257/aer.20172015.abstractZh: 寡头垄断的价格竞争模型预测，具有战略能力的企业会行使市场权力并导致效率低下。然而，企业战略能力的差异也会产生效率低下。我们研究了德克萨斯州电力市场，发现企业在偏离纳什均衡出价方面存在显著的差异。这些偏差反过来增加了生产成本。为了解释这种差异，我们将认知层次模型嵌入到出价结构模型中，并评估企业的战略复杂性。我们发现企业规模和管理层教育水平会影响其战略复杂性。利用该模型，我们表明，尽管市场集中度增加，但提高企业复杂性的合并行为可以提高效率。（JEL D24, D43, G34, L13, L25, L94）

abstract.text: International trade collapsed, and also became much less multilateral, during the 1930s. Previous studies, looking at aggregate trade flows, have argued that trade policies had relatively little to do with either phenomenon. Using a new dataset incorporating highly disaggregated information on the United Kingdom’s imports and trade policies, we find that while conventional wisdom is correct regarding the impact of trade policy on the total value of British imports, discriminatory trade policies can explain the majority of Britain’s shift toward Imperial imports in the 1930s. (JEL F13, F14, F54, N74)

10.1257/aer.20172020.abstractZh: 在20世纪30年代，国际贸易陷入崩溃，且多边性也大大减弱。以往关于贸易总量流动的研究认为，贸易政策与这两种现象之间的关系相对较小。通过利用包含英国进口和贸易政策详细数据的新数据集，我们发现，尽管关于贸易政策对英国进口总额影响的观点是正确的，但歧视性贸易政策可以解释20世纪30年代英国转向帝国进口的主要原因。（JEL F13, F14, F54, N74）

abstract.text: Drawing on a unique dataset of leaked customer lists from offshore financial institutions matched to administrative wealth records in Scandinavia, we show that offshore tax evasion is highly concentrated among the rich. The skewed distribution of offshore wealth implies high rates of tax evasion at the top: we find that the 0.01 percent richest households evade about 25 percent of their taxes. By contrast, tax evasion detected in stratified random tax audits is less than 5 percent throughout the distribution. Top wealth shares increase substantially when accounting for unreported assets, highlighting the importance of factoring in tax evasion to properly measure inequality. (JEL D31, H24, H26, K34)
