We present a model of monopsony power and test its predictions using price differences between the United States and Canada – a country that represents an example of a “Medicare for All” style system. Overall, we find that wage differences for medical providers across the two countries are primarily driven by the broader labor market while price difference for prescription drugs are more directly the result of buyer power. We discuss theoretical reasons why a Canadian monopsonist may be more willing to exploit its buyer power over prescription drugs rather than provider wages and why a U.S. monopsonist might not be willing to do the same

10.3386/w26122.abstractZh: 或许与经济的其他领域相比，医疗保健行业更依赖于政府资源。因此，许多医疗保健系统依靠政府垄断力量来减少开支。美国是一个显著的例外，因为该行业大部分领域的价格是由政府不参与而决定的。在本文中，我们探讨了在美国更大程度地利用垄断力量所带来的经济影响。我们构建了一个垄断力量模型，并通过美国与加拿大之间的价格差异来检验其预测结果——加拿大是一个“全民医保”模式的典型代表。总体而言，我们发现两国医疗提供者的工资差异主要由更广泛的劳动力市场驱动，而处方药的价格差异则更直接地反映了买方的议价能力。我们还讨论了理论上的原因，解释为什么加拿大的垄断者可能更愿意利用其在处方药上的议价能力，而不是医疗提供者的工资，而美国的垄断者则可能不愿意这样做。

abstract.text: We elicit numerical expectations for late-onset dementia in the Health and Retirement Study. Our elicitation distinguishes between precise and imprecise probabilities, while accounting for rounding of reports. Respondents quantify imprecision using probability intervals. Nearly half of respondents hold imprecise dementia probabilities, while almost a third of precise-probability respondents round their reports. We provide the first empirical evidence on dementia-risk perceptions among dementia-free older Americans and novel evidence about imprecise probabilities in a nationally-representative sample. We show, in a specific framework, that failing to account for imprecise or rounded probabilities can yield incorrect predictions of long-term care insurance purchase decisions.

10.3386/w26125.abstractZh: 我们在“健康与退休研究”中收集了关于晚发性痴呆的预计概率数据。我们的数据收集区分了精确概率和不精确概率，同时考虑了报告中的四舍五入情况。受访者通过概率区间来量化不精确性。近一半的受访者给出了不精确的概率估计，而几乎三分之一的精确概率受访者则对报告进行了四舍五入处理。我们首次提供了关于无痴呆症美国老年人对痴呆风险认知的实证证据，并发现了关于不精确概率的新证据。在特定框架下，我们发现未能考虑不精确或四舍五入的概率可能会导致对长期护理保险购买决策的错误预测。

abstract.text: E-cigarette taxes are an active area of legislation and have important regulatory implications by proxying e-cigarette accessibility. We examine the effect of e-cigarette taxes on pre-pregnancy and prenatal smoking using the near-universe of births to mothers conceiving between 2013 and 2019 in the United States. Using fixed effect regressions, we show that e-cigarette taxes increase pre-pregnancy and prenatal smoking. We also find evidence that e-cigarette taxes reduce pre-pregnancy and 3rd trimester e-cigarette use. Finally, we show that e-cigarette taxes increase news coverage of e-cigarettes and raise perceptions of risk of e-cigarettes.

10.3386/w26126.abstractZh: 电子香烟税是立法中的一个活跃领域，通过间接影响电子香烟的获取性，对监管具有重要意义。我们研究了电子香烟税对孕前和孕期吸烟的影响，研究样本涵盖了2013年至2019年间在美国怀孕的母亲所生的新生儿。通过固定效应回归分析，我们发现电子香烟税会增加孕前和孕期的吸烟行为。此外，我们还发现电子香烟税会降低孕前和妊娠第三期的电子香烟使用率。最后，我们指出电子香烟税会增加关于电子香烟的新闻报道，并提升人们对电子香烟风险的认知。

abstract.text: This article presents estimates of the effects of state prescription opioid policies on prescription opioid sales, mortality and socioeconomic outcomes of adults. Results indicate that state implementation of a “modern” PDMP is associated with decreases in opioid sales of between 5% and 20% and that pill mill laws are associated with a decrease in opioid sales of between 15% and 50%. The reductions in prescription opioid sales associated with these state policies were, in general, not associated with statistically significant effects on mortality. In the case of socioeconomic outcomes, we found consistent evidence that the adoption of a “modern” PDMP was associated with small, but statistically significant reductions in employment of 1% to 2% across all demographic groups examined; small reductions in earnings that were not statistically significant and similarly small, marginally significant increases in receipt of public assistance, particularly for women; and a significant, but small (1%) decline in the probability of being married among females. In contrast, pill mill laws were associated with marginally significant increases in employment of 1% to 2%, but only among those ages 18 to 25; small, but insignificant increases in earnings of males of between 2% to 4%; and a significant, but small (1%) decline in the probability of being married among all demographic groups.

10.3386/w26135.abstractZh: 本文对州级处方阿片类药物政策对处方阿片类药物销售、死亡率以及成年人社会经济状况的影响进行了估算。研究结果表明，实施“现代”处方药物管理制度的州，阿片类药物销售减少了5%至20%；而针对非法药品市场的法律则使阿片类药物销售减少了15%至50%。这些州政策导致的处方阿片类药物销售减少，总体上并未对死亡率产生显著影响。在社会经济状况方面，我们发现实施“现代”处方药物管理制度的州，所有被研究的群体中就业人数均减少了1%至2%，这一变化虽小但具有统计学意义；男性收入也有所减少，但幅度不大，且对公共援助的领取量有轻微但显著的提升，尤其是女性群体；女性已婚概率则出现了1%的显著但较小的下降。相比之下，针对非法药品市场的法律则导致就业人数增加了1%至2%，但这一变化仅发生在18至25岁的人群中；男性收入略有增加，幅度为2%至4%；所有群体中的已婚概率则出现了1%的显著但较小的下降。

abstract.text: Much research has studied the health effects of expanding insurance coverage to low-income people, but there is less work on the direct provision of care to the uninsured. We study the two largest federal programs aimed at reducing breast and cervical cancer among uninsured women in the US: one that paid for cancer screenings with federal funds and one that paid for cancer treatments under state Medicaid programs. Using variation in rollout of each program across states from 1991-2005, we find that funding for cancer treatment did not significantly increase most types of cancer screenings for uninsured women. In contrast, funding for cancer detection significantly increased breast and cervical cancer screenings among 40-64 year old uninsured women, with much smaller effects for insured women (who were not directly eligible). Moreover, we find that these program-induced screenings significantly increased detection of early stage pre-cancers and cancers of the breast but had no significant effect on early stage or other cancers of the cervix. Our results suggest that direct provision can significantly increase healthcare utilization among vulnerable populations.

10.3386/w26140.abstractZh: 许多研究探讨了为低收入人群扩大保险覆盖范围对健康的积极影响，但关于为无保险人群直接提供医疗服务的研究相对较少。本研究针对美国两个旨在减少无保险女性患乳腺癌和宫颈癌的联邦项目进行了分析：一个项目由联邦资金支付癌症筛查费用，另一个项目则由州级医疗补助计划支付癌症治疗费用。通过1991年至2005年间各州实施这些项目的差异，我们发现，癌症治疗的资金并未显著增加无保险女性各类癌症筛查的覆盖率。相反，针对40至64岁无保险女性的癌症检测资金显著增加了乳腺癌和宫颈癌筛查的覆盖率，而对于有保险的女性（她们并非直接受益对象）则效果较小。此外，我们发现这些项目推动的筛查措施显著提高了早期癌前病变和乳腺癌的检出率，但对宫颈癌的早期阶段及其他类型的癌症则没有显著影响。我们的研究结果表明，直接为弱势群体提供医疗服务可以显著增加他们的医疗利用程度。

abstract.text: We conduct a comparative welfare analysis of 133 historical policy changes over the past half-century in the United States, focusing on policies in social insurance, education and job training, taxes and cash transfers, and in-kind transfers. For each policy, we use existing causal estimates to calculate both the benefit that each policy provides its recipients (measured as their willingness to pay) and the policy’s net cost, inclusive of long-term impacts on the government’s budget. We divide the willingness to pay by the net cost to the government to form each policy’s Marginal Value of Public Funds, or its “MVPF”. Comparing MVPFs across policies provides a unified method of assessing their impact on social welfare. Our results suggest that direct investments in low-income children’s health and education have historically had the highest MVPFs, on average exceeding 5. Many such policies have paid for themselves as governments recouped the cost of their initial expenditures through additional taxes collected and reduced transfers. We find large MVPFs for education and health policies amongst children of all ages, rather than observing diminishing marginal returns throughout childhood. We find smaller MVPFs for policies targeting adults, generally between 0.5 and 2. Expenditures on adults have exceeded this MVPF range in particular if they induced large spillovers on children. We relate our estimates to existing theories of optimal government policy and we discuss how the MVPF provides lessons for the design of future research.

10.3386/w26144.abstractZh: 我们对过去半个世纪美国发生的133项历史政策变化进行了比较福利分析，重点关注社会保险、教育和职业培训、税收以及实物转移方面的政策。对于每一项政策，我们利用现有的因果估计数据来计算每项政策为受助者提供的利益（以他们的支付意愿为衡量标准）以及政策的净成本，包括对政府预算的长期影响。我们将支付意愿与政府的净成本相除，得出每项政策的公共资金边际价值，即“MVPF”。通过比较不同政策的MVPF，我们可以统一评估它们对社会福利的影响。我们的研究结果表明，直接投资于低收入儿童的健康和教育方面的政策，其MVPF通常最高，平均超过5。许多这类政策通过政府通过征收额外税收和减少转移支付来收回初始支出，从而实现了成本回收。我们发现，针对所有年龄段的儿童的教育和卫生政策的MVPF较大，而不是在整个童年阶段边际回报递减。针对成人的政策则表现出较小的MVPF，通常在0.5到2之间。如果这些政策对儿童产生了较大的溢出效应，那么对成人的支出则超过了这一MVPF范围。我们将我们的估计结果与现有的最优政府政策理论联系起来，并讨论了MVPF为未来研究的设计提供了哪些启示。

abstract.text: This paper examines trends in Medicaid enrollment across the income distribution after the ACA’s Medicaid expansion. Using data from the American Community Survey between 2012 and 2017, we compare Medicaid coverage over time in 9 states that expanded Medicaid in 2014 with no previous expansion for able-bodied, working-age adults with 12 states that had not expanded Medicaid by 2019 and also had no previous expansion for such adults. A difference-in-differences model is used to formalize this comparison. Similar to many previous studies, we find that Medicaid coverage increased dramatically for income-eligible adults under 138% of the federal poverty level (FPL). In addition, we show that Medicaid participation increased by 3.0 percentage points for those with incomes above 138% of the FPL from a pre-ACA baseline of 2.7% among this group. While we cannot say with certainty why these individuals were able to participate in Medicaid, we offer several potential explanations that should be the subject of future work. For example, it is possible that the ACA Medicaid expansions were administered differently at the state or local level than federal rules would require, similarly to differences between effective tax rates and statutory tax rates in many transfer programs.

10.3386/w26145.abstractZh: 本文探讨了《平价医疗法案》实施后的医疗补助参保情况在收入分布上的变化。通过2012年至2017年间的美国社区调查数据，我们比较了2014年扩大医疗补助覆盖范围的9个州与2019年仍未扩大医疗补助覆盖范围的12个州的情况。我们使用差异-差异模型来正式比较这些差异。与许多先前的研究类似，我们发现，在收入达到联邦贫困线138%以下的成年人中，医疗补助的覆盖率显著上升。此外，我们还发现，对于收入超过联邦贫困线138%的成年人，医疗补助的参与率从《平价医疗法案》实施前的2.7%上升到了3.0%。虽然我们无法确定这些个体能够参与医疗补助的具体原因，但我们提出了几种可能的解释，这些解释值得未来进一步研究。例如，《平价医疗法案》下的医疗补助扩展在州或地方层面的实施方式可能与联邦规定有所不同，这与许多转移支付项目中实际税率与法定税率之间的差异类似。

abstract.text: We experimentally varied information mailed to 87,000 households in California's health insurance marketplace to study the role of frictions in insurance take-up. Reminders about the enrollment deadline raised enrollment by 1.3 pp (16 percent), in this typically low take-up population. Heterogeneous effects of personalized subsidy information indicate systematic misperceptions about program benefits. Consistent with an adverse selection model with frictional enrollment costs, the intervention lowered average spending risk by 5.1 percent, implying that marginal respondents were 37 percent less costly than inframarginal consumers. We observe the largest positive selection among low income consumers, who exhibit the largest frictions in enrollment. Finally, the intervention raised average consumer WTP for insurance by $25 to $54 per month. These results suggest that frictions may partially explain low measured WTP for marketplace insurance, and that interventions reducing them can improve enrollment and market risk in exchanges.

10.3386/w26153.abstractZh: 我们通过实验方式调整了加州健康保险市场发送给87,000户家庭的信息，以研究摩擦因素在保险购买行为中的作用。关于注册截止日期的提醒使保险购买率提高了1.3个百分点（即16%）。在通常购买率较低的人群中，个性化补贴信息的不同效应表明存在对计划福利的系统性误解。与具有摩擦性注册成本的逆向选择模型一致，该干预措施使平均支出风险降低了5.1%，这意味着边际受访者比次边际消费者节省了37%的成本。我们观察到低收入消费者表现出最大的正向选择行为，而他们也是注册过程中摩擦最大的群体。最后，该干预措施使消费者购买保险的平均支付意愿每月增加了25至54美元。这些结果表明，摩擦因素可能部分解释了市场保险中较低的支付意愿，而减少摩擦的干预措施能够提升保险购买率和市场风险。

abstract.text: The purpose of this paper is to estimate the impact of the major components of the ACA (Medicaid expansion, subsidized Marketplace plans, and insurance market reforms) on disparities in insurance coverage after four years. We use data from the 2011–2017 waves of the American Community Survey (ACS), with the sample restricted to nonelderly adults. Our methods feature a difference-in-difference-in-differences model, developed in the recent ACA literature, which separately identifies the effects of the nationwide and Medicaid expansion portions of the law. The differences in this model come from time, state Medicaid expansion status, and local area pre-ACA uninsured rate. We stratify our sample separately by income, race/ethnicity, marital status, age, gender, and geography in order to examine access disparities. After four years, we find that the fully implemented ACA eliminated 44 percent of the coverage gap across income groups, with the Medicaid expansion accounting for this entire reduction. The ACA also reduced coverage disparities across racial groups by 26.7 percent, across marital status by 45 percent, and across age groups by 44 percent, with these changes being partly attributable to both the Medicaid expansion and nationwide components of the law.

10.3386/w26157.abstractZh: 本文旨在评估《平价医疗法案》主要组成部分（包括医疗补助扩展、补贴市场计划以及保险市场改革）在四年后对保险覆盖差异的影响。我们采用了2011年至2017年《美国社区调查》的数据，样本限定为非老年人成年人。我们的研究方法采用了一种差异-差异-差异模型，该模型在最近的《平价医疗法案》文献中得到了发展，能够分别识别该法律全国范围部分和医疗补助扩展部分的效应。该模型中的差异来源于时间、各州的医疗补助扩展状况以及《平价医疗法案》实施前的当地无保险率。我们进一步按收入、种族/族裔、婚姻状况、年龄、性别和地理位置对样本进行分层，以研究获取机会的差异。经过四年时间，我们发现完全实施的《平价医疗法案》消除了44%的收入群体之间的保险覆盖差距，其中医疗补助扩展部分承担了这一减少的全部责任。该法案还减少了26.7%的种族群体之间的保险覆盖差异，减少了45%的婚姻状况之间的差异，以及减少了44%的年龄组之间的差异，这些变化部分归因于医疗补助扩展和法律全国范围的部分。

abstract.text: Many opioid control policies target the prescribing behavior of health care providers. In this paper, we study the first comprehensive state-level policy requiring providers to access patients' opioid history before making prescribing decisions. We compare prescribers in Kentucky, which implemented this policy in 2012, to those in a control state, Indiana. Our main difference-in-differences analysis uses the universe of prescriptions filled in the two states to assess how the information provided affected prescribing behavior. As many as forty percent of low-volume opioid prescribers stopped prescribing opioids altogether after the policy was implemented. Among other providers, the major margin of response was to prescribe opioids to approximately sixteen percent fewer patients. While providers disproportionately discontinued treating patients whose opioid histories showed the use of multiple providers, there were also economically-meaningful reductions for patients without multiple providers and single-use acute patients.

10.3386/w26159.abstractZh: 许多阿片类药物控制政策都针对医疗保健提供者的处方行为。在本文中，我们研究了首个要求提供者在做出处方决策前了解患者阿片类药物历史的综合性州级政策。我们将肯塔基州（该州于2012年实施该政策）的处方者与印第安纳州的控制组进行了比较。我们的主要差异分析使用了两个州中完成的处方数量来评估所提供信息对处方行为的影响。在实施该政策后，高达40%的低剂量阿片类药物处方者完全停止了阿片类药物的处方。在其他提供者中，最大的变化是处方阿片类药物的患者数量减少了大约16%。虽然那些有多次处方历史的患者的治疗被不成比例地中断，但对于没有多次处方记录的患者以及单次急性发病的患者来说，也出现了具有经济意义的减少。

abstract.text: This paper investigates whether offers of commitment contracts, in the form of self-imposed choice-set restrictions and penalties with no financial upside, are well-targeted tools for addressing self-control problems. In an experiment on gym attendance (N= 1;248), we examine take-up of commitment contracts, and also introduce a separate elicitation task to identify actual and perceived time inconsistency. There is high take-up of commitment contracts for greater gym attendance, resulting in significant increases in exercise. However, this is take-up is influenced both by noisy valuation and incorrect beliefs about one’s time inconsistency. Approximately half of the people who take up commitment contracts for higher gym attendance also take up commitment contracts for lower gym attendance. There is little association between commitment contract take-up and reduced-form and structural estimates of actual or perceived time inconsistency. A novel information treatment providing an exogenous shock to awareness of time inconsistency reduces demand for commitment contracts. Structural estimates of a model of quasi-hyperbolic discounting and gym attendance imply that offering our commitment contracts lowers consumer surplus, and is less socially efficient than utilizing linear exercise subsidies that achieve the same average change in behavior.

10.3386/w26161.abstractZh: 本文探讨了以自我施加的选择限制和惩罚形式出现的承诺契约，是否是一种有效的工具，可用于解决自我控制问题。在一项关于健身房出勤率的实验中（样本量为1,248人），我们研究了承诺契约的采纳情况，并引入了一项单独的调查任务，以识别实际和感知的时间不一致性。对于更高的健身房出勤率，承诺契约的采纳率很高，这导致了锻炼量的显著增加。然而，这种采纳率受到噪声估值和对时间不一致性的错误认知的影响。大约一半采用承诺契约以提高健身房出勤率的人，也会采用承诺契约来降低出勤率。承诺契约的采纳与实际或感知的时间不一致性的减少形式和结构估计之间几乎没有关联。一种新颖的信息处理方法，通过提供外生冲击来影响对时间不一致性的认知，可以减少对承诺契约的需求。关于准超线性折扣和健身房出勤率的模型结构估计表明，提供我们的承诺契约会降低消费者剩余，并且不如使用线性锻炼补贴那样在社交效率上更优，后者能够实现相同的行为变化。

abstract.text: Debates over whether and when to recommend screening for a potential disease focus on the causal impact of screening for a typical individual covered by the recommendation, who may differ from the typical individual who responds to the recommendation. We explore this distinction in the context of recommendations that breast cancer screening start at age 40. The raw data suggest that responders to the age 40 recommendation have less cancer than do women who self-select into screening at earlier ages. Combining these patterns with a clinical oncology model allows us to infer that responders to the age 40 recommendation also have less cancer than women who never screen, suggesting that the benefits of recommending early screening are smaller than if responders were representative of covered individuals. For example, we estimate that shifting the recommendation from age 40 to age 45 results in over three times as many deaths if responders were randomly drawn from the population than under the estimated patterns of selection. These results highlight the importance of considering the characteristics of responders when making and designing recommendations.

10.3386/w26162.abstractZh: 关于是否以及何时推荐筛查潜在疾病的讨论，主要集中在接受推荐服务的典型个体因筛查而受到的因果影响上，这些典型个体可能与响应推荐的典型个体有所不同。我们在40岁开始乳腺癌筛查的建议背景下探讨这一区别。原始数据表明，响应40岁开始筛查建议的女性，其癌症发病率低于那些在更早年龄自行选择接受筛查的女性。结合临床肿瘤学模型，我们可以推断，响应40岁开始筛查建议的女性，其癌症发病率也低于从未接受筛查的女性，这表明推荐早期筛查的好处不如那些被推荐者能够代表接受筛查的个体的情况下那么显著。例如，我们估计，如果将推荐年龄从40岁改为45岁，如果响应者是从人群中随机选取的，那么死亡人数将比根据现有选择模式估计的情况多出三倍以上。这些结果强调了在制定和设计建议时考虑响应者特征的重要性。

abstract.text: We use machine learning as a tool to study decision making, focusing specifically on how physicians diagnose heart attack. An algorithmic model of a patient’s probability of heart attack allows us to identify cases where physician testing decisions deviate from predicted risk. We then use actual health outcomes to evaluate whether those deviations represent mistakes or physicians’ superior knowledge. This approach reveals two inefficiencies. Physicians over-test: predictably low-risk patients are tested, but do not benefit. At the same time, physicians undertest: predictably high-risk patients are left untested, and then go on to suffer adverse health events including death. A natural experiment using shift-to-shift testing variation confirms these findings. Simultaneous over- and under-testing cannot easily be explained by incentives alone, and instead point to systematic errors in judgment. We provide suggestive evidence on the psychology underlying these errors. First, physicians use too simple a model of risk. Second, they overweight factors that are salient or representative of heart attack, such as chest pain. We argue health care models must incorporate physician error, and illustrate how policies focused solely on incentive problems can produce large inefficiencies.

10.3386/w26168.abstractZh: 我们运用机器学习作为工具来研究决策过程，特别关注医生如何诊断心脏病发作。通过构建患者心脏病发作概率的算法模型，我们能够识别出医生诊断决策与预测风险存在偏差的情况。随后，我们通过实际的健康结果来评估这些偏差是错误还是医生具有的卓越知识。这种方法揭示了两个效率低下的问题：医生过度诊断：风险较低的患者被诊断，但却无法从中受益；同时，医生也未能对高风险患者进行全面诊断，导致这些患者遭受不良健康事件，甚至死亡。一项使用连续检测方法的自然实验证实了这些发现。同时出现过度诊断和诊断不足的现象，很难仅用激励机制来解释，而是表明存在系统性的判断错误。我们提供了一些关于这些错误背后心理机制的线索：首先，医生使用的风险模型过于简单；其次，他们过于重视那些与心脏病发作相关的因素，如胸痛。我们认为，医疗模型必须考虑医生判断中的错误，并说明仅关注激励问题的政策会导致严重的效率低下。

abstract.text: This paper uses a difference-in-difference approach to examine the impact of California's hospital closures occurring from 1995-2011 on adjusted inpatient mortality for time-sensitive conditions: sepsis, stroke, asthma/chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and acute myocardial infarction (AMI). Outcomes of admissions in hospital service areas (HSAs) with and without closure(s) are compared before and after the closure year. The paper focuses on: 1) the differential impacts of rural and urban closures, 2) the aggregate patient-level impact across several post-closure mechanisms, and 3) the effect on Medicare as well as non-Medicare patients. Results suggest that when treatment groups are not differentiated by hospital rurality, closures appear to have no measurable impact, i.e. there is no general impact of closures. However, estimating differential impacts shows that rural closures increase inpatient mortality by 0.78% points (an increase of 8.7%), whereas urban closures have no measurable impact. Subgroup analyses indicate the existence of a general impact for stroke and AMI patients (4.4% increase in inpatient mortality) and relatively worse impacts of rural closures for Medicaid patients and racial minorities (11.3% and 12.6%, respectively).

10.3386/w26182.abstractZh: 本文采用差异-差异方法，研究1995年至2011年间加利福尼亚州医院关闭对时间敏感疾病患者死亡率的影响，这些疾病包括败血症、中风、哮喘/慢性阻塞性肺病以及急性心肌梗死。研究比较了有和没有医院关闭的医疗服务区域在关闭年份前后的住院情况。研究重点包括：1）农村和城市关闭的不同影响；2）关闭后多种机制对整体患者的影响；3）对医疗保险患者和非医疗保险患者的影响。研究结果表明，当治疗组不根据医院的地理位置进行区分时，关闭似乎没有可测量的影响。然而，通过估计差异影响后发现，农村关闭使住院死亡率增加了0.78个百分点（即增加了8.7%），而城市关闭则没有可测量的影响。子组分析表明，中风和急性心肌梗死患者的住院死亡率普遍增加了4.4%，而农村关闭对医疗补助患者和少数族裔患者的负面影响更为严重，分别增加了11.3%和12.6%。

abstract.text: There have been dozens of high-profile mass shootings in recent decades. This paper presents three main findings about the impact of mass shootings on gun policy. First, mass shootings evoke large policy responses. A single mass shooting leads to a 15% increase in the number of firearm bills introduced within a state in the year after a mass shooting. This effect increases with the extent of media coverage. Second, mass shootings account for a small portion of all gun deaths, but have an outsized influence relative to other homicides. Third, when looking at bills that were actually enacted into law, the impact of mass shootings depends on the party in power. The annual number of laws that loosen gun restrictions doubles in the year following a mass shooting in states with Republican-controlled legislatures. We find no significant effect of mass shootings on laws enacted when there is a Democrat-controlled legislature, nor do we find a significant effect of mass shootings on the enactment of laws that tighten gun restrictions.

10.3386/w26187.abstractZh: 近几十年来，发生了数十起引人注目的大规模枪击事件。本文提出了关于大规模枪击事件对枪支政策影响的三个主要发现。首先，大规模枪击事件会引发大规模的政策反应。一次大规模枪击事件会导致事发后一年内某个州提出的枪支相关法案数量增加15%。这种影响随着媒体报道的广泛程度而加剧。其次，大规模枪击事件虽然占所有枪支死亡案例的比例很小，但其对其他类型凶杀案的影响却非常显著。第三，当观察实际成为法律的法案时，大规模枪击事件的影响取决于执政党的情况。在共和党控制的立法机构所在的州，大规模枪击事件发生后的一年内，放宽枪支限制的法律数量会翻倍。我们发现，在民主党控制的立法机构下，大规模枪击事件对法律制定的影响并不显著，同样，大规模枪击事件对加强枪支限制的法律制定的影响也不显著。

abstract.text: Antimicrobial use in animal agriculture contributes to antimicrobial resistance in humans, which imposes significant health and economic costs on society. These costs are negative externalities. We review the relevant literature and develop a model to quantify the external costs of antimicrobial use in animal agriculture on antimicrobial resistance in humans. Parameters required for this estimate include: 1) the health and economic burden of antimicrobial resistance in humans, 2) the impact of antimicrobial use in animal agriculture on antimicrobial resistance in animals, 3) the fraction of antimicrobial resistance in humans attributable to animal agriculture, and 4) antimicrobial use in animals. We use a well-documented historic case to estimate an externality cost of about $1500 per kilogram of fluoroquinolones administered in US broiler chicken production. Enhanced data collection, particularly on parameters 3) and 4), would be highly useful to quantify more fully the externalities of antimicrobial use in animal agriculture.

10.3386/w26189.abstractZh: 在动物农业中使用的抗菌剂会导致人类出现抗菌素耐药性，这对社会造成了重大的健康和经济负担。这些成本属于负外部性。我们回顾了相关文献，并开发了一个模型来量化动物农业中抗菌剂使用对人类抗菌素耐药性的外部成本。进行这一估算所需的参数包括：1）人类抗菌素耐药性的健康和经济负担；2）动物农业中抗菌剂使用对动物抗菌素耐药性的影响；3）人类抗菌素耐药性中可归因于动物农业的比例；4）动物中抗菌剂的使用情况。我们以一个有充分记录的历史案例为例，估算出在美国肉鸡生产中每使用一公斤氟喹诺酮类药物所产生的外部成本约为1500美元。加强数据收集，特别是关于参数3）和4）的数据收集，将有助于更全面地量化动物农业中抗菌剂使用的外部性。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) expanded the availability of public health insurance, decreasing the relative benefit of participating in disability programs but also lowering the cost of exiting the labor market to apply for disability program benefits. In this paper, we explore the impact of expanded access to Medicaid through the ACA on applications to the Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and Social Security Disability Income (SSDI) programs. Using the fact that the Supreme Court decision of June 2012 made the Medicaid expansion optional for the states, we compare changes in county-level SSI and SSDI caseloads in contiguous county pairs across a state border. We find no significant effects of the Medicaid expansion on applications or awards to either SSI or SSDI, and can reject economically meaningful impacts of Medicaid expansions on applications to disability programs.

10.3386/w26192.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》扩大了公共健康保险的覆盖范围，虽然这降低了参与残疾项目的相对收益，但也降低了劳动力市场中申请残疾项目福利的成本。在本文中，我们探讨了通过《平价医疗法案》扩大医疗补助覆盖范围对补充保障收入计划和社会安全残疾收入计划申请情况的影响。鉴于2012年6月最高法院的裁决使得医疗补助的扩大成为各州的选项，我们比较了跨州边界的相邻县对补充保障收入和社会安全残疾收入计划申请数量的变化。我们发现，医疗补助的扩大对这两种计划的申请或福利金额没有显著影响，并且可以排除医疗补助扩大对残疾项目申请产生有意义的经济影响。

abstract.text: We establish four facts concerning competition among U.S. generic drug suppliers, using IQVIA’s National Sales Perspective™ 2004Q4 – 2016Q3 data. We define a unique product market (“molform”), consisting of the combination of a molecule active ingredient and a route of administration formulation, aggregated over different dosages and strengths. We find: (i) supply exhibits substantial churning in entrants and exits; (ii) volume-weighted use concentrates in older generic molform cohorts; (iii) the extent of competition is greatest for the oldest molform cohorts and is smallest for the youngest molform cohorts. With a median of one competitor, the extent of competition in the youngest molform cohort is very limited; and (iv) supplier-molform annual revenues are typically small, are largest for relatively young drugs, but are heavily right skewed. These four facts provide an empirical platform on which to construct and empirically evaluate hypotheses regarding generic drug market structure, performance, and possible policy reforms.

10.3386/w26194.abstractZh: 我们利用IQVIA的National Sales Perspective™ 2004Q4 – 2016Q3数据，确定了美国仿制药供应商之间的竞争情况，共确定了四个事实。我们定义了一个独特的产品市场——“molform”，它由一种活性成分与一种给药途径的组合构成，并涵盖不同的剂量和规格。研究发现：(i) 供应商数量在市场中呈现显著的增减变化；(ii) 按使用量加权后，仿制药的使用主要集中在较老的molform产品上；(iii) 竞争程度在较老的molform产品中最高，而在较新的molform产品中最低。在较新的molform产品中，平均只有一位竞争对手，竞争程度非常有限；(iv) 供应商的molform产品年收入通常较低，但在相对较新的药物中最高，且收入分布严重右偏。这四项事实为构建和验证关于仿制药市场结构、性能及可能的政策改革的假设提供了实证基础。

abstract.text: The support for scientific investigation in biomedicine depends in part on the adoption of new knowledge into medical practice. We investigate how a technological advance, in the form of a large and influential 2010 randomized controlled study, changed physician practice in statin (a medication used to manage high cholesterol levels) prescribing. We analyze data representative of the Italian population for the period 2003-2014. Our analysis accounts for possible non-random sorting of patients into treatment. We show that both doctors and patients responded promptly to this technological shock, changing the mix of patients who received therapy, drug dosing, and frequency of testing for side effects, as well as patient adherence to therapy. The results show that investments in scientific knowledge can rapidly diffuse into practice in professions where continuing education is the norm.

10.3386/w26202.abstractZh: 生物医学领域对科学研究的支持部分依赖于将新知识应用于医疗实践。我们研究了2010年一项规模较大且具有影响力的随机对照研究这一技术进步如何改变了医生在他汀类药物（用于管理高胆固醇水平的药物）处方方面的实践。我们分析了2003年至2014年期间意大利人口的相关数据。我们的分析考虑到了患者可能被非随机地分配到不同治疗组的情况。结果显示，医生和患者都迅速对这一技术变革做出了反应，改变了接受治疗的患者比例、药物剂量以及副作用检测的频率，同时也影响了患者对治疗的依从性。研究结果表明，在继续教育为常态的职业中，对科学知识的投资能够迅速转化为实践成果。

abstract.text: To assess ways to achieve widespread health insurance coverage with financial solvency in developing countries, we designed a randomized experiment involving almost 6,000 households in Indonesia who are subject to a nationally mandated government health insurance program. We assessed several interventions that simple theory and prior evidence suggest could increase coverage and reduce adverse selection: substantial temporary price subsidies (which had to be activated within a limited time window and lasted for only a year), assisted registration, and information. Both temporary subsidies and assisted registration increased initial enrollment. Temporary subsidies attracted lower-cost enrollees, in part by eliminating the practice observed in the no subsidy group of strategically timing coverage for a few months during health emergencies. As a result, while subsidies were in effect, they increased coverage more than eightfold, at no higher unit cost; even after the subsidies ended, coverage remained twice as high, again at no higher unit cost. However, the most intensive (and effective) intervention – assisted registration and a full one-year subsidy – resulted in only a 30 percent initial enrollment rate, underscoring the challenges to achieving widespread coverage.

10.3386/w26204.abstractZh: 为了评估在发展中国家实现广泛健康保险覆盖的方法，同时保证财务可持续性，我们在印度尼西亚设计了一项随机实验，涉及近6,000户家庭，这些家庭都参加了国家政府规定的健康保险计划。我们评估了几种干预措施，根据简单理论和先前证据，这些措施能够增加保险覆盖范围并减少逆向选择问题：大规模的临时价格补贴（必须在有限的时间内实施，且仅持续一年）、协助登记以及提供信息。无论是临时补贴还是协助登记，都能增加初始参保人数。临时补贴吸引了成本较低的参保者，部分原因是消除了无补贴组在健康紧急情况下战略性地推迟保险覆盖几个月的做法。因此，在补贴实施期间，保险覆盖范围增加了八倍，且单位成本没有上升；即使补贴结束后，保险覆盖范围仍然保持为补贴实施前的两倍，单位成本同样没有上升。然而，最密集且最有效的干预措施——协助登记和为期一年的全额补贴——仅使初始参保率提高了30%，这凸显了实现广泛覆盖所面临的挑战。

abstract.text: The practice of burning agricultural waste is ubiquitous around the world, yet the external human capital costs from those fires have been underexplored. Using data from the National College Entrance Examination (NCEE) and agricultural fires detected by high-resolution satellites in China during 2005 to 2011, this paper investigates the impacts of fires on cognitive performance. To address the endogeneity of agricultural fires, we differentiate upwind fires from downwind fires. We find that a one-standard-deviation increase in the difference between upwind and downwind fires during the exam decreases the total exam score by 1.42 percent of a standard deviation (or 0.6 point), and further decreases the probability of getting into first-tier universities by 0.51 percent of a standard deviation.

10.3386/w26205.abstractZh: 燃烧农业废弃物的行为在全球范围内普遍存在，然而这些火灾对人类资本成本的负面影响却尚未得到充分研究。本文利用2005至2011年中国全国高考数据以及高分辨率卫星检测到的农业火灾数据，探讨了火灾对认知表现的影响。为了处理农业火灾的内生性问题，我们将上风方向的火灾与下风方向的火灾进行了区分。研究发现，考试期间上风方向和下风方向火灾差异每增加一个标准差，总考试分数就会减少1.42个百分点（或0.6分），同时进入一流大学的概率也会减少0.51个百分点。

abstract.text: We study risky behavior of adolescents. Concentrating on smoking and alcohol use, we structurally estimate a dynamic social interaction model in the context of students' school networks included in the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health (Add Health). The model allows for forward-looking behavior of agents, addiction effects, and social interactions in the form of preferences for conformity in the social network. We find strong evidence for forward looking dynamics and addiction effects. We also find that social interactions in the estimated dynamic model are quantitatively large. A misspecified static model would fit data substantially worse, while producing a much smaller estimate of the social interaction effect. With the estimated dynamic model, a temporary shock to students' preferences in the 10th grade has effects on their behavior in grades 10, 11, 12, with estimated social multipliers 1:53, 1:03, and 0:76, respectively. The multiplier effect of a permanent shock is much larger, up to 3:7 in grade 12. Moreover (semi-) elasticities of a permanent change in the availability of alcohol or cigarettes at home on child risky behavior implied by the dynamic equilibrium are 25%, 63%, and 79%, in grades 10, 11, 12, respectively.

10.3386/w26223.abstractZh: 我们研究了青少年的风险行为。重点关注吸烟和饮酒行为，我们在《全国青少年健康纵向研究》中构建了一个动态社会互动模型，该模型考虑了学生学校网络的影响。该模型允许行为主体具有前瞻性行为，并考虑了成瘾效应以及以社会网络中遵从性偏好形式出现的社交互动。我们发现前瞻性行为和成瘾效应具有显著特征。此外，我们发现在所构建的动态模型中，社交互动的影响程度相当显著。如果采用一个误设的静态模型，数据拟合效果会显著恶化，同时社交互动效应的估计值也会大幅降低。通过所构建的动态模型，对十年级学生偏好的临时冲击会对其在十、十一、十二年级的行为产生影响，其社会乘数效应分别约为1:53、1:03和0:76。对于永久性冲击，乘数效应更大，在十二年级可达3:7。此外，家庭环境中酒精或香烟可获得性的永久性变化对青少年风险行为的（半）弹性系数分别为10年级25%、11年级63%和12年级79%。

abstract.text: Beyond a handful of studies examining early-adopting states in the early 1990s, little is known about the causal eﬀects of mandatory waiting periods for abortion. In this study we evaluate the eﬀects of a Tennessee law enacted in 2015 that requires women to make an additional trip to abortion providers for state-directed counseling at least 48 hours before they can obtain an abortion. Our diﬀerence-in-diﬀerences and synthetic-control estimates indicate that the introduction of the mandatory waiting period caused a 48–73 percent increase in the share of abortions obtained during the second trimester. Our analysis examining overall abortion rates is less conclusive but suggests a reduction caused by the waiting period. Putting these estimates into context, our back-of-the-envelope calculations indicate that Tennessee’s MWP increased the monetary costs of obtaining an abortion by as much as $929 for some women.

10.3386/w26228.abstractZh: 在20世纪90年代初仅有少数研究关注早期采用该政策的州，关于强制等待期对堕胎的因果效应知之甚少。本研究评估了2015年田纳西州的一项法律的影响，该法律要求女性在堕胎前至少48小时前往堕胎机构接受州政府指导。我们的差异比较和合成控制估计表明，强制等待期的引入导致第二孕期堕胎的比例增加了48%至73%。我们对整体堕胎率的分析虽然结论不那么明确，但表明等待期确实导致了堕胎率的下降。将这些估计结果纳入背景考虑，我们的粗略计算表明，田纳西州的强制等待期使得一些女性堕胎的货币成本增加了高达929美元。

abstract.text: Several cities in the U.S. have implemented taxes on sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs) in an attempt to improve public health and raise revenue. On July 1, 2017, Oakland California introduced a tax of one cent per ounce on SSBs. In this paper, we estimate the impact of the tax on retail prices, product availability, purchases, and child and adult consumption of taxed beverages in Oakland, as well as of potential substitute beverages. We collected data from Oakland stores and their customers and a matched group of stores in surrounding counties and their customers. We collected information in the months prior to the implementation of the tax and again a year later on: (1) prices, (2) purchase information from customers exiting the stores, and (3) a follow-up household survey of adults and child beverage purchases and consumption. We use a difference-in-differences identification strategy to estimate the impact of the tax on prices, purchases, and consumption of taxed beverages. We find that roughly 60 percent of the tax was passed on to consumers in the form of higher prices. There was a slight decrease in the volume of SSBs purchased per shopping trip in Oakland and a small increase in purchases at stores outside of the city, and we find some evidence of increased shopping by Oakland residents at stores outside of the city. We do not find evidence of substantial changes in the overall consumption of SSBs or of added sugars consumed through beverages for either adults or children after the tax.

10.3386/w26233.abstractZh: 美国一些城市已经对含糖饮料征收税收，旨在改善公共健康并增加财政收入。2017年7月1日，加利福尼亚州奥克兰开始对含糖饮料征收每盎司一美分的税收。本文我们估算了这项税收对奥克兰含糖饮料零售价格、产品供应、购买行为以及儿童和成人对含糖饮料的消费的影响，同时也研究了潜在替代品的消费情况。我们收集了奥克兰商店及其顾客的数据，以及周边县商店及其顾客的数据。我们在税收实施前的几个月以及一年后再次收集了以下信息：（1）价格；（2）顾客离开商店时的购买信息；（3）对成人和儿童饮料购买及消费情况的后续家庭调查。我们使用差异识别策略来估算税收对含糖饮料价格、购买行为和消费的影响。研究发现，大约60%的税收以更高的价格形式转嫁给了消费者。奥克兰居民每次购物时购买的含糖饮料数量略有减少，而在城市外的商店购买量则略有增加，我们还发现奥克兰居民在城市外商店的购物频率有所提高。我们没有发现税收后成人或儿童整体含糖饮料消费或饮料中添加糖分摄入量有显著变化。

abstract.text: We propose leave-out estimators of quadratic forms designed for the study of linear models with unrestricted heteroscedasticity. Applications include analysis of variance and tests of linear restrictions in models with many regressors. An approximation algorithm is provided that enables accurate computation of the estimator in very large datasets. We study the large sample properties of our estimator allowing the number of regressors to grow in proportion to the number of observations. Consistency is established in a variety of settings where plug-in methods and estimators predicated on homoscedasticity exhibit first-order biases. For quadratic forms of increasing rank, the limiting distribution can be represented by a linear combination of normal and non-central χ² random variables, with normality ensuing under strong identification. Standard error estimators are proposed that enable tests of linear restrictions and the construction of uniformly valid confidence intervals for quadratic forms of interest. We find in Italian social security records that leave-out estimates of a variance decomposition in a two-way fixed effects model of wage determination yield substantially different conclusions regarding the relative contribution of workers, firms, and worker-firm sorting to wage inequality than conventional methods. Monte Carlo exercises corroborate the accuracy of our asymptotic approximations, with clear evidence of non-normality emerging when worker mobility between blocks of firms is limited.

10.3386/w26244.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种用于研究具有无限制异方差性的线性模型的二次型省略估计量。该估计量的应用包括方差分析以及在许多回归变量模型中检验线性约束。我们提供了一种近似算法，使得在非常大的数据集中也能准确计算该估计量。我们研究了该估计量在大样本下的性质，允许回归变量的数量随着观测数量的增加而成比例增长。在多种情况下，我们证明了该估计量的一致性，而在那些基于同方差性假设的插入方法和估计量表现出一阶偏差的情况下，该估计量仍然表现出良好的性能。对于秩逐渐增加的二次型，其极限分布可以表示为正态和非中心χ²随机变量的线性组合，并且在强识别条件下保持正态性。我们提出了标准误差估计量，这些估计量能够用于检验线性约束，并构建对感兴趣二次型具有一致有效性的置信区间。我们在意大利社会保障记录中发现，在双固定效应模型中，对方差分解的省略估计在关于工人、企业和工人-企业排序对工资不平等的相对贡献方面，与传统方法相比得出了截然不同的结论。蒙特卡洛模拟验证了我们的渐近近似的准确性，当工人在企业集团之间的流动性受到限制时，出现了非正态性的明显证据。

abstract.text: Grim national statistics about the U.S. opioid crisis are increasingly well known to the American public. Far less well known is that U.S. war veterans are at ground zero of the epidemic, facing an overdose rate twice that of civilians. Post-9/11 deployments to Afghanistan and Iraq have exposed servicemembers to injury-related chronic pain, psychological trauma, and cheap opium supplies, each of which may fuel opioid addiction. This study is the first to estimate the causal impact of combat deployments in the Global War on Terrorism on opioid abuse. We exploit a natural experiment in overseas deployment assignments and find that combat service substantially increased the risk of prescription painkiller abuse and illicit heroin use among active duty servicemen. War-related physical injuries, death-related battlefield trauma, and Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder emerge as primary mechanisms. The magnitudes of our estimates imply lower-bound combat exposure-induced health care costs of $1.04 billion per year for prescription painkiller abuse and $470 million per year for heroin use.

10.3386/w26264.abstractZh: 关于美国阿片类药物危机的 grim 统计数据已经广为人知。但鲜为人知的是，美国退伍军人正是这一危机的最前线，他们的过量用药率是普通民众的两倍。9·11事件后，美军被派往阿富汗和伊拉克，这些军人面临着与战斗相关的慢性疼痛、心理创伤以及廉价的鸦片供应，这些因素都可能引发阿片类药物成瘾。本研究首次估算了全球反恐战争中的战斗部署对阿片类药物滥用的影响。我们通过一项海外部署的自然实验发现，战斗经历显著增加了现役军人滥用处方止痛药和非法使用海洛因的风险。与战斗相关的身体伤害、与死亡相关的战场创伤以及创伤后应激障碍被认为是主要机制。我们的估算结果显示，战斗暴露导致的处方止痛药滥用每年可能造成10.4亿美元的医疗费用，而海洛因滥用则每年可能造成4.7亿美元的医疗费用。

abstract.text: Primary care physicians (PCPs) provide frontline health care to patients in the U.S.; however, it is unclear how their practice styles affect patient care. In this paper, we estimate the long-lasting effects of PCP practice styles on patient health care utilization by focusing on Medicare patients affected by PCP relocations or retirements, which we refer to as "exits." Observing where patients receive care after these exits, we estimate event studies to compare patients who switch to PCPs with different practice style intensities. We find that PCPs have large effects on a range of aggregate utilization measures, including physician and outpatient spending and the number of diagnosed conditions. Moreover, we find that PCPs have large effects on the quality of care that patients receive, and that all of these effects persist for several years. Our results suggest that switching to higher-quality PCPs could significantly affect patients' longer-run health outcomes.

10.3386/w26269.abstractZh: 在美国，初级保健医生为患者提供一线医疗服务。然而，他们的执业风格如何影响患者护理效果尚不清楚。本文通过研究因初级保健医生调任或退休而受到影响的患者，即所谓的“离职”患者，来估计其执业风格对患者医疗利用的长期影响。通过观察患者在离职后接受护理的地点，我们进行了事件研究，比较了转向不同执业风格强度初级保健医生的患者情况。研究发现，初级保健医生对一系列综合利用指标有显著影响，包括医生和门诊支出以及诊断出的疾病数量。此外，我们发现初级保健医生对患者所接受护理的质量也有显著影响，而这些影响会持续数年。我们的结果表明，转向更高质量的初级保健医生可能会显著影响患者的长期健康结果。

abstract.text: Oversubscribed treatments are often allocated using randomized waiting lists. Applicants are ranked randomly, and treatment offers are made following that ranking until all seats are filled. To estimate causal effects, researchers often compare applicants getting and not getting an offer. We show that those two groups are not statistically comparable. Therefore, the estimator arising from that comparison is inconsistent when the number of waitlists goes to infinity. We propose a new estimator, and show that it is consistent, provided the waitlists have at least two seats. Finally, we revisit an application, and we show that using our estimator can lead to significantly different results from those obtained using the commonly used estimator.

10.3386/w26282.abstractZh: 超额供应的治疗项目通常通过随机等待列表来分配。申请者会被随机排序，并根据该排序顺序提供治疗机会，直到所有名额都被填满。为了估计因果效应，研究人员通常会比较获得治疗机会和未获得治疗机会的申请者。我们发现，这两组申请者在统计上不可比。因此，当等待列表的数量趋于无穷大时，基于这种比较的估计方法就不一致了。我们提出了一种新的估计方法，并证明只要等待列表至少有两个名额，该方法就是一致的。最后，我们重新审视了一个应用案例，并发现使用我们的估计方法可以得到与常用估计方法显著不同的结果。

abstract.text: Insurance markets often feature consumer sorting along both an extensive margin (whether to buy) and an intensive margin (which plan to buy). We present a new graphical theoretical framework that extends the workhorse model to incorporate both selection margins simultaneously. A key insight from our framework is that policies aimed at addressing one margin of selection often involve an economically meaningful trade-off on the other margin in terms of prices, enrollment, and welfare. For example, while a larger penalty for opting to remain uninsured reduces the uninsurance rate, it also tends to lead to unraveling of generous coverage because the newly insured are healthier and sort into less generous plans, driving down the relative prices of those plans. While risk adjustment transfers shift enrollment from lower- to higher-generosity plans, they also sometimes increase the uninsurance rate by raising the prices of less generous plans, which are the entry points into the market. We illustrate these trade-offs in an empirical sufficient statistics approach that is tightly linked to the graphical framework. Using data from Massachusetts, we show that in many policy environments these trade-offs can be empirically meaningful and can cause these policies to have unexpected consequences for overall social welfare.

10.3386/w26288.abstractZh: 保险市场通常呈现出消费者在广泛边际（是否购买）和密集边际（选择哪种计划）上的选择行为。我们提出了一个新的图形理论框架，该框架扩展了传统模型，同时考虑了这两种选择边际。我们的框架的一个关键洞察是，旨在解决某一选择边际的政策往往会在另一边际上产生经济意义上的权衡，这些权衡涉及价格、参保率和福利等方面。例如，对选择保持无保险状态的更大惩罚虽然降低了无保险率，但也会导致慷慨的保险计划变得不那么吸引人，因为新参保的人更健康，会选择较不慷慨的保险计划，从而降低这些计划的相对价格。虽然风险调整将参保率从较低慷慨度的计划转移到较高慷慨度的计划，但有时也会通过提高较不慷慨计划的成本来增加无保险率，而这些计划正是进入市场的起点。我们通过一个与图形框架紧密相连的实证充分统计量方法来说明这些权衡。利用马萨诸塞州的数据，我们发现在许多政策环境下，这些权衡具有实际意义，并且可能导致这些政策对整体社会福利产生意想不到的影响。

abstract.text: We use comprehensive patient-level discharge data to study the effect of Medicaid on the use of hospital services. Our analysis relies on cross-state variation in the Affordable Care Act’s Medicaid expansion, along with within-state variation across ZIP Codes in exposure to the expansion. We find that the Medicaid expansion increased Medicaid visits and decreased uninsured visits. The net effect is positive for all visits, suggesting that those who gain coverage through Medicaid consume more hospital services than they would if they remained uninsured. The increase in emergency department visits is largely accounted for by “deferrable” medical conditions. Those who gained coverage under the Medicaid expansion appear to be those who had relatively high need for hospital services, suggesting that the expansion was well targeted. Lastly, we find significant heterogeneity across Medicaid-expansion states in the effects of the expansion, with some states experiencing a large increase in total utilization and other states experiencing little change. Increases in hospital utilization were larger in Medicaid-expansion states that had more residents gaining coverage and lower pre-expansion levels of hospital uncompensated care costs.

10.3386/w26289.abstractZh: 我们利用全面的患者出院数据来研究医疗补助对医院服务使用的影响。我们的分析基于《平价医疗法案》医疗补助扩展在各州之间的差异，以及各州内不同邮政编码区在医疗补助扩展影响下的差异。我们发现，医疗补助扩展增加了医疗补助就诊次数，减少了无保险患者的就诊次数。总体而言，这种效应是积极的，表明通过医疗补助获得保险的人比无保险的人消费更多的医院服务。急诊就诊次数的增加主要归因于“可推迟”的医疗状况。那些在医疗补助扩展下获得保险的人似乎对医院服务的需求相对较高，这表明该扩展措施的目标定位较为精准。最后，我们发现不同医疗补助扩展州在扩展效果上存在显著的异质性，有些州的医院使用量大幅增加，而另一些州的医院使用量几乎没有变化。在医疗补助扩展州，医院使用量的增加幅度更大，这些州的居民获得保险的比例更高，且扩展前的医院无补偿护理成本也较低。

abstract.text: Medicare is a large government health insurance program in the United States which covers about 60 million people. This paper analyzes the effects of Medicare insurance on health for a group of people in urgent need of medical care: people with cancer. We used a regression discontinuity design to assess impacts of near-universal Medicare insurance at age 65 on cancer detection and outcomes, using population-based cancer registries and vital statistics data. Our analysis focused on the three tumor sites for which screening is recommended both before and after age 65: breast, colorectal, and lung cancer. At age 65, cancer detection increased by 72 per 100,000 population among women and 33 per 100,000 population among men; cancer mortality also decreased by 9 per 100,000 population for women but did not significantly change for men. In a placebo check, we found no comparable changes at age 65 in Canada. This study provides the first evidence to our knowledge that near-universal access to Medicare at age 65 is associated with improvements in population-level cancer mortality and provides new evidence on the differences in the impact of health insurance by gender.

10.3386/w26292.abstractZh: Medicare是美国的一项大型政府健康保险计划，覆盖约6000万人。本文分析了Medicare保险对急需医疗护理的人群——癌症患者健康的影响。我们采用回归不连续设计，利用基于人口数据的癌症登记和生命统计数据，评估在65岁时几乎全民都能享受Medicare保险对癌症检测及治疗效果的影响。我们的研究重点关注三种在65岁之前和之后都建议进行筛查的肿瘤类型：乳腺癌、结直肠癌和肺癌。在65岁时，女性癌症检测率增加了72例/10万人，男性则增加了33例/10万人；男性癌症死亡率则下降了9例/10万人，但男性数据并未出现显著变化。在加拿大进行安慰剂对照时，我们并未发现类似的改变。据我们所知，这项研究首次证明了在65岁时几乎全民都能享受Medicare与人群层面的癌症死亡率下降之间存在关联，并为不同性别在健康保险影响上的差异提供了新的证据。

abstract.text: We quantify the role of population aging in the structural transformation process. Household-level data from the U.S. show that the fraction of expenditures devoted to services increases with household age. We use a shift-share decomposition and a quantitative model to show that U.S. population aging accounted for about a fifth of the observed increase in the service share in consumption between 1982 and 2016. The contribution of population aging to the rise in the service share is about the same size as the contribution of real income growth, and about half as large as that of changes in relative prices.

10.3386/w26327.abstractZh: 我们量化了人口老龄化在结构转型过程中的作用。来自美国的家庭层面数据显示，用于服务的支出比例随家庭年龄的增加而上升。我们通过位移分解法和定量模型分析发现，1982年至2016年间，美国人口老龄化因素占消费中服务份额增加量的约五分之一。人口老龄化对服务份额上升的贡献与实际收入增长的贡献相当，约为相对价格变化贡献的一半。

abstract.text: Pharmaceutical companies market to physicians through individual detailing accompanied by monetary or in-kind transfers. Large compensation payments to a small number of physicians account for most of this promotional spending. Studying US promotional payments and prescriptions for anticoagulant drugs, we investigate how peer inﬂuence broadens the payments’ reach. Following a compensation payment, prescriptions for the marketed drug increase by both the paid physician and the paid physician’s peers. Payments increase prescriptions to both recommended and contraindicated patients. Over three years, marketed anticoagulant prescriptions rose 23 percent due to payments, with peer spillovers contributing a quarter of the increase.

10.3386/w26338.abstractZh: 制药公司通过个人详细信息以及金钱或实物转移的方式向医生进行营销。对少数医生进行大额补偿支付是这种促销支出的主要来源。本研究通过研究美国的促销支付和抗凝药物的处方情况，探讨了同行影响如何扩大支付的范围。在支付完成后，所推销药物的处方数量不仅增加了被支付医生的处方数量，也增加了被支付医生同行的处方数量。支付行为使得推荐患者和禁忌患者的处方数量都有所增加。在三年期间，由于支付行为，抗凝药物的处方数量增加了23%，其中同行影响贡献了四分之一的增长幅度。

abstract.text: We provide some of the first empirical evidence of maternal and fetal health effects of working during pregnancy by using a unique dataset from the New Jersey Department of Health that includes information not only on pregnancy and birth outcomes but also on maternal employment. We match the mother’s occupation with the Metabolic Equivalent of Task, provided by the Census Occupational Classification System and used as a measure for the strenuousness of the work activities performed. We find robust evidence that working in a relatively more strenuous job during pregnancy raises the likelihood of fetal macrosomia by about 1.5 percentage points. There are no statistically or economically significant effects on other birth outcomes. Our study further indicates an under-studied link between gestational diabetes (a known risk factor for fetal macrosomia) and intensive physical activities at work during pregnancy, potentially mediated by disrupted sleep due to greater work intensity.

10.3386/w26343.abstractZh: 我们通过使用新泽西州卫生部提供的数据集，首次提供了关于孕妇工作对母婴健康影响的实证证据。该数据集不仅包含妊娠和分娩结果的信息，还包含孕妇的就业情况。我们将母亲的职业与由人口普查职业分类系统提供的任务代谢当量进行了匹配，该指标用于衡量工作活动的强度。研究发现，在妊娠期间从事相对强度较高的工作，会使胎儿巨大儿的发生率增加约1.5个百分点。其他分娩结果方面，未发现统计学或经济意义上的显著影响。我们的研究进一步表明，妊娠糖尿病（已知的胎儿巨大儿风险因素）与妊娠期间高强度体力活动之间存在关联，这种关联可能由工作强度增加导致的睡眠中断所介导。

abstract.text: Health insurance in the United States for the working age population has traditionally been provided in the form of employer-sponsored health insurance (ESHI). If employers offered ESHI to their employees, they also typically extended coverage to their spouse and dependents. Provisions in the Affordable Care Act (ACA) significantly alter the incentive for firms to offer insurance to the spouses of employees. We evaluate the long-run impact of ACA on firms’ insurance offerings and on household outcomes by developing and estimating an equilibrium job search model in which multiple household members are searching for jobs. The distribution of job offers is determined endogenously, with compensation packages consisting of a wage and menu of insurance offerings (premiums and coverage) that workers select from. Using our estimated model we find that households’ valuation of employer-sponsored spousal health insurance is significantly reduced under ACA, and with an “employee-only” health insurance contract emerging among low productivity firms. We relate these outcomes to the specific provisions in the ACA.

10.3386/w26350.abstractZh: 美国的劳动年龄人口健康保险传统上以雇主提供健康保险的形式存在。如果雇主为员工提供健康保险，他们通常会将其覆盖范围扩展到配偶和受抚养人。《平价医疗法案》的条款显著改变了企业向员工配偶提供保险的动机。我们通过开发并估计一个均衡求职模型来评估《平价医疗法案》对企业保险提供行为及家庭结果的长期影响。该模型假设多个家庭成员都在寻找工作，职位分配由内生因素决定，薪酬包括工资以及企业提供的各种保险选项（保费和保险范围）。根据我们估计的模型，我们发现《平价医疗法案》实施后，家庭对雇主提供配偶健康保险的重视程度显著降低，同时低生产力企业开始采用“仅限员工”的健康保险合同。我们将这些结果与《平价医疗法案》的具体条款联系起来进行分析。

abstract.text: Prior work considers effects of prescribing restrictions on opioid use but not upstream implications for pharmaceutical marketing activities, despite the inordinate role many believe marketing played in the crisis. Our study proposes a stylized model of pharmaceutical payments and investigates the impact of Mandatory Access Prescription Drug Monitoring Programs (MPDMPs) on opioid-specific commercial promotion directed at physicians. We find that MPDMPs reduce promotion on both extensive and intensive margins. Our results are consistent with economic theory, predicting lower promotional activities when return on investment decreases after state prescribing restrictions, and indicative of MPDMPs' role in affecting opioid use through reduced promotion.

10.3386/w26356.abstractZh: 先前的研究探讨了处方限制对阿片类药物使用的影响，但并未考虑对药品营销活动的影响。尽管许多人认为营销在危机中发挥了重要作用，但现有研究并未对此进行探讨。我们的研究提出了一个药品支付的标准化模型，并研究了强制处方药品监控计划对针对医生的阿片类药物商业推广的影响。我们发现，强制处方药品监控计划减少了各种规模的推广活动。我们的研究结果与经济理论一致，表明当州级处方限制后的投资回报下降时，推广活动会减少，这表明强制处方药品监控计划在减少推广活动方面对阿片类药物使用的影响。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of the State Innovation Models (SIM) on population-level health status. The SIM initiative provided $250 million to six states in 2013 for delivery system reforms. We use data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System for the years 2010 -- 2016 to compare health of the populations in 6 SIM states to 15 states that were not involved in any aspects of SIM. We examine changes in health using an event study design. We develop a Latent Class Profile model that takes multiple measures of latent health into a common, latent health status to study the effect of the intervention. Such models can yield informative estimates where separate estimation of measures do not. We find that individuals in states that implemented SIM saw significant improvements in health across a number policy-relevant subpopulations.

10.3386/w26360.abstractZh: 我们研究了国家创新模式对人口健康状况的影响。2013年，国家创新模式计划向六个州提供了2.5亿美元用于医疗体系改革。我们利用2010至2016年的行为风险因素监测系统数据，比较了六个实施国家创新模式的州与未参与该计划的15个州的居民健康状况。我们通过事件研究设计来考察健康状况的变化。我们开发了一个潜在类别剖面模型，将多个潜在健康指标合并为一个共同的潜在健康状态，以研究干预措施的效果。这样的模型能够提供更全面的估计结果，而单独估计各个指标则难以获得完整信息。研究发现，在实施国家创新模式的州中，多个与政策相关的子群体的健康状况都得到了显著改善。

abstract.text: In this paper, we estimate the impacts of abortion clinic closures on access to clinics in terms of distance and congestion, abortion rates, and birth rates. Legislation regulating abortion providers enacted in Wisconsin in 2011-2013 ultimately led to the closure of two of five abortion clinics in Wisconsin, increasing the average distance to the nearest clinic to 55 miles and distance to some counties to over 100 miles. We use a difference-in-differences design to estimate the effect of change in distance to the nearest clinic on birth and abortion rates, using within-county variation across time in distance to identify the effect. We find that a hundred-mile increase in distance to the nearest clinic is associated with 25 percent fewer abortions and 4 percent more births. We see no significant effect of increased congestion at remaining clinics on abortion rates. We find significant racial disparities in who is most affected by abortion clinic closures, with increases in distance increasing birth rates significantly more for Black, Asian, and Hispanic women. Our results suggest that even small numbers of clinic closures can result in significant restrictions to abortion access of similar magnitude to those seen in Texas when a greater number of clinics closed their doors.

10.3386/w26362.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们评估了堕胎诊所关闭对诊所可及性、堕胎率和出生率的影响。2011-2013年间，威斯康星州通过的相关立法导致该州五家堕胎诊所中的两家关闭，使得最近的诊所平均距离增加到55英里，某些县的距离甚至超过100英里。我们采用差异-差异设计来估计距离最近诊所的变化对出生率和堕胎率的影响，并通过不同县随时间变化的诊所距离来识别这种影响。研究发现，距离最近诊所增加100英里会导致堕胎次数减少25%，出生率增加4%。我们并未发现剩余诊所的拥挤程度对堕胎率有显著影响。我们还发现，堕胎诊所关闭对不同种族群体的影响存在显著差异，距离增加对黑人、亚裔和西班牙裔女性的出生率影响更为显著。我们的研究结果表明，即使只有少数诊所关闭，也可能导致与德州类似程度的堕胎权利限制，而德州的情况是当更多诊所关闭时才会出现这种情况。

abstract.text: Over the past 30 years, the criteria used to diagnose many illnesses have been relaxed, resulting in millions more relatively healthy individuals receiving treatment. This paper explores the impact of receiving a diagnosis of a common disease among such “marginally ill” patients. We apply a regression discontinuity design to the cutoff in blood sugar levels used to classify patients as having diabetes. We find that a marginally diagnosed patient with diabetes spends $1,097 more on drugs and diabetes-related care annually after diagnosis, but find no corresponding changes in self-reported health or healthy behaviors. These increases in spending persist over the 6-year period we observe the patients. These marginally diagnosed patients experience improved blood sugar after the first year of diagnosis, but this improvement does not persist in subsequent years. Other clinical measures of health, such as BMI, blood pressure, cholesterol, and mortality show no improvement. The diagnosis rates for preventable disease-related conditions such as diabetic retinopathy, neuropathy, and kidney disease increase following a diagnosis, likely due to more intensive screening. Our results imply that a small relaxation in the diagnosis cutoff would increase total spending on diabetes-related care by about $2.4 billion annually and minimally impact patient health.

10.3386/w26363.abstractZh: 在过去的30年里，用于诊断许多疾病的标准有所放宽，导致数百万相对健康的人接受了治疗。本文探讨了被诊断出常见疾病对这些“边缘性患病”患者的影响。我们采用回归不连续设计来研究用于分类糖尿病患者的血糖水平 cutoff值。研究发现，被诊断为糖尿病的患者在诊断后每年在药物和糖尿病相关护理上的支出增加1,097美元，但自我报告的健康状况或健康行为并未出现相应的变化。这些支出的增加在我们观察患者的6年期间持续存在。这些边缘性患病患者在诊断后的第一年内血糖水平有所改善，但这种改善在后续年份并未持续。其他临床健康指标，如BMI、血压、胆固醇和死亡率，均未显示出改善。诸如糖尿病视网膜病变、神经病变和肾脏疾病等可预防的疾病相关疾病的诊断率在诊断后有所上升，这可能是由于筛查更加严格所致。我们的研究结果表明，对诊断标准的轻微放宽每年将使糖尿病相关护理的总支出增加约24亿美元，而对患者健康的影响微乎其微。

abstract.text: Since the landmark ruling in Goodridge v. Department of Public Health in 2004, the legalization of same-sex marriage (SSM) has proliferated throughout the United States via either legislative action or court order. Advocates of SSM laws argue that marriage equality will generate important health benefits not only for adult same-sex couples, but also for LGBQ-identifying youths. Using data from the State Youth Risk Behavior Surveys, we explore the relationship between marriage equality and suicidal behaviors among LGBQ-identifying youths. Despite previous research suggesting otherwise, we find little evidence that SSM laws have reduced suicide attempts among teen sexual minorities, nor have they decreased the likelihood of suicide planning, suicide ideation, or depression. Instead, we find some evidence that SSM legalization via judicial mandate is associated with worse mental health for these individuals, consistent with a story of social backlash.

10.3386/w26364.abstractZh: 自2004年Goodridge v. Department of Public Health案的里程碑性裁决以来，同性婚姻合法化已通过立法或法院命令在美国各地广泛推行。支持同性婚姻法律的人士认为，婚姻平等不仅能为成年同性伴侣带来重要的健康益处，也能为LGBQ身份认同的年轻人带来好处。我们利用州级青少年风险行为调查的数据，探讨了婚姻平等与LGBQ身份认同的年轻人自杀行为之间的关系。尽管先前的研究表明情况并非如此，但我们发现几乎没有证据表明同性婚姻法律减少了青少年性少数群体的自杀企图，也没有降低自杀计划、自杀念头或抑郁情绪的发生概率。相反，我们发现通过司法强制力实现同性婚姻合法化与这些个体的心理健康状况恶化有关，这与社会反制的观点一致。

abstract.text: Public programs frequently use observable characteristics of recipients, such as income, to target benefits. We show theoretically that when the provision of the subsidized good is decentralized to intermediaries with market power, targeting of subsidies induces a “demographic externality” that can distort the incidence and efficiency of public transfers. We examine this possibility empirically in the context of means-tested subsidies for privately-provided health insurance under the Affordable Care Act (ACA). We estimate that the overall incidence of premium subsidies on consumers in ACA Marketplaces is less than 50 percent, and a third of net government spending on premium subsidies is a deadweight loss. Market power in the presence of means-tested subsidies leads to regressive redistribution, lowering consumer surplus and rates of insurance in the poorer population targeted by subsidies. Under sufficiently high social preferences for redistribution, however, means-tested subsidies still dominate income-invariant transfers.

10.3386/w26367.abstractZh: 公共项目经常利用受助者的可观察特征，如收入，来分配福利。我们从理论上表明，当补贴商品的提供被分散到具有市场力量的中间商手中时，补贴的定向分配会引发“人口外部性”，从而扭曲公共转移的分配和效率。我们在《平价医疗法案》下对私人提供的健康保险补贴进行实证分析，发现ACA市场中的保费补贴对消费者的总体影响不到50%，而政府用于保费补贴的支出中有三分之一是无效支出。在存在基于经济状况的补贴的情况下，市场力量会导致再分配效应递减，从而降低受补贴人群的消费剩余和保险覆盖率。然而，如果社会对于再分配有较高的偏好，基于经济状况的补贴仍然会占据主导地位，即使这些补贴与收入无关。

abstract.text: Does childhood health capital affect long-run labor market success? We address this question using inpatient hospital admission records linked to population census records. Sibling fixed effects estimates indicate that in comparison to their brothers, boys with health deficiencies were more likely to experience downward occupational mobility relative to their father’s occupational rank. This decline in occupational success across generations can be decomposed into a lower likelihood of attaining white collar status and a higher likelihood of working in unskilled jobs, which translated into lower occupational wages on average. Evidence indicates that a lower school attendance rate and higher rates of disability in both childhood and adulthood are plausible mechanisms for our findings.

10.3386/w26368.abstractZh: 童年健康资本是否会影响长期的劳动力市场表现？我们通过将住院记录与人口普查记录相结合来探讨这个问题。兄弟姐妹固定效应估计表明，与兄弟相比，有健康缺陷的男孩在职业晋升方面表现较差，其职业地位低于父亲。这种代际间的职业成功下降可以分解为两种因素：获得白领职位的可能性较低，以及从事非技术工作的可能性较高，这导致他们的平均职业工资较低。研究结果表明，童年时期较低的学校出勤率和成年后较高的残疾率可能是导致我们研究结果的原因。

abstract.text: We use temperature variation within narrowly-defined geographic and demographic cells to show that exposure to extreme heat increases the risk of maternal hospitalization during pregnancy for potentially life-threatening causes. We find that this effect is driven by women residing in historically cooler rather than hotter counties, suggesting that adaptation plays a role in mitigating the health impacts of weather shocks. We also find that the heat-induced deterioration in maternal pregnancy health is larger for black than for white mothers, suggesting that projected increases in extreme heat over the next century may further exacerbate the black-white maternal health gap.

10.3386/w26384.abstractZh: 我们通过分析特定地理和人口统计区域内的温度变化，发现暴露于极端高温会增加孕妇因潜在致命原因而住院的风险。研究发现，这种影响主要出现在那些历史上气温较低的县，这表明适应性的作用在缓解天气冲击对健康的负面影响方面起着重要作用。此外，我们还发现，高温对黑人母亲孕期健康的损害程度比白人母亲更为严重，这表明未来一个世纪极端高温的加剧可能会进一步扩大黑人与白人母亲之间的健康差距。

abstract.text: Developing countries increasingly use biometric identification technology in hopes of improving the reliability of administrative information and delivering social services more efficiently. This paper exploits the random placement of biometric tracking devices in tuberculosis treatment centers in urban slums across four Indian states to measure their effects both on disease control and on the quality of health records. The devices record health worker attendance and patient adherence to treatment, and they automatically generate prompts to follow up with patients who miss doses. Combining data from patient and health worker surveys, independent field visits, and government registers, we first find that patients enrolled at biometric-equipped centers are 25 percent less likely to interrupt treatment—an improvement driven by increased attendance and efforts by health workers and greater treatment adherence by patients. Second, biometric tracking decreases data forgery: it reduces overreporting of patient numbers in both NGO data and government registers and underreporting of treatment interruptions. Third, the impact of biometric tracking is sustained over time and it decreases neither health worker satisfaction nor patient satisfaction. Overall, our results suggest biometric tracking technology is both an effective and sustainable way to improve the state's capacity to deliver healthcare in challenging areas.

10.3386/w26388.abstractZh: 发展中国家越来越多地使用生物识别技术，以期提高行政信息的可靠性并更高效地提供社会服务。本文通过研究印度四个州城市贫民窟结核病治疗中心中生物识别设备的随机分布，来评估这些设备对疾病控制以及健康记录质量的影响。这些设备记录了卫生工作者的出勤情况以及患者治疗依从性，并自动生成提醒，以跟进错过治疗剂量的患者。结合患者和卫生工作者调查的数据、独立的现场访问以及政府登记资料，我们发现：在配备生物识别设备的中心接受治疗的患者，中断治疗的可能性降低了25%——这一改进主要得益于卫生工作者出勤率的提高以及患者治疗依从性的增强。其次，生物识别跟踪减少了数据伪造现象：它减少了非政府组织数据和政府登记中的患者数量报告过多，同时也减少了治疗中断的漏报。第三，生物识别跟踪的效果具有长期性，且不会降低卫生工作者和患者的满意度。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，生物识别跟踪技术是一种有效且可持续的方式，能够提升政府在困难地区提供医疗服务的能力。

abstract.text: Since 2017, many U.S. cities have implemented taxes on sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs) to decrease consumption of sugary beverages and raise revenue. In this paper, we analyze household receipt data to examine the impact of SSB taxes on households’ purchases of taxed and untaxed beverages in the four largest U.S. cities with such taxes: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania; San Francisco, California; Seattle, Washington; and Oakland, California. We estimate the impact of these taxes by comparing changes in monthly household purchases in the treatment cities to changes in one of two comparison groups: 1) areas adjacent to the treatment cities; or 2) a matched set of households nationally. We find that an increase in the beverage tax rate of 1 cent per ounce decreases household purchases of taxed beverages by 53.0 ounces per month or 12.2 percent. This impact is small in magnitude and consistent with a reduction in individual consumption of 5 calories per day per household member and eventual reduction in weight of 0.5 pounds. When we examine results separately by city, we find that the decline was concentrated in Philadelphia, where the tax decreased purchases by 27.7 percent. We do not find impacts of the taxes in the other three cities combined.

10.3386/w26393.abstractZh: 自2017年以来，许多美国城市开始对含糖饮料征税，以减少含糖饮料的消费并增加税收收入。本文通过分析家庭收入数据，研究了含糖饮料税对这四个实施此类税项的美国最大城市的家庭购买行为的影响：宾夕法尼亚州的费城、加利福尼亚州的旧金山、华盛顿州的西雅图以及加利福尼亚州的奥克兰。我们通过比较处理城市与两个对照组的家庭月购买量变化来估算这些税项的影响：1）处理城市周边的地区；2）全国范围内的一组匹配家庭。研究发现，饮料税率每盎司增加1美分，家庭每月购买含糖饮料的数量减少53.0盎司，降幅为12.2%。这一影响幅度较小，与每户家庭成员每天减少5卡路里的消费以及最终体重减少0.5磅的情况一致。当我们分别按城市分析结果时，发现这一下降主要集中在费城，该城市的税收使购买量减少了27.7%。而在其他三个城市，我们没有发现税收的综合影响。

abstract.text: This paper provides novel evidence of the unintended health effects stemming from the halt in nuclear power production after the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear accident. After the accident, nuclear power stations ceased operation and nuclear power was replaced by fossil fuels, causing an increase in electricity prices. We find that this increase led to a reduction in energy consumption, which caused an increase in mortality during very cold temperatures, given the protective role that climate control plays against the elements. Our results contribute to the debate surrounding the use of nuclear as a source of energy by documenting a yet unexplored health benefit from using nuclear power, and more broadly to regulatory policy approaches implemented during periods of scientific uncertainty about potential adverse effects.

10.3386/w26395.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于福岛第一核电站事故后停止核能生产所带来的非预期健康影响的新的证据。事故发生后，核电站停止运行，核能被化石燃料取代，导致电价上涨。我们发现，这一价格上涨导致能源消耗减少，而在极寒天气条件下，能源消耗减少反而导致了死亡率的增加，因为气候调节在抵御恶劣环境方面具有保护作用。我们的研究结果有助于探讨将核能作为能源来源的争议，并记录了核能使用所带来的尚未被充分探索的健康益处。此外，这些结果也为在科学对潜在不良影响存在不确定性的时期制定监管政策提供了参考。

abstract.text: Evidence of patient and physician turnover in accountable care organizations (ACOs) has raised concerns that ACOs may be earning shared-savings bonuses by selecting for lower-risk patients or providers with lower-risk panels. We conducted three sets of analyses to examine risk selection in the Medicare Shared Savings Program. First, we estimated overall MSSP savings through 2015 using a difference-in-differences approach and methods that eliminated selection bias from ACO program exit or changes in the practices or physicians included in ACO contracts. We then checked for residual risk selection at the patient level. Second, we re-estimated savings with methods that address undetected risk selection but could introduce bias from other sources. These included patient fixed effects, baseline assignment, and area-level MSSP exposure to hold patient populations constant. Third, we tested for changes in provider composition or provider billing that may have contributed to bonuses, even if they were eliminated as sources of bias in the evaluation analyses. We find that MSSP participation was associated with modest and increasing annual gross savings in the 2012-2013 entry cohorts of ACOs that reached $139-302/patient by 2015. Savings in the 2014 entry cohort were small and not statistically significant. Robustness checks revealed no evidence of residual risk selection. Alternative methods to address risk selection produced consistent results but were less robust than our primary analysis, suggesting the introduction of bias from within-patient changes in time-varying characteristics. We find no evidence of ACO manipulation of provider composition or billing to inflate savings. We further demonstrate that exit of high-risk patients or physicians with high-risk patients from ACOs is misleading without considering a counterfactual among non-ACO practices. We conclude that participation in the original MSSP program was associated with modest savings and not with favorable risk selection. These findings suggest an opportunity to build on early progress. Understanding the effect of new incentives and opportunities for risk selection in the revamped MSSP will be important for guiding future program reforms.

10.3386/w26403.abstractZh: 有证据表明，在问责护理组织中，患者和医生的流动现象引起了关注。这些组织可能通过选择风险较低的患者或医生来赚取共享节约奖金。我们进行了三组分析，以研究Medicare共享节约计划中的风险选择问题。首先，我们使用差异-差异方法估算了截至2015年的整体共享节约金额，并采用了消除选择偏差的方法，以避免因ACO项目退出或ACO合同中包含的医生或实践的变化而产生的偏差。然后，我们检查了患者层面的剩余风险选择问题。其次，我们重新估算了节约金额，采用了能够解决未被发现的风险选择问题的方法，但这些方法可能会引入其他来源的偏差。这些方法包括患者固定效应、基线分配以及区域级别的共享节约金额暴露，以保持患者群体的稳定性。第三，我们测试了医生组成或医生账单的变化是否可能促成奖金的发放，即使这些因素在评估分析中被排除为偏差来源。我们发现，参与共享节约计划的ACO在2012-2013年的入组队列中，年度总节约金额有所上升，到2015年达到了139-302美元/患者。2014年入组队列的节约金额较小，且没有统计学意义。稳健性检验显示没有剩余风险选择的证据。其他解决风险选择问题的方法也产生了一致的结果，但比我们的主要分析更为不稳定，这表明可能存在来自患者随时间变化的特征的偏差。我们没有发现ACO操纵医生组成或账单来虚增节约金额的证据。我们进一步证明，不考虑非ACO实践中的反事实情况，将高风险患者或医生从ACO中剔除是具有误导性的。我们得出结论，参与最初的MSSP计划与适度的节省成本相关，而非与有利的风险选择相关。这些发现表明，有机会在早期进展的基础上继续发展。了解在改进后的MSSP中新的激励措施和风险选择机会的影响，对于指导未来的项目改革至关重要。

abstract.text: The ACA requires insurers to provide cost-sharing reductions (CSRs) to low-income consumers on the marketplaces. We link 2013-2015 All-Payer Claims Data to 2004-2013 administrative hospital discharge data from Utah and exploit policy-driven differences in the value of CSRs that are solely determined by income. We find that enrollees with lower cost sharing have higher levels of health care spending, controlling for past health care use. We estimate the demand elasticity of total health care spending to be -0.10, but find larger elasticities for emergency room care, lifestyle drugs, and low-value care. We also find positive cross-price elasticities between outpatient and inpatient care.

10.3386/w26430.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》要求保险公司向市场中的低收入消费者提供费用分担减免。我们将2013-2015年的全保险公司索赔数据与犹他州2004-2013年的医院出院行政数据进行了关联，并分析了政策导致的费用分担减免价值的差异，这些差异完全由收入决定。我们发现，在控制过去医疗使用情况的前提下，费用分担较少的参保者医疗支出水平更高。我们估计总医疗支出的需求弹性为-0.10，但发现急诊护理、生活方式相关药物和低价值护理的弹性更大。我们还发现门诊和住院护理之间存在正向的跨价格弹性关系。

abstract.text: Nascent research suggests intergenerational health mobility may be relatively high and non-genetic factors may make room for policy intervention. This project broadens this direction by considering heterogeneous intergenerational health mobility in spatial and contextual patterns. With 14,797 parent-child pairs from a school-based representative panel survey of adolescents (Add Health), this study finds large spatial variation in intergenerational health mobility in the United States. On average relative mobility in this sample is approximately 0.17 and expected health rank for children of parents at the 25th percentile of parent health is 47. These metrics however mask substantial spatial heterogeneity. In cases of low health mobility, rank-rank slopes can approach 0.5 or expected child health rank may only be the 34th percentile. Descriptive school- and contextual-level correlates of this spatial variation indicate localities with higher proportions of non-Hispanic blacks, school PTAs, or a school health education requirement may experience greater health mobility.

10.3386/w26442.abstractZh: 初步研究表明，代际健康流动的可能性相对较高，非遗传因素可能为政策干预提供了空间。本项目通过考虑不同代际健康流动在空间与情境上的差异，进一步扩展了这一研究方向。本研究基于一项针对青少年的学校代表性调查（Add Health），收集了14,797对父母与子女的数据，发现美国代际健康流动存在显著的空间差异。平均而言，样本中的相对流动程度约为0.17，而处于父母健康处于第25百分位的儿童的预期健康排名仅为47。然而，这些指标掩盖了实质性的空间异质性。在健康流动较低的情况下，排名与排名之间的斜率可能接近0.5，或者儿童的预期健康排名可能仅处于第34百分位。描述性分析表明，学校环境和情境因素对这种空间差异有显著影响：非西班牙裔黑人比例较高、学校家长教师协会活动较多或学校设有健康教育要求的地区，其代际健康流动程度可能更高。

abstract.text: We use data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS) for the years 2004 - 2012 to examine the impact of economic shocks on the family’s out-of-pocket health care spending burden. We define this burden as the share of family income devoted to out-of-pocket health care spending. In contrast to static, cross-sectional analyses, our study examines how the within-family change in spending burden over the two-year MEPS observation period responds to losses in family income, insurance, and employment. We also consider the impact of such losses on single-mother and two-parent families. To do so, we apply fractional response and health expenditure models using the correlated random effects (CRE) method to control for time-invariant, unobserved heterogeneity across family units. We find evidence that the change in the out-of-pocket spending burden is sensitive to income shocks, and that income changes rather than changes in health spending per se appears to drive changes in the out-of-pocket burden.

10.3386/w26443.abstractZh: 我们利用了2004至2012年的医疗支出面板调查数据，来研究经济冲击对家庭自付医疗费用负担的影响。我们将这一负担定义为家庭收入中用于自付医疗支出的比例。与静态的横向分析不同，我们的研究考察了在两年时间跨度内，家庭内部支出负担的变化如何响应家庭收入、保险和就业状况的变动。我们还考虑了这些变动对单亲家庭和双亲家庭的影响。为此，我们采用了分数响应和健康支出模型，并利用相关随机效应方法来控制不同家庭单位之间的时间不变性与非观测异质性。我们发现，自付医疗支出的变化对收入冲击非常敏感，而且收入的变化而非医疗支出的变化似乎才是驱动自付负担变化的主要因素。

abstract.text: Over the past decades, health insurers have developed payment reforms, with the goal of rewarding quality over quantity. While these reforms may add value, they require providers to gather more information on patient health conditions, which is costly. We evaluate the role of costs and revenues in coding intensity for Medicare inpatients. We consider costs by estimating hospitals’ changes in coding intensity following a 2007 reform that increased coding complexity. Hospitals with Electronic Medical Records (EMRs) reported 1.25 percentage points more high bill codes immediately after the reform, with the increase only for non-surgical admissions, consistent with the hypotheses that coding costs became an important determinant of coding and EMRs lowered these costs, particularly for medical admissions. Turning to revenues, we examine whether increased reimbursements from reporting high bill codes led hospitals to report more such codes. Before the reform, a one-unit increase in the DRG weight spread between high and low bill codes was associated with 0.63 percentage points more high codes, with no positive association after the reform, suggesting that hospitals base their coding less on revenues after the reform. We develop a simple model that ties the results together and offers one coherent way to reconcile the cost and revenue findings. Our findings imply that recent payment innovations might add cost to providers.

10.3386/w26455.abstractZh: 在过去的几十年里，健康保险公司进行了支付改革，目的是以质量而非数量作为奖励标准。虽然这些改革可能增加了价值，但它们要求医疗服务提供者收集更多关于患者健康状况的信息，这成本较高。我们评估了Medicare住院患者编码强度中成本和收入的作用。通过估算医院在2007年改革后编码强度的变化，我们研究了成本问题。拥有电子病历的医院在改革后立即报告了1.25个百分点的高账单代码，且这一增长仅发生在非手术住院患者中，这与编码成本成为编码重要决定因素的假设一致，而电子病历则降低了这些成本，尤其是在医疗住院患者中。至于收入方面，我们研究了报告高账单代码所带来的补偿增加是否促使医院报告更多此类代码。在改革之前，高账单代码与低账单代码之间的DRG权重差异每增加一个单位，高账单代码的数量就会增加0.63个百分点，而在改革后则没有这种正相关性，这表明改革后医院在编码时较少依赖收入因素。我们建立了一个简单的模型，将各项结果联系起来，并提供了一种协调成本和收入发现的方法。我们的研究结果表明，最近的支付创新可能会给医疗服务提供者带来额外的成本。

abstract.text: There are two salient facts about health care in low and middle-income countries; 1) the private sector plays an important role and 2) the care provided is often of poor quality. Despite these facts we know little about what drives quality of care in the private sector and why patients continue to seek care from poor quality providers. We use two field studies in India that provide unique insight into this issue. First, we use a discrete choice experiment to show that patients are willing to pay higher prices for better technical quality (defined by correct treatment and correct diagnosis). Second, we use standardized patients to show that private providers who provide better technical quality are not able to charge higher prices. Instead providers are able to charge higher prices for elements of quality that the patient can observe (good patient interactions and more effort), which are less important for health outcomes. Taken together, this research highlights a market inefficiency and suggests that engaging patients with accessible information on technical quality of the providers in their community could shift demand to providers that provide better care and thus improve health outcomes.

10.3386/w26460.abstractZh: 关于低收入和中等收入国家的医疗保健，有两个显著的事实：1) 私营部门发挥着重要作用；2) 所提供的医疗服务质量往往较差。尽管有这些事实，我们对私营部门医疗服务质量的驱动因素以及为什么患者仍愿意从质量较差的医疗服务提供者那里获得服务知之甚少。我们在印度进行了两项实地研究，为这一问题提供了独特的见解。首先，我们通过离散选择实验表明，患者愿意支付更高的价格以获得更好的技术质量（即正确的治疗和诊断）。其次，我们通过标准化患者实验发现，提供更好技术质量的私营医疗服务提供者无法收取更高的价格。相反，这些提供者能够因一些患者可以观察到的质量要素（如良好的医患互动和更多的努力）而收取更高的价格，而这些要素对健康结果的影响较小。综合来看，这项研究揭示了市场中的低效现象，并建议通过向患者提供有关其所在社区医疗服务提供者技术质量的详细信息，可以促使需求转向提供更好服务的提供者，从而改善健康结果。

abstract.text: Physicians, judges, teachers, and agents in many other settings differ systematically in the decisions they make when faced with similar cases. Standard approaches to interpreting and exploiting such differences assume they arise solely from variation in preferences. We develop an alternative framework that allows variation in both preferences and diagnostic skill, and show that both dimensions may be identified in standard settings under quasi-random assignment. We apply this framework to study pneumonia diagnoses by radiologists. Diagnosis rates vary widely among radiologists, and descriptive evidence suggests that a large component of this variation is due to differences in diagnostic skill. Our estimated model suggests that radiologists view failing to diagnose a patient with pneumonia as more costly than incorrectly diagnosing one without, and that this leads less-skilled radiologists to optimally choose lower diagnostic thresholds. Variation in skill can explain 39 percent of the variation in diagnostic decisions, and policies that improve skill perform better than uniform decision guidelines. Failing to account for skill variation can lead to highly misleading results in research designs that use agent assignments as instruments.

10.3386/w26467.abstractZh: 在许多其他领域，医生、法官、教师以及代理人在面对类似案例时做出的决策存在系统性差异。传统的研究方法认为，这种差异仅源于偏好上的差异。我们提出了一种替代框架，该框架允许偏好和诊断技能都存在差异，并表明在准随机分配的情况下，这两个维度都可以在标准设置中被识别。我们将这一框架应用于放射科医生对肺炎的诊断研究。不同放射科医生之间的诊断率存在很大差异，描述性证据表明，这种差异在很大程度上是由于诊断技能的差异造成的。我们的模型估计表明，放射科医生认为未能诊断出肺炎的患者比错误诊断一个没有肺炎的患者代价更大，这使得技能较低的放射科医生选择较低的诊断阈值。技能差异可以解释诊断决策差异的39%，而改善技能的政策比统一的决策指南表现得更好。如果未能考虑技能差异，那么在使用代理人分配作为工具的研究设计中，可能会导致高度误导性的结果。

abstract.text: There is increasing interest in expanding Medicare health insurance coverage in the U.S., but it is not clear whether the current program is the right foundation on which to build. Traditional Medicare covers a uniformset of benefits for all income groups and provides more generous access to providers and new treatments than public programs in other developed countries. We develop an economic framework to assess the efficiency and equity tradeoffs involved with reforming this generous, uniform structure. We argue that three major shifts make a uniform design less efficient today than when Medicare began in 1965. First, rising income inequality makes it more difficult to design a single plan that serves the needs of both higher- and lower-income people. Second, the dramatic expansion of expensive medical technology means that a generous program increasingly crowds out other public programs valued by the poor and middle class. Finally, as medical spending rises, the tax-financing of the system creates mounting economic costs and increasingly untenable policy constraints. These forces motivate reforms that shift towards a more basic public benefit that individuals can “top-up” with private spending. If combined with an increase in other progressive transfers, such a reform could improve efficiency and reduce public spending while benefiting low income populations.
