10.3386/w26472.abstractZh: 美国对于扩大医疗保险覆盖范围的兴趣日益增加，但目前该计划是否是一个合适的改革基础尚不清楚。传统的医疗保险为所有收入群体提供统一的福利，并且比其他发达国家公共项目更能够让人们获得更优质的医疗服务和新的治疗方法。我们建立了一个经济框架来评估改革这一统一结构所带来的效率和公平之间的权衡。我们认为，有三个主要因素使得统一设计在当今比1965年实施医疗保险时效率更低。首先，收入不平等的加剧使得设计一项能够同时满足高收入和低收入人群需求的单一计划变得更加困难。其次，昂贵的医疗技术的广泛应用意味着，一个慷慨的医疗保险计划会越来越多地挤占穷人和中产阶级所重视的其他公共项目。最后，随着医疗支出的增加，税收对医疗系统的支持带来了不断上升的经济成本，同时也使得政策约束变得越来越难以承受。这些因素促使人们进行改革，转向一种更基础的公共福利体系，个人可以通过私人支出来补充这种福利。如果这种改革与其他渐进式的转移支付相结合，就可以提高效率，减少公共支出，同时惠及低收入人群。

abstract.text: Hoynes, Miller and Simon (2015), henceforth HMS, report that the national expansion of the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) is associated with decreases in low birth weight. We question their findings. HMS’s difference-in-differences estimates are unidentified in some comparisons, while failed placebo tests undermine others. Their effects lack a plausible mechanism as the association between the EITC and prenatal smoking also fails placebo tests. We contend that the waning of the crack epidemic is a possible confound, but we show that any number of policies directed at poor women also eliminate the effect of the EITC when aggregated to the national level. Identifying small, causal effects of a national policy at a single point in time is exceedingly challenging.

10.3386/w26476.abstractZh: Hoynes、Miller和Simon（2015年）的研究表明，全国范围内扩大劳动收入税收抵免政策的实施与低出生体重率的下降有关。我们对他们的研究结果提出了质疑。HMS的研究在部分比较中未能识别出差异效应，而失败的安慰剂测试也削弱了其他结果的可靠性。他们研究中的效应缺乏合理的机制解释，因为劳动收入税收抵免与产前吸烟之间的关联同样未能通过安慰剂测试得到验证。我们认为，毒品泛滥的减少可能是一个混杂因素，但我们发现，任何针对贫困女性的政策，在汇总到全国层面时，都会消除劳动收入税收抵免的效果。在单一时间点识别国家政策的微小因果效应是非常具有挑战性的。

abstract.text: According to Troesken (2004), efforts to purify municipal water supplies at the turn of the 20th century dramatically improved the relative health of blacks. There is, however, little empirical evidence to support the Troesken hypothesis. Using city-level data published by the U.S. Bureau of the Census for the period 1906-1938, we explore the relationship between water purification efforts and the black-white infant mortality gap. Our results suggest that, while water filtration was effective across the board, adding chlorine to the water supply reduced mortality only among black infants. Specifically, chlorination is associated with an 11 percent reduction in black infant mortality and a 13 percent reduction in the black-white infant mortality gap. We also find that chlorination led to a substantial reduction in the black-white diarrhea mortality gap among children under the age of 2, although this estimate is measured with less precision.

10.3386/w26489.abstractZh: 根据Troesken（2004）的研究，20世纪初对市政供水系统的净化努力显著改善了黑人的健康状况。然而，几乎没有实证证据支持Troesken的假设。我们利用美国人口普查局提供的1906-1938年间的城市级数据，探讨了供水净化努力与黑人与白人婴儿死亡率差距之间的关系。研究结果表明，虽然水过滤措施在整体上有效，但向水中添加氯仅降低了黑人婴儿的死亡率。具体而言，氯化处理使黑人婴儿死亡率降低了11%，同时黑人与白人婴儿死亡率的差距也缩小了13%。我们还发现，氯化处理显著降低了2岁以下儿童黑人与白人之间的腹泻死亡率差距，尽管这一数据的精确度较低。

abstract.text: The multi-decade growth and spatial dispersion of immigrant families in the United States has shifted the composition of US schools, reshaping the group of peers with whom students age through adolescence. US-born students are more likely to have foreign-born peers and foreign-born students are more likely to be educated outside of enclaves. This study examines the short-term and long-term impact of being educated with immigrant peers, for both US-born and foreign-born students. We leverage a quasi-experimental research design that uses across-grade, within-school variation in cohort composition for students in the Add Health study. We describe effects on a broad set of education, social, and health outcomes. For US-born students, we find little evidence that having immigrant peers affects a wide array of outcomes, either in adolescence or in adulthood. For foreign-born students, attending school with other immigrant students is protective against risky health behaviors and social isolation, relative to native born students. However, foreign-born students’ language skills measured with Picture-Vocabulary Test scores are negatively affected by attending school with a larger share of other immigrant students. The negative effect on vocabulary scores persists through young adulthood but does not translate into reductions in most longer-run socioeconomic outcomes, including earnings or the economic status of their residential neighborhoods.

10.3386/w26491.abstractZh: 美国移民家庭的数十年增长和空间分散改变了美国学校的构成，重塑了学生青少年时期与同龄人的关系。美国出生的学生更有可能拥有外国出生的同龄人，而外国出生的学生则更有可能在远离移民聚居区的环境中接受教育。本研究探讨了与移民同龄人一起接受教育对美国出生和外国出生学生产生的短期和长期影响。我们采用准实验研究设计，利用Add Health研究中的年级间和校内同龄人构成差异来进行分析。我们发现，在广泛的教育、社会和健康结果方面，与移民同龄人一起接受教育对美国出生的学生几乎没有影响，无论是在青少年时期还是成年后。对于外国出生的学生来说，与其他移民学生一起上学有助于避免危险的健康行为和社会孤立。然而，通过Picture-Vocabulary测试得分衡量的外国出生学生的语言技能，在与其他移民学生一起上学的情况下会受到负面影响。这种对词汇得分的负面影响会持续至青年时期，但并不会导致大多数长期的社会经济结果恶化，包括收入或居住社区的经济状况。

abstract.text: Overdose deaths involving opioids have increased dramatically since the mid-1990s, leading to the worst drug overdose epidemic in U.S. history, but there is limited empirical evidence on the initial causes. In this paper, we examine the role of the 1996 introduction and marketing of OxyContin as a potential leading cause of the opioid crisis. We leverage cross-state variation in exposure to OxyContin’s introduction due to a state policy that substantially limited OxyContin’s early entry and marketing in select states. Recently-unsealed court documents involving Purdue Pharma show that state-based triplicate prescription programs posed a major obstacle to sales of OxyContin and suggest that less marketing was targeted to states with these programs. We find that OxyContin distribution was about 50% lower in “triplicate states” in the years after the launch. While triplicate states had higher rates of overdose deaths prior to 1996, this relationship flipped shortly after the launch and triplicate states saw substantially slower growth in overdose deaths, continuing even twenty years after OxyContin's introduction. Our results show that the introduction and marketing of OxyContin explain a substantial share of overdose deaths over the last two decades.

10.3386/w26500.abstractZh: 自20世纪90年代中期以来，涉及阿片类药物的过量死亡事件急剧增加，导致美国历史上最严重的药物过量流行病。然而，关于其初始原因的相关实证证据非常有限。本文探讨了1996年奥施康定作为阿片类药物危机的潜在诱因所起的作用。我们利用各州在奥施康定引入过程中的差异来进行分析，这些差异是由于某些州的政策显著限制了奥施康定的早期引入和营销。最近公布的涉及普渡制药公司的法庭文件显示，基于州的重复处方计划对奥施康定的销售构成了重大障碍，这表明针对这些计划的营销活动较少。我们发现，在奥施康定推出的几年后，“重复处方计划”实施州的奥施康定分发量减少了约50%。虽然“重复处方计划”实施州在1996年之前的过量死亡率较高，但这一关系在推出后不久发生了逆转，这些州的过量死亡率显著下降，并且这种下降趋势持续了二十年后。我们的研究结果表明，奥施康定的引入和营销在过去二十年里对过量死亡事件起到了重要作用。

abstract.text: The increase in public insurance eligibility caused by the Affordable Care Act (ACA) Medicaid expansions may have had spillover effects to other public assistance programs. We explore the impact of the ACA on the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC), the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), and Temporary Assistance to Needy Families (TANF). Our research design uses variation in Medicaid eligibility that occurs on either side of state borders: we examine county-level administrative measures of EITC and SNAP participation in contiguous county pairs that cross state lines and individual data on program participation from the American Community Survey (ACS) in contiguous sub-state geographic units. This approach allows us to focus narrowly on differences arising from the ACA Medicaid expansion choice, implicitly controlling for local economic trends that could affect safety net participation. Our results suggest that the Medicaid expansion increased participation in SNAP and TANF, and possibly in the EITC. The ACS analysis suggests that safety net impacts are mainly due to participation conditional on eligibility rather than from eligibility changes stemming from labor supply responses. It appears that ACA Medicaid eligibility reduced the marginal cost of applying in SNAP, particularly facilitating enrollment in places with low 2013 SNAP take-up rates. Our results demonstrate the potential for spillovers across safety net programs.

10.3386/w26504.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》对医疗补助计划的扩展增加了公共保险的可及性，这可能对其他公共援助项目也产生了溢出效应。我们研究了《平价医疗法案》对劳动收入税收抵免、补充营养援助计划和临时援助计划的影响。我们的研究设计利用了州界两侧医疗补助资格的变化情况：我们考察了跨越州界的相邻县对劳动收入税收抵免和补充营养援助计划参与情况的县级行政数据，以及美国社区调查中的个体数据。这种方法使我们能够专注于《平价医疗法案》医疗补助扩展所带来的差异，同时隐含地控制了可能影响安全网项目参与情况的当地经济趋势。我们的研究结果表明，医疗补助扩展增加了对补充营养援助计划和临时援助计划的参与，可能也增加了对劳动收入税收抵免的参与。美国社区调查的分析表明，安全网项目的影响主要源于基于资格条件的参与，而非由于劳动力供应反应导致的资格变化。看来，《平价医疗法案》的医疗补助资格降低了申请补充营养援助计划的边际成本，尤其是在2013年补充营养援助计划参与率较低的地区，这种促进作用更为明显。我们的研究展示了安全网项目之间可能存在溢出效应的可能性。

abstract.text: Can measured risk attitudes and associated structural models predict insurance demand? In an experiment (n = 1,730), we elicit measures of utility curvature, probability weighting, loss aversion, and preference for certainty and use them to parameterize seventeen common structural models (e.g., expected utility, cumulative prospect theory). Subjects also make twelve insurance choices over different loss probabilities and prices. The insurance choices show coherence and some correlation with various risk-attitude measures. Yet all the structural models predict insurance poorly, often less accurately than random predictions. Simpler prediction heuristics show more promise for predicting insurance choices across different conditions.

10.3386/w26508.abstractZh: 能否通过测量风险态度及相关结构模型来预测保险需求？在一项实验中（n=1,730），我们测量了效用曲率、概率权重、损失厌恶以及对确定性的偏好，并利用这些指标对十七种常见结构模型（如期望效用、累积前景理论）进行参数化。参与者还针对不同的损失概率和价格做出了十二种保险选择。这些保险选择显示出与各种风险态度指标之间的连贯性和相关性。然而，所有结构模型对保险需求的预测效果都很差，其准确性往往低于随机预测。更简单的预测方法在预测不同条件下的保险选择方面显示出更大的潜力。

abstract.text: Measures of economic concentration, such as the k-firm concentration index and the Hirschman-Herfindahl Index (HHI) are commonly used to ascertain the competitiveness of a product market. Within a Cournot model industry equilibrium, it is known a relationship exists between the HHI and the gap between industry price and marginal cost, but the economic theory foundations and intuition underlying the HHI formula are seemingly arbitrary. Here we document that there are indeed powerful and intuitive theoretical foundations to the HHI, but those foundations emanate from outside economics, namely, ecology, where the HHI is known as Simpson’s Diversity Index. We discuss the origins of the HHI and Simpson’s Diversity Index, summarize other measures of concentration, and link them to common measures of inequality. Based on a priori reasoning, we conclude there is little on which to base a choice between the HHI and non-HHI measures of market concentration. We empirically illustrate the implementation of the HHI and other concentration indexes as the statin drug LipitorTM lost patent protection and faced generic competition in 2012; we find very similar empirical trends and high correlations among them. Our research provides support for the continued use of HHI as a measure of concentration, provided one recognizes its link to market power is equivocal.

10.3386/w26512.abstractZh: 经济集中度的衡量指标，如k-企业集中指数和Hirschman-Herfindahl指数（HHI），常被用来评估产品市场的竞争力。在Cournot模型行业均衡中，已知HHI与行业价格与边际成本之间的差距之间存在关联，但支撑HHI公式的经济理论基础和直觉似乎是任意的。我们发现，HHI确实有着强大且直观的理论基础，但这些基础源自经济学之外，即生态学领域，在那里HHI被称为Simpson多样性指数。我们讨论了HHI和Simpson多样性指数的起源，总结了其他集中度衡量指标，并将它们与常见的不平等衡量指标联系起来。基于先验推理，我们得出结论，在HHI与非HHI市场集中度衡量指标之间，几乎没有理由进行选择。我们通过实证案例说明了HHI及其他集中度指数的应用，例如2012年他汀类药物LipitorTM失去专利保护并面临仿制药竞争时，我们发现这些指标之间存在非常相似的实证趋势和高相关性。我们的研究支持继续将HHI作为集中度衡量指标，前提是人们认识到其与市场力量的关联是存在争议的。

abstract.text: We conduct a randomized field experiment to quantify biases that affect consumers of addictive goods: present-biased preferences, naïve beliefs regarding present bias, and projection-biased beliefs over future abstinence. These biases reflect departures from the neoclassical benchmark needed to accommodate intertemporal and state-dependent prediction errors and have important theoretical and policy ramifications. Our experiment employs a new approach for remote monitoring to ensure truthful reporting of behavior and valuations, and a novel identification of subjects’ biases based on willingness to pay for future abstinence incentives that serve as partial commitment devices. We find that cigarette smokers overestimate their likelihood of future abstinence by more than 100%, consistent with partially-naïve present-biased preferences. We estimate that on average smokers are present biased and only partially aware of their present bias, with substantial heterogeneity and a positive correlation between the two at the individual level. Smokers mispredict the effects of an abstinence intervention. Ex ante smokers anticipate no effect of the intervention on their future abstinence and ex post fail to recognize the intervention’s positive effect. Our estimates highlight that smokers suffer from a constellation of biases: under their own long-run preferences, smokers’ choices lead to a private welfare loss of $400 per week.

10.3386/w26522.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项随机实地实验，以量化影响成瘾商品消费者的各种偏见：当前偏向的偏好、对当前偏向的天真认知，以及对未来戒瘾的投射性信念。这些偏见反映了与适应跨时性和状态依赖预测误差所需的新古典基准的偏离，并在理论和政策层面具有重要意义。我们的实验采用了一种新的远程监控方法，以确保行为和评估的如实报告，并基于愿意为未来戒瘾激励支付的意愿，采用了一种新颖的方法来识别受试者的偏见，这些激励措施作为部分承诺机制。我们发现，吸烟者对未来戒瘾的可能性估计过高，超过100%，这与部分天真的当前偏向偏好一致。我们估计，平均而言，吸烟者存在当前偏向，并且仅部分意识到自己的当前偏向，这种偏向在个体层面存在显著异质性，且两者之间存在正相关关系。吸烟者对戒瘾干预的效果预测不准确。事前吸烟者认为干预对其未来戒瘾没有影响，而事后则未能认识到干预的积极效果。我们的估计表明，吸烟者受到多种偏见的困扰：根据他们自身的长期偏好，吸烟者的选择导致每周的私人福利损失达400美元。

abstract.text: Prescription pharmaceuticals are frequently used consumer products, whose manufacturing location is commonly held as a trade secret by firms and U.S. regulatory agencies. Here we use previously non-publicly available data to describe levels and trends in the manufacturing locations of the most commonly used prescription pharmaceuticals, off-patent generic drugs, intended to be consumed by Americans. We find that the base ingredients required for the manufacturing of these prescription drugs are overwhelmingly and increasingly manufactured in non-domestic locations, specifically India and China. The manufacturing of finished prescription drugs for the American market is equally split between domestic and foreign locations, but is increasingly foreign as well. The growing American reliance on non-domestic manufacturing of prescription drugs is important for stakeholders to appreciate given current quality and pricing concerns involving these products and their potential susceptibility to interruptions in supply. We discuss implications of these levels and trends for current domestic and international policy discussions.

10.3386/w26524.abstractZh: 处方药是常见的消费品，其制造地点通常被企业和美国监管机构视为商业机密。本文利用此前未公开的数据，描述了最常用处方药以及非专利仿制药的制造地点情况，这些药品面向美国消费者。研究发现，这些处方药的基础原料绝大多数在印度和中国等非本国制造。针对美国市场的成品处方药，其制造地点同样分为国内和国外两部分，但国外制造的比例正在上升。鉴于当前这些产品在质量和价格方面的担忧，以及其供应可能受到中断的风险，美国对非本国制造处方药的依赖程度值得相关方重视。本文还讨论了这些趋势对当前国内和国际政策讨论的影响。

abstract.text: We evaluate a randomized pilot study in which the IRS sent informational letters to 3.9 million taxpayers who paid a tax penalty for lacking health insurance coverage under the Affordable Care Act. Drawing on administrative data, we study the effect of the intervention on taxpayers’ subsequent health insurance enrollment and mortality. We find the intervention led to increased coverage in the two years following treatment and that this additional coverage reduced mortality among middle-aged adults over the same time period. Our results provide the first experimental evidence that health insurance reduces mortality.

10.3386/w26533.abstractZh: 我们评估了一项随机试点研究，该研究由美国国税局进行，向390万因未遵守《平价医疗法案》规定而面临税收处罚的纳税人发送了通知。通过利用行政数据，我们研究了该干预措施对纳税人后续健康保险投保率和死亡率的影响。研究发现，在干预后的两年里，健康保险覆盖率有所提高，而且在这段时间内，这种额外的保险覆盖减少了中年成年人的死亡率。我们的研究结果首次提供了实验性证据，证明健康保险能够降低死亡率。

abstract.text: In 2013, China launched a landmark program to monitor air quality and disclose real-time data, significantly increasing the public’s access to and awareness of pollution information. The program triggered cascading behavioral changes such as stronger avoidance of outdoor pollution exposure and increased spending on protective products. These behavioral responses mitigated the mortality impact of air pollution. Conservative estimates indicate that the program’s health benefits outweigh the costs by an order of magnitude. The findings highlight the benefits of improving public access to pollution information in developing countries which often experience severe air pollution but lack pollution data collection and dissemination.

10.3386/w26541.abstractZh: 2013年，中国启动了一项具有里程碑意义的空气质量监测计划，并公开实时数据，显著提高了公众获取和了解污染信息的机会。该计划引发了连锁行为变化，如更强烈地避免接触室外污染，以及增加对防护产品的支出。这些行为反应减轻了空气污染对死亡率的影响。保守估计表明，该计划带来的健康效益远远超过其成本。这些发现凸显了在发展中国家改善公众获取污染信息的重要性，因为这些国家往往面临严重的空气污染问题，但缺乏污染数据的收集与传播。

abstract.text: Opioid addiction and mortality skyrocketed over the past decade. A casual look at the geographic incidence of opioid mortality shows sharply higher mortality rates in the Appalachian region, especially in coal-mining areas. This has led observers to make a link that was characterized by one newspaper as “abandoned by coal, swallowed by opioids.” We test that theory using restricted death data and mine level coal production data. Specifically, we examine whether higher reliance on coal mining in a county’s economy leads to higher or lower opioid mortality. We find a positive relationship between the share of coal miners among total local labor force and county-level opioid mortality rates. This contradicts the “abandoned by coal, swallowed by opioids” story. Rather our results suggest that the higher rates of injury in underground coal mining (in particular) lead to greater amounts of opioid consumption and mortality. An implication is that the decline in coal mining in the United States may have a positive spillover in the form of reduced mortality from opioid use.

10.3386/w26551.abstractZh: 在过去十年中，阿片类药物成瘾和死亡率急剧上升。从阿片类药物导致的死亡率的地理分布来看，阿巴拉契亚地区，尤其是煤炭开采区的死亡率明显更高。这一现象让一些观察者认为，阿片类药物的泛滥与煤炭开采的衰落之间存在关联。我们使用受限死亡数据以及煤炭开采量数据来验证这一理论。具体来说，我们研究了一个县的经济中煤炭开采比重越高，阿片类药物导致的死亡率是否也会相应增加或减少。研究发现，当地劳动力中煤炭矿工的比例与县级阿片类药物死亡率之间存在正相关关系。这与“阿片类药物的泛滥导致煤炭开采衰落”的说法相矛盾。相反，我们的研究结果表明，地下煤炭开采中较高的受伤率导致了更多的阿片类药物消费和更高的死亡率。这意味着，美国煤炭开采的减少可能会以降低阿片类药物使用相关的死亡率为积极效果。

abstract.text: We examine how a key provision of the Affordable Care Act--the expansion of Medicaid eligibility--affected health insurance coverage, access to care, and labor market transitions of unemployed workers. Comparing trends in states that implemented the Medicaid expansion to those that did not, we find that the ACA Medicaid expansion substantially increased insurance coverage and improved access to health care among unemployed workers. We then test whether this strengthening of the safety net affected transitions from unemployment to employment or out of the labor force. We find no meaningful statistical evidence in support of moral hazard effects that reduce job finding or labor force attachment.

10.3386/w26553.abstractZh: 我们研究了《平价医疗法案》的一项关键条款——扩大医疗补助的资格范围——对健康保险覆盖、就医机会以及失业工人的劳动力市场转型的影响。通过比较实施医疗补助扩展政策的州与未实施该政策的州的趋势，我们发现《平价医疗法案》的医疗补助扩展显著增加了失业工人的保险覆盖范围，并改善了他们的就医机会。接下来，我们测试了这种对社会保障体系的加强是否影响了失业者从失业到就业或退出劳动力市场的转变。我们没有发现任何有意义的统计证据支持会降低求职或劳动力依附性的道德风险效应。

abstract.text: Factorial designs are widely used for studying multiple treatments in one experiment. While t-tests based on the “long” model (including main and interaction effects) provide valid inferences against “business-as-usual” counterfactuals, “short” model t-tests (that ignore interactions) yield higher power if the interactions are zero, but incorrect inferences otherwise. Out of 27 factorial experiments published in top-5 journals in 2007–2017, 19 use the short model. We reanalyze these experiments, and show that over half of their published results lose significance when interactions are included. We show that testing the interactions using the long model and presenting the short model if the interactions are not significantly different from zero leads to incorrect inference due to the implied data-dependent model selection. Based on recent econometric advances, we show that local power improvements over the long model are possible. However, if the main effects are of primary interest, leaving the interaction cells empty yields valid inferences and global power improvements. In addition, the sample size needed to detect interactions is substantially larger than that required to detect main effects, resulting in most experiments being under-powered to detect interactions. Thus, using factorial designs to explore whether interactions are meaningful can be problematic because interaction estimates are likely to considerably overestimate the magnitude of the true effect conditional on being significant.

10.3386/w26562.abstractZh: 因子设计被广泛用于研究实验中多个处理的影响。基于“长”模型的t检验（包括主效应和交互效应）能够针对“常规操作”的反事实进行有效推断，而“短”模型的t检验（忽略交互效应）在交互效应为零时具有较高的检验功效，但在其他情况下则可能导致错误的推断。在2007至2017年间发表在顶级期刊上的27个因子实验中，有19个使用了“短”模型。我们对这些实验进行了重新分析，发现当包含交互效应时，超过一半的实验结果失去了显著性。我们指出，使用“长”模型检验交互效应，并在交互效应与零无显著差异时展示“短”模型，会导致由于隐含的数据依赖模型选择而导致的错误推断。基于最近的计量经济学进展，我们表明相对于“长”模型，局部功效的改进是可能的。然而，如果主要效应是主要关注点，那么让交互效应单元格为空可以得到有效的推断和整体功效的提升。此外，检测交互效应所需的样本量远大于检测主效应所需的样本量，因此大多数实验在检测交互效应时会出现功效不足的问题。因此，使用因子设计来探讨交互效应是否有意义可能会存在问题，因为交互效应的估计值可能会大大高估了在交互效应显著条件下的真实效应大小。

abstract.text: While over 240,000 American students experienced a school shooting in the last two decades, little is known about the impacts of these events on the mental health of surviving youth. Using large-scale prescription data from 2006 to 2015, we examine the effects of 44 school shootings on youth antidepressant use in a difference-in-difference framework. We find that local exposure to fatal school shootings increases youth antidepressant use by 21.4 percent in the following two years. These effects are smaller in areas with a higher density of mental health providers who focus on behavioral, rather than pharmacological, interventions.

10.3386/w26563.abstractZh: 在过去二十年里，超过24万美国学生遭遇了校园枪击事件，但关于这些事件对幸存青少年的心理健康影响的研究却很少。我们利用2006至2015年的大规模处方数据，通过差异-差异框架来研究44起校园枪击事件对青少年抗抑郁药使用的影响。研究发现，当地发生致命校园枪击事件后，青少年在随后两年内使用抗抑郁药的比例增加了21.4%。在那些拥有更多专注于行为干预而非药物干预的心理健康服务提供者的地区，这些影响相对较小。

abstract.text: E-cigarettes use a battery powered heater to turn a liquid containing nicotine into a vapor. The vapor is inhaled by the user and is generally considered to be less harmful than the smoke from combustible cigarettes because the vapor does not contain the toxins that are found in tobacco smoke. Because e-cigarettes provide an experience that is very similar to smoking, they may be effective in helping smokers to quit, and thus the availability of e-cigarettes could increase quit rates. Alternatively, e-cigarettes may provide smokers with a method of bypassing smoking restrictions and prolong the smoking habit. There is very little causal evidence to date on how e-cigarette use impacts smoking cessation among adults. Although there is no federal tax on e-cigarettes, a few states have recently imposed heavy taxes on them. We provide some of the first evidence on how e-cigarette taxes impact adult smokers, exploiting the large tax increase in Minnesota. That state was the first to impose a tax on e-cigarettes by extending the definition of tobacco products to include e-cigarettes. This tax, which is 95% of the wholesale price, provides a plausibly exogenous deterrent to e-cigarette use. We utilize data from the Current Population Survey Tobacco Use Supplements from 1992 to 2015, in conjunction with a synthetic control difference-in-differences approach. We assess how this large tax increase impacted smoking cessation among adult smokers. Estimates suggest that the e-cigarette tax increased adult smoking and reduced smoking cessation in Minnesota, relative to the control group, and imply a cross elasticity of current smoking participation with respect to e-cigarette prices of 0.13. Our results suggest that in the sample period about 32,400 additional adult smokers would have quit smoking in Minnesota in the absence of the tax. If this tax were imposed on a national level about 1.8 million smokers would be deterred from quitting in a ten year period. The taxation of e-cigarettes at the same rate as cigarettes could deter more than 2.75 million smokers nationally from quitting in the same period. The public health benefits of not taxing e-cigarettes, however, must be weighed against effects of this decision on efforts to reduce vaping by youth.

10.3386/w26589.abstractZh: 电子香烟利用电池驱动的加热器将含有尼古丁的液体转化为蒸汽。使用者吸入这种蒸汽，通常认为其危害比可燃香烟的烟雾要小，因为蒸汽中不含烟草烟雾中的毒素。由于电子香烟提供的体验与吸烟非常相似，它们可能有助于帮助吸烟者戒烟，因此电子香烟的普及可能会增加戒烟率。另一方面，电子香烟可能为吸烟者提供了一种绕过吸烟限制的方法，从而延长吸烟习惯。目前关于电子香烟使用对成年人戒烟的影响，几乎没有因果证据。尽管联邦政府对电子香烟没有征税，但一些州最近对其征收了高额税收。我们提供了一些关于电子香烟税收如何影响成年吸烟者的首批证据，利用了明尼苏达州大幅增税的情况。该州是第一个将电子香烟纳入烟草产品定义并对其进行征税的州。这项税收占批发价格的95%，可以作为一种合理的外部威慑措施来阻止电子香烟的使用。我们利用了1992年至2015年《当前人口调查》中关于烟草使用的补充数据，并结合了合成控制差异法进行分析。我们评估了这一大幅增税对成年吸烟者的戒烟行为的影响。估计结果显示，与对照组相比，明尼苏达州的电子香烟税收增加了成年人的吸烟量，并减少了戒烟行为，同时表明当前吸烟参与率与电子香烟价格之间的交叉弹性为0.13。我们的研究结果表明，在样本期间，如果没有这项税收，明尼苏达州大约有32,400名成年吸烟者会戒烟。如果在全国范围内实施这项税收，那么在十年内大约有180万吸烟者会放弃戒烟。以与香烟相同的税率对电子烟征税，则可以在同一时期内阻止超过275万吸烟者戒烟。然而，不对电子烟征税所带来的公共卫生效益，必须与这一决定对减少青少年使用电子烟的影响进行权衡。

abstract.text: We show that even in the absence of data on individual decisions, the distribution of individual attitudes towards risk can be identified from the aggregate conditions that characterize equilibrium on markets for risky assets. Taking parimutuel horse races as a textbook model of contingent markets, we allow for heterogeneous bettors with very general risk preferences, including non-expected utility. Under a standard single-crossing condition on preferences, we identify the distribution of preferences among the population of bettors and we derive testable implications. We estimate the model on data from U.S. races. Specifications based on expected utility fit the data very poorly. Our results stress the crucial importance of nonlinear probability weighting. They also suggest that several dimensions of heterogeneity may be at work.

10.3982/ecta11165.abstractZh: 我们表明，即使缺乏关于个体决策的数据，也可以从描述风险资产市场均衡的汇总条件中识别出个体对风险的态度分布。以帕里穆特尔赛马作为随机市场的典型模型，我们考虑了具有非常普遍风险偏好的异质赌徒，包括非期望效用。在偏好标准的单一交叉条件下，我们确定了赌徒群体中的偏好分布，并得出了可检验的结论。我们基于美国赛马的数据对模型进行了估计。基于期望效用的假设与数据非常不吻合。我们的研究结果强调了非线性概率加权的重要性。此外，这些结果还表明，可能存在多个维度的异质性因素在起作用。

abstract.text: In 1960, 94 percent of doctors and lawyers were white men. By 2010, the fraction was just 62 percent. Similar changes in other highly‐skilled occupations have occurred throughout the U.S. economy during the last 50 years. Given that the innate talent for these professions is unlikely to have changed differently across groups, the change in the occupational distribution since 1960 suggests that a substantial pool of innately talented women and black men in 1960 were not pursuing their comparative advantage. We examine the effect on aggregate productivity of the convergence in the occupational distribution between 1960 and 2010 through the prism of a Roy model. Across our various specifications, between 20% and 40% of growth in aggregate market output per person can be explained by the improved allocation of talent.

10.3982/ecta11427.abstractZh: 在1960年，94%的医生和律师都是白人男性。到2010年，这一比例下降到了62%。在过去50年中，美国其他高技能职业也发生了类似的变化。鉴于这些职业的先天才能在不同群体中的表现可能并无差异，1960年以来职业分布的变化表明，1960年时，大量具有先天才能的女性及黑人男性并未发挥他们的比较优势。我们通过罗伊模型来研究1960年至2010年间职业分布趋同对总体生产力的影响。根据我们的各种模型分析，人均市场产出增长的20%到40%可以通过人才分配方式的改善来解释。

abstract.text: Twelve percent of the Malawian population is HIV infected. Eighteen percent of sexual encounters are casual. A condom is used a third of the time. To analyze the Malawian epidemic, a choice‐theoretic general equilibrium search model is constructed. In the developed framework, people select between different sexual practices while knowing the inherent risk. The calibrated model is used to study several policy interventions, namely, ART, circumcision, better condoms, and the treatment of other STDs. The efficacy of public policy depends upon the induced behavioral changes and equilibrium effects. The framework complements the insights from epidemiological studies and small‐scale field experiments.

10.3982/ecta11530.abstractZh: 马拉维有12%的人口感染了HIV。18%的性伴侣关系是非正式的。只有三分之一的性行为使用避孕套。为了分析马拉维的疫情，构建了一个选择理论的一般均衡搜索模型。在这个框架下，人们会在了解潜在风险的情况下选择不同的性行为方式。该模型被用来研究多种政策干预措施，包括抗逆转录病毒疗法、包皮环切术、更优质的避孕套以及其他性传播疾病的防治。公共政策的有效性取决于所引发的行为改变以及均衡效应。该框架补充了流行病学研究和小规模实地实验的成果。

abstract.text: We study stability of two-sided many-to-one matching in which firms' preferences for workers may exhibit complementarities. Although such preferences are known to jeopardize stability in a finite market, we show that a stable matching exists in a large market with a continuum of workers, provided that each firm's choice is convex and changes continuously as the set of available workers changes. We also study the existence and structure of stable matchings under preferences exhibiting substitutability and indifferences in a large market. Building on these results, we show that an approximately stable matching exists in large finite economies. We extend our framework to ensure a stable matching with desirable incentive and fairness properties in the presence of indifferences in firms' preferences.

10.3982/ecta13547.abstractZh: 我们研究了在双方多对一匹配中的稳定性问题，其中企业的员工偏好可能表现出互补性。尽管这种偏好已知会危及有限市场中的稳定性，但我们证明，在拥有连续员工的大市场中，只要每个企业的选择是凸的，并且随着可用员工数量的变化而持续变化，那么稳定的匹配是存在的。我们还研究了在偏好具有可替代性和无差异性的大市场中，稳定匹配的存在性和结构。基于这些结果，我们证明了在大型有限经济中，存在近似稳定的匹配。我们扩展了我们的框架，以确保在存在企业偏好无差异性的情况下，匹配具有理想的激励和公平性质。

abstract.text: Households face large income uncertainty that varies substantially over the business cycle. We examine the macroeconomic consequences of these variations in a model with incomplete markets, liquid and illiquid assets, and a nominal rigidity. Heightened uncertainty depresses aggregate demand as households respond by hoarding liquid ``paper'' assets for precautionary motives, thereby reducing both illiquid physical investment and consumption demand. This translates into output losses, which a central bank can prevent by providing liquidity. We show that the welfare consequences of uncertainty shocks crucially depend on a household's asset position. Households with little human capital but high illiquid wealth lose the most from an uncertainty shock and gain the most from stabilization policy.

10.3982/ecta13601.abstractZh: 家庭面临着巨大的收入不确定性，这种不确定性在商业周期中会有显著变化。我们在一个具有不完全市场、流动性和非流动性资产以及名义刚性特征的模型中，研究了这些不确定性变化的宏观经济后果。不确定性加剧会抑制总需求，因为家庭出于预防动机而囤积流动性“虚拟”资产，从而减少了非流动性的实物投资和消费需求。这会导致产出损失，而中央银行可以通过提供流动性来防止这种情况。我们表明，不确定性冲击的福利后果在很大程度上取决于家庭的资产状况。人力资本较少但非流动性财富较高的家庭，在不确定性冲击中遭受的损失最大，而通过稳定政策获得的收益也最大。

abstract.text: We revisit the Nash bargaining model and axiomatize a procedural solution that maximizes the probability of successful bargaining. Our characterization spans several known solution concepts, including the special cases of the Nash, egalitarian, and utilitarian solutions. Using a probability‐based language, we offer a natural interpretation for the product operator underlying the Nash solution: when the bargainers' individual acceptance probabilities are independent, their product recovers the joint acceptance probability.

10.3982/ecta13673.abstractZh: 我们重新审视了纳什讨价还价模型，并为一種程序化解决方案建立了公理体系，该方案能够最大化讨价还价成功的概率。我们的描述涵盖了多种已知的解决方案概念，包括纳什解、平等主义解和功利主义解的特殊情况。我们采用基于概率的语言，对纳什解所基于的乘积运算符进行了自然解释：当讨价还价者的个体接受概率相互独立时，它们的乘积就代表了联合接受概率。

abstract.text: We study whether individuals save more when information about their savings is shared with another village member (a monitor). We focus on whether the monitor's eectiveness depends on her network position. Central monitors may be better able to disseminate information, and more proximate monitors may pass information to individ- uals who interact with the saver frequently. In 30 villages, we randomly assign monitors. Average monitors increase savings by 35%. A one-standard deviation more central monitor increases savings by 14%; increasing proximity from social distance three to two increases savings by 16%. The increased savings persist over a year after the intervention's end, and monitored savers better respond to shocks. In 30 other villages, savers choose their monitors. Proximate and central monitors are chosen. Information flows. 63% of monitors tell others about the saver's progress. 15 months later, others know more about the saver's progress and believe she is responsible if the saver was assigned a more central monitor.

10.3982/ecta13683.abstractZh: 我们研究的是，当个人储蓄信息被分享给另一个村庄成员（即监督者）时，他们是否会储蓄更多。我们关注的是监督者的有效性是否取决于其网络地位。中央位置的监督者可能更能有效传播信息，而距离较近的监督者则可能将信息传递给与储蓄者频繁互动的个体。在30个村庄中，我们随机分配了监督者。平均而言，有监督者的情况下，储蓄增加了35%。距离中央位置一个标准差的监督者，储蓄增加了14%；将社交距离从3倍增加到2倍，储蓄增加了16%。在干预结束后，储蓄增加的趋势仍持续了一年，而且受到监督的储蓄者对冲击的响应更好。在另外30个村庄中，储蓄者自行选择监督者。距离较近和位于中央位置的监督者被选中。信息流动方面，63%的监督者向其他人通报了储蓄者的进展情况。15个月后，其他人对储蓄者的进展了解得更清楚，并且认为如果储蓄者被分配到中央位置的监督者，那么储蓄者更有责任。

abstract.text: An Equivalence Theorem between geometric structures and utility functions allows new methods for understanding preferences. Our classification of valuations into “Demand Types” incorporates existing definitions (substitutes, complements, “strong substitutes,” etc.) and permits new ones. Our Unimodularity Theorem generalizes previous results about when competitive equilibrium exists for any set of agents whose valuations are all of a “demand type.” Contrary to popular belief, equilibrium is guaranteed for more classes of purely‐complements than of purely‐substitutes, preferences. Our Intersection Count Theorem checks equilibrium existence for combinations of agents with specific valuations by counting the intersection points of geometric objects. Applications include matching and coalition‐formation, and the “Product‐Mix Auction” introduced by the Bank of England in response to the financial crisis.

10.3982/ecta13693.abstractZh: 几何结构与效用函数之间的等价性定理为理解偏好提供了新的方法。我们将估值分类为“需求类型”，这既包含了现有的定义（替代品、互补品、“强替代品”等），也允许引入新的分类。我们的非单性定理将先前关于竞争均衡存在性的研究结果推广到任何一组估值都属于“需求类型”的代理人。与普遍看法相反，对于纯互补型偏好，均衡的存在性比纯替代型偏好更为保证。我们的交集计数定理通过计算几何对象的交集点，来判断具有特定估值的代理人组合是否存在均衡。该理论的应用包括匹配和联盟形成，以及英格兰银行为应对金融危机而引入的“产品混合拍卖”。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic trade model with spatially distinct labor markets facing varying exposure to international trade. The model captures the role of labor mobility frictions, goods mobility frictions, geographic factors, and input‐output linkages in determining equilibrium allocations. We show how to solve the equilibrium of the model and take the model to the data without assuming that the economy is at a steady state and without estimating productivities, migration frictions, or trade costs, which can be difficult to identify. We calibrate the model to 22 sectors, 38 countries, and 50 U.S. states. We study how the rise in China's trade for the period 2000 to 2007 impacted U.S. households across more than a thousand U.S. labor markets distinguished by sector and state. We find that the China trade shock resulted in a reduction of about 0.55 million U.S. manufacturing jobs, about 16% of the observed decline in manufacturing employment from 2000 to 2007. The U.S. gains in the aggregate, but due to trade and migration frictions, the welfare and employment effects vary across U.S. labor markets. Estimated transition costs to the new long‐run equilibrium are also heterogeneous and reflect the importance of accounting for labor dynamics.

10.3982/ecta13758.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个动态贸易模型，该模型中的劳动力市场在空间上有所区分，且面临不同的国际贸易影响。该模型揭示了劳动力流动摩擦、商品流动摩擦、地理因素以及投入产出联系在决定均衡分配中的作用。我们展示了如何求解模型的均衡状态，并将模型应用于实际数据，无需假设经济处于稳定状态，也无需估计生产率、迁移摩擦或贸易成本，因为这些因素往往难以确定。我们对模型进行了校准，涵盖了22个行业、38个国家和50个美国州。我们研究了2000至2007年间中国贸易的增长对美国上千个劳动力市场的家庭产生了怎样的影响，这些劳动力市场按行业和州进行了区分。研究发现，中国贸易冲击导致约55万个美国制造业岗位减少，这一比例约为2000至2007年间制造业就业减少量的16%。总体而言，美国从中受益，但由于贸易和迁移摩擦的影响，不同劳动力市场的福利和就业效果存在差异。估计的新长期均衡的过渡成本也各不相同，这反映了考虑劳动力动态的重要性。

abstract.text: We study optimal dynamic Ramsey policies in a standard growth model with financial frictions.For developing countries with low financial wealth, the optimal policy intervention increases labor supply and lowers wages, resulting in higher entrepreneurial profits and faster wealth accumulation.This in turn relaxes borrowing constraints in the future, leading to higher labor productivity and wages.The use of additional policy instruments, such as subsidized credit, may be optimal as well.In the long run, the optimal policy reverses sign.Taking advantage of the tractability of our framework, we extend the model to study its implications for optimal exchange rate and sectoral industrial policies.

10.3982/ecta13761.abstractZh: 我们研究了在具有金融摩擦的标准增长模型中的最优动态拉姆齐政策。对于金融财富较低的发展中国家，最优政策干预会增加劳动力供给并降低工资，从而提高企业利润和财富积累速度。这反过来会放松未来的借贷限制，进而提高劳动生产率和工资。使用额外的政策工具，如补贴信贷，也可能是最优选择。从长远来看，最优政策的方向会发生变化。利用我们框架的可处理性，我们扩展了模型以研究其对最优汇率和部门产业政策的影响。

abstract.text: Endogenous demand composition across sectors due to income elasticity differences, or Engel's Law for brevity, affects (i) sectoral compositions in employment and in value‐added, (ii) variations in innovation rates and in productivity change across sectors, (iii) intersectoral patterns of trade across countries, and (iv) product cycles from rich to poor countries. Using a two‐country model of directed technical change with a continuum of sectors under nonhomothetic preferences, which is rich enough to capture all these effects as well as their interactions, this paper offers a unifying perspective on how economic growth and globalization affect the patterns of structural change, innovation, and trade across countries and across sectors in the presence of Engel's Law. Among the main messages is that globalization amplifies, instead of reducing, the power of endogenous domestic demand composition differences as a driver of structural change.

10.3982/ecta13765.abstractZh: 由于收入弹性差异导致的各部门内生需求构成，或简称恩格尔法则，会影响以下方面：(i) 各部门在就业和增加值方面的构成；(ii) 各部门在创新率和生产率变化方面的差异；(iii) 国家间的部门间贸易模式；(iv) 从富裕国家到贫穷国家的产品周期。本文采用一个包含两个国家的定向技术变革模型，该模型在非齐次偏好下涵盖了一系列部门，足以捕捉所有这些效应及其相互作用。本文提供了一个统一的视角，探讨在恩格尔法则存在的情况下，经济增长和全球化如何影响国家间及各部门间的结构变革、创新和贸易模式。主要结论之一是，全球化增强了而不是削弱了内生国内需求构成差异作为结构变革驱动力的作用。

abstract.text: We propose a bootstrap‐based calibrated projection procedure to build confidence intervals for single components and for smooth functions of a partially identified parameter vector in moment (in)equality models. The method controls asymptotic coverage uniformly over a large class of data generating processes. The extreme points of the calibrated projection confidence interval are obtained by extremizing the value of the function of interest subject to a proper relaxation of studentized sample analogs of the moment (in)equality conditions. The degree of relaxation, or critical level, is calibrated so that the function of θ , not θ itself, is uniformly asymptotically covered with prespecified probability. This calibration is based on repeatedly checking feasibility of linear programming problems, rendering it computationally attractive. Nonetheless, the program defining an extreme point of the confidence interval is generally nonlinear and potentially intricate. We provide an algorithm, based on the response surface method for global optimization, that approximates the solution rapidly and accurately, and we establish its rate of convergence. The algorithm is of independent interest for optimization problems with simple objectives and complicated constraints. An empirical application estimating an entry game illustrates the usefulness of the method. Monte Carlo simulations confirm the accuracy of the solution algorithm, the good statistical as well as computational performance of calibrated projection (including in comparison to other methods), and the algorithm's potential to greatly accelerate computation of other confidence intervals.

10.3982/ecta14075.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于自举法的校准投影方法，用于为部分确定的参数向量的平滑函数以及单变量方程模型构建置信区间。该方法能够均匀地覆盖大量数据生成过程。通过极值化受适当放松的studentized样本类似物约束的感兴趣函数的值，可以得到校准投影置信区间的极端点。放松程度或临界水平经过校准，使得θ的函数而非θ本身以预先指定的概率均匀覆盖。这种校准基于反复检查线性规划问题的可行性，使其在计算上具有吸引力。尽管如此，定义置信区间极端点的程序通常是非线性的且可能相当复杂。我们提供了一种基于响应面法的全局优化算法，该算法能够快速准确地近似求解，并确定了其收敛速度。该算法对于具有简单目标与复杂约束的优化问题具有独立的参考价值。一个用于估算进入博弈的实证应用说明了该方法的实用性。蒙特卡洛模拟证实了求解算法的准确性，以及校准投影方法在统计和计算上的良好性能（与其他方法相比），同时表明该算法有潜力大幅加速其他置信区间的计算。

abstract.text: This paper is about measuring state dependence in dynamic discrete outcomes. I develop a nonparametric dynamic potential outcomes (DPO) model and propose an array of parameters and identifying assumptions that can be considered in this model. I show how to construct sharp identified sets under combinations of identifying assumptions by using a flexible linear programming procedure. I apply the analysis to study state dependence in unemployment for working age high school educated men using an extract from the 2008 Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP). Using only nonparametric assumptions, I estimate that state dependence accounts for at least 30–40% of the four‐month persistence in unemployment among high school educated men.

10.3982/ecta14138.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在动态离散结果中衡量状态依赖性的方法。我开发了一个非参数动态潜在结果模型，并提出了可以在该模型中考虑的若干参数和识别假设。我展示了如何通过灵活的线性规划程序，在多种识别假设组合下构建精确识别集。我应用该分析方法来研究具有高中教育背景的男性在失业状况中的状态依赖性，数据来源于2008年收入与计划参与调查。仅使用非参数假设，我估计状态依赖性至少占高中教育背景男性四个月失业持续性的30-40%。

abstract.text: This paper begins by observing that any reflexive binary (preference) relation (over risky prospects) that satisfies the independence axiom admits a form of expected utility representation. We refer to this representation notion as the coalitional minmax expected utility representation. By adding the remaining properties of the expected utility theorem, namely, continuity, completeness, and transitivity, one by one, we find how this representation gets sharper and sharper, thereby deducing the versions of this classical theorem in which any combination of these properties is dropped from its statement. This approach also allows us to weaken transitivity in this theorem, rather than eliminate it entirely, say, to quasitransitivity or acyclicity. Apart from providing a unified dissection of the expected utility theorem, these results are relevant for the growing literature on boundedly rational choice in which revealed preference relations often lack the properties of completeness and/or transitivity (but often satisfy the independence axiom). They are also especially suitable for the (yet overlooked) case in which the decision‐maker is made up of distinct individuals and, consequently, transitivity is routinely violated. Finally, and perhaps more importantly, we show that our representation theorems allow us to answer many economic questions that are posed in terms of nontransitive/incomplete preferences, say, about the maximization of preferences, the existence of Nash equilibrium, the preference for portfolio diversification, and the possibility of the preference reversal phenomenon.

10.3982/ecta14156.abstractZh: 本文首先指出，任何满足独立性公理的反射性二元偏好关系（针对风险前景）都存在一个预期效用表示形式。我们将这种表示方式称为联合最小最大预期效用表示。通过逐一添加预期效用定理的其余性质，即连续性、完备性和传递性，我们发现这种表示方式变得越来越精确，从而推导出在定理中省略了这些性质之一的版本。这种方法还允许我们削弱该定理中的传递性，而不是完全消除它，例如将其改为准传递性或非循环性。除了为预期效用定理提供统一的解析方法外，这些结果对于关于有界理性选择的日益增多的文献也具有重要意义，在这些文献中，揭示的偏好关系通常缺乏完备性和/或传递性，但往往满足独立性公理。这些结果特别适用于那些决策者由不同个体组成的（但被忽视的情况），在这种情况下，传递性通常会被违反。最后，或许更重要的是，我们的表示定理使我们能够回答许多关于非传递性/不完全偏好问题的经济问题，例如关于偏好最大化、纳什均衡的存在性、对投资组合多样化的偏好，以及偏好反转现象的可能性等问题。

abstract.text: We show how frictions and continuous transfers jointly affect equilibria in a model of matching in trading networks. Our model incorporates distortionary frictions such as transaction taxes and commissions. When contracts are fully substitutable for firms, competitive equilibria exist and coincide with outcomes that satisfy a cooperative solution concept called trail stability . However, competitive equilibria are generally neither stable nor Pareto‐efficient.

10.3982/ecta14159.abstractZh: 我们展示了摩擦和连续转移如何共同影响交易网络中的匹配模型中的均衡。我们的模型包含了诸如交易税和佣金等扭曲性摩擦。当合同对企业来说是完全可替代的时，存在竞争均衡，并且这些均衡与满足一种称为“轨迹稳定性”的合作解决方案的概念相一致。然而，竞争均衡通常既不稳定也不帕累托有效。

abstract.text: Making inferences about aggregate business cycles from regional variation alone is difficult because of economic channels and shocks that differ between regional and aggregate economies. However, we argue that regional business cycles contain valuable information that can help discipline models of aggregate fluctuations. We begin by documenting a strong relationship across U.S. states between local employment and wage growth during the Great Recession. This relationship is much weaker in U.S. aggregates. Then, we present a methodology that combines such regional and aggregate data in order to estimate a medium‐scale New Keynesian DSGE model. We find that aggregate demand shocks were important drivers of aggregate employment during the Great Recession, but the wage stickiness necessary for them to account for the slow employment recovery and the modest fall in aggregate wages is inconsistent with the flexibility of wages we observe across U.S. states. Finally, we show that our methodology yields different conclusions about the causes of aggregate employment and wage dynamics between 2007 and 2014 than either estimating our model with aggregate data alone or performing back‐of‐the‐envelope calculations that directly extrapolate from well‐identified regional elasticities.

10.3982/ecta14243.abstractZh: 仅从区域差异来推断整体商业周期是困难的，因为经济渠道和冲击在区域经济和整体经济中是不同的。然而，我们认为区域商业周期包含有价值的信息，可以帮助规范整体波动的模型。我们首先记录了美国各州在大衰退期间本地就业与工资增长之间的强烈关系。这种关系在整体美国范围内则较弱。然后，我们提出了一种结合区域和整体数据的方法，以估计一个中等规模的新凯恩斯DSGE模型。我们发现，在大衰退期间，总需求冲击是整体就业的重要驱动因素，但要使这些冲击解释缓慢的就业恢复和整体工资的适度下降，所需的工资粘性与美国各州观察到的工资灵活性不符。最后，我们表明，我们的方法得出的关于2007年至2014年间整体就业和工资动态的原因的结论，与仅使用整体数据估计模型或从已确定的区域弹性直接外推得出的结论不同。

abstract.text: We study the optimal design of subsidies in an equilibrium setting, where the decisions of individual recipients impose externalities on one another. We apply the model to the case of post‐Katrina rebuilding in New Orleans under the Louisiana Road Home rebuilding grant program (RH). We estimate the structural model via indirect inference, exploiting a discontinuity in the formula for determining the size of grants, which helps isolate the causal effect of neighbors' rebuilding on one's own rebuilding choices. We find that the additional rebuilding induced by RH generated positive externalities equivalent to $4950 to each inframarginal household whose rebuilding choice was not affected by the program. Counterfactual policy experiments find that optimal subsidy policies bias grant offers against relocation, with an inverse‐U‐shaped relationship between the degree of bias and the severity of damages from the disaster.

10.3982/ecta14246.abstractZh: 我们研究了在均衡条件下补贴的最优设计问题，其中个体接受者的决策会相互影响并产生外部性。我们将该模型应用于路易斯安那州“道路家园重建计划”下新奥尔良在卡特里娜飓风灾后重建的情况。我们通过间接推断方法估计了该结构模型，利用确定补助金额公式中的不连续性，从而能够分离出邻居的重建行为对个体重建选择的影响。研究发现，由“道路家园重建计划”引发的额外重建行为为那些未受该计划影响的家庭带来了相当于4950美元的积极外部性。反事实政策实验表明，最优的补贴政策会使得补助提供倾向于反对搬迁，且偏差程度与灾害造成的损失严重程度之间存在倒U型关系。

abstract.text: Insurgency and guerrilla warfare impose enormous socio‐economic costs and often persist for decades. The opacity of such forms of conflict is an obstacle to effective international humanitarian intervention and development programs. To shed light on the internal organization of otherwise unknown insurgent groups, this paper proposes two methodologies for the detection of unobserved coalitions of militants in conflict areas. These approaches are based on daily geocoded incident‐level data on insurgent attacks. We provide applications to the Afghan conflict during the 2004–2009 period and to Pakistan during the 2008–2011 period, identifying systematically different coalition structures. Applications to global terrorism data and identification of new groups or shifting coalitions are discussed.

10.3982/ecta14436.abstractZh: 叛乱和游击战带来了巨大的社会经济成本，且往往持续数十年。这种冲突形式的隐蔽性阻碍了有效的国际人道主义干预和发展计划的实施。为了揭示那些鲜为人知的叛乱组织的内部结构，本文提出了两种方法来检测冲突地区中未被观察到的武装团体联盟。这些方法基于每日地理编码的叛乱袭击数据。我们将其应用于2004年至2009年的阿富汗冲突以及2008年至2011年的巴基斯坦冲突，发现了系统性的不同联盟结构。文中还讨论了将这种方法应用于全球恐怖主义数据以及识别新出现的团体或变化的联盟联盟的可能性。

abstract.text: Comparing the 1935 and 1975 U.S. birth cohorts, wages of married women grew twice as fast as for married men, and the wage gap between married and single women turned from negative to positive. The employment rate of married women also increased sharply, while that of other groups remained quite stable. To better understand these diverse patterns, we develop a life-cycle model incorporating individual and household decisions about education, employment, marriage/divorce, and fertility. The model provides an excellent fit to wage and employment patterns, along with changes in education, marriage/divorce rates, and fertility. We assume fixed preferences, but allow for four exogenously changing factors: (i) mother's education, health, and taxes/transfers; (ii) marriage market opportunities and divorce costs; (iii) the wage structure and job offers; (iv) contraception technology. We quantify how each factor contributed to changes across cohorts. We find that factor (iii) was the most important force driving the increase in relative wages of married women, but that all four factors are important for explaining the many socio-economic changes that occurred in the past 50 years. Finally, we use the model to simulate a shift from joint to individual taxation. In a revenue-neutral simulation, we predict this would increase employment of married women by 9% and the marriage rate by 8.1%.

10.3982/ecta14474.abstractZh: 通过比较1935年和1975年的美国出生队列，我们发现已婚女性的工资增长速度是已婚男性的两倍，而且已婚女性与单身女性之间的工资差距从负转变为正。已婚女性的就业率也显著上升，而其他群体的就业率则保持相对稳定。为了更好地理解这些不同的模式，我们开发了一个生命周期模型，该模型包含了个人和家庭在教育、就业、婚姻/离婚以及生育方面的决策。该模型很好地解释了工资和就业模式的变化，以及教育、婚姻/离婚率和生育率的变化。我们假设偏好是固定的，但允许四个外生变化的因素：(i) 母亲的教育水平、健康状况以及税收/转移支付；(ii) 婚姻市场的机会和离婚成本；(iii) 工资结构和工作机会；(iv) 避孕技术。我们量化了每个因素对各个队列变化的影响。我们发现，因素(iii)是推动已婚女性相对工资增长的最重要因素，但所有四个因素对于解释过去50年发生的许多社会经济变化都非常重要。最后，我们使用该模型模拟了从联合征税转向个人征税的情况。在收入中性的模拟中，我们预测这将使已婚女性的就业率增加9%，婚姻率增加8.1%。

abstract.text: An empirical approach to optimal income taxation design is developed within an equilibrium collective marriage market model with imperfectly transferable utility. Taxes distort labour supply and time allocation decisions, as well as marriage market outcomes, and the within household decision process. Using data from the American Community Survey and American Time Use Survey, we structurally estimate our model and explore empirical design problems. We consider the optimal design problem when the planner is able to condition taxes on marital status, as in the U.S. tax code, but we allow the schedule for married couples to have an arbitrary form of tax jointness. Our results suggest that the optimal tax system for married couples is characterized by negative jointness, although the welfare gains from this jointness are shown to be quite modest.

10.3982/ecta14528.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于均衡集体婚姻市场模型的实证最优所得税设计方法，该模型考虑了不完美可转移效用的情况。税收会扭曲劳动力供给、时间分配决策以及婚姻市场的结果，同时也会影响家庭内部的决策过程。通过美国社区调查和美国时间使用调查的数据，我们对模型进行了结构性估计，并探讨了实证设计中的相关问题。我们考虑了规划者能够根据婚姻状况调整税收的情况，类似于美国税法中的做法，但允许已婚夫妇的税收安排具有任意形式的联合性。研究结果表明，已婚夫妇的最优税收体系具有负联合性特征，尽管这种联合性带来的福利收益相当有限。

abstract.text: This paper shows that bargainers may reach delayed agreements even in environments where there is no uncertainty about payoffs or feasible actions. Under such conditions, delay may arise when bargainers face direct forms of strategic uncertainty—that is, uncertainty about the opponent's play. The paper restricts the nature of this uncertainty in two important ways. First, it assumes on‐path strategic certainty : Bargainers face uncertainty only after surprise moves. Second, it assumes Battigalli and Siniscalchi's (2002) rationality and common strong belief of rationality (RCSBR)—a requirement that bargainers are “strategically sophisticated.” The main result characterizes the set of outcomes consistent with on‐path strategic certainty and RCSBR. It shows that these assumptions allow for delayed agreement, despite the fact that the bargaining environment is one of complete information. The source of delay is second‐order optimism : Bargainers do not put forward “good” offers early in the negotiation process because they fear that doing so will cause the other party to become more optimistic about her future prospects.

10.3982/ecta14534.abstractZh: 本文表明，即使在没有关于收益或可行行动的不确定性的情况下，谈判者仍可能达成延迟协议。在这种情况下，当谈判者面临直接的战略不确定性时，即对手的行为存在不确定性，延迟现象就会出现。本文从两个重要方面限制了这种不确定性的性质。首先，假设谈判者在谈判过程中始终处于战略确定性：谈判者只有在遭遇意外行动时才会面临不确定性。其次，假设谈判者具备Battigalli和Siniscalchi（2002）提出的理性与共同理性信念（RCSBR）——这一要求表明谈判者具有“战略上的成熟度”。主要结果描述了与战略确定性和RCSBR相一致的结果集合。结果表明，尽管谈判环境是完全信息化的，但这些假设仍然允许延迟达成协议。延迟的来源是二阶乐观心理：谈判者在谈判初期不会提出“好”的提议，因为他们担心这样做会使对方对未来前景更加乐观。

abstract.text: This paper considers inference on fixed effects in a linear regression model estimated from network data. An important special case of our setup is the two‐way regression model. This is a workhorse technique in the analysis of matched data sets, such as employer–employee or student–teacher panel data. We formalize how the structure of the network affects the accuracy with which the fixed effects can be estimated. This allows us to derive sufficient conditions on the network for consistent estimation and asymptotically valid inference to be possible. Estimation of moments is also considered. We allow for general networks and our setup covers both the dense and the sparse case. We provide numerical results for the estimation of teacher value‐added models and regressions with occupational dummies.

10.3982/ecta14605.abstractZh: 本文探讨了从网络数据中估计的线性回归模型中固定效应的推断问题。我们研究的一个重要特例是双向回归模型。这种技术在分析匹配数据集时非常有用，例如雇主-雇员或学生-教师面板数据。我们明确了网络结构如何影响固定效应的估计精度。这使我们能够推导出网络的一致估计和渐近有效推断所需的充分条件。我们也考虑了矩估计方法。我们的模型适用于一般网络，包括密集和稀疏两种情况。我们为教师价值增加模型以及带有职业虚拟变量的回归模型的估计提供了数值结果。

abstract.text: Private information is at the heart of many economic activities. For decades, economists have assumed that individuals are willing to misreport private information if this maximizes their material payoff. We combine data from 90 experimental studies in economics, psychology, and sociology, and show that, in fact, people lie surprisingly little. We then formalize a wide range of potential explanations for the observed behavior, identify testable predictions that can distinguish between the models, and conduct new experiments to do so. Our empirical evidence suggests that a preference for being seen as honest and a preference for being honest are the main motivations for truth‐telling.

10.3982/ecta14673.abstractZh: 私人信息是许多经济活动的核心。几十年来，经济学家一直认为，如果错误报告私人信息能够最大化个人的物质收益，那么个体是愿意这样做的。我们结合经济学、心理学和社会学领域90项实验研究的数据，发现实际上人们说谎的情况非常少。随后，我们为这一观察到的行为提出了多种可能的解释，确定了可以区分不同模型的可测试预测，并进行了新的实验来验证这些预测。我们的实证证据表明，倾向于被视为诚实的人，以及希望保持诚实的意愿，是人们选择说实话的主要动机。

abstract.text: We derive asymptotic properties of estimators and test statistics to determine—in a grouped data setting—common versus group‐specific factors. Despite the fact that our test statistic for the number of common factors, under the null, involves a parameter at the boundary (related to unit canonical correlations), we derive a parameter‐free asymptotic Gaussian distribution. We show how the group factor setting applies to mixed‐frequency data. As an empirical illustration, we address the question whether Industrial Production (IP) is still the dominant factor driving the U.S. economy using a mixed‐frequency data panel of IP and non‐IP sectors. We find that a single common factor explains 89% of IP output growth and 61% of total GDP growth despite the diminishing role of manufacturing.

10.3982/ecta14690.abstractZh: 我们推导了估计量和检验统计量的渐近性质，以在分组数据环境下确定共同因素与特定群体因素之间的差异。尽管我们的检验统计量用于计算共同因素的数量，在零假设下涉及一个边界参数（与单位典型相关性相关），但我们推导出了一个无参数的渐近高斯分布。我们展示了群体因素设定如何适用于混合频率数据。作为实证示例，我们探讨了工业生产是否仍然是驱动美国经济的主要因素这一问题，使用了包含工业与非工业部门的混合频率数据面板。我们发现，尽管制造业的作用逐渐减弱，但单一共同因素能够解释89%的工业生产增长和61%的GDP增长。

abstract.text: We consider a general social choice environment that has multiple agents, a finite set of alternatives, independent types, and atomless type distribution. We show that for any Bayesian incentive compatible mechanism, there exists an equivalent deterministic mechanism that (1) is Bayesian incentive compatible; (2) delivers the same interim expected allocation probabilities and the same interim expected utilities for all agents; and (3) delivers the same ex ante expected social surplus. This result holds in settings with a rich class of utility functions, multidimensional types, interdependent valuations, and in settings without monetary transfers. To prove our result, we develop a novel methodology of mutual purification, and establish its link with the mechanism design literature.

10.3982/ecta14698.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个一般性的社会选择环境，该环境包含多个代理人、有限的备选方案、独立的类型以及无原子类型的类型分布。我们证明了，对于任何贝叶斯激励兼容的机制，都存在一个等效的确定性机制，该机制满足以下条件：(1) 也是贝叶斯激励兼容的；(2) 为所有代理人提供相同的临时预期分配概率和临时预期效用；(3) 提供相同的预期社会收益。这一结果适用于具有丰富效用函数类、多维类型、相互依赖的估值情况，以及不涉及货币转移的情况。为了证明我们的结论，我们提出了一种新颖的相互净化方法，并建立了其与机制设计文献之间的联系。

abstract.text: I develop a search‐and‐bargaining model of endogenous intermediation in over‐the‐counter markets. Unlike the existing work, my model allows for rich investor heterogeneity in three simultaneous dimensions: preferences, inventories, and meeting rates. By comparing trading‐volume patterns that arise in my model and are observed in practice, I argue that the heterogeneity in meeting rates is the main driver of intermediation patterns. I find that investors with higher meeting rates (i.e., fast investors) are less averse to holding inventories and more attracted to cash earnings, which makes the model corroborate a number of stylized facts that do not emerge from existing models: (i) fast investors provide intermediation by charging a speed premium , and (ii) fast investors hold more extreme inventories. Then, I use the model to study the effect of trading frictions on the supply and price of liquidity. On social welfare, I show that the interaction of meeting rate heterogeneity with optimal inventory management makes the equilibrium inefficient. I provide a financial transaction tax/subsidy scheme that corrects this inefficiency, in which fast investors cross‐subsidize slow investors.

10.3982/ecta14713.abstractZh: 我开发了一个关于OTC市场中内生中介行为的搜索与协商模型。与现有研究不同，我的模型允许投资者在三个维度上表现出丰富的异质性：偏好、库存和匹配率。通过比较模型中出现的交易量模式与实际观察到的模式，我认为匹配率的异质性是中介行为模式的主要驱动因素。我发现，匹配率较高的投资者（即快速投资者）对持有库存的厌恶程度较低，而更倾向于获取现金收益，这使得该模型能够证实一些现有模型未能揭示的特质：(i) 快速投资者通过收取速度溢价来提供中介服务；(ii) 快速投资者持有更极端的库存。接着，我利用该模型研究交易摩擦对流动性供给和价格的影响。在福利层面，我表明匹配率异质性与最优库存管理的相互作用会导致均衡效率低下。我提出了一个金融交易税/补贴方案来纠正这种效率低下，即快速投资者向慢速投资者提供交叉补贴。

abstract.text: In a transformation model y t = c[a(x t , β), u t ], where the errors u t are i.i.d and independent of the explanatory variables x t , the parameters can be estimated by a pseudo-maximum likelihood (PML) method, that is, by using a misspecified distribution of the errors, but the PML estimator of β is in general not consistent.We explain in this paper how to nest the initial model in an identified augmented model with more parameters in order to derive consistent PML estimators of appropriate functions of parameter β.The usefulness of the consistency result is illustrated by examples of systems of nonlinear equations, conditionally heteroskedastic models, stochastic volatility, or models with spatial interactions.

10.3982/ecta14727.abstractZh: 在一个转换模型中，y_t = c[a(x_t, β), u_t]，其中误差u_t是独立同分布的，并且与解释变量x_t无关。参数可以通过伪最大似然法来估计，即使用一种误设的误差分布，但β的伪最大似然估计通常并不一致。本文阐述了如何将初始模型嵌套在一个已识别的增广模型中，该模型包含更多的参数，从而得出对参数β的适当函数的一致伪最大似然估计。通过非线性方程系统、条件异方差模型、随机波动性模型或具有空间相互作用的模型示例，说明了该一致性结果的有效性。

abstract.text: We study the interactions between sovereign debt default and maturity choice in a setting with limited commitment for repayment as well as future debt issuances. Our main finding is that, under a wide range of conditions, the sovereign should, as long as default is not preferable, remain passive in long‐term bond markets, making payments and retiring long‐term bonds as they mature but never actively issuing or buying back such bonds. The only active debt‐management margin is the short‐term bond market. We show that any attempt to manipulate the existing maturity profile of outstanding long‐term bonds generates losses, as bond prices move against the sovereign. Our results hold regardless of the shape of the yield curve. The yield curve captures the average costs of financing at different maturities but is misleading regarding the marginal costs.

10.3982/ecta14806.abstractZh: 我们研究了主权债务违约与债务期限选择之间的相互作用，这种相互作用发生在偿还承诺有限以及未来债务发行受限的情况下。我们的主要发现是，在广泛的条件下，只要违约不是可取的，主权政府应在长期债券市场上保持被动态度，在债券到期时进行支付并赎回长期债券，但绝不会主动发行或回购这些债券。唯一活跃的债务管理手段是短期债券市场。我们表明，任何试图操纵现有长期债券期限结构的尝试都会产生损失，因为债券价格会朝着不利于主权政府的方向变动。我们的结果不受收益率曲线形状的影响。收益率曲线反映了不同到期日的平均融资成本，但关于边际成本则具有误导性。

abstract.text: Entrants and incumbents can create new products and displace the products of competitors. Incumbents can also improve their existing products. How much of aggregate productivity growth occurs through each of these channels? Using data from the U.S. Longitudinal Business Database on all nonfarm private businesses from 1983 to 2013, we arrive at three main conclusions: First, most growth appears to come from incumbents. We infer this from the modest employment share of entering firms (defined as those less than 5 years old). Second, most growth seems to occur through improvements of existing varieties rather than creation of brand new varieties. Third, own‐product improvements by incumbents appear to be more important than creative destruction. We infer this because the distribution of job creation and destruction has thinner tails than implied by a model with a dominant role for creative destruction.

10.3982/ecta14930.abstractZh: 新进入者和现有企业都可以创造新产品并取代竞争对手的产品。现有企业也可以改进其现有产品。这些渠道分别带来了多少总体生产率增长？利用美国纵向商业数据库1983年至2013年间所有非农业私营企业的数据，我们得出三个主要结论：首先，大部分增长似乎来自现有企业。我们由此推断，新进入企业的就业份额较低（定义为成立时间不足5年的企业）。其次，大部分增长似乎是通过改进现有产品实现的，而不是创造全新的产品。第三，现有企业对自身产品的改进似乎比创造性破坏更为重要。我们之所以如此推断，是因为就业创造和破坏的分布比一个以创造性破坏为主导的模型所暗示的更为均匀。

abstract.text: We study economies in which agents face Knightian uncertainty about state prices. Knightian uncertainty leads naturally to nonlinear expectations. We introduce a corresponding equilibrium concept with sublinear prices and prove that equilibria exist under weak conditions. In general, such equilibria lead to Pareto inefficient allocations; the equilibria coincide with Arrow-Debreu equilibria only if the values of net trades are ambiguity-free in the mean. In economies without aggregate uncertainty, inefficiencies are generic. We introduce a constrained efficiency concept, uncertainty-neutral efficiency, equilibrium allocations under price uncertainty are efficient in this constrained sense. Arrow-Debreu equilibria turn out to be non-robust with respect to the introduction of Knightian uncertainty.

10.3982/ecta14934.abstractZh: 我们研究的是那些代理人面临关于状态价格的不确定性问题的经济体系。这种不确定性自然会导致非线性预期。我们引入了一个相应的均衡概念，其中价格呈次线性，并证明了在弱条件下均衡是存在的。通常情况下，这样的均衡会导致帕累托无效率的分配；只有当净交易的价值在平均意义上没有歧义时，均衡才与阿罗-德布鲁均衡一致。在没有总体不确定性的经济体系中，这种无效率是普遍存在的。我们引入了一个受限效率概念，即不确定性中立效率，在价格不确定性的情况下，均衡分配在这种受限意义上被认为是有效的。而阿罗-德布鲁均衡在引入不确定性时并不具有鲁棒性。

abstract.text: We introduce a new solution concept for models of coalition formation, called the myopic stable set (MSS). The MSS is defined for a general class of social environments and allows for an infinite state space. An MSS exists and, under minor continuity assumptions, it is also unique. The MSS generalizes and unifies various results from more specific applications. It coincides with the coalition structure core in coalition function form games when this set is nonempty; with the set of stable matchings in the Gale-Shapley matching model; with the set of pairwise stable networks and closed cycles in models of network formation; and with the set of pure strategy Nash equilibria in pseudo-potential games and finite supermodular games. We also characterize the MSS for the class of proper simple games.

10.3982/ecta14954.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的联盟形成模型的解概念，称为近视稳定集（MSS）。该概念适用于一般类型的社会环境，并允许存在无限的状态空间。近视稳定集是存在的，并且在适当的连续性假设下是唯一的。近视稳定集可以推广和统一来自更具体应用的各种结果。当该集合非空时，它与联盟函数形式博弈中的联盟结构核心相吻合；与Gale-Shapley匹配模型中的稳定匹配集合相吻合；与网络形成模型中的成对稳定网络和封闭循环相吻合；以及与伪势博弈和有限超模块博弈中的纯策略纳什均衡相吻合。我们还对适当简单博弈类中的近视稳定集进行了描述。

abstract.text: We show that in a class of I ‐agent mechanism design problems with evidence, commitment is unnecessary, randomization has no value, and robust incentive compatibility has no cost. In particular, for each agent i , we construct a simple disclosure game between the principal and agent i where the equilibrium strategies of the agents in these disclosure games give their equilibrium strategies in the game corresponding to the mechanism but where the principal is not committed to his response. In this equilibrium, the principal obtains the same payoff as in the optimal mechanism with commitment. As an application, we show that certain costly verification models can be characterized using equilibrium analysis of an associated model of evidence.

10.3982/ecta14991.abstractZh: 我们证明，在一类具有证据的信息机制设计中，承诺是不必要的，随机化没有价值，而稳健的激励相容性也没有成本。具体来说，对于每个代理人i，我们构造了一个简单的披露游戏，该游戏由主人和代理人i共同参与，这些披露游戏中的代理人策略相当于在相应机制下的均衡策略，但此时主人并不承诺对其回应。在这种均衡状态下，主人的收益与具有承诺的最优机制下的收益相同。作为应用，我们展示了某些昂贵的验证模型可以通过对相关证据模型的均衡分析来表征。

abstract.text: We study Pareto optimal policy reforms aimed at overhauling retirement financing as an integral part of the tax and transfer system. Our framework for policy analysis is a heterogeneous‐agent overlapping‐generations model that performs well in matching the aggregate and distributional features of the U.S. economy. We present a test of Pareto optimality that identifies the main source of inefficiency in the status quo policies. Our test suggests that lack of asset subsidies late in life is the main source of inefficiency when annuity markets are incomplete. We solve for Pareto optimal policy reforms and show that progressive asset subsidies provide a powerful tool for Pareto optimal reforms. On the other hand, earnings tax reforms do not always yield efficiency gains. We implement our Pareto optimal policy reform in an economy that features demographic change. The reform reduces the present discounted value of net resources consumed by each generation by about 7 to 11 percent in the steady state. These gains amount to a one‐time lump‐sum transfer to the initial generation equal to 10.5 percent of GDP.

10.3982/ecta15088.abstractZh: 我们研究了旨在彻底改革退休融资的帕累托最优政策改革，将其作为税收和转移支付体系的一个组成部分。我们的政策分析框架是一个异质代理人、多代重叠模型，该模型在匹配美国经济的整体和分布特征方面表现良好。我们提出了一种帕累托最优性检验方法，以识别现状政策中效率低下的主要来源。我们的测试表明，在年金市场不完善的情况下，晚年缺乏资产补贴是效率低下的主要原因。我们求解了帕累托最优政策改革方案，并发现渐进式资产补贴是实现帕累托最优改革的强大工具。另一方面，所得税改革并不总是能带来效率提升。我们在具有人口变化特征的经济体中实施了帕累托最优政策改革。该改革使各代人在稳态下消耗的净资源的现值减少了7%到11%。这些收益相当于对初始代人群体进行一次性的总额转移，金额相当于GDP的10.5%。

abstract.text: This paper develops a dynamic model of rational behavior under uncertainty, in which the agent maximizes the stream of future τ ‐quantile utilities, for τ ∈ (0,1). That is, the agent has a quantile utility preference instead of the standard expected utility. Quantile preferences have useful advantages, including the ability to capture heterogeneity and allowing the separation between risk aversion and elasticity of intertemporal substitution. Although quantiles do not share some of the helpful properties of expectations, such as linearity and the law of iterated expectations, we are able to establish all the standard results in dynamic models. Namely, we show that the quantile preferences are dynamically consistent, the corresponding dynamic problem yields a value function, via a fixed point argument, this value function is concave and differentiable, and the principle of optimality holds. Additionally, we derive the corresponding Euler equation, which is well suited for using well‐known quantile regression methods for estimating and testing the economic model. In this way, the parameters of the model can be interpreted as structural objects. Therefore, the proposed methods provide microeconomic foundations for quantile regression methods. To illustrate the developments, we construct an intertemporal consumption model and estimate the discount factor and elasticity of intertemporal substitution parameters across the quantiles. The results provide evidence of heterogeneity in these parameters.

10.3982/ecta15146.abstractZh: 本文发展了一个在不确定性下的理性行为动态模型，其中代理人旨在最大化未来的τ分位数效用，其中τ∈(0,1)。也就是说，代理人具有分位数效用偏好，而非标准的期望效用。分位数偏好具有一些有用的优势，包括能够捕捉异质性，以及允许将风险厌恶与跨期替代弹性分开。尽管分位数不具备期望效用的一些有益特性，如线性和迭代期望法则，但我们仍然能够在动态模型中得到所有标准结果。具体来说，我们证明了分位数偏好在动态上是一致的，相应的动态问题通过不动点论证产生了一个价值函数，该价值函数是凹的且可微的，并且遵循最优性原理。此外，我们还推导出了相应的欧拉方程，该方程非常适合使用众所周知的分位数回归方法来估计和检验经济模型。通过这种方式，模型的参数可以被解释为结构对象。因此，所提出的方法为分位数回归方法提供了微观经济基础。为了说明这些发展，我们构建了一个跨期消费模型，并估计了不同分位数下的贴现因子和跨期替代弹性参数。结果证明了这些参数存在异质性。

abstract.text: We provide a nonlinear characterization of the macroeconomic impact of microeconomic productivity shocks in terms of reduced‐form nonparametric elasticities for efficient economies. We also show how microeconomic parameters are mapped to these reduced‐form general equilibrium elasticities. In this sense, we extend the foundational theorem of Hulten (1978) beyond the first order to capture nonlinearities. Key features ignored by first‐order approximations that play a crucial role are: structural microeconomic elasticities of substitution, network linkages, structural microeconomic returns to scale, and the extent of factor reallocation. In a business‐cycle calibration with sectoral shocks, nonlinearities magnify negative shocks and attenuate positive shocks, resulting in an aggregate output distribution that is asymmetric (negative skewness), fat‐tailed (excess kurtosis), and has a negative mean, even when shocks are symmetric and thin‐tailed. Average output losses due to short‐run sectoral shocks are an order of magnitude larger than the welfare cost of business cycles calculated by Lucas (1987). Nonlinearities can also cause shocks to critical sectors to have disproportionate macroeconomic effects, almost tripling the estimated impact of the 1970s oil shocks on world aggregate output. Finally, in a long‐run growth context, nonlinearities, which underpin Baumol's cost disease via the increase over time in the sales shares of low‐growth bottleneck sectors, account for a 20 percentage point reduction in aggregate TFP growth over the period 1948–2014 in the United States.

10.3982/ecta15202.abstractZh: 我们提供了一种非线性表征方法，用于描述微观经济生产率冲击对宏观经济的影响，该方法通过降阶非参数弹性来刻画高效经济体的动态特性。我们还展示了如何将微观经济参数映射到这些降阶一般均衡弹性上。从这个意义上说，我们扩展了Hulten在1978年提出的基础定理，使其超越一阶近似，以捕捉非线性效应。一阶近似忽略的关键特征包括：结构性微观经济替代弹性、网络联系、结构性微观经济规模报酬以及要素再分配的程度。在包含行业冲击的商业周期校准中，非线性效应会放大负面冲击，并减弱正面冲击，从而导致总体产出分布呈现不对称（负偏度）、厚尾（超额峰度）且均值为负的特点，即使冲击是对称的且呈薄尾分布。由于短期行业冲击导致的平均产出损失，比Lucas在1987年计算的商业周期福利成本要大一个数量级。非线性效应还可能导致关键行业受到不成比例的宏观经济影响，例如，1970年代石油冲击对全球总产出的影响估计值几乎增加了三倍。最后，在长期增长背景下，非线性效应通过增加低增长瓶颈行业的销售份额，解释了1948年至2014年间美国总体技术效率增长减少了20个百分点。

abstract.text: Half of U.S. 50‐year‐olds will experience a nursing home stay before they die, and one in ten will incur out‐of‐pocket long‐term care expenses in excess of $200,000. Surprisingly, only about 10% of individuals over age 62 have private long‐term care insurance (LTCI) and LTCI takeup rates are low at all wealth levels. We analyze the contributions of Medicaid, administrative costs, and asymmetric information about nursing home entry risk to low LTCI takeup rates in a quantitative equilibrium contracting model. As in practice, the insurer in the model assigns individuals to risk groups based on noisy indicators of their nursing home entry risk. All individuals in frail and/or low‐income risk groups are denied coverage because the cost of insuring any individual in these groups exceeds that individual's willingness‐to‐pay. Individuals in insurable risk groups are offered a menu of contracts whose terms vary across risk groups. We find that Medicaid accounts for low LTCI takeup rates of poorer individuals. However, administrative costs and adverse selection are responsible for low takeup rates of the rich. The model reproduces other empirical features of the LTCI market including the fact that owners of LTCI have about the same nursing home entry rates as non‐owners.

10.3982/ecta15295.abstractZh: 在美国，50岁的人中有一半会在去世前入住养老院，而每十个人中就有一个需要承担超过20万美元的长期护理费用。令人惊讶的是，只有大约10%的62岁以上的人拥有私人长期护理保险，而且无论财富水平如何，长期护理保险的普及率都很低。我们在一个定量均衡契约模型中分析了医疗补助、行政成本以及关于入住养老院风险的不对称信息对长期护理保险普及率较低的影响。正如实际情况一样，模型中的保险公司会根据一些不准确的指标将个体分配到不同的风险组。所有属于脆弱和/或低收入风险组的个体都被拒绝承保，因为为这些群体中的任何个体投保的成本超过了他们的支付意愿。属于可承保风险组的个体则会被提供一系列合同，其条款因风险组的不同而有所差异。我们发现，医疗补助是导致较贫困人群长期护理保险普及率较低的原因。然而，行政成本和逆向选择则是导致富人长期护理保险普及率较低的原因。该模型还再现了长期护理保险市场的其他实证特征，包括拥有长期护理保险的人与没有保险的人在入住养老院的概率上大致相同。

abstract.text: We analyze financial markets in which agents face differential constraints on the set of assets in which they can trade. In particular, the assets available to each agent span a partition of the state space that can be strictly coarser than the partition spanned by the assets available in the market. We first show that the existence of differential constraints has an impact on prices and allocations as compared to a complete financial market with unconstrained agents. We consider the implications for survival, taking the work of Blume and Easley (2006) as a starting point. We show that whenever agents have identical correct beliefs and equal discount factors, and their partitions are nested, all agents survive. When agents have heterogeneous beliefs, differential constraints may allow agents with wrong beliefs to survive. Provided constraints are relevant (in a sense we define more precisely), the condition for an agent to survive is that his survival index is at least as large as that of the agents with finer partitions. We also study the impact of deregulation (an increase in the set of assets available to some agents). Unless the agent can adopt beliefs that are closer to the truth on the newly refined partition than those of less constrained agents, increasing his opportunities for trade might harm his chances for survival.

10.3982/ecta15328.abstractZh: 我们分析了金融市场中，各主体在可交易资产集合上面临不同约束的情况。具体而言，每个主体可选择的资产分布在状态空间中的一个划分上，该划分可能比市场上可选择的资产划分更为粗略。我们首先证明了，与完全无约束的金融市场相比，存在不同约束会对价格和分配产生影响。我们考虑了这一情况对生存的影响，以Blume和Easley（2006年）的研究为基础。我们指出，只要各主体持有相同的正确信念且折现率相等，并且它们的划分是嵌套的，那么所有主体都能存活。当主体持有异质信念时，不同约束可能允许持有错误信念的主体存活。只要这些约束是相关的（我们对此有更精确的定义），一个主体存活的条件是其生存指数至少与划分更精细的主体相当。我们还研究了放松管制（即增加某些主体可选择的资产数量）的影响。除非该主体能够采用更接近新划分下真实情况的信念，否则增加交易机会可能会降低其存活几率。

abstract.text: Structural econometric methods are often criticized for being sensitive to functional form assumptions. We study parametric estimators of the local average treatment effect (LATE) derived from a widely used class of latent threshold crossing models and show they yield LATE estimates algebraically equivalent to the instrumental variables (IV) estimator. Our leading example is Heckman's (1979) two‐step (“Heckit”) control function estimator which, with two‐sided non‐compliance, can be used to compute estimates of a variety of causal parameters. Equivalence with IV is established for a semiparametric family of control function estimators and shown to hold at interior solutions for a class of maximum likelihood estimators. Our results suggest differences between structural and IV estimates often stem from disagreements about the target parameter rather than from functional form assumptions per se. In cases where equivalence fails, reporting structural estimates of LATE alongside IV provides a simple means of assessing the credibility of structural extrapolation exercises.

10.3982/ecta15444.abstractZh: 结构计量经济学方法常常因对函数形式假设过于敏感而受到批评。我们研究了从一类广泛使用的潜在阈值穿越模型中得出的局部平均处理效应（LATE）的参数估计量，并证明这些估计量所得到的LATE结果在代数上等同于工具变量（IV）估计量。我们的主要例子是Heckman在1979年提出的两步控制函数估计方法，该方法通过双向非遵从性处理，可以用来计算多种因果参数的估计值。我们证明了这类半参数控制函数估计量与工具变量估计量之间的等价性，并且这种等价性在一系列最大似然估计量的内部解上仍然成立。我们的研究结果表明，结构估计量与工具变量估计量之间的差异往往源于对目标参数的不同理解，而非函数形式假设本身的问题。在等价性不成立的情况下，同时报告结构估计的LATE和工具变量估计量，可以为评估结构推断的可信度提供一种简单的方法。

abstract.text: We provide an axiomatic analysis of dynamic random utility, characterizing the stochastic choice behavior of agents who solve dynamic decision problems by maximizing some stochastic process ( U t ) of utilities. We show first that even when ( U t ) is arbitrary, dynamic random utility imposes new testable across‐period restrictions on behavior, over and above period‐by‐period analogs of the static random utility axioms. An important feature of dynamic random utility is that behavior may appear history‐dependent , because period‐ t choices reveal information about U t , which may be serially correlated; however, our key new axioms highlight that the model entails specific limits on the form of history dependence that can arise. Second, we show that imposing natural Bayesian rationality axioms restricts the form of randomness that ( U t ) can display. By contrast, a specification of utility shocks that is widely used in empirical work violates these restrictions, leading to behavior that may display a negative option value and can produce biased parameter estimates. Finally, dynamic stochastic choice data allow us to characterize important special cases of random utility—in particular, learning and taste persistence—that on static domains are indistinguishable from the general model.

10.3982/ecta15456.abstractZh: 我们提供了动态随机效用的公理分析，描述了通过最大化某个随机效用过程（U t）来解决动态决策问题的代理人的随机选择行为。我们首先证明，即使（U t）是任意的，动态随机效用也会对行为施加新的跨时期限制，这些限制超出了静态随机效用公理的逐时期限制。动态随机效用的一个重要特点是，行为可能表现出历史依赖性，因为第t期的选择会揭示关于U t的信息，而这些信息可能存在序列相关性；然而，我们的新公理强调，该模型对历史依赖的形式有特定的限制。其次，我们表明，施加自然贝叶斯理性公理会限制（U t）所显示的随机性的形式。相比之下，在实证研究中广泛使用的效用冲击模型规范会违反这些限制，从而导致行为可能表现出负的选择价值，并可能产生有偏的参数估计。最后，动态随机选择数据使我们能够描述随机效用的重要特殊情况——特别是学习和偏好持久性——在静态领域中与一般模型无法区分。

abstract.text: A general selection theorem is presented constructing a measurable mapping from a state space to a parameter space under the assumption that the state space can be decomposed as a collection of countable equivalence classes under a smooth equivalence relation. It is then shown how this selection theorem can be used as a general purpose tool for proving the existence of measurable equilibria in broad classes of several branches of games when an appropriate smoothness condition holds, including Bayesian games with atomic knowledge spaces, stochastic games with countable orbits, and graphical games of countable degree—examples of a subclass of games with uncountable state spaces that we term purely atomic games. Applications to repeated games with symmetric incomplete information and acceptable bets are also presented.

10.3982/ecta15479.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种通用选择定理，该定理在假设状态空间可以分解为具有平滑等价关系的可数等价类的情况下，构建从状态空间到参数空间的可测映射。随后展示了如何利用这一选择定理作为通用工具，在适当的平滑条件下证明多种博弈类别中存在可测均衡的存在性，包括具有原子知识空间的贝叶斯博弈、具有可数轨道的随机博弈，以及具有可数阶的图博弈——这些博弈属于具有不可数状态空间的博弈的一个子类，我们将其称为纯原子博弈。文中还介绍了该定理在具有对称不完全信息且允许接受赌注的重复博弈中的应用。

abstract.text: We can often predict the behavior of those closest to us more accurately than that of complete strangers, yet we routinely engage in strategic situations with both: our social network impacts our strategic knowledge. Peer‐confirming equilibrium describes the behavioral consequences of this intuition in a noncooperative game. We augment a game with a network to represent strategic information: if two players are linked in the network, they have correct conjectures about each others' strategies. In peer‐confirming equilibrium, there is common belief that players (i) behave rationally and (ii) correctly anticipate neighbors' play. In simultaneous‐move games, adding links to the network always restricts the set of outcomes. In dynamic games, the outcome set may vary non‐monotonically with the network because the actions of well‐connected players help poorly‐connected players coordinate. This solution concept provides a useful language for studying public good provision, highlights a new channel through which central individuals facilitate coordination, and delineates possible sources of miscoordination in protests and coups.

10.3982/ecta15597.abstractZh: 我们往往能够比预测完全陌生人的行为更准确地预测与自己关系密切的人的行为，然而在实际中，我们却经常与这两者同时打交道：我们的社交网络影响着我们的战略认知。同伴确认均衡描述了这种直觉在非合作博弈中的行为后果。我们通过网络来补充博弈，以表示战略信息：如果两个玩家在网络中相连，那么他们对彼此的策略就有正确的预测。在同伴确认均衡中，人们普遍认为玩家（i）会理性行事，以及（ii）能够正确地预测邻居的行为。在同时行动博弈中，向网络中添加链接总是会限制结果集。在动态博弈中，由于连接良好的玩家的行为有助于连接较差的玩家进行协调，结果集可能会非单调地变化。这一解决方案概念为研究公共物品供给提供了有用的语言，揭示了中央个体促进协调的新途径，并指出了抗议和政变中可能出现的不协调来源。

abstract.text: A sender persuades a receiver to accept a project by disclosing information about a payoff‐relevant quality. The receiver has private information about the quality, referred to as his type. We show that the sender‐optimal mechanism takes the form of nested intervals: each type accepts on an interval of qualities and a more optimistic type's interval contains a less optimistic type's interval. This nested‐interval structure offers a simple algorithm to solve for the optimal disclosure and connects our problem to the monopoly screening problem.
