The mechanism is optimal even if the sender conditions the disclosure mechanism on the receiver's reported type.

10.3982/ecta15668.abstractZh: 发送者通过披露与收益相关的信息来说服接收者接受一个项目。接收者拥有关于该质量的私人信息，我们称之为他的类型。我们证明，发送者最优的机制表现为嵌套区间的形式：每种类型在特定的质量区间内接受项目，且较乐观类型的区间包含较不乐观类型的区间。这种嵌套区间结构提供了一种简单的算法来求解最优披露方案，并将我们的问题与垄断筛选问题联系起来。即使发送者根据接收者报告的类型来设定披露机制，该机制仍然是最优的。

abstract.text: We propose a new solution for discrete exchange economies and resource‐allocation problems, the exclusion core. The exclusion core rests upon a foundational idea in the legal understanding of property, the right to exclude others. By reinterpreting endowments as a distribution of exclusion rights, rather than as bundles of goods, our analysis extends to economies with qualified property rights, joint ownership, and social hierarchies. The exclusion core is characterized by a generalized top trading cycle algorithm in a large class of economies, including those featuring private, public, and mixed ownership. It is neither weaker nor stronger than the strong core.

10.3982/ecta15676.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种针对离散交换经济和资源分配问题的新解决方案，即排除核心。排除核心基于法律对财产理解中的一个基础概念，即排除他人的权利。通过将财产重新解释为排除权利的分配，而非商品束，我们的分析可以扩展到具有合格财产权、共同所有权和社会等级制度的经济体系中。排除核心的特点是在一大类经济体系中具有通用的顶级交易循环算法，包括私人、公共和混合所有制的经济体系。它既不像强核心那样弱，也不像强核心那样强。

abstract.text: A receiver wants to learn multidimensional information from a sender, and she has the capacity to verify just one dimension. The sender's payoff depends on the belief he induces, via an exogenously given monotone function. We show that by using a randomized verification strategy, the receiver can learn the sender's information fully in many cases. We characterize exactly when it is possible to do so. In particular, when the exogenous payoff function is submodular, we can explicitly describe a full‐learning mechanism; when it is (strictly) supermodular, full learning is not possible. In leading cases where full learning is possible, it can be attained using an indirect mechanism in which the sender chooses the probability of verifying each dimension.

10.3982/ecta15712.abstractZh: 接收者希望从发送者那里获取多维信息，但她只能验证一个维度。发送者的收益取决于他引发的信念，这一信念是通过一个外生给定的单调函数来确定的。我们证明了，通过使用随机验证策略，接收者在许多情况下可以完全获取发送者的信息。我们详细描述了在什么情况下可以实现这种完全学习。特别是当外生收益函数是次模函数时，我们可以明确描述一种完全学习机制；而当它是（严格）超模函数时，完全学习则无法实现。在完全学习可能实现的主要情况下，可以通过一种间接机制来实现，即发送者选择验证每个维度的概率。

abstract.text: We propose a framework to identify and estimate earnings distributions and worker composition on matched panel data, allowing for two‐sided worker‐firm unobserved heterogeneity and complementarities in earnings. We introduce two models: a static model that allows for nonlinear interactions between workers and firms, and a dynamic model that allows, in addition, for Markovian earnings dynamics and endogenous mobility. We show that this framework nests a number of structural models of wages and worker mobility. We establish identification in short panels, and develop tractable two‐step estimators where firms are classified in a first step. Applying our method to Swedish administrative data, we find that log‐earnings are approximately additive in worker and firm heterogeneity. Our estimates imply the presence of strong sorting patterns between workers and firms, and a small contribution of firms—net of worker composition—to earnings dispersion. In addition, we document that wages have a direct effect on mobility, and that, beyond their dependence on the current firm, earnings after a job move also depend on the previous employer.

10.3982/ecta15722.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个框架，用于识别和估计匹配面板数据中的收入分布和工人构成，该框架能够同时考虑工人与企业的双向异质性和收入之间的互补性。我们引入了两个模型：一个静态模型，允许工人与企业的非线性互动；以及一个动态模型，除了允许 Markov 型收入动态和内生流动性外，还考虑了工人与企业的互动。我们证明这个框架包含了许多关于工资和工人流动性的结构模型。我们在短面板数据中建立了识别性，并开发了可行的两步估计方法，其中企业在第一步中被分类。将我们的方法应用于瑞典的行政数据，我们发现对数收入在工人和企业异质性方面大致是可加性的。我们的估计结果表明，工人与企业在收入分配上存在明显的排序模式，而企业对收入分散的贡献较小——仅考虑工人的构成。此外，我们还发现工资对流动性有直接影响，而且，除了依赖于当前企业外，工作调动后的收入还取决于之前的雇主。

abstract.text: The main result in Daskalakis, Deckelbaum, and Tzamos (2017) establishes strong duality in the monopoly problem with an argument based on transportation theory. We provide a short, alternative proof using linear programming.

10.3982/ecta15735.abstractZh: Daskalakis、Deckelbaum和Tzamos在2017年的研究中得出了垄断问题中的强对偶性结论，其论证基于运输理论。我们提供了一种使用线性规划的简短替代证明。

abstract.text: Fan, Liao, and Yao (2015) recently introduced a remarkable method for increasing the asymptotic power of tests in high‐dimensional testing problems. If applicable to a given test, their power enhancement principle leads to an improved test that has the same asymptotic size, has uniformly non‐inferior asymptotic power, and is consistent against a strictly broader range of alternatives than the initially given test. We study under which conditions this method can be applied and show the following: In asymptotic regimes where the dimensionality of the parameter space is fixed as sample size increases, there often exist tests that cannot be further improved with the power enhancement principle. However, when the dimensionality of the parameter space increases sufficiently slowly with sample size and a marginal local asymptotic normality (LAN) condition is satisfied, every test with asymptotic size smaller than 1 can be improved with the power enhancement principle. While the marginal LAN condition alone does not allow one to extend the latter statement to all rates at which the dimensionality increases with sample size, we give sufficient conditions under which this is the case.

10.3982/ecta15844.abstractZh: 范、廖和姚在2015年提出了一种显著的方法，用于提高高维检验问题的渐近功效。如果该方法适用于某个特定的检验，其功效增强原理将导致一个改进的检验，该检验具有相同的渐近大小，具有均匀的非劣渐近功效，并且能够抵御比初始检验更广泛的替代假设。我们研究了在哪些条件下可以应用这种方法，并得出以下结论：在参数空间的维度在样本量增加时不固定的渐近情况下，通常存在无法通过功效增强原理进一步改进的检验。然而，当参数空间的维度随样本量缓慢增加时，并且满足边际局部渐近正态性条件时，所有渐近大小小于1的检验都可以通过功效增强原理得到改进。虽然边际渐近正态性条件本身并不能将这一结论推广到参数空间维度随样本量增加的任何速率，但我们给出了在这种情况下成立的条件。

abstract.text: We revisit prominent learning models in which a sequence of agents make a binary decision on the basis of both a private signal and information related to past choices. We analyze the efficiency of learning in these models, measured in terms of the expected welfare. We show that, irrespective of the distribution of private signals, learning efficiency is the same whether each agent observes the entire sequence of earlier decisions or only the previous decision. In addition, we provide a simple condition on the signal distributions that is necessary and sufficient for learning efficiency. This condition fails to hold in many cases of interest. We discuss a number of extensions and variants.

10.3982/ecta15845.abstractZh: 我们重新审视了一些重要的学习模型，这些模型中的一系列代理基于私有信号以及与过去选择相关的信息做出二元决策。我们分析了这些模型中学习的效率，以预期福利来衡量。我们发现，无论私有信号的分布如何，如果每个代理都观察到所有之前的决策，还是仅观察到前一个决策，学习的效率都是相同的。此外，我们提出了一种关于信号分布的简单条件，这个条件对于学习效率来说既是必要的，也是充分的。然而，在许多感兴趣的案例中，这个条件并不成立。我们还讨论了一些扩展和变体。

abstract.text: This paper provides nonparametric identification results for a class of latent utility models with additively separable unobservable heterogeneity. These results apply to existing models of discrete choice, bundles, decisions under uncertainty, and matching. Under an independence assumption, such models admit a representative agent. As a result, we can identify how regressors alter the desirability of goods using only average demands. Moreover, average indirect utility (“welfare”) is identified without needing to specify or identify the distribution of unobservable heterogeneity.

10.3982/ecta15867.abstractZh: 本文为具有可加性可分离不可观测异质性的潜在效用模型类提供了非参数识别结果。这些结果适用于离散选择、捆绑选择、不确定性下的决策以及匹配等现有模型。在独立性假设下，这类模型允许采用代表性代理人进行识别。因此，我们仅通过平均需求就可以识别回归变量如何改变商品的吸引力。此外，平均间接效用（“福利”）的识别无需指定或确定不可观测异质性的分布。

abstract.text: We define and investigate a property of mechanisms that we call “strategic simplicity,” and that is meant to capture the idea that, in strategically simple mechanisms, strategic choices require limited strategic sophistication. We define a mechanism to be strategically simple if choices can be based on first‐order beliefs about the other agents' preferences and first‐order certainty about the other agents' rationality alone, and there is no need for agents to form higher‐order beliefs, because such beliefs are irrelevant to the optimal strategies. All dominant strategy mechanisms are strategically simple. But many more mechanisms are strategically simple. In particular, strategically simple mechanisms may be more flexible than dominant strategy mechanisms in the bilateral trade problem and the voting problem.

10.3982/ecta15897.abstractZh: 我们定义并研究了一种机制的特性，称之为“战略简单性”。这种特性旨在体现这样一个概念：在战略简单的机制中，战略选择所需的战略复杂性是有限的。如果一个机制的选择可以仅基于对其他代理人的偏好的一阶信念以及对其他代理人理性的第一阶确定性，并且代理人不需要形成更高阶的信念，因为这样的信念与最优策略无关，那么这种机制就被认为是战略简单的。所有占优策略机制都是战略简单的。但实际上，还有更多的机制是战略简单的。特别是在双边贸易问题和投票问题中，战略简单的机制可能比占优策略机制更加灵活。

abstract.text: Many decision situations involve two or more of the following divergences from subjective expected utility: imprecision of beliefs (or ambiguity), imprecision of tastes (or multi‐utility), and state dependence of utility. This paper proposes and characterizes a model of uncertainty averse preferences that can simultaneously incorporate all three phenomena. The representation supports a principled separation of (imprecise) beliefs and (potentially state‐dependent, imprecise) tastes. Moreover, the representation permits comparative statics separating the roles of beliefs and tastes, and is modular: it easily delivers special cases involving various combinations of the phenomena, as well as state‐dependent multi‐utility generalizations covering popular ambiguity models.

10.3982/ecta15916.abstractZh: 许多决策情境涉及以下三种从主观期望效用出发的偏差：信念的不精确性（或模糊性）、偏好的不精确性（或多效用），以及效用的状态依赖性。本文提出并描述了一种不确定性厌恶偏好模型，该模型能够同时涵盖这三种现象。该模型支持将（不精确的）信念和（可能依赖于状态的、不精确的）偏好进行原则性区分。此外，该模型允许通过比较静态分析来分离信念和偏好的作用，并且具有模块化特性：它能够轻松处理涉及各种组合现象的特殊情况，以及涵盖常见模糊性模型的、依赖于状态的多元效用概括。

abstract.text: We develop a framework to study the dynamics of vote trading over multiple binary issues. We prove that there always exists a stable allocation of votes that is reachable in a finite number of trades, for any number of voters and issues, any separable preference profile, and any restrictions on the coalitions that may form. If at every step all blocking trades are chosen with positive probability, convergence to a stable allocation occurs in finite time with probability 1. If coalitions are unrestricted, the outcome of vote trading must be Pareto optimal, but unless there are three voters or two issues, it need not correspond to the Condorcet winner.

10.3982/ecta15940.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个框架，用于研究多个二元议题上的投票交易动态。我们证明了，对于任何数量的选民、议题、可分离偏好配置，以及可能形成的联盟所受的任何限制，总存在一种在有限次交易中可以实现的稳定投票分配。如果每一步都以正概率选择所有能够阻止交易的交易，那么稳定分配在有限时间内以1的概率实现。如果联盟不受限制，投票交易的结果必然是帕累托最优的，但除非有三位选民或两个议题，否则不一定会对应到康德赛特获胜者。

abstract.text: How should a society choose between two social alternatives if participation in the decision process is voluntary and costly, and monetary transfers are not feasible? Assuming symmetric independent private values, we show that it is utilitarian‐optimal to use a linear voting rule: votes get alternative‐dependent weights, and a default obtains if the weighted sum of votes stays below some threshold. Any combination of weights and threshold can be optimal. A standard quorum rule can be optimal only when it yields the same outcome as a linear rule. A linear rule is called upper linear if the default is upset at every election result that meets the threshold exactly. We develop a perturbation method to characterize equilibria of voting rules in the case of small participation costs and show that leaving participation voluntary increases welfare for any two‐sided upper linear rule that is optimal under compulsory participation.

10.3982/ecta16004.abstractZh: 如果参与决策过程是自愿的且成本较高，而货币转移不可行，那么社会应该如何在两种社会选择之间做出抉择？假设私人价值观是对称的且相互独立的，我们表明使用线性投票规则是功利最优的：投票结果会获得与备选方案相关的权重，并且如果投票加权和低于某个阈值，则默认情况下会采用该权重。任何权重和阈值的组合都可能是最优的。标准的法定人数规则只有在与线性规则产生相同结果时才是最优的。如果每次达到阈值时都会打破默认权重，那么线性规则被称为上线性规则。我们开发了一种扰动方法，用于描述小参与成本情况下的投票规则均衡，并表明在强制参与的情况下，让参与过程保持自愿性可以提高任何上线性规则下的福利。

abstract.text: Harsanyi (1974) and Ray and Vohra (2015) extended the stable set of von Neumann and Morgenstern to impose farsighted credibility on coalitional deviations. But the resulting farsighted stable set suffers from a conceptual drawback: while coalitional moves improve on existing outcomes, coalitions might do even better by moving elsewhere. Or other coalitions might intervene to impose their favored moves. We show that every farsighted stable set satisfying some reasonable and easily verifiable properties is unaffected by the imposition of these stringent maximality constraints. The properties we describe are satisfied by many, but not all, farsighted stable sets.

10.3982/ecta16047.abstractZh: Harsanyi（1974）和Ray与Vohra（2015）将冯·诺伊曼和摩根斯坦的稳定集扩展，以对联盟决策施加前瞻性可信度要求。然而，由此产生的前瞻性稳定集存在一个概念上的缺陷：虽然联盟决策可以改善现有结果，但联盟可能通过转向其他策略取得更好的效果。或者，其他联盟也可能介入，以实施他们偏爱的决策。我们证明，每一个满足某些合理且易于验证属性的前瞻性稳定集，都不会受到这些严格的最大化约束的影响。我们所描述的这些属性被许多但并非所有的前瞻性稳定集所满足。

abstract.text: Can participation in financial markets lead individuals to reevaluate the costs of conflict, change their political attitudes, and even their votes? Prior to the 2015 Israeli elections, we randomly assigned Palestinian and Israeli financial assets to likely voters and incentivized them to actively trade for up to 7 weeks. No political messages or nonfinancial information were included. The treatment systematically shifted vote choices toward parties more supportive of the peace process. This effect is not due to a direct material incentive to vote a particular way. Rather, the treatment reduces opposition to concessions for peace and changes awareness of the broader economic risks of conflict. While participants who were assigned Palestinian assets are more likely to associate their assets' performance with peace, they are less engaged in the experiment. Combined with the superior performance of Israeli stocks during the study period, the ultimate effects of Israeli and Palestinian assets are similar.

10.3982/ecta16385.abstractZh: 参与金融市场是否会促使个人重新评估冲突的成本，改变他们的政治态度，甚至投票选择？在2015年以色列选举之前，我们将巴勒斯坦和以色列的金融资产随机分配给可能的选民，并激励他们进行长达7周的积极交易。过程中未包含任何政治信息或非财务信息。这种处理方式系统性地将投票选择转向了更支持和平进程的政党。这种效应并非由于直接的物质激励而促使人们以特定方式投票。相反，这种处理方式降低了人们对和平妥协的反对态度，并改变了人们对冲突带来的更广泛经济风险的认识。虽然被分配了巴勒斯坦金融资产的参与者更有可能将资产表现与和平联系起来，但他们参与实验的意愿较低。结合研究期间以色列股票表现更优的情况，以色列和巴勒斯坦金融资产的最终效果是相似的。

abstract.text: We study the problem of measuring group differences in choices when the dimensionality of the choice set is large. We show that standard approaches suffer from a severe finite‐sample bias, and we propose an estimator that applies recent advances in machine learning to address this bias. We apply this method to measure trends in the partisanship of congressional speech from 1873 to 2016, defining partisanship to be the ease with which an observer could infer a congressperson's party from a single utterance. Our estimates imply that partisanship is far greater in recent years than in the past, and that it increased sharply in the early 1990s after remaining low and relatively constant over the preceding century.

10.3982/ecta16566.abstractZh: 我们研究了在选择集合的维度较大时，衡量群体选择差异的问题。我们发现标准方法存在严重的有限样本偏差，并提出了一种利用机器学习最新进展的估计方法来解决这一偏差。我们应用这种方法来衡量1873年至2016年间国会演讲中党派倾向的变化趋势，其中党派倾向是指观察者从单次发言中能够轻易推断出国会议员的党派归属的程度。我们的估计结果显示，与过去相比，当前的党派倾向明显更强，并且在20世纪90年代初急剧上升，而在之前的百年间则保持较低且相对稳定的水平。

abstract.text: In this note, we reconsider Arrow–Enthoven’s (1961) Sufficiency Theorem 1 onquasi-concave programming [Econometrica, 29(4), p. 783]. One example illustrates thefact that condition (c) of their Theorem 1 should include the twice continuous differen-tiability of the quasi-concave objective function so that the conditions of the theoremare sufficient to identify global optima.

10.3982/ecta17014.abstractZh: 在这篇论文中，我们重新考虑了Arrow–Enthoven在1961年提出的关于准凹规划的充分性定理[《Econometrica》，29(4)，第783页]。一个例子表明，他们的定理1中的条件(c)应包括准凹目标函数的两次连续可微性，只有这样，定理的条件才足以确定全局最优解。

abstract.text: We obtain a recursive formulation for a general class of optimization problems with forward‐looking constraints which often arise in economic dynamic models, for example, in contracting problems with incentive constraints or in models of optimal policy. In this case, the solution does not satisfy the Bellman equation. Our approach consists of studying a recursive Lagrangian. Under standard general conditions, there is a recursive saddle‐point functional equation (analogous to a Bellman equation) that characterizes a recursive solution to the planner's problem. The recursive formulation is obtained after adding a co‐state variable μ t summarizing previous commitments reflected in past Lagrange multipliers. The continuation problem is obtained with μ t playing the role of weights in the objective function. Our approach is applicable to characterizing and computing solutions to a large class of dynamic contracting problems.

10.3982/ecta9902.abstractZh: 我们为一类具有前瞻性约束的优化问题获得了递归公式，这类问题经常出现在经济动态模型中，例如，在带有激励约束的契约问题或最优政策模型中。在这种情况下，解不满足贝尔曼方程。我们的方法包括研究递归拉格朗日函数。在标准一般条件下，存在一个递归鞍点泛函方程（类似于贝尔曼方程），它描述了规划问题的递归解。在添加了一个共状态变量μt后，可以得到递归公式，该变量总结了过去承诺的影响，这些影响反映在过去的拉格朗日乘数中。继续问题可以通过让μt在目标函数中充当权重来解决。我们的方法适用于描述和计算大量动态契约问题的解。

abstract.text: The data and programs replicate tables and figures from "Identifying Sources of Inefficiency in Healthcare", by Chandra and Staiger. Please see the Readme file for additional details.
